title: Genesis 1:1
text: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

title: Genesis 1:2
text: And the earth was waste and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep: and the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

title: Genesis 1:3
text: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

title: Genesis 1:4
text: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.

title: Genesis 1:5
text: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, one day.

title: Genesis 1:6
text: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.

title: Genesis 1:7
text: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.

title: Genesis 1:8
text: And God called the firmament Heaven. And there was evening and there was morning, a second day.

title: Genesis 1:9
text: And God said, Let the waters under the heavens be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.

title: Genesis 1:10
text: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.

title: Genesis 1:11
text: And God said, Let the earth put forth grass, herbs yielding seed, [and] fruit-trees bearing fruit after their kind, wherein is the seed thereof, upon the earth: and it was so.

title: Genesis 1:12
text: And the earth brought forth grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, wherein is the seed thereof, after their kind: and God saw that it was good.

title: Genesis 1:13
text: And there was evening and there was morning, a third day.

title: Genesis 1:14
text: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days and years:

title: Genesis 1:15
text: and let them be for lights in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.

title: Genesis 1:16
text: And God made the two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: [he made] the stars also.

title: Genesis 1:17
text: And God set them in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth,

title: Genesis 1:18
text: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.

title: Genesis 1:19
text: And there was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

title: Genesis 1:20
text: And God said, Let the waters swarm with swarms of living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.

title: Genesis 1:21
text: And God created the great sea-monsters, and every living creature that moveth, wherewith the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind: and God saw that it was good.

title: Genesis 1:22
text: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.

title: Genesis 1:23
text: And there was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

title: Genesis 1:24
text: And God said, Let the earth bring forth living creatures after their kind, cattle, and creeping things, and beasts of the earth after their kind: and it was so.

title: Genesis 1:25
text: And God made the beasts of the earth after their kind, and the cattle after their kind, and everything that creepeth upon the ground after its kind: and God saw that it was good.

title: Genesis 1:26
text: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the heavens, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

title: Genesis 1:27
text: And God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

title: Genesis 1:28
text: And God blessed them: and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it; and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the heavens, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.

title: Genesis 1:29
text: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for food:

title: Genesis 1:30
text: and to every beast of the earth, and to every bird of the heavens, and to everything that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, [I have given] every green herb for food: and it was so.

title: Genesis 1:31
text: And God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.

title: Genesis 2:1
text: And the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.

title: Genesis 2:2
text: And on the seventh day God finished his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

title: Genesis 2:3
text: And God blessed the seventh day, and hallowed it; because that in it he rested from all his work which God had created and made.

title: Genesis 2:4
text: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that Jehovah God made earth and heaven.

title: Genesis 2:5
text: And no plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for Jehovah God had not caused it to rain upon the earth: and there was not a man to till the ground;

title: Genesis 2:6
text: but there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.

title: Genesis 2:7
text: And Jehovah God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

title: Genesis 2:8
text: And Jehovah God planted a garden eastward, in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.

title: Genesis 2:9
text: And out of the ground made Jehovah God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

title: Genesis 2:10
text: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became four heads.

title: Genesis 2:11
text: The name of the first is Pishon: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

title: Genesis 2:12
text: and the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.

title: Genesis 2:13
text: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Cush.

title: Genesis 2:14
text: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth in front of Assyria. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.

title: Genesis 2:15
text: And Jehovah God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

title: Genesis 2:16
text: And Jehovah God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:

title: Genesis 2:17
text: but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.

title: Genesis 2:18
text: And Jehovah God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a help meet for him.

title: Genesis 2:19
text: And out of the ground Jehovah God formed every beast of the field, and every bird of the heavens; and brought them unto the man to see what he would call them: and whatsoever the man called every living creature, that was the name thereof.

title: Genesis 2:20
text: And the man gave names to all cattle, and to the birds of the heavens, and to every beast of the field; but for man there was not found a help meet for him.

title: Genesis 2:21
text: And Jehovah God caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man, and he slept; and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof:

title: Genesis 2:22
text: and the rib, which Jehovah God had taken from the man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.

title: Genesis 2:23
text: And the man said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.

title: Genesis 2:24
text: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.

title: Genesis 2:25
text: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.

title: Genesis 3:1
text: Now the serpent was more subtle than any beast of the field which Jehovah God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of any tree of the garden?

title: Genesis 3:2
text: And the woman said unto the serpent, Of the fruit of the trees of the garden we may eat:

title: Genesis 3:3
text: but of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.

title: Genesis 3:4
text: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:

title: Genesis 3:5
text: for God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as God, knowing good and evil.

title: Genesis 3:6
text: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat; and she gave also unto her husband with her, and he did eat.

title: Genesis 3:7
text: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig-leaves together, and made themselves aprons.

title: Genesis 3:8
text: And they heard the voice of Jehovah God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Jehovah God amongst the trees of the garden.

title: Genesis 3:9
text: And Jehovah God called unto the man, and said unto him, Where art thou?

title: Genesis 3:10
text: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.

title: Genesis 3:11
text: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?

title: Genesis 3:12
text: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.

title: Genesis 3:13
text: And Jehovah God said unto the woman, What is this thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.

title: Genesis 3:14
text: And Jehovah God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, cursed art thou above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:

title: Genesis 3:15
text: and I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed: he shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.

title: Genesis 3:16
text: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy pain and thy conception; in pain thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.

title: Genesis 3:17
text: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in toil shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;

title: Genesis 3:18
text: thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;

title: Genesis 3:19
text: in the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.

title: Genesis 3:20
text: And the man called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.

title: Genesis 3:21
text: And Jehovah God made for Adam and for his wife coats of skins, and clothed them.

title: Genesis 3:22
text: And Jehovah God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil; and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever--

title: Genesis 3:23
text: therefore Jehovah God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.

title: Genesis 3:24
text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden the Cherubim, and the flame of a sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

title: Genesis 4:1
text: And the man knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man with [the help of] Jehovah.

title: Genesis 4:2
text: And again she bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

title: Genesis 4:3
text: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto Jehovah.

title: Genesis 4:4
text: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And Jehovah had respect unto Abel and to his offering:

title: Genesis 4:5
text: but unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.

title: Genesis 4:6
text: And Jehovah said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?

title: Genesis 4:7
text: If thou doest well, shall it not be lifted up? and if thou doest not well, sin coucheth at the door; and unto thee shall be its desire; but do thou rule over it.

title: Genesis 4:8
text: And Cain told Abel his brother. And it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.

title: Genesis 4:9
text: And Jehovah said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: am I my brother's keeper?

title: Genesis 4:10
text: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground.

title: Genesis 4:11
text: And now cursed art thou from the ground, which hath opened its mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand;

title: Genesis 4:12
text: when thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee its strength; a fugitive and a wanderer shalt thou be in the earth.

title: Genesis 4:13
text: And Cain said unto Jehovah, My punishment is greater than I can bear.

title: Genesis 4:14
text: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the ground; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth; and it will come to pass, that whosoever findeth me will slay me.

title: Genesis 4:15
text: And Jehovah said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And Jehovah appointed a sign for Cain, lest any finding him should smite him.

title: Genesis 4:16
text: And Cain went out from the presence of Jehovah, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

title: Genesis 4:17
text: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.

title: Genesis 4:18
text: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael; and Mehujael begat Methushael; and Methushael begat Lamech.

title: Genesis 4:19
text: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.

title: Genesis 4:20
text: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents and [have] cattle.

title: Genesis 4:21
text: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and pipe.

title: Genesis 4:22
text: And Zillah, she also bare Tubal-cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.

title: Genesis 4:23
text: And Lamech said unto his wives: Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; Ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: For I have slain a man for wounding me, And a young man for bruising me:

title: Genesis 4:24
text: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, Truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.

title: Genesis 4:25
text: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For, [said she], God hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel; for Cain slew him.

title: Genesis 4:26
text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enosh. Then began men to call upon the name of Jehovah.

title: Genesis 5:1
text: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;

title: Genesis 5:2
text: male and female created he them, and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.

title: Genesis 5:3
text: And Adam lived a hundred and thirty years, and begat [a son] in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:

title: Genesis 5:4
text: and the days of Adam after he begat Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 5:5
text: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.

title: Genesis 5:6
text: And Seth lived a hundred and five years, and begat Enosh:

title: Genesis 5:7
text: and Seth lived after he begat Enosh eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:

title: Genesis 5:8
text: and all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.

title: Genesis 5:9
text: And Enosh lived ninety years, and begat Kenan:

title: Genesis 5:10
text: and Enosh lived after he begat Kenan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:

title: Genesis 5:11
text: and all the days of Enosh were nine hundred and five years: and he died.

title: Genesis 5:12
text: And Kenan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalalel:

title: Genesis 5:13
text: and Kenan lived after he begat Mahalalel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:

title: Genesis 5:14
text: and all the days of Kenan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.

title: Genesis 5:15
text: And Mahalalel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:

title: Genesis 5:16
text: And Mahalalel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:

title: Genesis 5:17
text: and all the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.

title: Genesis 5:18
text: And Jared lived a hundred sixty and two years, and begat Enoch:

title: Genesis 5:19
text: and Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

title: Genesis 5:20
text: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.

title: Genesis 5:21
text: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:

title: Genesis 5:22
text: and Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

title: Genesis 5:23
text: and all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:

title: Genesis 5:24
text: and Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.

title: Genesis 5:25
text: And Methuselah lived a hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:

title: Genesis 5:26
text: and Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:

title: Genesis 5:27
text: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.

title: Genesis 5:28
text: And Lamech lived a hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:

title: Genesis 5:29
text: and he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, [which cometh] because of the ground which Jehovah hath cursed.

title: Genesis 5:30
text: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:

title: Genesis 5:31
text: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.

title: Genesis 5:32
text: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

title: Genesis 6:1
text: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the ground, and daughters were born unto them,

title: Genesis 6:2
text: that the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all that they chose.

title: Genesis 6:3
text: And Jehovah said, My Spirit shall not strive with man for ever, for that he also is flesh: yet shall his days be a hundred and twenty years. [

title: Genesis 6:4
text: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them: the same were the mighty men that were of old, the men of renown.

title: Genesis 6:5
text: And Jehovah saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

title: Genesis 6:6
text: And it repented Jehovah that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.

title: Genesis 6:7
text: And Jehovah said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the ground; both man, and beast, and creeping things, and birds of the heavens; for it repenteth me that I have made them.

title: Genesis 6:8
text: But Noah found favor in the eyes of Jehovah.

title: Genesis 6:9
text: These are the generations of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, [and] perfect in his generations: Noah walked with God.

title: Genesis 6:10
text: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

title: Genesis 6:11
text: And the earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

title: Genesis 6:12
text: And God saw the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted their way upon the earth.

title: Genesis 6:13
text: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.

title: Genesis 6:14
text: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.

title: Genesis 6:15
text: And this is how thou shalt make it: the length of the ark three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.

title: Genesis 6:16
text: A light shalt thou make to the ark, and to a cubit shalt thou finish it upward; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.

title: Genesis 6:17
text: And I, behold, I do bring the flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; everything that is in the earth shall die.

title: Genesis 6:18
text: But I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.

title: Genesis 6:19
text: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.

title: Genesis 6:20
text: Of the birds after their kind, and of the cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort shall come unto thee, to keep them alive.

title: Genesis 6:21
text: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.

title: Genesis 6:22
text: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.

title: Genesis 7:1
text: And Jehovah said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.

title: Genesis 7:2
text: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee seven and seven, the male and his female; and of the beasts that are not clean two, the male and his female:

title: Genesis 7:3
text: of the birds also of the heavens, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.

title: Genesis 7:4
text: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living thing that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the ground.

title: Genesis 7:5
text: And Noah did according unto all that Jehovah commanded him.

title: Genesis 7:6
text: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.

title: Genesis 7:7
text: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.

title: Genesis 7:8
text: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of birds, and of everything that creepeth upon the ground,

title: Genesis 7:9
text: there went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, male and female, as God commanded Noah.

title: Genesis 7:10
text: And it came to pass after the seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.

title: Genesis 7:11
text: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.

title: Genesis 7:12
text: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

title: Genesis 7:13
text: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;

title: Genesis 7:14
text: they, and every beast after its kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.

title: Genesis 7:15
text: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh wherein is the breath of life.

title: Genesis 7:16
text: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him: and Jehovah shut him in.

title: Genesis 7:17
text: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lifted up above the earth.

title: Genesis 7:18
text: And the waters prevailed, and increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.

title: Genesis 7:19
text: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high mountains that were under the whole heaven were covered.

title: Genesis 7:20
text: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.

title: Genesis 7:21
text: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both birds, and cattle, and beasts, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:

title: Genesis 7:22
text: all in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, of all that was on the dry land, died.

title: Genesis 7:23
text: And every living thing was destroyed that was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and creeping things, and birds of the heavens; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only was left, and they that were with him in the ark.

title: Genesis 7:24
text: And the waters prevailed upon the earth a hundred and fifty days.

title: Genesis 8:1
text: And God remembered Noah, and all the beasts, and all the cattle that were with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters assuaged;

title: Genesis 8:2
text: the fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;

title: Genesis 8:3
text: and the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of a hundred and fifty days the waters decreased.

title: Genesis 8:4
text: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.

title: Genesis 8:5
text: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.

title: Genesis 8:6
text: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:

title: Genesis 8:7
text: and he sent forth a raven, and it went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.

title: Genesis 8:8
text: And he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;

title: Genesis 8:9
text: but the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him to the ark; for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: and he put forth his hand, and took her, and brought her in unto him into the ark.

title: Genesis 8:10
text: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;

title: Genesis 8:11
text: and the dove came in to him at eventide; and, lo, in her mouth an olive-leaf plucked off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

title: Genesis 8:12
text: And he stayed yet other seven days, and sent forth the dove; and she returned not again unto him any more.

title: Genesis 8:13
text: And it came to pass in the six hundred and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dried.

title: Genesis 8:14
text: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dry.

title: Genesis 8:15
text: And God spake unto Noah, saying,

title: Genesis 8:16
text: Go forth from the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.

title: Genesis 8:17
text: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee of all flesh, both birds, and cattle, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.

title: Genesis 8:18
text: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:

title: Genesis 8:19
text: every beast, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatsoever moveth upon the earth, after their families, went forth out of the ark.

title: Genesis 8:20
text: And Noah builded an altar unto Jehovah, and took of every clean beast, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt-offerings on the altar.

title: Genesis 8:21
text: And Jehovah smelled the sweet savor; and Jehovah said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake, for that the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more everything living, as I have done.

title: Genesis 8:22
text: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.

title: Genesis 9:1
text: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

title: Genesis 9:2
text: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every bird of the heavens; with all wherewith the ground teemeth, and all the fishes of the sea, into your hand are they delivered.

title: Genesis 9:3
text: Every moving thing that liveth shall be food for you; as the green herb have I given you all.

title: Genesis 9:4
text: But flesh with the life thereof, [which is] the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.

title: Genesis 9:5
text: And surely your blood, [the blood] of your lives, will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it: and at the hand of man, even at the hand of every man's brother, will I require the life of man.

title: Genesis 9:6
text: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: For in the image of God made he man.

title: Genesis 9:7
text: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.

title: Genesis 9:8
text: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,

title: Genesis 9:9
text: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;

title: Genesis 9:10
text: and with every living creature that is with you, the birds, the cattle, and every beast of the earth with you; of all that go out of the ark, even every beast of the earth.

title: Genesis 9:11
text: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of the flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.

title: Genesis 9:12
text: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

title: Genesis 9:13
text: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

title: Genesis 9:14
text: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud,

title: Genesis 9:15
text: and I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

title: Genesis 9:16
text: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.

title: Genesis 9:17
text: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.

title: Genesis 9:18
text: And the sons of Noah, that went forth from the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.

title: Genesis 9:19
text: These three were the sons of Noah: and of these was the whole earth overspread.

title: Genesis 9:20
text: And Noah began to be a husbandman, and planted a vineyard:

title: Genesis 9:21
text: and he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.

title: Genesis 9:22
text: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.

title: Genesis 9:23
text: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.

title: Genesis 9:24
text: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done unto him.

title: Genesis 9:25
text: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; A servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.

title: Genesis 9:26
text: And he said, Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Shem; And let Canaan be his servant.

title: Genesis 9:27
text: God enlarge Japheth, And let him dwell in the tents of Shem; And let Canaan be his servant.

title: Genesis 9:28
text: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.

title: Genesis 9:29
text: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: And he died.

title: Genesis 10:1
text: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, [namely], of Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.

title: Genesis 10:2
text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

title: Genesis 10:3
text: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

title: Genesis 10:4
text: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

title: Genesis 10:5
text: Of these were the isles of the nations divided in their lands, every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.

title: Genesis 10:6
text: And the sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, and Put, and Canaan.

title: Genesis 10:7
text: And the sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabteca; and the sons of Raamah: Sheba, and Dedan.

title: Genesis 10:8
text: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.

title: Genesis 10:9
text: He was a mighty hunter before Jehovah: wherefore it is said, Like Nimrod a mighty hunter before Jehovah.

title: Genesis 10:10
text: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

title: Genesis 10:11
text: Out of that land he went forth into Assyria, and builded Nineveh, and Rehoboth-Ir, and Calah,

title: Genesis 10:12
text: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah (the same is the great city).

title: Genesis 10:13
text: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

title: Genesis 10:14
text: and Pathrusim, and Casluhim (whence went forth the Philistines), and Caphtorim.

title: Genesis 10:15
text: And Canaan begat Sidon his first-born, and Heth,

title: Genesis 10:16
text: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

title: Genesis 10:17
text: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

title: Genesis 10:18
text: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanite spread abroad.

title: Genesis 10:19
text: And the border of the Canaanite was from Sidon, as thou goest toward Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest toward Sodom and Gomorrah and Admah and Zeboiim, unto Lasha.

title: Genesis 10:20
text: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, in their nations.

title: Genesis 10:21
text: And unto Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the elder brother of Japheth, to him also were children born.

title: Genesis 10:22
text: The sons of Shem: Elam, and Asshur, and Arpachshad, and Lud, and Aram.

title: Genesis 10:23
text: And the sons of Aram: Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.

title: Genesis 10:24
text: And Arpachshad begat Shelah; and Shelah begat Eber.

title: Genesis 10:25
text: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.

title: Genesis 10:26
text: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

title: Genesis 10:27
text: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,

title: Genesis 10:28
text: and Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

title: Genesis 10:29
text: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.

title: Genesis 10:30
text: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

title: Genesis 10:31
text: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.

title: Genesis 10:32
text: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and of these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.

title: Genesis 11:1
text: And the whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

title: Genesis 11:2
text: And it came to pass, as they journeyed east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.

title: Genesis 11:3
text: And they said one to another, Come, let us make brick, and burn them thoroughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for mortar.

title: Genesis 11:4
text: And they said, Come, let us build us a city, and a tower, whose top [may reach] unto heaven, and let us make us a name; lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.

title: Genesis 11:5
text: And Jehovah came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.

title: Genesis 11:6
text: And Jehovah said, Behold, they are one people, and they have all one language; and this is what they begin to do: and now nothing will be withholden from them, which they purpose to do.

title: Genesis 11:7
text: Come, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech.

title: Genesis 11:8
text: So Jehovah scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off building the city.

title: Genesis 11:9
text: Therefore was the name of it called Babel; because Jehovah did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did Jehovah scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.

title: Genesis 11:10
text: These are the generations of Shem. Shem was a hundred years old, and begat Arpachshad two years after the flood:

title: Genesis 11:11
text: and Shem lived after he begat Arpachshad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 11:12
text: And Arpachshad lived five and thirty years, and begat Shelah:

title: Genesis 11:13
text: and Arpachshad lived after he begat Shelah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 11:14
text: And Shelah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:

title: Genesis 11:15
text: and Shelah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 11:16
text: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:

title: Genesis 11:17
text: and Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 11:18
text: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:

title: Genesis 11:19
text: and Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 11:20
text: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:

title: Genesis 11:21
text: and Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 11:22
text: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:

title: Genesis 11:23
text: and Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 11:24
text: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:

title: Genesis 11:25
text: and Nahor lived after he begat Terah a hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 11:26
text: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

title: Genesis 11:27
text: Now these are the generations of Terah. Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.

title: Genesis 11:28
text: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.

title: Genesis 11:29
text: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.

title: Genesis 11:30
text: And Sarai was barren; she had no child.

title: Genesis 11:31
text: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran, his son's son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.

title: Genesis 11:32
text: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.

title: Genesis 12:1
text: Now Jehovah said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto the land that I will show thee:

title: Genesis 12:2
text: and I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make they name great; and be thou a blessing:

title: Genesis 12:3
text: and I will bless them that bless thee, and him that curseth thee will I curse: and in thee shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

title: Genesis 12:4
text: So Abram went, as Jehovah had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.

title: Genesis 12:5
text: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.

title: Genesis 12:6
text: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Shechem, unto the oak of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.

title: Genesis 12:7
text: And Jehovah appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto Jehovah, who appeared unto him.

title: Genesis 12:8
text: And he removed from thence unto the mountain on the east of Beth-el, and pitched his tent, having Beth-el on the west, and Ai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto Jehovah, and called upon the name of Jehovah.

title: Genesis 12:9
text: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the South.

title: Genesis 12:10
text: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was sore in the land.

title: Genesis 12:11
text: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:

title: Genesis 12:12
text: and it will come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they will say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.

title: Genesis 12:13
text: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister; that it may be well with me for thy sake, and that my soul may live because of thee.

title: Genesis 12:14
text: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.

title: Genesis 12:15
text: And the princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.

title: Genesis 12:16
text: And he dealt well with Abram for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he-asses, and men-servants, and maid-servants, and she-asses, and camels.

title: Genesis 12:17
text: And Jehovah plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram's wife.

title: Genesis 12:18
text: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?

title: Genesis 12:19
text: why saidst thou, She is my sister, so that I took her to be my wife? now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.

title: Genesis 12:20
text: And Pharaoh gave men charge concerning him: and they brought him on the way, and his wife, and all that he had.

title: Genesis 13:1
text: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the South.

title: Genesis 13:2
text: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.

title: Genesis 13:3
text: And he went on his journeys from the South even to Beth-el, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Beth-el and Ai,

title: Genesis 13:4
text: unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of Jehovah.

title: Genesis 13:5
text: And Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.

title: Genesis 13:6
text: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.

title: Genesis 13:7
text: And there was a strife between the herdsmen of Abram's cattle and the herdsmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelt then in the land.

title: Genesis 13:8
text: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdsmen and thy herdsmen; for we are brethren.

title: Genesis 13:9
text: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if [thou wilt take] the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if [thou take] the right hand, then I will go to the left.

title: Genesis 13:10
text: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the Plain of the Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before Jehovah destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of Jehovah, like the land of Egypt, as thou goest unto Zoar.

title: Genesis 13:11
text: So Lot chose him all the Plain of the Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.

title: Genesis 13:12
text: Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelt in the cities of the Plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.

title: Genesis 13:13
text: Now the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners against Jehovah exceedingly.

title: Genesis 13:14
text: And Jehovah said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art, northward and southward and eastward and westward:

title: Genesis 13:15
text: for all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.

title: Genesis 13:16
text: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then may thy seed also be numbered.

title: Genesis 13:17
text: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for unto thee will I give it.

title: Genesis 13:18
text: And Abram moved his tent, and came and dwelt by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built there an altar unto Jehovah.

title: Genesis 14:1
text: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim,

title: Genesis 14:2
text: that they made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar).

title: Genesis 14:3
text: All these joined together in the vale of Siddim (the same is the Salt Sea).

title: Genesis 14:4
text: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

title: Genesis 14:5
text: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaim in Ashteroth-karnaim, and the Zuzim in Ham, and the Emim in Shaveh-kiriathaim,

title: Genesis 14:6
text: and the Horites in their mount Seir, unto Elparan, which is by the wilderness.

title: Genesis 14:7
text: And they returned, and came to En-mishpat (the same is Kadesh), and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazazon-tamar.

title: Genesis 14:8
text: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar); and they set the battle in array against them in the vale of Siddim;

title: Genesis 14:9
text: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.

title: Genesis 14:10
text: Now the vale of Siddim was full of slime pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and they fell there, and they that remained fled to the mountain.

title: Genesis 14:11
text: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.

title: Genesis 14:12
text: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

title: Genesis 14:13
text: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew: now he dwelt by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner; and these were confederate with Abram. [

title: Genesis 14:14
text: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he led forth his trained men, born in his house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued as far as Dan.

title: Genesis 14:15
text: And he divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

title: Genesis 14:16
text: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought back his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.

title: Genesis 14:17
text: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him, after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings that were with him, at the vale of Shaveh (the same is the King's Vale).

title: Genesis 14:18
text: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was priest of God Most High.

title: Genesis 14:19
text: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth:

title: Genesis 14:20
text: and blessed be God Most High, who hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him a tenth of all.

title: Genesis 14:21
text: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.

title: Genesis 14:22
text: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lifted up my hand unto Jehovah, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,

title: Genesis 14:23
text: that I will not take a thread nor a shoe-latchet nor aught that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:

title: Genesis 14:24
text: save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men that went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.

title: Genesis 15:1
text: After these things the word of Jehovah came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, [and] thy exceeding great reward.

title: Genesis 15:2
text: And Abram said, O Lord Jehovah, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and he that shall be possessor of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?

title: Genesis 15:3
text: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.

title: Genesis 15:4
text: And, behold, the word of Jehovah came unto him, saying, This man shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.

title: Genesis 15:5
text: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and number the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.

title: Genesis 15:6
text: And he believed in Jehovah; and he reckoned it to him for righteousness.

title: Genesis 15:7
text: And he said unto him, I am Jehovah that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.

title: Genesis 15:8
text: And he said, O Lord Jehovah, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?

title: Genesis 15:9
text: And he said unto him, Take me a heifer three years old, and a she-goat three years old, and a ram three years old, and a turtle-dove, and a young pigeon.

title: Genesis 15:10
text: And he took him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each half over against the other: but the birds divided he not.

title: Genesis 15:11
text: And the birds of prey came down upon the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.

title: Genesis 15:12
text: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, a horror of great darkness fell upon him.

title: Genesis 15:13
text: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be sojourners in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;

title: Genesis 15:14
text: and also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.

title: Genesis 15:15
text: But thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.

title: Genesis 15:16
text: And in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.

title: Genesis 15:17
text: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace, and a flaming torch that passed between these pieces.

title: Genesis 15:18
text: In that day Jehovah made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:

title: Genesis 15:19
text: the Kenite, and the Kenizzite, and the Kadmonite,

title: Genesis 15:20
text: and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Rephaim,

title: Genesis 15:21
text: and the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Girgashite, and the Jebusite.

title: Genesis 16:1
text: Now Sarai, Abram's wife, bare him no children: and she had a handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

title: Genesis 16:2
text: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, Jehovah hath restrained me from bearing; go in, I pray thee, unto my handmaid; it may be that I shall obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.

title: Genesis 16:3
text: And Sarai, Abram's wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her handmaid, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.

title: Genesis 16:4
text: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

title: Genesis 16:5
text: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I gave my handmaid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: Jehovah judge between me and thee.

title: Genesis 16:6
text: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her that which is good in thine eyes. And Sarai dealt hardly with her, and she fled from her face.

title: Genesis 16:7
text: And the angel of Jehovah found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.

title: Genesis 16:8
text: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's handmaid, whence camest thou? and whither goest thou? And she said, I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.

title: Genesis 16:9
text: And the angel of Jehovah said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.

title: Genesis 16:10
text: And the angel of Jehovah said unto her, I will greatly multiply thy seed, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.

title: Genesis 16:11
text: And the angel of Jehovah said unto her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son; and thou shalt call his name Ishmael, because Jehovah hath heard thy affliction.

title: Genesis 16:12
text: And he shall be [as] a wild ass among men; his hand [shall be] against every man, and every man's hand against him; and he shall dwell over against all his brethren.

title: Genesis 16:13
text: And she called the name of Jehovah that spake unto her, Thou art a God that seeth: for she said, Have I even here looked after him that seeth me?

title: Genesis 16:14
text: Wherefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

title: Genesis 16:15
text: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bare, Ishmael.

title: Genesis 16:16
text: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.

title: Genesis 17:1
text: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, Jehovah appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am God Almighty; walk before me, and be thou perfect.

title: Genesis 17:2
text: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.

title: Genesis 17:3
text: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,

title: Genesis 17:4
text: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be the father of a multitude of nations.

title: Genesis 17:5
text: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for the father of a multitude of nations have I made thee.

title: Genesis 17:6
text: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.

title: Genesis 17:7
text: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee and to thy seed after thee.

title: Genesis 17:8
text: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land of thy sojournings, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.

title: Genesis 17:9
text: And God said unto Abraham, And as for thee, thou shalt keep my covenant, thou, and thy seed after thee throughout their generations.

title: Genesis 17:10
text: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee: every male among you shall be circumcised.

title: Genesis 17:11
text: And ye shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of a covenant betwixt me and you.

title: Genesis 17:12
text: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any foreigner that is not of thy seed.

title: Genesis 17:13
text: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

title: Genesis 17:14
text: And the uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.

title: Genesis 17:15
text: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.

title: Genesis 17:16
text: And I will bless her, and moreover I will give thee a son of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be [a mother of] nations; kings of peoples shall be of her.

title: Genesis 17:17
text: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is a hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?

title: Genesis 17:18
text: And Abraham said unto God, Oh that Ishmael might live before thee!

title: Genesis 17:19
text: And God said, Nay, but Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his seed after him. [

title: Genesis 17:20
text: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.

title: Genesis 17:21
text: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.

title: Genesis 17:22
text: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.

title: Genesis 17:23
text: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.

title: Genesis 17:24
text: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

title: Genesis 17:25
text: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

title: Genesis 17:26
text: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.

title: Genesis 17:27
text: And all the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money of a foreigner, were circumcised with him.

title: Genesis 18:1
text: And Jehovah appeared unto him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;

title: Genesis 18:2
text: and he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood over against him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,

title: Genesis 18:3
text: and said, My lord, if now I have found favor in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:

title: Genesis 18:4
text: let now a little water be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:

title: Genesis 18:5
text: and I will fetch a morsel of bread, and strengthen ye your heart; after that ye shall pass on: forasmuch as ye are come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.

title: Genesis 18:6
text: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.

title: Genesis 18:7
text: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetched a calf tender and good, and gave it unto the servant; and he hasted to dress it.

title: Genesis 18:8
text: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.

title: Genesis 18:9
text: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.

title: Genesis 18:10
text: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee when the season cometh round; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.

title: Genesis 18:11
text: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, [and] well stricken in age; it had ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.

title: Genesis 18:12
text: And Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?

title: Genesis 18:13
text: And Jehovah said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, who am old?

title: Genesis 18:14
text: Is anything too hard for Jehovah? At the set time I will return unto thee, when the season cometh round, and Sarah shall have a son.

title: Genesis 18:15
text: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.

title: Genesis 18:16
text: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.

title: Genesis 18:17
text: And Jehovah said, Shall I hide from Abraham that which I do;

title: Genesis 18:18
text: seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?

title: Genesis 18:19
text: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of Jehovah, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that Jehovah may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.

title: Genesis 18:20
text: And Jehovah said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;

title: Genesis 18:21
text: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.

title: Genesis 18:22
text: And the men turned from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before Jehovah.

title: Genesis 18:23
text: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou consume the righteous with the wicked?

title: Genesis 18:24
text: Peradventure there are fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?

title: Genesis 18:25
text: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked, that so the righteous should be as the wicked; that be far from thee: shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?

title: Genesis 18:26
text: And Jehovah said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sake.

title: Genesis 18:27
text: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, who am but dust and ashes:

title: Genesis 18:28
text: peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, I will not destroy it, if I find there forty and five.

title: Genesis 18:29
text: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for the forty's sake.

title: Genesis 18:30
text: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.

title: Genesis 18:31
text: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for the twenty's sake.

title: Genesis 18:32
text: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for the ten's sake.

title: Genesis 18:33
text: And Jehovah went his way, as soon as he had left off communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.

title: Genesis 19:1
text: And the two angels came to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face to the earth;

title: Genesis 19:2
text: and he said, Behold now, my lords, turn aside, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your way. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.

title: Genesis 19:3
text: And he urged them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.

title: Genesis 19:4
text: But before they lay down, the men of the city, [even] the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both young and old, all the people from every quarter;

title: Genesis 19:5
text: and they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men that came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.

title: Genesis 19:6
text: And Lot went out unto them to the door, and shut the door after him.

title: Genesis 19:7
text: And he said, I pray you, my brethren, do not so wickedly.

title: Genesis 19:8
text: Behold now, I have two daughters that have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing, forasmuch as they are come under the shadow of my roof.

title: Genesis 19:9
text: And they said, Stand back. And they said, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and drew near to break the door.

title: Genesis 19:10
text: But the men put forth their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.

title: Genesis 19:11
text: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

title: Genesis 19:12
text: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son-in-law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whomsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of the place:

title: Genesis 19:13
text: for we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxed great before Jehovah; and Jehovah hath sent us to destroy it.

title: Genesis 19:14
text: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons-in-law, who married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for Jehovah will destroy the city. But he seemed unto his sons-in-law as one that mocked.

title: Genesis 19:15
text: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters that are here, lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.

title: Genesis 19:16
text: But he lingered; and the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters, Jehovah being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.

title: Genesis 19:17
text: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the Plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.

title: Genesis 19:18
text: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my lord:

title: Genesis 19:19
text: behold now, thy servant hath found favor in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy lovingkindness, which thou hast showed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die:

title: Genesis 19:20
text: behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape thither (is it not a little one?), and my soul shall live.

title: Genesis 19:21
text: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which thou hast spoken.

title: Genesis 19:22
text: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do anything till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

title: Genesis 19:23
text: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot came unto Zoar.

title: Genesis 19:24
text: Then Jehovah rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from Jehovah out of heaven;

title: Genesis 19:25
text: and he overthrew those cities, and all the Plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.

title: Genesis 19:26
text: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

title: Genesis 19:27
text: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Jehovah:

title: Genesis 19:28
text: and he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the Plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.

title: Genesis 19:29
text: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the Plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot dwelt.

title: Genesis 19:30
text: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.

title: Genesis 19:31
text: And the first-born said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:

title: Genesis 19:32
text: come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

title: Genesis 19:33
text: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the first-born went in, and lay with her father; and he knew not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

title: Genesis 19:34
text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the first-born said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

title: Genesis 19:35
text: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he knew not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

title: Genesis 19:36
text: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.

title: Genesis 19:37
text: And the first-born bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.

title: Genesis 19:38
text: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Ben-ammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.

title: Genesis 20:1
text: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the land of the South, and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur; and he sojourned in Gerar.

title: Genesis 20:2
text: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

title: Genesis 20:3
text: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, because of the woman whom thou hast taken; for she is a man's wife.

title: Genesis 20:4
text: Now Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay even a righteous nation?

title: Genesis 20:5
text: Said he not himself unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and the innocency of my hands have I done this.

title: Genesis 20:6
text: And God said unto him in the dream, Yea, I know that in the integrity of thy heart thou has done this, and I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.

title: Genesis 20:7
text: Now therefore restore the man's wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.

title: Genesis 20:8
text: And Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.

title: Genesis 20:9
text: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and wherein have I sinned against thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.

title: Genesis 20:10
text: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?

title: Genesis 20:11
text: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.

title: Genesis 20:12
text: And moreover she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife:

title: Genesis 20:13
text: and it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt show unto me: at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.

title: Genesis 20:14
text: And Abimelech took sheep and oxen, and men-servants and women-servants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.

title: Genesis 20:15
text: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.

title: Genesis 20:16
text: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, it is for thee a covering of the eyes to all that are with thee; and in respect of all thou art righted.

title: Genesis 20:17
text: And Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maid-servants; and they bare children.

title: Genesis 20:18
text: For Jehovah had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham's wife.

title: Genesis 21:1
text: And Jehovah visited Sarah as he had said, and Jehovah did unto Sarah as he had spoken.

title: Genesis 21:2
text: And Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

title: Genesis 21:3
text: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.

title: Genesis 21:4
text: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.

title: Genesis 21:5
text: And Abraham was a hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.

title: Genesis 21:6
text: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh; every one that heareth will laugh with me.

title: Genesis 21:7
text: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should give children suck? for I have borne him a son in his old age.

title: Genesis 21:8
text: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.

title: Genesis 21:9
text: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne unto Abraham, mocking.

title: Genesis 21:10
text: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this handmaid and her son: for the son of this handmaid shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.

title: Genesis 21:11
text: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight on account of his son.

title: Genesis 21:12
text: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy handmaid; in all that Sarah saith unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.

title: Genesis 21:13
text: And also of the son of the handmaid will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.

title: Genesis 21:14
text: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and [gave her] the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.

title: Genesis 21:15
text: And the water in the bottle was spent, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.

title: Genesis 21:16
