text: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not look upon the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.

title: Genesis 21:17
text: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.

title: Genesis 21:18
text: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thy hand; for I will make him a great nation.

title: Genesis 21:19
text: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.

title: Genesis 21:20
text: And God was with the lad, and he grew; and he dwelt in the wilderness, and became, as he grew up, an archer.

title: Genesis 21:21
text: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 21:22
text: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:

title: Genesis 21:23
text: now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.

title: Genesis 21:24
text: And Abraham said, I will swear.

title: Genesis 21:25
text: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of the well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.

title: Genesis 21:26
text: And Abimelech said, I know not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to-day.

title: Genesis 21:27
text: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and they two made a covenant.

title: Genesis 21:28
text: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

title: Genesis 21:29
text: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?

title: Genesis 21:30
text: And he said, These seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that it may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.

title: Genesis 21:31
text: Wherefore he called that place Beer-sheba; because there they sware both of them.

title: Genesis 21:32
text: So they made a covenant at Beer-sheba: and Abimelech rose up, and Phicol the captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

title: Genesis 21:33
text: And [Abraham] planted a tamarisk tree in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of Jehovah, the Everlasting God.

title: Genesis 21:34
text: And Abraham sojourned in the land of the Philistines many days.

title: Genesis 22:1
text: And it came to pass after these things, that God did prove Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham; and he said, Here am I.

title: Genesis 22:2
text: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son, whom thou lovest, even Isaac, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt-offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

title: Genesis 22:3
text: And Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son; and he clave the wood for the burnt-offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.

title: Genesis 22:4
text: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.

title: Genesis 22:5
text: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass, and I and the lad will go yonder; and we will worship, and come again to you.

title: Genesis 22:6
text: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt-offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took in his hand the fire and the knife; and they went both of them together.

title: Genesis 22:7
text: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold, the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt-offering?

title: Genesis 22:8
text: And Abraham said, God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt-offering, my son: so they went both of them together.

title: Genesis 22:9
text: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, upon the wood.

title: Genesis 22:10
text: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.

title: Genesis 22:11
text: And the angel of Jehovah called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here I am.

title: Genesis 22:12
text: And he said, Lay not thy hand upon the lad, neither do thou anything unto him; for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son, from me.

title: Genesis 22:13
text: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, behind [him] a ram caught in the thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son.

title: Genesis 22:14
text: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of Jehovah it shall be provided.

title: Genesis 22:15
text: And the angel of Jehovah called unto Abraham a second time out of heaven,

title: Genesis 22:16
text: and said, By myself have I sworn, saith Jehovah, because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son,

title: Genesis 22:17
text: that in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heavens, and as the sand which is upon the seashore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;

title: Genesis 22:18
text: and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.

title: Genesis 22:19
text: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.

title: Genesis 22:20
text: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she also hath borne children unto thy brother Nahor:

title: Genesis 22:21
text: Uz his first-born, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,

title: Genesis 22:22
text: and Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.

title: Genesis 22:23
text: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight did Milcah bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.

title: Genesis 22:24
text: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she also bare Tebah, and Gaham, and Tahash, and Maacah.

title: Genesis 23:1
text: And the life of Sarah was a hundred and seven and twenty years: these were the years of the life of Sarah.

title: Genesis 23:2
text: And Sarah died in Kiriath-arba (the same is Hebron), in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

title: Genesis 23:3
text: And Abraham rose up from before his dead, and spake unto the children of Heth, saying,

title: Genesis 23:4
text: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.

title: Genesis 23:5
text: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,

title: Genesis 23:6
text: Hear us, my lord; thou art a prince of God among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.

title: Genesis 23:7
text: And Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.

title: Genesis 23:8
text: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

title: Genesis 23:9
text: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for the full price let him give it to me in the midst of you for a possession of a burying-place.

title: Genesis 23:10
text: Now Ephron was sitting in the midst of the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,

title: Genesis 23:11
text: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the children of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.

title: Genesis 23:12
text: And Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.

title: Genesis 23:13
text: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt, I pray thee, hear me: I will give the price of the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.

title: Genesis 23:14
text: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,

title: Genesis 23:15
text: My lord, hearken unto me: a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver, what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.

title: Genesis 23:16
text: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the audience of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current [money] with the merchant.

title: Genesis 23:17
text: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the border thereof round about, were made sure

title: Genesis 23:18
text: unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.

title: Genesis 23:19
text: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (the same is Hebron), in the land of Canaan.

title: Genesis 23:20
text: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a burying-place by the children of Heth.

title: Genesis 24:1
text: And Abraham was old, [and] well stricken in age: and Jehovah had blessed Abraham in all things.

title: Genesis 24:2
text: And Abraham said unto his servant, the elder of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:

title: Genesis 24:3
text: and I will make thee swear by Jehovah, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that thou wilt not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:

title: Genesis 24:4
text: but thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife for my son Isaac.

title: Genesis 24:5
text: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?

title: Genesis 24:6
text: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.

title: Genesis 24:7
text: Jehovah, the God of heaven, who took me from my father's house, and from the land of my nativity, and who spake unto me, and who sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he will send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife for my son from thence.

title: Genesis 24:8
text: And if the woman be not willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath; only thou shalt not bring my son thither again.

title: Genesis 24:9
text: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning this matter.

title: Genesis 24:10
text: And the servant took ten camels, of the camels of his master, and departed, having all goodly things of his master's in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.

title: Genesis 24:11
text: And he made the camels to kneel down without the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.

title: Genesis 24:12
text: And he said, O Jehovah, the God of my master Abraham, send me, I pray thee, good speed this day, and show kindness unto my master Abraham.

title: Genesis 24:13
text: Behold, I am standing by the fountain of water; and the daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water:

title: Genesis 24:14
text: and let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast showed kindness unto my master.

title: Genesis 24:15
text: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.

title: Genesis 24:16
text: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the fountain, and filled her pitcher, and came up.

title: Genesis 24:17
text: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Give me to drink, I pray thee, a little water from thy pitcher.

title: Genesis 24:18
text: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.

title: Genesis 24:19
text: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.

title: Genesis 24:20
text: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.

title: Genesis 24:21
text: And the man looked stedfastly on her, holding his peace, to know whether Jehovah had made his journey prosperous or not.

title: Genesis 24:22
text: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,

title: Genesis 24:23
text: and said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee. Is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?

title: Genesis 24:24
text: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bare unto Nahor.

title: Genesis 24:25
text: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.

title: Genesis 24:26
text: And the man bowed his head, and worshipped Jehovah.

title: Genesis 24:27
text: And he said, Blessed be Jehovah, the God of my master Abraham, who hath not forsaken his lovingkindness and his truth toward my master: as for me, Jehovah hath led me in the way to the house of my master's brethren.

title: Genesis 24:28
text: And the damsel ran, and told her mother's house according to these words.

title: Genesis 24:29
text: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the fountain.

title: Genesis 24:30
text: And it came to pass, when he saw the ring, and the bracelets upon his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he was standing by the camels at the fountain.

title: Genesis 24:31
text: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of Jehovah; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.

title: Genesis 24:32
text: And the man came into the house, and he ungirded the camels; and he gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men that were with him.

title: Genesis 24:33
text: And there was set food before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.

title: Genesis 24:34
text: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.

title: Genesis 24:35
text: And Jehovah hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks and herds, and silver and gold, and men-servants and maid-servants, and camels and asses.

title: Genesis 24:36
text: And Sarah my master's wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.

title: Genesis 24:37
text: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:

title: Genesis 24:38
text: but thou shalt go unto my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife for my son.

title: Genesis 24:39
text: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.

title: Genesis 24:40
text: And he said unto me, Jehovah, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house:

title: Genesis 24:41
text: then shalt thou be clear from my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give her not to thee, thou shalt be clear from my oath.

title: Genesis 24:42
text: And I came this day unto the fountain, and said, O Jehovah, the God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:

title: Genesis 24:43
text: behold, I am standing by the fountain of water; and let it come to pass, that the maiden that cometh forth to draw, to whom I shall say, Give me, I pray thee, a little water from thy pitcher to drink;

title: Genesis 24:44
text: and she shall say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom Jehovah hath appointed for my master's son.

title: Genesis 24:45
text: And before I had done speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the fountain, and drew: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.

title: Genesis 24:46
text: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.

title: Genesis 24:47
text: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the ring upon her nose, and the bracelets upon her hands.

title: Genesis 24:48
text: And I bowed my head, and worshipped Jehovah, and blessed Jehovah, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter for his son.

title: Genesis 24:49
text: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.

title: Genesis 24:50
text: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from Jehovah: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.

title: Genesis 24:51
text: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master's son's wife, as Jehovah hath spoken.

title: Genesis 24:52
text: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth unto Jehovah.

title: Genesis 24:53
text: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.

title: Genesis 24:54
text: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.

title: Genesis 24:55
text: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us [a few] days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.

title: Genesis 24:56
text: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing Jehovah hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.

title: Genesis 24:57
text: And they said, We will call the damsel, and inquire at her mouth.

title: Genesis 24:58
text: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.

title: Genesis 24:59
text: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.

title: Genesis 24:60
text: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Our sister, be thou [the mother] of thousands of ten thousands, and let thy seed possess the gate of those that hate them.

title: Genesis 24:61
text: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

title: Genesis 24:62
text: And Isaac came from the way of Beer-lahai-roi; for he dwelt in the land of the South.

title: Genesis 24:63
text: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, there were camels coming.

title: Genesis 24:64
text: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she alighted from the camel.

title: Genesis 24:65
text: And she said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant said, It is my master: and she took her veil, and covered herself.

title: Genesis 24:66
text: And the servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.

title: Genesis 24:67
text: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.

title: Genesis 25:1
text: And Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.

title: Genesis 25:2
text: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.

title: Genesis 25:3
text: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.

title: Genesis 25:4
text: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

title: Genesis 25:5
text: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.

title: Genesis 25:6
text: But unto the sons of the concubines, that Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts; and he sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.

title: Genesis 25:7
text: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, a hundred threescore and fifteen years.

title: Genesis 25:8
text: And Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full [of years], and was gathered to his people.

title: Genesis 25:9
text: And Isaac and Ishmael his sons buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;

title: Genesis 25:10
text: the field which Abraham purchased of the children of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.

title: Genesis 25:11
text: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed Isaac his son: and Isaac dwelt by Beer-lahai-roi.

title: Genesis 25:12
text: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bare unto Abraham:

title: Genesis 25:13
text: and these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the first-born of Ishmael, Nebaioth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

title: Genesis 25:14
text: and Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,

title: Genesis 25:15
text: Hadad, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:

title: Genesis 25:16
text: these are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments; twelve princes according to their nations.

title: Genesis 25:17
text: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, a hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died, and was gathered unto his people.

title: Genesis 25:18
text: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: he abode over against all his brethren.

title: Genesis 25:19
text: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son: Abraham begat Isaac:

title: Genesis 25:20
text: and Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan-aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.

title: Genesis 25:21
text: And Isaac entreated Jehovah for his wife, because she was barren: and Jehovah was entreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

title: Genesis 25:22
text: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, wherefore do I live? And she went to inquire of Jehovah.

title: Genesis 25:23
text: And Jehovah said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, And two peoples shall be separated from thy bowels: And the one people shall be stronger than the other people; And the elder shall serve the younger.

title: Genesis 25:24
text: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

title: Genesis 25:25
text: And the first came forth red, all over like a hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.

title: Genesis 25:26
text: And after that came forth his brother, and his hand had hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.

title: Genesis 25:27
text: And the boys grew: and Esau was a skilful hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a quiet man, dwelling in tents.

title: Genesis 25:28
text: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: and Rebekah loved Jacob.

title: Genesis 25:29
text: And Jacob boiled pottage: and Esau came in from the field, and he was faint:

title: Genesis 25:30
text: and Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red [pottage] ; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.

title: Genesis 25:31
text: And Jacob said, Sell me first thy birthright.

title: Genesis 25:32
text: And Esau said, Behold, I am about to die: and what profit shall the birthright do to me?

title: Genesis 25:33
text: And Jacob said, Swear to me first; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.

title: Genesis 25:34
text: And Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentils; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: so Esau despised his birthright.

title: Genesis 26:1
text: And there was a famine in the land, besides the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines, unto Gerar.

title: Genesis 26:2
text: And Jehovah appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:

title: Genesis 26:3
text: sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;

title: Genesis 26:4
text: and I will multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these lands; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;

title: Genesis 26:5
text: because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.

title: Genesis 26:6
text: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:

title: Genesis 26:7
text: and the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, My wife; lest, [said he], the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.

title: Genesis 26:8
text: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.

title: Genesis 26:9
text: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife: and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die because of her.

title: Genesis 26:10
text: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? One of the people might easily have lain with thy wife, and thou wouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.

title: Genesis 26:11
text: And Abimelech charged all the people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.

title: Genesis 26:12
text: And Isaac sowed in that land, and found in the same year a hundredfold: and Jehovah blessed him.

title: Genesis 26:13
text: And the man waxed great, and grew more and more until he became very great:

title: Genesis 26:14
text: and he had possessions of flocks, and possessions of herds, and a great household: and the Philistines envied him.

title: Genesis 26:15
text: Now all the wells which his father's servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.

title: Genesis 26:16
text: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.

title: Genesis 26:17
text: And Isaac departed thence, and encamped in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.

title: Genesis 26:18
text: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham; and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

title: Genesis 26:19
text: And Isaac's servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.

title: Genesis 26:20
text: And the herdsmen of Gerar strove with Isaac's herdsmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.

title: Genesis 26:21
text: And they digged another well, and they strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.

title: Genesis 26:22
text: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now Jehovah hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

title: Genesis 26:23
text: And he went up from thence to Beer-sheba.

title: Genesis 26:24
text: And Jehovah appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.

title: Genesis 26:25
text: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of Jehovah, and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac's servants digged a well.

title: Genesis 26:26
text: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his host.

title: Genesis 26:27
text: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore are ye come unto me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?

title: Genesis 26:28
text: And they said, We saw plainly that Jehovah was with thee: and we said, Let there now be an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee,

title: Genesis 26:29
text: that thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of Jehovah.

title: Genesis 26:30
text: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.

title: Genesis 26:31
text: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

title: Genesis 26:32
text: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.

title: Genesis 26:33
text: And he called it Shibah: therefore the name of the city is Beer-sheba unto this day.

title: Genesis 26:34
text: And when Esau was forty years old he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:

title: Genesis 26:35
text: and they were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.

title: Genesis 27:1
text: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Here am I.

title: Genesis 27:2
text: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death.

title: Genesis 27:3
text: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me venison;

title: Genesis 27:4
text: and make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.

title: Genesis 27:5
text: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

title: Genesis 27:6
text: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,

title: Genesis 27:7
text: Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless thee before Jehovah before my death.

title: Genesis 27:8
text: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.

title: Genesis 27:9
text: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savory food for thy father, such as he loveth:

title: Genesis 27:10
text: and thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, so that he may bless thee before his death.

title: Genesis 27:11
text: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.

title: Genesis 27:12
text: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.

title: Genesis 27:13
text: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son; only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.

title: Genesis 27:14
text: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savory food, such as his father loved.

title: Genesis 27:15
text: And Rebekah took the goodly garments of Esau her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son;

title: Genesis 27:16
text: and she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:

title: Genesis 27:17
text: and she gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

title: Genesis 27:18
text: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?

title: Genesis 27:19
text: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy first-born; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.

title: Genesis 27:20
text: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because Jehovah thy God sent me good speed.

title: Genesis 27:21
text: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.

title: Genesis 27:22
text: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.

title: Genesis 27:23
text: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands: so he blessed him.

title: Genesis 27:24
text: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.

title: Genesis 27:25
text: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son's venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.

title: Genesis 27:26
text: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.

title: Genesis 27:27
text: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son Is as the smell of a field which Jehovah hath blessed:

title: Genesis 27:28
text: And God give thee of the dew of heaven, And of the fatness of the earth, And plenty of grain and new wine:

title: Genesis 27:29
text: Let peoples serve thee, And nations bow down to thee: Be lord over thy brethren, And let thy mother's sons bow down to thee: Cursed be every one that curseth thee, And blessed be every one that blesseth thee.

title: Genesis 27:30
text: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

title: Genesis 27:31
text: And he also made savory food, and brought it unto his father; and he said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.

title: Genesis 27:32
text: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy first-born, Esau.

title: Genesis 27:33
text: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who then is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, [and] he shall be blessed.

title: Genesis 27:34
text: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceeding great and bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.

title: Genesis 27:35
text: And he said, Thy brother came with guile, and hath taken away thy blessing.

title: Genesis 27:36
text: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?

title: Genesis 27:37
text: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with grain and new wine have I sustained him: and what then shall I do for thee, my son?

title: Genesis 27:38
text: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

title: Genesis 27:39
text: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, of the fatness of the earth shall be thy dwelling, And of the dew of heaven from above;

title: Genesis 27:40
text: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and thou shalt serve thy brother; And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt break loose, That thou shalt shake his yoke from off thy neck.

title: Genesis 27:41
text: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.

title: Genesis 27:42
text: And the words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah; and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, [purposing] to kill thee.

title: Genesis 27:43
text: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;

title: Genesis 27:44
text: and tarry with him a few days, until thy brother's fury turn away;

title: Genesis 27:45
text: until thy brother's anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?

title: Genesis 27:46
text: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?

title: Genesis 28:1
text: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

title: Genesis 28:2
text: Arise, go to Paddan-aram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother.

title: Genesis 28:3
text: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a company of peoples;

title: Genesis 28:4
text: and give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land of thy sojournings, which God gave unto Abraham.

title: Genesis 28:5
text: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Paddan-aram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother.

title: Genesis 28:6
text: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan-aram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;

title: Genesis 28:7
text: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan-aram:

title: Genesis 28:8
text: and Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;

title: Genesis 28:9
text: and Esau went unto Ishmael, and took, besides the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.

title: Genesis 28:10
text: And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went toward Haran.

title: Genesis 28:11
text: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.

title: Genesis 28:12
text: And he dreamed; and behold, a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven; and, behold, the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

title: Genesis 28:13
text: And, behold, Jehovah stood above it, and said, I am Jehovah, the God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;

title: Genesis 28:14
text: and thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

title: Genesis 28:15
text: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee whithersoever thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

title: Genesis 28:16
text: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely Jehovah is in this place; and I knew it not.

title: Genesis 28:17
text: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

title: Genesis 28:18
text: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.

title: Genesis 28:19
text: And he called the name of that place Beth-el: but the name of the city was Luz at the first.

title: Genesis 28:20
text: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,

title: Genesis 28:21
text: so that I come again to my father's house in peace, and Jehovah will be my God,

title: Genesis 28:22
text: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, shall be God's house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.

title: Genesis 29:1
text: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.

title: Genesis 29:2
text: And he looked, and, behold, a well in the field, and, lo, three flocks of sheep lying there by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and the stone upon the well's mouth was great.

title: Genesis 29:3
text: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well's mouth in its place.

title: Genesis 29:4
text: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence are ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.

title: Genesis 29:5
text: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.

title: Genesis 29:6
text: And he said unto them, Is it well with him? And they said, It is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.

title: Genesis 29:7
text: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.

title: Genesis 29:8
text: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well's mouth; then we water the sheep.

title: Genesis 29:9
text: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep; for she kept them.

title: Genesis 29:10
text: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother.

title: Genesis 29:11
text: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

title: Genesis 29:12
text: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's brother, and that he was Rebekah's son: and she ran and told her father.

title: Genesis 29:13
text: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.

title: Genesis 29:14
text: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.

title: Genesis 29:15
text: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?

title: Genesis 29:16
text: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

title: Genesis 29:17
text: And Leah's eyes were tender; but Rachel was beautiful and well-favored.

title: Genesis 29:18
text: And Jacob loved Rachel; and he said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.

title: Genesis 29:19
text: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.

title: Genesis 29:20
text: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.

title: Genesis 29:21
text: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.

title: Genesis 29:22
text: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

title: Genesis 29:23
text: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.

title: Genesis 29:24
text: And Laban gave Zilpah his handmaid unto his daughter Leah for a handmaid.

title: Genesis 29:25
text: And it came to pass in the morning that, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?

title: Genesis 29:26
text: And Laban said, It is not so done in our place, to give the younger before the first-born.

title: Genesis 29:27
text: Fulfil the week of this one, and we will give thee the other also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.

title: Genesis 29:28
text: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife.

title: Genesis 29:29
text: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her handmaid.

title: Genesis 29:30
text: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.

title: Genesis 29:31
text: And Jehovah saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.

title: Genesis 29:32
text: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Because Jehovah hath looked upon my affliction; for now my husband will love me.

title: Genesis 29:33
text: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and said, Because Jehovah hath heard that I am hated, he hath therefore given me this [son] also: and she called his name Simeon.

title: Genesis 29:34
text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have borne him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.

title: Genesis 29:35
text: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, This time will I praise Jehovah: therefore she called his name Judah; and she left off bearing.

title: Genesis 30:1
text: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and she said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.

title: Genesis 30:2
text: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?

title: Genesis 30:3
text: And she said, Behold, my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; that she may bear upon my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.

title: Genesis 30:4
text: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.

title: Genesis 30:5
text: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.

title: Genesis 30:6
text: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.

title: Genesis 30:7
text: And Bilhah Rachel's handmaid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.

title: Genesis 30:8
text: And Rachel said, With mighty wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.

title: Genesis 30:9
text: When Leah saw that she had left off bearing, she took Zilpah her handmaid, and gave her to Jacob to wife.

title: Genesis 30:10
text: And Zilpah Leah's handmaid bare Jacob a son.

title: Genesis 30:11
text: And Leah said, Fortunate! and she called his name Gad.

title: Genesis 30:12
text: And Zilpah Leah's handmaid bare Jacob a second son.

title: Genesis 30:13
text: And Leah said, Happy am I! for the daughters will call me happy: and she called his name Asher.

title: Genesis 30:14
text: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes. [

title: Genesis 30:15
text: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken away my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to-night for thy son's mandrakes.

title: Genesis 30:16
text: And Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for I have surely hired thee with my son's mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.

title: Genesis 30:17
text: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob a fifth son.

title: Genesis 30:18
text: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I gave my handmaid to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.

title: Genesis 30:19
text: And Leah conceived again, and bare a sixth son to Jacob.

title: Genesis 30:20
text: And Leah said, God hath endowed me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have borne him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.

title: Genesis 30:21
text: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.

title: Genesis 30:22
text: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

title: Genesis 30:23
text: And she conceived, and bare a son: and said, God hath taken away my reproach:

title: Genesis 30:24
text: and she called his name Joseph, saying, Jehovah add to me another son.

title: Genesis 30:25
text: And it came to pass, when Rachel had borne Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.

title: Genesis 30:26
text: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service wherewith I have served thee.

title: Genesis 30:27
text: And Laban said unto him, If now I have found favor in thine eyes, [tarry] : [for] I have divined that Jehovah hath blessed me for thy sake.

title: Genesis 30:28
text: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.

title: Genesis 30:29
text: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle have fared with me.

title: Genesis 30:30
text: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it hath increased unto a multitude; and Jehovah hath blessed thee whithersoever I turned: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?

title: Genesis 30:31
text: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me aught: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed thy flock and keep it.

title: Genesis 30:32
text: I will pass through all thy flock to-day, removing from thence every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and [of such] shall be my hire.

title: Genesis 30:33
text: So shall my righteousness answer for me hereafter, when thou shalt come concerning my hire that is before thee: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that, [if found] with me, shall be counted stolen.

title: Genesis 30:34
text: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.

title: Genesis 30:35
text: And he removed that day the he-goats that were ringstreaked and spotted, and all the she-goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons;

title: Genesis 30:36
text: and he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.

title: Genesis 30:37
text: And Jacob took him rods of fresh poplar, and of the almond and of the plane-tree; and peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

title: Genesis 30:38
text: And he set the rods which he had peeled over against the flocks in the gutters in the watering-troughs where the flocks came to drink; and they conceived when they came to drink.

title: Genesis 30:39
text: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks brought forth ringstreaked, speckled, and spotted.

title: Genesis 30:40
text: And Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstreaked and all the black in the flock of Laban: and he put his own droves apart, and put them not unto Laban's flock.

title: Genesis 30:41
text: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger of the flock did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the flock in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods;

title: Genesis 30:42
text: but when the flock were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.

title: Genesis 30:43
text: And the man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, and maid-servants and men-servants, and camels and asses.

title: Genesis 31:1
text: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's hath he gotten all this glory.

title: Genesis 31:2
text: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as beforetime.

title: Genesis 31:3
text: And Jehovah said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.

title: Genesis 31:4
text: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,

title: Genesis 31:5
text: and said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as beforetime; but the God of my father hath been with me.

title: Genesis 31:6
text: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.

title: Genesis 31:7
text: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.

title: Genesis 31:8
text: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the flock bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstreaked shall be thy wages; then bare all the flock ringstreaked.

title: Genesis 31:9
text: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.

title: Genesis 31:10
text: And it came to pass at the time that the flock conceive, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the he-goats which leaped upon the flock were ringstreaked, speckled, and grizzled.

title: Genesis 31:11
text: And the angel of God said unto me in the dream, Jacob: and I said, Here am I.

title: Genesis 31:12
text: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see: all the he-goats which leap upon the flock are ringstreaked, speckled, and grizzled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.

title: Genesis 31:13
text: I am the God of Beth-el, where thou anointedst a pillar, where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy nativity.

title: Genesis 31:14
text: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?

title: Genesis 31:15
text: Are we not accounted by him as foreigners? for he hath sold us, and hath also quite devoured our money.

title: Genesis 31:16
text: For all the riches which God hath taken away from our father, that is ours and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.

title: Genesis 31:17
text: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon the camels;

title: Genesis 31:18
text: and he carried away all his cattle, and all his substance which he had gathered, the cattle of his getting, which he had gathered in Paddan-aram, to go to Isaac his father unto the land of Canaan.

title: Genesis 31:19
text: Now Laban was gone to shear his sheep: and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father's.

title: Genesis 31:20
text: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.

title: Genesis 31:21
text: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the River, and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead.

title: Genesis 31:22
text: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.

title: Genesis 31:23
text: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and he overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.

title: Genesis 31:24
text: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream of the night, and said unto him, Take heed to thyself that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

title: Genesis 31:25
text: And Laban came up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain: and Laban with his brethren encamped in the mountain of Gilead.

title: Genesis 31:26
text: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters as captives of the sword?

title: Genesis 31:27
text: Wherefore didst thou flee secretly, and steal away from me, and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth and with songs, with tabret and with harp;

title: Genesis 31:28
text: and didst not suffer me to kiss my sons and my daughters? now hast thou done foolishly.

title: Genesis 31:29
text: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take heed to thyself that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

title: Genesis 31:30
text: And now, [though] thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, [yet] wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?

title: Genesis 31:31
text: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Lest thou shouldest take thy daughters from me by force.

title: Genesis 31:32
text: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, he shall not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.

title: Genesis 31:33
text: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the tent of the two maid-servants; but he found them not. And he went out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.

title: Genesis 31:34
text: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, and put them in the camel's saddle, and sat upon them. And Laban felt about all the tent, but found them not.

title: Genesis 31:35
text: And she said to her father, Let not my lord be angry that I cannot rise up before thee; for the manner of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the teraphim.

title: Genesis 31:36
text: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast hotly pursued after me?

title: Genesis 31:37
text: Whereas thou hast felt about all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? Set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us two.

title: Genesis 31:38
text: These twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she-goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flocks have I not eaten.

title: Genesis 31:39
text: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.

title: Genesis 31:40
text: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from mine eyes.

title: Genesis 31:41
text: These twenty years have I been in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy flock: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.

title: Genesis 31:42
text: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the Fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now hadst thou sent me away empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.

title: Genesis 31:43
text: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, The daughters are my daughters, and the children are my children, and the flocks are my flocks, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children whom they have borne?

title: Genesis 31:44
text: And now come, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.

title: Genesis 31:45
text: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

title: Genesis 31:46
text: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made a heap: and they did eat there by the heap.

title: Genesis 31:47
text: And Laban called it Jegar-saha-dutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.

title: Genesis 31:48
text: And Laban said, This heap is witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed:

title: Genesis 31:49
text: and Mizpah, for he said, Jehovah watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.

title: Genesis 31:50
text: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, and if thou shalt take wives besides my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.

title: Genesis 31:51
text: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold the pillar, which I have set betwixt me and thee.

title: Genesis 31:52
text: This heap be witness, and the pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.

title: Genesis 31:53
text: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the Fear of his father Isaac.

title: Genesis 31:54
text: And Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mountain.

title: Genesis 31:55
text: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.

title: Genesis 32:1
text: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

title: Genesis 32:2
text: And Jacob said when he saw them, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

title: Genesis 32:3
text: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the field of Edom.

title: Genesis 32:4
text: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye say unto my lord Esau: Thus saith thy servant Jacob, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed until now:

title: Genesis 32:5
text: and I have oxen, and asses, [and] flocks, and men-servants, and maid-servants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in thy sight.

title: Genesis 32:6
text: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and moreover he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.

title: Genesis 32:7
text: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed: and he divided the people that were with him, and the flocks, and the herds, and the camels, into two companies;

title: Genesis 32:8
text: and he said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the company which is left shall escape.

title: Genesis 32:9
text: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, O Jehovah, who saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will do thee good:

title: Genesis 32:10
text: I am not worthy of the least of all the lovingkindnesses, and of all the truth, which thou hast showed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two companies.

title: Genesis 32:11
text: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he come and smite me, the mother with the children.

title: Genesis 32:12
text: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.

title: Genesis 32:13
text: And he lodged there that night, and took of that which he had with him a present for Esau his brother:

title: Genesis 32:14
text: two hundred she-goats and twenty he-goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,

title: Genesis 32:15
text: thirty milch camels and their colts, forty cows and ten bulls, twenty she-asses and ten foals.

title: Genesis 32:16
text: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by itself, and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.

title: Genesis 32:17
text: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?

title: Genesis 32:18
text: then thou shalt say, [They are] thy servant Jacob's; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, he also is behind us.

title: Genesis 32:19
text: And he commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him;

title: Genesis 32:20
text: and ye shall say, Moreover, behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept me.

title: Genesis 32:21
text: So the present passed over before him: and he himself lodged that night in the company.

title: Genesis 32:22
text: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two handmaids, and his eleven children, and passed over the ford of the Jabbok.

title: Genesis 32:23
text: And he took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.

title: Genesis 32:24
text: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.

title: Genesis 32:25
text: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was strained, as he wrestled with him.

title: Genesis 32:26
text: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

title: Genesis 32:27
text: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.

title: Genesis 32:28
text: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for thou hast striven with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

title: Genesis 32:29
text: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.

title: Genesis 32:30
text: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for, [said he], I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.

title: Genesis 32:31
text: And the sun rose upon him as he passed over Penuel, and he limped upon his thigh.

title: Genesis 32:32
text: Therefore the children of Israel eat not the sinew of the hip which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew of the hip.

title: Genesis 33:1
text: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.

title: Genesis 33:2
text: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.

title: Genesis 33:3
text: And he himself passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

title: Genesis 33:4
text: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.

title: Genesis 33:5
text: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are these with thee? And he said, The children whom God hath graciously given thy servant.

title: Genesis 33:6
text: Then the handmaids came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.

title: Genesis 33:7
text: And Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

title: Genesis 33:8
text: And he said, What meanest thou by all this company which I met? And he said, To find favor in the sight of my lord.

title: Genesis 33:9
text: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; let that which thou hast be thine.

title: Genesis 33:10
text: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found favor in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand; forasmuch as I have seen thy face, as one seeth the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.

title: Genesis 33:11
text: Take, I pray thee, my gift that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.

title: Genesis 33:12
text: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.

title: Genesis 33:13
text: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young: and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.

title: Genesis 33:14
text: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the cattle that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.

title: Genesis 33:15
text: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find favor in the sight of my lord.

title: Genesis 33:16
text: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.

title: Genesis 33:17
text: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him a house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

title: Genesis 33:18
text: And Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan-aram; and encamped before the city.

title: Genesis 33:19
text: And he bought the parcel of ground, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for a hundred pieces of money.

title: Genesis 33:20
text: And he erected there an altar, and called it El-Elohe-Israel.

title: Genesis 34:1
text: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

title: Genesis 34:2
text: And Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her; and he took her, and lay with her, and humbled her.

title: Genesis 34:3
text: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.

title: Genesis 34:4
text: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.

title: Genesis 34:5
text: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter; and his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they came.

title: Genesis 34:6
text: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.

title: Genesis 34:7
text: And the sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter; which thing ought not to be done.

title: Genesis 34:8
text: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you, give her unto him to wife.

title: Genesis 34:9
text: And make ye marriages with us; give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.

title: Genesis 34:10
text: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.

title: Genesis 34:11
text: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find favor in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.

title: Genesis 34:12
text: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.

title: Genesis 34:13
text: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with guile, and spake, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,

title: Genesis 34:14
text: and said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us.

title: Genesis 34:15
text: Only on this condition will we consent unto you: if ye will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised;

title: Genesis 34:16
text: then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

title: Genesis 34:17
text: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.

title: Genesis 34:18
text: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor's son.

title: Genesis 34:19
text: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he was honored above all the house of his father.

title: Genesis 34:20
text: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,

title: Genesis 34:21
text: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for, behold, the land is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.

title: Genesis 34:22
text: Only on this condition will the men consent unto us to dwell with us, to become one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.

title: Genesis 34:23
text: Shall not their cattle and their substance and all their beasts be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.

title: Genesis 34:24
text: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.

title: Genesis 34:25
text: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city unawares, and slew all the males.

title: Genesis 34:26
text: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went forth.

title: Genesis 34:27
text: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.

title: Genesis 34:28
text: They took their flocks and their herds and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field;

title: Genesis 34:29
text: and all their wealth, and all their little ones and their wives, took they captive and made a prey, even all that was in the house.

title: Genesis 34:30
text: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and, I being few in number, they will gather themselves together against me and smite me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.

title: Genesis 34:31
text: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with a harlot?

title: Genesis 35:1
text: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Beth-el, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, who appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.

title: Genesis 35:2
text: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the foreign gods that are among you, and purify yourselves, and change your garments:

title: Genesis 35:3
text: and let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.

title: Genesis 35:4
text: And they gave unto Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hand, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

title: Genesis 35:5
text: And they journeyed: and a terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.

title: Genesis 35:6
text: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan (the same is Beth-el), he and all the people that were with him.

title: Genesis 35:7
text: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el; because there God was revealed unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

title: Genesis 35:8
text: And Deborah Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried below Beth-el under the oak: and the name of it was called Allon-bacuth.

title: Genesis 35:9
text: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came from Paddan-aram, and blessed him.

title: Genesis 35:10
text: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.

title: Genesis 35:11
text: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;

title: Genesis 35:12
text: and the land which I gave unto Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.

title: Genesis 35:13
text: And God went up from him in the place where he spake with him.

title: Genesis 35:14
text: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spake with him, a pillar of stone: and he poured out a drink-offering thereon, and poured oil thereon.

title: Genesis 35:15
text: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Beth-el.

title: Genesis 35:16
text: And they journeyed from Beth-el; and there was still some distance to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labor.

title: Genesis 35:17
text: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labor, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; for now thou shalt have another son.

title: Genesis 35:18
text: And it came to pass, as her soul was departing (for she died), that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.

title: Genesis 35:19
text: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath (the same is Beth-lehem).

title: Genesis 35:20
text: And Jacob set up a pillar upon her grave: the same is the Pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.

title: Genesis 35:21
text: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.

title: Genesis 35:22
text: And it came to pass, while Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:

title: Genesis 35:23
