text: the sons of Leah: Reuben, Jacob's first-born, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun;

title: Genesis 35:24
text: the sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin;

title: Genesis 35:25
text: and the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid: Dan and Naphtali;

title: Genesis 35:26
text: and the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid: Gad and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, that were born to him in Paddan-aram.

title: Genesis 35:27
text: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father to Mamre, to Kiriath-arba (the same is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.

title: Genesis 35:28
text: And the days of Isaac were a hundred and fourscore years.

title: Genesis 35:29
text: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, old and full of days: and Esau and Jacob his sons buried him.

title: Genesis 36:1
text: Now these are the generations of Esau (the same is Edom).

title: Genesis 36:2
text: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite,

title: Genesis 36:3
text: and Basemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebaioth.

title: Genesis 36:4
text: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Basemath bare Reuel;

title: Genesis 36:5
text: and Oholibamah bare Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, that were born unto him in the land of Canaan.

title: Genesis 36:6
text: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the souls of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan; and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.

title: Genesis 36:7
text: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together; and the land of their sojournings could not bear them because of their cattle.

title: Genesis 36:8
text: And Esau dwelt in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.

title: Genesis 36:9
text: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:

title: Genesis 36:10
text: these are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Basemath the wife of Esau.

title: Genesis 36:11
text: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

title: Genesis 36:12
text: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these are the sons of Adah, Esau's wife.

title: Genesis 36:13
text: And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.

title: Genesis 36:14
text: And these were the sons of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah.

title: Genesis 36:15
text: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the first-born of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,

title: Genesis 36:16
text: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek: these are the chiefs that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Adah.

title: Genesis 36:17
text: And these are the sons of Reuel, Esau's son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah: these are the chiefs that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.

title: Genesis 36:18
text: And these are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau's wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah: these are the chiefs that came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.

title: Genesis 36:19
text: These are the sons of Esau, and these are their chiefs: the same is Edom.

title: Genesis 36:20
text: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon and Anah,

title: Genesis 36:21
text: and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan: these are the chiefs that came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

title: Genesis 36:22
text: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Heman; and Lotan's sister was Timna.

title: Genesis 36:23
text: And these are the children of Shobal: Alvan and Manahath and Ebal, Shepho and Onam.

title: Genesis 36:24
text: And these are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah; this is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.

title: Genesis 36:25
text: And these are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah.

title: Genesis 36:26
text: And these are the children of Dishon: Hemdan and Eshban and Ithran and Cheran.

title: Genesis 36:27
text: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan and Zaavan and Akan.

title: Genesis 36:28
text: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

title: Genesis 36:29
text: These are the chiefs that came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

title: Genesis 36:30
text: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, chief Dishan: these are the chiefs that came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

title: Genesis 36:31
text: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.

title: Genesis 36:32
text: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

title: Genesis 36:33
text: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

title: Genesis 36:34
text: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.

title: Genesis 36:35
text: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

title: Genesis 36:36
text: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

title: Genesis 36:37
text: And Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his stead.

title: Genesis 36:38
text: And Shaul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

title: Genesis 36:39
text: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.

title: Genesis 36:40
text: And these are the names of the chiefs that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

title: Genesis 36:41
text: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

title: Genesis 36:42
text: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

title: Genesis 36:43
text: chief Magdiel, chief Iram: these are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.

title: Genesis 37:1
text: And Jacob dwelt in the land of his father's sojournings, in the land of Canaan.

title: Genesis 37:2
text: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and he was a lad with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought the evil report of them unto their father.

title: Genesis 37:3
text: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colors.

title: Genesis 37:4
text: And his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren; and they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.

title: Genesis 37:5
text: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.

title: Genesis 37:6
text: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:

title: Genesis 37:7
text: for, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves came round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.

title: Genesis 37:8
text: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.

title: Genesis 37:9
text: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed yet a dream: and, behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars made obeisance to me.

title: Genesis 37:10
text: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren; and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?

title: Genesis 37:11
text: And his brethren envied him; but his father kept the saying in mind.

title: Genesis 37:12
text: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.

title: Genesis 37:13
text: And Israel said unto Joseph, Are not thy brethren feeding the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.

title: Genesis 37:14
text: And he said to him, Go now, see whether it is well with thy brethren, and well with the flock; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

title: Genesis 37:15
text: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?

title: Genesis 37:16
text: And he said, I am seeking my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they are feeding [the flock] .

title: Genesis 37:17
text: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.

title: Genesis 37:18
text: And they saw him afar off, and before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.

title: Genesis 37:19
text: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.

title: Genesis 37:20
text: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, An evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.

title: Genesis 37:21
text: And Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, Let us not take his life.

title: Genesis 37:22
text: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood; cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand upon him: that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.

title: Genesis 37:23
text: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stripped Joseph of his coat, the coat of many colors that was on him;

title: Genesis 37:24
text: and they took him, and cast him into the pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.

title: Genesis 37:25
text: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a caravan of Ishmaelites was coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

title: Genesis 37:26
text: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother and conceal his blood?

title: Genesis 37:27
text: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother, our flesh. And his brethren hearkened unto him.

title: Genesis 37:28
text: And there passed by Midianites, merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. And they brought Joseph into Egypt.

title: Genesis 37:29
text: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.

title: Genesis 37:30
text: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?

title: Genesis 37:31
text: And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a he-goat, and dipped the coat in the blood;

title: Genesis 37:32
text: and they sent the coat of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, This have we found: know now whether it is thy son's coat or not.

title: Genesis 37:33
text: And he knew it, and said, It is my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.

title: Genesis 37:34
text: And Jacob rent his garments, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.

title: Genesis 37:35
text: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down to Sheol to my son mourning. And his father wept for him.

title: Genesis 37:36
text: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, the captain of the guard.

title: Genesis 38:1
text: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

title: Genesis 38:2
text: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite whose name was Shua; and he took her, and went in unto her.

title: Genesis 38:3
text: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.

title: Genesis 38:4
text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.

title: Genesis 38:5
text: And she yet again bare a son, and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.

title: Genesis 38:6
text: And Judah took a wife for Er his first-born, and her name was Tamar.

title: Genesis 38:7
text: And Er, Judah's first-born, was wicked in the sight of Jehovah; and Jehovah slew him.

title: Genesis 38:8
text: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother's wife, and perform the duty of a husband's brother unto her, and raise up seed to thy brother.

title: Genesis 38:9
text: And Onan knew that the seed would not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother's wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest he should give seed to his brother.

title: Genesis 38:10
text: And the thing which he did was evil in the sight of Jehovah: and he slew him also.

title: Genesis 38:11
text: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter-in-law, Remain a widow in thy father's house, till Shelah my son be grown up; for he said, Lest he also die, like his brethren. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father's house.

title: Genesis 38:12
text: And in process of time Shua's daughter, the wife of Judah, died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheep-shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.

title: Genesis 38:13
text: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold, thy father-in-law goeth up to Timnah to shear his sheep.

title: Genesis 38:14
text: And she put off from her the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is by the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she was not given unto him to wife.

title: Genesis 38:15
text: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be a harlot; for she had covered her face.

title: Genesis 38:16
text: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Come, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee: for he knew not that she was his daughter-in-law. And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?

title: Genesis 38:17
text: And he said, I will send thee a kid of the goats from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?

title: Genesis 38:18
text: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet and thy cord, and thy staff that is in thy hand. And he gave them to her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.

title: Genesis 38:19
text: And she arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

title: Genesis 38:20
text: And Judah sent the kid of the goats by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman's hand: but he found her not.

title: Genesis 38:21
text: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the wayside? And they said, There hath been no prostitute here.

title: Genesis 38:22
text: And he returned to Judah, and said, I have not found her; and also the men of the place said, There hath been no prostitute here.

title: Genesis 38:23
text: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be put to shame: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.

title: Genesis 38:24
text: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter-in-law hath played the harlot; and moreover, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.

title: Genesis 38:25
text: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and the cords, and the staff.

title: Genesis 38:26
text: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She is more righteous than I, forasmuch as I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.

title: Genesis 38:27
text: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.

title: Genesis 38:28
text: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that one put out a hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.

title: Genesis 38:29
text: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, Wherefore hast thou made a breach for thyself? therefore his name was called Perez.

title: Genesis 38:30
text: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zerah.

title: Genesis 39:1
text: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hand of the Ishmaelites, that had brought him down thither.

title: Genesis 39:2
text: And Jehovah was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

title: Genesis 39:3
text: And his master saw that Jehovah was with him, and that Jehovah made all that he did to prosper in his hand.

title: Genesis 39:4
text: And Joseph found favor in his sight, and he ministered unto him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

title: Genesis 39:5
text: And it came to pass from the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that Jehovah blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of Jehovah was upon all that he had, in the house and in the field.

title: Genesis 39:6
text: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand; and he knew not aught [that was] with him, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was comely, and well-favored.

title: Genesis 39:7
text: And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.

title: Genesis 39:8
text: But he refused, and said unto his master's wife, Behold, my master knoweth not what is with me in the house, and he hath put all that he hath into my hand:

title: Genesis 39:9
text: he is not greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back anything from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

title: Genesis 39:10
text: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, [or] to be with her.

title: Genesis 39:11
text: And it came to pass about this time, that he went into the house to do his work; and there was none of the men of the house there within.

title: Genesis 39:12
text: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.

title: Genesis 39:13
text: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,

title: Genesis 39:14
text: that she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in a Hebrew unto us to mock us: he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:

title: Genesis 39:15
text: and it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment by me, and fled, and got him out.

title: Genesis 39:16
text: And she laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.

title: Genesis 39:17
text: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, whom thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:

title: Genesis 39:18
text: and it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment by me, and fled out.

title: Genesis 39:19
text: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.

title: Genesis 39:20
text: And Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king's prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.

title: Genesis 39:21
text: But Jehovah was with Joseph, and showed kindness unto him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

title: Genesis 39:22
text: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.

title: Genesis 39:23
text: The keeper of the prison looked not to anything that was under his hand, because Jehovah was with him; and that which he did, Jehovah made it to prosper.

title: Genesis 40:1
text: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord the king of Egypt.

title: Genesis 40:2
text: And Pharaoh was wroth against his two officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.

title: Genesis 40:3
text: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

title: Genesis 40:4
text: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he ministered unto them: and they continued a season in ward.

title: Genesis 40:5
text: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.

title: Genesis 40:6
text: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and saw them, and, behold, they were sad.

title: Genesis 40:7
text: And he asked Pharaoh's officers that were with him in ward in his master's house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sad to-day?

title: Genesis 40:8
text: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell it me, I pray you.

title: Genesis 40:9
text: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;

title: Genesis 40:10
text: and in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, [and] its blossoms shot forth; [and] the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:

title: Genesis 40:11
text: and Pharaoh's cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

title: Genesis 40:12
text: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: the three branches are three days;

title: Genesis 40:13
text: within yet three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head, and restore thee unto thine office: and thou shalt give Pharaoh's cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.

title: Genesis 40:14
text: But have me in thy remembrance when it shall be well with thee, and show kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:

title: Genesis 40:15
text: for indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.

title: Genesis 40:16
text: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head:

title: Genesis 40:17
text: and in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of baked food for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.

title: Genesis 40:18
text: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: the three baskets are three days;

title: Genesis 40:19
text: within yet three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.

title: Genesis 40:20
text: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and the head of the chief baker among his servants.

title: Genesis 40:21
text: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand:

title: Genesis 40:22
text: but he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.

title: Genesis 40:23
text: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.

title: Genesis 41:1
text: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.

title: Genesis 41:2
text: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, well-favored and fat-fleshed; and they fed in the reed-grass.

title: Genesis 41:3
text: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill-favored and lean-fleshed, and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.

title: Genesis 41:4
text: And the ill-favored and lean-fleshed kine did eat up the seven well-favored and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.

title: Genesis 41:5
text: And he slept and dreamed a second time: and, behold, seven ears of grain came up upon one stalk, rank and good.

title: Genesis 41:6
text: And, behold, seven ears, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

title: Genesis 41:7
text: And the thin ears swallowed up the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.

title: Genesis 41:8
text: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 41:9
text: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:

title: Genesis 41:10
text: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, me and the chief baker:

title: Genesis 41:11
text: and we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.

title: Genesis 41:12
text: And there was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.

title: Genesis 41:13
text: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.

title: Genesis 41:14
text: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 41:15
text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that when thou hearest a dream thou canst interpret it.

title: Genesis 41:16
text: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.

title: Genesis 41:17
text: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the brink of the river:

title: Genesis 41:18
text: and, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fat-fleshed and well-favored: and they fed in the reed-grass:

title: Genesis 41:19
text: and, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill-favored and lean-fleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:

title: Genesis 41:20
text: and the lean and ill-favored kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:

title: Genesis 41:21
text: and when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill-favored, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

title: Genesis 41:22
text: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up upon one stalk, full and good:

title: Genesis 41:23
text: and, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, [and] blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:

title: Genesis 41:24
text: and the thin ears swallowed up the seven good ears: and I told it unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.

title: Genesis 41:25
text: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: what God is about to do he hath declared unto Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 41:26
text: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.

title: Genesis 41:27
text: And the seven lean and ill-favored kine that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind; they shall be seven years of famine.

title: Genesis 41:28
text: That is the thing which I spake unto Pharaoh: what God is about to do he hath showed unto Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 41:29
text: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:

title: Genesis 41:30
text: and there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;

title: Genesis 41:31
text: and the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine which followeth; for it shall be very grievous.

title: Genesis 41:32
text: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh, it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

title: Genesis 41:33
text: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:34
text: Let Pharaoh do [this], and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.

title: Genesis 41:35
text: And let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and lay up grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.

title: Genesis 41:36
text: And the food shall be for a store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.

title: Genesis 41:37
text: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

title: Genesis 41:38
text: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom the spirit of God is?

title: Genesis 41:39
text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath showed thee all of this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou:

title: Genesis 41:40
text: thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.

title: Genesis 41:41
text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:42
text: And Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;

title: Genesis 41:43
text: and he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had: and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he set him over all the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:44
text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:45
text: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphenath-paneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath, the daughter of Poti-phera priest of On. And Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:46
text: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:47
text: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.

title: Genesis 41:48
text: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.

title: Genesis 41:49
text: And Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left off numbering; for it was without number.

title: Genesis 41:50
text: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Poti-phera priest of On, bare unto him.

title: Genesis 41:51
text: And Joseph called the name of the first-born Manasseh: For, [said he], God hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.

title: Genesis 41:52
text: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.

title: Genesis 41:53
text: And the seven years of plenty, that was in the land of Egypt, came to an end.

title: Genesis 41:54
text: And the seven years of famine began to come, according as Joseph had said: and there was famine in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

title: Genesis 41:55
text: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.

title: Genesis 41:56
text: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: and Joseph opened all the store-houses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine was sore in the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:57
text: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph to buy grain, because the famine was sore in all the earth.

title: Genesis 42:1
text: Now Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?

title: Genesis 42:2
text: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.

title: Genesis 42:3
text: And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy grain from Egypt.

title: Genesis 42:4
text: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure harm befall him.

title: Genesis 42:5
text: And the sons of Israel came to buy among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

title: Genesis 42:6
text: And Joseph was the governor over the land; he it was that sold to all the people of the land. And Joseph's brethren came, and bowed down themselves to him with their faces to the earth.

title: Genesis 42:7
text: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly with them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.

title: Genesis 42:8
text: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.

title: Genesis 42:9
text: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

title: Genesis 42:10
text: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.

title: Genesis 42:11
text: We are all one man's sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.

title: Genesis 42:12
text: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

title: Genesis 42:13
text: And they said, We thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.

title: Genesis 42:14
text: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, Ye are spies:

title: Genesis 42:15
text: hereby ye shall be proved: by the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.

title: Genesis 42:16
text: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be bound, that your words may be proved, whether there be truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.

title: Genesis 42:17
text: And he put them all together into ward three days.

title: Genesis 42:18
text: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear God:

title: Genesis 42:19
text: if ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in your prison-house; but go ye, carry grain for the famine of your houses:

title: Genesis 42:20
text: and bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.

title: Genesis 42:21
text: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.

title: Genesis 42:22
text: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore also, behold, his blood is required.

title: Genesis 42:23
text: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them.

title: Genesis 42:24
text: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and he returned to them, and spake to them, and took Simeon from among them, and bound him before their eyes.

title: Genesis 42:25
text: Then Joseph commanded to fill their vessels with grain, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provisions for the way: and thus was it done unto them.

title: Genesis 42:26
text: And they laded their asses with their grain, and departed thence.

title: Genesis 42:27
text: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the lodging-place, he espied his money; and, behold, it was in the mouth of his sack.

title: Genesis 42:28
text: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they turned trembling one to another, saying, What is this that God hath done unto us?

title: Genesis 42:29
text: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that had befallen them, saying,

title: Genesis 42:30
text: The man, the lord of the land, spake roughly with us, and took us for spies of the country.

title: Genesis 42:31
text: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:

title: Genesis 42:32
text: we are twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

title: Genesis 42:33
text: And the man, the lord of the land, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men: leave one of your brethren with me, and take [grain for] the famine of your houses, and go your way;

title: Genesis 42:34
text: and bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye are no spies, but that ye are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffic in the land.

title: Genesis 42:35
text: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man's bundle of money was in his sack: and when they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were afraid.

title: Genesis 42:36
text: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.

title: Genesis 42:37
text: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.

title: Genesis 42:38
text: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he only is left: if harm befall him by the way in which ye go, then will ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.

title: Genesis 43:1
text: And the famine was sore in the land.

title: Genesis 43:2
text: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the grain which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.

title: Genesis 43:3
text: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

title: Genesis 43:4
text: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:

title: Genesis 43:5
text: but if thou wilt not send him, we will not go down; for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

title: Genesis 43:6
text: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?

title: Genesis 43:7
text: And they said, The man asked straitly concerning ourselves, and concerning our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye [another] brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we in any wise know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

title: Genesis 43:8
text: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.

title: Genesis 43:9
text: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:

title: Genesis 43:10
text: for except we had lingered, surely we had now returned a second time.

title: Genesis 43:11
text: And their father Israel said unto them, If it be so now, do this: take of the choice fruits of the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spicery and myrrh, nuts, and almonds;

title: Genesis 43:12
text: and take double money in your hand; and the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks carry again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:

title: Genesis 43:13
text: take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:

title: Genesis 43:14
text: and God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release unto you your other brother and Benjamin. And if I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.

title: Genesis 43:15
text: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

title: Genesis 43:16
text: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, Bring the men into the house, and slay, and make ready; for the men shall dine with me at noon.

title: Genesis 43:17
text: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men to Joseph's house.

title: Genesis 43:18
text: And the men were afraid, because they were brought to Joseph's house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.

title: Genesis 43:19
text: And they came near to the steward of Joseph's house, and they spake unto him at the door of the house,

title: Genesis 43:20
text: and said, Oh, my lord, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:

title: Genesis 43:21
text: and it came to pass, when we came to the lodging-place, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man's money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.

title: Genesis 43:22
text: And other money have we brought down in our hand to buy food: we know not who put our money in our sacks.

title: Genesis 43:23
text: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.

title: Genesis 43:24
text: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.

title: Genesis 43:25
text: And they made ready the present against Joseph's coming at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.

title: Genesis 43:26
text: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed down themselves to him to the earth.

title: Genesis 43:27
text: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?

title: Genesis 43:28
text: And they said, Thy servant our father is well, he is yet alive. And they bowed the head, and made obeisance.

title: Genesis 43:29
text: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw Benjamin his brother, his mother's son, and said, Is this your youngest brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.

title: Genesis 43:30
text: And Joseph made haste; for his heart yearned over his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.

title: Genesis 43:31
text: And he washed his face, and came out; and he refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.

title: Genesis 43:32
text: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, that did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

title: Genesis 43:33
text: And they sat before him, the first-born according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one with another.

title: Genesis 43:34
text: And he took [and sent] messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin's mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him. [

title: Genesis 44:1
text: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man's money in his sack's mouth.

title: Genesis 44:2
text: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, and his grain money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

title: Genesis 44:3
text: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.

title: Genesis 44:4
text: [ And] when they were gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?

title: Genesis 44:5
text: Is not this that in which my lord drinketh, and whereby he indeed divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.

title: Genesis 44:6
text: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these words.

title: Genesis 44:7
text: And they said unto him, Wherefore speaketh my lord such words as these? Far be it from thy servants that they should do such a thing.

title: Genesis 44:8
text: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord's house silver or gold?

title: Genesis 44:9
text: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, let him die, and we also will be my lord's bondmen.

title: Genesis 44:10
text: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my bondman; and ye shall be blameless.

title: Genesis 44:11
text: Then they hasted, and took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.

title: Genesis 44:12
text: And he searched, [and] began at the eldest, and left off at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

title: Genesis 44:13
text: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.

title: Genesis 44:14
text: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house; and he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.

title: Genesis 44:15
text: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? know ye not that such a man as I can indeed divine?

title: Genesis 44:16
text: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord's bondmen, both we, and he also in whose hand the cup is found.

title: Genesis 44:17
text: And he said, Far be it from me that I should do so: the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my bondman; but as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.

title: Genesis 44:18
text: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh, my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant; for thou art even as Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 44:19
text: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?

title: Genesis 44:20
text: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loveth him.

title: Genesis 44:21
text: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.

title: Genesis 44:22
text: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.

title: Genesis 44:23
text: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.

title: Genesis 44:24
text: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

title: Genesis 44:25
text: And our father said, Go again, buy us a little food.

title: Genesis 44:26
text: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down; for we may not see the man's face, except our youngest brother be with us.

title: Genesis 44:27
text: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:

title: Genesis 44:28
text: and the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I have not seen him since:

title: Genesis 44:29
text: and if ye take this one also from me, and harm befall him, ye will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.

title: Genesis 44:30
text: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad is not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad's life;

title: Genesis 44:31
text: it will come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not [with us], that he will die: and thy servants will bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to Sheol.

title: Genesis 44:32
text: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then shall I bear the blame to my father for ever.

title: Genesis 44:33
text: Now therefore, let thy servant, I pray thee, abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.

title: Genesis 44:34
text: For how shall I go up to my father, if the lad be not with me? lest I see the evil that shall come on my father.

title: Genesis 45:1
text: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.

title: Genesis 45:2
text: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.

title: Genesis 45:3
text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.

title: Genesis 45:4
text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

title: Genesis 45:5
text: And now be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.

title: Genesis 45:6
text: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and there are yet five years, in which there shall be neither plowing nor harvest.

title: Genesis 45:7
text: And God sent me before you to preserve you a remnant in the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.

title: Genesis 45:8
text: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 45:9
text: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not;

title: Genesis 45:10
text: and thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:

title: Genesis 45:11
text: and there will I nourish thee; for there are yet five years of famine; lest thou come to poverty, thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast.

title: Genesis 45:12
text: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.

title: Genesis 45:13
text: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen: and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.

title: Genesis 45:14
text: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

title: Genesis 45:15
text: And he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.

title: Genesis 45:16
text: And the report thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

title: Genesis 45:17
text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye: lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;

title: Genesis 45:18
text: and take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.

title: Genesis 45:19
text: Now thou art commanded, this do ye: take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

title: Genesis 45:20
text: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.

title: Genesis 45:21
text: And the sons of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

title: Genesis 45:22
text: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.

title: Genesis 45:23
text: And to his father he sent after this manner: ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she-asses laden with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way.

title: Genesis 45:24
text: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.

title: Genesis 45:25
text: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father.

title: Genesis 45:26
text: And they told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt. And his heart fainted, for he believed them not.

title: Genesis 45:27
text: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:

title: Genesis 45:28
text: and Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.

title: Genesis 46:1
text: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.

title: Genesis 46:2
text: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.

title: Genesis 46:3
text: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:

title: Genesis 46:4
text: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.

title: Genesis 46:5
text: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

title: Genesis 46:6
text: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:

title: Genesis 46:7
text: his sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.

title: Genesis 46:8
text: And these are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's first-born.

title: Genesis 46:9
text: And the sons of Reuben: Hanoch, and Pallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

title: Genesis 46:10
text: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.

title: Genesis 46:11
text: And the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

title: Genesis 46:12
text: And the sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

title: Genesis 46:13
text: And the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puvah, and Iob, and Shimron.

title: Genesis 46:14
text: And the sons of Zebulun: Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.

title: Genesis 46:15
text: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bare unto Jacob in Paddan-aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.

title: Genesis 46:16
text: And the sons of Gad: Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

title: Genesis 46:17
text: And the sons of Asher: Imnah, and Ishvah, and Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister; and the sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel.

title: Genesis 46:18
text: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter; and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.

title: Genesis 46:19
text: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife: Joseph and Benjamin.

title: Genesis 46:20
text: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Poti-phera priest of On, bare unto him.

title: Genesis 46:21
text: And the sons of Benjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

title: Genesis 46:22
text: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

title: Genesis 46:23
text: And the sons of Dan: Hushim.

title: Genesis 46:24
text: And the sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

title: Genesis 46:25
text: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.

title: Genesis 46:26
text: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, that came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls were threescore and six;

title: Genesis 46:27
text: and the sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, that came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.

title: Genesis 46:28
text: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to show the way before him unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.

title: Genesis 46:29
text: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen; and he presented himself unto him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

title: Genesis 46:30
text: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, that thou art yet alive.

title: Genesis 46:31
text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father's house, I will go up, and tell Pharaoh, and will say unto him, My brethren, and my father's house, who were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;

title: Genesis 46:32
text: and the men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

title: Genesis 46:33
text: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?

title: Genesis 46:34
text: that ye shall say, Thy servants have been keepers of cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

title: Genesis 47:1
text: Then Joseph went in and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.

title: Genesis 47:2
text: And from among his brethren he took five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 47:3
text: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and our fathers.

title: Genesis 47:4
text: And they said unto Pharaoh, To sojourn in the land are we come; for there is no pasture for thy servants' flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

title: Genesis 47:5
text: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:

title: Genesis 47:6
text: the land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and thy brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any able men among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.

title: Genesis 47:7
text: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 47:8
text: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How many are the days of the years of thy life?

title: Genesis 47:9
text: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are a hundred and thirty years: few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, and they have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

title: Genesis 47:10
text: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from the presence of Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 47:11
text: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

title: Genesis 47:12
text: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father's household, with bread, according to their families.

title: Genesis 47:13
text: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

title: Genesis 47:14
text: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.

title: Genesis 47:15
text: And when the money was all spent in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for [our] money faileth.

title: Genesis 47:16
text: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.

title: Genesis 47:17
text: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph; and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses, and for the flocks, and for the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread in exchange for all their cattle for that year.

title: Genesis 47:18
text: And when that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide from my lord, how that our money is all spent; and the herds of cattle are my lord's; there is nought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:

title: Genesis 47:19
text: wherefore should we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land be not desolate.

title: Genesis 47:20
text: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine was sore upon them: and the land became Pharaoh's.

title: Genesis 47:21
text: And as for the people, he removed them to the cities from one end of the border of Egypt even to the other end thereof.

title: Genesis 47:22
text: Only the land of the priests bought he not: for the priests had a portion from Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them; wherefore they sold not their land.

title: Genesis 47:23
text: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.

title: Genesis 47:24
text: And it shall come to pass at the ingatherings, that ye shall give a fifth unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.

title: Genesis 47:25
text: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find favor in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.

title: Genesis 47:26
text: And Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth; only the land of the priests alone became not Pharaoh's.

title: Genesis 47:27
text: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen; and they gat them possessions therein, and were fruitful, and multiplied exceedingly.

title: Genesis 47:28
text: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were a hundred forty and seven years.

title: Genesis 47:29
text: And the time drew near that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found favor in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me: bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt;

title: Genesis 47:30
text: but when I sleep with my fathers, thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their burying-place. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.

title: Genesis 47:31
text: And he said, Swear unto me: and he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.

title: Genesis 48:1
text: And it came to pass after these things, that one said to Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

title: Genesis 48:2
text: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

title: Genesis 48:3
text: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

title: Genesis 48:4
text: and said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a company of peoples, and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.

title: Genesis 48:5
text: And now thy two sons, who were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, shall be mine.

title: Genesis 48:6
text: And thy issue, that thou begettest after them, shall be thine; they shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

title: Genesis 48:7
text: And as for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when there was still some distance to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way to Ephrath (the same is Beth-lehem).

title: Genesis 48:8
text: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who are these?

title: Genesis 48:9
text: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me here. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.

title: Genesis 48:10
text: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

title: Genesis 48:11
text: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath let me see thy seed also.

title: Genesis 48:12
text: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees; and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

title: Genesis 48:13
text: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought them near unto him.

title: Genesis 48:14
text: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim's head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh's head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the first-born.

title: Genesis 48:15
text: And he blessed Joseph, and said, The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God who hath fed me all my life long unto this day,

title: Genesis 48:16
text: the angel who hath redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

title: Genesis 48:17
text: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father's hand, to remove it from Ephraim's head unto Manasseh's head.

title: Genesis 48:18
text: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father; for this is the first-born; put thy right hand upon his head.

title: Genesis 48:19
text: And his father refused, and said, I know [it], my son, I know [it] ; he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: howbeit his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

title: Genesis 48:20
text: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee will Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

title: Genesis 48:21
text: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God will be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

title: Genesis 48:22
text: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.

title: Genesis 49:1
text: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said: Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the latter days.

title: Genesis 49:2
text: Assemble yourselves, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; And hearken unto Israel your father.

title: Genesis 49:3
text: Reuben, thou art my first-born, my might, and the beginning of my strength; The pre-eminence of dignity, and the pre-eminence of power.

title: Genesis 49:4
text: Boiling over as water, thou shalt not have the pre-eminence; Because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; Then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.

title: Genesis 49:5
text: Simeon and Levi are brethren; Weapons of violence are their swords.

title: Genesis 49:6
text: O my soul, come not thou into their council; Unto their assembly, my glory, be not thou united; For in their anger they slew a man, And in their self-will they hocked [ an ox.

title: Genesis 49:7
text: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; And their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, And scatter them in Israel.

title: Genesis 49:8
text: Judah, thee shall thy brethren praise: Thy hand shall be on the neck of thine enemies; Thy father's sons shall bow down before thee.

title: Genesis 49:9
text: Judah is a lion's whelp; From the prey, my son, thou art gone up: He stooped down, he couched as a lion, And as a lioness; who shall rouse him up?

title: Genesis 49:10
text: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, Nor the ruler's staff from between his feet, Until Shiloh come; And unto him shall the obedience of the peoples be.

title: Genesis 49:11
text: Binding his foal unto the vine, And his ass's colt unto the choice vine; He hath washed his garments in wine, And his vesture in the blood of grapes:

title: Genesis 49:12
text: His eyes shall be red with wine, And his teeth white with milk.

title: Genesis 49:13
text: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; And he shall be for a haven of ships; And his border shall be upon Sidon.

title: Genesis 49:14
text: Issachar is a strong ass, Couching down between the sheepfolds:

title: Genesis 49:15
text: And he saw a resting-place that it was good, And the land that it was pleasant; And he bowed his shoulder to bear, And became a servant under taskwork.

title: Genesis 49:16
text: Dan shall judge his people, As one of the tribes of Israel.

title: Genesis 49:17
text: Dan shall be a serpent in the way, An adder in the path, That biteth the horse's heels, So that his rider falleth backward.

title: Genesis 49:18
text: I have waited for thy salvation, O Jehovah.

title: Genesis 49:19
text: Gad, a troop shall press upon him; But he shall press upon their heel.

title: Genesis 49:20
text: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, And he shall yield royal dainties.

title: Genesis 49:21
text: Naphtali is a hind let loose: He giveth goodly words.

title: Genesis 49:22
text: Joseph is a fruitful bough, A fruitful bough by a fountain; His branches run over the wall.

title: Genesis 49:23
text: The archers have sorely grieved him, And shot at him, and persecuted him:

title: Genesis 49:24
text: But his bow abode in strength, And the arms of his hands were made strong, By the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob (From thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel), [

title: Genesis 49:25
text: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee, And by the Almighty, who shall bless thee, With blessings of heaven above, Blessings of the deep that coucheth beneath, Blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.

title: Genesis 49:26
text: The blessings of thy father Have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors Unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: They shall be on the head of Joseph, And on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.

title: Genesis 49:27
text: Benjamin is a wolf that raveneth: In the morning he shall devour the prey, And at even he shall divide the spoil.

title: Genesis 49:28
text: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.

title: Genesis 49:29
text: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

title: Genesis 49:30
text: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a burying-place.

title: Genesis 49:31
text: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah--

title: Genesis 49:32
text: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.

title: Genesis 49:33
text: And when Jacob made an end of charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.

title: Genesis 50:1
text: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.

title: Genesis 50:2
text: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.

title: Genesis 50:3
text: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of embalming: and the Egyptians wept for him three-score and ten days.

title: Genesis 50:4
text: And when the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found favor in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

title: Genesis 50:5
text: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.

title: Genesis 50:6
text: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.

title: Genesis 50:7
text: And Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,

title: Genesis 50:8
text: and all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

title: Genesis 50:9
text: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.

title: Genesis 50:10
text: And they came to the threshing-floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.

title: Genesis 50:11
text: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abel-mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.

title: Genesis 50:12
text: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:

title: Genesis 50:13
text: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, for a possession of a burying-place, of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.

title: Genesis 50:14
text: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

title: Genesis 50:15
text: And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully requite us all the evil which we did unto him.

title: Genesis 50:16
text: And they sent a message unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,

title: Genesis 50:17
text: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the transgression of thy brethren, and their sin, for that they did unto thee evil. And now, we pray thee, forgive the transgression of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.

title: Genesis 50:18
text: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we are thy servants.

title: Genesis 50:19
text: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?

title: Genesis 50:20
text: And as for you, ye meant evil against me; but God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

title: Genesis 50:21
text: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.

title: Genesis 50:22
text: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father's house: and Joseph lived a hundred and ten years.

title: Genesis 50:23
text: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were born upon Joseph's knees.

title: Genesis 50:24
text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die; but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

title: Genesis 50:25
text: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.

title: Genesis 50:26
text: So Joseph died, being a hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

title: Exodus 1:1
text: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel, who came into Egypt (every man and his household came with Jacob):

title: Exodus 1:2
text: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

title: Exodus 1:3
text: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

title: Exodus 1:4
text: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

title: Exodus 1:5
