text: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found favor in thy sight, show me now thy ways, that I may know thee, to the end that I may find favor in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.

title: Exodus 33:14
text: And he said, My presence shall go [with thee], and I will give thee rest.

title: Exodus 33:15
text: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not [with me], carry us not up hence.

title: Exodus 33:16
text: For wherein now shall it be known that I have found favor in thy sight, I and thy people? is it not in that thou goest with us, so that we are separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth?

title: Exodus 33:17
text: And Jehovah said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken; for thou hast found favor in my sight, and I know thee by name.

title: Exodus 33:18
text: And he said, Show me, I pray thee, thy glory.

title: Exodus 33:19
text: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and will proclaim the name of Jehovah before thee; and I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.

title: Exodus 33:20
text: And he said, Thou canst not see my face; for man shall not see me and live.

title: Exodus 33:21
text: And Jehovah said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon the rock:

title: Exodus 33:22
text: and it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a cleft of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand until I have passed by:

title: Exodus 33:23
text: and I will take away my hand, and thou shalt see my back; but my face shall not be seen.

title: Exodus 34:1
text: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon the tables the words that were on the first tables, which thou brakest.

title: Exodus 34:2
text: And be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me on the top of the mount.

title: Exodus 34:3
text: And no man shall come up with thee; neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.

title: Exodus 34:4
text: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as Jehovah had commanded him, and took in his hand two tables of stone.

title: Exodus 34:5
text: And Jehovah descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of Jehovah.

title: Exodus 34:6
text: And Jehovah passed by before him, and proclaimed, Jehovah, Jehovah, a God merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness and truth;

title: Exodus 34:7
text: keeping lovingkindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin; and that will by no means clear [the guilty], visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, upon the third and upon the fourth generation.

title: Exodus 34:8
text: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.

title: Exodus 34:9
text: And he said, If now I have found favor in thy sight, O Lord, let the Lord, I pray thee, go in the midst of us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.

title: Exodus 34:10
text: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been wrought in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of Jehovah; for it is a terrible thing that I do with thee.

title: Exodus 34:11
text: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

title: Exodus 34:12
text: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:

title: Exodus 34:13
text: but ye shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and ye shall cut down their Asherim

title: Exodus 34:14
text: (for thou shalt worship no other god: for Jehovah, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God);

title: Exodus 34:15
text: lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they play the harlot after their gods, and sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee and thou eat of his sacrifice;

title: Exodus 34:16
text: and thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters play the harlot after their gods, and make thy sons play the harlot after their gods.

title: Exodus 34:17
text: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.

title: Exodus 34:18
text: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.

title: Exodus 34:19
text: All that openeth the womb is mine; and all thy cattle that is male, the firstlings of cow and sheep.

title: Exodus 34:20
text: And the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break its neck. All the first-born of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.

title: Exodus 34:21
text: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in plowing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.

title: Exodus 34:22
text: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, [even] of the first-fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year's end.

title: Exodus 34:23
text: Three times in the year shall all thy males appear before the Lord Jehovah, the God of Israel.

title: Exodus 34:24
text: For I will cast out nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou goest up to appear before Jehovah thy God three times in the year.

title: Exodus 34:25
text: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.

title: Exodus 34:26
text: The first of the first-fruits of thy ground thou shalt bring unto the house of Jehovah thy God. Thou shalt not boil a kid in its mother's milk.

title: Exodus 34:27
text: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.

title: Exodus 34:28
text: And he was there with Jehovah forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

title: Exodus 34:29
text: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of the testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses knew not that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.

title: Exodus 34:30
text: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.

title: Exodus 34:31
text: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses spake to them.

title: Exodus 34:32
text: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that Jehovah had spoken with him in mount Sinai.

title: Exodus 34:33
text: And when Moses had done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.

title: Exodus 34:34
text: But when Moses went in before Jehovah to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

title: Exodus 34:35
text: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face shone; and Moses put the veil upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

title: Exodus 35:1
text: And Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said unto them, These are the words which Jehovah hath commanded, that ye should do them.

title: Exodus 35:2
text: Six days shall work be done; but on the seventh day there shall be to you a holy day, a sabbath of solemn rest to Jehovah: whosoever doeth any work therein shall be put to death.

title: Exodus 35:3
text: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.

title: Exodus 35:4
text: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which Jehovah commanded, saying,

title: Exodus 35:5
text: Take ye from among you an offering unto Jehovah; whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, Jehovah's offering: gold, and silver, and brass,

title: Exodus 35:6
text: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' [hair] ,

title: Exodus 35:7
text: and rams' skins dyed red, and sealskins, and acacia wood,

title: Exodus 35:8
text: and oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,

title: Exodus 35:9
text: and onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate.

title: Exodus 35:10
text: And let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that Jehovah hath commanded:

title: Exodus 35:11
text: the tabernacle, its tent, and its covering, its clasps, and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;

title: Exodus 35:12
text: the ark, and the staves thereof, the mercy-seat, and the veil of the screen;

title: Exodus 35:13
text: the table, and its staves, and all its vessels, and the showbread;

title: Exodus 35:14
text: the candlestick also for the light, and its vessels, and its lamps, and the oil for the light;

title: Exodus 35:15
text: and the altar of incense, and its staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;

title: Exodus 35:16
text: the altar of burnt-offering, with its grating of brass, it staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base;

title: Exodus 35:17
text: the hangings of the court, the pillars thereof, and their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;

title: Exodus 35:18
text: the pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords;

title: Exodus 35:19
text: the finely wrought garments, for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.

title: Exodus 35:20
text: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

title: Exodus 35:21
text: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, [and] brought Jehovah's offering, for the work of the tent of meeting, and for all the service thereof, and for the holy garments.

title: Exodus 35:22
text: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, [and] brought brooches, and ear-rings, and signet-rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man that offered an offering of gold unto Jehovah.

title: Exodus 35:23
text: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' [hair], and rams' skins dyed red, and sealskins, brought them.

title: Exodus 35:24
text: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought Jehovah's offering; and every man, with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.

title: Exodus 35:25
text: And all the women that were wise-hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, the blue, and the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.

title: Exodus 35:26
text: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats' [hair] .

title: Exodus 35:27
text: And the rulers brought the onyx stones, and the stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;

title: Exodus 35:28
text: and the spice, and the oil; for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

title: Exodus 35:29
text: The children of Israel brought a freewill-offering unto Jehovah; every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which Jehovah had commanded to be made by Moses.

title: Exodus 35:30
text: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, Jehovah hath called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;

title: Exodus 35:31
text: and he hath filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;

title: Exodus 35:32
text: and to devise skilful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

title: Exodus 35:33
text: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all manner of skilful workmanship.

title: Exodus 35:34
text: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

title: Exodus 35:35
text: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of workmanship, of the engraver, and of the skilful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any workmanship, and of those that devise skilful works.

title: Exodus 36:1
text: And Bezalel and Oholiab shall work, and every wise-hearted man, in whom Jehovah hath put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that Jehovah hath commanded.

title: Exodus 36:2
text: And Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart Jehovah had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:

title: Exodus 36:3
text: and they received of Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, wherewith to make it. And they brought yet unto him freewill-offerings every morning.

title: Exodus 36:4
text: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they wrought;

title: Exodus 36:5
text: and they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work which Jehovah commanded to make.

title: Exodus 36:6
text: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.

title: Exodus 36:7
text: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.

title: Exodus 36:8
text: And all the wise-hearted men among them that wrought the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains; of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim, the work of the skilful workman, [Bezalel] made them.

title: Exodus 36:9
text: The length of each curtain was eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains had one measure.

title: Exodus 36:10
text: And he coupled five curtains one to another: and [the other] five curtains he coupled one to another.

title: Exodus 36:11
text: And he made loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outmost in the second coupling.

title: Exodus 36:12
text: Fifty loops made he in the one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling: the loops were opposite one to another.

title: Exodus 36:13
text: And he made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains one to another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was one.

title: Exodus 36:14
text: And he made curtains of goats' [hair] for a tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.

title: Exodus 36:15
text: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the breadth of each curtain: the eleven curtains had one measure.

title: Exodus 36:16
text: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

title: Exodus 36:17
text: And he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which was [outmost in] the second coupling.

title: Exodus 36:18
text: And he made fifty clasps of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.

title: Exodus 36:19
text: And he made a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of sealskins above.

title: Exodus 36:20
text: And he made the boards for the tabernacle, of acacia wood, standing up.

title: Exodus 36:21
text: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the breadth of each board.

title: Exodus 36:22
text: Each board had two tenons, joined one to another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

title: Exodus 36:23
text: And he made the boards for the tabernacle: twenty boards for the south side southward;

title: Exodus 36:24
text: and he made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

title: Exodus 36:25
text: And for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards,

title: Exodus 36:26
text: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

title: Exodus 36:27
text: And for the hinder part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

title: Exodus 36:28
text: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the hinder part.

title: Exodus 36:29
text: And they were double beneath; and in like manner they were entire unto the top thereof unto one ring: thus he did to both of them in the two corners.

title: Exodus 36:30
text: And there were eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; under every board two sockets.

title: Exodus 36:31
text: And he made bars of acacia wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

title: Exodus 36:32
text: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.

title: Exodus 36:33
text: And he made the middle bar to pass through in the midst of the boards from the one end to the other.

title: Exodus 36:34
text: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold for places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

title: Exodus 36:35
text: And he made the veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubim, the work of the skilful workman, made he it.

title: Exodus 36:36
text: And he made thereunto four pillars of acacia, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold: and he cast for them four sockets of silver.

title: Exodus 36:37
text: And he made a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer;

title: Exodus 36:38
text: and the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold; and their five sockets were of brass.

title: Exodus 37:1
text: And Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it.

title: Exodus 37:2
text: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.

title: Exodus 37:3
text: And he cast for it four rings of gold, in the four feet thereof; even two rings on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

title: Exodus 37:4
text: And he made staves of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.

title: Exodus 37:5
text: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

title: Exodus 37:6
text: And he made a mercy-seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half [was] the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

title: Exodus 37:7
text: And he made two cherubim of gold; of beaten work made he them, at the two ends of the mercy-seat;

title: Exodus 37:8
text: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end: of one piece with the mercy-seat made he the cherubim at the two ends thereof.

title: Exodus 37:9
text: And the cherubim spread out their wings on high, covering the mercy-seat with their wings, with their faces one to another; toward the mercy-seat were the faces of the cherubim.

title: Exodus 37:10
text: And he made the table of acacia wood: two cubits [was] the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

title: Exodus 37:11
text: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereto a crown of gold round about.

title: Exodus 37:12
text: And he made unto it a border of a handbreadth round about, and made a golden crown to the border thereof round about.

title: Exodus 37:13
text: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that were on the four feet thereof.

title: Exodus 37:14
text: Close by the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.

title: Exodus 37:15
text: And he made the staves of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.

title: Exodus 37:16
text: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, the dishes thereof, and the spoons thereof, and the bowls thereof, and the flagons thereof, wherewith to pour out, of pure gold.

title: Exodus 37:17
text: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick, even its base, and its shaft; its cups, it knops, and its flowers, were of one piece with it.

title: Exodus 37:18
text: And there were six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:

title: Exodus 37:19
text: three cups made like almond-blossoms in one branch, a knop and a flower, and three cups made like almond-blossoms in the other branch, a knop and a flower: so for the six branches going out of the candlestick.

title: Exodus 37:20
text: And in the candlestick were four cups made like almond-blossoms, the knops thereof, and the flowers thereof;

title: Exodus 37:21
text: and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.

title: Exodus 37:22
text: Their knops and their branches were of one piece with it: the whole of it was one beaten work of pure gold.

title: Exodus 37:23
text: And he made the lamps thereof, seven, and the snuffers thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, of pure gold.

title: Exodus 37:24
text: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.

title: Exodus 37:25
text: And he made the altar of incense of acacia wood: a cubit was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, foursquare; and two cubits was the height thereof; the horns thereof were of one piece with it.

title: Exodus 37:26
text: And he overlaid it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: and he made unto it a crown of gold round about.

title: Exodus 37:27
text: And he made for it two golden rings under the crown thereof, upon the two ribs thereof, upon the two sides of it, for places for staves wherewith to bear it.

title: Exodus 37:28
text: And he made the staves of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.

title: Exodus 37:29
text: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.

title: Exodus 38:1
text: And he made the altar of burnt-offering of acacia wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof, foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.

title: Exodus 38:2
text: And he made the horns thereof upon the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of one piece with it: and he overlaid it with brass.

title: Exodus 38:3
text: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basins, the flesh-hooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.

title: Exodus 38:4
text: And he made for the altar a grating of network of brass, under the ledge round it beneath, reaching halfway up.

title: Exodus 38:5
text: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grating of brass, to be places for the staves.

title: Exodus 38:6
text: And he made the staves of acacia wood, and overlaid them with brass.

title: Exodus 38:7
text: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, wherewith to bear it; he made it hollow with planks.

title: Exodus 38:8
text: And he made the laver of brass, and the base thereof of brass, of the mirrors of the ministering women that ministered at the door of the tent of meeting.

title: Exodus 38:9
text: And he made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, a hundred cubits;

title: Exodus 38:10
text: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

title: Exodus 38:11
text: And for the north side a hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

title: Exodus 38:12
text: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

title: Exodus 38:13
text: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.

title: Exodus 38:14
text: The hangings for the one side [of the gate] were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;

title: Exodus 38:15
text: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

title: Exodus 38:16
text: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.

title: Exodus 38:17
text: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver; and the overlaying of their capitals, of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.

title: Exodus 38:18
text: And the screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.

title: Exodus 38:19
text: And their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of brass; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.

title: Exodus 38:20
text: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.

title: Exodus 38:21
text: This is the sum of [the things for] the tabernacle, even the tabernacle of the testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

title: Exodus 38:22
text: And Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 38:23
text: And with him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skilful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and in fine linen.

title: Exodus 38:24
text: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

title: Exodus 38:25
text: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was a hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

title: Exodus 38:26
text: a beka a head, [that is], half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that passed over to them that were numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.

title: Exodus 38:27
text: And the hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the veil; a hundred sockets for the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.

title: Exodus 38:28
text: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five [shekels] he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.

title: Exodus 38:29
text: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.

title: Exodus 38:30
text: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tent of meeting, and the brazen altar, and the brazen grating for it, and all the vessels of the altar,

title: Exodus 38:31
text: and the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the gate of the court, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.

title: Exodus 39:1
text: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made finely wrought garments, for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:2
text: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

title: Exodus 39:3
text: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, the work of the skilful workman.

title: Exodus 39:4
text: They made shoulder-pieces for it, joined together; at the two ends was it joined together.

title: Exodus 39:5
text: And the skilfully woven band, that was upon it, wherewith to gird it on, was of the same piece [and] like the work thereof; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:6
text: And they wrought the onyx stones, inclosed in settings of gold, graven with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.

title: Exodus 39:7
text: And he put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:8
text: And he made the breastplate, the work of the skilful workman, like the work of the ephod; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

title: Exodus 39:9
text: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being double.

title: Exodus 39:10
text: And they set in it four rows of stones. A row of sardius, topaz, and carbuncle was the first row;

title: Exodus 39:11
text: and the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond;

title: Exodus 39:12
text: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

title: Exodus 39:13
text: and the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jaspar: they were inclosed in inclosings of gold in their settings.

title: Exodus 39:14
text: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, every one according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

title: Exodus 39:15
text: And they made upon the breastplate chains like cords, of wreathen work of pure gold.

title: Exodus 39:16
text: And they made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

title: Exodus 39:17
text: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

title: Exodus 39:18
text: And the [other] two ends of the two wreathen chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, in the forepart thereof.

title: Exodus 39:19
text: And they made two rings of gold, and put them upon the two ends of the breastplate, upon the edge thereof, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.

title: Exodus 39:20
text: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder-pieces of the ephod underneath, in the forepart thereof, close by the coupling thereof, above the skilfully woven band of the ephod.

title: Exodus 39:21
text: And they did bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be upon the skilfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:22
text: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue;

title: Exodus 39:23
text: and the hole of the robe in the midst thereof, as the hole of a coat of mail, with a binding round about the hole of it, that it should not be rent.

title: Exodus 39:24
text: And they made upon the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, [and] twined [linen] .

title: Exodus 39:25
text: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the skirts of the robe round about, between the pomegranates;

title: Exodus 39:26
text: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, upon the skirts of the robe round about, to minister in; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:27
text: And they made the coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,

title: Exodus 39:28
text: and the mitre of fine linen, and the goodly head-tires of fine linen, and the linen breeches of fine twined linen,

title: Exodus 39:29
text: and the girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:30
text: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like the engravings of a signet, HOLY TO JEHOVAH.

title: Exodus 39:31
text: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it upon the mitre above; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:32
text: Thus was finished all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting: and the children of Israel did according to all that Jehovah commanded Moses; so did they.

title: Exodus 39:33
text: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the Tent, and all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, it bars, and its pillars, and it sockets;

title: Exodus 39:34
text: and the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of sealskins, and the veil of the screen;

title: Exodus 39:35
text: the ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy-seat;

title: Exodus 39:36
text: the table, all the vessels thereof, and the showbread;

title: Exodus 39:37
text: the pure candlestick, the lamps thereof, even the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for the light;

title: Exodus 39:38
text: and the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the screen for the door of the Tent;

title: Exodus 39:39
text: the brazen altar, and its grating of brass, its staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base;

title: Exodus 39:40
text: the hangings of the court, its pillars, and its sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court, the cords thereof, and the pins thereof, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting;

title: Exodus 39:41
text: the finely wrought garments for ministering in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.

title: Exodus 39:42
text: According to all that Jehovah commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

title: Exodus 39:43
text: And Moses saw all the work, and, behold, they had done it; as Jehovah had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.

title: Exodus 40:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Exodus 40:2
text: On the first day of the first month shalt thou rear up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.

title: Exodus 40:3
text: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and thou shalt screen the ark with the veil.

title: Exodus 40:4
text: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.

title: Exodus 40:5
text: And thou shalt set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

title: Exodus 40:6
text: And thou shalt set the altar of burnt-offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.

title: Exodus 40:7
text: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of meeting and the altar, and shalt put water therein.

title: Exodus 40:8
text: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.

title: Exodus 40:9
text: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the furniture thereof: and it shall be holy.

title: Exodus 40:10
text: And thou shalt anoint the altar of burnt-offering, and all its vessels, and sanctify the altar: and the altar shall be most holy.

title: Exodus 40:11
text: And thou shalt anoint the laver and its base, and sanctify it.

title: Exodus 40:12
text: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tent of meeting, and shalt wash them with water.

title: Exodus 40:13
text: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments; and thou shalt anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.

title: Exodus 40:14
text: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them;

title: Exodus 40:15
text: and thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office: and their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.

title: Exodus 40:16
text: Thus did Moses: according to all that Jehovah commanded him, so did he.

title: Exodus 40:17
text: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.

title: Exodus 40:18
text: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up its pillars.

title: Exodus 40:19
text: And he spread the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:20
text: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy-seat above upon the ark:

title: Exodus 40:21
text: and he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the testimony; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:22
text: And he put the table in the tent of meeting, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the veil.

title: Exodus 40:23
text: And he set the bread in order upon it before Jehovah; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:24
text: And he put the candlestick in the tent of meeting, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

title: Exodus 40:25
text: And he lighted the lamps before Jehovah; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:26
text: And he put the golden altar in the tent of meeting before the veil:

title: Exodus 40:27
text: and he burnt thereon incense of sweet spices; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:28
text: And he put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

title: Exodus 40:29
text: And he set the altar of burnt-offering at the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered upon it the burnt-offering and the meal-offering; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:30
text: And he set the laver between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water therein, wherewith to wash.

title: Exodus 40:31
text: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat;

title: Exodus 40:32
text: when they went into the tent of meeting, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:33
text: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.

title: Exodus 40:34
text: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of Jehovah filled the tabernacle.

title: Exodus 40:35
text: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of meeting, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of Jehovah filled the tabernacle.

title: Exodus 40:36
text: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys:

title: Exodus 40:37
text: but if the cloud was not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.

title: Exodus 40:38
text: For the cloud of Jehovah was upon the tabernacle by day, and there was fire therein by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

title: Leviticus 1:1
text: And Jehovah called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tent of meeting, saying,

title: Leviticus 1:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man of you offereth an oblation unto Jehovah, ye shall offer your oblation of the cattle, [even] of the herd and of the flock.

title: Leviticus 1:3
text: If his oblation be a burnt-offering of the herd, he shall offer it a male without blemish: he shall offer it at the door of the tent of meeting, that he may be accepted before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 1:4
text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the burnt-offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

title: Leviticus 1:5
text: And he shall kill the bullock before Jehovah: and Aaron's sons, the priests, shall present the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is at the door of the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 1:6
text: And he shall flay the burnt-offering, and cut it into its pieces.

title: Leviticus 1:7
text: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay wood in order upon the fire;

title: Leviticus 1:8
text: and Aaron's sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:

title: Leviticus 1:9
text: but its inwards and its legs shall he wash with water. And the priest shall burn the whole on the altar, for a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 1:10
text: And if his oblation be of the flock, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt-offering; he shall offer it a male without blemish.

title: Leviticus 1:11
text: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before Jehovah: and Aaron's sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood upon the altar round about.

title: Leviticus 1:12
text: And he shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat; and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:

title: Leviticus 1:13
text: but the inwards and the legs shall he wash with water. And the priest shall offer the whole, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 1:14
text: And if his oblation to Jehovah be a burnt-offering of birds, then he shall offer his oblation of turtle-doves, or of young pigeons.

title: Leviticus 1:15
text: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be drained out on the side of the altar;

title: Leviticus 1:16
text: and he shall take away its crop with the filth thereof, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes:

title: Leviticus 1:17
text: and he shall rend it by the wings thereof, [but] shall not divide it asunder. And the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 2:1
text: And when any one offereth an oblation of a meal-offering unto Jehovah, his oblation shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:

title: Leviticus 2:2
text: and he shall bring it to Aaron's sons the priests; and he shall take thereout his handful of the fine flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof. And the priest shall burn [it as] the memorial thereof upon the altar, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah:

title: Leviticus 2:3
text: and that which is left of the meal-offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire.

title: Leviticus 2:4
text: And when thou offerest an oblation of a meal-offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

title: Leviticus 2:5
text: And if thy oblation be a meal-offering of the baking-pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.

title: Leviticus 2:6
text: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meal-offering.

title: Leviticus 2:7
text: And if thy oblation be a meal-offering of the frying-pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

title: Leviticus 2:8
text: And thou shalt bring the meal-offering that is made of these things unto Jehovah: and it shall be presented unto the priest, and he shall bring it unto the altar.

title: Leviticus 2:9
text: And the priest shall take up from the meal-offering the memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 2:10
text: And that which is left of the meal-offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire.

title: Leviticus 2:11
text: No meal-offering, which ye shall offer unto Jehovah, shall be made with leaven; for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 2:12
text: As an oblation of first-[ fruits] ye shall offer them unto Jehovah: but they shall not come up for a sweet savor on the altar.

title: Leviticus 2:13
text: And every oblation of thy meal-offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meal-offering: with all thine oblations thou shalt offer salt.

title: Leviticus 2:14
text: And if thou offer a meal-offering of first-fruits unto Jehovah, thou shalt offer for the meal-offering of thy first-fruits grain in the ear parched with fire, bruised grain of the fresh ear.

title: Leviticus 2:15
text: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meal-offering.

title: Leviticus 2:16
text: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the bruised grain thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 3:1
text: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace-offerings; if he offer of the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 3:2
text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his oblation, and kill it at the door of the tent of meeting: and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

title: Leviticus 3:3
text: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of peace-offerings an offering made by fire unto Jehovah; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

title: Leviticus 3:4
text: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the caul upon the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away.

title: Leviticus 3:5
text: And Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt-offering, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 3:6
text: And if his oblation for a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.

title: Leviticus 3:7
text: If he offer a lamb for his oblation, then shall he offer it before Jehovah;

title: Leviticus 3:8
text: and he shall lay his hand upon the head of his oblation, and kill it before the tent of meeting: and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.

title: Leviticus 3:9
text: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of peace-offerings an offering made by fire unto Jehovah; the fat thereof, the fat tail entire, he shall take away hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

title: Leviticus 3:10
text: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the loins, and the caul upon the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away.

title: Leviticus 3:11
text: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 3:12
text: And if his oblation be a goat, then he shall offer it before Jehovah:

title: Leviticus 3:13
text: and he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tent of meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.

title: Leviticus 3:14
text: And he shall offer thereof his oblation, [even] an offering made by fire unto Jehovah; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

title: Leviticus 3:15
text: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the loins, and the caul upon the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away.

title: Leviticus 3:16
text: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a sweet savor; all the fat is Jehovah's.

title: Leviticus 3:17
text: It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that ye shall eat neither fat nor blood.

title: Leviticus 4:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 4:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any one shall sin unwittingly, in any of the things which Jehovah hath commanded not to be done, and shall do any one of them:

title: Leviticus 4:3
text: if the anointed priest shall sin so as to bring guilt on the people, then let him offer for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto Jehovah for a sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 4:4
text: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tent of meeting before Jehovah; and he shall lay his hand upon the head of the bullock, and kill the bullock before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 4:5
text: And the anointed priest shall take of the blood of the bullock, and bring it to the tent of meeting:

title: Leviticus 4:6
text: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before Jehovah, before the veil of the sanctuary.

title: Leviticus 4:7
text: And the priest shall put of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before Jehovah, which is in the tent of meeting; and all the blood of the bullock shall he pour out at the base of the altar of burnt-offering, which is at the door of the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 4:8
text: And all the fat of the bullock of the sin-offering he shall take off from it; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

title: Leviticus 4:9
text: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the loins, and the caul upon the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away,

title: Leviticus 4:10
text: as it is taken off from the ox of the sacrifice of peace-offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of burnt-offering.

title: Leviticus 4:11
text: And the skin of the bullock, and all its flesh, with its head, and with its legs, and its inwards, and its dung,

title: Leviticus 4:12
text: even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall it be burnt.

title: Leviticus 4:13
text: And if the whole congregation of Israel err, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done any of the things which Jehovah hath commanded not to be done, and are guilty;

title: Leviticus 4:14
text: when the sin wherein they have sinned is known, then the assembly shall offer a young bullock for a sin-offering, and bring it before the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 4:15
text: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before Jehovah; and the bullock shall be killed before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 4:16
text: And the anointed priest shall bring of the blood of the bullock to the tent of meeting:

title: Leviticus 4:17
text: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before Jehovah, before the veil.

title: Leviticus 4:18
text: And he shall put of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before Jehovah, that is in the tent of meeting; and all the blood shall he pour out at the base of the altar of burnt-offering, which is at the door of the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 4:19
text: And all the fat thereof shall he take off from it, and burn it upon the altar.

title: Leviticus 4:20
text: Thus shall he do with the bullock; as he did with the bullock of the sin-offering, so shall he do with this; and the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.

title: Leviticus 4:21
text: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bullock: it is the sin-offering for the assembly.

title: Leviticus 4:22
text: When a ruler sinneth, and doeth unwittingly any one of all the things which Jehovah his God hath commanded not to be done, and is guilty;

title: Leviticus 4:23
text: if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, be made known to him, he shall bring for his oblation a goat, a male without blemish.

title: Leviticus 4:24
text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt-offering before Jehovah: it is a sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 4:25
text: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin-offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt-offering; and the blood thereof shall he pour out at the base of the altar of burnt-offering.

title: Leviticus 4:26
text: And all the fat thereof shall he burn upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace-offerings; and the priest shall make atonement for him as concerning his sin, and he shall be forgiven.

title: Leviticus 4:27
text: And if any one of the common people sin unwittingly, in doing any of the things which Jehovah hath commanded not to be done, and be guilty;

title: Leviticus 4:28
text: if his sin, which he hath sinned, be made known to him, then he shall bring for his oblation a goat, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.

title: Leviticus 4:29
text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin-offering, and kill the sin-offering in the place of burnt-offering.

title: Leviticus 4:30
text: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt-offering; and all the blood thereof shall he pour out at the base of the altar.

title: Leviticus 4:31
text: And all the fat thereof shall he take away, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace-offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savor unto Jehovah; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be forgiven.

title: Leviticus 4:32
text: And if he bring a lamb as his oblation for a sin-offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.

title: Leviticus 4:33
text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin-offering, and kill it for a sin-offering in the place where they kill the burnt-offering.

title: Leviticus 4:34
text: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin-offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt-offering; and all the blood thereof shall he pour out at the base of the altar.

title: Leviticus 4:35
text: And all the fat thereof shall he take away, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of peace-offerings; and the priest shall burn them on the altar, upon the offerings of Jehovah made by fire; and the priest shall make atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned, and he shall be forgiven.

title: Leviticus 5:1
text: And if any one sin, in that he heareth the voice of adjuration, he being a witness, whether he hath seen or known, if he do not utter [it], then he shall bear his iniquity.

title: Leviticus 5:2
text: Or if any one touch any unclean thing, whether it be the carcass of an unclean beast, or the carcass of unclean cattle, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and it be hidden from him, and he be unclean, then he shall be guilty.

title: Leviticus 5:3
text: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever his uncleanness be wherewith he is unclean, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty.

title: Leviticus 5:4
text: Or if any one swear rashly with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall utter rashly with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty in one of these [things] .

title: Leviticus 5:5
text: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these [things], that he shall confess that wherein he hath sinned:

title: Leviticus 5:6
text: and he shall bring his trespass-offering unto Jehovah for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him as concerning his sin.

title: Leviticus 5:7
text: And if his means suffice not for a lamb, then he shall bring his trespass-offering for that wherein he hath sinned, two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, unto Jehovah; one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering.

title: Leviticus 5:8
text: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin-offering first, and wring off its head from its neck, but shall not divide it asunder:

title: Leviticus 5:9
text: and he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin-offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar: it is a sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 5:10
text: And he shall offer the second for a burnt-offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him as concerning his sin which he hath sinned, and he shall be forgiven. [

title: Leviticus 5:11
text: But if his means suffice not for two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, then he shall bring his oblation for that wherein he hath sinned, the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin-offering: he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon; for it is a sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 5:12
text: And he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, upon the offerings of Jehovah made by fire: it is a sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 5:13
text: And the priest shall make atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in any of these things, and he shall be forgiven: and [the remnant] shall be the priest's, as the meal-offering.

title: Leviticus 5:14
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 5:15
text: If any one commit a trespass, and sin unwittingly, in the holy things of Jehovah; then he shall bring his trespass-offering unto Jehovah, a ram without blemish out of the flock, according to thy estimation in silver by shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass-offering:

title: Leviticus 5:16
text: and he shall make restitution for that which he hath done amiss in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass-offering, and he shall be forgiven.

title: Leviticus 5:17
text: And if any one sin, and do any of the things which Jehovah hath commanded not to be done; though he knew it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

title: Leviticus 5:18
text: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, according to thy estimation, for a trespass-offering, unto the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing wherein he erred unwittingly and knew it not, and he shall be forgiven.

title: Leviticus 5:19
text: It is a trespass-offering: he is certainly guilty before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 6:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 6:2
text: If any one sin, and commit a trespass against Jehovah, and deal falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit, or of bargain, or of robbery, or have oppressed his neighbor,

title: Leviticus 6:3
text: or have found that which was lost, and deal falsely therein, and swear to a lie; in any of all these things that a man doeth, sinning therein;

title: Leviticus 6:4
text: then it shall be, if he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he hath gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was committed to him, or the lost thing which he found,

title: Leviticus 6:5
text: or any thing about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in full, and shall add the fifth part more thereto: unto him to whom it appertaineth shall he give it, in the day of his being found guilty.

title: Leviticus 6:6
text: And he shall bring his trespass-offering unto Jehovah, a ram without blemish out of the flock, according to thy estimation, for a trespass-offering, unto the priest:

title: Leviticus 6:7
text: and the priest shall make atonement for him before Jehovah; and he shall be forgiven concerning whatsoever he doeth so as to be guilty thereby.

title: Leviticus 6:8
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 6:9
text: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt-offering: the burnt-offering shall be on the hearth upon the altar all night unto the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning thereon.

title: Leviticus 6:10
text: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh; and he shall take up the ashes whereto the fire hath consumed the burnt-offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

title: Leviticus 6:11
text: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.

title: Leviticus 6:12
text: And the fire upon the altar shall be kept burning thereon, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning: and he shall lay the burnt-offering in order upon it, and shall burn thereon the fat of the peace-offerings.

title: Leviticus 6:13
text: Fire shall be kept burning upon the altar continually; it shall not go out.

title: Leviticus 6:14
text: And this is the law of the meal-offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before Jehovah, before the altar.

title: Leviticus 6:15
text: And he shall take up therefrom his handful, of the fine flour of the meal-offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meal-offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savor, as the memorial thereof, unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 6:16
text: And that which is left thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: it shall be eaten without leaven in a holy place; in the court of the tent of meeting they shall eat it.

title: Leviticus 6:17
text: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as the sin-offering, and as the trespass-offering.

title: Leviticus 6:18
text: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as [his] portion for ever throughout your generations, from the offerings of Jehovah made by fire: whosoever toucheth them shall be holy.

title: Leviticus 6:19
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 6:20
text: This is the oblation of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto Jehovah in the day when he is anointed: the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meal-offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half thereof in the evening.

title: Leviticus 6:21
text: On a baking-pan it shall be made with oil; when it is soaked, thou shalt bring it in: in baken pieces shalt thou offer the meal-offering for a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 6:22
text: And the anointed priest that shall be in his stead from among his sons shall offer it: by a statute for ever it shall be wholly burnt unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 6:23
text: And every meal-offering of the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.

title: Leviticus 6:24
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 6:25
text: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin-offering: in the place where the burnt-offering is killed shall the sin-offering be killed before Jehovah: it is most holy.

title: Leviticus 6:26
text: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in a holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 6:27
text: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy; and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in a holy place.

title: Leviticus 6:28
text: But the earthen vessel wherein it is boiled shall be broken; and if it be boiled in a brazen vessel, it shall be scoured, and rinsed in water.

title: Leviticus 6:29
text: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.

title: Leviticus 6:30
text: And no sin-offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the holy place, shall be eaten: it shall be burnt with fire.

title: Leviticus 7:1
text: And this is the law of the trespass-offering: it is most holy.

title: Leviticus 7:2
text: In the place where they kill the burnt-offering shall they kill the trespass-offering; and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle upon the altar round about.

title: Leviticus 7:3
text: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof: the fat tail, and the fat that covereth the inwards,

title: Leviticus 7:4
text: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the caul upon the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away;

title: Leviticus 7:5
text: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto Jehovah: it is a trespass-offering.

title: Leviticus 7:6
text: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in a holy place: it is most holy.

title: Leviticus 7:7
text: As is the sin-offering, so is the trespass-offering; there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith, he shall have it.

title: Leviticus 7:8
text: And the priest that offereth any man's burnt-offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt-offering which he hath offered.

title: Leviticus 7:9
text: And every meal-offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the frying-pan, and on the baking-pan, shall be the priest's that offereth it.

title: Leviticus 7:10
text: And every meal-offering, mingled with oil, or dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as well as another.

title: Leviticus 7:11
text: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace-offerings, which one shall offer unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 7:12
text: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour soaked.

title: Leviticus 7:13
text: With cakes of leavened bread he shall offer his oblation with the sacrifice of his peace-offerings for thanksgiving.

title: Leviticus 7:14
text: And of it he shall offer one out of each oblation for a heave-offering unto Jehovah; it shall be the priest's that sprinkleth the blood of the peace-offerings.

title: Leviticus 7:15
text: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace-offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his oblation; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.

title: Leviticus 7:16
text: But if the sacrifice of his oblation be a vow, or a freewill-offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offereth his sacrifice; and on the morrow that which remaineth of it shall be eaten:

title: Leviticus 7:17
text: but that which remaineth of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.

title: Leviticus 7:18
text: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace-offerings be eaten on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.

title: Leviticus 7:19
text: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire. And as for the flesh, every one that is clean shall eat thereof:

title: Leviticus 7:20
text: but the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace-offerings, that pertain unto Jehovah, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.

title: Leviticus 7:21
text: And when any one shall touch any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean beast, or any unclean abomination, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace-offerings, which pertain unto Jehovah, that soul shall be cut off from his people.

title: Leviticus 7:22
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 7:23
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no fat, of ox, or sheep, or goat.

title: Leviticus 7:24
text: And the fat of that which dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of beasts, may be used for any other service; but ye shall in no wise eat of it.

title: Leviticus 7:25
text: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.

title: Leviticus 7:26
text: And ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of bird or of beast, in any of your dwellings.

title: Leviticus 7:27
text: Whosoever it be that eateth any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.

title: Leviticus 7:28
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 7:29
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace-offerings unto Jehovah shall bring his oblation unto Jehovah out of the sacrifice of his peace-offerings:

title: Leviticus 7:30
text: his own hands shall bring the offerings of Jehovah made by fire; the fat with the breast shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave-offering before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 7:31
text: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar; but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.

title: Leviticus 7:32
text: And the right thigh shall ye give unto the priest for a heave-offering out of the sacrifices of your peace-offerings.

title: Leviticus 7:33
text: He among the sons of Aaron that offereth the blood of the peace-offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.

title: Leviticus 7:34
text: For the wave-breast and the heave - thigh have I taken of the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace-offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons as [their] portion for ever from the children of Israel.

title: Leviticus 7:35
text: This is the anointing-portion of Aaron, and the anointing-portion of his sons, out of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto Jehovah in the priest's office;

title: Leviticus 7:36
text: which Jehovah commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is [their] portion for ever throughout their generations.

title: Leviticus 7:37
text: This is the law of the burnt-offering, of the meal-offering, and of the sin-offering, and of the trespass-offering, and of the consecration, and of the sacrifice of peace-offerings;

title: Leviticus 7:38
text: which Jehovah commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto Jehovah, in the wilderness of Sinai.

title: Leviticus 8:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 8:2
text: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bullock of the sin-offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;

title: Leviticus 8:3
text: and assemble thou all the congregation at the door of the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 8:4
text: And Moses did as Jehovah commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 8:5
text: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded to be done.

title: Leviticus 8:6
text: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

title: Leviticus 8:7
text: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the skilfully woven band of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.

title: Leviticus 8:8
text: And he placed the breastplate upon him: and in the breastplate he put the Urim and the Thummim.

title: Leviticus 8:9
text: And he set the mitre upon his head; and upon the mitre, in front, did he set the golden plate, the holy crown; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:10
text: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.

title: Leviticus 8:11
text: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the laver and its base, to sanctify them.

title: Leviticus 8:12
text: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron's head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

title: Leviticus 8:13
text: And Moses brought Aaron's sons, and clothed them with coats, and girded them with girdles, and bound head-tires upon them; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:14
text: And he brought the bullock of the sin-offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock of the sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 8:15
text: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.

title: Leviticus 8:16
text: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it upon the altar.

title: Leviticus 8:17
text: But the bullock, and its skin, and its flesh, and its dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:18
text: And he presented the ram of the burnt-offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

title: Leviticus 8:19
text: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

title: Leviticus 8:20
text: And he cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

title: Leviticus 8:21
text: And he washed the inwards and the legs with water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt-offering for a sweet savor: it was an offering made by fire unto Jehovah; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:22
text: And he presented the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

title: Leviticus 8:23
text: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood thereof, and put it upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.

title: Leviticus 8:24
text: And he brought Aaron's sons; and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

title: Leviticus 8:25
text: And he took the fat, and the fat tail, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right thigh:

title: Leviticus 8:26
text: and out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before Jehovah, he took one unleavened cake, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat, and upon the right thigh:

title: Leviticus 8:27
text: and he put the whole upon the hands of Aaron, and upon the hands of his sons, and waved them for a wave-offering before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 8:28
text: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt-offering: they were a consecration for a sweet savor: it was an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 8:29
text: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave-offering before Jehovah: it was Moses' portion of the ram of consecration; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:30
text: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons' garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.

title: Leviticus 8:31
text: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tent of meeting: and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.

title: Leviticus 8:32
text: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.

title: Leviticus 8:33
text: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tent of meeting seven days, until the days of your consecration be fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.

title: Leviticus 8:34
text: As hath been done this day, so Jehovah hath commanded to do, to make atonement for you.

title: Leviticus 8:35
text: And at the door of the tent of meeting shall ye abide day and night seven days, and keep the charge of Jehovah, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.

title: Leviticus 8:36
text: And Aaron and his sons did all the things which Jehovah commanded by Moses.

title: Leviticus 9:1
text: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

title: Leviticus 9:2
text: and he said unto Aaron, Take thee a calf of the herd for a sin-offering, and a ram for a burnt-offering, without blemish, and offer them before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 9:3
text: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a he-goat for a sin-offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without blemish, for a burnt-offering;

title: Leviticus 9:4
text: and an ox and a ram for peace-offerings, to sacrifice before Jehovah; and a meal-offering mingled with oil: for to-day Jehovah appeareth unto you.

title: Leviticus 9:5
text: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tent of meeting: and all the congregation drew near and stood before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 9:6
