text: And Moses said, This is the thing which Jehovah commanded that ye should do: and the glory of Jehovah shall appear unto you.

title: Leviticus 9:7
text: And Moses said unto Aaron, Draw near unto the altar, and offer thy sin-offering, and thy burnt-offering, and make atonement for thyself, and for the people; and offer the oblation of the people, and make atonement for them; as Jehovah commanded.

title: Leviticus 9:8
text: So Aaron drew near unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin-offering, which was for himself.

title: Leviticus 9:9
text: And the sons of Aaron presented the blood unto him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar:

title: Leviticus 9:10
text: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul from the liver of the sin-offering, he burnt upon the altar; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 9:11
text: And the flesh and the skin he burnt with fire without the camp.

title: Leviticus 9:12
text: And he slew the burnt-offering; and Aaron's sons delivered unto him the blood, and he sprinkled it upon the altar round about.

title: Leviticus 9:13
text: And they delivered the burnt-offering unto him, piece by piece, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.

title: Leviticus 9:14
text: And he washed the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt-offering on the altar.

title: Leviticus 9:15
text: And he presented the people's oblation, and took the goat of the sin-offering which was for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.

title: Leviticus 9:16
text: And he presented the burnt-offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.

title: Leviticus 9:17
text: And he presented the meal-offering, and filled his hand therefrom, and burnt it upon the altar, besides the burnt-offering of the morning.

title: Leviticus 9:18
text: He slew also the ox and the ram, the sacrifice of peace-offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron's sons delivered unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,

title: Leviticus 9:19
text: and the fat of the ox and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covereth [the inwards], and the kidneys, and the caul of the liver:

title: Leviticus 9:20
text: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:

title: Leviticus 9:21
text: and the breasts and the right thigh Aaron waved for a wave-offering before Jehovah; as Moses commanded.

title: Leviticus 9:22
text: And Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin-offering, and the burnt-offering, and the peace-offerings.

title: Leviticus 9:23
text: And Moses and Aaron went into the tent of meeting, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of Jehovah appeared unto all the people.

title: Leviticus 9:24
text: And there came forth fire from before Jehovah, and consumed upon the altar the burnt-offering and the fat: and when all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

title: Leviticus 10:1
text: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took each of them his censer, and put fire therein, and laid incense thereon, and offered strange fire before Jehovah, which he had not commanded them.

title: Leviticus 10:2
text: And there came forth fire from before Jehovah, and devoured them, and they died before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 10:3
text: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that Jehovah spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.

title: Leviticus 10:4
text: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Draw near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.

title: Leviticus 10:5
text: So they drew near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp, as Moses had said.

title: Leviticus 10:6
text: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Let not the hair of your heads go loose, neither rend your clothes; that ye die not, and that he be not wroth with all the congregation: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which Jehovah hath kindled.

title: Leviticus 10:7
text: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tent of meeting, lest ye die; for the anointing oil of Jehovah is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.

title: Leviticus 10:8
text: And Jehovah spake unto Aaron, saying,

title: Leviticus 10:9
text: Drink no wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tent of meeting, that ye die not: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:

title: Leviticus 10:10
text: and that ye may make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean;

title: Leviticus 10:11
text: and that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which Jehovah hath spoken unto them by Moses.

title: Leviticus 10:12
text: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meal-offering that remaineth of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar; for it is most holy;

title: Leviticus 10:13
text: and ye shall eat it in a holy place, because it is thy portion, and thy sons' portion, of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire: for so I am commanded.

title: Leviticus 10:14
text: And the wave-breast and the heave-thigh shall ye eat in a clean place, thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they are given as thy portion, and thy sons' portion, out of the sacrifices of the peace-offerings of the children of Israel.

title: Leviticus 10:15
text: The heave-thigh and the wave-breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave-offering before Jehovah: and it shall be thine, and thy sons' with thee, as a portion for ever; as Jehovah hath commanded.

title: Leviticus 10:16
text: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin-offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and with Ithamar, the sons of Aaron that were left, saying,

title: Leviticus 10:17
text: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin-offering in the place of the sanctuary, seeing it is most holy, and he hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before Jehovah?

title: Leviticus 10:18
text: Behold, the blood of it was not brought into the sanctuary within: ye should certainly have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.

title: Leviticus 10:19
text: And Aaron spake unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin-offering and their burnt-offering before Jehovah; and there have befallen me such things as these: and if I had eaten the sin-offering to-day, would it have been well-pleasing in the sight of Jehovah?

title: Leviticus 10:20
text: And when Moses heard [that], it was well-pleasing in his sight.

title: Leviticus 11:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,

title: Leviticus 11:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the living things which ye may eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.

title: Leviticus 11:3
text: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, [and] cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that may ye eat.

title: Leviticus 11:4
text: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that part the hoof: the camel, because he cheweth the cud but parteth not the hoof, he is unclean unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:5
text: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud but parteth not the hoof, he is unclean unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:6
text: And the hare, because she cheweth the cud but parteth not the hoof, she is unclean unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:7
text: And the swine, because he parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, but cheweth not the cud, he is unclean unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:8
text: Of their flesh ye shall not eat, and their carcasses ye shall not touch; they are unclean unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:9
text: These may ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that may ye eat.

title: Leviticus 11:10
text: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination unto you,

title: Leviticus 11:11
text: and they shall be an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, and their carcasses ye shall have in abomination.

title: Leviticus 11:12
text: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that is an abomination unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:13
text: And these ye shall have in abomination among the birds; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the gier-eagle, and the ospray,

title: Leviticus 11:14
text: and the kite, and the falcon after its kind,

title: Leviticus 11:15
text: every raven after its kind,

title: Leviticus 11:16
text: and the ostrich, and the night-hawk, and the sea-mew, and the hawk after its kind,

title: Leviticus 11:17
text: and the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,

title: Leviticus 11:18
text: and the horned owl, and the pelican, and the vulture,

title: Leviticus 11:19
text: and the stork, the heron after its kind, and the hoopoe, and the bat.

title: Leviticus 11:20
text: All winged creeping things that go upon all fours are an abomination unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:21
text: Yet these may ye eat of all winged creeping things that go upon all fours, which have legs above their feet, wherewith to leap upon the earth.

title: Leviticus 11:22
text: Even these of them ye may eat: the locust after its kind, and the bald locust after its kind, and the cricket after its kind, and the grasshopper after its kind.

title: Leviticus 11:23
text: But all winged creeping things, which have four feet, are an abomination unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:24
text: And by these ye shall become unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcass of them shall be unclean until the even;

title: Leviticus 11:25
text: And whosoever beareth [aught] of the carcass of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 11:26
text: Every beast which parteth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, is unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.

title: Leviticus 11:27
text: And whatsoever goeth upon its paws, among all beasts that go on all fours, they are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcass shall be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 11:28
text: And he that beareth the carcass of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:29
text: And these are they which are unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth: the weasel, and the mouse, and the great lizard after its kind,

title: Leviticus 11:30
text: and the gecko, and the land-crocodile, and the lizard, and the sand-lizard, and the chameleon.

title: Leviticus 11:31
text: These are they which are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they are dead, shall be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 11:32
text: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherewith any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; then shall it be clean.

title: Leviticus 11:33
text: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean, and it ye shall break.

title: Leviticus 11:34
text: All food [therein] which may be eaten, that on which water cometh, shall be unclean; and all drink that may be drunk in every [such] vessel shall be unclean.

title: Leviticus 11:35
text: And every thing whereupon [any part] of their carcass falleth shall be unclean; whether oven, or range for pots, it shall be broken in pieces: they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:36
text: Nevertheless a fountain or a pit wherein is a gathering of water shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcass shall be unclean.

title: Leviticus 11:37
text: And if [aught] of their carcass fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it is clean.

title: Leviticus 11:38
text: But if water be put upon the seed, and [aught] of their carcass fall thereon, it is unclean unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:39
text: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcass thereof shall be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 11:40
text: And he that eateth of the carcass of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcass of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 11:41
text: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth is an abomination; it shall not be eaten.

title: Leviticus 11:42
text: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all fours, or whatsoever hath many feet, even all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

title: Leviticus 11:43
text: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.

title: Leviticus 11:44
text: For I am Jehovah your God: sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that moveth upon the earth.

title: Leviticus 11:45
text: For I am Jehovah that brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

title: Leviticus 11:46
text: This is the law of the beast, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth;

title: Leviticus 11:47
text: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living thing that may not be eaten.

title: Leviticus 12:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 12:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman conceive seed, and bear a man-child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of the impurity of her sickness shall she be unclean.

title: Leviticus 12:3
text: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

title: Leviticus 12:4
text: And she shall continue in the blood of [her] purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.

title: Leviticus 12:5
text: But if she bear a maid-child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her impurity; and she shall continue in the blood of [her] purifying threescore and six days.

title: Leviticus 12:6
text: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb a year old for a burnt-offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtle-dove, for a sin-offering, unto the door of the tent of meeting, unto the priest:

title: Leviticus 12:7
text: and he shall offer it before Jehovah, and make atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the fountain of her blood. This is the law for her that beareth, whether a male or a female.

title: Leviticus 12:8
text: And if her means suffice not for a lamb, then she shall take two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons; the one for a burnt-offering, and the other for a sin-offering: and the priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.

title: Leviticus 13:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

title: Leviticus 13:2
text: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it become in the skin of his flesh the plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:

title: Leviticus 13:3
text: and the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and if the hair in the plague be turned white, and the appearance of the plague be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is the plague of leprosy; and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.

title: Leviticus 13:4
text: And if the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and the appearance thereof be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white, then the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the plague seven days:

title: Leviticus 13:5
text: and the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if in his eyes the plague be at a stay, and the plague be not spread in the skin, then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:

title: Leviticus 13:6
text: and the priest shall look on him again the seventh day; and, behold, if the plague be dim, and the plague be not spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

title: Leviticus 13:7
text: But if the scab spread abroad in the skin, after that he hath showed himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again:

title: Leviticus 13:8
text: and the priest shall look; and, behold, if the scab be spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is leprosy.

title: Leviticus 13:9
text: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;

title: Leviticus 13:10
text: and the priest shall look; and, behold, if there be a white rising in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising,

title: Leviticus 13:11
text: it is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean: he shall not shut him up, for he is unclean.

title: Leviticus 13:12
text: And if the leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of [him that hath] the plague from his head even to his feet, as far as appeareth to the priest;

title: Leviticus 13:13
text: then the priest shall look; and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce [him] clean [that hath] the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.

title: Leviticus 13:14
text: But whensoever raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.

title: Leviticus 13:15
text: And the priest shall look on the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean: it is leprosy.

title: Leviticus 13:16
text: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, then he shall come unto the priest;

title: Leviticus 13:17
text: and the priest shall look on him; and, behold, if the plague be turned into white, then the priest shall pronounce [him] clean [that hath] the plague: he is clean.

title: Leviticus 13:18
text: And when the flesh hath in the skin thereof a boil, and it is healed,

title: Leviticus 13:19
text: and in the place of the boil there is a white rising, or a bright spot, reddish-white, then is shall be showed to the priest;

title: Leviticus 13:20
text: and the priest shall look; and, behold, if the appearance thereof be lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy, it hath broken out in the boil.

title: Leviticus 13:21
text: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and it be not lower than the skin, but be dim; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:

title: Leviticus 13:22
text: And if it spread abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.

title: Leviticus 13:23
text: But if the bright spot stay in its place, and be not spread, it is the scar of the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

title: Leviticus 13:24
text: Or when the flesh hath in the skin thereof a burning by fire, and the quick [flesh] of the burning become a bright spot, reddish-white, or white;

title: Leviticus 13:25
text: then the priest shall look upon it; and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and the appearance thereof be deeper than the skin; it is leprosy, it hath broken out in the burning: and the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.

title: Leviticus 13:26
text: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the skin, but be dim; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:

title: Leviticus 13:27
text: and the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: if it spread abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.

title: Leviticus 13:28
text: And if the bright spot stay in its place, and be not spread in the skin, but be dim; it is the rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is the scar of the burning.

title: Leviticus 13:29
text: And when a man or woman hath a plague upon the head or upon the beard,

title: Leviticus 13:30
text: then the priest shall look on the plague; and, behold, if the appearance thereof be deeper than the skin, and there be in it yellow thin hair, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a scall, it is leprosy of the head or of the beard.

title: Leviticus 13:31
text: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, the appearance thereof be not deeper than the skin, and there be no black hair in it, then the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the plague of the scall seven days:

title: Leviticus 13:32
text: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague; and, behold, if the scall be not spread, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the appearance of the scall be not deeper than the skin,

title: Leviticus 13:33
text: then he shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the scall seven days more:

title: Leviticus 13:34
text: and in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall; and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, and the appearance thereof be not deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

title: Leviticus 13:35
text: But if the scall spread abroad in the skin after his cleansing,

title: Leviticus 13:36
text: then the priest shall look on him; and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for the yellow hair; he is unclean.

title: Leviticus 13:37
text: But if in his eyes the scall be at a stay, and black hair be grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

title: Leviticus 13:38
text: And when a man or a woman hath in the skin of the flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;

title: Leviticus 13:39
text: then the priest shall look; and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be of a dull white, it is a tetter, it hath broken out in the skin; he is clean.

title: Leviticus 13:40
text: And if a man's hair be fallen off his head, he is bald; [yet] is he clean.

title: Leviticus 13:41
text: And if his hair be fallen off from the front part of his head, he is forehead bald; [yet] is he clean.

title: Leviticus 13:42
text: But if there be in the bald head, or the bald forehead, a reddish-white plague; it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head, or his bald forehead.

title: Leviticus 13:43
text: Then the priest shall look upon him; and, behold, if the rising of the plague be reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the flesh;

title: Leviticus 13:44
text: he is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall surely pronounce him unclean; his plague is in his head.

title: Leviticus 13:45
text: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and the hair of his head shall go loose, and he shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.

title: Leviticus 13:46
text: All the days wherein the plague is in him he shall be unclean; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his dwelling be.

title: Leviticus 13:47
text: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;

title: Leviticus 13:48
text: whether it be in warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in anything made of skin;

title: Leviticus 13:49
text: if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin; it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be showed unto the priest.

title: Leviticus 13:50
text: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up [that which hath] the plague seven days:

title: Leviticus 13:51
text: and he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever service skin is used for; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.

title: Leviticus 13:52
text: And he shall burn the garment, whether the warp or the woof, in woollen or in linen, or anything of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.

title: Leviticus 13:53
text: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin;

title: Leviticus 13:54
text: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more:

title: Leviticus 13:55
text: and the priest shall look, after that the plague is washed; and, behold, if the plague have not changed its color, and the plague be not spread, it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire: it is a fret, whether the bareness be within or without.

title: Leviticus 13:56
text: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be dim after the washing thereof, then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:

title: Leviticus 13:57
text: and if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is breaking out: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.

title: Leviticus 13:58
text: And the garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.

title: Leviticus 13:59
text: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or anything of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.

title: Leviticus 14:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 14:2
text: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: he shall be brought unto the priest:

title: Leviticus 14:3
text: and the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look; and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper,

title: Leviticus 14:4
text: then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two living clean birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

title: Leviticus 14:5
text: And the priest shall command to kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

title: Leviticus 14:6
text: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:

title: Leviticus 14:7
text: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let go the living bird into the open field.

title: Leviticus 14:8
text: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water; and he shall be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, but shall dwell outside his tent seven days.

title: Leviticus 14:9
text: And it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.

title: Leviticus 14:10
text: And on the eighth day he shall take two he-lambs without blemish, and one ewe-lamb a year old without blemish, and three tenth parts [of an ephah] of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.

title: Leviticus 14:11
text: And the priest that cleanseth him shall set the man that is to be cleansed, and those things, before Jehovah, at the door of the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 14:12
text: And the priest shall take one of the he-lambs, and offer him for a trespass-offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave-offering before Jehovah:

title: Leviticus 14:13
text: and he shall kill the he-lamb in the place where they kill the sin-offering and the burnt-offering, in the place of the sanctuary: for as the sin-offering is the priest's, so is the trespass-offering: it is most holy:

title: Leviticus 14:14
text: and the priest shall take of the blood of the trespass-offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.

title: Leviticus 14:15
text: And the priest shall take of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand;

title: Leviticus 14:16
text: and the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before Jehovah:

title: Leviticus 14:17
text: and of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass-offering:

title: Leviticus 14:18
text: and the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make atonement for him before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 14:19
text: And the priest shall offer the sin-offering, and make atonement for him that is to be cleansed because of his uncleanness: and afterward he shall kill the burnt-offering;

title: Leviticus 14:20
text: and the priest shall offer the burnt-offering and the meal-offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

title: Leviticus 14:21
text: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much, then he shall take one he-lamb for a trespass-offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and one tenth part [of an ephah] of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal-offering, and a log of oil;

title: Leviticus 14:22
text: and two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin-offering, and the other a burnt-offering.

title: Leviticus 14:23
text: And on the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tent of meeting, before Jehovah:

title: Leviticus 14:24
text: and the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass-offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave-offering before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 14:25
text: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass-offering; and the priest shall take of the blood of the trespass-offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.

title: Leviticus 14:26
text: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand;

title: Leviticus 14:27
text: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before Jehovah:

title: Leviticus 14:28
text: and the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass-offering:

title: Leviticus 14:29
text: and the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 14:30
text: And he shall offer one of the turtle-doves, or of the young pigeons, such as he is able to get,

title: Leviticus 14:31
text: even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering, with the meal-offering: and the priest shall make atonement for him that is to be cleansed before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 14:32
text: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to get [that which pertaineth] to his cleansing.

title: Leviticus 14:33
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

title: Leviticus 14:34
text: When ye are come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;

title: Leviticus 14:35
text: then he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, There seemeth to me to be as it were a plague in the house.

title: Leviticus 14:36
text: And the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goeth in to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:

title: Leviticus 14:37
text: and he shall look on the plague; and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and the appearance thereof be lower than the wall;

title: Leviticus 14:38
text: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days.

title: Leviticus 14:39
text: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look; and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;

title: Leviticus 14:40
text: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which the plague is, and cast them into an unclean place without the city:

title: Leviticus 14:41
text: and he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the mortar, that they scrape off, without the city into an unclean place:

title: Leviticus 14:42
text: and they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.

title: Leviticus 14:43
text: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken out the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plastered;

title: Leviticus 14:44
text: then the priest shall come in and look; and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house: it is unclean.

title: Leviticus 14:45
text: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the mortar of the house; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place.

title: Leviticus 14:46
text: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 14:47
text: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.

title: Leviticus 14:48
text: And if the priest shall come in, and look, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plastered; then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

title: Leviticus 14:49
text: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

title: Leviticus 14:50
text: and he shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:

title: Leviticus 14:51
text: and he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:

title: Leviticus 14:52
text: and he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:

title: Leviticus 14:53
text: but he shall let got the living bird out of the city into the open field: so shall he make atonement for the house; and it shall be clean.

title: Leviticus 14:54
text: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and for a scall,

title: Leviticus 14:55
text: and for the leprosy of a garment, and for a house,

title: Leviticus 14:56
text: and for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot;

title: Leviticus 14:57
text: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean: this is the law of leprosy.

title: Leviticus 15:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,

title: Leviticus 15:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath an issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.

title: Leviticus 15:3
text: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.

title: Leviticus 15:4
text: Every bed whereon he that hath the issue lieth shall be unclean; and everything whereon he sitteth shall be unclean.

title: Leviticus 15:5
text: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:6
text: And he that sitteth on anything whereon he that hath the issue sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:7
text: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:8
text: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:9
text: And what saddle soever he that hath the issue rideth upon shall be unclean.

title: Leviticus 15:10
text: And whosoever toucheth anything that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:11
text: And whomsoever he that hath the issue toucheth, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:12
text: And the earthen vessel, which he that hath the issue toucheth, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

title: Leviticus 15:13
text: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue, then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

title: Leviticus 15:14
text: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and come before Jehovah unto the door of the tent of meeting, and give them unto the priest:

title: Leviticus 15:15
text: and the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him before Jehovah for his issue.

title: Leviticus 15:16
text: And if any man's seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:17
text: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:18
text: The woman also with whom a man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:19
text: And if a woman have an issue, [and] her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:20
text: And everything that she lieth upon in her impurity shall be unclean: everything also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.

title: Leviticus 15:21
text: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:22
text: And whosoever toucheth anything that she sitteth upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:23
text: And if it be on the bed, or on anything whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:24
text: And if any man lie with her, and her impurity be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.

title: Leviticus 15:25
text: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days not in the time of her impurity, or if she have an issue beyond the time of her impurity; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness she shall be as in the days of her impurity: she is unclean.

title: Leviticus 15:26
text: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her impurity: and everything whereon she sitteth shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her impurity.

title: Leviticus 15:27
text: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:28
text: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

title: Leviticus 15:29
text: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 15:30
text: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before Jehovah for the issue of her uncleanness.

title: Leviticus 15:31
text: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is in the midst of them.

title: Leviticus 15:32
text: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed of copulation goeth from him, so that he is unclean thereby;

title: Leviticus 15:33
text: and of her that is sick with her impurity, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.

title: Leviticus 16:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they drew near before Jehovah, and died;

title: Leviticus 16:2
text: and Jehovah said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the veil, before the mercy-seat which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy-seat.

title: Leviticus 16:3
text: Herewith shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin-offering, and a ram for a burnt-offering.

title: Leviticus 16:4
text: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with the linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: they are the holy garments; and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and put them on.

title: Leviticus 16:5
text: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two he-goats for a sin-offering, and one ram for a burnt-offering.

title: Leviticus 16:6
text: And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself, and for his house.

title: Leviticus 16:7
text: And he shall take the two goats, and set them before Jehovah at the door of the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 16:8
text: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for Jehovah, and the other lot for Azazel.

title: Leviticus 16:9
text: And Aaron shall present the goat upon which the lot fell for Jehovah, and offer him for a sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 16:10
text: But the goat, on which the lot fell for Azazel, shall be set alive before Jehovah, to make atonement for him, to send him away for Azazel into the wilderness.

title: Leviticus 16:11
text: And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin-offering which is for himself:

title: Leviticus 16:12
text: and he shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before Jehovah, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil:

title: Leviticus 16:13
text: and he shall put the incense upon the fire before Jehovah, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy-seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:

title: Leviticus 16:14
text: and he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy-seat on the east; and before the mercy-seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.

title: Leviticus 16:15
text: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin-offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy-seat, and before the mercy-seat:

title: Leviticus 16:16
text: and he shall make atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleannesses of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins: and so shall he do for the tent of meeting, that dwelleth with them in the midst of their uncleannesses.

title: Leviticus 16:17
text: And there shall be no man in the tent of meeting when he goeth in to make atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.

title: Leviticus 16:18
text: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before Jehovah, and make atonement for it, and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.

title: Leviticus 16:19
text: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleannesses of the children of Israel.

title: Leviticus 16:20
text: And when he hath made an end of atoning for the holy place, and the tent of meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat:

title: Leviticus 16:21
text: and Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a man that is in readiness into the wilderness:

title: Leviticus 16:22
text: and the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a solitary land: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.

title: Leviticus 16:23
text: And Aaron shall come into the tent of meeting, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:

title: Leviticus 16:24
text: and he shall bathe his flesh in water in a holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt-offering and the burnt-offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.

title: Leviticus 16:25
text: And the fat of the sin-offering shall he burn upon the altar.

title: Leviticus 16:26
text: And he that letteth go the goat for Azazel shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

title: Leviticus 16:27
text: And the bullock of the sin-offering, and the goat of the sin-offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall be carried forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.

title: Leviticus 16:28
text: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

title: Leviticus 16:29
text: And it shall be a statute for ever unto you: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and shall do no manner of work, the home-born, or the stranger that sojourneth among you:

title: Leviticus 16:30
text: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you; from all your sins shall ye be clean before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 16:31
text: It is a sabbath of solemn rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls; it is a statute for ever.

title: Leviticus 16:32
text: And the priest, who shall be anointed and who shall be consecrated to be priest in his father's stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments:

title: Leviticus 16:33
text: and he shall make atonement for the holy sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the tent of meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.

title: Leviticus 16:34
text: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make atonement for the children of Israel because of all their sins once in the year. And he did as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 17:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 17:2
text: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them: This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded, saying,

title: Leviticus 17:3
text: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it without the camp,

title: Leviticus 17:4
text: and hath not brought it unto the door of the tent of meeting, to offer it as an oblation unto Jehovah before the tabernacle of Jehovah: blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:

title: Leviticus 17:5
text: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, even that they may bring them unto Jehovah, unto the door of the tent of meeting, unto the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace-offerings unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 17:6
text: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of Jehovah at the door of the tent of meeting, and burn the fat for a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 17:7
text: And they shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices unto the he-goats, after which they play the harlot. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.

title: Leviticus 17:8
text: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, that offereth a burnt-offering or sacrifice,

title: Leviticus 17:9
text: and bringeth it not unto the door of the tent of meeting, to sacrifice it unto Jehovah; that man shall be cut off from his people.

title: Leviticus 17:10
text: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, that eateth any manner of blood, I will set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

title: Leviticus 17:11
text: For the life of the flesh is in the blood; and I have given it to you upon the altar to make atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh atonement by reason of the life.

title: Leviticus 17:12
text: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.

title: Leviticus 17:13
text: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, who taketh in hunting any beast or bird that may be eaten; he shall pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.

title: Leviticus 17:14
text: For as to the life of all flesh, the blood thereof is [all one] with the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh; for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.

title: Leviticus 17:15
text: And every soul that eateth that which dieth of itself, or that which is torn of beasts, whether he be home-born or a sojourner, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.

title: Leviticus 17:16
text: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.

title: Leviticus 18:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 18:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 18:3
text: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do; neither shall ye walk in their statutes.

title: Leviticus 18:4
text: Mine ordinances shall ye do, and my statutes shall ye keep, to walk therein: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 18:5
text: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and mine ordinances; which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 18:6
text: None of you shall approach to any that are near of kin to him, to uncover [their] nakedness: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 18:7
text: The nakedness of thy father, even the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

title: Leviticus 18:8
text: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.

title: Leviticus 18:9
text: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or the daughter of thy mother, whether born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.

title: Leviticus 18:10
text: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.

title: Leviticus 18:11
text: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

title: Leviticus 18:12
text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.

title: Leviticus 18:13
text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.

title: Leviticus 18:14
text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.

title: Leviticus 18:15
text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter-in-law: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

title: Leviticus 18:16
text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it is thy brother's nakedness.

title: Leviticus 18:17
text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter; thou shalt not take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; they are near kinswomen: it is wickedness.

title: Leviticus 18:18
text: And thou shalt not take a wife to her sister, to be a rival [to her], to uncover her nakedness, besides the other in her life-time.

title: Leviticus 18:19
text: And thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.

title: Leviticus 18:20
text: And thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbor's wife, to defile thyself with her.

title: Leviticus 18:21
text: And thou shalt not give any of thy seed to make them pass through [the fire] to Molech; neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 18:22
text: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.

title: Leviticus 18:23
text: And thou shalt not lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith; neither shall any woman stand before a beast, to lie down thereto: it is confusion.

title: Leviticus 18:24
text: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out from before you;

title: Leviticus 18:25
text: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land vomiteth out her inhabitants.

title: Leviticus 18:26
text: Ye therefore shall keep my statutes and mine ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the home-born, nor the stranger that sojourneth among you;

title: Leviticus 18:27
text: (for all these abominations have the men of the land done, that were before you, and the land is defiled);

title: Leviticus 18:28
text: that the land vomit not you out also, when ye defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

title: Leviticus 18:29
text: For whosoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.

title: Leviticus 18:30
text: Therefore shall ye keep my charge, that ye practise not any of these abominable customs, which were practised before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 19:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 19:2
text: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy; for I Jehovah your God am holy.

title: Leviticus 19:3
text: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father; and ye shall keep my sabbaths: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 19:4
text: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 19:5
text: And when ye offer a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah, ye shall offer it that ye may be accepted.

title: Leviticus 19:6
text: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if aught remain until the third day, it shall be burnt with fire.

title: Leviticus 19:7
text: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination; it shall not be accepted:

title: Leviticus 19:8
text: but every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the holy thing of Jehovah: and that soul shall be cut off from his people.

title: Leviticus 19:9
text: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleaning of thy harvest.

title: Leviticus 19:10
text: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather the fallen fruit of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and for the sojourner: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 19:11
text: Ye shall not steal; neither shall ye deal falsely, nor lie one to another.

title: Leviticus 19:12
text: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of thy God: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 19:13
text: Thou shalt not oppress thy neighbor, nor rob him: the wages of a hired servant shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.

title: Leviticus 19:14
text: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind; but thou shalt fear thy God: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 19:15
text: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty; but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbor.

title: Leviticus 19:16
text: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbor: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 19:17
text: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thy heart: thou shalt surely rebuke thy neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.

title: Leviticus 19:18
text: Thou shalt not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people; but thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 19:19
text: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with two kinds of seed: neither shall there come upon thee a garment of two kinds of stuff mingled together.

title: Leviticus 19:20
text: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to a husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; they shall be punished; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

title: Leviticus 19:21
text: And he shall bring his trespass-offering unto Jehovah, unto the door of the tent of meeting, even a ram for a trespass-offering.

title: Leviticus 19:22
text: And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass-offering before Jehovah for his sin which he hath sinned: and the sin which he hath sinned shall be forgiven him.

title: Leviticus 19:23
text: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as their uncircumcision: three years shall they be as uncircumcised unto you; it shall not be eaten.

title: Leviticus 19:24
text: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy, for giving praise unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 19:25
text: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 19:26
text: Ye shall not eat anything with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantments, nor practise augury.

title: Leviticus 19:27
text: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.

title: Leviticus 19:28
text: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 19:29
text: Profane not thy daughter, to make her a harlot; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.

title: Leviticus 19:30
text: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 19:31
text: Turn ye not unto them that have familiar spirits, nor unto the wizards; seek them not out, to be defiled by them: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 19:32
text: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honor the face of the old man, and thou shalt fear thy God: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 19:33
text: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not do him wrong.

title: Leviticus 19:34
text: The stranger that sojourneth with you shall be unto you as the home-born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were sojourners in the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 19:35
text: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.

title: Leviticus 19:36
text: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

title: Leviticus 19:37
text: And ye shall observe all my statutes, and all mine ordinances, and do them: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 20:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 20:2
text: Moreover, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.

title: Leviticus 20:3
text: I also will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

title: Leviticus 20:4
text: And if the people at the land do at all hide their eyes from that man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and put him not to death;

title: Leviticus 20:5
text: then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that play the harlot after him, to play the harlot with Molech, from among their people.

title: Leviticus 20:6
text: And the soul that turneth unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto the wizards, to play the harlot after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.

title: Leviticus 20:7
text: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy; for I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 20:8
text: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am Jehovah who sanctifieth you.

title: Leviticus 20:9
text: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall surely be put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.

title: Leviticus 20:10
text: And the man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbor's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

title: Leviticus 20:11
text: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

title: Leviticus 20:12
text: And if a man lie with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.

title: Leviticus 20:13
text: And if a man lie with mankind, as with womankind, both of them have committed abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

title: Leviticus 20:14
text: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.

title: Leviticus 20:15
text: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.

title: Leviticus 20:16
text: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

title: Leviticus 20:17
text: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a shameful thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

title: Leviticus 20:18
text: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath made naked her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

title: Leviticus 20:19
text: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister, nor of thy father's sister; for he hath made naked his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.

title: Leviticus 20:20
text: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

title: Leviticus 20:21
text: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it is impurity: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.

title: Leviticus 20:22
text: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all mine ordinances, and do them; that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, vomit you not out.

title: Leviticus 20:23
text: And ye shall not walk in the customs of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

title: Leviticus 20:24
text: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey: I am Jehovah your God, who hath separated you from the peoples.

title: Leviticus 20:25
text: Ye shall therefore make a distinction between the clean beast and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by bird, or by anything wherewith the ground teemeth, which I have separated from you as unclean.

title: Leviticus 20:26
text: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I, Jehovah, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that ye should be mine.

title: Leviticus 20:27
text: A man also or a woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones; their blood shall be upon them.

title: Leviticus 21:1
text: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none defile himself for the dead among his people;

title: Leviticus 21:2
text: except for his kin, that is near unto him, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,

title: Leviticus 21:3
text: and for his sister a virgin, that is near unto him, that hath had no husband; for her may he defile himself.

title: Leviticus 21:4
text: He shall not defile himself, [being] a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

title: Leviticus 21:5
text: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.

title: Leviticus 21:6
text: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God; for the offerings of Jehovah made by fire, the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.

title: Leviticus 21:7
text: They shall not take a woman that is a harlot, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.

title: Leviticus 21:8
text: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I Jehovah, who sanctify you, am holy.

title: Leviticus 21:9
text: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the harlot, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.

title: Leviticus 21:10
text: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head go loose, nor rend his clothes;

title: Leviticus 21:11
text: neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;

title: Leviticus 21:12
text: neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 21:13
text: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.

title: Leviticus 21:14
text: A widow, or one divorced, or a profane woman, a harlot, these shall he not take: but a virgin of his own people shall he take to wife.

title: Leviticus 21:15
text: And he shall not profane his seed among his people: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth him.

title: Leviticus 21:16
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 21:17
text: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed throughout their generations that hath a blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.

title: Leviticus 21:18
text: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or anything superfluous,

title: Leviticus 21:19
text: or a man that is broken-footed, or broken-handed,

title: Leviticus 21:20
text: or crook-backed, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or is scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;

title: Leviticus 21:21
text: no man of the seed of Aaron the priest, that hath a blemish, shall come nigh to offer the offerings of Jehovah made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.

title: Leviticus 21:22
text: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy:

title: Leviticus 21:23
text: only he shall not go in unto the veil, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.

title: Leviticus 21:24
text: So Moses spake unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.

title: Leviticus 22:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 22:2
text: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they hallow unto me, and that they profane not my holy name: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 22:3
text: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed throughout your generations, that approacheth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto Jehovah, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from before me: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 22:4
text: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath an issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;

title: Leviticus 22:5
text: or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;

title: Leviticus 22:6
text: the soul that toucheth any such shall be unclean until the even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he bathe his flesh in water.

title: Leviticus 22:7
text: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.

title: Leviticus 22:8
text: That which dieth of itself, or is torn of beasts, he shall not eat, to defile himself therewith: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 22:9
text: They shall therefore keep my charge, lest they bear sin for it, and die therein, if they profane it: I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.

title: Leviticus 22:10
text: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest's, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

title: Leviticus 22:11
text: But if a priest buy any soul, the purchase of his money, he shall eat of it; and such as are born in his house, they shall eat of his bread.

title: Leviticus 22:12
text: And if a priest's daughter be married unto a stranger, she shall not eat of the heave-offering of the holy things.

title: Leviticus 22:13
text: But if a priest's daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and be returned unto her father's house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father's bread: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.

title: Leviticus 22:14
text: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give unto the priest the holy thing.

title: Leviticus 22:15
text: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto Jehovah,

title: Leviticus 22:16
text: and [so] cause them to bear the iniquity that bringeth guilt, when they eat their holy things: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.

title: Leviticus 22:17
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 22:18
text: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whosoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the sojourners in Israel, that offereth his oblation, whether it be any of their vows, or any of their freewill-offerings, which they offer unto Jehovah for a burnt-offering;

title: Leviticus 22:19
text: that ye may be accepted, [ye shall offer] a male without blemish, of the bullocks, of the sheep, or of the goats.

title: Leviticus 22:20
text: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.

title: Leviticus 22:21
text: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah to accomplish a vow, or for a freewill-offering, of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.

title: Leviticus 22:22
text: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto Jehovah, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 22:23
text: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath anything superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill-offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

title: Leviticus 22:24
text: That which hath its stones bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut, ye shall not offer unto Jehovah; neither shall ye do [thus] in your land.

title: Leviticus 22:25
text: Neither from the hand of a foreigner shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, there is a blemish in them: they shall not be accepted for you.

title: Leviticus 22:26
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 22:27
text: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for the oblation of an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 22:28
text: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and its young both in one day.

title: Leviticus 22:29
text: And when ye sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto Jehovah, ye shall sacrifice it that ye may be accepted.

title: Leviticus 22:30
text: On the same day it shall be eaten; ye shall leave none of it until the morning: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 22:31
text: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 22:32
text: And ye shall not profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am Jehovah who halloweth you,

title: Leviticus 22:33
text: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 23:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 23:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, The set feasts of Jehovah, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.

title: Leviticus 23:3
text: Six days shall work be done: but on the seventh day is a sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of work: it is a sabbath unto Jehovah in all your dwellings.

title: Leviticus 23:4
text: These are the set feasts of Jehovah, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their appointed season.

title: Leviticus 23:5
text: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, is Jehovah's passover.

title: Leviticus 23:6
text: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto Jehovah: seven days ye shall eat unleavened bread.

title: Leviticus 23:7
text: In the first day ye shall have a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work.

title: Leviticus 23:8
text: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah seven days: in the seventh day is a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.

title: Leviticus 23:9
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 23:10
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring the sheaf of the first-fruits of your harvest unto the priest:

title: Leviticus 23:11
text: and he shall wave the sheaf before Jehovah, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

title: Leviticus 23:12
text: And in the day when ye wave the sheaf, ye shall offer a he-lamb without blemish a year old for a burnt-offering unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 23:13
