text: And the meal-offering thereof shall be two tenth parts [of an ephah] of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah for a sweet savor; and the drink-offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.

title: Leviticus 23:14
text: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched grain, nor fresh ears, until this selfsame day, until ye have brought the oblation of your God: it is a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

title: Leviticus 23:15
text: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave-offering; seven sabbaths shall there be complete:

title: Leviticus 23:16
text: even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meal-offering unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 23:17
text: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave-loaves of two tenth parts [of an ephah] : they shall be of fine flour, they shall be baken with leaven, for first-fruits unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 23:18
text: And ye shall present with the bread seven lambs without blemish a year old, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be a burnt-offering unto Jehovah, with their meal-offering, and their drink-offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 23:19
text: And ye shall offer one he-goat for a sin-offering, and two he-lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace-offerings.

title: Leviticus 23:20
text: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the first-fruits for a wave-offering before Jehovah, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to Jehovah for the priest.

title: Leviticus 23:21
text: And ye shall make proclamation on the selfsame day; there shall be a holy convocation unto you; ye shall do no servile work: it is a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

title: Leviticus 23:22
text: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them for the poor, and for the sojourner: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 23:23
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 23:24
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, shall be a solemn rest unto you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.

title: Leviticus 23:25
text: Ye shall do no servile work; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 23:26
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 23:27
text: Howbeit on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement: it shall be a holy convocation unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 23:28
text: And ye shall do no manner of work in that same day; for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 23:29
text: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day; he shall be cut off from his people.

title: Leviticus 23:30
text: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any manner of work in that same day, that soul will I destroy from among his people.

title: Leviticus 23:31
text: Ye shall do no manner of work: it is a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

title: Leviticus 23:32
text: It shall be unto you a sabbath of solemn rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye keep your sabbath.

title: Leviticus 23:33
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 23:34
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 23:35
text: On the first day shall be a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work.

title: Leviticus 23:36
text: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah: on the eighth day shall be a holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah: it is a solemn assembly; ye shall do no servile work.

title: Leviticus 23:37
text: These are the set feasts of Jehovah, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah, a burnt-offering, and a meal-offering, a sacrifice, and drink-offerings, each on its own day;

title: Leviticus 23:38
text: besides the sabbaths of Jehovah, and besides your gifts, and besides all your vows, and besides all your freewill-offerings, which ye give unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 23:39
text: Howbeit on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruits of the land, ye shall keep the feast of Jehovah seven days: on the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.

title: Leviticus 23:40
text: And ye shall take you on the first day the fruit of goodly trees, branches of palm-trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before Jehovah your God seven days.

title: Leviticus 23:41
text: And ye shall keep it a feast unto Jehovah seven days in the year: it is a statute for ever throughout your generations; ye shall keep it in the seventh month.

title: Leviticus 23:42
text: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are home-born in Israel shall dwell in booths;

title: Leviticus 23:43
text: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 23:44
text: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the set feasts of Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 24:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 24:2
text: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

title: Leviticus 24:3
text: Without the veil of the testimony, in the tent of meeting, shall Aaron keep it in order from evening to morning before Jehovah continually: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations.

title: Leviticus 24:4
text: He shall keep in order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before Jehovah continually.

title: Leviticus 24:5
text: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth parts [of an ephah] shall be in one cake.

title: Leviticus 24:6
text: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 24:7
text: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 24:8
text: Every sabbath day he shall set it in order before Jehovah continually; it is on the behalf of the children of Israel, an everlasting covenant.

title: Leviticus 24:9
text: And it shall be for Aaron and his sons; and they shall eat it in a holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire by a perpetual statute.

title: Leviticus 24:10
text: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp:

title: Leviticus 24:11
text: and the son of the Israelitish woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him unto Moses. And his mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

title: Leviticus 24:12
text: And they put him in ward, that it might be declared unto them at the mouth of Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 24:13
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 24:14
text: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

title: Leviticus 24:15
text: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.

title: Leviticus 24:16
text: And he that blasphemeth the name of Jehovah, he shall surely be put to death; all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the sojourner, as the home-born, when he blasphemeth the name [of Jehovah], shall be put to death.

title: Leviticus 24:17
text: And he that smiteth any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

title: Leviticus 24:18
text: And he that smiteth a beast mortally shall make it good, life for life.

title: Leviticus 24:19
text: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbor; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him:

title: Leviticus 24:20
text: breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be rendered unto him.

title: Leviticus 24:21
text: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good: and he that killeth a man shall be put to death.

title: Leviticus 24:22
text: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the sojourner, as for the home-born: for I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 24:23
text: And Moses spake to the children of Israel; and they brought forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. And the children of Israel did as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 25:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,

title: Leviticus 25:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 25:3
text: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruits thereof;

title: Leviticus 25:4
text: but in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a sabbath unto Jehovah: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.

title: Leviticus 25:5
text: That which groweth of itself of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, and the grapes of thy undressed vine thou shalt not gather: it shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.

title: Leviticus 25:6
text: And the sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for thee, and for thy servant and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant and for thy stranger, who sojourn with thee.

title: Leviticus 25:7
text: And for thy cattle, and for the beasts that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be for food.

title: Leviticus 25:8
text: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and there shall be unto thee the days of seven sabbaths of years, even forty and nine years.

title: Leviticus 25:9
text: Then shalt thou send abroad the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month; in the day of atonement shall ye send abroad the trumpet throughout all your land.

title: Leviticus 25:10
text: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubilee unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.

title: Leviticus 25:11
text: A jubilee shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather [the grapes] in it of the undressed vines.

title: Leviticus 25:12
text: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.

title: Leviticus 25:13
text: In this year of jubilee ye shall return every man unto his possession.

title: Leviticus 25:14
text: And if thou sell aught unto thy neighbor, or buy of thy neighbor's hand, ye shall not wrong one another.

title: Leviticus 25:15
text: According to the number of years after the jubilee thou shalt buy of thy neighbor, [and] according unto the number of years of the crops he shall sell unto thee.

title: Leviticus 25:16
text: According to the multitude of the years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of the years thou shalt diminish the price of it; for the number of the crops doth he sell unto thee.

title: Leviticus 25:17
text: And ye shall not wrong one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 25:18
text: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep mine ordinances and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.

title: Leviticus 25:19
text: And the land shall yield its fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

title: Leviticus 25:20
text: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;

title: Leviticus 25:21
text: then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for the three years.

title: Leviticus 25:22
text: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits, the old store; until the ninth year, until its fruits come in, ye shall eat the old store.

title: Leviticus 25:23
text: And the land shall not be sold in perpetuity; for the land is mine: for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.

title: Leviticus 25:24
text: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.

title: Leviticus 25:25
text: If thy brother be waxed poor, and sell some of his possession, then shall his kinsman that is next unto him come, and shall redeem that which his brother hath sold.

title: Leviticus 25:26
text: And if a man have no one to redeem it, and he be waxed rich and find sufficient to redeem it;

title: Leviticus 25:27
text: then let him reckon the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return unto his possession.

title: Leviticus 25:28
text: But if he be not able to get it back for himself, then that which he hath sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubilee: and in the jubilee it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.

title: Leviticus 25:29
text: And if a man sell a dwelling-house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; for a full year shall he have the right of redemption.

title: Leviticus 25:30
text: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him that bought it, throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubilee.

title: Leviticus 25:31
text: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be reckoned with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubilee.

title: Leviticus 25:32
text: Nevertheless the cities of the Levites, the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.

title: Leviticus 25:33
text: And if one of the Levites redeem, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

title: Leviticus 25:34
text: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

title: Leviticus 25:35
text: And if thy brother be waxed poor, and his hand fail with thee; then thou shalt uphold him: [as] a stranger and a sojourner shall he live with thee.

title: Leviticus 25:36
text: Take thou no interest of him or increase, but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.

title: Leviticus 25:37
text: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon interest, nor give him thy victuals for increase.

title: Leviticus 25:38
text: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, [and] to be your God.

title: Leviticus 25:39
text: And if thy brother be waxed poor with thee, and sell himself unto thee; thou shalt not make him to serve as a bond-servant.

title: Leviticus 25:40
text: As a hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee; he shall serve with thee unto the year of jubilee:

title: Leviticus 25:41
text: then shall he go out from thee, he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.

title: Leviticus 25:42
text: For they are my servants, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.

title: Leviticus 25:43
text: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigor, but shalt fear thy God.

title: Leviticus 25:44
text: And as for thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, whom thou shalt have; of the nations that are round about you, of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.

title: Leviticus 25:45
text: Moreover of the children of the strangers that sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they have begotten in your land: and they shall be your possession.

title: Leviticus 25:46
text: And ye shall make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession; of them shall ye take your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel ye shall not rule, one over another, with rigor.

title: Leviticus 25:47
text: And if a stranger or sojourner with thee be waxed rich, and thy brother be waxed poor beside him, and sell himself unto the stranger [or] sojourner with thee, or to the stock of the stranger's family;

title: Leviticus 25:48
text: after that he is sold he may be redeemed: one of his brethren may redeem him;

title: Leviticus 25:49
text: or his uncle, or his uncle's son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be waxed rich, he may redeem himself.

title: Leviticus 25:50
text: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he sold himself to him unto the year of jubilee: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years; according to the time of a hired servant shall he be with him.

title: Leviticus 25:51
text: If there be yet many years, according unto them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

title: Leviticus 25:52
text: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according unto his years shall he give back the price of his redemption.

title: Leviticus 25:53
text: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him: he shall not rule with rigor over him in thy sight.

title: Leviticus 25:54
text: And if he be not redeemed by these [means], then he shall go out in the year of jubilee, he, and his children with him.

title: Leviticus 25:55
text: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 26:1
text: Ye shall make you no idols, neither shall ye rear you up a graven image, or a pillar, neither shall ye place any figured stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 26:2
text: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 26:3
text: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;

title: Leviticus 26:4
text: then I will give your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

title: Leviticus 26:5
text: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time; and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

title: Leviticus 26:6
text: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will cause evil beasts to cease out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

title: Leviticus 26:7
text: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

title: Leviticus 26:8
text: And five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

title: Leviticus 26:9
text: And I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.

title: Leviticus 26:10
text: And ye shall eat old store long kept, and ye shall bring forth the old because of the new.

title: Leviticus 26:11
text: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.

title: Leviticus 26:12
text: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.

title: Leviticus 26:13
text: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you go upright.

title: Leviticus 26:14
text: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;

title: Leviticus 26:15
text: and if ye shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhor mine ordinances, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant;

title: Leviticus 26:16
text: I also will do this unto you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away; and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.

title: Leviticus 26:17
text: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be smitten before your enemies: they that hate you shall rule over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.

title: Leviticus 26:18
text: And if ye will not yet for these things hearken unto me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.

title: Leviticus 26:19
text: And I will break the pride of your power: and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass;

title: Leviticus 26:20
text: and your strength shall be spent in vain; for your land shall not yield its increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruit.

title: Leviticus 26:21
text: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me, I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.

title: Leviticus 26:22
text: And I will send the beast of the field among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your ways shall become desolate.

title: Leviticus 26:23
text: And if by these things ye will not be reformed unto me, but will walk contrary unto me;

title: Leviticus 26:24
text: then will I also walk contrary unto you; and I will smite you, even I, seven times for your sins.

title: Leviticus 26:25
text: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall execute the vengeance of the covenant; and ye shall be gathered together within your cities: and I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

title: Leviticus 26:26
text: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.

title: Leviticus 26:27
text: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;

title: Leviticus 26:28
text: then I will walk contrary unto you in wrath; and I also will chastise you seven times for your sins.

title: Leviticus 26:29
text: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.

title: Leviticus 26:30
text: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your sun-images, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul shall abhor you.

title: Leviticus 26:31
text: And I will make your cities a waste, and will bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savor of your sweet odors.

title: Leviticus 26:32
text: And I will bring the land into desolation; and your enemies that dwell therein shall be astonished at it.

title: Leviticus 26:33
text: And you will I scatter among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you: and your land shall be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.

title: Leviticus 26:34
text: Then shall the land enjoy its sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye are in your enemies' land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy its sabbaths.

title: Leviticus 26:35
text: As long as it lieth desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it had not in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.

title: Leviticus 26:36
text: And as for them that are left of you, I will send a faintness into their heart in the lands of their enemies: and the sound of a driven leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as one fleeth from the sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.

title: Leviticus 26:37
text: And they shall stumble one upon another, as it were before the sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.

title: Leviticus 26:38
text: And ye shall perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.

title: Leviticus 26:39
text: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies' lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.

title: Leviticus 26:40
text: And they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me, and also that, because they walked contrary unto me,

title: Leviticus 26:41
text: I also walked contrary unto them, and brought them into the land of their enemies: if then their uncircumcised heart be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity;

title: Leviticus 26:42
text: then will I remember my covenant with Jacob; and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.

title: Leviticus 26:43
text: The land also shall be left by them, and shall enjoy its sabbaths, while it lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity; because, even because they rejected mine ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.

title: Leviticus 26:44
text: And yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them; for I am Jehovah their God;

title: Leviticus 26:45
text: but I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 26:46
text: These are the statutes and ordinances and laws, which Jehovah made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by Moses.

title: Leviticus 27:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 27:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall accomplish a vow, the persons shall be for Jehovah by thy estimation.

title: Leviticus 27:3
text: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

title: Leviticus 27:4
text: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.

title: Leviticus 27:5
text: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

title: Leviticus 27:6
text: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.

title: Leviticus 27:7
text: And if it be from sixty years old and upward; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

title: Leviticus 27:8
text: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to the ability of him that vowed shall the priest value him.

title: Leviticus 27:9
text: And if it be a beast, whereof men offer an oblation unto Jehovah, all that any man giveth of such unto Jehovah shall be holy.

title: Leviticus 27:10
text: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy.

title: Leviticus 27:11
text: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer an oblation unto Jehovah, then he shall set the beast before the priest;

title: Leviticus 27:12
text: and the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou the priest valuest it, so shall it be.

title: Leviticus 27:13
text: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.

title: Leviticus 27:14
text: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto Jehovah, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.

title: Leviticus 27:15
text: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.

title: Leviticus 27:16
text: And if a man shall sanctify unto Jehovah part of the field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the sowing thereof: the sowing of a homer of barley [shall be valued] at fifty shekels of silver.

title: Leviticus 27:17
text: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubilee, according to thy estimation it shall stand.

title: Leviticus 27:18
text: But if he sanctify his field after the jubilee, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain unto the year of jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from thy estimation.

title: Leviticus 27:19
text: And if he that sanctified the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.

title: Leviticus 27:20
text: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more:

title: Leviticus 27:21
text: but the field, when it goeth out in the jubilee, shall be holy unto Jehovah, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.

title: Leviticus 27:22
text: And if he sanctify unto Jehovah a field which he hath bought, which is not of the field of his possession;

title: Leviticus 27:23
text: then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation unto the year of jubilee: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 27:24
text: In the year of jubilee the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongeth.

title: Leviticus 27:25
text: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.

title: Leviticus 27:26
text: Only the firstling among beasts, which is made a firstling to Jehovah, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox or sheep, it is Jehovah's.

title: Leviticus 27:27
text: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall ransom it according to thine estimation, and shall add unto it the fifth part thereof: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.

title: Leviticus 27:28
text: Notwithstanding, no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto Jehovah of all that he hath, whether of man or beast, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 27:29
text: No one devoted, that shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed; he shall surely be put to death.

title: Leviticus 27:30
text: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is Jehovah's: it is holy unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 27:31
text: And if a man will redeem aught of his tithe, he shall add unto it the fifth part thereof.

title: Leviticus 27:32
text: And all the tithe of the herd or the flock, whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 27:33
text: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.

title: Leviticus 27:34
text: These are the commandments, which Jehovah commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.

title: Numbers 1:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tent of meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

title: Numbers 1:2
text: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, every male, by their polls;

title: Numbers 1:3
text: from twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel, thou and Aaron shall number them by their hosts.

title: Numbers 1:4
text: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of his fathers' house.

title: Numbers 1:5
text: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you. Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.

title: Numbers 1:6
text: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

title: Numbers 1:7
text: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

title: Numbers 1:8
text: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.

title: Numbers 1:9
text: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.

title: Numbers 1:10
text: Of the children of Joseph: Of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud. Of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

title: Numbers 1:11
text: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.

title: Numbers 1:12
text: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

title: Numbers 1:13
text: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.

title: Numbers 1:14
text: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

title: Numbers 1:15
text: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.

title: Numbers 1:16
text: These are they that were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.

title: Numbers 1:17
text: And Moses and Aaron took these men that are mentioned by name:

title: Numbers 1:18
text: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.

title: Numbers 1:19
text: As Jehovah commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

title: Numbers 1:20
text: And the children of Reuben, Israel's first-born, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

title: Numbers 1:21
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.

title: Numbers 1:22
text: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, those that were numbered thereof, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

title: Numbers 1:23
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

title: Numbers 1:24
text: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

title: Numbers 1:25
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 1:26
text: Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

title: Numbers 1:27
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Judah, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

title: Numbers 1:28
text: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

title: Numbers 1:29
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

title: Numbers 1:30
text: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

title: Numbers 1:31
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

title: Numbers 1:32
text: Of the children of Joseph, [namely], of the children of Ephraim, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

title: Numbers 1:33
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.

title: Numbers 1:34
text: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

title: Numbers 1:35
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

title: Numbers 1:36
text: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

title: Numbers 1:37
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

title: Numbers 1:38
text: Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

title: Numbers 1:39
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

title: Numbers 1:40
text: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

title: Numbers 1:41
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.

title: Numbers 1:42
text: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

title: Numbers 1:43
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

title: Numbers 1:44
text: These are they that were numbered, whom Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: they were each one for his fathers' house.

title: Numbers 1:45
text: So all they that were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers' houses, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;

title: Numbers 1:46
text: even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 1:47
text: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.

title: Numbers 1:48
text: For Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 1:49
text: Only the tribe of Levi thou shalt not number, neither shalt thou take the sum of them among the children of Israel;

title: Numbers 1:50
text: but appoint thou the Levites over the tabernacle of the testimony, and over all the furniture thereof, and over all that belongeth to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the furniture thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.

title: Numbers 1:51
text: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

title: Numbers 1:52
text: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their hosts.

title: Numbers 1:53
text: But the Levites shall encamp round about the tabernacle of the testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of the testimony.

title: Numbers 1:54
text: Thus did the children of Israel; according to all that Jehovah commanded Moses, so did they.

title: Numbers 2:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

title: Numbers 2:2
text: The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the ensigns of their fathers' houses: over against the tent of meeting shall they encamp round about.

title: Numbers 2:3
text: And those that encamp on the east side toward the sunrising shall be they of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their hosts: and the prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

title: Numbers 2:4
text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

title: Numbers 2:5
text: And those that encamp next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and the prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.

title: Numbers 2:6
text: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

title: Numbers 2:7
text: [ And] the tribe of Zebulun: and the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.

title: Numbers 2:8
text: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

title: Numbers 2:9
text: All that were numbered of the camp of Judah were a hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, according to their hosts. They shall set forth first.

title: Numbers 2:10
text: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their hosts: and the prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

title: Numbers 2:11
text: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.

title: Numbers 2:12
text: And those that encamp next unto him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

title: Numbers 2:13
text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

title: Numbers 2:14
text: And the tribe of Gad: and the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

title: Numbers 2:15
text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 2:16
text: All that were numbered of the camp of Reuben were a hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, according to their hosts. And they shall set forth second.

title: Numbers 2:17
text: Then the tent of meeting shall set forward, with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camps: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place, by their standards.

title: Numbers 2:18
text: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their hosts: and the prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

title: Numbers 2:19
text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.

title: Numbers 2:20
text: And next unto him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

title: Numbers 2:21
text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

title: Numbers 2:22
text: And the tribe of Benjamin: and the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

title: Numbers 2:23
text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

title: Numbers 2:24
text: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were a hundred thousand and eight thousand and a hundred, according to their hosts. And they shall set forth third.

title: Numbers 2:25
text: On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their hosts: and the prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

title: Numbers 2:26
text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

title: Numbers 2:27
text: And those that encamp next unto him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.

title: Numbers 2:28
text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.

title: Numbers 2:29
text: And the tribe of Naphtali: and the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

title: Numbers 2:30
text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

title: Numbers 2:31
text: All that were numbered of the camp of Dan were a hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall set forth hindmost by their standards.

title: Numbers 2:32
text: These are they that were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers' houses: all that were numbered of the camps according to their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 2:33
text: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 2:34
text: Thus did the children of Israel; according to all that Jehovah commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set forward, every one by their families, according to their fathers' houses.

title: Numbers 3:1
text: Now these are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Jehovah spake with Moses in mount Sinai.

title: Numbers 3:2
text: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the first-born, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

title: Numbers 3:3
text: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests that were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office.

title: Numbers 3:4
text: And Nadab and Abihu died before Jehovah, when they offered strange fire before Jehovah, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children; and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the presence of Aaron their father.

title: Numbers 3:5
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 3:6
text: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.

title: Numbers 3:7
text: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tent of meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.

title: Numbers 3:8
text: And they shall keep all the furniture of the tent of meeting, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

title: Numbers 3:9
text: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him on the behalf of the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 3:10
text: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

title: Numbers 3:11
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 3:12
text: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the first-born that openeth the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine:

title: Numbers 3:13
text: for all the first-born are mine; on the day that I smote all the first-born in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the first-born in Israel, both man and beast; mine they shall be: I am Jehovah.

title: Numbers 3:14
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

title: Numbers 3:15
text: Number the children of Levi by their fathers' houses, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.

title: Numbers 3:16
text: And Moses numbered them according to the word of Jehovah, as he was commanded.

title: Numbers 3:17
text: And these were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.

title: Numbers 3:18
text: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.

title: Numbers 3:19
text: And the sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, and Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

title: Numbers 3:20
text: And the sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers' houses.

title: Numbers 3:21
text: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites: these are the families of the Gershonites.

title: Numbers 3:22
text: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.

title: Numbers 3:23
text: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.

title: Numbers 3:24
text: And the prince of the fathers' house of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.

title: Numbers 3:25
text: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting shall be the tabernacle, and the Tent, the covering thereof, and the screen for the door of the tent of meeting,

title: Numbers 3:26
text: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.

title: Numbers 3:27
text: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.

title: Numbers 3:28
text: According to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.

title: Numbers 3:29
text: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the side of the tabernacle southward.

title: Numbers 3:30
text: And the prince of the fathers' house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

title: Numbers 3:31
text: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the screen, and all the service thereof.

title: Numbers 3:32
text: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, [and have] the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.

title: Numbers 3:33
text: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.

title: Numbers 3:34
text: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.

title: Numbers 3:35
text: And the prince of the fathers' house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: they shall encamp on the side of the tabernacle northward.

title: Numbers 3:36
text: And the appointed charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the instruments thereof, and all the service thereof,

title: Numbers 3:37
text: and the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.

title: Numbers 3:38
text: And those that encamp before the tabernacle eastward, before the tent of meeting toward the sunrising, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

title: Numbers 3:39
text: All that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of Jehovah, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.

title: Numbers 3:40
text: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Number all the first-born males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

title: Numbers 3:41
text: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am Jehovah) instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel:

title: Numbers 3:42
text: and Moses numbered, as Jehovah commanded him, all the first-born among the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 3:43
text: And all the first-born males according to the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.

title: Numbers 3:44
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 3:45
text: Take the Levites instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am Jehovah.

title: Numbers 3:46
text: And for the redemption of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the first-born of the children of Israel, that are over and above [the number of] the Levites,

title: Numbers 3:47
text: thou shalt take five shekels apiece by the poll; after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs):

title: Numbers 3:48
text: and thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.

title: Numbers 3:49
text: And Moses took the redemption-money from them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites;

title: Numbers 3:50
text: from the first-born of the children of Israel took he the money, a thousand three hundred and threescore and five [shekels], after the shekel of the sanctuary:

title: Numbers 3:51
text: and Moses gave the redemption-money unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of Jehovah, as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 4:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

title: Numbers 4:2
text: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers' houses,

title: Numbers 4:3
text: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter upon the service, to do the work in the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 4:4
text: This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting, [about] the most holy things:

title: Numbers 4:5
text: when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall go in, and his sons, and they shall take down the veil of the screen, and cover the ark of the testimony with it,

title: Numbers 4:6
text: and shall put thereon a covering of sealskin, and shall spread over it a cloth all of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.

title: Numbers 4:7
text: And upon the table of showbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls and the cups wherewith to pour out; and the continual bread shall be thereon:

title: Numbers 4:8
text: and they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in the staves thereof.

title: Numbers 4:9
text: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and its lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:

title: Numbers 4:10
text: and they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it upon the frame.

title: Numbers 4:11
text: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in the staves thereof:

title: Numbers 4:12
text: and they shall take all the vessels of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.

title: Numbers 4:13
text: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:

title: Numbers 4:14
text: and they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, the firepans, the flesh-hooks, and the shovels, and the basins, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of sealskin, and put in the staves thereof.

title: Numbers 4:15
text: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp is set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 4:16
text: And the charge of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the continual meal-offering, and the anointing oil, the charge of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, the sanctuary, and the furniture thereof.

title: Numbers 4:17
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

title: Numbers 4:18
text: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;

title: Numbers 4:19
text: but thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden;

title: Numbers 4:20
text: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.

title: Numbers 4:21
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 4:22
text: Take the sum of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers' houses, by their families;

title: Numbers 4:23
text: from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to wait upon the service, to do the work in the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 4:24
text: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:

title: Numbers 4:25
text: they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tent of meeting, its covering, and the covering of sealskin that is above upon it, and the screen for the door of the tent of meeting,

title: Numbers 4:26
text: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatsoever shall be done with them: therein shall they serve.

title: Numbers 4:27
text: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden, and in all their service; and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burden.

title: Numbers 4:28
text: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the tent of meeting: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

title: Numbers 4:29
text: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them by their families, by their fathers' houses;

title: Numbers 4:30
text: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth upon the service, to do the work of the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 4:31
text: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tent of meeting: the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof,

title: Numbers 4:32
text: and the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall appoint the instruments of the charge of their burden.

title: Numbers 4:33
text: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tent of meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

title: Numbers 4:34
text: And Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers' houses,

title: Numbers 4:35
text: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered upon the service, for work in the tent of meeting:

title: Numbers 4:36
text: and those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 4:37
text: These are they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that did serve in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Jehovah by Moses.

title: Numbers 4:38
text: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, their families, and by their fathers' houses,

title: Numbers 4:39
text: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered upon the service, for work in the tent of meeting,

title: Numbers 4:40
text: even those that were numbered of them, by their families, by their fathers' houses, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.

title: Numbers 4:41
text: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, all that did serve in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Jehovah.

title: Numbers 4:42
text: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers' houses,

title: Numbers 4:43
text: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered upon the service, for work in the tent of meeting,

title: Numbers 4:44
text: even those that were numbered of them by their families, were three thousand and two hundred.

title: Numbers 4:45
text: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Jehovah by Moses.

title: Numbers 4:46
text: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel numbered, by their families, and by their fathers' houses,

title: Numbers 4:47
text: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered in to do the work of service, and the work of bearing burdens in the tent of meeting,

title: Numbers 4:48
text: even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.

title: Numbers 4:49
text: According to the commandment of Jehovah they were numbered by Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as Jehovah commanded Moses. [

title: Numbers 5:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 5:2
text: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is unclean by the dead:

title: Numbers 5:3
text: both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camp, in the midst whereof I dwell.

title: Numbers 5:4
text: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp; as Jehovah spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 5:5
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 5:6
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against Jehovah, and that soul shall be guilty;

title: Numbers 5:7
text: then he shall confess his sin which he hath done: and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him in respect of whom he hath been guilty.

title: Numbers 5:8
text: But if the man have no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made unto Jehovah shall be the priest's; besides the ram of the atonement, whereby atonement shall be made for him.

title: Numbers 5:9
text: And every heave-offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present unto the priest, shall be his.

title: Numbers 5:10
text: And every man's hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.

title: Numbers 5:11
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 5:12
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,

title: Numbers 5:13
text: and a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, and she be not taken in the act;

title: Numbers 5:14
text: and the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:

title: Numbers 5:15
text: then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and shall bring her oblation for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is a meal-offering of jealousy, a meal-offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.

title: Numbers 5:16
text: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before Jehovah:

title: Numbers 5:17
text: and the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water.

title: Numbers 5:18
text: And the priest shall set the woman before Jehovah, and let the hair of the woman's head go loose, and put the meal-offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal-offering of jealousy: and the priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that causeth the curse.

title: Numbers 5:19
text: And the priest shall cause her to swear, and shall say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou have not gone aside to uncleanness, being under thy husband, be thou free from this water of bitterness that causeth the curse.

title: Numbers 5:20
text: But if thou have gone aside, being under thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee besides thy husband:

title: Numbers 5:21
text: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, Jehovah make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when Jehovah doth make thy thigh to fall away, and thy body to swell;

title: Numbers 5:22
text: and this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, and make thy body to swell, and thy thigh to fall away. And the woman shall say, Amen, Amen.

title: Numbers 5:23
text: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out into the water of bitterness:

title: Numbers 5:24
text: and he shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causeth the curse; and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her [and become] bitter.

title: Numbers 5:25
text: And the priest shall take the meal-offering of jealousy out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the meal-offering before Jehovah, and bring it unto the altar:

title: Numbers 5:26
text: and the priest shall take a handful of the meal-offering, as the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.

title: Numbers 5:27
text: And when he hath made her drink the water, then it shall come to pass, if she be defiled, and have committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her [and become] bitter, and her body shall swell, and her thigh shall fall away: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.

title: Numbers 5:28
text: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.

title: Numbers 5:29
text: This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goeth aside, and is defiled;

title: Numbers 5:30
text: or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then shall he set the woman before Jehovah, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.

title: Numbers 5:31
text: And the man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.

title: Numbers 6:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 6:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself unto Jehovah,

title: Numbers 6:3
text: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink; he shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.

title: Numbers 6:4
text: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the grape-vine, from the kernels even to the husk.

title: Numbers 6:5
text: All the days of his vow of separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in which he separateth himself unto Jehovah, he shall be holy; he shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.

title: Numbers 6:6
text: All the days that he separateth himself unto Jehovah he shall not come near to a dead body.

title: Numbers 6:7
text: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die; because his separation unto God is upon his head.

title: Numbers 6:8
text: All the days of his separation he is holy unto Jehovah.

title: Numbers 6:9
text: And if any man die very suddenly beside him, and he defile the head of his separation; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.

title: Numbers 6:10
text: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tent of meeting:

title: Numbers 6:11
text: and the priest shall offer one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering, and make atonement for him, for that he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.

title: Numbers 6:12
text: And he shall separate unto Jehovah the days of his separation, and shall bring a he-lamb a year old for a trespass-offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.

title: Numbers 6:13
text: And this is the law of the Nazirite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tent of meeting:

title: Numbers 6:14
text: and he shall offer his oblation unto Jehovah, one he-lamb a year old without blemish for a burnt-offering, and one ewe-lamb a year old without blemish for a sin-offering, and one ram without blemish for peace-offerings,

title: Numbers 6:15
text: and a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and their meal-offering, and their drink-offerings.

title: Numbers 6:16
text: And the priest shall present them before Jehovah, and shall offer his sin-offering, and his burnt-offering:

title: Numbers 6:17
text: and he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.

title: Numbers 6:18
text: And the Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tent of meeting, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace-offerings.

title: Numbers 6:19
text: And the priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazirite, after he hath shaven [the head of] his separation;

title: Numbers 6:20
text: and the priest shall wave them for a wave-offering before Jehovah; this is holy for the priest, together with the wave-breast and heave- thigh: and after that the Nazirite may drink wine.

title: Numbers 6:21
text: This is the law of the Nazirite who voweth, [and of] his oblation unto Jehovah for his separation, besides that which he is able to get: according to his vow which he voweth, so he must do after the law of his separation.

title: Numbers 6:22
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 6:23
text: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel: ye shall say unto them,

title: Numbers 6:24
text: Jehovah bless thee, and keep thee:

title: Numbers 6:25
text: Jehovah make his face to shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:

title: Numbers 6:26
text: Jehovah lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

title: Numbers 6:27
text: So shall they put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.

title: Numbers 7:1
text: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had made an end of setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it, and all the furniture thereof, and the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them and sanctified them;

title: Numbers 7:2
text: that the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers' houses, offered. These were the princes of the tribes, these are they that were over them that were numbered:

title: Numbers 7:3
text: and they brought their oblation before Jehovah, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they presented them before the tabernacle.

title: Numbers 7:4
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 7:5
text: Take it of them, that they may be [used] in doing the service of the tent of meeting; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.

title: Numbers 7:6
text: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.

title: Numbers 7:7
text: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:

title: Numbers 7:8
text: and four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

title: Numbers 7:9
text: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged unto them; they bare it upon their shoulders.

title: Numbers 7:10
text: And the princes offered for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their oblation before the altar.

title: Numbers 7:11
text: And Jehovah said unto Moses, They shall offer their oblation, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.

title: Numbers 7:12
text: And he that offered his oblation the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:

title: Numbers 7:13
text: and his oblation was one silver platter, the weight whereof was a hundred and thirty [shekels], one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal-offering;

title: Numbers 7:14
text: one golden spoon of ten [shekels], full of incense;

title: Numbers 7:15
text: one young bullock, one ram, one he-lamb a year old, for a burnt-offering;

title: Numbers 7:16
text: one male of the goats for a sin-offering;

title: Numbers 7:17
text: and for the sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five he-lambs a year old: this was the oblation of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

title: Numbers 7:18
text: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, did offer:

title: Numbers 7:19

title: Numbers 7:84
text: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden spoons;

title: Numbers 7:85
text: each silver platter [weighing] a hundred and thirty [shekels], and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand and four hundred [shekels], after the shekel of the sanctuary;

title: Numbers 7:86
text: the twelve golden spoons, full of incense, [weighing] ten [shekels] apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the spoons a hundred and twenty [shekels] ;

title: Numbers 7:87
text: all the oxen for the burnt-offering twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the he-lambs a year old twelve, and their meal-offering; and the males of the goats for a sin-offering twelve;

title: Numbers 7:88
text: and all the oxen for the sacrifice of peace-offerings twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he-goats sixty, the he-lambs a year old sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.

title: Numbers 7:89
text: And when Moses went into the tent of meeting to speak with him, then he heard the Voice speaking unto him from above the mercy-seat that was upon the ark of the testimony, from between the two cherubim: and he spake unto him.

title: Numbers 8:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 8:2
text: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the candlestick.

title: Numbers 8:3
text: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof [so as to give light] in front of the candlestick, as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 8:4
text: And this was the work of the candlestick, beaten work of gold; unto the base thereof, [and] unto the flowers thereof, it was beaten work: according unto the pattern which Jehovah had showed Moses, so he made the candlestick.

title: Numbers 8:5
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 8:6
text: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

title: Numbers 8:7
text: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of expiation upon them, and let them cause a razor to pass over all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.

title: Numbers 8:8
text: Then let them take a young bullock, and its meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil; and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin-offering.

title: Numbers 8:9
text: And thou shalt present the Levites before the tent of meeting: and thou shalt assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel:

title: Numbers 8:10
text: and thou shalt present the Levites before Jehovah. And the children of Israel shall lay their hands upon the Levites:

title: Numbers 8:11
text: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before Jehovah for a wave-offering, on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of Jehovah.

title: Numbers 8:12
text: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and offer thou the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering, unto Jehovah, to make atonement for the Levites.

title: Numbers 8:13
text: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for a wave-offering unto Jehovah.

title: Numbers 8:14
text: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine.

title: Numbers 8:15
