text: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tent of meeting: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for a wave-offering.

title: Numbers 8:16
text: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of all that openeth the womb, even the first-born of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.

title: Numbers 8:17
text: For all the first-born among the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote all the first-born in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.

title: Numbers 8:18
text: And I have taken the Levites instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 8:19
text: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tent of meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel; that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.

title: Numbers 8:20
text: Thus did Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the Levites: according unto all that Jehovah commanded Moses touching the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.

title: Numbers 8:21
text: And the Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes: and Aaron offered them for a wave-offering before Jehovah; and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.

title: Numbers 8:22
text: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tent of meeting before Aaron, and before his sons: as Jehovah had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.

title: Numbers 8:23
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 8:24
text: This is that which belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service in the work of the tent of meeting:

title: Numbers 8:25
text: and from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the work, and shall serve no more,

title: Numbers 8:26
text: but shall minister with their brethren in the tent of meeting, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charges.

title: Numbers 9:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

title: Numbers 9:2
text: Moreover let the children of Israel keep the passover in its appointed season.

title: Numbers 9:3
text: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in its appointed season: according to all the statutes of it, and according to all the ordinances thereof, shall ye keep it.

title: Numbers 9:4
text: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.

title: Numbers 9:5
text: And they kept the passover in the first [month], on the fourteenth day of the month, at even, in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that Jehovah commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 9:6
text: And there were certain men, who were unclean by reason of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:

title: Numbers 9:7
text: and those men said unto him, We are unclean by reason of the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer the oblation of Jehovah in its appointed season among the children of Israel?

title: Numbers 9:8
text: And Moses said unto them, Stay ye, that I may hear what Jehovah will command concerning you.

title: Numbers 9:9
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 9:10
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your generations shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be on a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto Jehovah.

title: Numbers 9:11
text: In the second month on the fourteenth day at even they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs:

title: Numbers 9:12
text: they shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break a bone thereof: according to all the statute of the passover they shall keep it.

title: Numbers 9:13
text: But the man that is clean, and is not on a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people; because he offered not the oblation of Jehovah in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

title: Numbers 9:14
text: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto Jehovah; according to the statute of the passover, and according to the ordinance thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one statute, both for the sojourner, and for him that is born in the land.

title: Numbers 9:15
text: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the tent of the testimony: and at even it was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.

title: Numbers 9:16
text: So it was alway: the cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.

title: Numbers 9:17
text: And whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel encamped.

title: Numbers 9:18
text: At the commandment of Jehovah the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of Jehovah they encamped: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they remained encamped.

title: Numbers 9:19
text: And when the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of Jehovah, and journeyed not.

title: Numbers 9:20
text: And sometimes the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of Jehovah they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of Jehovah they journeyed.

title: Numbers 9:21
text: And sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they journeyed: or [if it continued] by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.

title: Numbers 9:22
text: Whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, abiding thereon, the children of Israel remained encamped, and journeyed not; but when it was taken up, they journeyed.

title: Numbers 9:23
text: At the commandment of Jehovah they encamped, and at the commandment of Jehovah they journeyed: they kept the charge of Jehovah, at the commandment of Jehovah by Moses.

title: Numbers 10:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 10:2
text: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of beaten work shalt thou make them: and thou shalt use them for the calling of the congregation, and for the journeying of the camps.

title: Numbers 10:3
text: And when they shall blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves unto thee at the door of the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 10:4
text: And if they blow but one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.

title: Numbers 10:5
text: And when ye blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall take their journey.

title: Numbers 10:6
text: And when ye blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

title: Numbers 10:7
text: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.

title: Numbers 10:8
text: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets; and they shall be to you for a statute for ever throughout your generations.

title: Numbers 10:9
text: And when ye go to war in your land against the adversary that oppresseth you, then ye shall sound an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before Jehovah your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.

title: Numbers 10:10
text: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow the trumpets over your burnt-offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace-offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Numbers 10:11
text: And it came to pass in the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, that the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the testimony.

title: Numbers 10:12
text: And the children of Israel set forward according to their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud abode in the wilderness of Paran.

title: Numbers 10:13
text: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of Jehovah by Moses.

title: Numbers 10:14
text: And in the first [place] the standard of the camp of the children of Judah set forward according to their hosts: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

title: Numbers 10:15
text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethanel the son of Zuar.

title: Numbers 10:16
text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.

title: Numbers 10:17
text: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bare the tabernacle, set forward.

title: Numbers 10:18
text: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their hosts: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.

title: Numbers 10:19
text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

title: Numbers 10:20
text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

title: Numbers 10:21
text: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and [the others] did set up the tabernacle against their coming.

title: Numbers 10:22
text: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their hosts: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.

title: Numbers 10:23
text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

title: Numbers 10:24
text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.

title: Numbers 10:25
text: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rearward of all the camps, set forward according to their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

title: Numbers 10:26
text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ochran.

title: Numbers 10:27
text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.

title: Numbers 10:28
text: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their hosts; and they set forward.

title: Numbers 10:29
text: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses' father-in-law, We are journeying unto the place of which Jehovah said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good; for Jehovah hath spoken good concerning Israel.

title: Numbers 10:30
text: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.

title: Numbers 10:31
text: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou shalt be to us instead of eyes.

title: Numbers 10:32
text: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what good soever Jehovah shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.

title: Numbers 10:33
text: And they set forward from the mount of Jehovah three days' journey; and the ark of the covenant of Jehovah went before them three days' journey, to seek out a resting-place for them.

title: Numbers 10:34
text: And the cloud of Jehovah was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.

title: Numbers 10:35
text: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, O Jehovah, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.

title: Numbers 10:36
text: And when it rested, he said, Return, O Jehovah, unto the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.

title: Numbers 11:1
text: And the people were as murmurers, [speaking] evil in the ears of Jehovah: and when Jehovah heard it, his anger was kindled; and the fire of Jehovah burnt among them, and devoured in the uttermost part of the camp.

title: Numbers 11:2
text: And the people cried unto Moses; and Moses prayed unto Jehovah, and the fire abated.

title: Numbers 11:3
text: And the name of that place was called Taberah, because the fire of Jehovah burnt among them.

title: Numbers 11:4
text: And the mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?

title: Numbers 11:5
text: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt for nought; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic:

title: Numbers 11:6
text: but now our soul is dried away; there is nothing at all save this manna to look upon.

title: Numbers 11:7
text: And the manna was like coriander seed, and the appearance thereof as the appearance of bdellium.

title: Numbers 11:8
text: The people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.

title: Numbers 11:9
text: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.

title: Numbers 11:10
text: And Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent: and the anger of Jehovah was kindled greatly; and Moses was displeased.

title: Numbers 11:11
text: And Moses said unto Jehovah, Wherefore hast thou dealt ill with thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favor in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?

title: Numbers 11:12
text: Have I conceived all this people? have I brought them forth, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing-father carrieth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?

title: Numbers 11:13
text: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.

title: Numbers 11:14
text: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

title: Numbers 11:15
text: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favor in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.

title: Numbers 11:16
text: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tent of meeting, that they may stand there with thee.

title: Numbers 11:17
text: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the Spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.

title: Numbers 11:18
text: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to-morrow, and ye shall eat flesh; for ye have wept in the ears of Jehovah, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore Jehovah will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.

title: Numbers 11:19
text: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days,

title: Numbers 11:20
text: but a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you; because that ye have rejected Jehovah who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?

title: Numbers 11:21
text: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.

title: Numbers 11:22
text: Shall flocks and herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?

title: Numbers 11:23
text: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Is Jehovah's hand waxed short? now shalt thou see whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.

title: Numbers 11:24
text: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of Jehovah: and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the Tent.

title: Numbers 11:25
text: And Jehovah came down in the cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the Spirit that was upon him, and put it upon the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the Spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.

title: Numbers 11:26
text: But there remained two men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the Spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but had not gone out unto the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.

title: Numbers 11:27
text: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.

title: Numbers 11:28
text: And Joshua the son of Nun, the minister of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.

title: Numbers 11:29
text: And Moses said unto him, Art thou jealous for my sake? would that all Jehovah's people were prophets, that Jehovah would put his Spirit upon them!

title: Numbers 11:30
text: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

title: Numbers 11:31
text: And there went forth a wind from Jehovah, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day's journey on this side, and a day's journey on the other side, round about the camp, and about two cubits above the face of the earth.

title: Numbers 11:32
text: And the people rose up all that day, and all the night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.

title: Numbers 11:33
text: While the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the anger of Jehovah was kindled against the people, and Jehovah smote the people with a very great plague.

title: Numbers 11:34
text: And the name of that place was called Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people that lusted.

title: Numbers 11:35
text: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people journeyed unto Hazeroth; and they abode at Hazeroth.

title: Numbers 12:1
text: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.

title: Numbers 12:2
text: And they said, Hath Jehovah indeed spoken only with Moses? hath he not spoken also with us? And Jehovah heard it.

title: Numbers 12:3
text: Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men that were upon the face of the earth.

title: Numbers 12:4
text: And Jehovah spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tent of meeting. And they three came out.

title: Numbers 12:5
text: And Jehovah came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forth.

title: Numbers 12:6
text: And he said, Hear now my words: if there be a prophet among you, I Jehovah will make myself known unto him in a vision, I will speak with him in a dream.

title: Numbers 12:7
text: My servant Moses is not so; he is faithful in all my house:

title: Numbers 12:8
text: with him will I speak mouth to mouth, even manifestly, and not in dark speeches; and the form of Jehovah shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?

title: Numbers 12:9
text: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against them; and he departed.

title: Numbers 12:10
text: And the cloud removed from over the Tent; and, behold, Miriam was leprous, as [white as] snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.

title: Numbers 12:11
text: And Aaron said unto Moses, Oh, my lord, lay not, I pray thee, sin upon us, for that we have done foolishly, and for that we have sinned.

title: Numbers 12:12
text: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother's womb.

title: Numbers 12:13
text: And Moses cried unto Jehovah, saying, Heal her, O God, I beseech thee.

title: Numbers 12:14
text: And Jehovah said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut up without the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.

title: Numbers 12:15
text: And Miriam was shut up without the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.

title: Numbers 12:16
text: And afterward the people journeyed from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

title: Numbers 13:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 13:2
text: Send thou men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a prince among them.

title: Numbers 13:3
text: And Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Jehovah: all of them men who were heads of the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 13:4
text: And these were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

title: Numbers 13:5
text: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

title: Numbers 13:6
text: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

title: Numbers 13:7
text: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

title: Numbers 13:8
text: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.

title: Numbers 13:9
text: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

title: Numbers 13:10
text: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

title: Numbers 13:11
text: Of the tribe of Joseph, [namely], of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

title: Numbers 13:12
text: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

title: Numbers 13:13
text: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

title: Numbers 13:14
text: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

title: Numbers 13:15
text: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

title: Numbers 13:16
text: These are the names of the men that Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

title: Numbers 13:17
text: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way by the South, and go up into the hill-country:

title: Numbers 13:18
text: and see the land, what it is; and the people that dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;

title: Numbers 13:19
text: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;

title: Numbers 13:20
text: and what the land is, whether it is fat or lean, whether there is wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.

title: Numbers 13:21
text: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.

title: Numbers 13:22
text: And they went up by the South, and came unto Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

title: Numbers 13:23
text: And they came unto the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it upon a staff between two; [they brought] also of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

title: Numbers 13:24
text: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from thence.

title: Numbers 13:25
text: And they returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.

title: Numbers 13:26
text: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.

title: Numbers 13:27
text: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us; and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.

title: Numbers 13:28
text: Howbeit the people that dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified, [and] very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

title: Numbers 13:29
text: Amalek dwelleth in the land of the South: and the Hittite, and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, dwell in the hill-country; and the Canaanite dwelleth by the sea, and along by the side of the Jordan.

title: Numbers 13:30
text: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

title: Numbers 13:31
text: But the men that went up with him said, We are not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.

title: Numbers 13:32
text: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of great stature.

title: Numbers 13:33
text: And there we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come of the Nephilim: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.

title: Numbers 14:1
text: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

title: Numbers 14:2
text: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would that we had died in this wilderness!

title: Numbers 14:3
text: And wherefore doth Jehovah bring us unto this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be a prey: were it not better for us to return into Egypt?

title: Numbers 14:4
text: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.

title: Numbers 14:5
text: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 14:6
text: And Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of them that spied out the land, rent their clothes:

title: Numbers 14:7
text: and they spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceeding good land.

title: Numbers 14:8
text: If Jehovah delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it unto us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.

title: Numbers 14:9
text: Only rebel not against Jehovah, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is removed from over them, and Jehovah is with us: fear them not.

title: Numbers 14:10
text: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of Jehovah appeared in the tent of meeting unto all the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 14:11
text: And Jehovah said unto Moses, How long will this people despise me? and how long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have wrought among them?

title: Numbers 14:12
text: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a nation greater and mightier than they.

title: Numbers 14:13
text: And Moses said unto Jehovah, Then the Egyptians will hear it; for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;

title: Numbers 14:14
text: and they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that thou Jehovah art in the midst of this people; for thou Jehovah art seen face to face, and thy cloud standeth over them, and thou goest before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.

title: Numbers 14:15
text: Now if thou shalt kill this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,

title: Numbers 14:16
text: Because Jehovah was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.

title: Numbers 14:17
text: And now, I pray thee, let the power of the Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,

title: Numbers 14:18
text: Jehovah is slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness, forgiving iniquity and transgression; and that will by no means clear [the guilty], visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, upon the third and upon the fourth generation.

title: Numbers 14:19
text: Pardon, I pray thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy lovingkindness, and according as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.

title: Numbers 14:20
text: And Jehovah said, I have pardoned according to thy word:

title: Numbers 14:21
text: but in very deed, as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the glory of Jehovah;

title: Numbers 14:22
text: because all those men that have seen my glory, and my signs, which I wrought in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;

title: Numbers 14:23
text: surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that despised me see it:

title: Numbers 14:24
text: but my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.

title: Numbers 14:25
text: Now the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley: to-morrow turn ye, and get you into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.

title: Numbers 14:26
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

title: Numbers 14:27
text: How long [shall I bear] with this evil congregation, that murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.

title: Numbers 14:28
text: Say unto them, As I live, saith Jehovah, surely as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:

title: Numbers 14:29
text: your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, that have murmured against me,

title: Numbers 14:30
text: surely ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware that I would make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

title: Numbers 14:31
text: But your little ones, that ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have rejected.

title: Numbers 14:32
text: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.

title: Numbers 14:33
text: And your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your whoredoms, until your dead bodies be consumed in the wilderness.

title: Numbers 14:34
text: After the number of the days in which ye spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my alienation.

title: Numbers 14:35
text: I, Jehovah, have spoken, surely this will I do unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.

title: Numbers 14:36
text: And the men, whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up an evil report against the land,

title: Numbers 14:37
text: even those men that did bring up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Jehovah.

title: Numbers 14:38
text: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, remained alive of those men that went to spy out the land.

title: Numbers 14:39
text: And Moses told these words unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.

title: Numbers 14:40
text: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up to the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we are here, and will go up unto the place which Jehovah hath promised: for we have sinned.

title: Numbers 14:41
text: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of Jehovah, seeing it shall not prosper?

title: Numbers 14:42
text: Go not up, for Jehovah is not among you; that ye be not smitten down before your enemies.

title: Numbers 14:43
text: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned back from following Jehovah, therefore Jehovah will not be with you.

title: Numbers 14:44
text: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.

title: Numbers 14:45
text: Then the Amalekite came down, and the Canaanite who dwelt in that mountain, and smote them and beat them down, even unto Hormah.

title: Numbers 15:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 15:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,

title: Numbers 15:3
text: and will make an offering by fire unto Jehovah, a burnt-offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a freewill-offering, or in your set feasts, to make a sweet savor unto Jehovah, of the herd, or of the flock;

title: Numbers 15:4
text: then shall he that offereth his oblation offer unto Jehovah a meal-offering of a tenth part [of an ephah] of fine flour mingled with the fourth part of a hin of oil:

title: Numbers 15:5
text: and wine for the drink-offering, the fourth part of a hin, shalt thou prepare with the burnt-offering, or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.

title: Numbers 15:6
text: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meal-offering two tenth parts [of an ephah] of fine flour mingled with the third part of a hin of oil:

title: Numbers 15:7
text: and for the drink-offering thou shalt offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

title: Numbers 15:8
text: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt-offering, or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace-offerings unto Jehovah;

title: Numbers 15:9
text: then shall he offer with the bullock a meal-offering of three tenth parts [of an ephah] of fine flour mingled with half a hin of oil:

title: Numbers 15:10
text: and thou shalt offer for the drink-offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

title: Numbers 15:11
text: Thus shall it be done for each bullock, or for each ram, or for each of the he-lambs, or of the kids.

title: Numbers 15:12
text: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.

title: Numbers 15:13
text: All that are home-born shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

title: Numbers 15:14
text: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah; as ye do, so he shall do.

title: Numbers 15:15
text: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth [with you], a statute for ever throughout your generations: as ye are, so shall the sojourner be before Jehovah.

title: Numbers 15:16
text: One law and one ordinance shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.

title: Numbers 15:17
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 15:18
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,

title: Numbers 15:19
text: then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up a heave-offering unto Jehovah.

title: Numbers 15:20
text: Of the first of your dough ye shall offer up a cake for a heave-offering: as the heave-offering of the threshing-floor, so shall ye heave it.

title: Numbers 15:21
text: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto Jehovah a heave-offering throughout your generations.

title: Numbers 15:22
text: And when ye shall err, and not observe all these commandments, which Jehovah hath spoken unto Moses,

title: Numbers 15:23
text: even all that Jehovah hath commanded you by Moses, from the day that Jehovah gave commandment, and onward throughout your generations;

title: Numbers 15:24
text: then it shall be, if it be done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt-offering, for a sweet savor unto Jehovah, with the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof, according to the ordinance, and one he-goat for a sin-offering.

title: Numbers 15:25
text: And the priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their oblation, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah, and their sin-offering before Jehovah, for their error:

title: Numbers 15:26
text: and all the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; for in respect of all the people it was done unwittingly.

title: Numbers 15:27
text: And if one person sin unwittingly, then he shall offer a she-goat a year old for a sin-offering.

title: Numbers 15:28
text: And the priest shall make atonement for the soul that erreth, when he sinneth unwittingly, before Jehovah, to make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.

title: Numbers 15:29
text: Ye shall have one law for him that doeth aught unwittingly, for him that is home-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.

title: Numbers 15:30
text: But the soul that doeth aught with a high hand, whether he be home-born or a sojourner, the same blasphemeth Jehovah; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

title: Numbers 15:31
text: Because he hath despised the word of Jehovah, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.

title: Numbers 15:32
text: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks upon the sabbath day.

title: Numbers 15:33
text: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.

title: Numbers 15:34
text: And they put him in ward, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.

title: Numbers 15:35
text: And Jehovah said unto Moses, The man shall surely be put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.

title: Numbers 15:36
text: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him to death with stones; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 15:37
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 15:38
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of each border a cord of blue:

title: Numbers 15:39
text: and it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of Jehovah, and do them; and that ye follow not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to play the harlot;

title: Numbers 15:40
text: that ye may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.

title: Numbers 15:41
text: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Numbers 16:1
text: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took [men] :

title: Numbers 16:2
text: and they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown;

title: Numbers 16:3
text: and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and Jehovah is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the assembly of Jehovah?

title: Numbers 16:4
text: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:

title: Numbers 16:5
text: and he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, In the morning Jehovah will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he shall choose will he cause to come near unto him.

title: Numbers 16:6
text: This do: take you censers, Korah, and all his company;

title: Numbers 16:7
text: and put fire in them, and put incense upon them before Jehovah to-morrow: and it shall be that the man whom Jehovah doth choose, he [shall be] holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.

title: Numbers 16:8
text: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear now, ye sons of Levi:

title: Numbers 16:9
text: [ seemeth it but] a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of the tabernacle of Jehovah, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them;

title: Numbers 16:10
text: and that he hath brought thee near, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee? and seek ye the priesthood also?

title: Numbers 16:11
text: Therefore thou and all thy company are gathered together against Jehovah: and Aaron, what is he that ye murmur against him?

title: Numbers 16:12
text: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, We will not come up:

title: Numbers 16:13
text: is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but thou must needs make thyself also a prince over us?

title: Numbers 16:14
text: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.

title: Numbers 16:15
text: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto Jehovah, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.

title: Numbers 16:16
text: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before Jehovah, thou, and they, and Aaron, to-morrow:

title: Numbers 16:17
text: and take ye every man his censer, and put incense upon them, and bring ye before Jehovah every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each his censer.

title: Numbers 16:18
text: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood at the door of the tent of meeting with Moses and Aaron.

title: Numbers 16:19
text: And Korah assembled all the congregation against them unto the door of the tent of meeting: and the glory of Jehovah appeared unto all the congregation.

title: Numbers 16:20
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

title: Numbers 16:21
text: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.

title: Numbers 16:22
text: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?

title: Numbers 16:23
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 16:24
text: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

title: Numbers 16:25
text: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

title: Numbers 16:26
text: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.

title: Numbers 16:27
text: So they gat them up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little ones.

title: Numbers 16:28
text: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that Jehovah hath sent me to do all these works; for [I have] not [done them] of mine own mind.

title: Numbers 16:29
text: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then Jehovah hath not sent me.

title: Numbers 16:30
text: But if Jehovah make a new thing, and the ground open its mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down alive into Sheol; then ye shall understand that these men have despised Jehovah.

title: Numbers 16:31
text: And it came to pass, as he made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them;

title: Numbers 16:32
text: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.

title: Numbers 16:33
text: So they, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into Sheol: and the earth closed upon them, and they perished from among the assembly.

title: Numbers 16:34
text: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them; for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up.

title: Numbers 16:35
text: And fire came forth from Jehovah, and devoured the two hundred and fifty men that offered the incense.

title: Numbers 16:36
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 16:37
text: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are holy,

title: Numbers 16:38
text: even the censers of these sinners against their own lives; and let them be made beaten plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before Jehovah; therefore they are holy; and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 16:39
text: And Eleazar the priest took the brazen censers, which they that were burnt had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,

title: Numbers 16:40
text: to be a memorial unto the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger, that is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to burn incense before Jehovah; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as Jehovah spake unto him by Moses.

title: Numbers 16:41
text: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of Jehovah.

title: Numbers 16:42
text: And it came to pass, when the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tent of meeting: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of Jehovah appeared.

title: Numbers 16:43
text: And Moses and Aaron came to the front of the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 16:44
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 16:45
text: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.

title: Numbers 16:46
text: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take thy censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and lay incense thereon, and carry it quickly unto the congregation, and make atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from Jehovah; the plague is begun.

title: Numbers 16:47
text: And Aaron took as Moses spake, and ran into the midst of the assembly; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.

title: Numbers 16:48
text: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

title: Numbers 16:49
text: Now they that died by the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, besides them that died about the matter of Korah.

title: Numbers 16:50
text: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tent of meeting: and the plague was stayed.

title: Numbers 17:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 17:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of them rods, one for each fathers' house, of all their princes according to their fathers' houses, twelve rods: write thou every man's name upon his rod.

title: Numbers 17:3
text: And thou shalt write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi; for there shall be one rod for each head of their fathers' houses.

title: Numbers 17:4
text: And thou shalt lay them up in the tent of meeting before the testimony, where I meet with you.

title: Numbers 17:5
text: And it shall come to pass, that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you.

title: Numbers 17:6
text: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers' houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.

title: Numbers 17:7
text: And Moses laid up the rods before Jehovah in the tent of the testimony.

title: Numbers 17:8
text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses went into the tent of the testimony; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and put forth buds, and produced blossoms, and bare ripe almonds.

title: Numbers 17:9
text: And Moses brought out all the rods from before Jehovah unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.

title: Numbers 17:10
text: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Put back the rod of Aaron before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that thou mayest make an end of their murmurings against me, that they die not.

title: Numbers 17:11
text: Thus did Moses: as Jehovah commanded him, so did he.

title: Numbers 17:12
text: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we perish, we are undone, we are all undone.

title: Numbers 17:13
text: Every one that cometh near, that cometh near unto the tabernacle of Jehovah, dieth: shall we perish all of us?

title: Numbers 18:1
text: And Jehovah said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy fathers' house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

title: Numbers 18:2
text: And thy brethren also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou near with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall be before the tent of the testimony.

title: Numbers 18:3
text: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the Tent: only they shall not come nigh unto the vessels of the sanctuary and unto the altar, that they die not, neither they, nor ye.

title: Numbers 18:4
text: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tent of meeting, for all the service of the Tent: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.

title: Numbers 18:5
text: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar; that there be wrath no more upon the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 18:6
text: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are a gift, given unto Jehovah, to do the service of the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 18:7
text: And thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil; and ye shall serve: I give you the priesthood as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

title: Numbers 18:8
text: And Jehovah spake unto Aaron, And I, behold, I have given thee the charge of my heave-offerings, even all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, as a portion for ever.

title: Numbers 18:9
text: This shall be thine of the most holy things, [reserved] from the fire: every oblation of theirs, even every meal-offering of theirs, and every sin-offering of theirs, and every trespass-offering of theirs, which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.

title: Numbers 18:10
text: As the most holy things shalt thou eat thereof; every male shall eat thereof: it shall be holy unto thee.

title: Numbers 18:11
text: And this is thine: the heave-offering of their gift, even all the wave-offerings of the children of Israel; I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, as a portion for ever; every one that is clean in thy house shall eat thereof.

title: Numbers 18:12
text: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first-fruits of them which they give unto Jehovah, to thee have I given them.

title: Numbers 18:13
text: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring unto Jehovah, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thy house shall eat thereof.

title: Numbers 18:14
text: Everything devoted in Israel shall be thine.

title: Numbers 18:15
text: Everything that openeth the womb, of all flesh which they offer unto Jehovah, both of man and beast shall be thine: nevertheless the first-born of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.

title: Numbers 18:16
text: And those that are to be redeemed of them from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary (the same is twenty gerahs).

title: Numbers 18:17
text: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

title: Numbers 18:18
text: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave-breast and as the right thigh, it shall be thine.

title: Numbers 18:19
text: All the heave-offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto Jehovah, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, as a portion for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before Jehovah unto thee and to thy seed with thee.

title: Numbers 18:20
text: And Jehovah said unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any portion among them: I am thy portion and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 18:21
text: And unto the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service which they serve, even the service of the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 18:22
text: And henceforth the children of Israel shall not come nigh the tent of meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.

title: Numbers 18:23
text: But the Levites shall do the service of the tent of meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations; and among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

title: Numbers 18:24
text: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they offer as a heave-offering unto Jehovah, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

title: Numbers 18:25
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 18:26
text: Moreover thou shalt speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up a heave-offering of it for Jehovah, a tithe of the tithe.

title: Numbers 18:27
text: And your heave-offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the grain of the threshing-floor, and as the fulness of the winepress.

title: Numbers 18:28
text: Thus ye also shall offer a heave-offering unto Jehovah of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and thereof ye shall give Jehovah's heave-offering to Aaron the priest.

title: Numbers 18:29
text: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave-offering of Jehovah, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.

title: Numbers 18:30
text: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye heave the best thereof from it, then it shall be reckoned unto the Levites as the increase of the threshing-floor, and as the increase of the wine-press.

title: Numbers 18:31
text: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward in return for your service in the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 18:32
text: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best thereof: and ye shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that ye die not.

title: Numbers 19:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

title: Numbers 19:2
text: This is the statute of the law which Jehovah hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, [and] upon which never came yoke.

title: Numbers 19:3
text: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:

title: Numbers 19:4
text: and Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the tent of meeting seven times.

title: Numbers 19:5
text: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:

title: Numbers 19:6
text: and the priest shall take cedar-wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

title: Numbers 19:7
text: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.

title: Numbers 19:8
text: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.

title: Numbers 19:9
text: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water for impurity: it is a sin-offering.

title: Numbers 19:10
text: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.

title: Numbers 19:11
text: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days:

title: Numbers 19:12
text: the same shall purify himself therewith on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

title: Numbers 19:13
text: Whosoever toucheth a dead person, the body of a man that hath died, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of Jehovah; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water for impurity was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.

title: Numbers 19:14
text: This is the law when a man dieth in a tent: every one that cometh into the tent, and every one that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

title: Numbers 19:15
text: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.

title: Numbers 19:16
text: And whosoever in the open field toucheth one that is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

title: Numbers 19:17
text: And for the unclean they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin-offering; and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:

title: Numbers 19:18
text: and a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave:

title: Numbers 19:19
text: and the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify him; and he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.

title: Numbers 19:20
text: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from the midst of the assembly, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of Jehovah: the water for impurity hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.

title: Numbers 19:21
text: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them: and he that sprinkleth the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he that toucheth the water for impurity shall be unclean until even.

title: Numbers 19:22
text: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.

title: Numbers 20:1
text: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.

title: Numbers 20:2
text: And there was no water for the congregation: and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

title: Numbers 20:3
text: And the people strove with Moses, and spake, saying, Would that we had died when our brethren died before Jehovah!

title: Numbers 20:4
text: And why have ye brought the assembly of Jehovah into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our beasts?

title: Numbers 20:5
text: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.

title: Numbers 20:6
text: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tent of meeting, and fell upon their faces: and the glory of Jehovah appeared unto them.

title: Numbers 20:7
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 20:8
text: Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes, that it give forth its water; and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock; so thou shalt give the congregation and their cattle drink.

title: Numbers 20:9
text: And Moses took the rod from before Jehovah, as he commanded him.

title: Numbers 20:10
text: And Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; shall we bring you forth water out of this rock?

title: Numbers 20:11
text: And Moses lifted up his hand, and smote the rock with his rod twice: and water came forth abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their cattle.

title: Numbers 20:12
text: And Jehovah said unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed not in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.

title: Numbers 20:13
text: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with Jehovah, and he was sanctified in them.

title: Numbers 20:14
text: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:

title: Numbers 20:15
text: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians dealt ill with us, and our fathers:

title: Numbers 20:16
text: and when we cried unto Jehovah, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border.

title: Numbers 20:17
text: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy land: we will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go along the king's highway; we will not turn aside to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy border.

title: Numbers 20:18
text: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against thee.

title: Numbers 20:19
text: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go up by the highway; and if we drink of thy water, I and my cattle, then will I give the price thereof: let me only, without [doing] anything [else], pass through on my feet.

title: Numbers 20:20
text: And he said, Thou shalt not pass through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.

title: Numbers 20:21
text: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.

title: Numbers 20:22
text: And they journeyed from Kadesh: and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came unto mount Hor.

title: Numbers 20:23
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,

title: Numbers 20:24
text: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.

title: Numbers 20:25
text: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor;

title: Numbers 20:26
text: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered [unto his people], and shall die there.

title: Numbers 20:27
text: And Moses did as Jehovah commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

title: Numbers 20:28
text: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there on the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.

title: Numbers 20:29
text: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

title: Numbers 21:1
text: And the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who dwelt in the South, heard tell that Israel came by the way of Atharim; and he fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.

title: Numbers 21:2
text: And Israel vowed a vow unto Jehovah, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.

title: Numbers 21:3
text: And Jehovah hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and the name of the place was called Hormah.

title: Numbers 21:4
text: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.

title: Numbers 21:5
text: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, and there is no water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.

title: Numbers 21:6
text: And Jehovah sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.

title: Numbers 21:7
text: And the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, because we have spoken against Jehovah, and against thee; pray unto Jehovah, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.

title: Numbers 21:8
text: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a standard: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he seeth it, shall live.

title: Numbers 21:9
text: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and set it upon the standard: and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked unto the serpent of brass, he lived.

title: Numbers 21:10
text: And the children of Israel journeyed, and encamped in Oboth.

title: Numbers 21:11
text: And they journeyed from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.

title: Numbers 21:12
text: From thence they journeyed, and encamped in the valley of Zered.

title: Numbers 21:13
text: From thence they journeyed, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness, that cometh out of the border of the Amorites: for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

title: Numbers 21:14
text: Wherefore it is said in the book of the Wars of Jehovah, Vaheb in Suphah, And the valleys of the Arnon,

title: Numbers 21:15
text: And the slope of the valleys That inclineth toward the dwelling of Ar, And leaneth upon the border of Moab.

title: Numbers 21:16
text: And from thence [they journeyed] to Beer: that is the well whereof Jehovah said unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.

title: Numbers 21:17
text: Then sang Israel this song: Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:

title: Numbers 21:18
text: The well, which the princes digged, Which the nobles of the people delved, With the sceptre, [and] with their staves. And from the wilderness [they journeyed] to Mattanah;

title: Numbers 21:19
text: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;

title: Numbers 21:20
text: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh down upon the desert.

title: Numbers 21:21
text: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

title: Numbers 21:22
text: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn aside into field, or into vineyard; we will not drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king's highway, until we have passed thy border.

title: Numbers 21:23
text: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz; and he fought against Israel.

title: Numbers 21:24
text: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon unto the Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.

title: Numbers 21:25
text: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the towns thereof.

title: Numbers 21:26
text: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto the Arnon.

title: Numbers 21:27
text: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come ye to Heshbon; Let the city of Sihon be built and established:

title: Numbers 21:28
text: For a fire is gone out of Heshbon, A flame from the city of Sihon: It hath devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.

title: Numbers 21:29
text: Woe to thee, Moab! Thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: He hath given his sons as fugitives, And his daughters into captivity, Unto Sihon king of the Amorites.

title: Numbers 21:30
text: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, And we have laid waste even unto Nophah, Which [reacheth] unto Medeba.

title: Numbers 21:31
text: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.

title: Numbers 21:32
text: And Moses sent to spy out Jazer; and they took the towns thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.

title: Numbers 21:33
text: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

title: Numbers 21:34
text: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon.

title: Numbers 21:35
text: So they smote him, and his sons and all his people, until there was none left him remaining: and they possessed his land.

title: Numbers 22:1
text: And the children of Israel journeyed, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.

title: Numbers 22:2
text: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

title: Numbers 22:3
text: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 22:4
text: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now will this multitude lick up all that is round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.

title: Numbers 22:5
text: And he sent messengers unto Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the [ face of the earth, and they abide over against me.

title: Numbers 22:6
text: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.

title: Numbers 22:7
text: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.

title: Numbers 22:8
text: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as Jehovah shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.

title: Numbers 22:9
text: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?

title: Numbers 22:10
text: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, [saying] ,

title: Numbers 22:11
text: Behold, the people that is come out of Egypt, it covereth the face of the earth: now, come curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to fight against them, and shall drive them out.

title: Numbers 22:12
text: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people; for they are blessed.

title: Numbers 22:13
text: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land; for Jehovah refuseth to give me leave to go with you.

title: Numbers 22:14
text: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.

title: Numbers 22:15
text: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honorable than they.

title: Numbers 22:16
text: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:

title: Numbers 22:17
text: for I will promote thee unto very great honor, and whatsoever thou sayest unto me I will do: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.

title: Numbers 22:18
text: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of Jehovah my God, to do less or more.

title: Numbers 22:19
text: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what Jehovah will speak unto me more.

title: Numbers 22:20
text: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men are come to call thee, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak unto thee, that shalt thou do.

title: Numbers 22:21
text: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.

title: Numbers 22:22
text: And God's anger was kindled because he went; and the angel of Jehovah placed himself in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.

title: Numbers 22:23
text: And the ass saw the angel of Jehovah standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.

title: Numbers 22:24
text: Then the angel of Jehovah stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

title: Numbers 22:25
text: And the ass saw the angel of Jehovah, and she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.

title: Numbers 22:26
text: And the angel of Jehovah went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

title: Numbers 22:27
text: And the ass saw the angel of Jehovah, and she lay down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with his staff.

title: Numbers 22:28
text: And Jehovah opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?

title: Numbers 22:29
text: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me, I would there were a sword in my hand, for now I had killed thee.

title: Numbers 22:30
text: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden all thy life long unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? and he said, Nay.

title: Numbers 22:31
text: Then Jehovah opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of Jehovah standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.

title: Numbers 22:32
text: And the angel of Jehovah said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I am come forth for an adversary, because thy way is perverse before me:

title: Numbers 22:33
text: and the ass saw me, and turned aside before me these three times: unless she had turned aside from me, surely now I had even slain thee, and saved her alive.

title: Numbers 22:34
text: And Balaam said unto the angel of Jehovah, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.

title: Numbers 22:35
text: And the angel of Jehovah said unto Balaam, Go with the men; but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

title: Numbers 22:36
text: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.

title: Numbers 22:37
text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honor?

title: Numbers 22:38
text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to speak anything? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.

title: Numbers 22:39
text: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kiriath-huzoth.

title: Numbers 22:40
text: And Balak sacrificed oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.

title: Numbers 22:41
text: And it came to pass in the morning, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from thence the utmost part of the people.

title: Numbers 23:1
text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.

title: Numbers 23:2
text: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.

title: Numbers 23:3
text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt-offering, and I will go: peradventure Jehovah will come to meet me; and whatsoever he showeth me I will tell thee. And he went to a bare height.

title: Numbers 23:4
