text: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bullock and a ram on every altar.

title: Numbers 23:5
text: And Jehovah put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.

title: Numbers 23:6
text: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he was standing by his burnt-offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.

title: Numbers 23:7
text: And he took up his parable, and said, From Aram hath Balak brought me, The king of Moab from the mountains of the East: Come, curse me Jacob, And come, defy Israel.

title: Numbers 23:8
text: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? And how shall I defy, whom Jehovah hath not defied?

title: Numbers 23:9
text: For from the top of the rocks I see him, And from the hills I behold him: lo, it is a people that dwelleth alone, And shall not be reckoned among the nations.

title: Numbers 23:10
text: Who can count the dust of Jacob, Or number the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, And let my last end be like his!

title: Numbers 23:11
text: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.

title: Numbers 23:12
text: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which Jehovah putteth in my mouth?

title: Numbers 23:13
text: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them; thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.

title: Numbers 23:14
text: And he took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bullock and a ram on every altar.

title: Numbers 23:15
text: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt-offering, while I meet [Jehovah] yonder.

title: Numbers 23:16
text: And Jehovah met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus shalt thou speak.

title: Numbers 23:17
text: And he came to him, and, lo, he was standing by his burnt-offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath Jehovah spoken?

title: Numbers 23:18
text: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; Hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:

title: Numbers 23:19
text: God is not a man, that he should lie, Neither the son of man, that he should repent: Hath he said, and will he not do it? Or hath he spoken, and will he not make it good?

title: Numbers 23:20
text: Behold, I have received [commandment] to bless: And he hath blessed, and I cannot reverse it.

title: Numbers 23:21
text: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob; Neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: Jehovah his God is with him, And the shout of a king is among them.

title: Numbers 23:22
text: God bringeth them forth out of Egypt; He hath as it were the strength of the wild-ox.

title: Numbers 23:23
text: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; Neither is there any divination with Israel: Now shalt it be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!

title: Numbers 23:24
text: Behold, the people riseth up as a lioness, And as a lion doth he lift himself up: He shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, And drink the blood of the slain.

title: Numbers 23:25
text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.

title: Numbers 23:26
text: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that Jehovah speaketh, that I must do?

title: Numbers 23:27
text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come now, I will take thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.

title: Numbers 23:28
text: And Balak took Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh down upon the desert.

title: Numbers 23:29
text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.

title: Numbers 23:30
text: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bullock and a ram on every altar.

title: Numbers 24:1
text: And when Balaam saw that it pleased Jehovah to bless Israel, he went not, as at the other times, to meet with enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

title: Numbers 24:2
text: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came upon him.

title: Numbers 24:3
text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor saith, And the man whose eye was closed saith;

title: Numbers 24:4
text: He saith, who heareth the words of God, Who seeth the vision of the Almighty, Falling down, and having his eyes open:

title: Numbers 24:5
text: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, Thy tabernacles, O Israel!

title: Numbers 24:6
text: As valleys are they spread forth, As gardens by the river-side, As lign-aloes which Jehovah hath planted, As cedar-trees beside the waters.

title: Numbers 24:7
text: Water shall flow from his buckets, And his seed shall be in many waters, And his king shall be higher than Agag, And his kingdom shall be exalted.

title: Numbers 24:8
text: God bringeth him forth out of Egypt; He hath as it were the strength of the wild-ox: He shall eat up the nations his adversaries, And shall break their bones in pieces, And smite [them] through with his arrows.

title: Numbers 24:9
text: He couched, he lay down as a lion, And as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Blessed be every one that blesseth thee, And cursed be every one that curseth thee.

title: Numbers 24:10
text: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together; and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.

title: Numbers 24:11
text: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honor; but, lo, Jehovah hath kept thee back from honor.

title: Numbers 24:12
text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers that thou sentest unto me, saying,

title: Numbers 24:13
text: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of Jehovah, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; what Jehovah speaketh, that will I speak?

title: Numbers 24:14
text: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come, [and] I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.

title: Numbers 24:15
text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor saith, And the man whose eye was closed saith;

title: Numbers 24:16
text: He saith, who heareth the words of God, And knoweth the knowledge of the Most High, Who seeth the vision of the Almighty, Falling down, and having his eyes open:

title: Numbers 24:17
text: I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not nigh: There shall come forth a star out of Jacob, And a sceptre shall rise out of Israel, And shall smite through the corners of Moab, And break down all the sons of tumult.

title: Numbers 24:18
text: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession, [who were] his enemies; While Israel doeth valiantly.

title: Numbers 24:19
text: And out of Jacob shall one have dominion, And shall destroy the remnant from the city.

title: Numbers 24:20
text: And he looked on Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; But his latter end shall come to destruction.

title: Numbers 24:21
text: And he looked on the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwelling-place, And thy nest is set in the rock.

title: Numbers 24:22
text: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, Until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.

title: Numbers 24:23
text: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this?

title: Numbers 24:24
text: But ships [shall come] from the coast of Kittim, And they shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber; And he also shall come to destruction.

title: Numbers 24:25
text: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.

title: Numbers 25:1
text: And Israel abode in Shittim; and the people began to play the harlot with the daughters of Moab:

title: Numbers 25:2
text: for they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods; and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.

title: Numbers 25:3
text: And Israel joined himself unto Baal-peor: and the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel.

title: Numbers 25:4
text: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up unto Jehovah before the sun, that the fierce anger of Jehovah may turn away from Israel.

title: Numbers 25:5
text: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that have joined themselves unto Baal-peor.

title: Numbers 25:6
text: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 25:7
text: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the midst of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand;

title: Numbers 25:8
text: and he went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel. [

title: Numbers 25:9
text: And those that died by the plague were twenty and four thousand.

title: Numbers 25:10
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 25:11
text: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.

title: Numbers 25:12
text: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:

title: Numbers 25:13
text: and it shall be unto him, and to his seed after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 25:14
text: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers' house among the Simeonites.

title: Numbers 25:15
text: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head of the people of a fathers' house in Midian.

title: Numbers 25:16
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 25:17
text: Vex the Midianites, and smite them;

title: Numbers 25:18
text: for they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.

title: Numbers 26:1
text: And it came to pass after the plague, that Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

title: Numbers 26:2
text: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers' houses, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel.

title: Numbers 26:3
text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

title: Numbers 26:4
text: [ Take the sum of the people], from twenty years old and upward; as Jehovah commanded Moses and the children of Israel, that came forth out of the land of Egypt.

title: Numbers 26:5
text: Reuben, the first-born of Israel; the sons of Reuben: [of] Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;

title: Numbers 26:6
text: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

title: Numbers 26:7
text: These are the families of the Reubenites; and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.

title: Numbers 26:8
text: And the sons of Pallu: Eliab.

title: Numbers 26:9
text: And the sons of Eliab: Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram, who were called of the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against Jehovah,

title: Numbers 26:10
text: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died; what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men, and they became a sign.

title: Numbers 26:11
text: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah died not.

title: Numbers 26:12
text: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;

title: Numbers 26:13
text: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

title: Numbers 26:14
text: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.

title: Numbers 26:15
text: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;

title: Numbers 26:16
text: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;

title: Numbers 26:17
text: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

title: Numbers 26:18
text: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

title: Numbers 26:19
text: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan; and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

title: Numbers 26:20
text: And the sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

title: Numbers 26:21
text: And the sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

title: Numbers 26:22
text: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.

title: Numbers 26:23
text: The sons of Issachar after their families: [of] Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;

title: Numbers 26:24
text: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

title: Numbers 26:25
text: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.

title: Numbers 26:26
text: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

title: Numbers 26:27
text: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.

title: Numbers 26:28
text: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

title: Numbers 26:29
text: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir begat Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

title: Numbers 26:30
text: These are the sons of Gilead: [of] Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;

title: Numbers 26:31
text: and [of] Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and [of] Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

title: Numbers 26:32
text: and [of] Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and [of] Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

title: Numbers 26:33
text: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

title: Numbers 26:34
text: These are the families of Manasseh; and they that were numbered of them were fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.

title: Numbers 26:35
text: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

title: Numbers 26:36
text: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

title: Numbers 26:37
text: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

title: Numbers 26:38
text: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;

title: Numbers 26:39
text: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

title: Numbers 26:40
text: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: [of Ard], the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

title: Numbers 26:41
text: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.

title: Numbers 26:42
text: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

title: Numbers 26:43
text: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.

title: Numbers 26:44
text: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.

title: Numbers 26:45
text: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

title: Numbers 26:46
text: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

title: Numbers 26:47
text: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them, fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

title: Numbers 26:48
text: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;

title: Numbers 26:49
text: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

title: Numbers 26:50
text: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.

title: Numbers 26:51
text: These are they that were numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.

title: Numbers 26:52
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 26:53
text: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

title: Numbers 26:54
text: To the more thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to the fewer thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one according to those that were numbered of him shall his inheritance be given.

title: Numbers 26:55
text: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

title: Numbers 26:56
text: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.

title: Numbers 26:57
text: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

title: Numbers 26:58
text: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korahites. And Kohath begat Amram.

title: Numbers 26:59
text: And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

title: Numbers 26:60
text: And unto Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

title: Numbers 26:61
text: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before Jehovah.

title: Numbers 26:62
text: And they that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, every male from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 26:63
text: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

title: Numbers 26:64
text: But among these there was not a man of them that were numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

title: Numbers 26:65
text: For Jehovah had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

title: Numbers 27:1
text: Then drew near the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

title: Numbers 27:2
text: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the tent of meeting, saying,

title: Numbers 27:3
text: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not among the company of them that gathered themselves together against Jehovah in the company of Korah: but he died in his own sin; and he had no sons.

title: Numbers 27:4
text: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give unto us a possession among the brethren of our father.

title: Numbers 27:5
text: And Moses brought their cause before Jehovah.

title: Numbers 27:6
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 27:7
text: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.

title: Numbers 27:8
text: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.

title: Numbers 27:9
text: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.

title: Numbers 27:10
text: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.

title: Numbers 27:11
text: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute [and] ordinance, as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 27:12
text: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mountain of Abarim, and behold the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 27:13
text: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered;

title: Numbers 27:14
text: because ye rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the waters before their eyes. (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

title: Numbers 27:15
text: And Moses spake unto Jehovah, saying,

title: Numbers 27:16
text: Let Jehovah, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,

title: Numbers 27:17
text: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in; that the congregation of Jehovah be not as sheep which have no shepherd.

title: Numbers 27:18
text: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay thy hand upon him;

title: Numbers 27:19
text: and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.

title: Numbers 27:20
text: And thou shalt put of thine honor upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.

title: Numbers 27:21
text: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before Jehovah: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.

title: Numbers 27:22
text: And Moses did as Jehovah commanded him; and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:

title: Numbers 27:23
text: and he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as Jehovah spake by Moses.

title: Numbers 28:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 28:2
text: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My oblation, my food for my offerings made by fire, of a sweet savor unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.

title: Numbers 28:3
text: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto Jehovah: he-lambs a year old without blemish, two day by day, for a continual burnt-offering.

title: Numbers 28:4
text: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;

title: Numbers 28:5
text: and the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.

title: Numbers 28:6
text: It is a continual burnt-offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savor, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

title: Numbers 28:7
text: And the drink-offering thereof shall be the fourth part of a hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou pour out a drink-offering of strong drink unto Jehovah.

title: Numbers 28:8
text: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meal-offering of the morning, and as the drink-offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

title: Numbers 28:9
text: And on the sabbath day two he-lambs a year old without blemish, and two tenth parts [of an ephah] of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, and the drink-offering thereof:

title: Numbers 28:10
text: this is the burnt-offering of every sabbath, besides the continual burnt-offering, and the drink-offering thereof.

title: Numbers 28:11
text: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt-offering unto Jehovah: two young bullocks, and one ram, seven he-lambs a year old without blemish;

title: Numbers 28:12
text: and three tenth parts [of an ephah] of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, for each bullock; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, for the one ram;

title: Numbers 28:13
text: and a tenth part of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal-offering unto every lamb; for a burnt-offering of a sweet savor, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

title: Numbers 28:14
text: And their drink-offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bullock, and the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb: this is the burnt-offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

title: Numbers 28:15
text: And one he-goat for a sin-offering unto Jehovah; it shall be offered besides the continual burnt-offering, and the drink-offering thereof.

title: Numbers 28:16
text: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Jehovah's passover.

title: Numbers 28:17
text: And on the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

title: Numbers 28:18
text: In the first day shall be a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work;

title: Numbers 28:19
text: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt-offering unto Jehovah: two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven he-lambs a year old; they shall be unto you without blemish;

title: Numbers 28:20
text: and their meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil: three tenth parts shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth parts for the ram;

title: Numbers 28:21
text: a tenth part shalt thou offer for every lamb of the seven lambs;

title: Numbers 28:22
text: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, to make atonement for you.

title: Numbers 28:23
text: Ye shall offer these besides the burnt-offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt-offering.

title: Numbers 28:24
text: After this manner ye shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah: it shall be offered besides the continual burnt-offering, and the drink-offering thereof.

title: Numbers 28:25
text: And on the seventh day ye shall have a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work.

title: Numbers 28:26
text: Also in the day of the first-fruits, when ye offer a new meal-offering unto Jehovah in your [feast of] weeks, ye shall have a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work;

title: Numbers 28:27
text: but ye shall offer a burnt-offering for a sweet savor unto Jehovah: two young bullocks, one ram, seven he-lambs a year old;

title: Numbers 28:28
text: and their meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for each bullock, two tenth parts for the one ram,

title: Numbers 28:29
text: a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;

title: Numbers 28:30
text: one he-goat, to make atonement for you.

title: Numbers 28:31
text: Besides the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, ye shall offer them (they shall be unto you without blemish), and their drink-offerings.

title: Numbers 29:1
text: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing of trumpets unto you.

title: Numbers 29:2
text: And ye shall offer a burnt-offering for a sweet savor unto Jehovah: one young bullock, one ram, seven he-lambs a year old without blemish;

title: Numbers 29:3
text: and their meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for the bullock, two tenth parts for the ram,

title: Numbers 29:4
text: and one tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;

title: Numbers 29:5
text: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, to make atonement for you;

title: Numbers 29:6
text: besides the burnt-offering of the new moon, and the meal-offering thereof, and the continual burnt-offering and the meal-offering thereof, and their drink-offerings, according unto their ordinance, for a sweet savor, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

title: Numbers 29:7
text: And on the tenth day of this seventh month ye shall have a holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: ye shall do no manner of work;

title: Numbers 29:8
text: but ye shall offer a burnt-offering unto Jehovah for a sweet savor: one young bullock, one ram, seven he-lambs a year old; they shall be unto you without blemish;

title: Numbers 29:9
text: and their meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for the bullock, two tenth parts for the one ram,

title: Numbers 29:10
text: a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs:

title: Numbers 29:11
text: one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the sin-offering of atonement, and the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, and their drink-offerings.

title: Numbers 29:12
text: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto Jehovah seven days:

title: Numbers 29:13
text: and ye shall offer a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs a year old; they shall be without blemish;

title: Numbers 29:14
text: and their meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth parts for each ram of the two rams,

title: Numbers 29:15
text: and a tenth part for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;

title: Numbers 29:16
text: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, besides the continual burnt-offering, the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.

title: Numbers 29:17
text: And on the second day [ye shall offer] twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs a year old without blemish;

title: Numbers 29:18
text: and their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

title: Numbers 29:19
text: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, and their drink-offerings.

title: Numbers 29:20
text: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs a year old without blemish;

title: Numbers 29:21
text: and their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

title: Numbers 29:22
text: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.

title: Numbers 29:23
text: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs a year old without blemish;

title: Numbers 29:24
text: their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

title: Numbers 29:25
text: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.

title: Numbers 29:26
text: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs a year old without blemish;

title: Numbers 29:27
text: and their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

title: Numbers 29:28
text: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, besides the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.

title: Numbers 29:29
text: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs a year old without blemish;

title: Numbers 29:30
text: and their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

title: Numbers 29:31
text: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offerings thereof.

title: Numbers 29:32
text: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs a year old without blemish;

title: Numbers 29:33
text: and their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

title: Numbers 29:34
text: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.

title: Numbers 29:35
text: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work;

title: Numbers 29:36
text: but ye shall offer a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah: one bullock, one ram, seven he-lambs a year old without blemish;

title: Numbers 29:37
text: their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance:

title: Numbers 29:38
text: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, besides the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.

title: Numbers 29:39
text: These ye shall offer unto Jehovah in your set feasts, besides your vows, and your freewill-offerings, for your burnt-offerings, and for your meal-offerings, and for your drink-offerings, and for your peace-offerings.

title: Numbers 29:40
text: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 30:1
text: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded.

title: Numbers 30:2
text: When a man voweth a vow unto Jehovah, or sweareth an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word; he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.

title: Numbers 30:3
text: Also when a woman voweth a vow unto Jehovah, and bindeth herself by a bond, being in her father's house, in her youth,

title: Numbers 30:4
text: and her father heareth her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father holdeth his peace at her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.

title: Numbers 30:5
text: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth, none of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and Jehovah will forgive her, because her father disallowed her.

title: Numbers 30:6
text: And if she be [married] to a husband, while her vows are upon her, or the rash utterance of her lips, wherewith she hath bound her soul,

title: Numbers 30:7
text: and her husband hear it, and hold his peace at her in the day that he heareth it; then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.

title: Numbers 30:8
text: But if her husband disallow her in the day that he heareth it, then he shall make void her vow which is upon her, and the rash utterance of her lips, wherewith she hath bound her soul: and Jehovah will forgive her.

title: Numbers 30:9
text: But the vow of a widow, or of her that is divorced, [even] everything wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand against her.

title: Numbers 30:10
text: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

title: Numbers 30:11
text: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

title: Numbers 30:12
text: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and Jehovah will forgive her.

title: Numbers 30:13
text: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

title: Numbers 30:14
text: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day, then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he hath established them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.

title: Numbers 30:15
text: But if he shall make them null and void after that he hath heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.

title: Numbers 30:16
text: These are the statutes, which Jehovah commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father's house.

title: Numbers 31:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 31:2
text: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.

title: Numbers 31:3
text: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm ye men from among you for the war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Jehovah's vengeance on Midian.

title: Numbers 31:4
text: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.

title: Numbers 31:5
text: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

title: Numbers 31:6
text: And Moses sent them, a thousand of every tribe, to the war, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.

title: Numbers 31:7
text: And they warred against Midian, as Jehovah commanded Moses; and they slew every male.

title: Numbers 31:8
text: And they slew the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.

title: Numbers 31:9
text: And the children of Israel took captive the women of Midian and their little ones; and all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods, they took for a prey.

title: Numbers 31:10
text: And all their cities in the places wherein they dwelt, and all their encampments, they burnt with fire.

title: Numbers 31:11
text: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of man and of beast.

title: Numbers 31:12
text: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and unto Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.

title: Numbers 31:13
text: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.

title: Numbers 31:14
text: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.

title: Numbers 31:15
text: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?

title: Numbers 31:16
text: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Jehovah in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of Jehovah.

title: Numbers 31:17
text: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.

title: Numbers 31:18
text: But all the women-children, that have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

title: Numbers 31:19
text: And encamp ye without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, ye and your captives.

title: Numbers 31:20
text: And as to every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats' [hair], and all things made of wood, ye shall purify yourselves.

title: Numbers 31:21
text: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war that went to the battle, This is the statute of the law which Jehovah hath commanded Moses:

title: Numbers 31:22
text: howbeit the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

title: Numbers 31:23
text: everything that may abide the fire, ye shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make to go through the water.

title: Numbers 31:24
text: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean; and afterward ye shall come into the camp.

title: Numbers 31:25
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 31:26
text: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers' [houses] of the congregation;

title: Numbers 31:27
text: and divide the prey into two parts: between the men skilled in war, that went out to battle, and all the congregation.

title: Numbers 31:28
text: And levy a tribute unto Jehovah of the men of war that went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, [both] of the persons, and of the oxen, and of the asses, and of the flocks:

title: Numbers 31:29
text: take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for Jehovah's heave-offering.

title: Numbers 31:30
text: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the oxen, of the asses, and of the flocks, [even] of all the cattle, and give them unto the Levites, that keep the charge of the tabernacle of Jehovah.

title: Numbers 31:31
text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 31:32
text: Now the prey, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,

title: Numbers 31:33
text: and threescore and twelve thousand oxen,

title: Numbers 31:34
text: and threescore and one thousand asses,

title: Numbers 31:35
text: and thirty and two thousand persons in all, of the women that had not known man by lying with him.

title: Numbers 31:36
text: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep:

title: Numbers 31:37
text: and Jehovah's tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.

title: Numbers 31:38
text: And the oxen were thirty and six thousand; of which Jehovah's tribute was threescore and twelve.

title: Numbers 31:39
text: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which Jehovah's tribute was threescore and one.

title: Numbers 31:40
text: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of whom Jehovah's tribute was thirty and two persons.

title: Numbers 31:41
text: And Moses gave the tribute, which was Jehovah's heave-offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 31:42
text: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided off from the men that warred

title: Numbers 31:43
text: (now the congregation's half was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand, seven thousand and five hundred sheep,

title: Numbers 31:44
text: and thirty and six thousand oxen,

title: Numbers 31:45
text: and thirty thousand and five hundred asses,

title: Numbers 31:46
text: and sixteen thousand persons),

title: Numbers 31:47
text: even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, that kept the charge of the tabernacle of Jehovah; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 31:48
text: And the officers that were over the thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses;

title: Numbers 31:49
text: and they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war that are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.

title: Numbers 31:50
text: And we have brought Jehovah's oblation, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, ankle-chains, and bracelets, signet-rings, ear-rings, and armlets, to make atonement for our souls before Jehovah.

title: Numbers 31:51
text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.

title: Numbers 31:52
text: And all the gold of the heave-offering that they offered up to Jehovah, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.

title: Numbers 31:53
text: ([ For] the men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.)

title: Numbers 31:54
text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tent of meeting, for a memorial for the children of Israel before Jehovah.

title: Numbers 32:1
text: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;

title: Numbers 32:2
text: the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,

title: Numbers 32:3
text: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Sebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

title: Numbers 32:4
text: the land which Jehovah smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle; and thy servants have cattle.

title: Numbers 32:5
text: And they said, If we have found favor in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession; bring us not over the Jordan.

title: Numbers 32:6
text: And Moses said unto the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to the war, and shall ye sit here?

title: Numbers 32:7
text: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Jehovah hath given them?

title: Numbers 32:8
text: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.

title: Numbers 32:9
text: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Jehovah had given them.

title: Numbers 32:10
text: And Jehovah's anger was kindled in that day, and he sware, saying,

title: Numbers 32:11
text: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:

title: Numbers 32:12
text: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun; because they have wholly followed Jehovah.

title: Numbers 32:13
text: And Jehovah's anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander to and fro in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of Jehovah, was consumed.

title: Numbers 32:14
text: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of Jehovah toward Israel.

title: Numbers 32:15
text: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye will destroy all this people.

title: Numbers 32:16
text: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:

title: Numbers 32:17
text: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

title: Numbers 32:18
text: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.

title: Numbers 32:19
text: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan, and forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.

title: Numbers 32:20
text: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will arm yourselves to go before Jehovah to the war,

title: Numbers 32:21
text: and every armed man of you will pass over the Jordan before Jehovah, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,

title: Numbers 32:22
text: and the land is subdued before Jehovah; then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless towards Jehovah, and towards Israel; and this land shall be unto you for a possession before Jehovah.

title: Numbers 32:23
text: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against Jehovah; and be sure your sin will find you out.

title: Numbers 32:24
text: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.

title: Numbers 32:25
text: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.

title: Numbers 32:26
text: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

title: Numbers 32:27
text: but thy servants will pass over, every man that is armed for war, before Jehovah to battle, as my lord saith.

title: Numbers 32:28
text: So Moses gave charge concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers' [houses] of the tribes of the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 32:29
text: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man that is armed to battle, before Jehovah, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:

title: Numbers 32:30
text: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

title: Numbers 32:31
text: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As Jehovah hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.

title: Numbers 32:32
text: We will pass over armed before Jehovah into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance [shall remain] with us beyond the Jordan.

title: Numbers 32:33
text: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, according to the cities thereof with [their] borders, even the cities of the land round about.

title: Numbers 32:34
text: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

title: Numbers 32:35
text: and Atrothshophan, and Jazer, and Jogbehah,

title: Numbers 32:36
text: and Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran: fortified cities, and folds for sheep.

title: Numbers 32:37
text: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kiriathaim,

title: Numbers 32:38
text: and Nebo, and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Sibmah: and they gave other names unto the cities which they builded.

title: Numbers 32:39
text: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorites that were therein.

title: Numbers 32:40
text: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.

title: Numbers 32:41
text: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the towns thereof, and called them Havvoth-jair.

title: Numbers 32:42
text: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

title: Numbers 33:1
text: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went forth out of the land of Egypt by their hosts under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

title: Numbers 33:2
text: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of Jehovah: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.

title: Numbers 33:3
text: And they journeyed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,

title: Numbers 33:4
text: while the Egyptians were burying all their first-born, whom Jehovah had smitten among them: upon their gods also Jehovah executed judgments.

title: Numbers 33:5
text: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

title: Numbers 33:6
text: And they journeyed from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

title: Numbers 33:7
text: And they journeyed from Etham, and turned back unto Pi-hahiroth, which is before Baal-zephon: and they encamped before Migdol.

title: Numbers 33:8
text: And they journeyed from before Hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness: and they went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.

title: Numbers 33:9
text: And they journeyed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve springs of water, and threescore and ten palm-trees; and they encamped there.

title: Numbers 33:10
text: And they journeyed from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.

title: Numbers 33:11
text: And they journeyed from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

title: Numbers 33:12
text: And they journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

title: Numbers 33:13
text: And they journeyed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

title: Numbers 33:14
text: And they journeyed from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.

title: Numbers 33:15
text: And they journeyed from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.

title: Numbers 33:16
text: And they journeyed from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth-hattaavah.

title: Numbers 33:17
text: And they journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.

title: Numbers 33:18
text: And they journeyed from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

title: Numbers 33:19
text: And they journeyed from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon-perez.

title: Numbers 33:20
text: And they journeyed from Rimmon-perez, and encamped in Libnah.

title: Numbers 33:21
text: And they journeyed from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.

title: Numbers 33:22
text: And they journeyed from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.

title: Numbers 33:23
text: And they journeyed from Kehelathah, and encamped in mount Shepher.

title: Numbers 33:24
text: And they journeyed from mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.

title: Numbers 33:25
text: And they journeyed from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

title: Numbers 33:26
text: And they journeyed from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.

title: Numbers 33:27
text: And they journeyed from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.

title: Numbers 33:28
text: And they journeyed from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.

title: Numbers 33:29
text: And they journeyed from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.

title: Numbers 33:30
text: And they journeyed from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.

title: Numbers 33:31
text: And they journeyed from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene-jaakan.

title: Numbers 33:32
text: And they journeyed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped in Hor-haggidgad.

title: Numbers 33:33
text: And they journeyed from Hor-haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.

title: Numbers 33:34
text: And they journeyed from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.

title: Numbers 33:35
text: And they journeyed from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion-geber.

title: Numbers 33:36
text: And they journeyed from Ezion-geber, and encamped in the wilderness of Zin (the same is Kadesh).

title: Numbers 33:37
text: And they journeyed from Kadesh, and encamped in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

title: Numbers 33:38
text: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of Jehovah, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

title: Numbers 33:39
text: And Aaron was a hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.

title: Numbers 33:40
text: And the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who dwelt in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 33:41
text: And they journeyed from mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

title: Numbers 33:42
text: And they journeyed from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.

title: Numbers 33:43
text: And they journeyed from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

title: Numbers 33:44
text: And they journeyed from Oboth, and encamped in Iye-abarim, in the border of Moab.

title: Numbers 33:45
text: And they journeyed from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon-gad.

title: Numbers 33:46
text: And they journeyed from Dibon-gad, and encamped in Almon-diblathaim.

title: Numbers 33:47
text: And they journeyed from Almon-diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

title: Numbers 33:48
text: And they journeyed from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

title: Numbers 33:49
text: And they encamped by the Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth even unto Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.

title: Numbers 33:50
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

title: Numbers 33:51
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

title: Numbers 33:52
text: then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their figured [stones], and destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places:

title: Numbers 33:53
text: and ye shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for unto you have I given the land to possess it.

title: Numbers 33:54
text: And ye shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer thou shalt give the less inheritance: wheresoever the lot falleth to any man, that shall be his; according to the tribes of your fathers shall ye inherit.

title: Numbers 33:55
text: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then shall those that ye let remain of them be as pricks in your eyes, and as thorns in your sides, and they shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.

title: Numbers 33:56
text: And it shall come to pass, that, as I thought to do unto them, so will I do unto you.

title: Numbers 34:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 34:2
text: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to the borders thereof),

title: Numbers 34:3
text: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward;

title: Numbers 34:4
text: and your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and the goings out thereof shall be southward of Kadesh-barnea; and it shall go forth to Hazar-addar, and pass along to Azmon;

title: Numbers 34:5
text: and the border shall turn about from Azmon unto the brook of Egypt, and the goings out thereof shall be at the sea.

title: Numbers 34:6
text: And for the western border, ye shall have the great sea and the border [thereof] : this shall be your west border.

title: Numbers 34:7
text: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall mark out for you mount Hor;

title: Numbers 34:8
text: from mount Hor ye shall mark out unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings out of the border shall be at Zedad;

title: Numbers 34:9
text: and the border shall go forth to Ziphron, and the goings out thereof shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.

title: Numbers 34:10
text: And ye shall mark out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham;

title: Numbers 34:11
text: and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall go down, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward;

title: Numbers 34:12
text: and the border shall go down to the Jordan, and the goings out thereof shall be at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to the borders thereof round about.

title: Numbers 34:13
text: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which Jehovah hath commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;

title: Numbers 34:14
text: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers' houses, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers' houses, have received, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received, their inheritance:

title: Numbers 34:15
text: the two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.

title: Numbers 34:16
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 34:17
text: These are the names of the men that shall divide the land unto you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

title: Numbers 34:18
text: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.

title: Numbers 34:19
text: And these are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

title: Numbers 34:20
text: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

title: Numbers 34:21
text: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

title: Numbers 34:22
text: And of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.

title: Numbers 34:23
text: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

title: Numbers 34:24
text: And of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

title: Numbers 34:25
text: And of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

title: Numbers 34:26
text: And of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

title: Numbers 34:27
text: And of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

title: Numbers 34:28
text: And of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.

title: Numbers 34:29
text: These are they whom Jehovah commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

title: Numbers 35:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

title: Numbers 35:2
text: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and suburbs for the cities round about them shall ye give unto the Levites.

title: Numbers 35:3
text: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and their suburbs shall be for their cattle, and for their substance, and for all their beasts.

title: Numbers 35:4
text: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.

title: Numbers 35:5
text: And ye shall measure without the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the midst. This shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.

title: Numbers 35:6
text: And the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which ye shall give for the manslayer to flee unto: and besides them ye shall give forty and two cities.

title: Numbers 35:7
text: All the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities; them [shall ye give] with their suburbs.

title: Numbers 35:8
text: And concerning the cities which ye shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many ye shall take many; and from the few ye shall take few: every one according to his inheritance which he inheriteth shall give of his cities unto the Levites.

title: Numbers 35:9
text: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 35:10
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

title: Numbers 35:11
text: then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the manslayer that killeth any person unwittingly may flee thither.

title: Numbers 35:12
text: And the cities shall be unto you for refuge from the avenger, that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation for judgment.

title: Numbers 35:13
text: And the cities which ye shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.

title: Numbers 35:14
text: Ye shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan; they shall be cities of refuge.

title: Numbers 35:15
text: For the children of Israel, and for the stranger and for the sojourner among them, shall these six cities be for refuge; that every one that killeth any person unwittingly may flee thither.

title: Numbers 35:16
text: But if he smote him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

title: Numbers 35:17
text: And if he smote him with a stone in the hand, whereby a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

title: Numbers 35:18
text: Or if he smote him with a weapon of wood in the hand, whereby a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

title: Numbers 35:19
text: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death: when he meeteth him, he shall put him to death.

title: Numbers 35:20
text: And if he thrust him of hatred, or hurled at him, lying in wait, so that he died,

title: Numbers 35:21
text: or in enmity smote him with his hand, so that he died; he that smote him shall surely be put to death; he is a murderer: the avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death, when he meeteth him.

title: Numbers 35:22
text: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or hurled upon him anything without lying in wait,

title: Numbers 35:23
text: or with any stone, whereby a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, so that he died, and he was not his enemy, neither sought his harm;

title: Numbers 35:24
text: then the congregation shall judge between the smiter and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances;

title: Numbers 35:25
text: and the congregation shall deliver the manslayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

title: Numbers 35:26
text: But if the manslayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge, whither he fleeth,

title: Numbers 35:27
text: and the avenger of blood find him without the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood slay the manslayer; he shall not be guilty of blood,

title: Numbers 35:28
text: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the manslayer shall return into the land of his possession.

title: Numbers 35:29
text: And these things shall be for a statute [and] ordinance unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

title: Numbers 35:30
text: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be slain at the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person that he die.

title: Numbers 35:31
text: Moreover ye shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer, that is guilty of death; but he shall surely be put to death.

title: Numbers 35:32
text: And ye shall take no ransom for him that is fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

title: Numbers 35:33
text: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood, it polluteth the land; and no expiation can be made for the land for the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.

title: Numbers 35:34
text: And thou shalt not defile the land which ye inhabit, in the midst of which I dwell: for I, Jehovah, dwell in the midst of the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 36:1
text: And the heads of the fathers' [houses] of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the heads of the fathers' [houses] of the children of Israel:

title: Numbers 36:2
text: and they said, Jehovah commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by Jehovah to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.

title: Numbers 36:3
text: And if they be married to any of the sons of the [other] tribes of the children of Israel, then will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they shall belong: so will it be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.

title: Numbers 36:4
text: And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be, then will their inheritance be added unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they shall belong: so will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.

title: Numbers 36:5
text: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of Jehovah, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaketh right.

title: Numbers 36:6
text: This is the thing which Jehovah doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them be married to whom they think best; only into the family of the tribe of their father shall they be married.

title: Numbers 36:7
text: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall cleave every one to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

title: Numbers 36:8
text: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may possess every man the inheritance of his fathers.

title: Numbers 36:9
text: So shall no inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall cleave every one to his own inheritance.

title: Numbers 36:10
text: Even as Jehovah commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:

title: Numbers 36:11
text: for Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father's brothers' sons.

title: Numbers 36:12
text: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

title: Numbers 36:13
text: These are the commandments and the ordinances which Jehovah commanded by Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

title: Deuteronomy 1:1
text: These are the words which Moses spake unto all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah over against Suph, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Di-zahab.

title: Deuteronomy 1:2
text: It is eleven days' [journey] from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh-barnea.

title: Deuteronomy 1:3
text: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that Jehovah had given him in commandment unto them;

title: Deuteronomy 1:4
text: after he had smitten Sihon the king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, who dwelt in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.

title: Deuteronomy 1:5
text: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 1:6
text: Jehovah our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mountain:

title: Deuteronomy 1:7
text: turn you, and take your journey, and go to the hill-country of the Amorites, and unto all [the places] nigh thereunto, in the Arabah, in the hill-country, and in the lowland, and in the South, and by the sea-shore, the land of the Canaanites, and Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.

title: Deuteronomy 1:8
text: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which Jehovah sware unto your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.

title: Deuteronomy 1:9
text: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:

title: Deuteronomy 1:10
text: Jehovah your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.

title: Deuteronomy 1:11
text: Jehovah, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!

title: Deuteronomy 1:12
text: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?

title: Deuteronomy 1:13
text: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known, according to your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.

title: Deuteronomy 1:14
text: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good [for us] to do.

title: Deuteronomy 1:15
text: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, and captains of fifties, and captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.

title: Deuteronomy 1:16
text: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear [the causes] between your brethren, and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the sojourner that is with him.

title: Deuteronomy 1:17
text: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; ye shall hear the small and the great alike; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God's: and the cause that is too hard for you ye shall bring unto me, and I will hear it.

title: Deuteronomy 1:18
text: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.

title: Deuteronomy 1:19
text: And we journeyed from Horeb, and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which ye saw, by the way to the hill-country of the Amorites, as Jehovah our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.

title: Deuteronomy 1:20
text: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the hill-country of the Amorites, which Jehovah our God giveth unto us.

title: Deuteronomy 1:21
text: Behold, Jehovah thy God hath set the land before thee: go up, take possession, as Jehovah, the God of thy fathers, hath spoken unto thee; fear not, neither be dismayed.

title: Deuteronomy 1:22
text: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, Let us send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring us word again of the way by which we must go up, and the cities unto which we shall come.

title: Deuteronomy 1:23
text: And the thing pleased me well; and I took twelve men of you, one man for every tribe:

title: Deuteronomy 1:24
text: and they turned and went up into the hill-country, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.

title: Deuteronomy 1:25
text: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which Jehovah our God giveth unto us.

title: Deuteronomy 1:26
text: Yet ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of Jehovah your God:

title: Deuteronomy 1:27
text: and ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because Jehovah hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.

title: Deuteronomy 1:28
text: Whither are we going up? our brethren have made our heart to melt, saying, The people are greater and taller than we; the cities are great and fortified up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there.

title: Deuteronomy 1:29
text: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.

title: Deuteronomy 1:30
text: Jehovah your God who goeth before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,

title: Deuteronomy 1:31
text: and in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that Jehovah thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came unto this place.

title: Deuteronomy 1:32
text: Yet in this thing ye did not believe Jehovah your God,

title: Deuteronomy 1:33
text: who went before you in the way, to seek you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to show you by what way ye should go, and in the cloud by day.

title: Deuteronomy 1:34
text: And Jehovah heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 1:35
text: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see the good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,

title: Deuteronomy 1:36
text: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh: he shall see it; and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed Jehovah.

title: Deuteronomy 1:37
