text: Also Jehovah was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither:

title: Deuteronomy 1:38
text: Joshua the son of Nun, who standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage thou him; for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

title: Deuteronomy 1:39
text: Moreover your little ones, that ye said should be a prey, and your children, that this day have no knowledge of good or evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 1:40
text: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.

title: Deuteronomy 1:41
text: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against Jehovah, we will go up and fight, according to all that Jehovah our God commanded us. And ye girded on every man his weapons of war, and were forward to go up into the hill-country.

title: Deuteronomy 1:42
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.

title: Deuteronomy 1:43
text: So I spake unto you, and ye hearkened not; but ye rebelled against the commandment of Jehovah, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill-country.

title: Deuteronomy 1:44
text: And the Amorites, that dwelt in that hill-country, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even unto Hormah.

title: Deuteronomy 1:45
text: And ye returned and wept before Jehovah; but Jehovah hearkened not to your voice, nor gave ear unto you.

title: Deuteronomy 1:46
text: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode [there] .

title: Deuteronomy 2:1
text: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as Jehovah spake unto me; and we compassed mount Seir many days.

title: Deuteronomy 2:2
text: And Jehovah spake unto me, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 2:3
text: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.

title: Deuteronomy 2:4
text: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the border of your brethren the children of Esau, that dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore;

title: Deuteronomy 2:5
text: contend not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.

title: Deuteronomy 2:6
text: Ye shall purchase food of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.

title: Deuteronomy 2:7
text: For Jehovah thy God hath blessed thee in all the work of thy hand; he hath known thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years Jehovah thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.

title: Deuteronomy 2:8
text: So we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, that dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion-geber. And we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

title: Deuteronomy 2:9
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Vex not Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give thee of his land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.

title: Deuteronomy 2:10
text: (The Emim dwelt therein aforetime, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakim:

title: Deuteronomy 2:11
text: these also are accounted Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.

title: Deuteronomy 2:12
text: The Horites also dwelt in Seir aforetime, but the children of Esau succeeded them; and they destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which Jehovah gave unto them.)

title: Deuteronomy 2:13
text: Now rise up, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.

title: Deuteronomy 2:14
text: And the days in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, were thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the midst of the camp, as Jehovah sware unto them.

title: Deuteronomy 2:15
text: Moreover the hand of Jehovah was against them, to destroy them from the midst of the camp, until they were consumed.

title: Deuteronomy 2:16
text: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

title: Deuteronomy 2:17
text: that Jehovah spake unto me, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 2:18
text: Thou art this day to pass over Ar, the border of Moab:

title: Deuteronomy 2:19
text: and when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, vex them not, nor contend with them; for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.

title: Deuteronomy 2:20
text: (That also is accounted a land of Rephaim: Rephaim dwelt therein aforetime; but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,

title: Deuteronomy 2:21
text: a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakim; but Jehovah destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead;

title: Deuteronomy 2:22
text: as he did for the children of Esau, that dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:

title: Deuteronomy 2:23
text: and the Avvim, that dwelt in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorim, that came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)

title: Deuteronomy 2:24
text: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon: behold, I have given into thy hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.

title: Deuteronomy 2:25
text: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the peoples that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear the report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.

title: Deuteronomy 2:26
text: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 2:27
text: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the highway, I will turn neither unto the right hand nor to the left.

title: Deuteronomy 2:28
text: Thou shalt sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only let me pass through on my feet,

title: Deuteronomy 2:29
text: as the children of Esau that dwell in Seir, and the Moabites that dwell in Ar, did unto me; until I shall pass over the Jordan into the land which Jehovah our God giveth us.

title: Deuteronomy 2:30
text: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him; for Jehovah thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as at this day.

title: Deuteronomy 2:31
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.

title: Deuteronomy 2:32
text: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, unto battle at Jahaz.

title: Deuteronomy 2:33
text: And Jehovah our God delivered him up before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.

title: Deuteronomy 2:34
text: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones; we left none remaining:

title: Deuteronomy 2:35
text: only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, with the spoil of the cities which we had taken.

title: Deuteronomy 2:36
text: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and [from] the city that is in the valley, even unto Gilead, there was not a city too high for us; Jehovah our God delivered up all before us:

title: Deuteronomy 2:37
text: only to the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not near; all the side of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill-country, and wheresoever Jehovah our God forbade us.

title: Deuteronomy 3:1
text: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, unto battle at Edrei.

title: Deuteronomy 3:2
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Fear him not; for I have delivered him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon.

title: Deuteronomy 3:3
text: So Jehovah our God delivered into our hand Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.

title: Deuteronomy 3:4
text: And we took all his cities at that time; there was not a city which we took not from them; threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

title: Deuteronomy 3:5
text: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars; besides the unwalled towns a great many.

title: Deuteronomy 3:6
text: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones.

title: Deuteronomy 3:7
text: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey unto ourselves.

title: Deuteronomy 3:8
text: And we took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites that were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon unto mount Hermon;

title: Deuteronomy 3:9
text: ([ which] Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir;)

title: Deuteronomy 3:10
text: all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

title: Deuteronomy 3:11
text: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.)

title: Deuteronomy 3:12
text: And this land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill-country of Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites:

title: Deuteronomy 3:13
text: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half-tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.

title: Deuteronomy 3:14
text: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth-jair, unto this day.)

title: Deuteronomy 3:15
text: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.

title: Deuteronomy 3:16
text: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and the border [thereof], even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

title: Deuteronomy 3:17
text: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and the border [thereof], from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.

title: Deuteronomy 3:18
text: And I commanded you at that time, saying, Jehovah your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all the men of valor.

title: Deuteronomy 3:19
text: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you,

title: Deuteronomy 3:20
text: until Jehovah give rest unto your brethren, as unto you, and they also possess the land which Jehovah your God giveth them beyond the Jordan: then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.

title: Deuteronomy 3:21
text: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that Jehovah your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall Jehovah do unto all the kingdoms whither thou goest over.

title: Deuteronomy 3:22
text: Ye shall not fear them; for Jehovah your God, he it is that fighteth for you.

title: Deuteronomy 3:23
text: And I besought Jehovah at that time, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 3:24
text: O Lord Jehovah, thou hast begun to show thy servant thy greatness, and thy strong hand: for what god is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy mighty acts?

title: Deuteronomy 3:25
text: Let me go over, I pray thee, and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.

title: Deuteronomy 3:26
text: But Jehovah was wroth with me for your sakes, and hearkened not unto me; and Jehovah said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.

title: Deuteronomy 3:27
text: Get thee up unto the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

title: Deuteronomy 3:28
text: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.

title: Deuteronomy 3:29
text: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.

title: Deuteronomy 4:1
text: And now, O Israel, hearken unto the statutes and unto the ordinances, which I teach you, to do them; that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which Jehovah, the God of your fathers, giveth you.

title: Deuteronomy 4:2
text: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish from it, that ye may keep the commandments of Jehovah your God which I command you.

title: Deuteronomy 4:3
text: Your eyes have seen what Jehovah did because of Baal-peor; for all the men that followed Baal-peor, Jehovah thy God hath destroyed them from the midst of thee.

title: Deuteronomy 4:4
text: But ye that did cleave unto Jehovah your God are alive every one of you this day.

title: Deuteronomy 4:5
text: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as Jehovah my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the midst of the land whither ye go in to possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 4:6
text: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples, that shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

title: Deuteronomy 4:7
text: For what great nation is there, that hath a god so nigh unto them, as Jehovah our God is whensoever we call upon him?

title: Deuteronomy 4:8
text: And what great nation is there, that hath statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?

title: Deuteronomy 4:9
text: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes saw, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life; but make them known unto thy children and thy children's children;

title: Deuteronomy 4:10
text: the day that thou stoodest before Jehovah thy God in Horeb, when Jehovah said unto me, Assemble me the people, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.

title: Deuteronomy 4:11
text: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the heart of heaven, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.

title: Deuteronomy 4:12
text: And Jehovah spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of words, but ye saw no form; only [ye heard] a voice.

title: Deuteronomy 4:13
text: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.

title: Deuteronomy 4:14
text: And Jehovah commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 4:15
text: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of form on the day that Jehovah spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire.

title: Deuteronomy 4:16
text: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

title: Deuteronomy 4:17
text: the likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flieth in the heavens,

title: Deuteronomy 4:18
text: the likeness of anything that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;

title: Deuteronomy 4:19
text: and lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the host of heaven, thou be drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which Jehovah thy God hath allotted unto all the peoples under the whole heaven.

title: Deuteronomy 4:20
text: But Jehovah hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as at this day.

title: Deuteronomy 4:21
text: Furthermore Jehovah was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which Jehovah thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:

title: Deuteronomy 4:22
text: but I must die in this land, I must not go over the Jordan; but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.

title: Deuteronomy 4:23
text: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of Jehovah your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image in the form of anything which Jehovah thy God hath forbidden thee.

title: Deuteronomy 4:24
text: For Jehovah thy God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.

title: Deuteronomy 4:25
text: When thou shalt beget children, and children's children, and ye shall have been long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image in the form of anything, and shall do that which is evil in the sight of Jehovah thy God, to provoke him to anger;

title: Deuteronomy 4:26
text: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over the Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.

title: Deuteronomy 4:27
text: And Jehovah will scatter you among the peoples, and ye shall be left few in number among the nations, whither Jehovah shall lead you away.

title: Deuteronomy 4:28
text: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

title: Deuteronomy 4:29
text: But from thence ye shall seek Jehovah thy God, and thou shalt find him, when thou searchest after him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.

title: Deuteronomy 4:30
text: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, in the latter days thou shalt return to Jehovah thy God, and hearken unto his voice:

title: Deuteronomy 4:31
text: for Jehovah thy God is a merciful God; he will not fail thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.

title: Deuteronomy 4:32
text: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and from the one end of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been [any such thing] as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?

title: Deuteronomy 4:33
text: Did ever a people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?

title: Deuteronomy 4:34
text: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of [another] nation, by trials, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Jehovah your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

title: Deuteronomy 4:35
text: Unto thee it was showed, that thou mightest know that Jehovah he is God; there is none else besides him.

title: Deuteronomy 4:36
text: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he made thee to see his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.

title: Deuteronomy 4:37
text: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;

title: Deuteronomy 4:38
text: to drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as at this day.

title: Deuteronomy 4:39
text: Know therefore this day, and lay it to thy heart, that Jehovah he is God in heaven above and upon the earth beneath; there is none else.

title: Deuteronomy 4:40
text: And thou shalt keep his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days in the land, which Jehovah thy God giveth thee, for ever.

title: Deuteronomy 4:41
text: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrising;

title: Deuteronomy 4:42
text: that the manslayer might flee thither, that slayeth his neighbor unawares, and hated him not in time past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:

title: Deuteronomy 4:43
text: [ namely], Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.

title: Deuteronomy 4:44
text: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:

title: Deuteronomy 4:45
text: these are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, when they came forth out of Egypt,

title: Deuteronomy 4:46
text: beyond the Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, when they came forth out of Egypt.

title: Deuteronomy 4:47
text: And they took his land in possession, and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrising;

title: Deuteronomy 4:48
text: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even unto mount Sion (the same is Hermon),

title: Deuteronomy 4:49
text: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.

title: Deuteronomy 5:1
text: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and observe to do them.

title: Deuteronomy 5:2
text: Jehovah our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

title: Deuteronomy 5:3
text: Jehovah made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.

title: Deuteronomy 5:4
text: Jehovah spake with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,

title: Deuteronomy 5:5
text: (I stood between Jehovah and you at that time, to show you the word of Jehovah: for ye were afraid because of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,

title: Deuteronomy 5:6
text: I am Jehovah thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

title: Deuteronomy 5:7
text: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

title: Deuteronomy 5:8
text: Thou shalt not make unto thee a graven image, [nor] any likeness [of anything] that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

title: Deuteronomy 5:9
text: thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them; for I, Jehovah, thy God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the third and upon the fourth generation of them that hate me;

title: Deuteronomy 5:10
text: and showing lovingkindness unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.

title: Deuteronomy 5:11
text: Thou shalt not take the name of Jehovah thy God in vain: for Jehovah will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

title: Deuteronomy 5:12
text: Observe the sabbath day, to keep it holy, as Jehovah thy God commanded thee.

title: Deuteronomy 5:13
text: Six days shalt thou labor, and do all thy work;

title: Deuteronomy 5:14
text: but the seventh day is a sabbath unto Jehovah thy God: [in it] thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy man-servant, nor thy maid-servant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy man-servant and thy maid-servant may rest as well as thou.

title: Deuteronomy 5:15
text: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and Jehovah thy God brought thee out thence by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm: therefore Jehovah thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.

title: Deuteronomy 5:16
text: Honor thy father and thy mother, as Jehovah thy God commanded thee; that thy days may be long, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which Jehovah thy God giveth thee.

title: Deuteronomy 5:17
text: Thou shalt not kill.

title: Deuteronomy 5:18
text: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.

title: Deuteronomy 5:19
text: Neither shalt thou steal.

title: Deuteronomy 5:20
text: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbor.

title: Deuteronomy 5:21
text: Neither shalt thou covet thy neighbor's wife; neither shalt thou desire thy neighbor's house, his field, or his man-servant, or his maid-servant, his ox, or his ass, or anything that is thy neighbor's.

title: Deuteronomy 5:22
text: These words Jehovah spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them upon two tables of stone, and gave them unto me.

title: Deuteronomy 5:23
text: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

title: Deuteronomy 5:24
text: and ye said, Behold, Jehovah our God hath showed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth speak with man, and he liveth.

title: Deuteronomy 5:25
text: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of Jehovah our God any more, then we shall die.

title: Deuteronomy 5:26
text: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?

title: Deuteronomy 5:27
text: Go thou near, and hear all that Jehovah our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that Jehovah our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.

title: Deuteronomy 5:28
text: And Jehovah heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and Jehovah said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.

title: Deuteronomy 5:29
text: Oh that there were such a heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!

title: Deuteronomy 5:30
text: Go say to them, Return ye to your tents.

title: Deuteronomy 5:31
text: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandment, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 5:32
text: Ye shall observe to do therefore as Jehovah your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.

title: Deuteronomy 5:33
text: Ye shall walk in all the way which Jehovah your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.

title: Deuteronomy 6:1
text: Now this is the commandment, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Jehovah your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it;

title: Deuteronomy 6:2
text: that thou mightest fear Jehovah thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son's son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.

title: Deuteronomy 6:3
text: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as Jehovah, the God of thy fathers, hath promised unto thee, in a land flowing with milk and honey.

title: Deuteronomy 6:4
text: Hear, O Israel: Jehovah our God is one Jehovah:

title: Deuteronomy 6:5
text: and thou shalt love Jehovah thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

title: Deuteronomy 6:6
text: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be upon thy heart;

title: Deuteronomy 6:7
text: and thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

title: Deuteronomy 6:8
text: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thy hand, and they shall be for frontlets between thine eyes.

title: Deuteronomy 6:9
text: And thou shalt write them upon the door-posts of thy house, and upon thy gates.

title: Deuteronomy 6:10
text: And it shall be, when Jehovah thy God shall bring thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee, great and goodly cities, which thou buildest not,

title: Deuteronomy 6:11
text: and houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and cisterns hewn out, which thou hewedst not, vineyards and olive-trees, which thou plantedst not, and thou shalt eat and be full;

title: Deuteronomy 6:12
text: then beware lest thou forget Jehovah, who brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

title: Deuteronomy 6:13
text: Thou shalt fear Jehovah thy God; and him shalt thou serve, and shalt swear by his name.

title: Deuteronomy 6:14
text: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples that are round about you;

title: Deuteronomy 6:15
text: for Jehovah thy God in the midst of thee is a jealous God; lest the anger of Jehovah thy God be kindled against thee, and he destroy thee from off the face of the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 6:16
text: Ye shall not tempt Jehovah your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.

title: Deuteronomy 6:17
text: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of Jehovah your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.

title: Deuteronomy 6:18
text: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of Jehovah; that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which Jehovah sware unto thy fathers,

title: Deuteronomy 6:19
text: to thrust out all thine enemies from before thee, as Jehovah hath spoken.

title: Deuteronomy 6:20
text: When thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which Jehovah our God hath commanded you?

title: Deuteronomy 6:21
text: then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh's bondmen in Egypt: and Jehovah brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;

title: Deuteronomy 6:22
text: and Jehovah showed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his house, before our eyes;

title: Deuteronomy 6:23
text: and he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.

title: Deuteronomy 6:24
text: And Jehovah commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Jehovah our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as at this day.

title: Deuteronomy 6:25
text: And it shall be righteousness unto us, if we observe to do all this commandment before Jehovah our God, as he hath commanded us.

title: Deuteronomy 7:1
text: When Jehovah thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and shall cast out many nations before thee, the Hittite, and the Girgashite, and the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;

title: Deuteronomy 7:2
text: and when Jehovah thy God shall deliver them up before thee, and thou shalt smite them; then thou shalt utterly destroy them: thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor show mercy unto them;

title: Deuteronomy 7:3
text: neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.

title: Deuteronomy 7:4
text: For he will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of Jehovah be kindled against you, and he will destroy thee quickly.

title: Deuteronomy 7:5
text: But thus shall ye deal with them: ye shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and hew down their Asherim, and burn their graven images with fire.

title: Deuteronomy 7:6
text: For thou art a holy people unto Jehovah thy God: Jehovah thy God hath chosen thee to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples that are upon the face of the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 7:7
text: Jehovah did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all peoples:

title: Deuteronomy 7:8
text: but because Jehovah loveth you, and because he would keep the oath which he sware unto your fathers, hath Jehovah brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

title: Deuteronomy 7:9
text: Know therefore that Jehovah thy God, he is God, the faithful God, who keepeth covenant and lovingkindness with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations,

title: Deuteronomy 7:10
text: and repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.

title: Deuteronomy 7:11
text: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandment, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which I command thee this day, to do them.

title: Deuteronomy 7:12
text: And it shall come to pass, because ye hearken to these ordinances, and keep and do them, that Jehovah thy God will keep with thee the covenant and the lovingkindness which he sware unto thy fathers:

title: Deuteronomy 7:13
text: and he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee; he will also bless the fruit of thy body and the fruit of thy ground, thy grain and thy new wine and thine oil, the increase of thy cattle and the young of thy flock, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

title: Deuteronomy 7:14
text: Thou shalt be blessed above all peoples: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.

title: Deuteronomy 7:15
text: And Jehovah will take away from thee all sickness; and none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, will he put upon thee, but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.

title: Deuteronomy 7:16
text: And thou shalt consume all the peoples that Jehovah thy God shall deliver unto thee; thine eye shall not pity them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.

title: Deuteronomy 7:17
text: If thou shalt say in thy heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?

title: Deuteronomy 7:18
text: thou shalt not be afraid of them: thou shalt well remember what Jehovah thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;

title: Deuteronomy 7:19
text: the great trials which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, whereby Jehovah thy God brought thee out: so shall Jehovah thy God do unto all the peoples of whom thou art afraid.

title: Deuteronomy 7:20
text: Moreover Jehovah thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves, perish from before thee.

title: Deuteronomy 7:21
text: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them; for Jehovah thy God is in the midst of thee, a great God and a terrible.

title: Deuteronomy 7:22
text: And Jehovah thy God will cast out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.

title: Deuteronomy 7:23
text: But Jehovah thy God will deliver them up before thee, and will discomfit them with a great discomfiture, until they be destroyed.

title: Deuteronomy 7:24
text: And he will deliver their kings into thy hand, and thou shalt make their name to perish from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.

title: Deuteronomy 7:25
text: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein; for it is an abomination to Jehovah thy God.

title: Deuteronomy 7:26
text: And thou shalt not bring an abomination into thy house, and become a devoted thing like unto it: thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.

title: Deuteronomy 8:1
text: All the commandment which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which Jehovah sware unto your fathers.

title: Deuteronomy 8:2
text: And thou shalt remember all the way which Jehovah thy God hath led thee these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble thee, to prove thee, to know what was in thy heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or not.

title: Deuteronomy 8:3
text: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by everything that proceedeth out of the mouth of Jehovah doth man live.

title: Deuteronomy 8:4
text: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.

title: Deuteronomy 8:5
text: And thou shalt consider in thy heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so Jehovah thy God chasteneth thee.

title: Deuteronomy 8:6
text: And thou shalt keep the commandments of Jehovah thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

title: Deuteronomy 8:7
text: For Jehovah thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and springs, flowing forth in valleys and hills;

title: Deuteronomy 8:8
text: a land of wheat and barley, and vines and fig-trees and pomegranates; a land of olive-trees and honey;

title: Deuteronomy 8:9
text: a land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig copper.

title: Deuteronomy 8:10
text: And thou shalt eat and be full, and thou shalt bless Jehovah thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.

title: Deuteronomy 8:11
text: Beware lest thou forget Jehovah thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:

title: Deuteronomy 8:12
text: lest, when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;

title: Deuteronomy 8:13
text: and when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;

title: Deuteronomy 8:14
text: then thy heart be lifted up, and thou forget Jehovah thy God, who brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;

title: Deuteronomy 8:15
text: who led thee through the great and terrible wilderness, [wherein were] fiery serpents and scorpions, and thirsty ground where was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;

title: Deuteronomy 8:16
text: who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not; that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end:

title: Deuteronomy 8:17
text: and [lest] thou say in thy heart, My power and the might of my hand hath gotten me this wealth.

title: Deuteronomy 8:18
text: But thou shalt remember Jehovah thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth; that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as at this day.

title: Deuteronomy 8:19
text: And it shall be, if thou shalt forget Jehovah thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.

title: Deuteronomy 8:20
text: As the nations that Jehovah maketh to perish before you, so shall ye perish; because ye would not hearken unto the voice of Jehovah your God.

title: Deuteronomy 9:1
text: Hear, O Israel: thou art to pass over the Jordan this day, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fortified up to heaven,

title: Deuteronomy 9:2
text: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom thou knowest, and of whom thou hast heard say, Who can stand before the sons of Anak?

title: Deuteronomy 9:3
text: Know therefore this day, that Jehovah thy God is he who goeth over before thee as a devouring fire; he will destroy them, and he will bring them down before thee: so shalt thou drive them out, and make them to perish quickly, as Jehovah hath spoken unto thee.

title: Deuteronomy 9:4
text: Speak not thou in thy heart, after that Jehovah thy God hath thrust them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness Jehovah hath brought me in to possess this land; whereas for the wickedness of these nations Jehovah doth drive them out from before thee.

title: Deuteronomy 9:5
text: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thy heart, dost thou go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations Jehovah thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may establish the word which Jehovah sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

title: Deuteronomy 9:6
text: Know therefore, that Jehovah thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou art a stiffnecked people.

title: Deuteronomy 9:7
text: Remember, forget thou not, how thou provokedst Jehovah thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou wentest forth out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against Jehovah.

title: Deuteronomy 9:8
text: Also in Horeb ye provoked Jehovah to wrath, and Jehovah was angry with you to destroy you.

title: Deuteronomy 9:9
text: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which Jehovah made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights; I did neither eat bread nor drink water.

title: Deuteronomy 9:10
text: And Jehovah delivered unto me the two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them [was written] according to all the words, which Jehovah spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.

title: Deuteronomy 9:11
text: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that Jehovah gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.

title: Deuteronomy 9:12
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people that thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.

title: Deuteronomy 9:13
text: Furthermore Jehovah spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:

title: Deuteronomy 9:14
text: let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven; and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.

title: Deuteronomy 9:15
text: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount was burning with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.

title: Deuteronomy 9:16
text: And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against Jehovah your God; ye had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which Jehovah had commanded you.

title: Deuteronomy 9:17
text: And I took hold of the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.

title: Deuteronomy 9:18
text: And I fell down before Jehovah, as at the first, forty days and forty nights; I did neither eat bread nor drink water; because of all your sin which ye sinned, in doing that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, to provoke him to anger.

title: Deuteronomy 9:19
text: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith Jehovah was wroth against you to destroy you. But Jehovah hearkened unto me that time also.

title: Deuteronomy 9:20
text: And Jehovah was very angry with Aaron to destroy him: and I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.

title: Deuteronomy 9:21
text: And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, grinding it very small, until it was as fine as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.

title: Deuteronomy 9:22
text: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah, ye provoked Jehovah to wrath.

title: Deuteronomy 9:23
text: And when Jehovah sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of Jehovah your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.

title: Deuteronomy 9:24
text: Ye have been rebellious against Jehovah from the day that I knew you.

title: Deuteronomy 9:25
text: So I fell down before Jehovah the forty days and forty nights that I fell down, because Jehovah had said he would destroy you.

title: Deuteronomy 9:26
text: And I prayed unto Jehovah, and said, O Lord Jehovah, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, that thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, that thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

title: Deuteronomy 9:27
text: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin,

title: Deuteronomy 9:28
text: lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because Jehovah was not able to bring them into the land which he promised unto them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.

title: Deuteronomy 9:29
text: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out by thy great power and by thine outstretched arm.

title: Deuteronomy 10:1
text: At that time Jehovah said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.

title: Deuteronomy 10:2
text: And I will write on the tables the words that were on the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.

title: Deuteronomy 10:3
text: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in my hand.

title: Deuteronomy 10:4
text: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which Jehovah spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and Jehovah gave them unto me.

title: Deuteronomy 10:5
text: And I turned and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they are as Jehovah commanded me.

title: Deuteronomy 10:6
text: (And the children of Israel journeyed from Beeroth Bene-jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest's office in his stead.

title: Deuteronomy 10:7
text: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.

title: Deuteronomy 10:8
text: At that time Jehovah set apart the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, to stand before Jehovah to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.

title: Deuteronomy 10:9
text: Wherefore Levi hath no portion nor inheritance with his brethren; Jehovah is his inheritance, according as Jehovah thy God spake unto him.)

title: Deuteronomy 10:10
text: And I stayed in the mount, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights: and Jehovah hearkened unto me that time also; Jehovah would not destroy thee.

title: Deuteronomy 10:11
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Arise, take thy journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.

title: Deuteronomy 10:12
text: And now, Israel, what doth Jehovah thy God require of thee, but to fear Jehovah thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve Jehovah thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,

title: Deuteronomy 10:13
text: to keep the commandments of Jehovah, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?

title: Deuteronomy 10:14
text: Behold, unto Jehovah thy God belongeth heaven and the heaven of heavens, the earth, with all that is therein.

title: Deuteronomy 10:15
text: Only Jehovah had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all peoples, as at this day.

title: Deuteronomy 10:16
text: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.

title: Deuteronomy 10:17
text: For Jehovah your God, he is God of gods, and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the terrible, who regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward.

title: Deuteronomy 10:18
text: He doth execute justice for the fatherless and widow, and loveth the sojourner, in giving him food and raiment.

title: Deuteronomy 10:19
text: Love ye therefore the sojourner; for ye were sojourners in the land of Egypt.

title: Deuteronomy 10:20
text: Thou shalt fear Jehovah thy God; him shalt thou serve; and to him shalt thou cleave, and by his name shalt thou swear.

title: Deuteronomy 10:21
text: He is thy praise, and he is thy God, that hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thine eyes have seen.

title: Deuteronomy 10:22
text: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now Jehovah thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.

title: Deuteronomy 11:1
text: Therefore thou shalt love Jehovah thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his ordinances, and his commandments, alway.

title: Deuteronomy 11:2
text: And know ye this day: for [I speak] not with your children that have not known, and that have not seen the chastisement of Jehovah your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his outstretched arm,

title: Deuteronomy 11:3
text: and his signs, and his works, which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and unto all his land;

title: Deuteronomy 11:4
text: and what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and how Jehovah hath destroyed them unto this day;

title: Deuteronomy 11:5
text: and what he did unto you in the wilderness, until ye came unto this place;

title: Deuteronomy 11:6
text: and what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben; how the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and every living thing that followed them, in the midst of all Israel:

title: Deuteronomy 11:7
text: but your eyes have seen all the great work of Jehovah which he did.

title: Deuteronomy 11:8
text: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandment which I command thee this day, that ye may be strong, and go in and possess the land, whither ye go over to possess it;

title: Deuteronomy 11:9
text: and that ye may prolong your days in the land, which Jehovah sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed, a land flowing with milk and honey.

title: Deuteronomy 11:10
text: For the land, whither thou goest in to possess it, is not as the land of Egypt, from whence ye came out, where thou sowedst thy seed, and wateredst it with thy foot, as a garden of herbs;

title: Deuteronomy 11:11
text: but the land, whither ye go over to possess it, is a land of hills and valleys, [and] drinketh water of the rain of heaven,

title: Deuteronomy 11:12
text: a land which Jehovah thy God careth for: the eyes of Jehovah thy God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.

title: Deuteronomy 11:13
text: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love Jehovah your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

title: Deuteronomy 11:14
text: that I will give the rain of your land in its season, the former rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy grain, and thy new wine, and thine oil.

title: Deuteronomy 11:15
text: And I will give grass in thy fields for thy cattle, and thou shalt eat and be full.

title: Deuteronomy 11:16
text: Take heed to yourselves, lest your heart be deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;

title: Deuteronomy 11:17
text: and the anger of Jehovah be kindled against you, and he shut up the heavens, so that there shall be no rain, and the land shall not yield its fruit; and ye perish quickly from off the good land which Jehovah giveth you.

title: Deuteronomy 11:18
text: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul; and ye shall bind them for a sign upon your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

title: Deuteronomy 11:19
text: And ye shall teach them your children, talking of them, when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

title: Deuteronomy 11:20
text: And thou shalt write them upon the door-posts of thy house, and upon thy gates;

title: Deuteronomy 11:21
text: that your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which Jehovah sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 11:22
text: For if ye shall diligently keep all this commandment which I command you, to do it, to love Jehovah your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him;

title: Deuteronomy 11:23
text: then will Jehovah drive out all these nations from before you, and ye shall dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourselves.

title: Deuteronomy 11:24
text: Every place whereon the sole of your foot shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness, and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the hinder sea shall be your border.

title: Deuteronomy 11:25
text: There shall no man be able to stand before you: Jehovah your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath spoken unto you.

title: Deuteronomy 11:26
text: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse:

title: Deuteronomy 11:27
text: the blessing, if ye shall hearken unto the commandments of Jehovah your God, which I command you this day;

title: Deuteronomy 11:28
text: and the curse, if ye shall not hearken unto the commandments of Jehovah your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.

title: Deuteronomy 11:29
text: And it shall come to pass, when Jehovah thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt set the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.

title: Deuteronomy 11:30
text: Are they not beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites that dwell in the Arabah, over against Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?

title: Deuteronomy 11:31
text: For ye are to pass over the Jordan to go in to possess the land which Jehovah your God giveth you, and ye shall possess it, and dwell therein.

title: Deuteronomy 11:32
text: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and the ordinances which I set before you this day.

title: Deuteronomy 12:1
text: These are the statutes and the ordinances which ye shall observe to do in the land which Jehovah, the God of thy fathers, hath given thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 12:2
text: Ye shall surely destroy all the places wherein the nations that ye shall dispossess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:

title: Deuteronomy 12:3
text: and ye shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and burn their Asherim with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods; and ye shall destroy their name out of that place.

title: Deuteronomy 12:4
text: Ye shall not do so unto Jehovah your God.

title: Deuteronomy 12:5
text: But unto the place which Jehovah your God shall choose out of all your tribes, to put his name there, even unto his habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come;

title: Deuteronomy 12:6
text: and thither ye shall bring your burnt-offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and the heave-offering of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill-offerings, and the firstlings of your herd and of your flock:

title: Deuteronomy 12:7
text: and there ye shall eat before Jehovah your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto, ye and your households, wherein Jehovah thy God hath blessed thee.

title: Deuteronomy 12:8
text: Ye shall not do after all the things that we do here this day, every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes;

title: Deuteronomy 12:9
text: for ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which Jehovah thy God giveth thee.

title: Deuteronomy 12:10
text: But when ye go over the Jordan, and dwell in the land which Jehovah your God causeth you to inherit, and he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about, so that ye dwell in safety;

title: Deuteronomy 12:11
text: then it shall come to pass that to the place which Jehovah your God shall choose, to cause his name to dwell there, thither shall ye bring all that I command you: your burnt-offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave-offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye vow unto Jehovah.

title: Deuteronomy 12:12
text: And ye shall rejoice before Jehovah your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your men-servants, and your maid-servants, and the Levite that is within your gates, forasmuch as he hath no portion nor inheritance with you.

title: Deuteronomy 12:13
text: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt-offerings in every place that thou seest;

title: Deuteronomy 12:14
text: but in the place which Jehovah shall choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt-offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.

title: Deuteronomy 12:15
text: Notwithstanding, thou mayest kill and eat flesh within all thy gates, after all the desire of thy soul, according to the blessing of Jehovah thy God which he hath given thee: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the gazelle, and as of the hart.

title: Deuteronomy 12:16
text: Only ye shall not eat the blood; thou shalt pour it out upon the earth as water.

title: Deuteronomy 12:17
text: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy grain, or of thy new wine, or of thine oil, or the firstlings of thy herd or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill-offerings, nor the heave-offering of thy hand;

title: Deuteronomy 12:18
text: but thou shalt eat them before Jehovah thy God in the place which Jehovah thy God shall choose, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy man-servant, and thy maid-servant, and the Levite that is within thy gates: and thou shalt rejoice before Jehovah thy God in all that thou puttest thy hand unto.

title: Deuteronomy 12:19
text: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest in thy land.

title: Deuteronomy 12:20
text: When Jehovah thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he hath promised thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul desireth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, after all the desire of thy soul.

title: Deuteronomy 12:21
text: If the place which Jehovah thy God shall choose, to put his name there, be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which Jehovah hath given thee, as I have commanded thee; and thou mayest eat within thy gates, after all the desire of thy soul.

title: Deuteronomy 12:22
text: Even as the gazelle and as the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat thereof: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof alike.

title: Deuteronomy 12:23
text: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood is the life; and thou shalt not eat the life with the flesh.

title: Deuteronomy 12:24
text: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it out upon the earth as water.

title: Deuteronomy 12:25
text: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do that which is right in the eyes of Jehovah.

title: Deuteronomy 12:26
text: Only thy holy things which thou hast, and thy vows, thou shalt take, and go unto the place which Jehovah shall choose:

title: Deuteronomy 12:27
text: and thou shalt offer thy burnt-offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of Jehovah thy God; and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of Jehovah thy God; and thou shalt eat the flesh.

title: Deuteronomy 12:28
text: Observe and hear all these words which I command thee, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest that which is good and right in the eyes of Jehovah thy God.

title: Deuteronomy 12:29
text: When Jehovah thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee, whither thou goest in to dispossess them, and thou dispossessest them, and dwellest in their land;

title: Deuteronomy 12:30
text: take heed to thyself that thou be not ensnared to follow them, after that they are destroyed from before thee; and that thou inquire not after their gods, saying, How do these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.

title: Deuteronomy 12:31
text: Thou shalt not do so unto Jehovah thy God: for every abomination to Jehovah, which he hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters do they burn in the fire to their gods.

title: Deuteronomy 12:32
text: What thing soever I command you, that shall ye observe to do: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it.

title: Deuteronomy 13:1
text: If there arise in the midst of thee a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and he give thee a sign or a wonder,

title: Deuteronomy 13:2
text: and the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spake unto thee, saying, Let us go after other gods, which thou hast not known, and let us serve them;

title: Deuteronomy 13:3
text: thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or unto that dreamer of dreams: for Jehovah your God proveth you, to know whether ye love Jehovah your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

title: Deuteronomy 13:4
text: Ye shall walk after Jehovah your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.

title: Deuteronomy 13:5
text: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death, because he hath spoken rebellion against Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of bondage, to draw thee aside out of the way which Jehovah thy God commanded thee to walk in. So shalt thou put away the evil from the midst of thee.

title: Deuteronomy 13:6
text: If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, that is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers;

title: Deuteronomy 13:7
text: of the gods of the peoples that are round about you, nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth;

title: Deuteronomy 13:8
text: thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him:

title: Deuteronomy 13:9
text: but thou shalt surely kill him; thy hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.

title: Deuteronomy 13:10
text: And thou shalt stone him to death with stones, because he hath sought to draw thee away from Jehovah thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

title: Deuteronomy 13:11
text: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do not more any such wickedness as this is in the midst of thee.

title: Deuteronomy 13:12
text: If thou shalt hear tell concerning one of thy cities, which Jehovah thy God giveth thee to dwell there, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 13:13
text: Certain base fellows are gone out from the midst of thee, and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye have not known;

title: Deuteronomy 13:14
text: then shalt thou inquire, and make search, and ask diligently; and, behold, if it be truth, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought in the midst of thee,

title: Deuteronomy 13:15
text: thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, and all that is therein and the cattle thereof, with the edge of the sword.

title: Deuteronomy 13:16
text: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof, and shalt burn with fire the city, and all the spoil thereof every whit, unto Jehovah thy God: and it shall be a [ heap for ever; it shall not be built again.

title: Deuteronomy 13:17
text: And there shall cleave nought of the devoted thing to thy hand; that Jehovah may turn from the fierceness of his anger, and show thee mercy, and have compassion upon thee, and multiply thee, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers;

title: Deuteronomy 13:18
text: when thou shalt hearken to the voice of Jehovah thy God, to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day, to do that which is right in the eyes of Jehovah thy God.

title: Deuteronomy 14:1
text: Ye are the children of Jehovah your God: ye shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

title: Deuteronomy 14:2
text: For thou art a holy people unto Jehovah thy God, and Jehovah hath chosen thee to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples that are upon the face of the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 14:3
text: Thou shalt not eat any abominable thing.

title: Deuteronomy 14:4
text: These are the beasts which ye may eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,

title: Deuteronomy 14:5
text: the hart, and the gazelle, and the roebuck, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the antelope, and the chamois.

title: Deuteronomy 14:6
text: And every beast that parteth the hoof, and hath the hoof cloven in two, [and] cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that may ye eat.

title: Deuteronomy 14:7
text: Nevertheless these ye shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that have the hoof cloven: the camel, and the hare, and the coney; because they chew the cud but part not the hoof, they are unclean unto you.

title: Deuteronomy 14:8
text: And the swine, because he parteth the hoof but cheweth not the cud, he is unclean unto you: of their flesh ye shall not eat, and their carcasses ye shall not touch.

title: Deuteronomy 14:9
text: These ye may eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales may ye eat;

title: Deuteronomy 14:10
text: and whatsoever hath not fins and scales ye shall not eat; it is unclean unto you.

title: Deuteronomy 14:11
text: Of all clean birds ye may eat.

title: Deuteronomy 14:12
text: But these are they of which ye shall not eat: the eagle, and the gier-eagle, and the ospray,

title: Deuteronomy 14:13
text: and the glede, and the falcon, and the kite after its kind,

title: Deuteronomy 14:14
text: and every raven after its kind,

title: Deuteronomy 14:15
text: and the ostrich, and the night-hawk, and the sea-mew, and the hawk after its kind,

title: Deuteronomy 14:16
text: the little owl, and the great owl, and the horned owl,

title: Deuteronomy 14:17
text: and the pelican, and the vulture, and the cormorant,

title: Deuteronomy 14:18
text: and the stork, and the heron after its kind, and the hoopoe, and the bat.

title: Deuteronomy 14:19
text: And all winged creeping things are unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.

title: Deuteronomy 14:20
text: Of all clean birds ye may eat.

title: Deuteronomy 14:21
text: Ye shall not eat of anything that dieth of itself: thou mayest give it unto the sojourner that is within thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto a foreigner: for thou art a holy people unto Jehovah thy God. Thou shalt not boil a kid in its mother's milk.

title: Deuteronomy 14:22
text: Thou shalt surely tithe all the increase of thy seed, that which cometh forth from the field year by year.

title: Deuteronomy 14:23
text: And thou shalt eat before Jehovah thy God, in the place which he shall choose, to cause his name to dwell there, the tithe of thy grain, of thy new wine, and of thine oil, and the firstlings of thy herd and of thy flock; that thou mayest learn to fear Jehovah thy God always.

title: Deuteronomy 14:24
text: And if the way be too long for thee, so that thou art not able to carry it, because the place is too far from thee, which Jehovah thy God shall choose, to set his name there, when Jehovah thy God shall bless thee;

title: Deuteronomy 14:25
text: then shalt thou turn it into money, and bind up the money in thy hand, and shalt go unto the place which Jehovah thy God shall choose:

title: Deuteronomy 14:26
text: and thou shalt bestow the money for whatsoever thy soul desireth, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatsoever thy soul asketh of thee; and thou shalt eat there before Jehovah thy God, and thou shalt rejoice, thou and thy household.

title: Deuteronomy 14:27
text: And the Levite that is within thy gates, thou shalt not forsake him; for he hath no portion nor inheritance with thee.

title: Deuteronomy 14:28
text: At the end of every three years thou shalt bring forth all the tithe of thine increase in the same year, and shalt lay it up within thy gates:

title: Deuteronomy 14:29
text: and the Levite, because he hath no portion nor inheritance with thee, and the sojourner, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are within thy gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that Jehovah thy God may bless thee in all the work of thy hand which thou doest.

title: Deuteronomy 15:1
text: At the end of every seven years thou shalt make a release.

title: Deuteronomy 15:2
text: And this is the manner of the release: every creditor shall release that which he hath lent unto his neighbor; he shall not exact it of his neighbor and his brother; because Jehovah's release hath been proclaimed.

title: Deuteronomy 15:3
text: Of a foreigner thou mayest exact it: but whatsoever of thine is with thy brother thy hand shall release.

title: Deuteronomy 15:4
text: Howbeit there shall be no poor with thee; (for Jehovah will surely bless thee in the land which Jehovah thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it;)

title: Deuteronomy 15:5
text: if only thou diligently hearken unto the voice of Jehovah thy God, to observe to do all this commandment which I command thee this day.

title: Deuteronomy 15:6
text: For Jehovah thy God will bless thee, as he promised thee: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt rule over many nations, but they shall not rule over thee.

title: Deuteronomy 15:7
text: If there be with thee a poor man, one of thy brethren, within any of thy gates in thy land which Jehovah thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not harden thy heart, nor shut thy hand from thy poor brother;

title: Deuteronomy 15:8
text: but thou shalt surely open thy hand unto him, and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need [in that] which he wanteth.

title: Deuteronomy 15:9
text: Beware that there be not a base thought in thy heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and thine eye be evil against thy poor brother, and thou give him nought; and he cry unto Jehovah against thee, and it be sin unto thee.

title: Deuteronomy 15:10
text: Thou shalt surely give him, and thy heart shall not be grieved when thou givest unto him; because that for this thing Jehovah thy God will bless thee in all thy work, and in all that thou puttest thy hand unto.

title: Deuteronomy 15:11
text: For the poor will never cease out of the land: therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt surely open thy hand unto thy brother, to thy needy, and to thy poor, in thy land.

title: Deuteronomy 15:12
text: If thy brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, be sold unto thee, and serve thee six years; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free from thee.

title: Deuteronomy 15:13
text: And when thou lettest him go free from thee, thou shalt not let him go empty:

title: Deuteronomy 15:14
text: thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock, and out of thy threshing-floor, and out of thy winepress; as Jehovah thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give unto him.

title: Deuteronomy 15:15
text: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt, and Jehovah thy God redeemed thee: therefore I command thee this thing to-day.

title: Deuteronomy 15:16
text: And it shall be, if he say unto thee, I will not go out from thee; because he loveth thee and thy house, because he is well with thee;

title: Deuteronomy 15:17
text: then thou shalt take an awl, and thrust it through his ear unto the door, and he shall be thy servant for ever. And also unto thy maid-servant thou shalt do likewise. [

title: Deuteronomy 15:18
text: It shall not seem hard unto thee, when thou lettest him go free from thee; for to the double of the hire of a hireling hath he served thee six years: and Jehovah thy God will bless thee in all that thou doest.

title: Deuteronomy 15:19
text: All the firstling males that are born of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto Jehovah thy God: thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy herd, nor shear the firstling of thy flock.

title: Deuteronomy 15:20
text: Thou shalt eat it before Jehovah thy God year by year in the place which Jehovah shall choose, thou and thy household.

title: Deuteronomy 15:21
text: And if it have any blemish, [as if it be] lame or blind, any ill blemish whatsoever, thou shalt not sacrifice it unto Jehovah thy God.

title: Deuteronomy 15:22
text: Thou shalt eat it within thy gates: the unclean and the clean [shall eat it] alike, as the gazelle, and as the hart.

title: Deuteronomy 15:23
text: Only thou shalt not eat the blood thereof; thou shalt pour it out upon the ground as water.

title: Deuteronomy 16:1
text: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the passover unto Jehovah thy God; for in the month of Abib Jehovah thy God brought thee forth out of Egypt by night.

title: Deuteronomy 16:2
text: And thou shalt sacrifice the passover unto Jehovah thy God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which Jehovah shall choose, to cause his name to dwell there.

title: Deuteronomy 16:3
text: Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread therewith, even the bread of affliction; for thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt in haste: that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of thy life.

title: Deuteronomy 16:4
text: And there shall be no leaven seen with thee in all thy borders seven days; neither shall any of the flesh, which thou sacrificest the first day at even, remain all night until the morning.

title: Deuteronomy 16:5
text: Thou mayest not sacrifice the passover within any of thy gates, which Jehovah thy God giveth thee;

title: Deuteronomy 16:6
text: but at the place which Jehovah thy God shall choose, to cause his name to dwell in, there thou shalt sacrifice the passover at even, at the going down of the sun, at the season that thou camest forth out of Egypt.

title: Deuteronomy 16:7
text: And thou shalt roast and eat it in the place which Jehovah thy God shall choose: and thou shalt turn in the morning, and go unto thy tents.

title: Deuteronomy 16:8
text: Six days thou shalt eat unleavened bread; and on the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to Jehovah thy God; thou shalt do no work [therein] .

title: Deuteronomy 16:9
text: Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee: from the time thou beginnest to put the sickle to the standing grain shalt thou begin to number seven weeks.

title: Deuteronomy 16:10
text: And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks unto Jehovah thy God with a tribute of a freewill-offering of thy hand, which thou shalt give, according as Jehovah thy God blesseth thee:

title: Deuteronomy 16:11
text: and thou shalt rejoice before Jehovah thy God, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy man-servant, and thy maid-servant, and the Levite that is within thy gates, and the sojourner, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are in the midst of thee, in the place which Jehovah thy God shall choose, to cause his name to dwell there.

title: Deuteronomy 16:12
text: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt: and thou shalt observe and do these statutes.

title: Deuteronomy 16:13
text: Thou shalt keep the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that thou hast gathered in from thy threshing-floor and from thy winepress:

title: Deuteronomy 16:14
text: and thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy man-servant, and thy maid-servant, and the Levite, and the sojourner, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are within thy gates.

title: Deuteronomy 16:15
text: Seven days shalt thou keep a feast unto Jehovah thy God in the place which Jehovah shall choose; because Jehovah thy God will bless thee in all thine increase, and in all the work of thy hands, and thou shalt be altogether joyful.

title: Deuteronomy 16:16
text: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before Jehovah thy God in the place which he shall choose: in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles; and they shall not appear before Jehovah empty:

title: Deuteronomy 16:17
text: every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of Jehovah thy God which he hath given thee.

title: Deuteronomy 16:18
text: Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates, which Jehovah thy God giveth thee, according to thy tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.

title: Deuteronomy 16:19
text: Thou shalt not wrest justice: thou shalt not respect persons; neither shalt thou take a bribe; for a bribe doth blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous.

title: Deuteronomy 16:20
