text: And he went up thence against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir beforetime was Kiriath-sepher.

title: Joshua 15:16
text: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kiriath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

title: Joshua 15:17
text: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

title: Joshua 15:18
text: And it came to pass, when she came [unto him], that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she alighted from off her ass; and Caleb said, What wouldest thou?

title: Joshua 15:19
text: And she said, Give me a blessing; for that thou hast set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.

title: Joshua 15:20
text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

title: Joshua 15:21
text: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,

title: Joshua 15:22
text: and Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,

title: Joshua 15:23
text: and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,

title: Joshua 15:24
text: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,

title: Joshua 15:25
text: and Hazor-hadattah, and Kerioth-hezron (the same is Hazor),

title: Joshua 15:26
text: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,

title: Joshua 15:27
text: and Hazar-gaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-pelet,

title: Joshua 15:28
text: and Hazar-shual, and Beer-sheba, and Biziothiah,

title: Joshua 15:29
text: Baalah, and Iim, and Ezem,

title: Joshua 15:30
text: and Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,

title: Joshua 15:31
text: and Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,

title: Joshua 15:32
text: and Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages.

title: Joshua 15:33
text: In the lowland, Eshtaol, and Zorah, and Ashnah,

title: Joshua 15:34
text: and Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,

title: Joshua 15:35
text: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,

title: Joshua 15:36
text: and Shaaraim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 15:37
text: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdal-gad,

title: Joshua 15:38
text: and Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,

title: Joshua 15:39
text: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,

title: Joshua 15:40
text: and Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Chitlish,

title: Joshua 15:41
text: and Gederoth, Beth-dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 15:42
text: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,

title: Joshua 15:43
text: and Iphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,

title: Joshua 15:44
text: and Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 15:45
text: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;

title: Joshua 15:46
text: from Ekron even unto the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.

title: Joshua 15:47
text: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; unto the brook of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border [thereof] .

title: Joshua 15:48
text: And in the hill-country, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,

title: Joshua 15:49
text: and Dannah, and Kiriath-sannah (the same is Debir),

title: Joshua 15:50
text: and Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,

title: Joshua 15:51
text: and Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 15:52
text: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshan,

title: Joshua 15:53
text: and Janim, and Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah,

title: Joshua 15:54
text: and Humtah, and Kiriath-arba (the same is Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 15:55
text: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Jutah,

title: Joshua 15:56
text: and Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,

title: Joshua 15:57
text: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 15:58
text: Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor,

title: Joshua 15:59
text: and Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 15:60
text: Kiriath-baal (the same is Kiriath-jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 15:61
text: In the wilderness, Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah,

title: Joshua 15:62
text: and Nibshan, and the City of Salt, and En-gedi; six cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 15:63
text: And as for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.

title: Joshua 16:1
text: And the lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, even the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill-country to Beth-el;

title: Joshua 16:2
text: and it went out from Beth-el to Luz, and passed along unto the border of the Archites to Ataroth;

title: Joshua 16:3
text: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, unto the border of Beth-horon the nether, even unto Gezer; and the goings out thereof were at the sea.

title: Joshua 16:4
text: And the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

title: Joshua 16:5
text: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was [thus] : the border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth-addar, unto Beth-horon the upper;

title: Joshua 16:6
text: and the border went out westward at Michmethath on the north; and the border turned about eastward unto Taanath-shiloh, and passed along it on the east of Janoah;

title: Joshua 16:7
text: and it went down from Janoah to Ataroth, and to Naarah, and reached unto Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.

title: Joshua 16:8
text: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;

title: Joshua 16:9
text: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the midst of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 16:10
text: And they drove not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell in the midst of Ephraim unto this day, and are become servants to do taskwork.

title: Joshua 17:1
text: And [this] was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the first-born of Joseph. As for Machir the first-born of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

title: Joshua 17:2
text: So [the lot] was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.

title: Joshua 17:3
text: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

title: Joshua 17:4
text: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, Jehovah commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren: therefore according to the commandment of Jehovah he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.

title: Joshua 17:5
text: And there fell ten parts to Manasseh, besides the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;

title: Joshua 17:6
text: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. And the land of Gilead belonged unto the rest of the sons of Manasseh.

title: Joshua 17:7
text: And the border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem; and the border went along to the right hand, unto the inhabitants of En-tappuah.

title: Joshua 17:8
text: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.

title: Joshua 17:9
text: And the border went down unto the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook: these cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh: and the border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook, and the goings out thereof were at the sea:

title: Joshua 17:10
text: southward it was Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's, and the sea was his border; and they reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.

title: Joshua 17:11
text: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth-shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of En-dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns, even the three heights.

title: Joshua 17:12
text: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out [the inhabitants of] those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

title: Joshua 17:13
text: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxed strong, that they put the Canaanites to taskwork, and did not utterly drive them out.

title: Joshua 17:14
text: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one part for an inheritance, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as hitherto Jehovah hath blessed me?

title: Joshua 17:15
text: And Joshua said unto them, If thou be a great people, get thee up to the forest, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim; since the hill-country of Ephraim is too narrow for thee.

title: Joshua 17:16
text: And the children of Joseph said, The hill-country is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are in Beth-shean and its towns, and they who are in the valley of Jezreel.

title: Joshua 17:17
text: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power; thou shalt not have one lot only:

title: Joshua 17:18
text: but the hill-country shall be thine; for though it is a forest, thou shalt cut it down, and the goings out thereof shall be thine; for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong.

title: Joshua 18:1
text: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the tent of meeting there: and the land was subdued before them.

title: Joshua 18:2
text: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet divided their inheritance.

title: Joshua 18:3
text: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go in to possess the land, which Jehovah, the God of your fathers, hath given you?

title: Joshua 18:4
text: Appoint for you three men of each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall arise, and walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; and they shall come unto me.

title: Joshua 18:5
text: And they shall divide it into seven portions: Judah shall abide in his border on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their border on the north.

title: Joshua 18:6
text: And ye shall describe the land into seven portions, and bring [the description] hither to me; and I will cast lots for you here before Jehovah our God.

title: Joshua 18:7
text: For the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of Jehovah is their inheritance: and Gad and Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan eastward, which Moses the servant of Jehovah gave them.

title: Joshua 18:8
text: And the men arose, and went: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me; and I will cast lots for you here before Jehovah in Shiloh.

title: Joshua 18:9
text: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven portions in a book; and they came to Joshua unto the camp at Shiloh.

title: Joshua 18:10
text: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before Jehovah: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.

title: Joshua 18:11
text: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

title: Joshua 18:12
text: And their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill-country westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth-aven.

title: Joshua 18:13
text: And the border passed along from thence to Luz, to the side of Luz (the same is Beth-el), southward; and the border went down to Ataroth-addar, by the mountain that lieth on the south of Beth-horon the nether.

title: Joshua 18:14
text: And the border extended [thence], and turned about on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lieth before Beth-horon southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kiriath-baal (the same is Kiriath-jearim), a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.

title: Joshua 18:15
text: And the south quarter was from the uttermost part of Kiriath-jearim; and the border went out westward, and went out to the fountain of the waters of Nephtoah;

title: Joshua 18:16
text: and the border went down to the uttermost part of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the vale of Rephaim northward; and it went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En-rogel;

title: Joshua 18:17
text: and it extended northward, and went out at En-shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is over against the ascent of Adummim; and it went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben;

title: Joshua 18:18
text: and it passed along to the side over against the Arabah northward, and went down unto the Arabah;

title: Joshua 18:19
text: and the border passed along to the side of Beth-hoglah northward; and the goings out of the border were at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan: this was the south border.

title: Joshua 18:20
text: And the Jordan was the border of it on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders thereof round about, according to their families.

title: Joshua 18:21
text: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Beth-hoglah, and Emek-keziz,

title: Joshua 18:22
text: and Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Beth-el,

title: Joshua 18:23
text: and Avvim, and Parah, and Ophrah,

title: Joshua 18:24
text: and Chephar-ammoni, and Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages:

title: Joshua 18:25
text: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,

title: Joshua 18:26
text: and Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,

title: Joshua 18:27
text: and Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,

title: Joshua 18:28
text: and Zelah, Eleph, and the Jebusite (the same is Jerusalem), Gibeath, [and] Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

title: Joshua 19:1
text: And the second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was in the midst of the inheritance of the children of Judah.

title: Joshua 19:2
text: And they had for their inheritance Beer-sheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,

title: Joshua 19:3
text: and Hazar-shual, and Balah, and Ezem,

title: Joshua 19:4
text: and Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,

title: Joshua 19:5
text: and Ziklag, and Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,

title: Joshua 19:6
text: and Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages:

title: Joshua 19:7
text: Ain, Rimmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages:

title: Joshua 19:8
text: and all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath-beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

title: Joshua 19:9
text: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the midst of their inheritance.

title: Joshua 19:10
text: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families; and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid;

title: Joshua 19:11
text: and their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth; and it reached to the brook that is before Jokneam;

title: Joshua 19:12
text: and it turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth-tabor; and it went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia;

title: Joshua 19:13
text: and from thence it passed along eastward to Gath-hepher, to Eth-kazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretcheth unto Neah;

title: Joshua 19:14
text: and the border turned about it on the north to Hannathon; and the goings out thereof were at the valley of Iphtah-el;

title: Joshua 19:15
text: and Kattath, and Nahalal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 19:16
text: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 19:17
text: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.

title: Joshua 19:18
text: And their border was unto Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,

title: Joshua 19:19
text: and Hapharaim, and Shion, and Anaharath,

title: Joshua 19:20
text: and Rabbith, and Kishion, and Ebez,

title: Joshua 19:21
text: and Remeth, and Engannim, and En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez,

title: Joshua 19:22
text: and the border reached to Tabor, and Shahazumah, and Beth-shemesh; and the goings out of their border were at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 19:23
text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 19:24
text: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

title: Joshua 19:25
text: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,

title: Joshua 19:26
text: and Allammelech, and Amad, and Mishal; and it reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihor-libnath;

title: Joshua 19:27
text: and it turned toward the sunrising to Beth-dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah-el northward to Beth-emek and Neiel; and it went out to Cabul on the left hand,

title: Joshua 19:28
text: and Ebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Sidon;

title: Joshua 19:29
text: and the border turned to Ramah, and to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea by the region of Achzib; [

title: Joshua 19:30
text: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 19:31
text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 19:32
text: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

title: Joshua 19:33
text: And their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, and Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakkum; and the goings out thereof were at the Jordan;

title: Joshua 19:34
text: and the border turned westward to Aznoth-tabor, and went out from thence to Hukkok; and it reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrising.

title: Joshua 19:35
text: And the fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,

title: Joshua 19:36
text: and Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,

title: Joshua 19:37
text: and Kedesh, and Edrei, and En-hazor,

title: Joshua 19:38
text: And Iron, and Migdal-el, Horem, and Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 19:39
text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 19:40
text: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

title: Joshua 19:41
text: And the border of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh,

title: Joshua 19:42
text: and Shaalabbin, and Aijalon, and Ithlah,

title: Joshua 19:43
text: and Elon, and Timnah, and Ekron,

title: Joshua 19:44
text: and Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,

title: Joshua 19:45
text: and Jehud, and Bene-berak, and Gath-rimmon,

title: Joshua 19:46
text: and Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border over against Joppa.

title: Joshua 19:47
text: And the border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.

title: Joshua 19:48
text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 19:49
text: So they made an end of distributing the land for inheritance by the borders thereof; and the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun in the midst of them:

title: Joshua 19:50
text: according to the commandment of Jehovah they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnath-serah in the hill-country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and dwelt therein.

title: Joshua 19:51
text: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers' [houses] of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before Jehovah, at the door of the tent of meeting. So they made an end of dividing the land.

title: Joshua 20:1
text: And Jehovah spake unto Joshua, saying,

title: Joshua 20:2
text: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Assign you the cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by Moses,

title: Joshua 20:3
text: that the manslayer that killeth any person unwittingly [and] unawares may flee thither: and they shall be unto you for a refuge from the avenger of blood.

title: Joshua 20:4
text: And he shall flee unto one of those cities, and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city; and they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.

title: Joshua 20:5
text: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver up the manslayer into his hand; because he smote his neighbor unawares, and hated him not beforetime.

title: Joshua 20:6
text: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the manslayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.

title: Joshua 20:7
text: And they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill-country of Naphtali, and Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba (the same is Hebron) in the hill-country of Judah.

title: Joshua 20:8
text: And beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

title: Joshua 20:9
text: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth any person unwittingly might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.

title: Joshua 21:1
text: Then came near the heads of fathers' [houses] of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of fathers' [houses] of the tribes of the children of Israel;

title: Joshua 21:2
text: and they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, Jehovah commanded Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.

title: Joshua 21:3
text: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of Jehovah, these cities with their suburbs.

title: Joshua 21:4
text: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of the Simeonites, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.

title: Joshua 21:5
text: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.

title: Joshua 21:6
text: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

title: Joshua 21:7
text: The children of Merari according to their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

title: Joshua 21:8
text: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as Jehovah commanded by Moses.

title: Joshua 21:9
text: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are [here] mentioned by name:

title: Joshua 21:10
text: and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot.

title: Joshua 21:11
text: And they gave them Kiriath-arba, [which Arba was] the father of Anak (the same is Hebron), in the hill-country of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.

title: Joshua 21:12
text: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

title: Joshua 21:13
text: And unto the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its suburbs, the city of refuge for the manslayer, and Libnah with its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:14
text: and Jattir with its suburbs, and Eshtemoa with its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:15
text: and Holon with its suburbs, and Debir with its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:16
text: and Ain with its suburbs, and Juttah with its suburbs, [and] Beth-shemesh with its suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.

title: Joshua 21:17
text: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its suburbs, Geba with its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:18
text: Anathoth with its suburbs, and Almon with its suburbs; four cities.

title: Joshua 21:19
text: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.

title: Joshua 21:20
text: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.

title: Joshua 21:21
text: And they gave them Shechem with its suburbs in the hill-country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the manslayer, and Gezer with its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:22
text: and Kibzaim with its suburbs, and Beth-horon with its suburbs; four cities.

title: Joshua 21:23
text: And out of the tribe of Dan, Elteke with its suburbs, Gibbethon with its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:24
text: Aijalon with its suburbs, Gath-rimmon with its suburbs; four cities.

title: Joshua 21:25
text: And out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with its suburbs; two cities.

title: Joshua 21:26
text: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their suburbs.

title: Joshua 21:27
text: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh [they gave] Golan in Bashan with its suburbs, the city of refuge for the manslayer, and Be-eshterah with its suburbs; two cities.

title: Joshua 21:28
text: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with its suburbs, Daberath with its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:29
text: Jarmuth with its suburbs, En-gannim with its suburbs; four cities.

title: Joshua 21:30
text: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with its suburbs, Abdon with its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:31
text: Helkath with its suburbs, and Rehob with its suburbs; four cities.

title: Joshua 21:32
text: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its suburbs, the city of refuge for the manslayer, and Hammoth-dor with its suburbs, and Kartan with its suburbs; three cities.

title: Joshua 21:33
text: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.

title: Joshua 21:34
text: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its suburbs, and Kartah with its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:35
text: Dimnah with its suburbs, Nahalal with its suburbs; four cities.

title: Joshua 21:36
text: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its suburbs, and Jahaz with its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:37
text: Kedemoth with its suburbs, and Mephaath with its suburbs; four cities.

title: Joshua 21:38
text: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its suburbs, the city of refuge for the manslayer, and Mahanaim with its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:39
text: Heshbon with its suburbs, Jazer with its suburbs; four cities in all.

title: Joshua 21:40
text: All [these were] the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, even the rest of the families of the Levites; and their lot was twelve cities.

title: Joshua 21:41
text: All the cities of the Levites in the midst of the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.

title: Joshua 21:42
text: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus it was with all these cities.

title: Joshua 21:43
text: So Jehovah gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.

title: Joshua 21:44
text: And Jehovah gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; Jehovah delivered all their enemies into their hand.

title: Joshua 21:45
text: There failed not aught of any good thing which Jehovah had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.

title: Joshua 22:1
text: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,

title: Joshua 22:2
text: and said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of Jehovah commanded you, and have hearkened unto my voice in all that I commanded you:

title: Joshua 22:3
text: ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of Jehovah your God.

title: Joshua 22:4
text: And now Jehovah your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he spake unto them: therefore now turn ye, and get you unto your tents, unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of Jehovah gave you beyond the Jordan.

title: Joshua 22:5
text: Only take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of Jehovah commanded you, to love Jehovah your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.

title: Joshua 22:6
text: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away; and they went unto their tents.

title: Joshua 22:7
text: Now to the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given [inheritance] in Bashan; but unto the other half gave Joshua among their brethren beyond the Jordan westward; moreover when Joshua sent them away unto their tents, he blessed them,

title: Joshua 22:8
text: and spake unto them, saying, Return with much wealth unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.

title: Joshua 22:9
text: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the commandment of Jehovah by Moses.

title: Joshua 22:10
text: And when they came unto the region about the Jordan, that is in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by the Jordan, a great altar to look upon.

title: Joshua 22:11
text: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar in the forefront of the land of Canaan, in the region about the Jordan, on the side that pertaineth to the children of Israel.

title: Joshua 22:12
text: And when the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up against them to war.

title: Joshua 22:13
text: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,

title: Joshua 22:14
text: and with him ten princes, one prince of a fathers' house for each of the tribes of Israel; and they were every one of them head of their fathers' houses among the thousands of Israel.

title: Joshua 22:15
text: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,

title: Joshua 22:16
text: Thus saith the whole congregation of Jehovah, What trespass is this that ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following Jehovah, in that ye have builded you an altar, to rebel this day against Jehovah?

title: Joshua 22:17
text: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves unto this day, although there came a plague upon the congregation of Jehovah,

title: Joshua 22:18
text: that ye must turn away this day from following Jehovah? and it will be, seeing ye rebel to-day against Jehovah, that to-morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Israel.

title: Joshua 22:19
text: Howbeit, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of Jehovah, wherein Jehovah's tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against Jehovah, nor rebel against us, in building you an altar besides the altar of Jehovah our God.

title: Joshua 22:20
text: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the devoted thing, and wrath fell upon all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.

title: Joshua 22:21
text: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered, and spake unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,

title: Joshua 22:22
text: The Mighty One, God, Jehovah, the Mighty One, God, Jehovah, he knoweth; and Israel he shall know: if it be in rebellion, or if in trespass against Jehovah (save thou us not this day,)

title: Joshua 22:23
text: that we have built us an altar to turn away from following Jehovah; or if to offer thereon burnt-offering or meal-offering, or if to offer sacrifices of peace-offerings thereon, let Jehovah himself require it;

title: Joshua 22:24
text: and if we have not [rather] out of carefulness done this, [and] of purpose, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have ye to do with Jehovah, the God of Israel?

title: Joshua 22:25
text: for Jehovah hath made the Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no portion in Jehovah: so might your children make our children cease from fearing Jehovah.

title: Joshua 22:26
text: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt-offering, nor for sacrifice:

title: Joshua 22:27
text: but it shall be a witness between us and you, and between our generations after us, that we may do the service of Jehovah before him with our burnt-offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace-offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no portion in Jehovah.

title: Joshua 22:28
text: Therefore said we, It shall be, when they so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we shall say, Behold the pattern of the altar of Jehovah, which our fathers made, not for burnt-offering, nor for sacrifice; but it is a witness between us and you.

title: Joshua 22:29
text: Far be it from us that we should rebel against Jehovah, and turn away this day from following Jehovah, to build an altar for burnt-offering, for meal-offering, or for sacrifice, besides the altar of Jehovah our God that is before his tabernacle.

title: Joshua 22:30
text: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation, even the heads of the thousands of Israel that were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them well.

title: Joshua 22:31
text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we know that Jehovah is in the midst of us, because ye have not committed this trespass against Jehovah: now have ye delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of Jehovah.

title: Joshua 22:32
text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

title: Joshua 22:33
text: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and spake no more of going up against them to war, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and the children of Gad dwelt.

title: Joshua 22:34
text: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar [Ed] : For, [said they], it is a witness between us that Jehovah is God.

title: Joshua 23:1
text: And it came to pass after many days, when Jehovah had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about, and Joshua was old and well stricken in years;

title: Joshua 23:2
text: that Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders and for their heads, and for their judges and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and well stricken in years:

title: Joshua 23:3
text: and ye have seen all that Jehovah your God hath done unto all these nations because of you; for Jehovah your God, he it is that hath fought for you.

title: Joshua 23:4
text: Behold, I have allotted unto you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun.

title: Joshua 23:5
text: And Jehovah your God, he will thrust them out from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as Jehovah your God spake unto you.

title: Joshua 23:6
text: Therefore be ye very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;

title: Joshua 23:7
text: that ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear [by them], neither serve them, nor bow down yourselves unto them;

title: Joshua 23:8
text: but cleave unto Jehovah your God, as ye have done unto this day.

title: Joshua 23:9
text: For Jehovah hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man hath stood before you unto this day.

title: Joshua 23:10
text: One man of you shall chase a thousand; for Jehovah your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he spake unto you.

title: Joshua 23:11
text: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love Jehovah your God.

title: Joshua 23:12
text: Else if ye do at all go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you;

title: Joshua 23:13
text: know for a certainty that Jehovah your God will no more drive these nations from out of your sight; but they shall be a snare and a trap unto you, and a scourge in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which Jehovah your God hath given you.

title: Joshua 23:14
text: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which Jehovah your God spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, not one thing hath failed thereof.

title: Joshua 23:15
text: And it shall come to pass, that as all the good things are come upon you of which Jehovah your God spake unto you, so will Jehovah bring upon you all the evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which Jehovah your God hath given you.

title: Joshua 23:16
text: When ye transgress the covenant of Jehovah your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow down yourselves to them; then will the anger of Jehovah be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.

title: Joshua 24:1
text: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

title: Joshua 24:2
text: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt of old time beyond the River, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor: and they served other gods.

title: Joshua 24:3
text: And I took your father Abraham from beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.

title: Joshua 24:4
text: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it: and Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

title: Joshua 24:5
text: And I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did in the midst thereof: and afterward I brought you out.

title: Joshua 24:6
text: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and with horsemen unto the Red Sea.

title: Joshua 24:7
text: And when they cried out unto Jehovah, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt: and ye dwelt in the wilderness many days.

title: Joshua 24:8
text: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, that dwelt beyond the Jordan: and they fought with you; and I gave them into your hand, and ye possessed their land; and I destroyed them from before you.

title: Joshua 24:9
text: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel: and he sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you;

title: Joshua 24:10
text: but I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.

title: Joshua 24:11
text: And ye went over the Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorite, and the Perizzite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I delivered them into your hand.

title: Joshua 24:12
text: And I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.

title: Joshua 24:13
text: And I gave you a land whereon thou hadst not labored, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell therein; of vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.

title: Joshua 24:14
text: Now therefore fear Jehovah, and serve him in sincerity and in truth; and put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, and in Egypt; and serve ye Jehovah.

title: Joshua 24:15
text: And if it seem evil unto you to serve Jehovah, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve Jehovah.

title: Joshua 24:16
text: And the people answered and said, Far be it from us that we should forsake Jehovah, to serve other gods;

title: Joshua 24:17
text: for Jehovah our God, he it is that brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and that did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the peoples through the midst of whom we passed;

title: Joshua 24:18
text: and Jehovah drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites that dwelt in the land: therefore we also will serve Jehovah; for he is our God.

title: Joshua 24:19
text: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve Jehovah; for he is a holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgression nor your sins.

title: Joshua 24:20
text: If ye forsake Jehovah, and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you evil, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.

title: Joshua 24:21
text: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve Jehovah.

title: Joshua 24:22
text: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you Jehovah, to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.

title: Joshua 24:23
text: Now therefore put away, [said he], the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto Jehovah, the God of Israel.

title: Joshua 24:24
text: And the people said unto Joshua, Jehovah our God will we serve, and unto his voice will we hearken.

title: Joshua 24:25
text: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

title: Joshua 24:26
text: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of Jehovah.

title: Joshua 24:27
text: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us; for it hath heard all the words of Jehovah which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness against you, lest ye deny your God.

title: Joshua 24:28
text: So Joshua sent the people away, every man unto his inheritance.

title: Joshua 24:29
text: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Jehovah, died, being a hundred and ten years old.

title: Joshua 24:30
text: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in the hill-country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.

title: Joshua 24:31
text: And Israel served Jehovah all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, and had known all the work of Jehovah, that he had wrought for Israel.

title: Joshua 24:32
text: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of money: and they became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

title: Joshua 24:33
text: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in the hill of Phinehas his son, which was given him in the hill-country of Ephraim.

title: Judges 1:1
text: And it came to pass after the death of Joshua, that the children of Israel asked of Jehovah, saying, Who shall go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?

title: Judges 1:2
text: And Jehovah said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.

title: Judges 1:3
text: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.

title: Judges 1:4
text: And Judah went up; and Jehovah delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they smote of them in Bezek ten thousand men.

title: Judges 1:5
text: And they found Adoni-bezek in Bezek; and they fought against him, and they smote the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

title: Judges 1:6
text: But Adoni-bezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.

title: Judges 1:7
text: And Adoni-bezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered [their food] under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

title: Judges 1:8
text: And the children of Judah fought against Jerusalem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

title: Judges 1:9
text: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites that dwelt in the hill-country, and in the South, and in the lowland.

title: Judges 1:10
text: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron (now the name of Hebron beforetime was Kiriath-arba); and they smote Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.

title: Judges 1:11
text: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (Now the name of Debir beforetime was Kiriath-sepher.)

title: Judges 1:12
text: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kiriath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

title: Judges 1:13
text: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

title: Judges 1:14
text: And it came to pass, when she came [unto him], that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she alighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?

title: Judges 1:15
text: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing; for that thou hast set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.

title: Judges 1:16
text: And the children of the Kenite, Moses' brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm-trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt with the people.

title: Judges 1:17
text: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they smote the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.

title: Judges 1:18
text: Also Judah took Gaza with the border thereof, and Ashkelon with the border thereof, and Ekron with the border thereof.

title: Judges 1:19
text: And Jehovah was with Judah; and drove out [the inhabitants of] the hill-country; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

title: Judges 1:20
text: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses had spoken: and he drove out thence the three sons of Anak.

title: Judges 1:21
text: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.

title: Judges 1:22
text: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Beth-el; and Jehovah was with them.

title: Judges 1:23
text: And the house of Joseph sent to spy out Beth-el. (Now the name of the city beforetime was Luz.)

title: Judges 1:24
text: And the watchers saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Show us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will deal kindly with thee.

title: Judges 1:25
text: And he showed them the entrance into the city; and they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man go and all his family.

title: Judges 1:26
text: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz, which is the name thereof unto this day.

title: Judges 1:27
text: And Manasseh did not drive out [the inhabitants of] Beth-shean and its towns, nor [of] Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

title: Judges 1:28
text: And it came to pass, when Israel was waxed strong, that they put the Canaanites to taskwork, and did not utterly drive them out.

title: Judges 1:29
text: And Ephraim drove not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.

title: Judges 1:30
text: Zebulun drove not out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became subject to taskwork.

title: Judges 1:31
text: Asher drove not out the inhabitants of Acco, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob;

title: Judges 1:32
text: but the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land; for they did not drive them out.

title: Judges 1:33
text: Naphtali drove not out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth-anath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and of Beth-anath became subject to taskwork.

title: Judges 1:34
text: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill-country; for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley;

title: Judges 1:35
text: but the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to taskwork.

title: Judges 1:36
text: And the border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.

title: Judges 2:1
text: And the angel of Jehovah came up from Gilgal to Bochim. And he said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you:

title: Judges 2:2
text: and ye shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall break down their altars. But ye have not hearkened unto my voice: why have ye done this?

title: Judges 2:3
text: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be [as thorns] in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.

title: Judges 2:4
text: And it came to pass, when the angel of Jehovah spake these words unto all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.

title: Judges 2:5
text: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto Jehovah.

title: Judges 2:6
text: Now when Joshua had sent the people away, the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.

title: Judges 2:7
text: And the people served Jehovah all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great work of Jehovah that he had wrought for Israel.

title: Judges 2:8
text: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Jehovah, died, being a hundred and ten years old.

title: Judges 2:9
text: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-heres, in the hill-country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.

title: Judges 2:10
text: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, that knew not Jehovah, nor yet the work which he had wrought for Israel.

title: Judges 2:11
text: And the children of Israel did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, and served the Baalim;

title: Judges 2:12
text: and they forsook Jehovah, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the peoples that were round about them, and bowed themselves down unto them: and they provoked Jehovah to anger.

title: Judges 2:13
text: And they forsook Jehovah, and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.

title: Judges 2:14
text: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that despoiled them; and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.

title: Judges 2:15
text: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of Jehovah was against them for evil, as Jehovah had spoken, and as Jehovah had sworn unto them: and they were sore distressed.

title: Judges 2:16
text: And Jehovah raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those that despoiled them.

title: Judges 2:17
text: And yet they hearkened not unto their judges; for they played the harlot after other gods, and bowed themselves down unto them: they turned aside quickly out of the way wherein their fathers walked, obeying the commandments of Jehovah; [but] they did not so.

title: Judges 2:18
text: And when Jehovah raised them up judges, then Jehovah was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented Jehovah because of their groaning by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.

title: Judges 2:19
text: But it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they turned back, and dealt more corruptly than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their doings, nor from their stubborn way.

title: Judges 2:20
text: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel; and he said, Because this nation have transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;

title: Judges 2:21
text: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations that Joshua left when he died;

title: Judges 2:22
text: that by them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of Jehovah to walk therein, as their fathers did keep it, or not.

title: Judges 2:23
text: So Jehovah left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.

title: Judges 3:1
text: Now these are the nations which Jehovah left, to prove Israel by them, even as many [of Israel] as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

title: Judges 3:2
text: only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as beforetime knew nothing thereof:

title: Judges 3:3
text: [ namely], the five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baal-hermon unto the entrance of Hamath.

title: Judges 3:4
text: And they were [left], to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of Jehovah, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.

title: Judges 3:5
text: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites:

title: Judges 3:6
text: and they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods.

title: Judges 3:7
text: And the children of Israel did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, and forgat Jehovah their God, and served the Baalim and the Asheroth.

title: Judges 3:8
text: Therefore the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Cushan-rishathaim eight years.

title: Judges 3:9
text: And when the children of Israel cried unto Jehovah, Jehovah raised up a saviour to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.

title: Judges 3:10
text: And the Spirit of Jehovah came upon him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and Jehovah delivered Cushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand: and his hand prevailed against Cushan-rishathaim.

title: Judges 3:11
text: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

title: Judges 3:12
text: And the children of Israel again did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah: and Jehovah strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah.

title: Judges 3:13
text: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek; and he went and smote Israel, and they possessed the city of palm-trees.

title: Judges 3:14
text: And the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

title: Judges 3:15
text: But when the children of Israel cried unto Jehovah, Jehovah raised them up a saviour, Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a man left-handed. And the children of Israel sent tribute by him unto Eglon the king of Moab.

title: Judges 3:16
text: And Ehud made him a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he girded it under his raiment upon his right thigh.

title: Judges 3:17
text: And he offered the tribute unto Eglon king of Moab: now Eglon was a very fat man.

title: Judges 3:18
text: And when he had made an end of offering the tribute, he sent away the people that bare the tribute.

title: Judges 3:19
text: But he himself turned back from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king. And he said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.

title: Judges 3:20
text: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. And Ehud said, I have a message from God unto thee. And he arose out of his seat.

title: Judges 3:21
text: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body:

title: Judges 3:22
text: and the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, for he drew not the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.

title: Judges 3:23
text: Then Ehud went forth into the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room upon him, and locked them.

title: Judges 3:24
text: Now when he was gone out, his servants came; and they saw, and, behold, the doors of the upper room were locked; and they said, Surely he is covering his feet in the upper chamber.

title: Judges 3:25
text: And they tarried till they were ashamed; and, behold, he opened not the doors of the upper room: therefore they took the key, and opened [them], and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.

title: Judges 3:26
text: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirah.

title: Judges 3:27
text: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the hill-country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill-country, and he before them.

title: Judges 3:28
text: And he said unto them, Follow after me; for Jehovah hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and suffered not a man to pass over.

title: Judges 3:29
text: And they smote of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, every lusty man, and every man of valor; and there escaped not a man.

title: Judges 3:30
text: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.

title: Judges 3:31
text: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who smote of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox-goad: and he also saved Israel.

title: Judges 4:1
text: And the children of Israel again did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, when Ehud was dead.

title: Judges 4:2
text: And Jehovah sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, who dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

title: Judges 4:3
text: And the children of Israel cried unto Jehovah: for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.

title: Judges 4:4
text: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, she judged Israel at that time.

title: Judges 4:5
text: And she dwelt under the palm-tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth-el in the hill-country of Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

title: Judges 4:6
text: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh-naphtali, and said unto him, Hath not Jehovah, the God of Israel, commanded, [saying], Go and draw unto mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

title: Judges 4:7
text: And I will draw unto thee, to the river Kishon, Sisera, the captain of Jabin's army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into thy hand.

title: Judges 4:8
text: And Barak said unto her, If thou wilt go with me, then I will go; but if thou wilt not go with me, I will not go.

title: Judges 4:9
text: And she said, I will surely go with thee: notwithstanding, the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honor; for Jehovah will sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

title: Judges 4:10
text: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh; and there went up ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.

title: Judges 4:11
text: Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites, even from the children of Hobab the brother-in-law of Moses, and had pitched his tent as far as the oak in Zaanannim, which is by Kedesh.

title: Judges 4:12
text: And they told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.

title: Judges 4:13
text: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles, unto the river Kishon.

title: Judges 4:14
text: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which Jehovah hath delivered Sisera into thy hand; is not Jehovah gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

title: Judges 4:15
text: And Jehovah discomfited Sisera, and all his chariots, and all his host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; and Sisera alighted from his chariot, and fled away on his feet.

title: Judges 4:16
text: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword; there was not a man left.

title: Judges 4:17
text: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

title: Judges 4:18
text: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And he turned in unto her into the tent, and she covered him with a rug.

title: Judges 4:19
text: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.

title: Judges 4:20
text: And he said unto her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man doth come and inquire of thee, and say, Is there any man here? that thou shalt say, No.

title: Judges 4:21
text: Then Jael Heber's wife took a tent-pin, and took a hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the pin into his temples, and it pierced through into the ground; for he was in a deep sleep; so he swooned and died.

title: Judges 4:22
text: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will show thee the man whom thou seekest. And he came unto her; and, behold, Sisera lay dead, and the tent-pin was in his temples.

title: Judges 4:23
text: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel.

title: Judges 4:24
text: And the hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.

title: Judges 5:1
text: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,

title: Judges 5:2
text: For that the leaders took the lead in Israel, For that the people offered themselves willingly, Bless ye Jehovah.

title: Judges 5:3
text: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, [even] I, will sing unto Jehovah; I will sing praise to Jehovah, the God of Israel.

title: Judges 5:4
text: Jehovah, when thou wentest forth out of Seir, When thou marchedst out of the field of Edom, The earth trembled, the heavens also dropped, Yea, the clouds dropped water.

title: Judges 5:5
text: The mountains quaked at the presence of Jehovah, Even yon Sinai at the presence of Jehovah, the God of Israel.

title: Judges 5:6
text: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, In the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, And the travellers walked through byways.

title: Judges 5:7
text: The rulers ceased in Israel, they ceased, Until that I Deborah arose, That I arose a mother in Israel.

title: Judges 5:8
text: They chose new gods; Then was war in the gates: Was there a shield or spear seen Among forty thousand in Israel?

title: Judges 5:9
text: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, That offered themselves willingly among the people: Bless ye Jehovah.

title: Judges 5:10
text: Tell [of it], ye that ride on white asses, Ye that sit on rich carpets, And ye that walk by the way.

title: Judges 5:11
text: Far from the noise of archers, in the places of drawing water, There shall they rehearse the righteous acts of Jehovah, [Even] the righteous acts of his rule in Israel. Then the people of Jehovah went down to the gates.

title: Judges 5:12
text: Awake, awake, Deborah; Awake, awake, utter a song: Arise, Barak, and lead away thy captives, thou son of Abinoam.

title: Judges 5:13
text: Then came down a remnant of the nobles [and] the people; Jehovah came down for me against the mighty.

title: Judges 5:14
text: Out of Ephraim [came down] they whose root is in Amalek; After thee, Benjamin, among thy peoples; Out of Machir came down governors, And out of Zebulun they that handle the marshal's staff.

title: Judges 5:15
text: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; As was Issachar, so was Barak; Into the valley they rushed forth at his feet. By the watercourses of Reuben There were great resolves of heart. [

title: Judges 5:16
text: Why sattest thou among the sheepfolds, To hear the pipings for the flocks? At the watercourses of Reuben There were great searchings of heart.

title: Judges 5:17
text: Gilead abode beyond the Jordan: And Dan, why did he remain in ships? Asher sat still at the haven of the sea, And abode by his creeks.

title: Judges 5:18
text: Zebulun was a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death, And Naphtali, upon the high places of the field.

title: Judges 5:19
text: The kings came and fought; Then fought the kings of Canaan. In Taanach by the waters of Megiddo: They took no gain of money.

title: Judges 5:20
text: From heaven fought the stars, From their courses they fought against Sisera.

title: Judges 5:21
text: The river Kishon swept them away, That ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, march on with strength.

title: Judges 5:22
text: Then did the horsehoofs stamp By reason of the prancings, the prancings of their strong ones.

title: Judges 5:23
text: Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of Jehovah. Curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof, Because they came not to the help of Jehovah, To the help of Jehovah against the mighty.

title: Judges 5:24
text: Blessed above women shall Jael be, The wife of Heber the Kenite; Blessed shall she be above women in the tent.

title: Judges 5:25
text: He asked water, [and] she gave him milk; She brought him butter in a lordly dish.

title: Judges 5:26
text: She put her hand to the tent-pin, And her right hand to the workmen's hammer; And with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote through his head; Yea, she pierced and struck through his temples.

title: Judges 5:27
text: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay; At her feet he bowed, he fell; Where he bowed, there he fell down dead.

title: Judges 5:28
text: Through the window she looked forth, and cried, The mother of Sisera [cried] through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why tarry the wheels of his chariots?

title: Judges 5:29
text: Her wise ladies answered her, Yea, she returned answer to herself,

title: Judges 5:30
text: Have they not found, have they not divided the spoil? A damsel, two damsels to every man; To Sisera a spoil of dyed garments, A spoil of dyed garments embroidered, Of dyed garments embroidered on both sides, on the necks of the spoil?

title: Judges 5:31
text: So let all thine enemies perish, O Jehovah: But let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.

title: Judges 6:1
text: And the children of Israel did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah: and Jehovah delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.

title: Judges 6:2
text: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel; and because of Midian the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains, and the caves, and the strongholds.

title: Judges 6:3
text: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east; they came up against them;

title: Judges 6:4
text: and they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till thou come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance in Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.

title: Judges 6:5
text: For they came up with their cattle and their tents; they came in as locusts for multitude; both they and their camels were without number: and they came into the land to destroy it.

title: Judges 6:6
text: And Israel was brought very low because of Midian; and the children of Israel cried unto Jehovah.

title: Judges 6:7
text: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel cried unto Jehovah because of Midian,

title: Judges 6:8
text: that Jehovah sent a prophet unto the children of Israel: and he said unto them, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;

title: Judges 6:9
text: and I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drove them out from before you, and gave you their land;

title: Judges 6:10
text: and I said unto you, I am Jehovah your God; ye shall not fear the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell. But ye have not hearkened unto my voice.

title: Judges 6:11
text: And the angel of Jehovah came, and sat under the oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abiezrite: and his son Gideon was beating out wheat in the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.

title: Judges 6:12
text: And the angel of Jehovah appeared unto him, and said unto him, Jehovah is with thee, thou mighty man of valor.

title: Judges 6:13
text: And Gideon said unto him, Oh, my lord, if Jehovah is with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where are all his wondrous works which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not Jehovah bring us up from Egypt? but now Jehovah hath cast us off, and delivered us into the hand of Midian.

title: Judges 6:14
text: And Jehovah looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and save Israel from the hand of Midian: have not I sent thee?

title: Judges 6:15
text: And he said unto him, Oh, Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is the poorest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.

title: Judges 6:16
text: And Jehovah said unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.

title: Judges 6:17
text: And he said unto him, If now I have found favor in thy sight, then show me a sign that it is thou that talkest with me.

title: Judges 6:18
text: Depart not hence, I pray thee, until I come unto thee, and bring forth my present, and lay it before thee. And he said, I will tarry until thou come again.

title: Judges 6:19
text: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of meal: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out unto him under the oak, and presented it.

title: Judges 6:20
text: And the angel of God said unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.

title: Judges 6:21
text: Then the angel of Jehovah put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there went up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and the angel of Jehovah departed out of his sight.

title: Judges 6:22
text: And Gideon saw that he was the angel of Jehovah; and Gideon said, Alas, O Lord Jehovah! forasmuch as I have seen the angel of Jehovah face to face.

title: Judges 6:23
text: And Jehovah said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.

title: Judges 6:24
text: Then Gideon built an altar there unto Jehovah, and called it Jehovah-shalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

title: Judges 6:25
text: And it came to pass the same night, that Jehovah said unto him, Take thy father's bullock, even the second bullock seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath, and cut down the Asherah that is by it;

title: Judges 6:26
text: and build an altar unto Jehovah thy God upon the top of this stronghold, in the orderly manner, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt-offering with the wood of the Asherah which thou shalt cut down.

title: Judges 6:27
text: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as Jehovah had spoken unto him: and it came to pass, because he feared his father's household and the men of the city, so that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.

title: Judges 6:28
text: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was broken down, and the Asherah was cut down that was by it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built.

title: Judges 6:29
text: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they inquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.

title: Judges 6:30
text: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die, because he hath broken down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the Asherah that was by it.

title: Judges 6:31
text: And Joash said unto all that stood against him, Will ye contend for Baal? Or will ye save him? he that will contend for him, let him be put to death whilst [it is yet] morning: if he be a god, let him contend for himself, because one hath broken down his altar.

title: Judges 6:32
