text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt-offerings and peace-offerings.

title: Judges 21:5
text: And the children of Israel said, Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up in the assembly unto Jehovah? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up unto Jehovah to Mizpah, saying, He shall surely be put to death.

title: Judges 21:6
text: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.

title: Judges 21:7
text: How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing we have sworn by Jehovah that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?

title: Judges 21:8
text: And they said, What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up unto Jehovah to Mizpah? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly.

title: Judges 21:9
text: For when the people were numbered, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead there.

title: Judges 21:10
text: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest, and commanded them, saying, Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the little ones.

title: Judges 21:11
text: And this is the thing that ye shall do: ye shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that hath lain by man.

title: Judges 21:12
text: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins, that had not known man by lying with him; and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

title: Judges 21:13
text: And the whole congregation sent and spake to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock of Rimmon, and proclaimed peace unto them.

title: Judges 21:14
text: And Benjamin returned at that time; and they gave them the women whom they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh-gilead: and yet so they sufficed them not.

title: Judges 21:15
text: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that Jehovah had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.

title: Judges 21:16
text: Then the elders of the congregation said, How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?

title: Judges 21:17
text: And they said, There must be an inheritance for them that are escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not blotted out from Israel.

title: Judges 21:18
text: Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters, for the children of Israel had sworn, saying, Cursed be he that giveth a wife to Benjamin.

title: Judges 21:19
text: And they said, Behold, there is a feast of Jehovah from year to year in Shiloh, which is on the north of Beth-el, on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Beth-el to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.

title: Judges 21:20
text: And they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards,

title: Judges 21:21
text: and see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in the dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

title: Judges 21:22
text: And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come to complain unto us, that we will say unto them, Grant them graciously unto us, because we took not for each man [of them] his wife in battle, neither did ye give them unto them, else would ye now be guilty.

title: Judges 21:23
text: And the children of Benjamin did so, and took them wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they carried off: and they went and returned unto their inheritance, and built the cities, and dwelt in them.

title: Judges 21:24
text: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.

title: Judges 21:25
text: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did that which was right in his own eyes.

title: Ruth 1:1
text: And it came to pass in the days when the judges judged, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Beth-lehem-judah went to sojourn in the country of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.

title: Ruth 1:2
text: And the name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Beth-lehem-judah. And they came into the country of Moab, and continued there.

title: Ruth 1:3
text: And Elimelech, Naomi's husband, died; and she was left, and her two sons.

title: Ruth 1:4
text: And they took them wives of the women of Moab; the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth: and they dwelt there about ten years.

title: Ruth 1:5
text: And Mahlon and Chilion died both of them; and the woman was left of her two children and of her husband.

title: Ruth 1:6
text: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law, that she might return from the country of Moab: for she had heard in the country of Moab how that Jehovah had visited his people in giving them bread.

title: Ruth 1:7
text: And she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah.

title: Ruth 1:8
text: And Naomi said unto her two daughters-in-law, Go, return each of you to her mother's house: Jehovah deal kindly with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.

title: Ruth 1:9
text: Jehovah grant you that ye may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband. Then she kissed them, and they lifted up their voice, and wept.

title: Ruth 1:10
text: And they said unto her, Nay, but we will return with thee unto thy people.

title: Ruth 1:11
text: And Naomi said, Turn again, my daughters: why will ye go with me? have I yet sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?

title: Ruth 1:12
text: Turn again, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have a husband. If I should say, I have hope, if I should even have a husband to-night, and should also bear sons;

title: Ruth 1:13
text: would ye therefore tarry till they were grown? would ye therefore stay from having husbands? nay, my daughters, for it grieveth me much for your sakes, for the hand of Jehovah is gone forth against me.

title: Ruth 1:14
text: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth clave unto her.

title: Ruth 1:15
text: And she said, Behold, thy sister-in-law is gone back unto her people, and unto her god: return thou after thy sister-in-law.

title: Ruth 1:16
text: And Ruth said, Entreat me not to leave thee, and to return from following after thee, for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge; thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God;

title: Ruth 1:17
text: where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: Jehovah do so to me, and more also, if aught but death part thee and me.

title: Ruth 1:18
text: And when she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her, she left off speaking unto her.

title: Ruth 1:19
text: So they two went until they came to Beth-lehem. And it came to pass, when they were come to Beth-lehem, that all the city was moved about them, and [the women] said, Is this Naomi?

title: Ruth 1:20
text: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara; for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.

title: Ruth 1:21
text: I went out full, and Jehovah hath brought me home again empty; why call ye me Naomi, seeing Jehovah hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?

title: Ruth 1:22
text: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter-in-law, with her, who returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Beth-lehem in the beginning of barley harvest.

title: Ruth 2:1
text: And Naomi had a kinsman of her husband's, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech, and his name was Boaz.

title: Ruth 2:2
text: And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi, Let me now go to the field, and glean among the ears of grain after him in whose sight I shall find favor. And she said unto her, Go, my daughter.

title: Ruth 2:3
text: And she went, and came and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her hap was to light on the portion of the field belonging unto Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech.

title: Ruth 2:4
text: And, behold, Boaz came from Beth-lehem, and said unto the reapers, Jehovah be with you. And they answered him, Jehovah bless thee.

title: Ruth 2:5
text: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers, Whose damsel is this?

title: Ruth 2:6
text: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said, It is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab:

title: Ruth 2:7
text: And she said, Let me glean, I pray you, and gather after the reapers among the sheaves. So she came, and hath continued even from the morning until now, save that she tarried a little in the house.

title: Ruth 2:8
text: Then said Boaz unto Ruth, Hearest thou not, my daughter? Go not to glean in another field, neither pass from hence, but abide here fast by my maidens.

title: Ruth 2:9
text: Let thine eyes be on the field that they do reap, and go thou after them: have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch thee? and when thou art athirst, go unto the vessels, and drink of that which the young men have drawn.

title: Ruth 2:10
text: Then she fell on her face, and bowed herself to the ground, and said unto him, Why have I found favor in thy sight, that thou shouldest take knowledge of me, seeing I am a foreigner?

title: Ruth 2:11
text: And Boaz answered and said unto her, It hath fully been showed me, all that thou hast done unto thy mother-in-law since the death of thy husband; and how thou hast left thy father and thy mother, and the land of thy nativity, and art come unto a people that thou knewest not heretofore.

title: Ruth 2:12
text: Jehovah recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of Jehovah, the God of Israel, under whose wings thou art come to take refuge.

title: Ruth 2:13
text: Then she said, Let me find favor in thy sight, my lord, for that thou hast comforted me, and for that thou hast spoken kindly unto thy handmaid, though I be not as one of thy handmaidens.

title: Ruth 2:14
text: And at meal-time Boaz said unto her, Come hither, and eat of the bread, and dip thy morsel in the vinegar. And she sat beside the reapers, and they reached her parched grain, and she did eat, and was sufficed, and left thereof.

title: Ruth 2:15
text: And when she was risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, Let her glean even among the sheaves, and reproach her not.

title: Ruth 2:16
text: And also pull out some for her from the bundles, and leave it, and let her glean, and rebuke her not.

title: Ruth 2:17
text: So she gleaned in the field until even; and she beat out that which she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah of barley.

title: Ruth 2:18
text: And she took it up, and went into the city; and her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned: and she brought forth and gave to her that which she had left after she was sufficed.

title: Ruth 2:19
text: And her mother-in-law said unto her, Where hast thou gleaned to-day? and where hast thou wrought? blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee. And she showed her mother-in-law with whom she had wrought, and said, The man's name with whom I wrought to-day is Boaz.

title: Ruth 2:20
text: And Naomi said unto her daughter-in-law, Blessed be he of Jehovah, who hath not left off his kindness to the living and to the dead. And Naomi said unto her, The man is nigh of kin unto us, one of our near kinsmen.

title: Ruth 2:21
text: And Ruth the Moabitess said, Yea, he said unto me, Thou shalt keep fast by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.

title: Ruth 2:22
text: And Naomi said unto Ruth her daughter-in-law, It is good, my daughter, that thou go out with his maidens, and that they meet thee not in any other field.

title: Ruth 2:23
text: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz, to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and she dwelt with her mother-in-law.

title: Ruth 3:1
text: And Naomi her mother-in-law said unto her, My daughter, shall I not seek rest for thee, that it may be well with thee?

title: Ruth 3:2
text: And now is not Boaz our kinsman, with whose maidens thou wast? Behold, he winnoweth barley to-night in the threshing-floor.

title: Ruth 3:3
text: Wash thyself therefore, and anoint thee, and put thy raiment upon thee, and get thee down to the threshing-floor, but make not thyself known unto the man, until he shall have done eating and drinking.

title: Ruth 3:4
text: And it shall be, when he lieth down, that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie, and thou shalt go in, and uncover his feet, and lay thee down; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do.

title: Ruth 3:5
text: And she said unto her, All that thou sayest I will do.

title: Ruth 3:6
text: And she went down unto the threshing-floor, and did according to all that her mother-in-law bade her.

title: Ruth 3:7
text: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain: and she came softly, and uncovered his feet, and laid her down.

title: Ruth 3:8
text: And it came to pass at midnight, that the man was afraid, and turned himself; and, behold, a woman lay at his feet.

title: Ruth 3:9
text: And he said, Who art thou? And she answered, I am Ruth thy handmaid: spread therefore thy skirt over thy handmaid; for thou art a near kinsman.

title: Ruth 3:10
text: And he said, Blessed be thou of Jehovah, my daughter: thou hast showed more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, inasmuch as thou followedst not young men, whether poor or rich.

title: Ruth 3:11
text: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou sayest; for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a worthy woman.

title: Ruth 3:12
text: And now it is true that I am a near kinsman; howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I.

title: Ruth 3:13
text: Tarry this night, and it shall be in the morning, that if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman, well; let him do the kinsman's part: but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee, then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee, as Jehovah liveth: lie down until the morning.

title: Ruth 3:14
text: And she lay at his feet until the morning. And she rose up before one could discern another. For he said, Let it not be known that the woman came to the threshing-floor.

title: Ruth 3:15
text: And he said, Bring the mantle that is upon thee, and hold it; and she held it; and he measured six [measures] of barley, and laid it on her: and he went into the city.

title: Ruth 3:16
text: And when she came to her mother-in-law, she said, Who art thou, my daughter? And she told her all that the man had done to her.

title: Ruth 3:17
text: And she said, These six [measures] of barley gave he me; for he said, Go not empty unto thy mother-in-law.

title: Ruth 3:18
text: Then said she, Sit still, my daughter, until thou know how the matter will fall; for the man will not rest, until he have finished the thing this day.

title: Ruth 4:1
text: Now Boaz went up to the gate, and sat him down there: and, behold, the near kinsman of whom Boaz spake came by; unto whom he said, Ho, such a one! turn aside, sit down here. And he turned aside, and sat down.

title: Ruth 4:2
text: And he took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, Sit ye down here. And they sat down.

title: Ruth 4:3
text: And he said unto the near kinsman, Naomi, that is come again out of the country of Moab, selleth the parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech's:

title: Ruth 4:4
text: And I thought to disclose it unto thee, saying, Buy it before them that sit here, and before the elders of my people. If thou wilt redeem it, redeem it: but if thou wilt not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know; for there is none to redeem it besides thee; and I am after thee. And he said, I will redeem it.

title: Ruth 4:5
text: Then said Boaz, What day thou buyest the field of the hand of Naomi, thou must buy it also of Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance.

title: Ruth 4:6
text: And the near kinsman said, I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I mar mine own inheritance: take thou my right of redemption on thee; for I cannot redeem it.

title: Ruth 4:7
text: Now this was [the custom] in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning exchanging, to confirm all things: a man drew off his shoe, and gave it to his neighbor; and this was the [manner of] attestation in Israel.

title: Ruth 4:8
text: So the near kinsman said unto Boaz, Buy it for thyself. And he drew off his shoe.

title: Ruth 4:9
text: And Boaz said unto the elders, and unto all the people, Ye are witnesses this day, that I have bought all that was Elimelech's, and all that was Chilion's and Mahlon's, of the hand of Naomi.

title: Ruth 4:10
text: Moreover Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, have I purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, that the name of the dead be not cut off from among his brethren, and from the gate of his place: ye are witnesses this day.

title: Ruth 4:11
text: And all the people that were in the gate, and the elders, said, We are witnesses. Jehovah make the woman that is come into thy house like Rachel and like Leah, which two did build the house of Israel: and do thou worthily in Ephrathah, and be famous in Beth-lehem:

title: Ruth 4:12
text: and let thy house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bare unto Judah, of the seed which Jehovah shall give thee of this young woman.

title: Ruth 4:13
text: So Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife; and he went in unto her, and Jehovah gave her conception, and she bare a son.

title: Ruth 4:14
text: And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be Jehovah, who hath not left thee this day without a near kinsman; and let his name be famous in Israel.

title: Ruth 4:15
text: And he shall be unto thee a restorer of life, and a nourisher of thine old age, for thy daughter-in-law, who loveth thee, who is better to thee than seven sons, hath borne him.

title: Ruth 4:16
text: And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it.

title: Ruth 4:17
text: And the women her neighbors gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.

title: Ruth 4:18
text: Now these are the generations of Perez: Perez begat Hezron,

title: Ruth 4:19
text: and Hezron begat Ram, and Ram begat Amminadab,

title: Ruth 4:20
text: and Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon,

title: Ruth 4:21
text: and Salmon begat Boaz, and Boaz begat Obed,

title: Ruth 4:22
text: and Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.

title: 1 Samuel 1:1
text: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim-zophim, of the hill-country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite:

title: 1 Samuel 1:2
text: and he had two wives; the name of the one was Hannah, and the name of other Peninnah: and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.

title: 1 Samuel 1:3
text: And this man went up out of his city from year to year to worship and to sacrifice unto Jehovah of hosts in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, priests unto Jehovah, were there.

title: 1 Samuel 1:4
text: And when the day came that Elkanah sacrificed, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions:

title: 1 Samuel 1:5
text: but unto Hannah he gave a double portion; for he loved Hannah, but Jehovah had shut up her womb.

title: 1 Samuel 1:6
text: And her rival provoked her sore, to make her fret, because Jehovah had shut up her womb.

title: 1 Samuel 1:7
text: And [as] he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of Jehovah, so she provoked her; therefore she wept, and did not eat.

title: 1 Samuel 1:8
text: And Elkanah her husband said unto her, Hannah, why weepest thou? and why eatest thou not? and why is thy heart grieved? am not I better to thee than ten sons?

title: 1 Samuel 1:9
text: So Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh, and after they had drunk. Now Eli the priest was sitting upon his seat by the door-post of the temple of Jehovah.

title: 1 Samuel 1:10
text: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto Jehovah, and wept sore.

title: 1 Samuel 1:11
text: And she vowed a vow, and said, O Jehovah of hosts, if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thy handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thy handmaid, but wilt give unto thy handmaid a man-child, then I will give him unto Jehovah all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.

title: 1 Samuel 1:12
text: And it came to pass, as she continued praying before Jehovah, that Eli marked her mouth.

title: 1 Samuel 1:13
text: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.

title: 1 Samuel 1:14
text: And Eli said unto her, How long wilt thou be drunken? put away thy wine from thee.

title: 1 Samuel 1:15
text: And Hannah answered and said, No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but I poured out my soul before Jehovah.

title: 1 Samuel 1:16
text: Count not thy handmaid for a wicked woman; for out of the abundance of my complaint and my provocation have I spoken hitherto.

title: 1 Samuel 1:17
text: Then Eli answered and said, Go in peace; and the God of Israel grant thy petition that thou hast asked of him.

title: 1 Samuel 1:18
text: And she said, Let thy handmaid find favor in thy sight. So the woman went her way, and did eat; and her countenance was no more [sad] .

title: 1 Samuel 1:19
text: And they rose up in the morning early, and worshipped before Jehovah, and returned, and came to their house to Ramah: and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and Jehovah remembered her.

title: 1 Samuel 1:20
text: And it came to pass, when the time was come about, that Hannah conceived, and bare a son; and she called his name Samuel, [saying], Because I have asked him of Jehovah.

title: 1 Samuel 1:21
text: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto Jehovah the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.

title: 1 Samuel 1:22
text: But Hannah went not up; for she said unto her husband, [I will not go up] until the child be weaned; and then I will bring him, that he may appear before Jehovah, and there abide for ever.

title: 1 Samuel 1:23
text: And Elkanah her husband said unto her, Do what seemeth thee good; tarry until thou have weaned him; only Jehovah establish his word. So the woman tarried and gave her son suck, until she weaned him.

title: 1 Samuel 1:24
text: And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bullocks, and one ephah of meal, and a bottle of wine, and brought him unto the house of Jehovah in Shiloh: and the child was young.

title: 1 Samuel 1:25
text: And they slew the bullock, and brought the child to Eli.

title: 1 Samuel 1:26
text: And she said, Oh, my lord, as thy soul liveth, my lord, I am the woman that stood by thee here, praying unto Jehovah.

title: 1 Samuel 1:27
text: For this child I prayed; and Jehovah hath given me my petition which I asked of him:

title: 1 Samuel 1:28
text: therefore also I have granted him to Jehovah; as long as he liveth he is granted to Jehovah. And he worshipped Jehovah there.

title: 1 Samuel 2:1
text: And Hannah prayed, and said: My heart exulteth in Jehovah; My horn is exalted in Jehovah; My mouth is enlarged over mine enemies; Because I rejoice in thy salvation.

title: 1 Samuel 2:2
text: There is none holy as Jehovah; For there is none besides thee, Neither is there any rock like our God.

title: 1 Samuel 2:3
text: Talk no more so exceeding proudly; Let not arrogancy come out of your mouth; For Jehovah is a God of knowledge, And by him actions are weighed.

title: 1 Samuel 2:4
text: The bows of the mighty men are broken; And they that stumbled are girded with strength.

title: 1 Samuel 2:5
text: They that were full have hired out themselves for bread; And they that were hungry have ceased [to hunger] : Yea, the barren hath borne seven; And she that hath many children languisheth. [

title: 1 Samuel 2:6
text: Jehovah killeth, and maketh alive: He bringeth down to Sheol, and bringeth up.

title: 1 Samuel 2:7
text: Jehovah maketh poor, and maketh rich: He bringeth low, he also lifteth up.

title: 1 Samuel 2:8
text: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, He lifteth up the needy from the dunghill, To make them sit with princes, And inherit the throne of glory: For the pillars of the earth are Jehovah's, And he hath set the world upon them.

title: 1 Samuel 2:9
text: He will keep the feet of his holy ones; But the wicked shall be put to silence in darkness; For by strength shall no man prevail.

title: 1 Samuel 2:10
text: They that strive with Jehovah shall be broken to pieces; Against them will he thunder in heaven: Jehovah will judge the ends of the earth; And he will give strength unto his king, And exalt the horn of his anointed.

title: 1 Samuel 2:11
text: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child did minister unto Jehovah before Eli the priest.

title: 1 Samuel 2:12
text: Now the sons of Eli were base men; they knew not Jehovah.

title: 1 Samuel 2:13
text: And the custom of the priests with the people was, that, when any man offered sacrifice, the priest's servant came, while the flesh was boiling, with a flesh-hook of three teeth in his hand;

title: 1 Samuel 2:14
text: and he struck it into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; all that the flesh-hook brought up the priest took therewith. So they did in Shiloh unto all the Israelites that came thither.

title: 1 Samuel 2:15
text: Yea, before they burnt the fat, the priest's servant came, and said to the man that sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest; for he will not have boiled flesh of thee, but raw.

title: 1 Samuel 2:16
text: And if the man said unto him, They will surely burn the fat first, and then take as much as thy soul desireth; then he would say, Nay, but thou shalt give it me now: and if not, I will take it by force.

title: 1 Samuel 2:17
text: And the sin of the young men was very great before Jehovah; for the men despised the offering of Jehovah.

title: 1 Samuel 2:18
text: But Samuel ministered before Jehovah, being a child, girded with a linen ephod.

title: 1 Samuel 2:19
text: Moreover his mother made him a little robe, and brought it to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.

title: 1 Samuel 2:20
text: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, Jehovah give thee seed of this woman for the petition which was asked of Jehovah. And they went unto their own home.

title: 1 Samuel 2:21
text: And Jehovah visited Hannah, and she conceived, and bare three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before Jehovah.

title: 1 Samuel 2:22
text: Now Eli was very old; and he heard all that his sons did unto all Israel, and how that they lay with the women that did service at the door of the tent of meeting.

title: 1 Samuel 2:23
text: And he said unto them, Why do ye such things? for I hear of your evil dealings from all this people.

title: 1 Samuel 2:24
text: Nay, my sons; for it is no good report that I hear: ye make Jehovah's people to transgress.

title: 1 Samuel 2:25
text: If one man sin against another, God shall judge him; but if a man sin against Jehovah, who shall entreat for him? Notwithstanding, they hearkened not unto the voice of their father, because Jehovah was minded to slay them.

title: 1 Samuel 2:26
text: And the child Samuel grew on, and increased in favor both with Jehovah, and also with men.

title: 1 Samuel 2:27
text: And there came a man of God unto Eli, and said unto him, Thus saith Jehovah, Did I reveal myself unto the house of thy father, when they were in Egypt [in bondage] to Pharaoh's house? [

title: 1 Samuel 2:28
text: and did I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up unto mine altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? and did I give unto the house of thy father all the offerings of the children of Israel made by fire?

title: 1 Samuel 2:29
text: Wherefore kick ye at my sacrifice and at mine offering, which I have commanded in [my] habitation, and honorest thy sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Israel my people?

title: 1 Samuel 2:30
text: Therefore Jehovah, the God of Israel, saith, I said indeed that thy house, and the house of thy father, should walk before me for ever: but now Jehovah saith, Be it far from me; for them that honor me I will honor, and they that despise me shall be lightly esteemed.

title: 1 Samuel 2:31
text: Behold, the days come, that I will cut off thine arm, and the arm of thy father's house, that there shall not be an old man in thy house.

title: 1 Samuel 2:32
text: And thou shalt behold the affliction of [my] habitation, in all the wealth which [God] shall give Israel; and there shall not be an old man in thy house for ever.

title: 1 Samuel 2:33
text: And the man of thine, [whom] I shall not cut off from mine altar, [shall be] to consume thine eyes, and to grieve thy heart; and all the increase of thy house shall die in the flower of their age.

title: 1 Samuel 2:34
text: And this shall be the sign unto thee, that shall come upon thy two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas: in one day they shall die both of them.

title: 1 Samuel 2:35
text: And I will raise me up a faithful priest, that shall do according to that which is in my heart and in my mind: and I will build him a sure house; and he shall walk before mine anointed for ever.

title: 1 Samuel 2:36
text: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left in thy house shall come and bow down to him for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread, and shall say, Put me, I pray thee, into one of the priests' offices, that I may eat a morsel of bread.

title: 1 Samuel 3:1
text: And the child Samuel ministered unto Jehovah before Eli. And the word of Jehovah was precious in those days; there was no frequent vision.

title: 1 Samuel 3:2
text: And it came to pass at that time, when Eli was laid down in his place (now his eyes had begun to wax dim, so that he could not see),

title: 1 Samuel 3:3
text: and the lamp of God was not yet gone out, and Samuel was laid down [to sleep], in the temple of Jehovah, where the ark of God was;

title: 1 Samuel 3:4
text: that Jehovah called Samuel; and he said, Here am I.

title: 1 Samuel 3:5
text: And he ran unto Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou calledst me. And he said, I called not; lie down again. And he went and lay down.

title: 1 Samuel 3:6
text: And Jehovah called yet again, Samuel. And Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou calledst me. And he answered, I called not, my son; lie down again.

title: 1 Samuel 3:7
text: Now Samuel did not yet know Jehovah, neither was the word of Jehovah yet revealed unto him.

title: 1 Samuel 3:8
text: And Jehovah called Samuel again the third time. And he arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou calledst me. And Eli perceived that Jehovah had called the child.

title: 1 Samuel 3:9
text: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel, Go, lie down: and it shall be, if he call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, Jehovah; for thy servant heareth. So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

title: 1 Samuel 3:10
text: And Jehovah came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel said, Speak; for thy servant heareth.

title: 1 Samuel 3:11
text: And Jehovah said to Samuel, Behold, I will do a thing in Israel, at which both the ears of every one that heareth it shall tingle.

title: 1 Samuel 3:12
text: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from the beginning even unto the end.

title: 1 Samuel 3:13
text: For I have told him that I will judge his house for ever, for the iniquity which he knew, because his sons did bring a curse upon themselves, and he restrained them not.

title: 1 Samuel 3:14
text: And therefore I have sworn unto the house of Eli, that the iniquity of Eli's house shall not be expiated with sacrifice nor offering for ever.

title: 1 Samuel 3:15
text: And Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of the house of Jehovah. And Samuel feared to show Eli the vision.

title: 1 Samuel 3:16
text: Then Eli called Samuel, and said, Samuel, my son. And he said, Here am I.

title: 1 Samuel 3:17
text: And he said, What is the thing that [Jehovah] hath spoken unto thee? I pray thee, hide it not from me: God do so to thee, and more also, if thou hide anything from me of all the things that he spake unto thee.

title: 1 Samuel 3:18
text: And Samuel told him every whit, and hid nothing from him. And he said, It is Jehovah: let him do what seemeth him good.

title: 1 Samuel 3:19
text: And Samuel grew, and Jehovah was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the ground.

title: 1 Samuel 3:20
text: And all Israel from Dan even to Beer-sheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of Jehovah.

title: 1 Samuel 3:21
text: And Jehovah appeared again in Shiloh; for Jehovah revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of Jehovah.

title: 1 Samuel 4:1
text: And the word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and encamped beside Eben-ezer: and the Philistines encamped in Aphek.

title: 1 Samuel 4:2
text: And the Philistines put themselves in array against Israel: and when they joined battle, Israel was smitten before the Philistines; and they slew of the army in the field about four thousand men.

title: 1 Samuel 4:3
text: And when the people were come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, Wherefore hath Jehovah smitten us to-day before the Philistines? Let us fetch the ark of the covenant of Jehovah out of Shiloh unto us, that it may come among us, and save us out of the hand of our enemies.

title: 1 Samuel 4:4
text: So the people sent to Shiloh; and they brought from thence the ark of the covenant of Jehovah of hosts, who sitteth [above] the cherubim: and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.

title: 1 Samuel 4:5
text: And when the ark of the covenant of Jehovah came into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth rang again.

title: 1 Samuel 4:6
text: And when the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, What meaneth the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews? And they understood that the ark of Jehovah was come into the camp.

title: 1 Samuel 4:7
text: And the Philistines were afraid, for they said, God is come into the camp. And they said, Woe unto us! for there hath not been such a thing heretofore.

title: 1 Samuel 4:8
text: Woe unto us! who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty gods? these are the gods that smote the Egyptians with all manner of plagues in the wilderness.

title: 1 Samuel 4:9
text: Be strong, and quit yourselves like men, O ye Philistines, that ye be not servants unto the Hebrews, as they have been to you: quit yourselves like men, and fight.

title: 1 Samuel 4:10
text: And the Philistines fought, and Israel was smitten, and they fled every man to his tent: and there was a very great slaughter; for there fell of Israel thirty thousand footmen.

title: 1 Samuel 4:11
text: And the ark of God was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.

title: 1 Samuel 4:12
text: And there ran a man of Benjamin out of the army, and came to Shiloh the same day, with his clothes rent, and with earth upon his head.

title: 1 Samuel 4:13
text: And when he came, lo, Eli was sitting upon his seat by the wayside watching; for his heart trembled for the ark of God. And when the man came into the city, and told it, all the city cried out.

title: 1 Samuel 4:14
text: And when Eli heard the noise of the crying, he said, What meaneth the noise of this tumult? And the man hasted, and came and told Eli.

title: 1 Samuel 4:15
text: Now Eli was ninety and eight years old; and his eyes were set, so that he could not see.

title: 1 Samuel 4:16
text: And the man said unto Eli, I am he that came out of the army, and I fled to-day out of the army. And he said, How went the matter, my son?

title: 1 Samuel 4:17
text: And he that brought the tidings answered and said, Israel is fled before the Philistines, and there hath been also a great slaughter among the people, and thy two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God is taken.

title: 1 Samuel 4:18
text: And it came to pass, when he made mention of the ark of God, that [Eli] feel from off his seat backward by the side of the gate; and his neck brake, and he died: for he was an old man, and heavy. And he had judged Israel forty years.

title: 1 Samuel 4:19
text: And his daughter-in-law, Phinehas' wife, was with child, near to be delivered: and when she heard the tidings that the ark of God was taken, and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and brought forth; for her pains came upon her.

title: 1 Samuel 4:20
text: And about the time of her death the women that stood by her said unto her, Fear not; for thou hast brought forth a son. But she answered not, neither did she regard it.

title: 1 Samuel 4:21
text: And she named the child Ichabod, saying, The glory is departed from Israel; because the ark of God was taken, and because of her father-in-law and her husband.

title: 1 Samuel 4:22
text: And she said, The glory is departed from Israel; for the ark of God is taken.

title: 1 Samuel 5:1
text: Now the Philistines had taken the ark of God, and they brought it from Eben-ezer unto Ashdod.

title: 1 Samuel 5:2
text: And the Philistines took the ark of God, and brought it into the house of Dagon, and set it by Dagon.

title: 1 Samuel 5:3
text: And when they of Ashdod arose early on the morrow, behold, Dagon was fallen upon his face to the ground before the ark of Jehovah. And they took Dagon, and set him in his place again.

title: 1 Samuel 5:4
text: And when they arose early on the morrow morning, behold, Dagon was fallen upon his face to the ground before the ark of Jehovah; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands [lay] cut off upon the threshold; only [the stump of] Dagon was left to him.

title: 1 Samuel 5:5
text: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon, nor any that come into Dagon's house, tread on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod, unto this day.

title: 1 Samuel 5:6
text: But the hand of Jehovah was heavy upon them of Ashdod, and he destroyed them, and smote them with tumors, even Ashdod and the borders thereof.

title: 1 Samuel 5:7
text: And when the men of Ashdod saw that it was so, they said, The ark of the God of Israel shall not abide with us; for his hand is sore upon us, and upon Dagon our god.

title: 1 Samuel 5:8
text: They sent therefore and gathered all the lords of the Philistines unto them, and said, What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel? And they answered, Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried about unto Gath. And they carried the ark of the God of Israel [thither] .

title: 1 Samuel 5:9
text: And it was so, that, after they had carried it about, the hand of Jehovah was against the city with a very great discomfiture: and he smote the men of the city, both small and great; and tumors brake out upon them.

title: 1 Samuel 5:10
text: So they sent the ark of God to Ekron. And it came to pass, as the ark of God came to Ekron, that the Ekronites cried out, saying, They have brought about the ark of the God of Israel to us, to slay us and our people.

title: 1 Samuel 5:11
text: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and they said, Send away the ark of the God of Israel, and let it go again to its own place, that is slay us not, and our people. For there was a deadly discomfiture throughout all the city; the hand of God was very heavy there.

title: 1 Samuel 5:12
text: And the men that died not were smitten with the tumors; and the cry of the city went up to heaven.

title: 1 Samuel 6:1
text: And the ark of Jehovah was in the country of the Philistines seven months.

title: 1 Samuel 6:2
text: And the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners, saying, What shall we do with the ark of Jehovah? show us wherewith we shall sent it to its place.

title: 1 Samuel 6:3
text: And they said, If ye send away the ark of the God of Israel, send it not empty; but by all means return him a trespass-offering: then ye shall be healed, and it shall be known to you why his hand is not removed from you.

title: 1 Samuel 6:4
text: Then said they, What shall be the trespass-offering which we shall return to him? And they said, Five golden tumors, and five golden mice, [according to] the number of the lords of the Philistines; for one plague was on you all, and on your lords.

title: 1 Samuel 6:5
text: Wherefore ye shall make images of your tumors, and images of your mice that mar the land; and ye shall give glory unto the God of Israel: peradventure he will lighten his hand from off you, and from off your gods, and from off your land.

title: 1 Samuel 6:6
text: Wherefore then do ye harden your hearts, as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? When he had wrought wonderfully among them, did they not let the people go, and they departed?

title: 1 Samuel 6:7
text: Now therefore take and prepare you a new cart, and two milch kine, on which there hath come no yoke; and tie the kine to the cart, and bring their calves home from them;

title: 1 Samuel 6:8
text: and take the ark of Jehovah, and lay it upon the cart; and put the jewels of gold, which ye return him for a trespass-offering, in a coffer by the side thereof; and send it away, that it may go.

title: 1 Samuel 6:9
text: And see; if it goeth up by the way of its own border to Beth-shemesh, then he hath done us this great evil: but if not, then we shall know that it is not his hand that smote us; it was a chance that happened to us.

title: 1 Samuel 6:10
text: And the men did so, and took two milch kine, and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home;

title: 1 Samuel 6:11
text: and they put the ark of Jehovah upon the cart, and the coffer with the mice of gold and the images of their tumors.

title: 1 Samuel 6:12
text: And the kine took the straight way by the way to Beth-shemesh; they went along the highway, lowing as they went, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left; and the lords of the Philistines went after them unto the border of Beth-shemesh.

title: 1 Samuel 6:13
text: And they of Beth-shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley; and they lifted up their eyes, and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see it.

title: 1 Samuel 6:14
text: And the cart came into the field of Joshua the Beth-shemite, and stood there, where there was a great stone: and they clave the wood of the cart, and offered up the kine for a burnt-offering unto Jehovah.

title: 1 Samuel 6:15
text: And the Levites took down the ark of Jehovah, and the coffer that was with it, wherein the jewels of gold were, and put them on the great stone: and the men of Beth-shemesh offered burnt-offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day unto Jehovah.

title: 1 Samuel 6:16
text: And when the five lords of the Philistines had seen it, they returned to Ekron the same day.

title: 1 Samuel 6:17
text: And these are the golden tumors which the Philistines returned for a trespass-offering unto Jehovah: for Ashdod one, for Gaza one, for Ashkelon one, for Gath one, for Ekron one;

title: 1 Samuel 6:18
text: and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fortified cities and of country villages, even unto the great stone, whereon they set down the ark of Jehovah, [which stone remaineth] unto this day in the field of Joshua the Beth-shemite.

title: 1 Samuel 6:19
text: And he smote of the men of Beth-shemesh, because they had looked into the ark of Jehovah, he smote of the people seventy men, [and] fifty thousand men; and the people mourned, because Jehovah had smitten the people with a great slaughter.

title: 1 Samuel 6:20
text: And the men of Beth-shemesh said, Who is able to stand before Jehovah, this holy God? and to whom shall he go up from us?

title: 1 Samuel 6:21
text: And they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath-jearim, saying, The Philistines have brought back the ark of Jehovah; come ye down, and fetch it up to you.

title: 1 Samuel 7:1
text: And the men of Kiriath-jearim came, and fetched up the ark of Jehovah, and brought it into the house of Abinadab in the hill, and sanctified Eleazar his son to keep the ark of Jehovah.

title: 1 Samuel 7:2
text: And it came to pass, from the day that the ark abode in Kiriath-jearim, that the time was long; for it was twenty years: and all the house of Israel lamented after Jehovah.

title: 1 Samuel 7:3
text: And Samuel spake unto all the house of Israel, saying, If ye do return unto Jehovah with all your heart, then put away the foreign gods and the Ashtaroth from among you, and direct your hearts unto Jehovah, and serve him only; and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.

title: 1 Samuel 7:4
text: Then the children of Israel did put away the Baalim and the Ashtaroth, and served Jehovah only.

title: 1 Samuel 7:5
text: And Samuel said, Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray for you unto Jehovah.

title: 1 Samuel 7:6
text: And they gathered together to Mizpah, and drew water, and poured it out before Jehovah, and fasted on that day, and said there, We have sinned against Jehovah. And Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpah.

title: 1 Samuel 7:7
text: And when the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together to Mizpah, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. And when the children of Israel heard it, they were afraid of the Philistines.

title: 1 Samuel 7:8
text: And the children of Israel said to Samuel, Cease not to cry unto Jehovah our God for us, that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines.

title: 1 Samuel 7:9
text: And Samuel took a sucking lamb, and offered it for a whole burnt-offering unto Jehovah: and Samuel cried unto Jehovah for Israel; and Jehovah answered him.

title: 1 Samuel 7:10
text: And as Samuel was offering up the burnt-offering, the Philistines drew near to battle against Israel; but Jehovah thundered with a great thunder on that day upon the Philistines, and discomfited them; and they were smitten down before Israel.

title: 1 Samuel 7:11
text: And the men of Israel went out of Mizpah, and pursued the Philistines, and smote them, until they came under Beth-car.

title: 1 Samuel 7:12
text: Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called the name of it Eben-ezer, saying, Hitherto hath Jehovah helped us.

title: 1 Samuel 7:13
text: So the Philistines were subdued, and they came no more within the border of Israel: and the hand of Jehovah was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.

title: 1 Samuel 7:14
text: And the cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron even unto Gath; and the border thereof did Israel deliver out of the hand of the Philistines. And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.

title: 1 Samuel 7:15
text: And Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.

title: 1 Samuel 7:16
text: And he went from year to year in circuit to Beth-el and Gilgal, and Mizpah; and he judged Israel in all those places.

title: 1 Samuel 7:17
text: And his return was to Ramah, for there was his house; and there he judged Israel: and he built there an altar unto Jehovah.

title: 1 Samuel 8:1
text: And it came to pass, when Samuel was old, that he made his sons judges over Israel.

title: 1 Samuel 8:2
text: Now the name of his first-born was Joel; and the name of his second, Abijah: they were judges in Beer-sheba.

title: 1 Samuel 8:3
text: And his sons walked not in his ways, but turned aside after lucre, and took bribes, and perverted justice.

title: 1 Samuel 8:4
text: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together, and came to Samuel unto Ramah;

title: 1 Samuel 8:5
text: and they said unto him, Behold, thou art old, and thy sons walk not in thy ways: now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.

title: 1 Samuel 8:6
text: But the thing displeased Samuel, when they said, Give us a king to judge us. And Samuel prayed unto Jehovah.

title: 1 Samuel 8:7
text: And Jehovah said unto Samuel, Hearken unto the voice of the people in all that they say unto thee; for they have not rejected thee, but they have rejected me, that I should not be king over them.

title: 1 Samuel 8:8
text: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even unto this day, in that they have forsaken me, and served other gods, so do they also unto thee.

title: 1 Samuel 8:9
text: Now therefore hearken unto their voice: howbeit thou shalt protest solemnly unto them, and shalt show them the manner of the king that shall reign over them.

title: 1 Samuel 8:10
text: And Samuel told all the words of Jehovah unto the people that asked of him a king.

title: 1 Samuel 8:11
text: And he said, This will be the manner of the king that shall reign over you: he will take your sons, and appoint them unto him, for his chariots, and to be his horsemen; and they shall run before his chariots;

title: 1 Samuel 8:12
text: and he will appoint them unto him for captains of thousands, and captains of fifties; and [he will set some] to plow his ground, and to reap his harvest, and to make his instruments of war, and the instruments of his chariots.

title: 1 Samuel 8:13
text: And he will take your daughters to be perfumers, and to be cooks, and to be bakers.

title: 1 Samuel 8:14
text: And he will take your fields, and your vineyards, and your oliveyards, even the best of them, and give them to his servants.

title: 1 Samuel 8:15
text: And he will take the tenth of your seed, and of your vineyards, and give to his officers, and to his servants.

title: 1 Samuel 8:16
text: And he will take your men-servants, and your maid-servants, and your goodliest young men, and your asses, and put them to his work.

title: 1 Samuel 8:17
text: He will take the tenth of your flocks: and ye shall be his servants.

title: 1 Samuel 8:18
text: And ye shall cry out in that day because of your king whom ye shall have chosen you; and Jehovah will not answer you in that day.

title: 1 Samuel 8:19
text: But the people refused to hearken unto the voice of Samuel; and they said, Nay: but we will have a king over us,

title: 1 Samuel 8:20
text: that we also may be like all the nations, and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.

title: 1 Samuel 8:21
text: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of Jehovah.

title: 1 Samuel 8:22
text: And Jehovah said to Samuel, Hearken unto their voice, and make them a king. And Samuel said unto the men of Israel, Go ye every man unto his city.

title: 1 Samuel 9:1
text: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish, the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah, the son of a Benjamite, a mighty man of valor.

title: 1 Samuel 9:2
text: And he had a son, whose name was Saul, a young man and a goodly: and there was not among the children of Israel a goodlier person than he: from his shoulders and upward he was higher than any of the people.

title: 1 Samuel 9:3
text: And the asses of Kish, Saul's father, were lost. And Kish said to Saul his son, Take now one of the servants with thee, and arise, go seek the asses.

title: 1 Samuel 9:4
text: And he passed through the hill-country of Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they found them not: then they passed through the land of Shaalim, and there they were not: and he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they found them not.

title: 1 Samuel 9:5
text: When they were come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant that was with him, Come, and let us return, lest my father leave off caring for the asses, and be anxious for us.

title: 1 Samuel 9:6
text: And he said unto him, Behold now, there is in this city a man of God, and he is a man that is held in honor; all that he saith cometh surely to pass: now let us go thither; peradventure he can tell us concerning our journey whereon we go.

title: 1 Samuel 9:7
text: Then said Saul to his servant, But, behold, if we go, what shall we bring the man? for the bread is spent in our vessels, and there is not a present to bring to the man of God: what have we?

title: 1 Samuel 9:8
text: And the servant answered Saul again, and said, Behold, I have in my hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver: that will I give to the man of God, to tell us our way.

title: 1 Samuel 9:9
text: (Beforetime in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, thus he said, Come, and let us go to the seer; for he that is now called a Prophet was beforetime called a Seer.)

title: 1 Samuel 9:10
text: Then said Saul to his servant, Well said; come, let us go. So they went unto the city where the man of God was.

title: 1 Samuel 9:11
text: As they went up the ascent to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said unto them, Is the seer here?

title: 1 Samuel 9:12
text: And they answered them, and said, He is; behold, [he is] before thee: make haste now, for he is come to-day into the city; for the people have a sacrifice to-day in the high place:

title: 1 Samuel 9:13
text: as soon as ye are come into the city, ye shall straightway find him, before he goeth up to the high place to eat; for the people will not eat until he come, because he doth bless the sacrifice; [and] afterwards they eat that are bidden. Now therefore get you up; for at this time ye shall find him.

title: 1 Samuel 9:14
text: And they went up to the city; [and] as they came within the city, behold, Samuel came out toward them, to go up to the high place.

title: 1 Samuel 9:15
text: Now Jehovah had revealed unto Samuel a day before Saul came, saying,

title: 1 Samuel 9:16
text: To-morrow about this time I will send thee a man out of the land of Benjamin, and thou shalt anoint him to be prince over my people Israel; and he shall save my people out of the hand of the Philistines: for I have looked upon my people, because their cry is come unto me.

title: 1 Samuel 9:17
text: And when Samuel saw Saul, Jehovah said unto him, Behold, the man of whom I spake to thee! this same shall have authority over my people.

title: 1 Samuel 9:18
text: Then Saul drew near to Samuel in the gate, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, where the seer's house is.

title: 1 Samuel 9:19
text: And Samuel answered Saul, and said, I am the seer; go up before me unto the high place, for ye shall eat with me to-day: and in the morning I will let thee go, and will tell thee all that is in thy heart.

title: 1 Samuel 9:20
text: And as for thine asses that were lost three days ago, set not they mind on them; for they are found. And for whom is all that is desirable in Israel? Is it not for thee, and for all thy father's house?

title: 1 Samuel 9:21
text: And Saul answered and said, Am not I a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? and my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? wherefore then speakest thou to me after this manner?

title: 1 Samuel 9:22
text: And Samuel took Saul and his servant, and brought them into the guest-chamber, and made them sit in the chiefest place among them that were bidden, who were about thirty persons.

title: 1 Samuel 9:23
text: And Samuel said unto the cook, Bring the portion which I gave thee, of which I said unto thee, Set it by thee.

title: 1 Samuel 9:24
text: And the cook took up the thigh, and that which was upon it, and set it before Saul. And [Samuel] said, Behold, that which hath been reserved! set it before thee and eat; because unto the appointed time hath it been kept for thee, for I said, I have invited the people. So Saul did eat with Samuel that day.

title: 1 Samuel 9:25
text: And when they were come down from the high place into the city, he communed with Saul upon the housetop.

title: 1 Samuel 9:26
text: And they arose early: and it came to pass about the spring of the day, that Samuel called to Saul on the housetop, saying, Up, that I may send thee away. And Saul arose, and they went out both of them, he and Samuel, abroad.

title: 1 Samuel 9:27
text: As they were going down at the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, Bid the servant pass on before us (and he passed on), but stand thou still first, that I may cause thee to hear the word of God.

title: 1 Samuel 10:1
text: Then Samuel took the vial of oil, and poured it upon his head, and kissed him, and said, Is it not that Jehovah hath anointed thee to be prince over his inheritance?

title: 1 Samuel 10:2
text: When thou art departed from me to-day, then thou shalt find two men by Rachel's sepulchre, in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah; and they will say unto thee, The asses which thou wentest to seek are found; and, lo, thy father hath left off caring for the asses, and is anxious for you, saying, What shall I do for my son?

title: 1 Samuel 10:3
text: Then shalt thou go on forward from thence, and thou shalt come to the oak of Tabor; and there shall meet thee there three men going up to God to Beth-el, one carrying three kids, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a bottle of wine:

title: 1 Samuel 10:4
text: and they will salute thee, and give thee two loaves of bread, which thou shalt receive of their hand.

title: 1 Samuel 10:5
text: After that thou shalt come to the hill of God, where is the garrison of the Philistines: and it shall come to pass, when thou art come thither to the city, that thou shalt meet a band of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery, and a timbrel, and a pipe, and a harp, before them; and they will be prophesying:

title: 1 Samuel 10:6
text: and the Spirit of Jehovah will come mightily upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.

title: 1 Samuel 10:7
text: And let it be, when these signs are come unto thee, that thou do as occasion shall serve thee; for God is with thee.

title: 1 Samuel 10:8
text: And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal; and, behold, I will come down unto thee, to offer burnt-offerings, and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace-offerings: seven days shalt thou tarry, till I come unto thee, and show thee what thou shalt do.

title: 1 Samuel 10:9
text: And it was so, that, when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart: and all those signs came to pass that day.

title: 1 Samuel 10:10
text: And when they came thither to the hill, behold, a band of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came mightily upon him, and he prophesied among them.

title: 1 Samuel 10:11
text: And it came to pass, when all that knew him beforetime saw that, behold, he prophesied with the prophets, then the people said one to another, What is this that is come unto the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?

title: 1 Samuel 10:12
text: And one of the same place answered and said, And who is their father? Therefore it became a proverb, Is Saul also among the prophets?

title: 1 Samuel 10:13
text: And when he had made an end of prophesying, he came to the high place.

title: 1 Samuel 10:14
text: And Saul's uncle said unto him and to his servant, Whither went ye? And he said, To seek the asses; and when we saw that they were not found, we came to Samuel.

title: 1 Samuel 10:15
text: And Saul's uncle said, Tell me, I pray thee, what Samuel said unto you.

title: 1 Samuel 10:16
text: And Saul said unto his uncle, He told us plainly that the asses were found. But concerning the matter of the kingdom, whereof Samuel spake, he told him not.

title: 1 Samuel 10:17
text: And Samuel called the people together unto Jehovah to Mizpah;

title: 1 Samuel 10:18
text: and he said unto the children of Israel, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, I brought up Israel out of Egypt, and I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all the kingdoms that oppressed you:

title: 1 Samuel 10:19
text: but ye have this day rejected your God, who himself saveth you out of all your calamities and your distresses; and ye have said unto him, [Nay], but set a king over us. Now therefore present yourselves before Jehovah by your tribes, and by your thousands.

title: 1 Samuel 10:20
text: So Samuel brought all the tribes of Israel near, and the tribe of Benjamin was taken.

title: 1 Samuel 10:21
text: And he brought the tribe of Benjamin near by their families; and the family of the Matrites was taken; and Saul the son of Kish was taken: but when they sought him, he could not be found.

title: 1 Samuel 10:22
text: Therefore they asked of Jehovah further, Is there yet a man to come hither? And Jehovah answered, Behold, he hath hid himself among the baggage.

title: 1 Samuel 10:23
text: And they ran and fetched him thence; and when he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.

title: 1 Samuel 10:24
text: And Samuel said to all the people, See ye him whom Jehovah hath chosen, that there is none like him along all the people? And all the people shouted, and said, [Long] live the king.

title: 1 Samuel 10:25
text: Then Samuel told the people the manner of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book, and laid it up before Jehovah. And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.

title: 1 Samuel 10:26
text: And Saul also went to his house to Gibeah; and there went with him the host, whose hearts God had touched.

title: 1 Samuel 10:27
text: But certain worthless fellows said, How shall this man save us? And they despised him, and brought him no present. But he held his peace.

title: 1 Samuel 11:1
text: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up, and encamped against Jabesh-gilead: and all the men of Jabesh said unto Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee.

title: 1 Samuel 11:2
text: And Nahash the Ammonite said unto them, On this condition will I make it with you, that all your right eyes be put out; and I will lay it for a reproach upon all Israel.

title: 1 Samuel 11:3
text: And the elders of Jabesh said unto him, Give us seven days' respite, that we may send messengers unto all the borders of Israel; and then, if there be none to save us, we will come out to thee.

title: 1 Samuel 11:4
text: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul, and spake these words in the ears of the people: and all the people lifted up their voice, and wept.

title: 1 Samuel 11:5
text: And, behold, Saul came following the oxen out of the field; and Saul said, What aileth the people that they weep? And they told him the words of the men of Jabesh.

title: 1 Samuel 11:6
text: And the Spirit of God came mightily upon Saul when he heard those words, and his anger was kindled greatly.

title: 1 Samuel 11:7
text: And he took a yoke of oxen, and cut them in pieces, and sent them throughout all the borders of Israel by the hand of messengers, saying, Whosoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done unto his oxen. And the dread of Jehovah fell on the people, and they came out as one man.

title: 1 Samuel 11:8
text: And he numbered them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.

title: 1 Samuel 11:9
text: And they said unto the messengers that came, Thus shall ye say unto the men of Jabesh-gilead, To-morrow, by the time the sun is hot, ye shall have deliverance. And the messengers came and told the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.

title: 1 Samuel 11:10
text: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, To-morrow we will come out unto you, and ye shall do with us all that seemeth good unto you.

title: 1 Samuel 11:11
text: And it was so on the morrow, that Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the midst of the camp in the morning watch, and smote the Ammonites until the heat of the day: and it came to pass, that they that remained were scattered, so that not two of them were left together.

title: 1 Samuel 11:12
text: And the people said unto Samuel, Who is he that said, Shall Saul reign over us? bring the men, that we may put them to death.

title: 1 Samuel 11:13
text: And Saul said, There shall not a man be put to death this day; for to-day Jehovah hath wrought deliverance in Israel.

title: 1 Samuel 11:14
text: Then said Samuel to the people, Come, and let us go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.

title: 1 Samuel 11:15
text: And all the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before Jehovah in Gilgal; and there they offered sacrifices of peace-offerings before Jehovah; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.

title: 1 Samuel 12:1
text: And Samuel said unto all Israel, Behold, I have hearkened unto your voice in all that ye said unto me, and have made a king over you.

title: 1 Samuel 12:2
text: And now, behold, the king walketh before you; and I am old and grayheaded; and, behold, my sons are with you: and I have walked before you from my youth unto this day.

title: 1 Samuel 12:3
text: Here I am: witness against me before Jehovah, and before his anointed: whose ox have I taken? or whose ass have I taken? or whom have I defrauded? whom have I oppressed? or of whose hand have I taken a ransom to blind mine eyes therewith? and I will restore it you.

title: 1 Samuel 12:4
text: And they said, Thou hast not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither hast thou taken aught of any man's hand.

title: 1 Samuel 12:5
text: And he said unto them, Jehovah is witness against you, and his anointed is witness this day, that ye have not found aught in my hand. And they said, He is witness.

title: 1 Samuel 12:6
text: And Samuel said unto the people, It is Jehovah that appointed Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.

title: 1 Samuel 12:7
text: Now therefore stand still, that I may plead with you before Jehovah concerning all the righteous acts of Jehovah, which he did to you and to your fathers.

title: 1 Samuel 12:8
text: When Jacob was come into Egypt, and your fathers cried unto Jehovah, then Jehovah sent Moses and Aaron, who brought forth your fathers out of Egypt, and made them to dwell in this place.

title: 1 Samuel 12:9
text: But they forgat Jehovah their God; and he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the host of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab; and they fought against them.

title: 1 Samuel 12:10
text: And they cried unto Jehovah, and said, We have sinned, because we have forsaken Jehovah, and have served the Baalim and the Ashtaroth: but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve thee.

title: 1 Samuel 12:11
text: And Jehovah sent Jerubbaal, and Bedan, and Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side; and ye dwelt in safety.

title: 1 Samuel 12:12
text: And when ye saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, ye said unto me, Nay, but a king shall reign over us; when Jehovah your God was your king.

title: 1 Samuel 12:13
text: Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen, and whom ye have asked for: and, behold, Jehovah hath set a king over you.

title: 1 Samuel 12:14
text: If ye will fear Jehovah, and serve him, and hearken unto his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of Jehovah, and both ye and also the king that reigneth over you be followers of Jehovah your God, [well] :

title: 1 Samuel 12:15
text: but if ye will not hearken unto the voice of Jehovah, but rebel against the commandment of Jehovah, then will the hand of Jehovah be against you, as it was against your fathers.

title: 1 Samuel 12:16
text: Now therefore stand still and see this great thing, which Jehovah will do before your eyes.

title: 1 Samuel 12:17
text: Is it not wheat harvest to-day? I will call unto Jehovah, that he may send thunder and rain; and ye shall know and see that your wickedness is great, which ye have done in the sight of Jehovah, in asking you a king.

title: 1 Samuel 12:18
text: So Samuel called unto Jehovah; and Jehovah sent thunder and rain that day: and all the people greatly feared Jehovah and Samuel.

title: 1 Samuel 12:19
text: And all the people said unto Samuel, Pray for thy servants unto Jehovah thy God, that we die not; for we have added unto all our sins [this] evil, to ask us a king.

title: 1 Samuel 12:20
text: And Samuel said unto the people, Fear not; ye have indeed done all this evil; yet turn not aside from following Jehovah, but serve Jehovah with all your heart:

title: 1 Samuel 12:21
text: and turn ye not aside; for [then would ye go] after vain things which cannot profit nor deliver, for they are vain.

title: 1 Samuel 12:22
text: For Jehovah will not forsake his people for his great name's sake, because it hath pleased Jehovah to make you a people unto himself.

title: 1 Samuel 12:23
text: Moreover as for me, far be it from me that I should sin against Jehovah in ceasing to pray for you: but I will instruct you in the good and the right way.

title: 1 Samuel 12:24
text: Only fear Jehovah, and serve him in truth with all your heart; for consider how great things he hath done for you.

title: 1 Samuel 12:25
text: But if ye shall still do wickedly, ye shall be consumed, both ye and your king.

title: 1 Samuel 13:1
text: Saul was [forty] years old when he began to reign; and when he had reigned two years over Israel,

title: 1 Samuel 13:2
text: Saul chose him three thousand men of Israel, whereof two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in the mount of Beth-el, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin: and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent.

title: 1 Samuel 13:3
text: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba: and the Philistines heard of it. And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, Let the Hebrews hear.

title: 1 Samuel 13:4
text: And all Israel heard say that Saul had smitten the garrison of the Philistines, and also that Israel was had in abomination with the Philistines. And the people were gathered together after Saul to Gilgal.

title: 1 Samuel 13:5
text: And the Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the sea-shore in multitude: and they came up, and encamped in Michmash, eastward of Beth-aven.

title: 1 Samuel 13:6
text: When the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait (for the people were distressed), then the people did hide themselves in caves, and in thickets, and in rocks, and in coverts, and in pits. [

title: 1 Samuel 13:7
text: Now some of the Hebrews had gone over the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead; but as for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.

title: 1 Samuel 13:8
text: And he tarried seven days, according to the set time that Samuel [had appointed] : but Samuel came not to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.

title: 1 Samuel 13:9
text: And Saul said, Bring hither the burnt-offering to me, and the peace-offerings. And he offered the burnt-offering.

title: 1 Samuel 13:10
text: And it came to pass that, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt-offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might salute him.

title: 1 Samuel 13:11
text: And Samuel said, What hast thou done? And Saul said, Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that thou camest not within the days appointed, and that the Philistines assembled themselves together at Michmash;

title: 1 Samuel 13:12
text: therefore said I, Now will the Philistines come down upon me to Gilgal, and I have not entreated the favor of Jehovah: I forced myself therefore, and offered the burnt-offering.

title: 1 Samuel 13:13
text: And Samuel said to Saul, Thou hast done foolishly; thou hast not kept the commandment of Jehovah thy God, which he commanded thee: for now would Jehovah have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever.

title: 1 Samuel 13:14
text: But now thy kingdom shall not continue: Jehovah hath sought him a man after his own heart, and Jehovah hath appointed him to be prince over his people, because thou hast not kept that which Jehovah commanded thee.

title: 1 Samuel 13:15
text: And Samuel arose, and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people that were present with him, about six hundred men.

title: 1 Samuel 13:16
text: And Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people that were present with them, abode in Geba of Benjamin: but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.

title: 1 Samuel 13:17
text: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned unto the way that leadeth to Ophrah, unto the land of Shual;

title: 1 Samuel 13:18
text: and another company turned the way to Beth-horon; and another company turned the way of the border that looketh down upon the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

title: 1 Samuel 13:19
text: Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel; for the Philistines said, Lest the Hebrews make them swords or spears:

title: 1 Samuel 13:20
text: but all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, to sharpen every man his share, and his coulter, and his axe, and his mattock;

title: 1 Samuel 13:21
text: yet they had a file for the mattocks, and for the coulters, and for the forks, and for the axes, and to set the goads.

title: 1 Samuel 13:22
text: So it came to pass in the day of battle, that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that were with Saul and Jonathan: but with Saul and with Jonathan his son was there found.

title: 1 Samuel 13:23
text: And the garrison of the Philistines went out unto the pass of Michmash.

title: 1 Samuel 14:1
text: Now it fell upon a day, that Jonathan the son of Saul said unto the young man that bare his armor, Come, and let us go over to the Philistines' garrison, that is on yonder side. But he told not his father.

title: 1 Samuel 14:2
text: And Saul abode in the uttermost part of Gibeah under the pomegranate-tree which is in Migron: and the people that were with him were about six hundred men;

title: 1 Samuel 14:3
text: and Ahijah, the son of Ahitub, Ichabod's brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the priest of Jehovah in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. And the people knew not that Jonathan was gone.

title: 1 Samuel 14:4
text: And between the passes, by which Jonathan sought to go over unto the Philistines' garrison, there was a rocky crag on the one side, and a rocky crag on the other side: and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

title: 1 Samuel 14:5
text: The one crag rose up on the north in front of Michmash, and the other on the south in front of Geba.

title: 1 Samuel 14:6
text: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armor, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that Jehovah will work for us; for there is no restraint to Jehovah to save by many or by few.

title: 1 Samuel 14:7
text: And his armorbearer said unto him, Do all that is in thy heart: turn thee, behold, I am with thee according to thy heart.

title: 1 Samuel 14:8
text: Then said Jonathan, Behold, we will pass over unto the men, and we will disclose ourselves unto them.

title: 1 Samuel 14:9
text: If they say thus unto us, Tarry until we come to you; then we will stand still in our place, and will not go up unto them.

title: 1 Samuel 14:10
text: But if they say thus, Come up unto us; then we will go up; for Jehovah hath delivered them into our hand: and this shall be the sign unto us.

title: 1 Samuel 14:11
text: And both of them disclosed themselves unto the garrison of the Philistines: and the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves.

title: 1 Samuel 14:12
text: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armorbearer, and said, Come up to us, and we will show you a thing. And Jonathan said unto his armorbearer, Come up after me; for Jehovah hath delivered them into the hand of Israel.

title: 1 Samuel 14:13
text: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet, and his armorbearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and his armorbearer slew them after him.

title: 1 Samuel 14:14
text: And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armorbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were half a furrow's length in an acre of land.

title: 1 Samuel 14:15
text: And there was a trembling in the camp, in the field, and among all the people; the garrison, and the spoilers, they also trembled; and the earth quaked: so there was an exceeding great trembling.

title: 1 Samuel 14:16
text: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and, behold, the multitude melted away, and they went [hither] and thither.

title: 1 Samuel 14:17
text: Then said Saul unto the people that were with him, Number now, and see who is gone from us. And when they had numbered, behold, Jonathan and his armorbearer were not there.

title: 1 Samuel 14:18
text: And Saul said unto Ahijah, Bring hither the ark of God. For the ark of God was [there] at that time with the children of Israel.

title: 1 Samuel 14:19
text: And it came to pass, while Saul talked unto the priest, that the tumult that was in the camp of the Philistines went on and increased: and Saul said unto the priest, Withdraw thy hand.

title: 1 Samuel 14:20
text: And Saul and all the people that were with him were gathered together, and came to the battle: and, behold, every man's sword was against his fellow, [and there was] a very great discomfiture.

title: 1 Samuel 14:21
text: Now the Hebrews that were with the Philistines as beforetime, and that went up with them into the camp, [from the country] round about, even they also [turned] to be with the Israelites that were with Saul and Jonathan.

title: 1 Samuel 14:22
text: Likewise all the men of Israel that had hid themselves in the hill-country of Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.

title: 1 Samuel 14:23
text: So Jehovah saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over by Beth-aven.

title: 1 Samuel 14:24
text: And the men of Israel were distressed that day; for Saul had adjured the people, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food until it be evening, and I be avenged on mine enemies. So none of the people tasted food.

title: 1 Samuel 14:25
text: And all the people came into the forest; and there was honey upon the ground.

title: 1 Samuel 14:26
