text: And it was so, that, when any man came nigh to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, and took hold of him, and kissed him.

title: 2 Samuel 15:6
text: And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

title: 2 Samuel 15:7
text: And it came to pass at the end of forty years, that Absalom said unto the king, I pray thee, let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed unto Jehovah, in Hebron.

title: 2 Samuel 15:8
text: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria, saying, If Jehovah shall indeed bring me again to Jerusalem, then I will serve Jehovah.

title: 2 Samuel 15:9
text: And the king said unto him, Go in peace. So he arose, and went to Hebron.

title: 2 Samuel 15:10
text: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then ye shall say, Absalom is king in Hebron.

title: 2 Samuel 15:11
text: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem, that were invited, and went in their simplicity; and they knew not anything.

title: 2 Samuel 15:12
text: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David's counsellor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he was offering the sacrifices. And the conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.

title: 2 Samuel 15:13
text: And there came a messenger to David, saying, The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.

title: 2 Samuel 15:14
text: And David said unto all his servants that were with him at Jerusalem, Arise, and let us flee; for else none of us shall escape from Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us quickly, and bring down evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.

title: 2 Samuel 15:15
text: And the king's servants said unto the king, Behold, thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall choose.

title: 2 Samuel 15:16
text: And the king went forth, and all his household after him. And the king left ten women, that were concubines, to keep the house.

title: 2 Samuel 15:17
text: And the king went forth, and all the people after him; and they tarried in Beth-merhak.

title: 2 Samuel 15:18
text: And all his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men that came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.

title: 2 Samuel 15:19
text: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite, Wherefore goest thou also with us? return, and abide with the king: for thou art a foreigner, and also an exile; [return] to thine own place.

title: 2 Samuel 15:20
text: Whereas thou camest but yesterday, should I this day make thee go up and down with us, seeing I go whither I may? return thou, and take back thy brethren; mercy and truth be with thee.

title: 2 Samuel 15:21
text: And Ittai answered the king, and said, As Jehovah liveth, and as my lord the king liveth, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether for death or for life, even there also will thy servant be.

title: 2 Samuel 15:22
text: And David said to Ittai, Go and pass over. And Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones that were with him.

title: 2 Samuel 15:23
text: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.

title: 2 Samuel 15:24
text: And, lo, Zadok also [came], and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God; and they set down the ark of God; and Abiathar went up, until all the people had done passing out of the city.

title: 2 Samuel 15:25
text: And the king said unto Zadok, Carry back the ark of God into the city: if I shall find favor in the eyes of Jehovah, he will bring me again, and show me both it, and his habitation:

title: 2 Samuel 15:26
text: but if he say thus, I have no delight in thee; behold, here am I, let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.

title: 2 Samuel 15:27
text: The king said also unto Zadok the priest, Art thou [not] a seer? return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz thy son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.

title: 2 Samuel 15:28
text: See, I will tarry at the fords of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.

title: 2 Samuel 15:29
text: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem: and they abode there.

title: 2 Samuel 15:30
text: And David went up by the ascent of the [mount of] Olives, and wept as he went up; and he had his head covered, and went barefoot: and all the people that were with him covered every man his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.

title: 2 Samuel 15:31
text: And one told David, saying, Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom. And David said, O Jehovah, I pray thee, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.

title: 2 Samuel 15:32
text: And it came to pass, that, when David was come to the top [of the ascent], where God was worshipped, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head.

title: 2 Samuel 15:33
text: And David said unto him, If thou passest on with me, then thou wilt be a burden unto me:

title: 2 Samuel 15:34
text: but if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; as I have been thy father's servant in time past, so will I now be thy servant; then wilt thou defeat for me the counsel of Ahithophel.

title: 2 Samuel 15:35
text: And hast thou not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests? therefore it shall be, that what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king's house, thou shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

title: 2 Samuel 15:36
text: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz, Zadok's son, and Jonathan, Abiathar's son; and by them ye shall send unto me everything that ye shall hear.

title: 2 Samuel 15:37
text: So Hushai, David's friend, came into the city; and Absalom came into Jerusalem.

title: 2 Samuel 16:1
text: And when David was a little past the top [of the ascent], behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him, with a couple of asses saddled, and upon them two hundred loaves of bread, and a hundred clusters of raisins, and a hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.

title: 2 Samuel 16:2
text: And the king said unto Ziba, What meanest thou by these? And Ziba said, The asses are for the king's household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as are faint in the wilderness may drink.

title: 2 Samuel 16:3
text: And the king said, And where is thy master's son? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he abideth at Jerusalem; for he said, To-day will the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father.

title: 2 Samuel 16:4
text: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, thine is all that pertaineth unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I do obeisance; let me find favor in thy sight, my lord, O king.

title: 2 Samuel 16:5
text: And when king David came to Bahurim, behold, there came out thence a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera; he came out, and cursed still as he came.

title: 2 Samuel 16:6
text: And he cast stones at David, and at all the servants of king David: and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.

title: 2 Samuel 16:7
text: And thus said Shimei when he cursed, Begone, begone, thou man of blood, and base fellow:

title: 2 Samuel 16:8
text: Jehovah hath returned upon thee all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose stead thou hast reigned; and Jehovah hath delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom thy son; and, behold, thou art [taken] in thine own mischief, because thou art a man of blood.

title: 2 Samuel 16:9
text: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king, Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? let me go over, I pray thee, and take off his head.

title: 2 Samuel 16:10
text: And the king said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah? Because he curseth, and because Jehovah hath said unto him, Curse David; who then shall say, Wherefore hast thou done so?

title: 2 Samuel 16:11
text: And David said to Abishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, who came forth from my bowels, seeketh my life: how much more [may] this Benjamite now [do it] ? let him alone, and let him curse; for Jehovah hath bidden him.

title: 2 Samuel 16:12
text: It may be that Jehovah will look on the wrong done unto me, and that Jehovah will requite me good for [his] cursing of me this day.

title: 2 Samuel 16:13
text: So David and his men went by the way; and Shimei went along on the hill-side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.

title: 2 Samuel 16:14
text: And the king, and all the people that were with him, came weary; and he refreshed himself there.

title: 2 Samuel 16:15
text: And Absalom, and all the people, the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

title: 2 Samuel 16:16
text: And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, David's friend, was come unto Absalom, that Hushai said unto Absalom, [Long] live the king, [Long] live the king.

title: 2 Samuel 16:17
text: And Absalom said to Hushai, Is this thy kindness to thy friend? why wentest thou not with thy friend?

title: 2 Samuel 16:18
text: And Hushai said unto Absalom, Nay; but whom Jehovah, and this people, and all the men of Israel have chosen, his will I be, and with him will I abide.

title: 2 Samuel 16:19
text: And again, whom should I serve? [should I] not [serve] in the presence of his son? as I have served in thy father's presence, so will I be in thy presence.

title: 2 Samuel 16:20
text: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give your counsel what we shall do.

title: 2 Samuel 16:21
text: And Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Go in unto thy father's concubines, that he hath left to keep the house; and all Israel will hear that thou art abhorred of thy father: then will the hands of all that are with thee be strong.

title: 2 Samuel 16:22
text: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house; and Absalom went in unto his father's concubines in the sight of all Israel.

title: 2 Samuel 16:23
text: And the counsel of Ahithophel, which he gave in those days, was as if a man inquired at the oracle of God: so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom.

title: 2 Samuel 17:1
text: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David this night:

title: 2 Samuel 17:2
text: and I will come upon him while he is weary and weak-handed, and will make him afraid; and all the people that are with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only;

title: 2 Samuel 17:3
text: and I will bring back all the people unto thee: the man whom thou seekest is as if all returned: [so] all the people shall be in peace.

title: 2 Samuel 17:4
text: And the saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.

title: 2 Samuel 17:5
text: Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear likewise what he saith.

title: 2 Samuel 17:6
text: And when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom spake unto him, saying, Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner: shall we do [after] his saying? if not, speak thou.

title: 2 Samuel 17:7
text: And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel hath given this time is not good.

title: 2 Samuel 17:8
text: Hushai said moreover, Thou knowest thy father and his men, that they are mighty men, and they are chafed in their minds, as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field; and thy father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.

title: 2 Samuel 17:9
text: Behold, he is hid now in some pit, or in some [other] place: and it will come to pass, when some of them are fallen at the first, that whosoever heareth it will say, There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom.

title: 2 Samuel 17:10
text: And even he that is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, will utterly melt; for all Israel knoweth that thy father is a mighty man, and they that are with him are valiant men.

title: 2 Samuel 17:11
text: But I counsel that all Israel be gathered together unto thee, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that thou go to battle in thine own person.

title: 2 Samuel 17:12
text: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found, and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground; and of him and of all the men that are with him we will not leave so much as one.

title: 2 Samuel 17:13
text: Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.

title: 2 Samuel 17:14
text: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said, The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For Jehovah had ordained to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that Jehovah might bring evil upon Absalom.

title: 2 Samuel 17:15
text: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel; and thus and thus have I counselled.

title: 2 Samuel 17:16
text: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, Lodge not this night at the fords of the wilderness, but by all means pass over; lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people that are with him.

title: 2 Samuel 17:17
text: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying by En-rogel; and a maid-servant used to go and tell them; and they went and told king David: for they might not be seen to come into the city.

title: 2 Samuel 17:18
text: But a lad saw them, and told Absalom: and they went both of them away quickly, and came to the house of a man in Bahurim, who had a well in his court; and they went down thither.

title: 2 Samuel 17:19
text: And the woman took and spread the covering over the well's mouth, and strewed bruised grain thereon; and nothing was known.

title: 2 Samuel 17:20
text: And Absalom's servants came to the woman to the house; and they said, Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said unto them, They are gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.

title: 2 Samuel 17:21
text: And it came to pass, after they were departed, that they came up out of the well, and went and told king David; and they said unto David, Arise ye, and pass quickly over the water; for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you.

title: 2 Samuel 17:22
text: Then David arose, and all the people that were with him, and they passed over the Jordan: by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over the Jordan.

title: 2 Samuel 17:23
text: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his ass, and arose, and gat him home, unto his city, and set his house in order, and hanged himself; and he died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his father.

title: 2 Samuel 17:24
text: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over the Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

title: 2 Samuel 17:25
text: And Absalom set Amasa over the host instead of Joab. Now Amasa was the son of a man, whose name was Ithra the Israelite, that went in to Abigal the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah, Joab's mother.

title: 2 Samuel 17:26
text: And Israel and Absalom encamped in the land of Gilead.

title: 2 Samuel 17:27
text: And it came to pass, when David was come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

title: 2 Samuel 17:28
text: brought beds, and basins, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and meal, and parched [grain], and beans, and lentils, and parched [pulse] ,

title: 2 Samuel 17:29
text: and honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheese of the herd, for David, and for the people that were with him, to eat: for they said, The people are hungry, and weary, and thirsty, in the wilderness.

title: 2 Samuel 18:1
text: And David numbered the people that were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.

title: 2 Samuel 18:2
text: And David sent forth the people, a third part under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab's brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said unto the people, I will surely go forth with you myself also.

title: 2 Samuel 18:3
text: But the people said, Thou shalt not go forth: for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they care for us: but thou art worth ten thousand of us; therefore now it is better that thou be ready to succor us out of the city.

title: 2 Samuel 18:4
text: And the king said unto them, What seemeth you best I will do. And the king stood by the gate-side, and all the people went out by hundreds and by thousands.

title: 2 Samuel 18:5
text: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom. And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.

title: 2 Samuel 18:6
text: So the people went out into the field against Israel: and the battle was in the forest of Ephraim.

title: 2 Samuel 18:7
text: And the people of Israel were smitten there before the servants of David, and there was a great slaughter there that day of twenty thousand men.

title: 2 Samuel 18:8
text: For the battle was there spread over the face of all the country; and the forest devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.

title: 2 Samuel 18:9
text: And Absalom chanced to meet the servants of David. And Absalom was riding upon his mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between heaven and earth; and the mule that was under him went on.

title: 2 Samuel 18:10
text: And a certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Absalom hanging in an oak.

title: 2 Samuel 18:11
text: And Joab said unto the man that told him, And, behold, thou sawest it, and why didst thou not smite him there to the ground? and I would have given thee ten [pieces of] silver, and a girdle.

title: 2 Samuel 18:12
text: And the man said unto Joab, Though I should receive a thousand [pieces of] silver in my hand, yet would I not put forth my hand against the king's son; for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Beware that none touch the young man Absalom.

title: 2 Samuel 18:13
text: Otherwise if I had dealt falsely against his life (and there is no matter hid from the king), then thou thyself wouldest have set thyself against [me] .

title: 2 Samuel 18:14
text: Then said Joab, I may not tarry thus with thee. And he took three darts in his hand, and thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak.

title: 2 Samuel 18:15
text: And ten young men that bare Joab's armor compassed about and smote Absalom, and slew him.

title: 2 Samuel 18:16
text: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel; for Joab held back the people.

title: 2 Samuel 18:17
text: And they took Absalom, and cast him into the great pit in the forest, and raised over him a very great heap of stones: and all Israel fled every one to his tent.

title: 2 Samuel 18:18
text: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself the pillar, which is in the king's dale; for he said, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance: and he called the pillar after his own name; and it is called Absalom's monument, unto this day.

title: 2 Samuel 18:19
text: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok, Let me now run, and bear the king tidings, how that Jehovah hath avenged him of his enemies.

title: 2 Samuel 18:20
text: And Joab said unto him, Thou shalt not be the bearer of tidings this day, but thou shalt bear tidings another day; but this day thou shalt bear no tidings, because the king's son is dead.

title: 2 Samuel 18:21
text: Then said Joab to the Cushite, Go, tell the king what thou hast seen. And the Cushite bowed himself unto Joab, and ran.

title: 2 Samuel 18:22
text: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok yet again to Joab, But come what may, let me, I pray thee, also run after the Cushite. And Joab said, Wherefore wilt thou run, my son, seeing that thou wilt have no reward for the tidings?

title: 2 Samuel 18:23
text: But come what may, [said he], I will run. And he said unto him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the Plain, and outran the Cushite.

title: 2 Samuel 18:24
text: Now David was sitting between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof of the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, a man running alone.

title: 2 Samuel 18:25
text: And the watchman cried, and told the king. And the king said, If he be alone, there is tidings in his mouth. And he came apace, and drew near.

title: 2 Samuel 18:26
text: And the watchman saw another man running; and the watchman called unto the porter, and said, Behold, [another] man running alone. And the king said, He also bringeth tidings.

title: 2 Samuel 18:27
text: And the watchman said, I think the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man, and cometh with good tidings.

title: 2 Samuel 18:28
text: And Ahimaaz called, and said unto the king, All is well. And he bowed himself before the king with his face to the earth, and said, Blessed be Jehovah thy God, who hath delivered up the men that lifted up their hand against my lord the king.

title: 2 Samuel 18:29
text: And the king said, Is it well with the young man Absalom? And Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent the king's servant, even me thy servant, I saw a great tumult, but I knew not what it was.

title: 2 Samuel 18:30
text: And the king said, Turn aside, and stand here. And he turned aside, and stood still.

title: 2 Samuel 18:31
text: And, behold, the Cushite came; and the Cushite said, Tidings for my lord the king; for Jehovah hath avenged thee this day of all them that rose up against thee.

title: 2 Samuel 18:32
text: And the king said unto the Cushite, Is it well with the young man Absalom? And the Cushite answered, The enemies of my lord the king, and all that rise up against thee to do thee hurt, be as that young man is.

title: 2 Samuel 18:33
text: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!

title: 2 Samuel 19:1
text: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.

title: 2 Samuel 19:2
text: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people; for the people heard say that day, The king grieveth for his son.

title: 2 Samuel 19:3
text: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people that are ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.

title: 2 Samuel 19:4
text: And the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!

title: 2 Samuel 19:5
text: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants, who this day have saved thy life, and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and the lives of thy concubines;

title: 2 Samuel 19:6
text: in that thou lovest them that hate thee, and hatest them that love thee. For thou hast declared this day, that princes and servants are nought unto thee: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we had died this day, then it had pleased thee well.

title: 2 Samuel 19:7
text: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably unto thy servants; for I swear by Jehovah, if thou go not forth, there will not tarry a man with thee this night: and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that hath befallen thee from thy youth until now.

title: 2 Samuel 19:8
text: Then the king arose, and sat in the gate. And they told unto all the people, saying, Behold, the king is sitting in the gate: and all the people came before the king. Now Israel had fled every man to his tent.

title: 2 Samuel 19:9
text: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, The king delivered us out of the hand of our enemies, and he saved us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he is fled out of the land from Absalom.

title: 2 Samuel 19:10
text: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back?

title: 2 Samuel 19:11
text: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Judah, saying, Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king, [to bring him] to his house.

title: 2 Samuel 19:12
text: Ye are my brethren, ye are my bone and my flesh: wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king?

title: 2 Samuel 19:13
text: And say ye to Amasa, Art thou not my bone and my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.

title: 2 Samuel 19:14
text: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as [the heart of] one man; so that they sent unto the king, [saying], Return thou, and all thy servants.

title: 2 Samuel 19:15
text: So the king returned, and came to the Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to bring the king over the Jordan.

title: 2 Samuel 19:16
text: And Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.

title: 2 Samuel 19:17
text: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went through the Jordan in the presence of the king.

title: 2 Samuel 19:18
text: And there went over a ferry-boat to bring over the king's household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, when he was come over the Jordan.

title: 2 Samuel 19:19
text: And he said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

title: 2 Samuel 19:20
text: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come this day the first of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.

title: 2 Samuel 19:21
text: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed Jehovah's anointed?

title: 2 Samuel 19:22
text: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel?

title: 2 Samuel 19:23
text: And the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.

title: 2 Samuel 19:24
text: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king; and he had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came home in peace.

title: 2 Samuel 19:25
text: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?

title: 2 Samuel 19:26
text: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go with the king; because thy servant is lame.

title: 2 Samuel 19:27
text: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of God: do therefore what is good in thine eyes.

title: 2 Samuel 19:28
text: For all my father's house were but dead men before my lord the king; yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table. What right therefore have I yet that I should cry any more unto the king?

title: 2 Samuel 19:29
text: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I say, Thou and Ziba divide the land.

title: 2 Samuel 19:30
text: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come in peace unto his own house.

title: 2 Samuel 19:31
text: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went over the Jordan with the king, to conduct him over the Jordan.

title: 2 Samuel 19:32
text: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king with sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.

title: 2 Samuel 19:33
text: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will sustain thee with me in Jerusalem.

title: 2 Samuel 19:34
text: And Barzillai said unto the king, How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?

title: 2 Samuel 19:35
text: I am this day fourscore years old: can I discern between good and bad? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?

title: 2 Samuel 19:36
text: Thy servant would but just go over the Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?

title: 2 Samuel 19:37
text: Let thy servant, I pray thee, turn back again, that I may die in mine own city, by the grave of my father and my mother. But behold, thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee.

title: 2 Samuel 19:38
text: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee: and whatsoever thou shalt require of me, that will I do for thee.

title: 2 Samuel 19:39
text: And all the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over: and the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.

title: 2 Samuel 19:40
text: So the king went over to Gilgal, and Chimham went over with him: and all the people of Judah brought the king over, and also half the people of Israel.

title: 2 Samuel 19:41
text: And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away, and brought the king, and his household, over the Jordan, and all David's men with him?

title: 2 Samuel 19:42
text: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the king is near of kin to us: wherefore then are ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all at the king's cost? or hath he given us any gift?

title: 2 Samuel 19:43
text: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more [right] in David than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.

title: 2 Samuel 20:1
text: And there happened to be there a base fellow, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew the trumpet, and said, We have no portion in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.

title: 2 Samuel 20:2
text: So all the men of Israel went up from following David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri; but the men of Judah clave unto their king, from the Jordan even to Jerusalem.

title: 2 Samuel 20:3
text: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and provided them with sustenance, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.

title: 2 Samuel 20:4
text: Then said the king to Amasa, Call me the men of Judah together within three days, and be thou here present.

title: 2 Samuel 20:5
text: So Amasa went to call [the men of] Judah together; but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.

title: 2 Samuel 20:6
text: And David said to Abishai, Now will Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take thou thy lord's servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fortified cities, and escape out of our sight.

title: 2 Samuel 20:7
text: And there went out after him Joab's men, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men; and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

title: 2 Samuel 20:8
text: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. And Joab was girded with his apparel of war that he had put on, and thereon was a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.

title: 2 Samuel 20:9
text: And Joab said to Amasa, Is it well with thee, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.

title: 2 Samuel 20:10
text: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab's hand: so he smote him therewith in the body, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. And Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.

title: 2 Samuel 20:11
text: And there stood by him one of Joab's young men, and said, He that favoreth Joab, and he that is for David, let him follow Joab.

title: 2 Samuel 20:12
text: And Amasa lay wallowing in his blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he carried Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a garment over him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.

title: 2 Samuel 20:13
text: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

title: 2 Samuel 20:14
text: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to Beth-maacah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.

title: 2 Samuel 20:15
text: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth-maacah, and they cast up a mound against the city, and it stood against the rampart; and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.

title: 2 Samuel 20:16
text: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.

title: 2 Samuel 20:17
text: And he came near unto her; and the woman said, Art thou Joab? And he answered, I am. Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thy handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.

title: 2 Samuel 20:18
text: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask [counsel] at Abel: and so they ended [the matter] .

title: 2 Samuel 20:19
text: I am of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of Jehovah?

title: 2 Samuel 20:20
text: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

title: 2 Samuel 20:21
text: The matter is not so: but a man of the hill-country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king, even against David; deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.

title: 2 Samuel 20:22
text: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. And he blew the trumpet, and they were dispersed from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.

title: 2 Samuel 20:23
text: Now Joab was over all the host of Israel; and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites;

title: 2 Samuel 20:24
text: and Adoram was over the men subject to taskwork; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder;

title: 2 Samuel 20:25
text: and Sheva was scribe; and Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

title: 2 Samuel 20:26
text: and also Ira the Jairite was chief minister unto David.

title: 2 Samuel 21:1
text: And there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David sought the face of Jehovah. And Jehovah said, It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he put to death the Gibeonites.

title: 2 Samuel 21:2
text: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal for the children of Israel and Judah);

title: 2 Samuel 21:3
text: and David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of Jehovah?

title: 2 Samuel 21:4
text: And the Gibeonites said unto him, It is no matter of silver or gold between us and Saul, or his house; neither is it for us to put any man to death in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, that will I do for you.

title: 2 Samuel 21:5
text: And they said unto the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us, [that] we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the borders of Israel,

title: 2 Samuel 21:6
text: let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto Jehovah in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of Jehovah. And the king said, I will give them.

title: 2 Samuel 21:7
text: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of Jehovah's oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

title: 2 Samuel 21:8
text: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she bare to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:

title: 2 Samuel 21:9
text: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the mountain before Jehovah, and they fell [all] seven together. And they were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, at the beginning of barley harvest.

title: 2 Samuel 21:10
text: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water was poured upon them from heaven; and she suffered neither the birds of the heavens to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.

title: 2 Samuel 21:11
text: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.

title: 2 Samuel 21:12
text: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh-gilead, who had stolen them from the street of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hanged them, in the day that the Philistines slew Saul in Gilboa;

title: 2 Samuel 21:13
text: and he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son: and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.

title: 2 Samuel 21:14
text: And they buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was entreated for the land.

title: 2 Samuel 21:15
text: And the Philistines had war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines. And David waxed faint;

title: 2 Samuel 21:16
text: and Ishbibenob, who was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred [shekels] of brass in weight, he being girded with a new [sword], thought to have slain David.

title: 2 Samuel 21:17
text: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succored him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the lamp of Israel.

title: 2 Samuel 21:18
text: And it came to pass after this, that there was again war with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbecai the Hushathite slew Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.

title: 2 Samuel 21:19
text: And there was again war with the Philistines at Gob; and Elhanan the son of Jaareoregim the Beth-lehemite slew Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.

title: 2 Samuel 21:20
text: And there was again war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant. [

title: 2 Samuel 21:21
text: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David's brother, slew him.

title: 2 Samuel 21:22
text: These four were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

title: 2 Samuel 22:1
text: And David spake unto Jehovah the words of this song in the day that Jehovah delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:

title: 2 Samuel 22:2
text: and he said, Jehovah is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;

title: 2 Samuel 22:3
text: God, my rock, in him will I take refuge; My shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge; My saviour, thou savest me from violence.

title: 2 Samuel 22:4
text: I will call upon Jehovah, who is worthy to be praised: So shall I be saved from mine enemies.

title: 2 Samuel 22:5
text: For the waves of death compassed me; The floods of ungodliness made me afraid:

title: 2 Samuel 22:6
text: The cords of Sheol were round about me; The snares of death came upon me.

title: 2 Samuel 22:7
text: In my distress I called upon Jehovah; Yea, I called unto my God: And he heard my voice out of his temple, And my cry [came] into his ears.

title: 2 Samuel 22:8
text: Then the earth shook and trembled, The foundations of heaven quaked And were shaken, because he was wroth.

title: 2 Samuel 22:9
text: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, And fire out of his mouth devoured: Coals were kindled by it.

title: 2 Samuel 22:10
text: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; And thick darkness was under his feet.

title: 2 Samuel 22:11
text: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly; Yea, he was seen upon the wings of the wind.

title: 2 Samuel 22:12
text: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, Gathering of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

title: 2 Samuel 22:13
text: At the brightness before him Coals of fire were kindled.

title: 2 Samuel 22:14
text: Jehovah thundered from heaven, And the Most High uttered his voice.

title: 2 Samuel 22:15
text: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; Lightning, and discomfited them.

title: 2 Samuel 22:16
text: Then the channels of the sea appeared, The foundations of the world were laid bare, By the rebuke of Jehovah, At the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

title: 2 Samuel 22:17
text: He sent from on high, he took me; He drew me out of many waters;

title: 2 Samuel 22:18
text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, From them that hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

title: 2 Samuel 22:19
text: They came upon me in the day of my calamity; But Jehovah was my stay.

title: 2 Samuel 22:20
text: He brought me forth also into a large place; He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

title: 2 Samuel 22:21
text: Jehovah rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

title: 2 Samuel 22:22
text: For I have kept the ways of Jehovah, And have not wickedly departed from my God.

title: 2 Samuel 22:23
text: For all his ordinances were before me; And as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.

title: 2 Samuel 22:24
text: I was also perfect toward him; And I kept myself from mine iniquity.

title: 2 Samuel 22:25
text: Therefore hath Jehovah recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.

title: 2 Samuel 22:26
text: With the merciful thou wilt show thyself merciful; With the perfect man thou wilt show thyself perfect;

title: 2 Samuel 22:27
text: With the pure thou wilt show thyself pure; And with the perverse thou wilt show thyself froward.

title: 2 Samuel 22:28
text: And the afflicted people thou wilt save; But thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.

title: 2 Samuel 22:29
text: For thou art my lamp, O Jehovah; And Jehovah will lighten my darkness.

title: 2 Samuel 22:30
text: For by thee I run upon a troop; By my God do I leap over a wall.

title: 2 Samuel 22:31
text: As for God, his way is perfect: The word of Jehovah is tried; He is a shield unto all them that take refuge in him.

title: 2 Samuel 22:32
text: For who is God, save Jehovah? And who is a rock, save our God?

title: 2 Samuel 22:33
text: God is my strong fortress; And he guideth the perfect in his way.

title: 2 Samuel 22:34
text: He maketh his feet like hinds' [feet], And setteth me upon my high places.

title: 2 Samuel 22:35
text: He teacheth my hands to war, So that mine arms do bend a bow of brass.

title: 2 Samuel 22:36
text: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation; And thy gentleness hath made me great.

title: 2 Samuel 22:37
text: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; And my feet have not slipped.

title: 2 Samuel 22:38
text: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; Neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

title: 2 Samuel 22:39
text: And I have consumed them, and smitten them through, so that they cannot arise: Yea, they are fallen under my feet.

title: 2 Samuel 22:40
text: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle; Thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

title: 2 Samuel 22:41
text: Thou hast also made mine enemies turn their backs unto me, That I might cut off them that hate me.

title: 2 Samuel 22:42
text: They looked, but there was none to save; Even unto Jehovah, but he answered them not.

title: 2 Samuel 22:43
text: Then did I beat them small as the dust of the earth, I did crush them as the mire of the streets, and did spread them abroad.

title: 2 Samuel 22:44
text: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people; Thou hast kept me to be the head of the nations: A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

title: 2 Samuel 22:45
text: The foreigners shall submit themselves unto me: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me.

title: 2 Samuel 22:46
text: The foreigners shall fade away, And shall come trembling out of their close places.

title: 2 Samuel 22:47
text: Jehovah liveth; And blessed be my rock; And exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,

title: 2 Samuel 22:48
text: Even the God that executeth vengeance for me, And that bringeth down peoples under me,

title: 2 Samuel 22:49
text: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: Yea, thou liftest me up above them that rise up against me; Thou deliverest me from the violent man.

title: 2 Samuel 22:50
text: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the nations, And will sing praises unto thy name.

title: 2 Samuel 22:51
text: Great deliverance giveth he to his king, And showeth lovingkindness to his anointed, To David and to his seed, for evermore.

title: 2 Samuel 23:1
text: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse saith, And the man who was raised on high saith, The anointed of the God of Jacob, And the sweet psalmist of Israel:

title: 2 Samuel 23:2
text: The Spirit of Jehovah spake by me, And his word was upon my tongue.

title: 2 Samuel 23:3
text: The God of Israel said, The Rock of Israel spake to me: One that ruleth over men righteously, That ruleth in the fear of God,

title: 2 Samuel 23:4
text: [ He shall be] as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, A morning without clouds, [When] the tender grass [springeth] out of the earth, Through clear shining after rain.

title: 2 Samuel 23:5
text: Verily my house is not so with God; Yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, Ordered in all things, and sure: For it is all my salvation, and all [my] desire, Although he maketh it not to grow.

title: 2 Samuel 23:6
text: But the ungodly shall be all of them as thorns to be thrust away, Because they cannot be taken with the hand;

title: 2 Samuel 23:7
text: But the man that toucheth them Must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear: And they shall be utterly burned with fire in [their] place.

title: 2 Samuel 23:8
text: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb-basshebeth a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite, against eight hundred slain at one time.

title: 2 Samuel 23:9
text: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away.

title: 2 Samuel 23:10
text: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword; and Jehovah wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to take spoil.

title: 2 Samuel 23:11
text: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee a Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.

title: 2 Samuel 23:12
text: But he stood in the midst of the plot, and defended it, and slew the Philistines; and Jehovah wrought a great victory.

title: 2 Samuel 23:13
text: And three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

title: 2 Samuel 23:14
text: And David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Beth-lehem.

title: 2 Samuel 23:15
text: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me water to drink of the well of Beth-lehem, which is by the gate!

title: 2 Samuel 23:16
text: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto Jehovah.

title: 2 Samuel 23:17
text: And he said, Be it far from me, O Jehovah, that I should do this: [shall I drink] the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did the three mighty men.

title: 2 Samuel 23:18
text: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred and slew them, and had a name among the three.

title: 2 Samuel 23:19
text: Was he not most honorable of the three? therefore he was made their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the [first] three.

title: 2 Samuel 23:20
text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, he slew the two [sons of] Ariel of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow.

title: 2 Samuel 23:21
text: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.

title: 2 Samuel 23:22
text: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had a name among the three mighty men.

title: 2 Samuel 23:23
text: He was more honorable than the thirty, but he attained not to the [first] three. And David set him over his guard.

title: 2 Samuel 23:24
text: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,

title: 2 Samuel 23:25
text: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

title: 2 Samuel 23:26
text: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

title: 2 Samuel 23:27
text: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

title: 2 Samuel 23:28
text: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

title: 2 Samuel 23:29
text: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

title: 2 Samuel 23:30
text: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash.

title: 2 Samuel 23:31
text: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

title: 2 Samuel 23:32
text: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

title: 2 Samuel 23:33
text: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite,

title: 2 Samuel 23:34
text: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

title: 2 Samuel 23:35
text: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

title: 2 Samuel 23:36
text: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

title: 2 Samuel 23:37
text: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armorbearers to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

title: 2 Samuel 23:38
text: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

title: 2 Samuel 23:39
text: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.

title: 2 Samuel 24:1
text: And again the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them, saying, Go, number Israel and Judah.

title: 2 Samuel 24:2
text: And the king said to Joab the captain of the host, who was with him, Go now to and fro through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the sum of the people.

title: 2 Samuel 24:3
text: And Joab said unto the king, Now Jehovah thy God add unto the people, how many soever they may be, a hundredfold; and may the eyes of my lord the king see it: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?

title: 2 Samuel 24:4
text: Notwithstanding, the king's word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.

title: 2 Samuel 24:5
text: And they passed over the Jordan, and encamped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley of Gad, and unto Jazer:

title: 2 Samuel 24:6
text: then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtim-hodshi; and they came to Dan-jaan, and round about to Sidon,

title: 2 Samuel 24:7
text: and came to the stronghold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites; and they went out to the south of Judah, at Beer-sheba.

title: 2 Samuel 24:8
text: So when they had gone to and from through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

title: 2 Samuel 24:9
text: And Joab gave up the sum of the numbering of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

title: 2 Samuel 24:10
text: And David's heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto Jehovah, I have sinned greatly in that which I have done: but now, O Jehovah, put away, I beseech thee, the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

title: 2 Samuel 24:11
text: And when David rose up in the morning, the word of Jehovah came unto the prophet Gad, David's seer, saying,

title: 2 Samuel 24:12
text: Go and speak unto David, Thus saith Jehovah, I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

title: 2 Samuel 24:13
text: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thy foes while they pursue thee? or shall there be three days' pestilence in thy land? now advise thee, and consider what answer I shall return to him that sent me.

title: 2 Samuel 24:14
text: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of Jehovah; for his mercies are great; and let me not fall into the hand of man.

title: 2 Samuel 24:15
text: So Jehovah sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed; and there died of the people from Dan even to Beer-sheba seventy thousand men.

title: 2 Samuel 24:16
text: And when the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, Jehovah repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough; now stay thy hand. And the angel of Jehovah was by the threshing-floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

title: 2 Samuel 24:17
text: And David spake unto Jehovah when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done perversely; but these sheep, what have they done? let thy hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father's house.

title: 2 Samuel 24:18
text: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto Jehovah in the threshing-floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

title: 2 Samuel 24:19
text: And David went up according to the saying of Gad, as Jehovah commanded.

title: 2 Samuel 24:20
text: And Araunah looked forth, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

title: 2 Samuel 24:21
text: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshing-floor of thee, to build an altar unto Jehovah, that the plague may be stayed from the people.

title: 2 Samuel 24:22
text: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him: behold, the oxen for the burnt-offering, and the threshing instruments and the yokes of the oxen for the wood:

title: 2 Samuel 24:23
text: all this, O king, doth Araunah give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, Jehovah thy God accept thee.

title: 2 Samuel 24:24
text: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will verily buy it of thee at a price. Neither will I offer burnt-offerings unto Jehovah my God which cost me nothing. So David bought the threshing-floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

title: 2 Samuel 24:25
text: And David built there an altar unto Jehovah, and offered burnt-offerings and peace-offerings. So Jehovah was entreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.

title: 1 Kings 1:1
text: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.

title: 1 Kings 1:2
text: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and cherish him; and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.

title: 1 Kings 1:3
text: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

title: 1 Kings 1:4
text: And the damsel was very fair; and she cherished the king, and ministered to him; but the king knew her not.

title: 1 Kings 1:5
text: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

title: 1 Kings 1:6
text: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he was also a very goodly man; and he was born after Absalom.

title: 1 Kings 1:7
text: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him.

title: 1 Kings 1:8
text: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men that belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

title: 1 Kings 1:9
text: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En-rogel; and he called all his brethren, the king's sons, and all the men of Judah, the king's servants: [

title: 1 Kings 1:10
text: but Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.

title: 1 Kings 1:11
text: Then Nathan spake unto Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?

title: 1 Kings 1:12
text: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.

title: 1 Kings 1:13
text: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thy handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?

title: 1 Kings 1:14
text: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.

title: 1 Kings 1:15
text: And Bath-sheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite was ministering unto the king.

title: 1 Kings 1:16
text: And Bath-sheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?

title: 1 Kings 1:17
text: And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by Jehovah thy God unto thy handmaid, [saying], Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.

title: 1 Kings 1:18
text: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and thou, my lord the king, knowest it not:

title: 1 Kings 1:19
text: and he hath slain oxen and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host; but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.

title: 1 Kings 1:20
text: And thou, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

title: 1 Kings 1:21
text: Otherwise it will come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.

title: 1 Kings 1:22
text: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.

title: 1 Kings 1:23
text: And they told the king, saying, Behold, Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

title: 1 Kings 1:24
text: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?

title: 1 Kings 1:25
text: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king's sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and say, [Long] live king Adonijah.

title: 1 Kings 1:26
text: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.

title: 1 Kings 1:27
text: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not showed unto thy servants who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?

title: 1 Kings 1:28
text: Then king David answered and said, Call to me Bath-sheba. And she came into the king's presence, and stood before the king.

title: 1 Kings 1:29
text: And the king sware, and said, As Jehovah liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

title: 1 Kings 1:30
text: verily as I sware unto thee by Jehovah, the God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; verily so will I do this day.

title: 1 Kings 1:31
text: Then Bath-sheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did obeisance to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.

title: 1 Kings 1:32
text: And king David said, Call to me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.

title: 1 Kings 1:33
text: And the king said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:

title: 1 Kings 1:34
text: and let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel; and blow ye the trumpet, and say, [Long] live king Solomon.

title: 1 Kings 1:35
text: Then ye shall come up after him, and he shall come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead; and I have appointed him to be prince over Israel and over Judah.

title: 1 Kings 1:36
text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: Jehovah, the God of my lord the king, say so [too] .

title: 1 Kings 1:37
text: As Jehovah hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.

title: 1 Kings 1:38
text: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David's mule, and brought him to Gihon.

title: 1 Kings 1:39
text: And Zadok the priest took the horn of oil out of the Tent, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, [Long] live king Solomon.

title: 1 Kings 1:40
text: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.

title: 1 Kings 1:41
text: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?

title: 1 Kings 1:42
text: While he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said, Come in; for thou art a worthy man, and bringest good tidings.

title: 1 Kings 1:43
text: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king:

title: 1 Kings 1:44
text: and the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they have caused him to ride upon the king's mule;

title: 1 Kings 1:45
text: and Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon; and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that ye have heard.

title: 1 Kings 1:46
text: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.

title: 1 Kings 1:47
text: And moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, Thy God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne: and the king bowed himself upon the bed.

title: 1 Kings 1:48
text: And also thus said the king, Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, who hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.

title: 1 Kings 1:49
text: And all the guests of Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.

title: 1 Kings 1:50
text: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon; and he arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

title: 1 Kings 1:51
text: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon; for, lo, he hath laid hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me first that he will not slay his servant with the sword.

title: 1 Kings 1:52
text: And Solomon said, If he shall show himself a worthy man, there shall not a hair of him fall to the earth; but if wickedness be found in him, he shall die.

title: 1 Kings 1:53
text: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and did obeisance to king Solomon; and Solomon said unto him, Go to thy house.

title: 1 Kings 2:1
text: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,

title: 1 Kings 2:2
text: I am going the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and show thyself a man;

title: 1 Kings 2:3
text: and keep the charge of Jehovah thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, [and] his commandments, and his ordinances, and his testimonies, according to that which is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself.

title: 1 Kings 2:4
text: That Jehovah may establish his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.

title: 1 Kings 2:5
text: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did unto me, even what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.

title: 1 Kings 2:6
text: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to Sheol in peace.

title: 1 Kings 2:7
text: But show kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table; for so they came to me when I fled from Absalom thy brother.

title: 1 Kings 2:8
text: And, behold, there is with thee Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I sware to him by Jehovah, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.

title: 1 Kings 2:9
text: Now therefore hold him not guiltless, for thou art a wise man; and thou wilt know what thou oughtest to do unto him, and thou shalt bring his hoar head down to Sheol with blood.

title: 1 Kings 2:10
text: And David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.

title: 1 Kings 2:11
text: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

title: 1 Kings 2:12
text: And Solomon sat upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.

title: 1 Kings 2:13
text: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.

title: 1 Kings 2:14
text: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.

title: 1 Kings 2:15
text: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother's; for it was his from Jehovah.

title: 1 Kings 2:16
text: And now I ask one petition of thee; deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.

title: 1 Kings 2:17
text: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king (for he will not say thee nay), that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.

title: 1 Kings 2:18
text: And Bath-sheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.

title: 1 Kings 2:19
text: Bath-sheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a throne to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.

title: 1 Kings 2:20
text: Then she said, I ask one small petition of thee; deny me not. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother; for I will not deny thee.

title: 1 Kings 2:21
text: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.

title: 1 Kings 2:22
text: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.

title: 1 Kings 2:23
text: Then king Solomon sware by Jehovah, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah hath not spoken this word against his own life.

title: 1 Kings 2:24
text: Now therefore as Jehovah liveth, who hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me a house, as he promised, surely Adonijah shall be put to death this day.

title: 1 Kings 2:25
text: And king Solomon sent by Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him, so that he died.

title: 1 Kings 2:26
text: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord Jehovah before David my father, and because thou wast afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.

title: 1 Kings 2:27
text: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto Jehovah, that he might fulfil the word of Jehovah, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

title: 1 Kings 2:28
text: And the tidings came to Joab; for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the Tent of Jehovah, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

title: 1 Kings 2:29
text: And it was told king Solomon, Joab is fled unto the Tent of Jehovah, and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.

title: 1 Kings 2:30
text: And Benaiah came to the Tent of Jehovah, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.

title: 1 Kings 2:31
text: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the blood, which Joab shed without cause, from me and from my father's house.

title: 1 Kings 2:32
text: And Jehovah will return his blood upon his own head, because he fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, and my father David knew it not, [to wit], Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.

title: 1 Kings 2:33
text: So shall their blood return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but unto David, and unto his seed, and unto his house, and unto his throne, shall there be peace for ever from Jehovah.

title: 1 Kings 2:34
text: Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him; and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.

title: 1 Kings 2:35
text: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host; and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.

title: 1 Kings 2:36
text: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee a house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.

title: 1 Kings 2:37
text: For on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, know thou for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.

title: 1 Kings 2:38
text: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.

title: 1 Kings 2:39
text: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants are in Gath.

title: 1 Kings 2:40
text: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish, to seek his servants; and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.

title: 1 Kings 2:41
text: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.

title: 1 Kings 2:42
text: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not adjure thee by Jehovah, and protest unto thee, saying, Know for certain, that on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The saying that I have heard is good.

title: 1 Kings 2:43
text: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of Jehovah, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?

title: 1 Kings 2:44
text: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thy heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore Jehovah shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head.

title: 1 Kings 2:45
text: But king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before Jehovah for ever.

title: 1 Kings 2:46
text: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he went out, and fell upon him, so that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.

title: 1 Kings 3:1
text: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh's daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of Jehovah, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.

title: 1 Kings 3:2
text: Only the people sacrificed in the high places, because there was no house built for the name of Jehovah until those days.

title: 1 Kings 3:3
text: And Solomon loved Jehovah, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.

title: 1 Kings 3:4
text: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt-offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.

title: 1 Kings 3:5
text: In Gibeon Jehovah appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.

title: 1 Kings 3:6
text: And Solomon said, Thou hast showed unto thy servant David my father great lovingkindness, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great lovingkindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.

title: 1 Kings 3:7
text: And now, O Jehovah my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child; I know not how to go out or come in.

title: 1 Kings 3:8
text: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.

title: 1 Kings 3:9
text: Give thy servant therefore an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this thy great people?

title: 1 Kings 3:10
text: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.

title: 1 Kings 3:11
text: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life, neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies, but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern justice;

title: 1 Kings 3:12
text: behold, I have done according to thy word: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there hath been none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.

title: 1 Kings 3:13
text: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches and honor, so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee, all thy days.

title: 1 Kings 3:14
text: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.

title: 1 Kings 3:15
