text: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream: and he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and offered up burnt-offerings, and offered peace-offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.

title: 1 Kings 3:16
text: Then there came two women that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.

title: 1 Kings 3:17
text: And the one woman said, Oh, my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.

title: 1 Kings 3:18
text: And it came to pass the third day after I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also; and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.

title: 1 Kings 3:19
text: And this woman's child died in the night, because she lay upon it.

title: 1 Kings 3:20
text: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thy handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

title: 1 Kings 3:21
text: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead; but when I had looked at it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, whom I did bear.

title: 1 Kings 3:22
text: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead is thy son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.

title: 1 Kings 3:23
text: Then said the king, The one saith, This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.

title: 1 Kings 3:24
text: And the king said, Fetch me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.

title: 1 Kings 3:25
text: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.

title: 1 Kings 3:26
text: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her heart yearned over her son, and she said, Oh, my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, It shall be neither mine nor thine; divide it.

title: 1 Kings 3:27
text: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.

title: 1 Kings 3:28
text: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do justice.

title: 1 Kings 4:1
text: And king Solomon was king over all Israel.

title: 1 Kings 4:2
text: And these were the princes whom he had: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;

title: 1 Kings 4:3
text: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;

title: 1 Kings 4:4
text: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host; and Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

title: 1 Kings 4:5
text: and Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers; and Zabud the son of Nathan was chief minister, [and] the king's friend;

title: 1 Kings 4:6
text: and Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to taskwork.

title: 1 Kings 4:7
text: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided victuals for the king and his household: each man had to make provision for a month in the year.

title: 1 Kings 4:8
text: And these are their names: Ben-hur, in the hill-country of Ephraim;

title: 1 Kings 4:9
text: Ben-deker, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beth-shemesh, and Elon-beth-hanan;

title: 1 Kings 4:10
text: Ben-hesed, in Arubboth (to him [pertained] Socoh, and all the land of Hepher);

title: 1 Kings 4:11
text: Ben-abinadab, in all the height of Dor (he had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife);

title: 1 Kings 4:12
text: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth-shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;

title: 1 Kings 4:13
text: Ben-geber, in Ramoth-gilead (to him [pertained] the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; [even] to him [pertained] the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brazen bars);

title: 1 Kings 4:14
text: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;

title: 1 Kings 4:15
text: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon to wife);

title: 1 Kings 4:16
text: Baana the son of Hushai, in Asher and Bealoth;

title: 1 Kings 4:17
text: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;

title: 1 Kings 4:18
text: Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;

title: 1 Kings 4:19
text: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and [he was] the only officer that was in the land.

title: 1 Kings 4:20
text: Judah and Israel were many as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and making merry.

title: 1 Kings 4:21
text: And Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the River unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought tribute, and served Solomon all the days of his life.

title: 1 Kings 4:22
text: And Solomon's provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,

title: 1 Kings 4:23
text: ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and a hundred sheep, besides harts, and gazelles, and roebucks, and fatted fowl.

title: 1 Kings 4:24
text: For he had dominion over all [the region] on this side the River, from Tiphsah even to Gaza, over all the kings on this side the River: and he had peace on all sides round about him.

title: 1 Kings 4:25
text: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig-tree, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, all the days of Solomon.

title: 1 Kings 4:26
text: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

title: 1 Kings 4:27
text: And those officers provided victuals for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon's table, every man in his month; they let nothing be lacking.

title: 1 Kings 4:28
text: Barley also and straw for the horses and swift steeds brought they unto the place where [the officers] were, every man according to his charge.

title: 1 Kings 4:29
text: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea-shore.

title: 1 Kings 4:30
text: And Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east, and all the wisdom of Egypt.

title: 1 Kings 4:31
text: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all the nations round about.

title: 1 Kings 4:32
text: And he spake three thousand proverbs; and his songs were a thousand and five.

title: 1 Kings 4:33
text: And he spake of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall; he spake also of beasts, and of birds, and of creeping things, and of fishes.

title: 1 Kings 4:34
text: And there came of all peoples to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, who had heard of his wisdom.

title: 1 Kings 5:1
text: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.

title: 1 Kings 5:2
text: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

title: 1 Kings 5:3
text: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build a house for the name of Jehovah his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until Jehovah put them under the soles of his feet.

title: 1 Kings 5:4
text: But now Jehovah my God hath given me rest on every side; there is neither adversary, nor evil occurrence.

title: 1 Kings 5:5
text: And, behold, I purpose to build a house for the name of Jehovah my God, as Jehovah spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build the house for my name.

title: 1 Kings 5:6
text: Now therefore command thou that they cut me cedar-trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants; and I will give thee hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt say: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that knoweth how to cut timber like unto the Sidonians.

title: 1 Kings 5:7
text: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be Jehovah this day, who hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.

title: 1 Kings 5:8
text: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have heard [the message] which thou hast sent unto me: I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.

title: 1 Kings 5:9
text: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea; and I will make them into rafts to go by sea unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be broken up there, and thou shalt receive them; and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.

title: 1 Kings 5:10
text: So Hiram gave Solomon timber of cedar and timber of fir according to all his desire.

title: 1 Kings 5:11
text: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.

title: 1 Kings 5:12
text: And Jehovah gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him; and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.

title: 1 Kings 5:13
text: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.

title: 1 Kings 5:14
text: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses; a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home; and Adoniram was over the men subject to taskwork.

title: 1 Kings 5:15
text: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand that were hewers in the mountains;

title: 1 Kings 5:16
text: besides Solomon's chief officers that were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, who bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.

title: 1 Kings 5:17
text: And the king commanded, and they hewed out great stones, costly stones, to lay the foundation of the house with wrought stone.

title: 1 Kings 5:18
text: And Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders and the Gebalites did fashion them, and prepared the timber and the stones to build the house.

title: 1 Kings 6:1
text: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of Jehovah.

title: 1 Kings 6:2
text: And the house which king Solomon built for Jehovah, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty [cubits], and the height thereof thirty cubits.

title: 1 Kings 6:3
text: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; [and] ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.

title: 1 Kings 6:4
text: And for the house he made windows of fixed lattice-work.

title: 1 Kings 6:5
text: And against the wall of the house he built stories round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle; and he made side-chambers round about.

title: 1 Kings 6:6
text: The nethermost story was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad; for on the outside he made offsets [in the wall] of the house round about, that [the beams] should not have hold in the walls of the house.

title: 1 Kings 6:7
text: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready at the quarry; and there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.

title: 1 Kings 6:8
text: The door for the middle side-chambers was in the right side of the house: and they went up by winding stairs into the middle [story], and out of the middle into the third.

title: 1 Kings 6:9
text: So he built the house, and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.

title: 1 Kings 6:10
text: And he built the stories against all the house, each five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.

title: 1 Kings 6:11
text: And the word of Jehovah came to Solomon, saying,

title: 1 Kings 6:12
text: Concerning this house which thou art building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute mine ordinances, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I establish my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father.

title: 1 Kings 6:13
text: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.

title: 1 Kings 6:14
text: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.

title: 1 Kings 6:15
text: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar: from the floor of the house unto the walls of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood; and he covered the floor of the house with boards of fir.

title: 1 Kings 6:16
text: And he built twenty cubits on the hinder part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor unto the walls [of the ceiling] : he built [them] for it within, for an oracle, even for the most holy place.

title: 1 Kings 6:17
text: And the house, that is, the temple before [the oracle], was forty cubits [long] .

title: 1 Kings 6:18
text: And there was cedar on the house within, carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.

title: 1 Kings 6:19
text: And he prepared an oracle in the midst of the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of Jehovah.

title: 1 Kings 6:20
text: And within the oracle was [a space of] twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof; and he overlaid it with pure gold: and he covered the altar with cedar.

title: 1 Kings 6:21
text: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he drew chains of gold across before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.

title: 1 Kings 6:22
text: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until all the house was finished: also the whole altar that belonged to the oracle he overlaid with gold.

title: 1 Kings 6:23
text: And in the oracle he made two cherubim of olive-wood, each ten cubits high.

title: 1 Kings 6:24
text: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.

title: 1 Kings 6:25
text: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.

title: 1 Kings 6:26
text: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.

title: 1 Kings 6:27
text: And he set the cherubim within the inner house; and the wings of the cherubim were stretched forth, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.

title: 1 Kings 6:28
text: And he overlaid the cherubim with gold.

title: 1 Kings 6:29
text: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubim and palm-trees and open flowers, within and without.

title: 1 Kings 6:30
text: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.

title: 1 Kings 6:31
text: And for the entrance of the oracle he made doors of olive-wood: the lintel [and] door-posts were a fifth part [of the wall] .

title: 1 Kings 6:32
text: So [he made] two doors of olive-wood; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubim and palm-trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold; and he spread the gold upon the cherubim, and upon the palm-trees.

title: 1 Kings 6:33
text: So also made he for the entrance of the temple door-posts of olive-wood, out of a fourth part [of the wall] ;

title: 1 Kings 6:34
text: and two doors of fir-wood: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.

title: 1 Kings 6:35
text: And he carved [thereon] cherubim and palm-trees and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted upon the graven work.

title: 1 Kings 6:36
text: And he built the inner court with three courses of hewn stone, and a course of cedar beams.

title: 1 Kings 6:37
text: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of Jehovah laid, in the month Ziv.

title: 1 Kings 6:38
text: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.

title: 1 Kings 7:1
text: And Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

title: 1 Kings 7:2
text: For he built the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was a hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.

title: 1 Kings 7:3
text: And it was covered with cedar above over the forty and five beams, that were upon the pillars; fifteen in a row.

title: 1 Kings 7:4
text: And there were beams in three rows, and window was over against window in three ranks.

title: 1 Kings 7:5
text: And all the doors and posts were made square with beams: and window was over against window in three ranks.

title: 1 Kings 7:6
text: And he made the porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits; and a porch before them; and pillars and a threshold before them.

title: 1 Kings 7:7
text: And he made the porch of the throne where he was to judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor.

title: 1 Kings 7:8
text: And his house where he was to dwell, the other court within the porch, was of the like work. He made also a house for Pharaoh's daughter (whom Solomon had taken to wife), like unto this porch.

title: 1 Kings 7:9
text: All these were of costly stones, even of hewn stone, according to measure, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside unto the great court.

title: 1 Kings 7:10
text: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.

title: 1 Kings 7:11
text: And above were costly stones, even hewn stone, according to measure, and cedar-wood.

title: 1 Kings 7:12
text: And the great court round about had three courses of hewn stone, and a course of cedar beams; like as the inner court of the house of Jehovah, and the porch of the house.

title: 1 Kings 7:13
text: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.

title: 1 Kings 7:14
text: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill, to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.

title: 1 Kings 7:15
text: For he fashioned the two pillars of brass, eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits compassed either of them about.

title: 1 Kings 7:16
text: And he made two capitals of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.

title: 1 Kings 7:17
text: There were nets of checker-work, and wreaths of chain-work, for the capitals which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one capital, and seven for the other capital.

title: 1 Kings 7:18
text: So he made the pillars; and there were two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the capitals that were upon the top of the pillars: and so did he for the other capital.

title: 1 Kings 7:19
text: And the capitals that were upon the top of the pillars in the porch were of lily-work, four cubits.

title: 1 Kings 7:20
text: And there were capitals above also upon the two pillars, close by the belly which was beside the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred, in rows round about upon the other capital.

title: 1 Kings 7:21
text: And he set up the pillars at the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin; and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.

title: 1 Kings 7:22
text: And upon the top of the pillars was lily-work: so was the work of the pillars finished.

title: 1 Kings 7:23
text: And he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and the height thereof was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits compassed it round about.

title: 1 Kings 7:24
text: And under the brim of it round about there were knops which did compass it, for ten cubits, compassing the sea round about: the knops were in two rows, cast when it was cast.

title: 1 Kings 7:25
text: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set upon them above, and all their hinder parts were inward.

title: 1 Kings 7:26
text: And it was a handbreadth thick: and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily: it held two thousand baths.

title: 1 Kings 7:27
text: And he made the ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.

title: 1 Kings 7:28
text: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had panels; and there were panels between the ledges;

title: 1 Kings 7:29
text: and on the panels that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubim; and upon the ledges there was a pedestal above; and beneath the lions and oxen were wreaths of hanging work.

title: 1 Kings 7:30
text: And every base had four brazen wheels, and axles of brass; and the four feet thereof had undersetters: beneath the laver were the undersetters molten, with wreaths at the side of each.

title: 1 Kings 7:31
text: And the mouth of it within the capital and above was a cubit: and the mouth thereof was round after the work of a pedestal, a cubit and a half; and also upon the mouth of it were gravings, and their panels were foursquare, not round.

title: 1 Kings 7:32
text: And the four wheels were underneath the panels; and the axletrees of the wheels were in the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.

title: 1 Kings 7:33
text: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their felloes, and their spokes, and their naves, were all molten.

title: 1 Kings 7:34
text: And there were four undersetters at the four corners of each base: the undersetters thereof were of the base itself.

title: 1 Kings 7:35
text: And in the top of the base was there a round compass half a cubit high; and on the top of the base the stays thereof and the panels thereof were of the same.

title: 1 Kings 7:36
text: And on the plates of the stays thereof, and on the panels thereof, he graved cherubim, lions, and palm-trees, according to the space of each, with wreaths round about.

title: 1 Kings 7:37
text: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one form.

title: 1 Kings 7:38
text: And he made ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths; and every laver was four cubits; and upon very one of the ten bases one laver.

title: 1 Kings 7:39
text: And he set the bases, five on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward, toward the south.

title: 1 Kings 7:40
text: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he wrought for king Solomon in the house of Jehovah:

title: 1 Kings 7:41
text: the two pillars, and the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; and the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars;

title: 1 Kings 7:42
text: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were upon the pillars;

title: 1 Kings 7:43
text: and the ten bases, and the ten lavers on the bases;

title: 1 Kings 7:44
text: and the one sea, and the twelve oxen under the sea;

title: 1 Kings 7:45
text: and the pots, and the shovels, and the basins: even all these vessels, which Hiram made for king Solomon, in the house of Jehovah, were of burnished brass.

title: 1 Kings 7:46
text: In the plain of the Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.

title: 1 Kings 7:47
text: And Solomon left all the vessels [unweighed], because they were exceeding many: the weight of the brass could not be found out.

title: 1 Kings 7:48
text: And Solomon made all the vessels that were in the house of Jehovah: the golden altar, and the table whereupon the showbread was, of gold;

title: 1 Kings 7:49
text: and the candlesticks, five on the right side, and five on the left, before the oracle, of pure gold; and the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, of gold;

title: 1 Kings 7:50
text: and the cups, and the snuffers, and the basins, and the spoons, and the firepans, of pure gold; and the hinges, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, [to wit], of the temple, of gold.

title: 1 Kings 7:51
text: Thus all the work that king Solomon wrought in the house of Jehovah was finished. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated, [even] the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, and put them in the treasuries of the house of Jehovah.

title: 1 Kings 8:1
text: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers' [houses] of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of Jehovah out of the city of David, which is Zion.

title: 1 Kings 8:2
text: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast, in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

title: 1 Kings 8:3
text: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.

title: 1 Kings 8:4
text: And they brought up the ark of Jehovah, and the tent of meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent; even these did the priests and the Levites bring up.

title: 1 Kings 8:5
text: And king Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be counted nor numbered for multitude.

title: 1 Kings 8:6
text: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of Jehovah unto its place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubim.

title: 1 Kings 8:7
text: For the cherubim spread forth their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

title: 1 Kings 8:8
text: And the staves were so long that the ends of the staves were seen from the holy place before the oracle; but they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.

title: 1 Kings 8:9
text: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone which Moses put there at Horeb, when Jehovah made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

title: 1 Kings 8:10
text: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of Jehovah,

title: 1 Kings 8:11
text: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for the glory of Jehovah filled the house of Jehovah.

title: 1 Kings 8:12
text: Then spake Solomon, Jehovah hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

title: 1 Kings 8:13
text: I have surely built thee a house of habitation, a place for thee to dwell in for ever.

title: 1 Kings 8:14
text: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the assembly of Israel: and all the assembly of Israel stood.

title: 1 Kings 8:15
text: And he said, Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, who spake with his mouth unto David thy father, and hath with his hand fulfilled it, saying,

title: 1 Kings 8:16
text: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house, that my name might be there; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.

title: 1 Kings 8:17
text: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of Jehovah, the God of Israel.

title: 1 Kings 8:18
text: But Jehovah said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thy heart to build a house for my name, thou didst well that it was in thy heart:

title: 1 Kings 8:19
text: nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.

title: 1 Kings 8:20
text: And Jehovah hath established his word that he spake; for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as Jehovah promised, and have built the house for the name of Jehovah, the God of Israel.

title: 1 Kings 8:21
text: And there have I set a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of Jehovah, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.

title: 1 Kings 8:22
text: And Solomon stood before the altar of Jehovah in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven;

title: 1 Kings 8:23
text: and he said, O Jehovah, the God of Israel, there is no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath; who keepest covenant and lovingkindness with thy servants, that walk before thee with all their heart;

title: 1 Kings 8:24
text: who hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou didst promise him: yea, thou spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thy hand, as it is this day.

title: 1 Kings 8:25
text: Now therefore, O Jehovah, the God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me as thou hast walked before me.

title: 1 Kings 8:26
text: Now therefore, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.

title: 1 Kings 8:27
text: But will God in very deed dwell on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded!

title: 1 Kings 8:28
text: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O Jehovah my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee this day;

title: 1 Kings 8:29
text: that thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place whereof thou hast said, My name shall be there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall pray toward this place.

title: 1 Kings 8:30
text: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: yea, hear thou in heaven thy dwelling-place; and when thou hearest, forgive.

title: 1 Kings 8:31
text: If a man sin against his neighbor, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and he come [and] swear before thine altar in this house;

title: 1 Kings 8:32
text: then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his own head, and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

title: 1 Kings 8:33
text: When thy people Israel are smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; if they turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication unto thee in this house:

title: 1 Kings 8:34
text: then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.

title: 1 Kings 8:35
text: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them:

title: 1 Kings 8:36
text: then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou teachest them the good way wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.

title: 1 Kings 8:37
text: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting [or] mildew, locust [or] caterpillar; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;

title: 1 Kings 8:38
text: what prayer and supplication soever be made by any man, [or] by all thy people Israel, who shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:

title: 1 Kings 8:39
text: then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling-place, and forgive, and do, and render unto every man according to all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou, even thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)

title: 1 Kings 8:40
text: that they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.

title: 1 Kings 8:41
text: Moreover concerning the foreigner, that is not of thy people Israel, when he shall come out of a far country for thy name's sake

title: 1 Kings 8:42
text: (for they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy mighty hand, and of thine outstretched arm); when he shall come and pray toward this house;

title: 1 Kings 8:43
text: hear thou in heaven thy dwelling-place, and do according to all that the foreigner calleth to thee for; that all the peoples of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as doth thy people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by my name.

title: 1 Kings 8:44
text: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, by whatsoever way thou shalt send them, and they pray unto Jehovah toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name;

title: 1 Kings 8:45
text: then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

title: 1 Kings 8:46
text: If they sin against thee (for there is no man that sinneth not), and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive unto the land of the enemy, far off or near;

title: 1 Kings 8:47
text: yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn again, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captive, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have dealt wickedly;

title: 1 Kings 8:48
text: if they return unto thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies, who carried them captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:

title: 1 Kings 8:49
text: then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling-place, and maintain their cause;

title: 1 Kings 8:50
text: and forgive thy people who have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee; and give them compassion before those who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them

title: 1 Kings 8:51
text: (for they are thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron);

title: 1 Kings 8:52
text: that thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them whensoever they cry unto thee.

title: 1 Kings 8:53
text: For thou didst separate them from among all the peoples of the earth, to be thine inheritance, as thou spakest by Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord Jehovah.

title: 1 Kings 8:54
text: And it was so, that, when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto Jehovah, he arose from before the altar of Jehovah, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread forth toward heaven.

title: 1 Kings 8:55
text: And he stood, and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

title: 1 Kings 8:56
text: Blessed be Jehovah, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.

title: 1 Kings 8:57
text: Jehovah our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us;

title: 1 Kings 8:58
text: that he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his ordinances, which he commanded our fathers.

title: 1 Kings 8:59
text: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before Jehovah, be nigh unto Jehovah our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel, as every day shall require;

title: 1 Kings 8:60
text: that all the peoples of the earth may know that Jehovah, he is God; there is none else.

title: 1 Kings 8:61
text: Let your heart therefore be perfect with Jehovah our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.

title: 1 Kings 8:62
text: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before Jehovah.

title: 1 Kings 8:63
text: And Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace-offerings, which he offered unto Jehovah, two and twenty thousand oxen, and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of Jehovah.

title: 1 Kings 8:64
text: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of Jehovah; for there he offered the burnt-offering, and the meal-offering, and the fat of the peace-offerings, because the brazen altar that was before Jehovah was too little to receive the burnt-offering, and the meal-offering, and the fat of the peace-offerings.

title: 1 Kings 8:65
text: So Solomon held the feast at that time, and all Israel with him, a great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath unto the brook of Egypt, before Jehovah our God, seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.

title: 1 Kings 8:66
text: On the eighth day he sent the people away; and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that Jehovah had showed unto David his servant, and to Israel his people.

title: 1 Kings 9:1
text: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of Jehovah, and the king's house, and all Solomon's desire which he was pleased to do,

title: 1 Kings 9:2
text: that Jehovah appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.

title: 1 Kings 9:3
text: And Jehovah said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.

title: 1 Kings 9:4
text: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee, and wilt keep my statutes and mine ordinances;

title: 1 Kings 9:5
text: then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom over Israel for ever, according as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.

title: 1 Kings 9:6
text: But if ye shall turn away from following me, ye or your children, and not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;

title: 1 Kings 9:7
text: then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

title: 1 Kings 9:8
text: And though this house is so high, yet shall every one that passeth by it be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath Jehovah done thus unto this land, and to this house?

title: 1 Kings 9:9
text: and they shall answer, Because they forsook Jehovah their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath Jehovah brought all this evil upon them.

title: 1 Kings 9:10
text: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the two houses, the house of Jehovah and the king's house

title: 1 Kings 9:11
text: (now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar-trees and fir-trees, and with gold, according to all his desire), that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

title: 1 Kings 9:12
text: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.

title: 1 Kings 9:13
text: And he said, What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.

title: 1 Kings 9:14
text: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.

title: 1 Kings 9:15
text: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised, to build the house of Jehovah, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.

title: 1 Kings 9:16
text: Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a portion unto his daughter, Solomon's wife.

title: 1 Kings 9:17
text: And Solomon built Gezer, and Beth-horon the nether,

title: 1 Kings 9:18
text: and Baalath, and Tamar in the wilderness, in the land,

title: 1 Kings 9:19
text: and all the store-cities that Solomon had, and the cities for his chariots, and the cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

title: 1 Kings 9:20
text: As for all the people that were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of the children of Israel;

title: 1 Kings 9:21
text: their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel were not able utterly to destroy, of them did Solomon raise a levy of bondservants unto this day.

title: 1 Kings 9:22
text: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondservants; but they were the men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.

title: 1 Kings 9:23
text: These were the chief officers that were over Solomon's work, five hundred and fifty, who bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.

title: 1 Kings 9:24
text: But Pharaoh's daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which [Solomon] had built for her: then did he build Millo.

title: 1 Kings 9:25
text: And three times a year did Solomon offer burnt-offerings and peace-offerings upon the altar which he built unto Jehovah, burning incense therewith, [upon the altar] that was before Jehovah. So he finished the house.

title: 1 Kings 9:26
text: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion-geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.

title: 1 Kings 9:27
text: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.

title: 1 Kings 9:28
text: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.

title: 1 Kings 10:1
text: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of Jehovah, she came to prove him with hard questions.

title: 1 Kings 10:2
text: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones; and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

title: 1 Kings 10:3
text: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not anything hid from the king which he told her not.

title: 1 Kings 10:4
text: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,

title: 1 Kings 10:5
text: and the food of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of Jehovah; there was no more spirit in her.

title: 1 Kings 10:6
text: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom.

title: 1 Kings 10:7
text: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me; thy wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.

title: 1 Kings 10:8
text: Happy are thy men, happy are these thy servants, that stand continually before thee, [and] that hear thy wisdom.

title: 1 Kings 10:9
text: Blessed be Jehovah thy God, who delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because Jehovah loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do justice and righteousness.

title: 1 Kings 10:10
text: And she gave the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.

title: 1 Kings 10:11
text: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug-trees and precious stones.

title: 1 Kings 10:12
text: And the king made of the almug-trees pillars for the house of Jehovah, and for the king's house, harps also and psalteries for the singers: there came no such almug-trees, nor were seen, unto this day.

title: 1 Kings 10:13
text: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, besides that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned, and went to her own land, she and her servants.

title: 1 Kings 10:14
text: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,

title: 1 Kings 10:15
text: besides [that which] the traders [brought], and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mingled people, and of the governors of the country.

title: 1 Kings 10:16
text: And king Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred [shekels] of gold went to one buckler.

title: 1 Kings 10:17
text: And [he made] three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pounds of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

title: 1 Kings 10:18
text: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the finest gold.

title: 1 Kings 10:19
text: There were six steps to the throne, and the top of the throne was round behind; and there were stays on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the stays.

title: 1 Kings 10:20
text: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.

title: 1 Kings 10:21
text: And all king Solomon's drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

title: 1 Kings 10:22
text: For the king had at sea a navy of Tarshish with the navy of Hiram: once every three years came the navy of Tarshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

title: 1 Kings 10:23
text: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom.

title: 1 Kings 10:24
text: And all the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

title: 1 Kings 10:25
text: And they brought every man his tribute, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, and armor, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

title: 1 Kings 10:26
text: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, that he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

title: 1 Kings 10:27
text: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore-trees that are in the lowland, for abundance.

title: 1 Kings 10:28
text: And the horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt; and the king's merchants received them in droves, each drove at a price.

title: 1 Kings 10:29
text: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred [shekels] of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty; and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring them out [ by their means.

title: 1 Kings 11:1
text: Now king Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites;

title: 1 Kings 11:2
text: of the nations concerning which Jehovah said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go among them, neither shall they come among you; for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.

title: 1 Kings 11:3
text: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines; and his wives turned away his heart.

title: 1 Kings 11:4
text: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not perfect with Jehovah his God, as was the heart of David his father.

title: 1 Kings 11:5
text: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

title: 1 Kings 11:6
text: And Solomon did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, and went not fully after Jehovah, as did David his father.

title: 1 Kings 11:7
text: Then did Solomon build a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, in the mount that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech the abomination of the children of Ammon.

title: 1 Kings 11:8
text: And so did he for all his foreign wives, who burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.

title: 1 Kings 11:9
text: And Jehovah was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from Jehovah, the God of Israel, who had appeared unto him twice,

title: 1 Kings 11:10
text: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which Jehovah commanded.

title: 1 Kings 11:11
text: Wherefore Jehovah said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.

title: 1 Kings 11:12
text: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it, for David thy father's sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.

title: 1 Kings 11:13
text: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but I will give one tribe to thy son, for David my servant's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake which I have chosen.

title: 1 Kings 11:14
text: And Jehovah raised up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king's seed in Edom.

title: 1 Kings 11:15
text: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, and had smitten every male in Edom

title: 1 Kings 11:16
text: (for Joab and all Israel remained there six months, until he had cut off every male in Edom);

title: 1 Kings 11:17
text: that Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father's servants with him, to go into Egypt, Hadad being yet a little child.

title: 1 Kings 11:18
text: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran; and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.

title: 1 Kings 11:19
text: And Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

title: 1 Kings 11:20
text: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh's house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh's house among the sons of Pharaoh.

title: 1 Kings 11:21
text: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.

title: 1 Kings 11:22
text: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit only let me depart.

title: 1 Kings 11:23
text: And God raised up [another] adversary unto him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah.

title: 1 Kings 11:24
text: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a troop, when David slew them [of Zobah] : and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.

title: 1 Kings 11:25
text: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, besides the mischief that Hadad [did] : and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.

title: 1 Kings 11:26
text: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother's name was Zeruah, a widow, he also lifted up his hand against the king.

title: 1 Kings 11:27
text: And this was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of the city of David his father.

title: 1 Kings 11:28
text: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw the young man that he was industrious, and he gave him charge over all the labor of the house of Joseph.

title: 1 Kings 11:29
text: And it came to pass at that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; now [Ahijah] had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field.

title: 1 Kings 11:30
text: And Ahijah laid hold of the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces.

title: 1 Kings 11:31
text: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces; for thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee

title: 1 Kings 11:32
text: (but he shall have one tribe, for my servant David's sake and for Jerusalem's sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel);

title: 1 Kings 11:33
text: because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon; and they have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in mine eyes, and [to keep] my statutes and mine ordinances, as did David his father.

title: 1 Kings 11:34
text: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand; but I will make him prince all the days of his life, for David my servant's sake whom I chose, who kept my commandments and my statutes;

title: 1 Kings 11:35
text: but I will take the kingdom out of his son's hand, and will give it unto thee, even ten tribes.

title: 1 Kings 11:36
text: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a lamp alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.

title: 1 Kings 11:37
text: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.

title: 1 Kings 11:38
text: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that which is right in mine eyes, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and will build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.

title: 1 Kings 11:39
text: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.

title: 1 Kings 11:40
text: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam; but Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

title: 1 Kings 11:41
text: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

title: 1 Kings 11:42
text: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

title: 1 Kings 11:43
text: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

title: 1 Kings 12:1
text: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.

title: 1 Kings 12:2
text: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was yet in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt,

title: 1 Kings 12:3
text: and they sent and called him), that Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,

title: 1 Kings 12:4
text: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.

title: 1 Kings 12:5
text: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.

title: 1 Kings 12:6
text: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?

title: 1 Kings 12:7
text: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.

title: 1 Kings 12:8
text: But he forsook the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men that were grown up with him, that stood before him.

title: 1 Kings 12:9
text: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye, that we may return answer to this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke that thy father did put upon us lighter?

title: 1 Kings 12:10
text: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou say unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou speak unto them, My little finger is thicker than my father's loins.

title: 1 Kings 12:11
text: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

title: 1 Kings 12:12
text: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come to me again the third day.

title: 1 Kings 12:13
text: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the counsel of the old men which they had given him,

title: 1 Kings 12:14
text: and spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

title: 1 Kings 12:15
text: So the king hearkened not unto the people; for it was a thing brought about of Jehovah, that he might establish his word, which Jehovah spake by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

title: 1 Kings 12:16
text: And when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents.

title: 1 Kings 12:17
text: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

title: 1 Kings 12:18
text: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the men subject to taskwork; and all Israel stoned him to death with stones. And king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

title: 1 Kings 12:19
text: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

title: 1 Kings 12:20
text: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was returned, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.

title: 1 Kings 12:21
text: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, that were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

title: 1 Kings 12:22
text: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

title: 1 Kings 12:23
text: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,

title: 1 Kings 12:24
text: Thus saith Jehovah, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel: return every man to his house; for this thing is of me. So they hearkened unto the word of Jehovah, and returned and went their way, according to the word of Jehovah.

title: 1 Kings 12:25
text: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and he went out from thence, and built Penuel.

title: 1 Kings 12:26
text: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now will the kingdom return to the house of David:

title: 1 Kings 12:27
text: if this people go up to offer sacrifices in the house of Jehovah at Jerusalem, then will the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, even unto Rehoboam king of Judah; and they will kill me, and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.

title: 1 Kings 12:28
text: Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold; and he said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

title: 1 Kings 12:29
text: And he set the one in Beth-el, and the other put he in Dan.

title: 1 Kings 12:30
text: And this thing became a sin; for the people went [to worship] before the one, even unto Dan.

title: 1 Kings 12:31
text: And he made houses of high places, and made priests from among all the people, that were not of the sons of Levi.

title: 1 Kings 12:32
text: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that is in Judah, and he went up unto the altar; so did he in Beth-el, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Beth-el the priests of the high places that he had made.

title: 1 Kings 12:33
text: And he went up unto the altar which he had made in Beth-el on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart: and he ordained a feast for the children of Israel, and went up unto the altar, to burn incense.

title: 1 Kings 13:1
text: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of Jehovah unto Beth-el: and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense.

title: 1 Kings 13:2
text: And he cried against the altar by the word of Jehovah, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith Jehovah: Behold, a son shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he sacrifice the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men's bones shall they burn upon thee.

title: 1 Kings 13:3
text: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign which Jehovah hath spoken: Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.

title: 1 Kings 13:4
text: And it came to pass, when the king heard the saying of the man of God, which he cried against the altar in Beth-el, that Jeroboam put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not draw it back again to him.

title: 1 Kings 13:5
text: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of Jehovah.

title: 1 Kings 13:6
text: And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Entreat now the favor of Jehovah thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God entreated Jehovah, and the king's hand was restored him again, and became as it was before.

title: 1 Kings 13:7
text: And the king said unto the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.

title: 1 Kings 13:8
text: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thy house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place;

title: 1 Kings 13:9
text: for so was it charged me by the word of Jehovah, saying, Thou shalt eat no bread, nor drink water, neither return by the way that thou camest.

title: 1 Kings 13:10
text: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Beth-el.

title: 1 Kings 13:11
text: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Beth-el; and one of his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Beth-el: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them also they told unto their father.

title: 1 Kings 13:12
text: And their father said unto them, What way went he? Now his sons had seen what way the man of God went, that came from Judah.

title: 1 Kings 13:13
text: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass; and he rode thereon.

title: 1 Kings 13:14
text: And he went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak; and he said unto him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am.

title: 1 Kings 13:15
text: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.

title: 1 Kings 13:16
text: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee; neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:

title: 1 Kings 13:17
text: for it was said to me by the word of Jehovah, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.

title: 1 Kings 13:18
text: And he said unto him, I also am a prophet as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of Jehovah, saying, Bring him back with thee into thy house, that he may eat bread and drink water. [But] he lied unto him.

title: 1 Kings 13:19
text: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.

title: 1 Kings 13:20
text: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of Jehovah came unto the prophet that brought him back;

title: 1 Kings 13:21
text: and he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith Jehovah, Forasmuch as thou hast been disobedient unto the mouth of Jehovah, and hast not kept the commandment which Jehovah thy God commanded thee,

title: 1 Kings 13:22
text: but camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place of which he said to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy body shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.

title: 1 Kings 13:23
text: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, [to wit], for the prophet whom he had brought back.

title: 1 Kings 13:24
text: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his body was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it; the lion also stood by the body.

title: 1 Kings 13:25
text: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the body cast in the way, and the lion standing by the body; and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.

title: 1 Kings 13:26
text: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof, he said, It is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the mouth of Jehovah: therefore Jehovah hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of Jehovah, which he spake unto him.

title: 1 Kings 13:27
text: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled it.

title: 1 Kings 13:28
text: And he went and found his body cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the body: the lion had not eaten the body, nor torn the ass.

title: 1 Kings 13:29
text: And the prophet took up the body of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back; and he came to the city of the old prophet, to mourn, and to bury him.

title: 1 Kings 13:30
text: And he laid his body in his own grave; and they mourned over him, [saying], Alas, my brother!

title: 1 Kings 13:31
text: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones.

title: 1 Kings 13:32
text: For the saying which he cried by the word of Jehovah against the altar in Beth-el, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.

title: 1 Kings 13:33
text: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again from among all the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, that there might be priests of the high places.

title: 1 Kings 13:34
text: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.

title: 1 Kings 14:1
text: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.

title: 1 Kings 14:2
text: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get thee to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, who spake concerning me that I should be king over this people.

title: 1 Kings 14:3
text: And take with thee ten loaves, and cakes, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he will tell thee what shall become of the child.

title: 1 Kings 14:4
text: And Jeroboam's wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. Now Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

title: 1 Kings 14:5
text: And Jehovah said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to inquire of thee concerning her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her; for it will be, when she cometh in, that she will feign herself to be another woman.

title: 1 Kings 14:6
text: And it was so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou thyself to be another? for I am sent to thee with heavy tidings.

title: 1 Kings 14:7
text: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel: Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,

title: 1 Kings 14:8
text: and rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee; and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in mine eyes,

title: 1 Kings 14:9
text: but hast done evil above all that were before thee, and hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:

title: 1 Kings 14:10
text: therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam every man-child, him that is shut up and him that is left at large in Israel, and will utterly sweep away the house of Jeroboam, as a man sweepeth away dung, till it be all gone.

title: 1 Kings 14:11
text: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the birds of the heavens eat: for Jehovah hath spoken it.

title: 1 Kings 14:12
text: Arise thou therefore, get thee to thy house: [and] when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.

title: 1 Kings 14:13
text: And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him; for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward Jehovah, the God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.

title: 1 Kings 14:14
text: Moreover Jehovah will raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.

title: 1 Kings 14:15
text: For Jehovah will smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water; and he will root up Israel out of this good land which he gave to their fathers, and will scatter them beyond the River, because they have made their Asherim, provoking Jehovah to anger.

title: 1 Kings 14:16
text: And he will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he hath sinned, and wherewith he hath made Israel to sin.

title: 1 Kings 14:17
text: And Jeroboam's wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: [and] as she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.

title: 1 Kings 14:18
text: And all Israel buried him, and mourned for him, according to the word of Jehovah, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the prophet.

title: 1 Kings 14:19
text: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

title: 1 Kings 14:20
text: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.

title: 1 Kings 14:21
text: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which Jehovah had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there: and his mother's name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

title: 1 Kings 14:22
text: And Judah did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they committed, above all that their fathers had done.

title: 1 Kings 14:23
text: For they also built them high places, and pillars, and Asherim, on every high hill, and under every green tree;

title: 1 Kings 14:24
text: and there were also sodomites in the land: they did according to all the abominations of the nations which Jehovah drove out before the children of Israel.

title: 1 Kings 14:25
text: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem;

title: 1 Kings 14:26
text: and he took away the treasures of the house of Jehovah, and the treasures of the king's house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

title: 1 Kings 14:27
text: And king Rehoboam made in their stead shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who kept the door of the king's house.

title: 1 Kings 14:28
text: And it was so, that, as oft as the king went into the house of Jehovah, the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard-chamber.

title: 1 Kings 14:29
text: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

title: 1 Kings 14:30
text: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

title: 1 Kings 14:31
text: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and his mother's name was Naamah the Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.

title: 1 Kings 15:1
text: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat began Abijam to reign over Judah.

title: 1 Kings 15:2
text: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

title: 1 Kings 15:3
text: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him; and his heart was not perfect with Jehovah his God, as the heart of David his father.

title: 1 Kings 15:4
text: Nevertheless for David's sake did Jehovah his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem;

title: 1 Kings 15:5
text: because David did that which was right in the eyes of Jehovah, and turned not aside from anything that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

title: 1 Kings 15:6
text: Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

title: 1 Kings 15:7
text: And the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

title: 1 Kings 15:8
text: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.

title: 1 Kings 15:9
text: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Asa to reign over Judah.

title: 1 Kings 15:10
text: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

title: 1 Kings 15:11
text: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of Jehovah, as did David his father.

title: 1 Kings 15:12
text: And he put away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

title: 1 Kings 15:13
text: And also Maacah his mother he removed from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; and Asa cut down her image, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.

title: 1 Kings 15:14
text: But the high places were not taken away: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect with Jehovah all his days.

title: 1 Kings 15:15
text: And he brought into the house of Jehovah the things that his father had dedicated, and the things that himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.

title: 1 Kings 15:16
text: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

title: 1 Kings 15:17
text: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any one to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

title: 1 Kings 15:18
text: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of Jehovah, and the treasures of the king's house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants; and king Asa sent them to Ben-hadad, the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

title: 1 Kings 15:19
text: [There is] a league between me and thee, between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

title: 1 Kings 15:20
text: And Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-beth-maacah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

title: 1 Kings 15:21
text: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.

title: 1 Kings 15:22
text: Then king Asa made a proclamation unto all Judah; none was exempted: and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built therewith Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

title: 1 Kings 15:23
