text: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to decline ten steps: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten steps.

title: 2 Kings 20:11
text: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto Jehovah; and he brought the shadow ten steps backward, by which it had gone down on the dial of Ahaz.

title: 2 Kings 20:12
text: At that time Berodach-baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah; for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

title: 2 Kings 20:13
text: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them, and showed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious oil, and the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah showed them not.

title: 2 Kings 20:14
text: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country, even from Babylon.

title: 2 Kings 20:15
text: And he said, What have they seen in thy house? And Hezekiah answered, All that is in my house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not showed them.

title: 2 Kings 20:16
text: And Isaiah said unto Hezekiah, Hear the word of Jehovah.

title: 2 Kings 20:17
text: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thy house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith Jehovah.

title: 2 Kings 20:18
text: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, whom thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

title: 2 Kings 20:19
text: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of Jehovah which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, Is it not so, if peace and truth shall be in my days?

title: 2 Kings 20:20
text: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made the pool, and the conduit, and brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

title: 2 Kings 20:21
text: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers; and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

title: 2 Kings 21:1
text: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign; and he reigned five and fifty years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Hephzibah.

title: 2 Kings 21:2
text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, after the abominations of the nations whom Jehovah cast out before the children of Israel.

title: 2 Kings 21:3
text: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made an Asherah, as did Ahab king of Israel, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

title: 2 Kings 21:4
text: And he built altars in the house of Jehovah, whereof Jehovah said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.

title: 2 Kings 21:5
text: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of Jehovah.

title: 2 Kings 21:6
text: And he made his son to pass through the fire, and practised augury, and used enchantments, and dealt with them that had familiar spirits, and with wizards: he wrought much evil in the sight of Jehovah, to provoke him to anger.

title: 2 Kings 21:7
text: And he set the graven image of Asherah, that he had made, in the house of which Jehovah said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever;

title: 2 Kings 21:8
text: neither will I cause the feet of Israel to wander any more out of the land which I gave their fathers, if only they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.

title: 2 Kings 21:9
text: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do that which is evil more than did the nations whom Jehovah destroyed before the children of Israel.

title: 2 Kings 21:10
text: And Jehovah spake by his servants the prophets, saying,

title: 2 Kings 21:11
text: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations, and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, that were before him, and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols;

title: 2 Kings 21:12
text: therefore thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, Behold, I bring such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.

title: 2 Kings 21:13
text: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab; and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.

title: 2 Kings 21:14
text: And I will cast off the remnant of mine inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;

title: 2 Kings 21:15
text: because they have done that which is evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.

title: 2 Kings 21:16
text: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; besides his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah.

title: 2 Kings 21:17
text: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

title: 2 Kings 21:18
text: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

title: 2 Kings 21:19
text: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

title: 2 Kings 21:20
text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, as did Manasseh his father.

title: 2 Kings 21:21
text: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:

title: 2 Kings 21:22
text: and he forsook Jehovah, the God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of Jehovah.

title: 2 Kings 21:23
text: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and put the king to death in his own house.

title: 2 Kings 21:24
text: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

title: 2 Kings 21:25
text: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

title: 2 Kings 21:26
text: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.

title: 2 Kings 22:1
text: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign; and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Jedidah the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.

title: 2 Kings 22:2
text: And he did that which was right in the eyes of Jehovah, and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.

title: 2 Kings 22:3
text: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, that the king sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of Jehovah, saying,

title: 2 Kings 22:4
text: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the money which is brought into the house of Jehovah, which the keepers of the threshold have gathered of the people:

title: 2 Kings 22:5
text: and let them deliver it into the hand of the workmen that have the oversight of the house of Jehovah; and let them give it to the workmen that are in the house of Jehovah, to repair the breaches of the house,

title: 2 Kings 22:6
text: unto the carpenters, and to the builders, and to the masons, and for buying timber and hewn stone to repair the house.

title: 2 Kings 22:7
text: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand; for they dealt faithfully.

title: 2 Kings 22:8
text: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of Jehovah. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

title: 2 Kings 22:9
text: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have emptied out the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of the workmen that have the oversight of the house of Jehovah.

title: 2 Kings 22:10
text: And Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

title: 2 Kings 22:11
text: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.

title: 2 Kings 22:12
text: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Micaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king's servant, saying,

title: 2 Kings 22:13
text: Go ye, inquire of Jehovah for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found; for great is the wrath of Jehovah that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.

title: 2 Kings 22:14
text: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asaiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the second quarter); and they communed with her.

title: 2 Kings 22:15
text: And she said unto them, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel: Tell ye the man that sent you unto me,

title: 2 Kings 22:16
text: Thus saith Jehovah, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read.

title: 2 Kings 22:17
text: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the work of their hands, therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and it shall not be quenched.

title: 2 Kings 22:18
text: But unto the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of Jehovah, thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel: As touching the words which thou hast heard,

title: 2 Kings 22:19
text: because thy heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before Jehovah, when thou heardest what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard thee, saith Jehovah.

title: 2 Kings 22:20
text: Therefore, behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.

title: 2 Kings 23:1
text: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

title: 2 Kings 23:2
text: And the king went up to the house of Jehovah, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of Jehovah.

title: 2 Kings 23:3
text: And the king stood by the pillar, and made a covenant before Jehovah, to walk after Jehovah, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all [his] heart, and all [his] soul, to confirm the words of this covenant that were written in this book: and all the people stood to the covenant.

title: 2 Kings 23:4
text: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the threshold, to bring forth out of the temple of Jehovah all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the Asherah, and for all the host of heaven, and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Beth-el.

title: 2 Kings 23:5
text: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.

title: 2 Kings 23:6
text: And he brought out the Asherah from the house of Jehovah, without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and beat it to dust, and cast the dust thereof upon the graves of the common people.

title: 2 Kings 23:7
text: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that were in the house of Jehovah, where the women wove hangings for the Asherah.

title: 2 Kings 23:8
text: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beer-sheba; and he brake down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man's left hand at the gate of the city.

title: 2 Kings 23:9
text: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of Jehovah in Jerusalem, but they did eat unleavened bread among their brethren.

title: 2 Kings 23:10
text: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.

title: 2 Kings 23:11
text: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entrance of the house of Jehovah, by the chamber of Nathan-melech the chamberlain, which was in the precincts; and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

title: 2 Kings 23:12
text: And the altars that were on the roof of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of Jehovah, did the king break down, and beat [them] down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.

title: 2 Kings 23:13
text: And the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.

title: 2 Kings 23:14
text: And he brake in pieces the pillars, and cut down the Asherim, and filled their places with the bones of men.

title: 2 Kings 23:15
text: Moreover the altar that was at Beth-el, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, even that altar and the high place he brake down; and he burned the high place and beat it to dust, and burned the Asherah.

title: 2 Kings 23:16
text: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount; and he sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned them upon the altar, and defiled it, according to the word of Jehovah which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these things.

title: 2 Kings 23:17
text: Then he said, What monument is that which I see? And the men of the city told him, It is the sepulchre of the man of God, who came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Beth-el.

title: 2 Kings 23:18
text: And he said, Let him be; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.

title: 2 Kings 23:19
text: And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke [Jehovah] to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Beth-el.

title: 2 Kings 23:20
text: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there, upon the altars, and burned men's bones upon them; and he returned to Jerusalem.

title: 2 Kings 23:21
text: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto Jehovah your God, as it is written in this book of the covenant.

title: 2 Kings 23:22
text: Surely there was not kept such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;

title: 2 Kings 23:23
text: but in the eighteenth year of king Josiah was this passover kept to Jehovah in Jerusalem.

title: 2 Kings 23:24
text: Moreover them that had familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the teraphim, and the idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might confirm the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of Jehovah.

title: 2 Kings 23:25
text: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to Jehovah with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.

title: 2 Kings 23:26
text: Notwithstanding, Jehovah turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations wherewith Manasseh had provoked him.

title: 2 Kings 23:27
text: And Jehovah said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and I will cast off this city which I have chosen, even Jerusalem, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.

title: 2 Kings 23:28
text: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

title: 2 Kings 23:29
text: In his days Pharaoh-necoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and [Pharaoh-necoh] slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.

title: 2 Kings 23:30
text: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father's stead.

title: 2 Kings 23:31
text: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

title: 2 Kings 23:32
text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, according to all that his fathers had done.

title: 2 Kings 23:33
text: And Pharaoh-necoh put him in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of a hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.

title: 2 Kings 23:34
text: And Pharaoh-necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim: but he took Jehoahaz away; and he came to Egypt, and died there.

title: 2 Kings 23:35
text: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give it unto Pharaoh-necoh.

title: 2 Kings 23:36
text: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

title: 2 Kings 23:37
text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, according to all that his fathers had done.

title: 2 Kings 24:1
text: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.

title: 2 Kings 24:2
text: And Jehovah sent against him bands of the Chaldeans, and bands of the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of Jehovah, which he spake by his servants the prophets.

title: 2 Kings 24:3
text: Surely at the commandment of Jehovah came this upon Judah, to remove them out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did,

title: 2 Kings 24:4
text: and also for the innocent blood that he shed; for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood: and Jehovah would not pardon.

title: 2 Kings 24:5
text: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

title: 2 Kings 24:6
text: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers; and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

title: 2 Kings 24:7
text: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land; for the king of Babylon had taken, from the brook of Egypt unto the river Euphrates, all that pertained to the king of Egypt.

title: 2 Kings 24:8
text: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign; and he reigned in Jerusalem three months: and his mother's name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

title: 2 Kings 24:9
text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, according to all that his father had done.

title: 2 Kings 24:10
text: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

title: 2 Kings 24:11
text: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came unto the city, while his servants were besieging it;

title: 2 Kings 24:12
text: and Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.

title: 2 Kings 24:13
text: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of Jehovah, and the treasures of the king's house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold, which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of Jehovah, as Jehovah had said.

title: 2 Kings 24:14
text: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths; none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.

title: 2 Kings 24:15
text: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon; and the king's mother, and the king's wives, and his officers, and the chief men of the land, carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

title: 2 Kings 24:16
text: And all the men of might, even seven thousand, and the craftsmen and the smiths a thousand, all of them strong and apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

title: 2 Kings 24:17
text: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah, [Jehoiachin's] father's brother, king is his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

title: 2 Kings 24:18
text: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

title: 2 Kings 24:19
text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

title: 2 Kings 24:20
text: For through the anger of Jehovah did it come to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. And Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

title: 2 Kings 25:1
text: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it round about.

title: 2 Kings 25:2
text: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

title: 2 Kings 25:3
text: On the ninth day of the [fourth] month the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

title: 2 Kings 25:4
text: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war [fled] by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king's garden (now the Chaldeans were against the city round about); and [the king] went by the way of the Arabah.

title: 2 Kings 25:5
text: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

title: 2 Kings 25:6
text: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.

title: 2 Kings 25:7
text: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

title: 2 Kings 25:8
text: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem.

title: 2 Kings 25:9
text: And he burnt the house of Jehovah, and the king's house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, burnt he with fire.

title: 2 Kings 25:10
text: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were [with] the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.

title: 2 Kings 25:11
text: And the residue of the people that were left in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the residue of the multitude, did Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carry away captive.

title: 2 Kings 25:12
text: But the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.

title: 2 Kings 25:13
text: And the pillars of brass that were in the house of Jehovah, and the bases and the brazen sea that were in the house of Jehovah, did the Chaldeans break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.

title: 2 Kings 25:14
text: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

title: 2 Kings 25:15
text: And the firepans, and the basins, that which was of gold, in gold, and that which was of silver, in silver, the captain of the guard took away.

title: 2 Kings 25:16
text: The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases, which Solomon had made for the house of Jehovah, the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

title: 2 Kings 25:17
text: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a capital of brass was upon it; and the height of the capital was three cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the capital round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with network.

title: 2 Kings 25:18
text: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold:

title: 2 Kings 25:19
text: and out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war; and five men of them that saw the king's face, who were found in the city; and the scribe, the captain of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the city.

title: 2 Kings 25:20
text: And Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

title: 2 Kings 25:21
text: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.

title: 2 Kings 25:22
text: And as for the people that were left in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor.

title: 2 Kings 25:23
text: Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.

title: 2 Kings 25:24
text: And Gedaliah sware to them and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not because of the servants of the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.

title: 2 Kings 25:25
text: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, so that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldeans that were with him at Mizpah.

title: 2 Kings 25:26
text: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the forces, arose, and came to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.

title: 2 Kings 25:27
text: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;

title: 2 Kings 25:28
text: and he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon,

title: 2 Kings 25:29
text: and changed his prison garments. And [Jehoiachin] did eat bread before him continually all the days of his life:

title: 2 Kings 25:30
text: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him of the king, every day a portion, all the days of his life.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:1
text: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

title: 1 Chronicles 1:2
text: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

title: 1 Chronicles 1:3
text: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

title: 1 Chronicles 1:4
text: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:5
text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:6
text: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Diphath, and Togarmah.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:7
text: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:8
text: The sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:9
text: And the sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raama, and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba, and Dedan.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:10
text: And Cush begat Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one in the earth.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:11
text: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

title: 1 Chronicles 1:12
text: and Pathrusim, and Casluhim (from whence came the Philistines), and Caphtorim.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:13
text: And Canaan begat Sidon his first-born, and Heth,

title: 1 Chronicles 1:14
text: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

title: 1 Chronicles 1:15
text: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

title: 1 Chronicles 1:16
text: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:17
text: The sons of Shem: Elam, and Asshur, and Arpachshad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:18
text: And Arpachshad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:19
text: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:20
text: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

title: 1 Chronicles 1:21
text: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,

title: 1 Chronicles 1:22
text: and Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

title: 1 Chronicles 1:23
text: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:24
text: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,

title: 1 Chronicles 1:25
text: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

title: 1 Chronicles 1:26
text: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

title: 1 Chronicles 1:27
text: Abram (the same is Abraham).

title: 1 Chronicles 1:28
text: The sons of Abraham: Isaac, and Ishmael.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:29
text: These are their generations: the first-born of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

title: 1 Chronicles 1:30
text: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,

title: 1 Chronicles 1:31
text: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:32
text: And the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba, and Dedan.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:33
text: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:34
text: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau, and Israel.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:35
text: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:36
text: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:37
text: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:38
text: And the sons of Seir: Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:39
text: And the sons of Lotan: Hori, and Homam; and Timna was Lotan's sister.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:40
text: The sons of Shobal: Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon: Aiah, and Anah.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:41
text: The sons of Anah: Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Hamran, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:42
text: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, and Zaavan, Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz, and Aran.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:43
text: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there resigned any king over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:44
text: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:45
text: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:46
text: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Avith.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:47
text: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:48
text: And Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his stead.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:49
text: And Shaul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:50
text: And Baal-hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Pai: and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.

title: 1 Chronicles 1:51
text: And Hadad died. And the chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

title: 1 Chronicles 1:52
text: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

title: 1 Chronicles 1:53
text: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

title: 1 Chronicles 1:54
text: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:1
text: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,

title: 1 Chronicles 2:2
text: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:3
text: The sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah; which three were born unto him of Shua's daughter the Canaanitess. And Er, Judah's first-born, was wicked in the sight of Jehovah; and he slew him.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:4
text: And Tamar his daughter-in-law bare him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:5
text: The sons of Perez: Hezron, and Hamul.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:6
text: And the sons of Zerah: Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara; five of them in all.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:7
text: And the sons of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:8
text: And the sons of Ethan: Azariah.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:9
text: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him: Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:10
text: And Ram begat Amminadab, and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

title: 1 Chronicles 2:11
text: and Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,

title: 1 Chronicles 2:12
text: and Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse;

title: 1 Chronicles 2:13
text: and Jesse begat his first-born Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third,

title: 1 Chronicles 2:14
text: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

title: 1 Chronicles 2:15
text: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh;

title: 1 Chronicles 2:16
text: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:17
text: And Abigail bare Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:18
text: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat [children] of Azubah [his] wife, and of Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:19
text: And Azubah died, and Caleb took unto him Ephrath, who bare him Hur.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:20
text: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezalel.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:21
text: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took [to wife] when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:22
text: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:23
text: And Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and the villages thereof, even threescore cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:24
text: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephrathah, then Abijah Hezron's wife bare him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:25
text: And the sons of Jerahmeel the first-born of Hezron were Ram the first-born, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, Ahijah.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:26
text: And Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:27
text: And the sons of Ram the first-born of Jerahmeel were Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:28
text: And the sons of Onam were Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai: Nadab, and Abishur.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:29
text: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:30
text: And the sons of Nadab: Seled, and Appaim; but Seled died without children.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:31
text: And the sons of Appaim: Ishi. And the sons of Ishi: Sheshan. And the sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:32
text: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether, and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:33
text: And the sons of Jonathan: Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:34
text: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:35
text: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:36
text: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,

title: 1 Chronicles 2:37
text: and Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,

title: 1 Chronicles 2:38
text: and Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,

title: 1 Chronicles 2:39
text: and Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,

title: 1 Chronicles 2:40
text: and Eleasah begat Sismai, and Sismai begat Shallum,

title: 1 Chronicles 2:41
text: and Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:42
text: And the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his first-born, who was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:43
text: And the sons of Hebron: Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:44
text: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem begat Shammai.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:45
text: And the son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:46
text: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez; and Haran begat Gazez.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:47
text: And the sons of Jahdai: Regem, and Jothan, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:48
text: Maacah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber and Tirhanah.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:49
text: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena, and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:50
text: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the first-born of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim,

title: 1 Chronicles 2:51
text: Salma the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:52
text: And Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:53
text: And the families of Kiriath-jearim: The Ithrites, and the Puthites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:54
text: The sons of Salma: Beth-lehem, and the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

title: 1 Chronicles 2:55
text: And the families of scribes that dwelt at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, the Sucathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

title: 1 Chronicles 3:1
text: Now these were the sons of David, that were born unto him in Hebron: the first-born, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;

title: 1 Chronicles 3:2
text: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;

title: 1 Chronicles 3:3
text: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:

title: 1 Chronicles 3:4
text: six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months. And in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years;

title: 1 Chronicles 3:5
text: and these were born unto him in Jerusalem: Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel;

title: 1 Chronicles 3:6
text: and Ibhar, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,

title: 1 Chronicles 3:7
text: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

title: 1 Chronicles 3:8
text: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

title: 1 Chronicles 3:9
text: All these were the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.

title: 1 Chronicles 3:10
text: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

title: 1 Chronicles 3:11
text: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

title: 1 Chronicles 3:12
text: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

title: 1 Chronicles 3:13
text: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

title: 1 Chronicles 3:14
text: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

title: 1 Chronicles 3:15
text: And the sons of Josiah: the first-born Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

title: 1 Chronicles 3:16
text: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.

title: 1 Chronicles 3:17
text: And the sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,

title: 1 Chronicles 3:18
text: and Malchiram, and Pedaiah, and Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

title: 1 Chronicles 3:19
text: And the sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel, and Shimei. And the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam, and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

title: 1 Chronicles 3:20
text: and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.

title: 1 Chronicles 3:21
text: And the sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah, and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.

title: 1 Chronicles 3:22
text: And the sons of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. And the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, and Igal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

title: 1 Chronicles 3:23
text: And the sons of Neariah: Elioenai, and Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.

title: 1 Chronicles 3:24
text: And the sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Anani, seven.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:1
text: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:2
text: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:3
text: And these were [the sons of] the father of Etam: Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash; and the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi;

title: 1 Chronicles 4:4
text: and Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the first-born of Ephrathah, the father of Beth-lehem.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:5
text: And Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:6
text: And Naarah bare him Ahuzzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:7
text: And the sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:8
text: And Hakkoz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:9
text: And Jabez was more honorable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:10
text: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my border, and that thy hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it be not to my sorrow! And God granted him that which he requested.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:11
text: And Chelub the brother of Shuhah begat Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:12
text: And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Recah.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:13
text: And the sons of Kenaz: Othniel, and Seraiah. And the sons of Othniel: Hathath.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:14
text: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab the father of Ge-harashim; for they were craftsmen.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:15
text: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the sons of Elah; and Kenaz.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:16
text: And the sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:17
text: And the sons of Ezrah: Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon; and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:18
text: And his wife the Jewess bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:19
text: And the sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:20
text: And the sons of Shimon: Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:21
text: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;

title: 1 Chronicles 4:22
text: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. And the records are ancient.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:23
text: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah: there they dwelt with the king for his work.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:24
text: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

title: 1 Chronicles 4:25
text: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:26
text: And the sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:27
text: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply like to the children of Judah.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:28
text: And they dwelt at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazarshual,

title: 1 Chronicles 4:29
text: and at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,

title: 1 Chronicles 4:30
text: and at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,

title: 1 Chronicles 4:31
text: and at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:32
text: And their villages were Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;

title: 1 Chronicles 4:33
text: and all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and they have their genealogy.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:34
text: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,

title: 1 Chronicles 4:35
text: and Joel, and Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

title: 1 Chronicles 4:36
text: and Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,

title: 1 Chronicles 4:37
text: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah--

title: 1 Chronicles 4:38
text: these mentioned by name were princes in their families: and their fathers' houses increased greatly.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:39
text: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:40
text: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they that dwelt there aforetime were of Ham.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:41
text: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the Meunim that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their stead; because there was pasture there for their flocks.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:42
text: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

title: 1 Chronicles 4:43
text: And they smote the remnant of the Amalekites that escaped, and have dwelt there unto this day.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:1
text: And the sons of Reuben the first-born of Israel (for he was the first-born; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father's couch, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:2
text: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph's),

title: 1 Chronicles 5:3
text: the sons of Reuben the first-born of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:4
text: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

title: 1 Chronicles 5:5
text: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

title: 1 Chronicles 5:6
text: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:7
text: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

title: 1 Chronicles 5:8
text: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baal-meon:

title: 1 Chronicles 5:9
text: and eastward he dwelt even unto the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:10
text: And in the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the [land] east of Gilead.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:11
text: And the sons of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salecah:

title: 1 Chronicles 5:12
text: Joel the chief, and Shapham the second, and Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:13
text: And their brethren of their fathers' houses: Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jacan, and Zia, and Eber, seven.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:14
text: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

title: 1 Chronicles 5:15
text: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers' houses.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:16
text: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in its towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, as far as their borders.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:17
text: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:18
text: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were forty and four thousand seven hundred and threescore, that were able to go forth to war.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:19
text: And they made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:20
text: And they were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he was entreated of them, because they put their trust in him.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:21
text: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men a hundred thousand.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:22
text: For there fell many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their stead until the captivity.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:23
text: And the children of the half-tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baal-hermon and Senir and mount Hermon.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:24
text: And these were the heads of their fathers' houses: even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers' houses.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:25
text: And they trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the harlot after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God destroyed before them.

title: 1 Chronicles 5:26
text: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river of Gozan, unto this day.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:1
text: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:2
text: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:3
text: And the children of Amram: Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron: Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:4
text: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:5
text: and Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:6
text: and Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:7
text: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:8
text: and Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:9
text: and Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:10
text: and Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest's office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem),

title: 1 Chronicles 6:11
text: and Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:12
text: and Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:13
text: and Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:14
text: and Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak;

title: 1 Chronicles 6:15
text: And Jehozadak went [into captivity], when Jehovah carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:16
text: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:17
text: And these are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:18
text: And the sons of Kohath were Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:19
text: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers' [houses] .

title: 1 Chronicles 6:20
text: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:21
text: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeatherai his son.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:22
text: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:23
text: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:24
text: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:25
text: And the sons of Elkanah: Amasai, and Ahimoth.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:26
text: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:27
text: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:28
text: And the sons of Samuel: the first-born, [Joel], and the second Abijah.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:29
text: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:30
text: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:31
text: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of Jehovah, after that the ark had rest.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:32
text: And they ministered with song before the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, until Solomon had built the house of Jehovah in Jerusalem: and they waited on their office according to their order. [

title: 1 Chronicles 6:33
text: And these are they that waited, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:34
text: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:35
text: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:36
text: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:37
text: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:38
text: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:39
text: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:40
text: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:41
text: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:42
text: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:43
text: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:44
text: And on the left hand their brethren the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:45
text: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:46
text: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:47
text: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:48
text: And their brethren the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:49
text: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of burnt-offering, and upon the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:50
text: And these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:51
text: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:52
text: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:53
text: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:54
text: Now these are their dwelling-places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the [first] lot),

title: 1 Chronicles 6:55
text: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it;

title: 1 Chronicles 6:56
text: but the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:57
text: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron; Libnah also with its suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa with its suburbs,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:58
text: and Hilen with its suburbs, Debir with its suburbs,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:59
text: and Ashan with its suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with its suburbs;

title: 1 Chronicles 6:60
text: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its suburbs, and Allemeth with its suburbs, and Anathoth with its suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:61
text: And unto the rest of the sons of Kohath [were given] by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:62
text: And to the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:63
text: Unto the sons of Merari [were given] by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:64
text: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their suburbs.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:65
text: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:66
text: And some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:67
text: And they gave unto them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim with its suburbs; Gezer also with its suburbs,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:68
text: and Jokmeam with its suburbs, and Beth-horon with its suburbs,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:69
text: and Aijalon with its suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with its suburbs;

title: 1 Chronicles 6:70
text: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its suburbs, and Bileam with its suburbs, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:71
text: Unto the sons of Gershom [were given], out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its suburbs, and Ashtaroth with its suburbs;

title: 1 Chronicles 6:72
text: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its suburbs, Daberath with its suburbs,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:73
text: and Ramoth with its suburbs, and Anem with its suburbs;

title: 1 Chronicles 6:74
text: and out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its suburbs, and Abdon with its suburbs,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:75
text: and Hukok with its suburbs, and Rehob with its suburbs;

title: 1 Chronicles 6:76
text: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its suburbs, and Hammon with its suburbs, and Kiriathaim with its suburbs.

title: 1 Chronicles 6:77
text: Unto the rest of [the Levites], the sons of Merari, [were given], out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its suburbs, Tabor with its suburbs;

title: 1 Chronicles 6:78
text: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, [were given them], out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with its suburbs, and Jahzah with its suburbs,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:79
text: and Kedemoth with its suburbs, and Mephaath with its suburbs;

title: 1 Chronicles 6:80
text: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its suburbs, and Mahanaim with its suburbs,

title: 1 Chronicles 6:81
text: and Heshbon with its suburbs, and Jazer with its suburbs.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:1
text: And of the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:2
text: And the sons of Tola: Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers' houses, [to wit], of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations: their number in the days of David was two and twenty thousand and six hundred.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:3
text: And the sons of Uzzi: Izrahiah. And the sons of Izrahiah: Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:4
text: And with them, by their generations, after their fathers' houses, were bands of the host for war, six and thirty thousand; for they had many wives and sons.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:5
text: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, reckoned in all by genealogy, were fourscore and seven thousand.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:6
text: [ The sons of] Benjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:7
text: And the sons of Bela: Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers' houses, mighty men of valor; and they were reckoned by genealogy twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:8
text: And the sons of Becher: Zemirah, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jeremoth, and Abijah, and Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:9
text: And they were reckoned by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers' houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand and two hundred.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:10
text: And the sons of Jediael: Bilhan. And the sons of Bilhan: Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:11
text: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers' [houses], mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand and two hundred, that were able to go forth in the host for war.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:12
text: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, the sons of Aher.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:13
text: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:14
text: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bare: she bare Machir the father of Gilead:

title: 1 Chronicles 7:15
text: and Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister's name was Maacah; and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:16
text: And Maacah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:17
text: And the sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:18
text: And his sister Hammolecheth bare Ishhod, and Abiezer, and Mahlah.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:19
text: And the sons of Shemida were Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:20
text: And the sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eleadah his son, and Tahath his son,

title: 1 Chronicles 7:21
text: and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in the land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:22
text: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:23
text: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:24
text: And his daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth-horon the nether and the upper, and Uzzen-sheerah.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:25
text: And Rephah was his son, and Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,

title: 1 Chronicles 7:26
text: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

title: 1 Chronicles 7:27
text: Nun his son, Joshua his son.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:28
text: And their possessions and habitations were Beth-el and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Azzah and the towns thereof;

title: 1 Chronicles 7:29
text: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, Dor and its towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:30
text: The sons of Asher: Imnah, and Ishvah, and Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:31
text: And the sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:32
text: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:33
text: And the sons of Japhlet: Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:34
text: And the sons of Shemer: Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:35
text: And the sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:36
text: The sons of Zophah: Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,

title: 1 Chronicles 7:37
text: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:38
text: And the sons of Jether: Jephunneh, and Pispa, and Ara.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:39
text: And the sons of Ulla: Arah, and Hanniel, and Rizia.

title: 1 Chronicles 7:40
text: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers' houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. And the number of them reckoned by genealogy for service in war was twenty and six thousand men.

title: 1 Chronicles 8:1
text: And Benjamin begat Bela his first-born, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

title: 1 Chronicles 8:2
text: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

title: 1 Chronicles 8:3
text: And Bela had sons: Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

title: 1 Chronicles 8:4
text: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

title: 1 Chronicles 8:5
text: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

title: 1 Chronicles 8:6
text: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of fathers' [houses] of the inhabitants of Geba, and they carried them captive to Manahath:

title: 1 Chronicles 8:7
text: and Naaman, and Ahijah, and Gera, he carried them captive: and he begat Uzza and Ahihud.

title: 1 Chronicles 8:8
text: And Shaharaim begat children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.

title: 1 Chronicles 8:9
text: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcam,

title: 1 Chronicles 8:10
text: and Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers' [houses] .

title: 1 Chronicles 8:11
text: And of Hushim he begat Abitub and Elpaal.

title: 1 Chronicles 8:12
text: And the sons of Elpaal: Eber, and Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with the towns thereof;

title: 1 Chronicles 8:13
text: and Beriah, and Shema, who were heads of fathers' [houses] of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

title: 1 Chronicles 8:14
text: and Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,

title: 1 Chronicles 8:15
text: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Eder,

title: 1 Chronicles 8:16
text: and Michael, and Ishpah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah,

title: 1 Chronicles 8:17
text: and Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hizki, and Heber,

title: 1 Chronicles 8:18
text: and Ishmerai, and Izliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,

title: 1 Chronicles 8:19
text: and Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

title: 1 Chronicles 8:20
text: and Elienai, and Zillethai, and Eliel,

title: 1 Chronicles 8:21
text: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,

title: 1 Chronicles 8:22
text: and Ishpan, and Eber, and Eliel,

title: 1 Chronicles 8:23
text: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

title: 1 Chronicles 8:24
text: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Anthothijah,

title: 1 Chronicles 8:25
text: and Iphdeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak,

title: 1 Chronicles 8:26
text: and Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

title: 1 Chronicles 8:27
text: and Jaareshiah, and Elijah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.

title: 1 Chronicles 8:28
text: These were heads of fathers' [houses] throughout their generations, chief men: these dwelt in Jerusalem.

title: 1 Chronicles 8:29
text: And in Gibeon there dwelt the father of Gibeon, [Jeiel], whose wife's name was Maacah;

title: 1 Chronicles 8:30
text: and his first-born son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

title: 1 Chronicles 8:31
text: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zecher.

title: 1 Chronicles 8:32
text: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And they also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against their brethren.

title: 1 Chronicles 8:33
text: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

title: 1 Chronicles 8:34
text: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begat Micah.

title: 1 Chronicles 8:35
text: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

title: 1 Chronicles 8:36
text: And Ahaz begat Jehoaddah; and Jehoaddah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza.

title: 1 Chronicles 8:37
text: And Moza begat Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

title: 1 Chronicles 8:38
text: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

title: 1 Chronicles 8:39
text: And the sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his first-born, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

title: 1 Chronicles 8:40
text: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, a hundred and fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:1
text: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel: and Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their transgression.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:2
text: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the Nethinim.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:3
text: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:

title: 1 Chronicles 9:4
text: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:5
text: And of the Shilonites: Asaiah the first-born, and his sons.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:6
text: And of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:7
text: And of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah,

title: 1 Chronicles 9:8
text: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

title: 1 Chronicles 9:9
text: and their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were heads of fathers' [houses] by their fathers' houses.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:10
text: And of the priests: Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, Jachin,

title: 1 Chronicles 9:11
text: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;

title: 1 Chronicles 9:12
text: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

title: 1 Chronicles 9:13
text: and their brethren, heads of their fathers' houses, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:14
text: And of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

title: 1 Chronicles 9:15
text: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

title: 1 Chronicles 9:16
text: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:17
text: And the porters: Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren (Shallum was the chief),

title: 1 Chronicles 9:18
text: who hitherto [waited] in the king's gate eastward: they were the porters for the camp of the children of Levi.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:19
text: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of his father's house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent: and their fathers had been over the camp of Jehovah, keepers of the entry.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:20
text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, [and] Jehovah was with him.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:21
text: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tent of meeting.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:22
text: All these that were chosen to be porters in the thresholds were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their office of trust.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:23
text: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of Jehovah, even the house of the tent, by wards.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:24
text: On the four sides were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:25
text: And their brethren, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them:

title: 1 Chronicles 9:26
text: for the four chief porters, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the chambers and over the treasuries in the house of God.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:27
text: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge [thereof] was upon them; and to them pertained the opening thereof morning by morning.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:28
text: And certain of them had charge of the vessels of service; for by count were these brought in and by count were these taken out.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:29
text: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, and over the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:30
text: And some of the sons of the priests prepared the confection of the spices.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:31
text: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the first-born of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:32
text: And some of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the showbread, to prepare it every sabbath.

title: 1 Chronicles 9:33
