text: Then were the king's scribes called at that time, in the third month Sivan, on the three and twentieth [day] thereof; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded unto the Jews, and to the satraps, and the governors and princes of the provinces which are from India unto Ethiopia, a hundred twenty and seven provinces, unto every province according to the writing thereof, and unto every people after their language, and to the Jews according to their writing, and according to their language.

title: Esther 8:10
text: And he wrote the name of king Ahasuerus, and sealed it with the king's ring, and sent letters by post on horseback, riding on swift steeds that were used in the king's service, bred of the stud:

title: Esther 8:11
text: wherein the king granted the Jews that were in every city to gather themselves together, and to stand for their life, to destroy, to slay, and to cause to perish, all the power of the people and province that would assault them, [their] little ones and women, and to take the spoil of them for a prey,

title: Esther 8:12
text: upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus, [namely], upon the thirteenth [day] of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

title: Esther 8:13
text: A copy of the writing, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published unto all the peoples, and that the Jews should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.

title: Esther 8:14
text: So the posts that rode upon swift steeds that were used in the king's service went out, being hastened and pressed on by the king's commandment; and the decree was given out in Shushan the palace.

title: Esther 8:15
text: And Mordecai went forth from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a robe of fine linen and purple: and the city of Shushan shouted and was glad.

title: Esther 8:16
text: The Jews had light and gladness, and joy and honor.

title: Esther 8:17
text: And in every province, and in every city, whithersoever the king's commandment and his decree came, the Jews had gladness and joy, a feast and a good day. And many from among the peoples of the land became Jews; for the fear of the Jews was fallen upon them.

title: Esther 9:1
text: Now in the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the same, when the king's commandment and his decree drew near to be put in execution, on the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to have rule over them, (whereas it was turned to the contrary, that the Jews had rule over them that hated them,)

title: Esther 9:2
text: the Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, to lay hand on such as sought their hurt: and no man could withstand them; for the fear of them was fallen upon all the peoples.

title: Esther 9:3
text: And all the princes of the provinces, and the satraps, and the governors, and they that did the king's business, helped the Jews; because the fear of Mordecai was fallen upon them.

title: Esther 9:4
text: For Mordecai was great in the king's house, and his fame went forth throughout all the provinces; for the man Mordecai waxed greater and greater.

title: Esther 9:5
text: And the Jews smote all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and with slaughter and destruction, and did what they would unto them that hated them.

title: Esther 9:6
text: And in Shushan the palace the Jews slew and destroyed five hundred men.

title: Esther 9:7
text: And Parshandatha, and Dalphon, and Aspatha,

title: Esther 9:8
text: and Poratha, and Adalia, and Aridatha,

title: Esther 9:9
text: and Parmashta, and Arisai, and Aridai, and Vaizatha,

title: Esther 9:10
text: the ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Jew's enemy, slew they; but on the spoil they laid not their hand.

title: Esther 9:11
text: On that day the number of those that were slain in Shushan the palace was brought before the king.

title: Esther 9:12
text: And the king said unto Esther the queen, The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the palace, and the ten sons of Haman; what then have they done in the rest of the king's provinces! Now what is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: or what is thy request further? and it shall be done.

title: Esther 9:13
text: Then said Esther, If it please the king, let it be granted to the Jews that are in Shushan to do to-morrow also according unto this day's decree, and let Haman's ten sons be hanged upon the gallows.

title: Esther 9:14
text: And the king commanded it so to be done: and a decree was given out in Shushan; and they hanged Haman's ten sons.

title: Esther 9:15
text: And the Jews that were in Shushan gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and slew three hundred men in Shushan; but on the spoil they laid not their hand.

title: Esther 9:16
text: And the other Jews that were in the king's provinces gathered themselves together, and stood for their lives, and had rest from their enemies, and slew of them that hated them seventy and five thousand; but on the spoil they laid not their hand.

title: Esther 9:17
text: [ This was done] on the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

title: Esther 9:18
text: But the Jews that were in Shushan assembled together on the thirteenth [day] thereof, and on the fourteenth thereof; and on the fifteenth [day] of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

title: Esther 9:19
text: Therefore do the Jews of the villages, that dwell in the unwalled towns, make the fourteenth day of the month Adar [a day of] gladness and feasting, and a good day, and of sending portions one to another.

title: Esther 9:20
text: And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters unto all the Jews that were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both nigh and far,

title: Esther 9:21
text: to enjoin them that they should keep the fourteenth day of the month Adar, and the fifteenth day of the same, yearly,

title: Esther 9:22
text: as the days wherein the Jews had rest from their enemies, and the month which was turned unto them from sorrow to gladness, and from mourning into a good day; that they should make them days of feasting and gladness, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.

title: Esther 9:23
text: And the Jews undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written unto them;

title: Esther 9:24
text: because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had plotted against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that is the lot, to consume them, and to destroy them;

title: Esther 9:25
text: but when [the matter] came before the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked device, which he had devised against the Jews, should return upon his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.

title: Esther 9:26
text: Wherefore they called these days Purim, after the name of Pur. Therefore because of all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and that which had come unto them,

title: Esther 9:27
text: the Jews ordained, and took upon them, and upon their seed, and upon all such as joined themselves unto them, so that it should not fail, that they would keep these two days according to the writing thereof, and according to the appointed time thereof, every year;

title: Esther 9:28
text: and that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor the remembrance of them [ perish from their seed.

title: Esther 9:29
text: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority to confirm this second letter of Purim.

title: Esther 9:30
text: And he sent letters unto all the Jews, to the hundred twenty and seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus, [with] words of peace and truth,

title: Esther 9:31
text: to confirm these days of Purim in their appointed times, according as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had enjoined them, and as they had ordained for themselves and for their seed, in the matter of the fastings and their cry.

title: Esther 9:32
text: And the commandment of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.

title: Esther 10:1
text: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and upon the isles of the sea.

title: Esther 10:2
text: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, whereunto the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

title: Esther 10:3
text: For Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the good of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.

title: Job 1:1
text: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and turned away from evil.

title: Job 1:2
text: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.

title: Job 1:3
text: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she-asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east.

title: Job 1:4
text: And his sons went and held a feast in the house of each one upon his day; and they sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

title: Job 1:5
text: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt-offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and renounced God in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.

title: Job 1:6
text: Now it came to pass on the day when the sons of God came to present themselves before Jehovah, that Satan also came among them.

title: Job 1:7
text: And Jehovah said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered Jehovah, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

title: Job 1:8
text: And Jehovah said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job? for there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and turneth away from evil.

title: Job 1:9
text: Then Satan answered Jehovah, and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?

title: Job 1:10
text: Hast not thou made a hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath, on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

title: Job 1:11
text: But put forth thy hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will renounce thee to thy face.

title: Job 1:12
text: And Jehovah said unto Satan, Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thy hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of Jehovah.

title: Job 1:13
text: And it fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house,

title: Job 1:14
text: that there came a messenger unto Job, and said, The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them;

title: Job 1:15
text: and the Sabeans fell [upon them], and took them away: yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

title: Job 1:16
text: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of God is fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

title: Job 1:17
text: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have taken them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

title: Job 1:18
text: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house;

title: Job 1:19
text: and, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee. [

title: Job 1:20
text: Then Job arose, and rent his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped;

title: Job 1:21
text: and he said, Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: Jehovah gave, and Jehovah hath taken away; blessed be the name of Jehovah.

title: Job 1:22
text: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.

title: Job 2:1
text: Again it came to pass on the day when the sons of God came to present themselves before Jehovah, that Satan came also among them to present himself before Jehovah.

title: Job 2:2
text: And Jehovah said unto Satan, From whence comest thou? And Satan answered Jehovah, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

title: Job 2:3
text: And Jehovah said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job? for there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and turneth away from evil: and he still holdeth fast his integrity, although thou movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause.

title: Job 2:4
text: And Satan answered Jehovah, and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life.

title: Job 2:5
text: But put forth thy hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will renounce thee to thy face.

title: Job 2:6
text: And Jehovah said unto Satan, Behold, he is in thy hand; only spare his life.

title: Job 2:7
text: So Satan went forth from the presence of Jehovah, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.

title: Job 2:8
text: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself therewith; and he sat among the ashes.

title: Job 2:9
text: Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still hold fast thine integrity? renounce God, and die.

title: Job 2:10
text: But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.

title: Job 2:11
text: Now when Job's three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite, and they made an appointment together to come to bemoan him and to comfort him.

title: Job 2:12
text: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his robe, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.

title: Job 2:13
text: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.

title: Job 3:1
text: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.

title: Job 3:2
text: And Job answered and said:

title: Job 3:3
text: Let the day perish wherein I was born, And the night which said, There is a man-child conceived.

title: Job 3:4
text: Let that day be darkness; Let not God from above seek for it, Neither let the light shine upon it.

title: Job 3:5
text: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own; Let a cloud dwell upon it; Let all that maketh black the day terrify it.

title: Job 3:6
text: As for that night, let thick darkness seize upon it: Let it not rejoice among the days of the year; Let it not come into the number of the months.

title: Job 3:7
text: Lo, let that night be barren; Let no joyful voice come therein.

title: Job 3:8
text: Let them curse it that curse the day, Who are ready to rouse up leviathan.

title: Job 3:9
text: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark: Let it look for light, but have none; Neither let it behold the eyelids of the morning:

title: Job 3:10
text: Because it shut not up the doors of my [mother's] womb, Nor hid trouble from mine eyes.

title: Job 3:11
text: Why died I not from the womb? Why did I not give up the ghost when my mother bare me?

title: Job 3:12
text: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should suck?

title: Job 3:13
text: For now should I have lain down and been quiet; I should have slept; then had I been at rest,

title: Job 3:14
text: With kings and counsellors of the earth, Who built up waste places for themselves;

title: Job 3:15
text: Or with princes that had gold, Who filled their houses with silver:

title: Job 3:16
text: Or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, As infants that never saw light.

title: Job 3:17
text: There the wicked cease from troubling; And there the weary are at rest.

title: Job 3:18
text: There the prisoners are at ease together; They hear not the voice of the taskmaster.

title: Job 3:19
text: The small and the great are there: And the servant is free from his master.

title: Job 3:20
text: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, And life unto the bitter in soul;

title: Job 3:21
text: Who long for death, but it cometh not, And dig for it more than for hid treasures;

title: Job 3:22
text: Who rejoice exceedingly, And are glad, when they can find the grave?

title: Job 3:23
text: [ Why is light given] to a man whose way is hid, And whom God hath hedged in?

title: Job 3:24
text: For my sighing cometh before I eat, And my groanings are poured out like water.

title: Job 3:25
text: For the thing which I fear cometh upon me, And that which I am afraid of cometh unto me.

title: Job 3:26
text: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither have I rest; But trouble cometh.

title: Job 4:1
text: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

title: Job 4:2
text: If one assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?

title: Job 4:3
text: Behold, thou hast instructed many, And thou hast strengthened the weak hands.

title: Job 4:4
text: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, And thou hast made firm the feeble knees.

title: Job 4:5
text: But now it is come unto thee, and thou faintest; It toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.

title: Job 4:6
text: Is not thy fear [of God] thy confidence, [And] the integrity of thy ways thy hope?

title: Job 4:7
text: Remember, I pray thee, who [ever] perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?

title: Job 4:8
text: According as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, And sow trouble, reap the same.

title: Job 4:9
text: By the breath of God they perish, And by the blast of his anger are they consumed.

title: Job 4:10
text: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, And the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

title: Job 4:11
text: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, And the whelps of the lioness are scattered abroad.

title: Job 4:12
text: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, And mine ear received a whisper thereof.

title: Job 4:13
text: In thoughts from the visions of the night, When deep sleep falleth on men,

title: Job 4:14
text: Fear came upon me, and trembling, Which made all my bones to shake.

title: Job 4:15
text: Then a spirit passed before my face; The hair of my flesh stood up.

title: Job 4:16
text: It stood still, but I could not discern the appearance thereof; A form was before mine eyes: [There was] silence, and I heard a voice, [saying] ,

title: Job 4:17
text: Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?

title: Job 4:18
text: Behold, he putteth no trust in his servants; And his angels he chargeth with folly:

title: Job 4:19
text: How much more them that dwell in houses of clay, Whose foundation is in the dust, Who are crushed before the moth!

title: Job 4:20
text: Betwixt morning and evening they are destroyed: They perish for ever without any regarding it.

title: Job 4:21
text: Is not their tent-cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.

title: Job 5:1
text: Call now; is there any that will answer thee? And to which of the holy ones wilt thou turn?

title: Job 5:2
text: For vexation killeth the foolish man, And jealousy slayeth the silly one.

title: Job 5:3
text: I have seen the foolish taking root: But suddenly I cursed his habitation.

title: Job 5:4
text: His children are far from safety, And they are crushed in the gate, Neither is there any to deliver them:

title: Job 5:5
text: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, And taketh it even out of the thorns; And the snare gapeth for their substance.

title: Job 5:6
text: For affliction cometh not forth from the dust, Neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;

title: Job 5:7
text: But man is born unto trouble, As the sparks fly upward.

title: Job 5:8
text: But as for me, I would seek unto God, And unto God would I commit my cause;

title: Job 5:9
text: Who doeth great things and unsearchable, Marvellous things without number:

title: Job 5:10
text: Who giveth rain upon the earth, And sendeth waters upon the fields;

title: Job 5:11
text: So that he setteth up on high those that are low, And those that mourn are exalted to safety.

title: Job 5:12
text: He frustrateth the devices of the crafty, So that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.

title: Job 5:13
text: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness; And the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

title: Job 5:14
text: They meet with darkness in the day-time, And grope at noonday as in the night.

title: Job 5:15
text: But he saveth from the sword of their mouth, Even the needy from the hand of the mighty.

title: Job 5:16
text: So the poor hath hope, And iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

title: Job 5:17
text: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: Therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty.

title: Job 5:18
text: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up; He woundeth, and his hands make whole.

title: Job 5:19
text: He will deliver thee in six troubles; Yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.

title: Job 5:20
text: In famine he will redeem thee from death; And in war from the power of the sword.

title: Job 5:21
text: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue; Neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.

title: Job 5:22
text: At destruction and dearth thou shalt laugh; Neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.

title: Job 5:23
text: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field; And the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.

title: Job 5:24
text: And thou shalt know that thy tent is in peace; And thou shalt visit thy fold, and shalt miss nothing.

title: Job 5:25
text: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, And thine offspring as the grass of the earth.

title: Job 5:26
text: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, Like as a shock of grain cometh in in its season.

title: Job 5:27
text: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; Hear it, and know thou it for thy good.

title: Job 6:1
text: Then Job answered and said,

title: Job 6:2
text: Oh that my vexation were but weighed, And all my calamity laid in the balances!

title: Job 6:3
text: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas: Therefore have my words been rash.

title: Job 6:4
text: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, The poison whereof my spirit drinketh up: The terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.

title: Job 6:5
text: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? Or loweth the ox over his fodder?

title: Job 6:6
text: Can that which hath no savor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

title: Job 6:7
text: My soul refuseth to touch [them] ; They are as loathsome food to me.

title: Job 6:8
text: Oh that I might have my request; And that God would grant [me] the thing that I long for!

title: Job 6:9
text: Even that it would please God to crush me; That he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

title: Job 6:10
text: And be it still my consolation, Yea, let me exult in pain that spareth not, That I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

title: Job 6:11
text: What is my strength, that I should wait? And what is mine end, that I should be patient?

title: Job 6:12
text: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of brass?

title: Job 6:13
text: Is it not that I have no help in me, And that wisdom is driven quite from me?

title: Job 6:14
text: To him that is ready to faint kindness [should be showed] from his friend; Even to him that forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.

title: Job 6:15
text: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, As the channel of brooks that pass away;

title: Job 6:16
text: Which are black by reason of the ice, [And] wherein the snow hideth itself:

title: Job 6:17
text: What time they wax warm, they vanish; When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

title: Job 6:18
text: The caravans [that travel] by the way of them turn aside; They go up into the waste, and perish.

title: Job 6:19
text: The caravans of Tema looked, The companies of Sheba waited for them.

title: Job 6:20
text: They were put to shame because they had hoped; They came thither, and were confounded.

title: Job 6:21
text: For now ye are nothing; Ye see a terror, and are afraid.

title: Job 6:22
text: Did I say, Give unto me? Or, Offer a present for me of your substance?

title: Job 6:23
text: Or, Deliver me from the adversary's hand? Or, Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors?

title: Job 6:24
text: Teach me, and I will hold my peace; And cause me to understand wherein I have erred.

title: Job 6:25
text: How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what doth it reprove?

title: Job 6:26
text: Do ye think to reprove words, Seeing that the speeches of one that is desperate are as wind?

title: Job 6:27
text: Yea, ye would cast [lots] upon the fatherless, And make merchandise of your friend.

title: Job 6:28
text: Now therefore be pleased to look upon me; For surely I shall not lie to your face.

title: Job 6:29
text: Return, I pray you, let there be no injustice; Yea, return again, my cause is righteous.

title: Job 6:30
text: Is there injustice on my tongue? Cannot my taste discern mischievous things?

title: Job 7:1
text: Is there not a warfare to man upon earth? And are not his days like the days of a hireling?

title: Job 7:2
text: As a servant that earnestly desireth the shadow, And as a hireling that looketh for his wages:

title: Job 7:3
text: So am I made to possess months of misery, And wearisome nights are appointed to me.

title: Job 7:4
text: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? And I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.

title: Job 7:5
text: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; My skin closeth up, and breaketh out afresh.

title: Job 7:6
text: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, And are spent without hope.

title: Job 7:7
text: Oh remember that my life is a breath: Mine eye shall no more see good.

title: Job 7:8
text: The eye of him that seeth me shall behold me no more; Thine eyes shall be upon me, but I shall not be.

title: Job 7:9
text: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away, So he that goeth down to Sheol shall come up no more.

title: Job 7:10
text: He shall return no more to his house, Neither shall his place know him any more.

title: Job 7:11
text: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

title: Job 7:12
text: Am I a sea, or a sea-monster, That thou settest a watch over me?

title: Job 7:13
text: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, My couch shall ease my complaint;

title: Job 7:14
text: Then thou scarest me with dreams, And terrifiest me through visions:

title: Job 7:15
text: So that my soul chooseth strangling, And death rather than [these] my bones.

title: Job 7:16
text: I loathe [my life] ; I would not live alway: Let me alone; for my days are vanity.

title: Job 7:17
text: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him, And that thou shouldest set thy mind upon him,

title: Job 7:18
text: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, And try him every moment?

title: Job 7:19
text: How long wilt thou not look away from me, Nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?

title: Job 7:20
text: If I have sinned, what do I unto thee, O thou watcher of men? Why hast thou set me as a mark for thee, So that I am a burden to myself?

title: Job 7:21
text: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, and take away mine iniquity? For now shall I lie down in the dust; And thou wilt seek me diligently, but I shall not be.

title: Job 8:1
text: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

title: Job 8:2
text: How long wilt thou speak these things? And [how long] shall the words of thy mouth be [like] a mighty wind?

title: Job 8:3
text: Doth God pervert justice? Or doth the Almighty pervert righteousness?

title: Job 8:4
text: If thy children have sinned against him, And he hath delivered them into the hand of their transgression;

title: Job 8:5
text: If thou wouldest seek diligently unto God, And make thy supplication to the Almighty;

title: Job 8:6
text: If thou wert pure and upright: Surely now he would awake for thee, And make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.

title: Job 8:7
text: And though thy beginning was small, Yet thy latter end would greatly increase.

title: Job 8:8
text: For inquire, I pray thee, of the former age, And apply thyself to that which their fathers have searched out:

title: Job 8:9
text: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, Because our days upon earth are a shadow);

title: Job 8:10
text: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, And utter words out of their heart?

title: Job 8:11
text: Can the rush grow up without mire? Can the flag grow without water?

title: Job 8:12
text: Whilst it is yet in its greenness, [and] not cut down, It withereth before any [other] herb.

title: Job 8:13
text: So are the paths of all that forget God; And the hope of the godless man shall perish:

title: Job 8:14
text: Whose confidence shall break in sunder, And whose trust is a spider's web.

title: Job 8:15
text: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: He shall hold fast thereby, but it shall not endure.

title: Job 8:16
text: He is green before the sun, And his shoots go forth over his garden.

title: Job 8:17
text: His roots are wrapped about the [stone] -heap, He beholdeth the place of stones.

title: Job 8:18
text: If he be destroyed from his place, Then it shall deny him, [saying], I have not seen thee.

title: Job 8:19
text: Behold, this is the joy of his way; And out of the earth shall others spring.

title: Job 8:20
text: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, Neither will he uphold the evil-doers.

title: Job 8:21
text: He will yet fill thy mouth with laughter, And thy lips with shouting.

title: Job 8:22
text: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; And the tent of the wicked shall be no more.

title: Job 9:1
text: Then Job answered and said,

title: Job 9:2
text: Of a truth I know that it is so: But how can man be just with God?

title: Job 9:3
text: If he be pleased to contend with him, He cannot answer him one of a thousand.

title: Job 9:4
text: [ He is] wise in heart, and mighty in strength: Who hath hardened himself against him, and prospered?--

title: Job 9:5
text: [ Him] that removeth the mountains, and they know it not, When he overturneth them in his anger;

title: Job 9:6
text: That shaketh the earth out of its place, And the pillars thereof tremble;

title: Job 9:7
text: That commandeth the sun, and it riseth not, And sealeth up the stars;

title: Job 9:8
text: That alone stretcheth out the heavens, And treadeth upon the waves of the sea;

title: Job 9:9
text: That maketh the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, And the chambers of the south;

title: Job 9:10
text: That doeth great things past finding out, Yea, marvellous things without number.

title: Job 9:11
text: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: He passeth on also, but I perceive him not.

title: Job 9:12
text: Behold, he seizeth [the prey], who can hinder him? Who will say unto him, What doest thou?

title: Job 9:13
text: God will not withdraw his anger; The helpers of Rahab do stoop under him.

title: Job 9:14
text: How much less shall I answer him, And choose out my words [to reason] with him?

title: Job 9:15
text: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer; I would make supplication to my judge.

title: Job 9:16
text: If I had called, and he had answered me, Yet would I not believe that he hearkened unto my voice.

title: Job 9:17
text: For he breaketh me with a tempest, And multiplieth my wounds without cause.

title: Job 9:18
text: He will not suffer me to take my breath, But filleth me with bitterness.

title: Job 9:19
text: If [we speak] of strength, lo, [he is] mighty! And if of justice, Who, [saith he], will summon me?

title: Job 9:20
text: Though I be righteous, mine own mouth shall condemn me: Though I be perfect, it shall prove me perverse.

title: Job 9:21
text: I am perfect; I regard not myself; I despise my life.

title: Job 9:22
text: It is all one; therefore I say, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.

title: Job 9:23
text: If the scourge slay suddenly, He will mock at the trial of the innocent.

title: Job 9:24
text: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked; He covereth the faces of the judges thereof: If [it be] not [he], who then is it?

title: Job 9:25
text: Now my days are swifter than a post: They flee away, they see no good,

title: Job 9:26
text: They are passed away as the swift ships; As the eagle that swoopeth on the prey.

title: Job 9:27
text: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will put off my [sad] countenance, and be of good cheer;

title: Job 9:28
text: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.

title: Job 9:29
text: I shall be condemned; Why then do I labor in vain?

title: Job 9:30
text: If I wash myself with snow water, And make my hands never so clean;

title: Job 9:31
text: Yet wilt thou plunge me in the ditch, And mine own clothes shall abhor me.

title: Job 9:32
text: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, That we should come together in judgment.

title: Job 9:33
text: There is no umpire betwixt us, That might lay his hand upon us both.

title: Job 9:34
text: Let him take his rod away from me, And let not his terror make me afraid:

title: Job 9:35
text: Then would I speak, and not fear him; For I am not so in myself.

title: Job 10:1
text: My soul is weary of my life; I will give free course to my complaint; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

title: Job 10:2
text: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; Show me wherefore thou contendest with me.

title: Job 10:3
text: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, That thou shouldest despise the work of thy hands, And shine upon the counsel of the wicked?

title: Job 10:4
text: Hast thou eyes of flesh? Or seest thou as man seeth?

title: Job 10:5
text: Are thy days as the days of man, Or thy years as man's days,

title: Job 10:6
text: That thou inquirest after mine iniquity, And searchest after my sin,

title: Job 10:7
text: Although thou knowest that I am not wicked, And there is none that can deliver out of thy hand?

title: Job 10:8
text: Thy hands have framed me and fashioned me Together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.

title: Job 10:9
text: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast fashioned me as clay; And wilt thou bring me into dust again?

title: Job 10:10
text: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, And curdled me like cheese?

title: Job 10:11
text: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, And knit me together with bones and sinews.

title: Job 10:12
text: Thou hast granted me life and lovingkindness; And thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.

title: Job 10:13
text: Yet these things thou didst hide in thy heart; I know that this is with thee:

title: Job 10:14
text: If I sin, then thou markest me, And thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.

title: Job 10:15
text: If I be wicked, woe unto me; And if I be righteous, yet shall I not lift up my head; Being filled with ignominy, And looking upon mine affliction.

title: Job 10:16
text: And if [my head] exalt itself, thou huntest me as a lion; And again thou showest thyself marvellous upon me.

title: Job 10:17
text: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, And increasest thine indignation upon me: Changes and warfare are with me.

title: Job 10:18
text: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me.

title: Job 10:19
text: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

title: Job 10:20
text: Are not my days few? cease then, And let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,

title: Job 10:21
text: Before I go whence I shall not return, [Even] to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

title: Job 10:22
text: The land dark as midnight, [The land] of the shadow of death, without any order, And where the light is as midnight.

title: Job 11:1
text: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

title: Job 11:2
text: Should not the multitude of words be answered? And should a man full of talk be justified?

title: Job 11:3
text: Should thy boastings make men hold their peace? And when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?

title: Job 11:4
text: For thou sayest, My doctrine is pure, And I am clean in thine eyes.

title: Job 11:5
text: But oh that God would speak, And open his lips against thee,

title: Job 11:6
text: And that he would show thee the secrets of wisdom! For he is manifold in understanding. Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.

title: Job 11:7
text: Canst thou by searching find out God? Canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?

title: Job 11:8
text: It is high as heaven; what canst thou do? Deeper than Sheol; What canst thou know?

title: Job 11:9
text: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, And broader than the sea.

title: Job 11:10
text: If he pass through, and shut up, And call unto judgment, then who can hinder him?

title: Job 11:11
text: For he knoweth false men: He seeth iniquity also, even though he consider it not.

title: Job 11:12
text: But vain man is void of understanding, Yea, man is born [as] a wild ass's colt.

title: Job 11:13
text: If thou set thy heart aright, And stretch out thy hands toward him;

title: Job 11:14
text: If iniquity be in thy hand, put it far away, And let not unrighteousness dwell in thy tents.

title: Job 11:15
text: Surely then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; Yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:

title: Job 11:16
text: For thou shalt forget thy misery; Thou shalt remember it as waters that are passed away,

title: Job 11:17
text: And [thy] life shall be clearer than the noonday; Though there be darkness, it shall be as the morning.

title: Job 11:18
text: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; Yea, thou shalt search [about thee], and shalt take thy rest in safety.

title: Job 11:19
text: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; Yea, many shall make suit unto thee.

title: Job 11:20
text: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, And they shall have no way to flee; And their hope shall be the giving up of the ghost.

title: Job 12:1
text: Then Job answered and said,

title: Job 12:2
text: No doubt but ye are the people, And wisdom shall die with you.

title: Job 12:3
text: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: Yea, who knoweth not such things as these?

title: Job 12:4
text: I am as one that is a laughing-stock to his neighbor, I who called upon God, and he answered: The just, the perfect man is a laughing-stock.

title: Job 12:5
text: In the thought of him that is at ease there is contempt for misfortune; It is ready for them whose foot slippeth.

title: Job 12:6
text: The tents of robbers prosper, And they that provoke God are secure; Into whose hand God bringeth [abundantly] .

title: Job 12:7
text: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; And the birds of the heavens, and they shall tell thee:

title: Job 12:8
text: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee; And the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.

title: Job 12:9
text: Who knoweth not in all these, That the hand of Jehovah hath wrought this,

title: Job 12:10
text: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, And the breath of all mankind?

title: Job 12:11
text: Doth not the ear try words, Even as the palate tasteth its food?

title: Job 12:12
text: With aged men is wisdom, And in length of days understanding.

title: Job 12:13
text: With [God] is wisdom and might; He hath counsel and understanding.

title: Job 12:14
text: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again; He shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.

title: Job 12:15
text: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up; Again, he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.

title: Job 12:16
text: With him is strength and wisdom; The deceived and the deceiver are his.

title: Job 12:17
text: He leadeth counsellors away stripped, And judges maketh he fools.

title: Job 12:18
text: He looseth the bond of kings, And he bindeth their loins with a girdle.

title: Job 12:19
text: He leadeth priests away stripped, And overthroweth the mighty.

title: Job 12:20
text: He removeth the speech of the trusty, And taketh away the understanding of the elders.

title: Job 12:21
text: He poureth contempt upon princes, And looseth the belt of the strong.

title: Job 12:22
text: He uncovereth deep things out of darkness, And bringeth out to light the shadow of death.

title: Job 12:23
text: He increaseth the nations, and he destroyeth them: He enlargeth the nations, and he leadeth them captive.

title: Job 12:24
text: He taketh away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, And causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

title: Job 12:25
text: They grope in the dark without light; And he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.

title: Job 13:1
text: Lo, mine eye hath seen all [this], Mine ear hath heard and understood it.

title: Job 13:2
text: What ye know, [the same] do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.

title: Job 13:3
text: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, And I desire to reason with God.

title: Job 13:4
text: But ye are forgers of lies; Ye are all physicians of no value.

title: Job 13:5
text: Oh that ye would altogether hold your peace! And it would be your wisdom.

title: Job 13:6
text: Hear now my reasoning, And hearken to the pleadings of my lips.

title: Job 13:7
text: Will ye speak unrighteously for God, And talk deceitfully for him?

title: Job 13:8
text: Will ye show partiality to him? Will ye contend for God?

title: Job 13:9
text: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceiveth a man, will ye deceive him?

title: Job 13:10
text: He will surely reprove you, If ye do secretly show partiality.

title: Job 13:11
text: Shall not his majesty make you afraid, And his dread fall upon you?

title: Job 13:12
text: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes, Your defences are defences of clay.

title: Job 13:13
text: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak; And let come on me what will.

title: Job 13:14
text: Wherefore should I take my flesh in my teeth, And put my life in my hand?

title: Job 13:15
text: Behold, he will slay me; I have no hope: Nevertheless I will maintain my ways before him.

title: Job 13:16
text: This also shall be my salvation, That a godless man shall not come before him.

title: Job 13:17
text: Hear diligently my speech, And let my declaration be in your ears.

title: Job 13:18
text: Behold now, I have set my cause in order; I know that I am righteous.

title: Job 13:19
text: Who is he that will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and give up the ghost.

title: Job 13:20
text: Only do not two things unto me; Then will I not hide myself from thy face:

title: Job 13:21
text: Withdraw thy hand far from me; And let not thy terror make me afraid.

title: Job 13:22
text: Then call thou, and I will answer; Or let me speak, and answer thou me.

title: Job 13:23
text: How many are mine iniquities and sins? Make me to know my transgression and my sin.

title: Job 13:24
text: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, And holdest me for thine enemy?

title: Job 13:25
text: Wilt thou harass a driven leaf? And wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?

title: Job 13:26
text: For thou writest bitter things against me, And makest me to inherit the iniquities of my youth:

title: Job 13:27
text: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, And markest all my paths; Thou settest a bound to the soles of my feet:

title: Job 13:28
text: Though I am like a rotten thing that consumeth, Like a garment that is moth-eaten.

title: Job 14:1
text: Man, that is born of a woman, Is of few days, and full of trouble.

title: Job 14:2
text: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: He fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.

title: Job 14:3
text: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such a one, And bringest me into judgment with thee?

title: Job 14:4
text: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.

title: Job 14:5
text: Seeing his days are determined, The number of his months is with thee, And thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;

title: Job 14:6
text: Look away from him, that he may rest, Till he shall accomplish, as a hireling, his day.

title: Job 14:7
text: For there is hope of a tree, If it be cut down, that it will sprout again, And that the tender branch thereof will not cease.

title: Job 14:8
text: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, And the stock thereof die in the ground;

title: Job 14:9
text: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, And put forth boughs like a plant.

title: Job 14:10
text: But man dieth, and is laid low: Yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?

title: Job 14:11
text: [ As] the waters fail from the sea, And the river wasteth and drieth up;

title: Job 14:12
text: So man lieth down and riseth not: Till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, Nor be roused out of their sleep.

title: Job 14:13
text: Oh that thou wouldest hide me in Sheol, That thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, That thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!

title: Job 14:14
text: If a man die, shall he live [again] ? All the days of my warfare would I wait, Till my release should come.

title: Job 14:15
text: Thou wouldest call, and I would answer thee: Thou wouldest have a desire to the work of thy hands.

title: Job 14:16
text: But now thou numberest my steps: Dost thou not watch over my sin?

title: Job 14:17
text: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, And thou fastenest up mine iniquity.

title: Job 14:18
text: But the mountain falling cometh to nought; And the rock is removed out of its place;

title: Job 14:19
text: The waters wear the stones; The overflowings thereof wash away the dust of the earth: So thou destroyest the hope of man.

title: Job 14:20
text: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth; Thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.

title: Job 14:21
text: His sons come to honor, and he knoweth it not; And they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.

title: Job 14:22
text: But his flesh upon him hath pain, And his soul within him mourneth.

title: Job 15:1
text: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

title: Job 15:2
text: Should a wise man make answer with vain knowledge, And fill himself with the east wind?

title: Job 15:3
text: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, Or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?

title: Job 15:4
text: Yea, thou doest away with fear, And hinderest devotion before God.

title: Job 15:5
text: For thine iniquity teacheth thy mouth, And thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.

title: Job 15:6
text: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I; Yea, thine own lips testify against thee.

title: Job 15:7
text: Art thou the first man that was born? Or wast thou brought forth before the hills?

title: Job 15:8
text: Hast thou heard the secret counsel of God? And dost thou limit wisdom to thyself?

title: Job 15:9
text: What knowest thou, that we know not? What understandest thou, which is not in us?

title: Job 15:10
text: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, Much elder than thy father.

title: Job 15:11
text: Are the consolations of God too small for thee, Even the word that is gentle toward thee?

title: Job 15:12
text: Why doth thy heart carry thee away? And why do thine eyes flash,

title: Job 15:13
text: That against God thou turnest thy spirit, And lettest words go out of thy mouth?

title: Job 15:14
text: What is man, that he should be clean? And he that is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

title: Job 15:15
text: Behold, he putteth no trust in his holy ones; Yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight:

title: Job 15:16
text: How much less one that is abominable and corrupt, A man that drinketh iniquity like water!

title: Job 15:17
text: I will show thee, hear thou me; And that which I have seen I will declare:

title: Job 15:18
text: (Which wise men have told From their fathers, and have not hid it;

title: Job 15:19
text: Unto whom alone the land was given, And no stranger passed among them):

title: Job 15:20
text: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, Even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

title: Job 15:21
text: A sound of terrors is in his ears; In prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.

title: Job 15:22
text: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, And he is waited for of the sword.

title: Job 15:23
text: He wandereth abroad for bread, [saying], Where is it? He knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

title: Job 15:24
text: Distress and anguish make him afraid; They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

title: Job 15:25
text: Because he hath stretched out his hand against God, And behaveth himself proudly against the Almighty;

title: Job 15:26
text: He runneth upon him with a [stiff] neck, With the thick bosses of his bucklers;

title: Job 15:27
text: Because he hath covered his face with his fatness, And gathered fat upon his loins;

title: Job 15:28
text: And he hath dwelt in desolate cities, In houses which no man inhabited, Which were ready to become heaps;

title: Job 15:29
text: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, Neither shall their possessions be extended on the earth.

title: Job 15:30
text: He shall not depart out of darkness; The flame shall dry up his branches, And by the breath of [God's] mouth shall he go away.

title: Job 15:31
text: Let him not trust in vanity, deceiving himself; For vanity shall be his recompense.

title: Job 15:32
text: It shall be accomplished before his time, And his branch shall not be green.

title: Job 15:33
text: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, And shall cast off his flower as the olive-tree.

title: Job 15:34
text: For the company of the godless shall be barren, And fire shall consume the tents of bribery.

title: Job 15:35
text: They conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity, And their heart prepareth deceit.

title: Job 16:1
text: Then Job answered and said,

title: Job 16:2
text: I have heard many such things: Miserable comforters are ye all.

title: Job 16:3
text: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provoketh thee that thou answerest?

title: Job 16:4
text: I also could speak as ye do; If your soul were in my soul's stead, I could join words together against you, And shake my head at you.

title: Job 16:5
text: [ But] I would strengthen you with my mouth, And the solace of my lips would assuage [your grief] .

title: Job 16:6
text: Though I speak, my grief is not assuaged; And though I forbear, what am I eased?

title: Job 16:7
text: But now he hath made me weary: Thou hast made desolate all my company.

title: Job 16:8
text: And thou hast laid fast hold on me, [which] is a witness [against me] : And my leanness riseth up against me, It testifieth to my face.

title: Job 16:9
text: He hath torn me in his wrath, and persecuted me; He hath gnashed upon me with his teeth: Mine adversary sharpeneth his eyes upon me.

title: Job 16:10
text: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; They have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully: They gather themselves together against me.

title: Job 16:11
text: God delivereth me to the ungodly, And casteth me into the hands of the wicked.

title: Job 16:12
text: I was at ease, and he brake me asunder; Yea, he hath taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces: He hath also set me up for his mark.

title: Job 16:13
text: His archers compass me round about; He cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; He poureth out my gall upon the ground.

title: Job 16:14
text: He breaketh me with breach upon breach; He runneth upon me like a giant.

title: Job 16:15
text: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, And have laid my horn in the dust.

title: Job 16:16
text: My face is red with weeping, And on my eyelids is the shadow of death;

title: Job 16:17
text: Although there is no violence in my hands, And my prayer is pure.

title: Job 16:18
text: O earth, cover not thou my blood, And let my cry have no [resting] -place.

title: Job 16:19
text: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven, And he that voucheth for me is on high.

title: Job 16:20
text: My friends scoff at me: [But] mine eye poureth out tears unto God,

title: Job 16:21
text: That he would maintain the right of a man with God, And of a son of man with his neighbor!

title: Job 16:22
text: For when a few years are come, I shall go the way whence I shall not return.

title: Job 17:1
text: My spirit is consumed, my days are extinct, The grave is [ready] for me.

title: Job 17:2
text: Surely there are mockers with me, And mine eye dwelleth upon their provocation.

title: Job 17:3
text: Give now a pledge, be surety for me with thyself; Who is there that will strike hands with me?

title: Job 17:4
text: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: Therefore shalt thou not exalt [them] .

title: Job 17:5
text: He that denounceth his friends for a prey, Even the eyes of his children shall fail.

title: Job 17:6
text: But he hath made me a byword of the people; And they spit in my face.

title: Job 17:7
text: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, And all my members are as a shadow.

title: Job 17:8
text: Upright men shall be astonished at this, And the innocent shall stir up himself against the godless.

title: Job 17:9
text: Yet shall the righteous hold on his way, And he that hath clean hands shall wax stronger and stronger.

title: Job 17:10
text: But as for you all, come on now again; And I shall not find a wise man among you.

title: Job 17:11
text: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, Even the thoughts of my heart.

title: Job 17:12
text: They change the night into day: The light, [say they], is near unto the darkness.

title: Job 17:13
text: If I look for Sheol as my house; If I have spread my couch in the darkness;

title: Job 17:14
text: If I have said to corruption, Thou art my father; To the worm, [Thou art] my mother, and my sister;

title: Job 17:15
text: Where then is my hope? And as for my hope, who shall see it?

title: Job 17:16
text: It shall go down to the bars of Sheol, When once there is rest in the dust.

title: Job 18:1
text: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

title: Job 18:2
text: How long will ye hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.

title: Job 18:3
text: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, [And] are become unclean in your sight?

title: Job 18:4
text: Thou that tearest thyself in thine anger, Shall the earth be forsaken for thee? Or shall the rock be removed out of its place?

title: Job 18:5
text: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, And the spark of his fire shall not shine.

title: Job 18:6
text: The light shall be dark in his tent, And his lamp above him shall be put out.

title: Job 18:7
text: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, And his own counsel shall cast him down.

title: Job 18:8
text: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, And he walketh upon the toils.

title: Job 18:9
text: A gin shall take [him] by the heel, [And] a snare shall lay hold on him.

title: Job 18:10
text: A noose is hid for him in the ground, And a trap for him in the way.

title: Job 18:11
text: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, And shall chase him at his heels.

title: Job 18:12
text: His strength shall be hunger-bitten, And calamity shall be ready at his side.

title: Job 18:13
text: The members of his body shall be devoured, [Yea], the first-born of death shall devour his members.

title: Job 18:14
text: He shall be rooted out of his tent where he trusteth; And he shall be brought to the king of terrors.

title: Job 18:15
text: There shall dwell in his tent that which is none of his: Brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.

title: Job 18:16
text: His roots shall be dried up beneath, And above shall his branch be cut off.

title: Job 18:17
text: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, And he shall have no name in the street.

title: Job 18:18
text: He shall be driven from light into darkness, And chased out of the world.

title: Job 18:19
text: He shall have neither son nor son's son among his people, Nor any remaining where he sojourned.

title: Job 18:20
text: They that come after shall be astonished at his day, As they that went before were affrighted.

title: Job 18:21
text: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous, And this is the place of him that knoweth not God.

title: Job 19:1
text: Then Job answered and said,

title: Job 19:2
text: How long will ye vex my soul, And break me in pieces with words?

title: Job 19:3
text: These ten times have ye reproached me: Ye are not ashamed that ye deal hardly with me.

title: Job 19:4
text: And be it indeed that I have erred, Mine error remaineth with myself.

title: Job 19:5
text: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, And plead against me my reproach;

title: Job 19:6
text: Know now that God hath subverted me [in my cause], And hath compassed me with his net.

title: Job 19:7
text: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry for help, but there is no justice.

title: Job 19:8
text: He hath walled up my way that I cannot pass, And hath set darkness in my paths.

title: Job 19:9
text: He hath stripped me of my glory, And taken the crown from my head.

title: Job 19:10
text: He hath broken me down on every side, and I am gone; And my hope hath he plucked up like a tree.

title: Job 19:11
text: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, And he counteth me unto him as [one of] his adversaries.

title: Job 19:12
text: His troops come on together, And cast up their way against me, And encamp round about my tent.

title: Job 19:13
text: He hath put my brethren far from me, And mine acquaintance are wholly estranged from me.

title: Job 19:14
text: My kinsfolk have failed, And my familiar friends have forgotten me.

title: Job 19:15
text: They that dwell in my house, and my maids, count me for a stranger; I am an alien in their sight.

title: Job 19:16
text: I call unto my servant, and he giveth me no answer, [Though] I entreat him with my mouth.

title: Job 19:17
text: My breath is strange to my wife, And my supplication to the children of mine own mother.

title: Job 19:18
text: Even young children despise me; If I arise, they speak against me.

title: Job 19:19
text: All my familiar friends abhor me, And they whom I loved are turned against me.

title: Job 19:20
text: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, And I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.

title: Job 19:21
text: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; For the hand of God hath touched me.

title: Job 19:22
text: Why do ye persecute me as God, And are not satisfied with my flesh?

title: Job 19:23
text: Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!

title: Job 19:24
text: That with an iron pen and lead They were graven in the rock for ever!

title: Job 19:25
text: But as for me I know that my Redeemer liveth, And at last he will stand up upon the earth:

title: Job 19:26
text: And after my skin, [even] this [body], is destroyed, Then without my flesh shall I see God;

title: Job 19:27
text: Whom I, even I, shall see, on my side, And mine eyes shall behold, and not as a stranger. My heart is consumed within me.

title: Job 19:28
text: If ye say, How we will persecute him! And that the root of the matter is found in me;

title: Job 19:29
text: Be ye afraid of the sword: For wrath [bringeth] the punishments of the sword, That ye may know there is a judgment.

title: Job 20:1
text: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

title: Job 20:2
text: Therefore do my thoughts give answer to me, Even by reason of my haste that is in me.

title: Job 20:3
text: I have heard the reproof which putteth me to shame; And the spirit of my understanding answereth me.

title: Job 20:4
text: Knowest thou [not] this of old time, Since man was placed upon earth,

title: Job 20:5
text: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, And the joy of the godless but for a moment?

title: Job 20:6
text: Though his height mount up to the heavens, And his head reach unto the clouds;

title: Job 20:7
text: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: They that have seen him shall say, Where is he?

title: Job 20:8
text: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: Yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.

title: Job 20:9
text: The eye which saw him shall see him no more; Neither shall his place any more behold him.

title: Job 20:10
text: His children shall seek the favor of the poor, And his hands shall give back his wealth.

title: Job 20:11
text: His bones are full of his youth, But it shall lie down with him in the dust.

title: Job 20:12
text: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, Though he hide it under his tongue,

title: Job 20:13
text: Though he spare it, and will not let it go, But keep it still within his mouth;

title: Job 20:14
text: Yet his food in his bowels is turned, It is the gall of asps within him.

title: Job 20:15
text: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again; God will cast them out of his belly.

title: Job 20:16
text: He shall suck the poison of asps: The viper's tongue shall slay him.

title: Job 20:17
text: He shall not look upon the rivers, The flowing streams of honey and butter.

title: Job 20:18
text: That which he labored for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down; According to the substance that he hath gotten, he shall not rejoice.

title: Job 20:19
text: For he hath oppressed and forsaken the poor; He hath violently taken away a house, and he shall not build it up.

title: Job 20:20
text: Because he knew no quietness within him, He shall not save aught of that wherein he delighteth.

title: Job 20:21
text: There was nothing left that he devoured not; Therefore his prosperity shall not endure.

title: Job 20:22
text: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: The hand of every one that is in misery shall come upon him.

title: Job 20:23
text: When he is about to fill his belly, [God] will cast the fierceness of his wrath upon him, And will rain it upon him while he is eating.

title: Job 20:24
text: He shall flee from the iron weapon, And the bow of brass shall strike him through.

title: Job 20:25
text: He draweth it forth, and it cometh out of his body; Yea, the glittering point cometh out of his gall: Terrors are upon him.

title: Job 20:26
text: All darkness is laid up for his treasures: A fire not blown [by man] shall devour him; It shall consume that which is left in his tent.

title: Job 20:27
text: The heavens shall reveal his iniquity, And the earth shall rise up against him.

title: Job 20:28
text: The increase of his house shall depart; [His goods] shall flow away in the day of his wrath.

title: Job 20:29
text: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, And the heritage appointed unto him by God.

title: Job 21:1
text: Then Job answered and said,

title: Job 21:2
text: Hear diligently my speech; And let this be your consolations.

title: Job 21:3
text: Suffer me, and I also will speak; And after that I have spoken, mock on.

title: Job 21:4
text: As for me, is my complaint to man? And why should I not be impatient?

title: Job 21:5
text: Mark me, and be astonished, And lay your hand upon your mouth.

title: Job 21:6
text: Even when I remember I am troubled, And horror taketh hold on my flesh.

title: Job 21:7
text: Wherefore do the wicked live, Become old, yea, wax mighty in power?

title: Job 21:8
text: Their seed is established with them in their sight, And their offspring before their eyes.

title: Job 21:9
text: Their houses are safe from fear, Neither is the rod of God upon them.

title: Job 21:10
text: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; Their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.

title: Job 21:11
text: They send forth their little ones like a flock, And their children dance.

title: Job 21:12
text: They sing to the timbrel and harp, And rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

title: Job 21:13
text: They spend their days in prosperity, And in a moment they go down to Sheol.

title: Job 21:14
text: And they say unto God, Depart from us; For we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.

title: Job 21:15
text: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? And what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?

title: Job 21:16
text: Lo, their prosperity is not in their hand: The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

title: Job 21:17
text: How oft is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out? That their calamity cometh upon them? That [God] distributeth sorrows in his anger?

title: Job 21:18
text: That they are as stubble before the wind, And as chaff that the storm carrieth away?

title: Job 21:19
text: [Ye say], God layeth up his iniquity for his children. Let him recompense it unto himself, that he may know it:

title: Job 21:20
text: Let his own eyes see his destruction, And let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

title: Job 21:21
text: For what careth he for his house after him, When the number of his months is cut off?

title: Job 21:22
text: Shall any teach God knowledge, Seeing he judgeth those that are high?

title: Job 21:23
text: One dieth in his full strength, Being wholly at ease and quiet:

title: Job 21:24
text: His pails are full of milk, And the marrow of his bones is moistened.

title: Job 21:25
text: And another dieth in bitterness of soul, And never tasteth of good.

title: Job 21:26
text: They lie down alike in the dust, And the worm covereth them.

title: Job 21:27
text: Behold, I know your thoughts, And the devices wherewith ye would wrong me.

title: Job 21:28
text: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? And where is the tent wherein the wicked dwelt?

title: Job 21:29
text: Have ye not asked wayfaring men? And do ye not know their evidences,

title: Job 21:30
text: That the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity? That they are led forth to the day of wrath?

title: Job 21:31
text: Who shall declare his way to his face? And who shall repay him what he hath done?

title: Job 21:32
text: Yet shall he be borne to the grave, And men shall keep watch over the tomb.

title: Job 21:33
text: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, And all men shall draw after him, As there were innumerable before him.

title: Job 21:34
text: How then comfort ye me in vain, Seeing in your answers there remaineth [only] falsehood?

title: Job 22:1
text: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

title: Job 22:2
text: Can a man be profitable unto God? Surely he that is wise is profitable unto himself.

title: Job 22:3
text: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? Or is it gain [to him], that thou makest thy ways perfect?

title: Job 22:4
text: Is it for thy fear [of him] that he reproveth thee, That he entereth with thee into judgment?

title: Job 22:5
text: Is not thy wickedness great? Neither is there any end to thine iniquities.

title: Job 22:6
text: For thou hast taken pledges of thy brother for nought, And stripped the naked of their clothing.

title: Job 22:7
text: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, And thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

title: Job 22:8
text: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; And the honorable man, he dwelt in it.

title: Job 22:9
text: Thou hast sent widows away empty, And the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

title: Job 22:10
text: Therefore snares are round about thee, And sudden fear troubleth thee,

title: Job 22:11
text: Or darkness, so that thou canst not see, And abundance of waters cover thee.

title: Job 22:12
text: Is not God in the height of heaven? And behold the height of the stars, how high they are!

title: Job 22:13
text: And thou sayest, What doth God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

title: Job 22:14
text: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he seeth not; And he walketh on the vault of heaven.

title: Job 22:15
text: Wilt thou keep the old way Which wicked men have trodden?

title: Job 22:16
text: Who were snatched away before their time, Whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

title: Job 22:17
text: Who said unto God, Depart from us; And, What can the Almighty do for us?

title: Job 22:18
text: Yet he filled their houses with good things: But the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

title: Job 22:19
text: The righteous see it, and are glad; And the innocent laugh them to scorn,

title: Job 22:20
text: [ Saying], Surely they that did rise up against us are cut off, And the remnant of them the fire hath consumed.

title: Job 22:21
text: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: Thereby good shall come unto thee.

title: Job 22:22
text: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, And lay up his words in thy heart.

title: Job 22:23
text: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, If thou put away unrighteousness far from thy tents.

title: Job 22:24
text: And lay thou [thy] treasure in the dust, And [the gold of] Ophir among the stones of the brooks;

title: Job 22:25
text: And the Almighty will be thy treasure, And precious silver unto thee.

title: Job 22:26
text: For then shalt thou delight thyself in the Almighty, And shalt lift up thy face unto God.

title: Job 22:27
text: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he will hear thee; And thou shalt pay thy vows.

title: Job 22:28
text: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee; And light shall shine upon thy ways.

title: Job 22:29
text: When they cast [thee] down, thou shalt say, [There is] lifting up; And the humble person he will save.

title: Job 22:30
text: He will deliver [even] him that is not innocent: Yea, he shall be delivered through the cleanness of thy hands.

title: Job 23:1
text: Then Job answered and said,

title: Job 23:2
text: Even to-day is my complaint rebellious: My stroke is heavier than my groaning.

title: Job 23:3
text: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

title: Job 23:4
text: I would set my cause in order before him, And fill my mouth with arguments.

title: Job 23:5
text: I would know the words which he would answer me, And understand what he would say unto me.

title: Job 23:6
text: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? Nay; but he would give heed unto me.

title: Job 23:7
text: There the upright might reason with him; So should I be delivered for ever from my judge.

title: Job 23:8
text: Behold, I go forward, but he is not [there] ; And backward, but I cannot perceive him;

title: Job 23:9
text: On the left hand, when he doth work, but I cannot behold him; He hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him.

title: Job 23:10
text: But he knoweth the way that I take; When he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

title: Job 23:11
text: My foot hath held fast to his steps; His way have I kept, and turned not aside.

title: Job 23:12
text: I have not gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

title: Job 23:13
text: But he is in one [mind], and who can turn him? And what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.

title: Job 23:14
text: For he performeth that which is appointed for me: And many such things are with him.

title: Job 23:15
text: Therefore am I terrified at his presence; When I consider, I am afraid of him.

title: Job 23:16
text: For God hath made my heart faint, And the Almighty hath terrified me;

title: Job 23:17
text: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, Neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.

title: Job 24:1
text: Why are times not laid up by the Almighty? And why do not they that know him see his days?

title: Job 24:2
text: There are that remove the landmarks; They violently take away flocks, and feed them.

title: Job 24:3
text: They drive away the ass of the fatherless; They take the widow's ox for a pledge.

title: Job 24:4
text: They turn the needy out of the way: The poor of the earth all hide themselves.

title: Job 24:5
text: Behold, as wild asses in the desert They go forth to their work, seeking diligently for food; The wilderness [yieldeth] them bread for their children.

title: Job 24:6
text: They cut their provender in the field; And they glean the vintage of the wicked.

title: Job 24:7
text: They lie all night naked without clothing, And have no covering in the cold.

title: Job 24:8
text: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, And embrace the rock for want of a shelter.

title: Job 24:9
text: There are that pluck the fatherless from the breast, And take a pledge of the poor;

title: Job 24:10
text: [ So that] they go about naked without clothing, And being hungry they carry the sheaves.

title: Job 24:11
text: They make oil within the walls of these men; They tread [their] winepresses, and suffer thirst.

title: Job 24:12
text: From out of the populous city men groan, And the soul of the wounded crieth out: Yet God regardeth not the folly.

title: Job 24:13
text: These are of them that rebel against the light; They know not the ways thereof, Nor abide in the paths thereof.

title: Job 24:14
text: The murderer riseth with the light; He killeth the poor and needy; And in the night he is as a thief.

title: Job 24:15
text: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, Saying, No eye shall see me: And he disguiseth his face.

title: Job 24:16
text: In the dark they dig through houses: They shut themselves up in the day-time; They know not the light.

title: Job 24:17
text: For the morning is to all of them as thick darkness; For they know the terrors of the thick darkness.

title: Job 24:18
text: Swiftly they [pass away] upon the face of the waters; Their portion is cursed in the earth: They turn not into the way of the vineyards.

title: Job 24:19
text: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: [So doth] Sheol [those that] have sinned.

title: Job 24:20
text: The womb shall forget him; The worm shall feed sweetly on him; He shall be no more remembered; And unrighteousness shall be broken as a tree.

title: Job 24:21
text: He devoureth the barren that beareth not, And doeth not good to the widow.

title: Job 24:22
text: Yet [God] preserveth the mighty by his power: He riseth up that hath no assurance of life.

title: Job 24:23
text: [ God] giveth them to be in security, and they rest thereon; And his eyes are upon their ways.

title: Job 24:24
text: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone; Yea, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, And are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.

title: Job 24:25
text: And if it be not so now, who will prove me a liar, And make my speech nothing worth?

title: Job 25:1
text: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

title: Job 25:2
text: Dominion and fear are with him; He maketh peace in his high places.

title: Job 25:3
text: Is there any number of his armies? And upon whom doth not his light arise?

title: Job 25:4
text: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?

title: Job 25:5
text: Behold, even the moon hath no brightness, And the stars are not pure in his sight:

title: Job 25:6
text: How much less man, that is a worm! And the son of man, that is a worm!

title: Job 26:1
text: Then Job answered and said,

title: Job 26:2
text: How hast thou helped him that is without power! How hast thou saved the arm that hath no strength!

title: Job 26:3
text: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom, And plentifully declared sound knowledge!

title: Job 26:4
text: To whom hast thou uttered words? And whose spirit came forth from thee?

title: Job 26:5
text: They that are deceased tremble Beneath the waters and the inhabitants thereof.

title: Job 26:6
text: Sheol is naked before [God], And Abaddon hath no covering.

title: Job 26:7
text: He stretcheth out the north over empty space, And hangeth the earth upon nothing.

title: Job 26:8
text: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; And the cloud is not rent under them.

title: Job 26:9
text: He incloseth the face of his throne, And spreadeth his cloud upon it.

title: Job 26:10
text: He hath described a boundary upon the face of the waters, Unto the confines of light and darkness.

title: Job 26:11
text: The pillars of heaven tremble And are astonished at his rebuke.

title: Job 26:12
text: He stirreth up the sea with his power, And by his understanding he smiteth through Rahab.

title: Job 26:13
text: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished; His hand hath pierced the swift serpent.

title: Job 26:14
text: Lo, these are but the outskirts of his ways: And how small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?

title: Job 27:1
text: And Job again took up his parable, and said,

title: Job 27:2
text: As God liveth, who hath taken away my right, And the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul:

title: Job 27:3
text: (For my life is yet whole in me, And the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

title: Job 27:4
text: Surely my lips shall not speak unrighteousness, Neither shall my tongue utter deceit.

title: Job 27:5
text: Far be it from me that I should justify you: Till I die I will not put away mine integrity from me.

title: Job 27:6
text: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: My heart shall not reproach [me] so long as I live.

title: Job 27:7
text: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, And let him that riseth up against me be as the unrighteous.

title: Job 27:8
text: For what is the hope of the godless, though he get him gain, When God taketh away his soul?

title: Job 27:9
text: Will God hear his cry, When trouble cometh upon him?

title: Job 27:10
text: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, And call upon God at all times?

title: Job 27:11
