text: I will teach you concerning the hand of God; That which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

title: Job 27:12
text: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; Why then are ye become altogether vain?

title: Job 27:13
text: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, And the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty:

title: Job 27:14
text: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword; And his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

title: Job 27:15
text: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death, And his widows shall make no lamentation.

title: Job 27:16
text: Though he heap up silver as the dust, And prepare raiment as the clay;

title: Job 27:17
text: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, And the innocent shall divide the silver.

title: Job 27:18
text: He buildeth his house as the moth, And as a booth which the keeper maketh.

title: Job 27:19
text: He lieth down rich, but he shall not be gathered [to his fathers] ; He openeth his eyes, and he is not.

title: Job 27:20
text: Terrors overtake him like waters; A tempest stealeth him away in the night.

title: Job 27:21
text: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth; And it sweepeth him out of his place.

title: Job 27:22
text: For [God] shall hurl at him, and not spare: He would fain flee out of his hand.

title: Job 27:23
text: Men shall clap their hands at him, And shall hiss him out of his place.

title: Job 28:1
text: Surely there is a mine for silver, And a place for gold which they refine.

title: Job 28:2
text: Iron is taken out of the earth, And copper is molten out of the stone.

title: Job 28:3
text: [ Man] setteth an end to darkness, And searcheth out, to the furthest bound, The stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

title: Job 28:4
text: He breaketh open a shaft away from where men sojourn; They are forgotten of the foot; They hang afar from men, they swing to and fro.

title: Job 28:5
text: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread; And underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

title: Job 28:6
text: The stones thereof are the place of sapphires, And it hath dust of gold.

title: Job 28:7
text: That path no bird of prey knoweth, Neither hath the falcon's eye seen it:

title: Job 28:8
text: The proud beasts have not trodden it, Nor hath the fierce lion passed thereby.

title: Job 28:9
text: He putteth forth his hand upon the flinty rock; He overturneth the mountains by the roots.

title: Job 28:10
text: He cutteth out channels among the rocks; And his eye seeth every precious thing.

title: Job 28:11
text: He bindeth the streams that they trickle not; And the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.

title: Job 28:12
text: But where shall wisdom be found? And where is the place of understanding?

title: Job 28:13
text: Man knoweth not the price thereof; Neither is it found in the land of the living.

title: Job 28:14
text: The deep saith, It is not in me; And the sea saith, It is not with me.

title: Job 28:15
text: It cannot be gotten for gold, Neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.

title: Job 28:16
text: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, With the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

title: Job 28:17
text: Gold and glass cannot equal it, Neither shall it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

title: Job 28:18
text: No mention shall be made of coral or of crystal: Yea, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

title: Job 28:19
text: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, Neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

title: Job 28:20
text: Whence then cometh wisdom? And where is the place of understanding?

title: Job 28:21
text: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, And kept close from the birds of the heavens.

title: Job 28:22
text: Destruction and Death say, We have heard a rumor thereof with our ears.

title: Job 28:23
text: God understandeth the way thereof, And he knoweth the place thereof.

title: Job 28:24
text: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, And seeth under the whole heaven;

title: Job 28:25
text: To make a weight for the wind: Yea, he meteth out the waters by measure.

title: Job 28:26
text: When he made a decree for the rain, And a way for the lightning of the thunder;

title: Job 28:27
text: Then did he see it, and declare it; He established it, yea, and searched it out.

title: Job 28:28
text: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; And to depart from evil is understanding.

title: Job 29:1
text: And Job again took up his parable, and said,

title: Job 29:2
text: Oh that I were as in the months of old, As in the days when God watched over me;

title: Job 29:3
text: When his lamp shined upon my head, And by his light I walked through darkness;

title: Job 29:4
text: As I was in the ripeness of my days, When the friendship of God was upon my tent;

title: Job 29:5
text: When the Almighty was yet with me, And my children were about me;

title: Job 29:6
text: When my steps were washed with butter, And the rock poured me out streams of oil!

title: Job 29:7
text: When I went forth to the gate unto the city, When I prepared my seat in the street,

title: Job 29:8
text: The young men saw me and hid themselves, And the aged rose up and stood;

title: Job 29:9
text: The princes refrained from talking, And laid their hand on their mouth;

title: Job 29:10
text: The voice of the nobles was hushed, And their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.

title: Job 29:11
text: For when the ear heard [me], then it blessed me; And when the eye saw [me], it gave witness unto me:

title: Job 29:12
text: Because I delivered the poor that cried, The fatherless also, that had none to help him.

title: Job 29:13
text: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me; And I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.

title: Job 29:14
text: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

title: Job 29:15
text: I was eyes to the blind, And feet was I to the lame.

title: Job 29:16
text: I was a father to the needy: And the cause of him that I knew not I searched out.

title: Job 29:17
text: And I brake the jaws of the unrighteous, And plucked the prey out of his teeth.

title: Job 29:18
text: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, And I shall multiply my days as the sand:

title: Job 29:19
text: My root is spread out to the waters, And the dew lieth all night upon my branch;

title: Job 29:20
text: My glory is fresh in me, And my bow is renewed in my hand.

title: Job 29:21
text: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, And kept silence for my counsel.

title: Job 29:22
text: After my words they spake not again; And my speech distilled upon them.

title: Job 29:23
text: And they waited for me as for the rain; And they opened their mouth wide [as] for the latter rain.

title: Job 29:24
text: I smiled on them, when they had no confidence; And the light of my countenance they cast not down.

title: Job 29:25
text: I chose out their way, and sat [as] chief, And dwelt as a king in the army, As one that comforteth the mourners.

title: Job 30:1
text: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, Whose fathers I disdained to set with the dogs of my flock.

title: Job 30:2
text: Yea, the strength of their hands, whereto should it profit me? Men in whom ripe age is perished.

title: Job 30:3
text: They are gaunt with want and famine; They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of wasteness and desolation.

title: Job 30:4
text: They pluck salt-wort by the bushes; And the roots of the broom are their food.

title: Job 30:5
text: They are driven forth from the midst [of men] ; They cry after them as after a thief;

title: Job 30:6
text: So that they dwell in frightful valleys, In holes of the earth and of the rocks.

title: Job 30:7
text: Among the bushes they bray; Under the nettles they are gathered together.

title: Job 30:8
text: [ They are] children of fools, yea, children of base men; They were scourged out of the land.

title: Job 30:9
text: And now I am become their song, Yea, I am a byword unto them.

title: Job 30:10
text: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, And spare not to spit in my face.

title: Job 30:11
text: For he hath loosed his cord, and afflicted me; And they have cast off the bridle before me.

title: Job 30:12
text: Upon my right hand rise the rabble; They thrust aside my feet, And they cast up against me their ways of destruction.

title: Job 30:13
text: They mar my path, They set forward my calamity, [Even] men that have no helper.

title: Job 30:14
text: As through a wide breach they come: In the midst of the ruin they roll themselves [upon me] .

title: Job 30:15
text: Terrors are turned upon me; They chase mine honor as the wind; And my welfare is passed away as a cloud.

title: Job 30:16
text: And now my soul is poured out within me; Days of affliction have taken hold upon me.

title: Job 30:17
text: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, And the [pains] that gnaw me take no rest.

title: Job 30:18
text: By [God's] great force is my garment disfigured; It bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.

title: Job 30:19
text: He hath cast me into the mire, And I am become like dust and ashes.

title: Job 30:20
text: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not answer me: I stand up, and thou gazest at me.

title: Job 30:21
text: Thou art turned to be cruel to me; With the might of thy hand thou persecutest me.

title: Job 30:22
text: Thou liftest me up to the wind, thou causest me to ride [upon it] ; And thou dissolvest me in the storm.

title: Job 30:23
text: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, And to the house appointed for all living.

title: Job 30:24
text: Howbeit doth not one stretch out the hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

title: Job 30:25
text: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? Was not my soul grieved for the needy?

title: Job 30:26
text: When I looked for good, then evil came; And when I waited for light, there came darkness.

title: Job 30:27
text: My heart is troubled, and resteth not; Days of affliction are come upon me.

title: Job 30:28
text: I go mourning without the sun: I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

title: Job 30:29
text: I am a brother to jackals, And a companion to ostriches.

title: Job 30:30
text: My skin is black, [and falleth] from me, And my bones are burned with heat.

title: Job 30:31
text: Therefore is my harp [turned] to mourning, And my pipe into the voice of them that weep.

title: Job 31:1
text: I made a covenant with mine eyes; How then should I look upon a virgin?

title: Job 31:2
text: For what is the portion from God above, And the heritage from the Almighty on high?

title: Job 31:3
text: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, And disaster to the workers of iniquity?

title: Job 31:4
text: Doth not he see my ways, And number all my steps?

title: Job 31:5
text: If I have walked with falsehood, And my foot hath hasted to deceit

title: Job 31:6
text: (Let me be weighed in an even balance, That God may know mine integrity);

title: Job 31:7
text: If my step hath turned out of the way, And my heart walked after mine eyes, And if any spot hath cleaved to my hands:

title: Job 31:8
text: Then let me sow, and let another eat; Yea, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

title: Job 31:9
text: If my heart hath been enticed unto a woman, And I have laid wait at my neighbor's door;

title: Job 31:10
text: Then let my wife grind unto another, And let others bow down upon her.

title: Job 31:11
text: For that were a heinous crime; Yea, it were an iniquity to be punished by the judges:

title: Job 31:12
text: For it is a fire that consumeth unto Destruction, And would root out all mine increase.

title: Job 31:13
text: If I have despised the cause of my man-servant or of my maid-servant, When they contended with me;

title: Job 31:14
text: What then shall I do when God riseth up? And when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?

title: Job 31:15
text: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? And did not one fashion us in the womb?

title: Job 31:16
text: If I have withheld the poor from [their] desire, Or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

title: Job 31:17
text: Or have eaten my morsel alone, And the fatherless hath not eaten thereof

title: Job 31:18
text: (Nay, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, And her have I guided from my mother's womb);

title: Job 31:19
text: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, Or that the needy had no covering;

title: Job 31:20
text: If his loins have not blessed me, And if he hath not been warmed with the fleece of my sheep;

title: Job 31:21
text: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, Because I saw my help in the gate:

title: Job 31:22
text: Then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder-blade, And mine arm be broken from the bone.

title: Job 31:23
text: For calamity from God is a terror to me, And by reason of his majesty I can do nothing.

title: Job 31:24
text: If I have made gold my hope, And have said to the fine gold, [Thou art] my confidence;

title: Job 31:25
text: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, And because my hand had gotten much;

title: Job 31:26
text: If I have beheld the sun when it shined, Or the moon walking in brightness,

title: Job 31:27
text: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, And my mouth hath kissed my hand:

title: Job 31:28
text: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judges; For I should have denied the God that is above.

title: Job 31:29
text: If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, Or lifted up myself when evil found him;

title: Job 31:30
text: (Yea, I have not suffered my mouth to sin By asking his life with a curse);

title: Job 31:31
text: If the men of my tent have not said, Who can find one that hath not been filled with his meat?

title: Job 31:32
text: (The sojourner hath not lodged in the street; But I have opened my doors to the traveller);

title: Job 31:33
text: If like Adam I have covered my transgressions, By hiding mine iniquity in my bosom,

title: Job 31:34
text: Because I feared the great multitude, And the contempt of families terrified me, So that I kept silence, and went not out of the door--

title: Job 31:35
text: Oh that I had one to hear me! (Lo, here is my signature, let the Almighty answer me); And [that I had] the indictment which mine adversary hath written!

title: Job 31:36
text: Surely I would carry it upon my shoulder; I would bind it unto me as a crown:

title: Job 31:37
text: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; As a prince would I go near unto him.

title: Job 31:38
text: If my land crieth out against me, And the furrows thereof weep together;

title: Job 31:39
text: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, Or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:

title: Job 31:40
text: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, And cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.

title: Job 32:1
text: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

title: Job 32:2
text: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.

title: Job 32:3
text: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

title: Job 32:4
text: Now Elihu had waited to speak unto Job, because they were elder than he.

title: Job 32:5
text: And when Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

title: Job 32:6
text: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; Wherefore I held back, and durst not show you mine opinion.

title: Job 32:7
text: I said, Days should speak, And multitude of years should teach wisdom.

title: Job 32:8
text: But there is a spirit in man, And the breath of the Almighty giveth them understanding.

title: Job 32:9
text: It is not the great that are wise, Nor the aged that understand justice.

title: Job 32:10
text: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will show mine opinion.

title: Job 32:11
text: Behold, I waited for your words, I listened for your reasonings, Whilst ye searched out what to say.

title: Job 32:12
text: Yea, I attended unto you, And, behold, there was none that convinced Job, Or that answered his words, among you.

title: Job 32:13
text: Beware lest ye say, We have found wisdom; God may vanquish him, not man:

title: Job 32:14
text: For he hath not directed his words against me; Neither will I answer him with your speeches.

title: Job 32:15
text: They are amazed, they answer no more: They have not a word to say.

title: Job 32:16
text: And shall I wait, because they speak not, Because they stand still, and answer no more?

title: Job 32:17
text: I also will answer my part, I also will show mine opinion.

title: Job 32:18
text: For I am full of words; The spirit within me constraineth me.

title: Job 32:19
text: Behold, my breast is as wine which hath no vent; Like new wine-skins it is ready to burst.

title: Job 32:20
text: I will speak, that I may be refreshed; I will open my lips and answer.

title: Job 32:21
text: Let me not, I pray you, respect any man's person; Neither will I give flattering titles unto any man.

title: Job 32:22
text: For I know not to give flattering titles; [Else] would my Maker soon take me away.

title: Job 33:1
text: Howbeit, Job, I pray thee, hear my speech, And hearken to all my words.

title: Job 33:2
text: Behold now, I have opened my mouth; My tongue hath spoken in my mouth.

title: Job 33:3
text: My words [shall utter] the uprightness of my heart; And that which my lips know they shall speak sincerely.

title: Job 33:4
text: The Spirit of God hath made me, And the breath of the Almighty giveth me life.

title: Job 33:5
text: If thou canst, answer thou me; Set [thy words] in order before me, stand forth.

title: Job 33:6
text: Behold, I am toward God even as thou art: I also am formed out of the clay.

title: Job 33:7
text: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, Neither shall my pressure be heavy upon thee.

title: Job 33:8
text: Surely thou hast spoken in my hearing, And I have heard the voice of [thy] words, [saying] ,

title: Job 33:9
text: I am clean, without transgression; I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me:

title: Job 33:10
text: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, He counteth me for his enemy:

title: Job 33:11
text: He putteth my feet in the stocks, He marketh all my paths.

title: Job 33:12
text: Behold, I will answer thee, in this thou art not just; For God is greater than man.

title: Job 33:13
text: Why dost thou strive against him, For that he giveth not account of any of his matters?

title: Job 33:14
text: For God speaketh once, Yea twice, [though man] regardeth it not.

title: Job 33:15
text: In a dream, in a vision of the night, When deep sleep falleth upon men, In slumberings upon the bed;

title: Job 33:16
text: Then he openeth the ears of men, And sealeth their instruction,

title: Job 33:17
text: That he may withdraw man [from his] purpose, And hide pride from man;

title: Job 33:18
text: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, And his life from perishing by the sword.

title: Job 33:19
text: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, And with continual strife in his bones;

title: Job 33:20
text: So that his life abhorreth bread, And his soul dainty food.

title: Job 33:21
text: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; And his bones that were not seen stick out.

title: Job 33:22
text: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the pit, And his life to the destroyers.

title: Job 33:23
text: If there be with him an angel, An interpreter, one among a thousand, To show unto man what is right for him;

title: Job 33:24
text: Then [God] is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.

title: Job 33:25
text: His flesh shall be fresher than a child's; He returneth to the days of his youth.

title: Job 33:26
text: He prayeth unto God, and he is favorable unto him, So that he seeth his face with joy: And he restoreth unto man his righteousness.

title: Job 33:27
text: He singeth before men, and saith, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, And it profited me not:

title: Job 33:28
text: He hath redeemed my soul from going into the pit, And my life shall behold the light.

title: Job 33:29
text: Lo, all these things doth God work, Twice, [yea] thrice, with a man,

title: Job 33:30
text: To bring back his soul from the pit, That he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

title: Job 33:31
text: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: Hold thy peace, and I will speak.

title: Job 33:32
text: If thou hast anything to say, answer me: Speak, for I desire to justify thee.

title: Job 33:33
text: If not, hearken thou unto me: Hold thy peace, and I will teach thee wisdom.

title: Job 34:1
text: Moreover Elihu answered and said,

title: Job 34:2
text: Hear my words, ye wise men; And give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.

title: Job 34:3
text: For the ear trieth words, As the palate tasteth food.

title: Job 34:4
text: Let us choose for us that which is right: Let us know among ourselves what is good.

title: Job 34:5
text: For Job hath said, I am righteous, And God hath taken away my right:

title: Job 34:6
text: Notwithstanding my right I am [accounted] a liar; My wound is incurable, [though I am] without transgression.

title: Job 34:7
text: What man is like Job, Who drinketh up scoffing like water,

title: Job 34:8
text: Who goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, And walketh with wicked men?

title: Job 34:9
text: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing That he should delight himself with God.

title: Job 34:10
text: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: Far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, And from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

title: Job 34:11
text: For the work of a man will he render unto him, And cause every man to find according to his ways.

title: Job 34:12
text: Yea, of a surety, God will not do wickedly, Neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

title: Job 34:13
text: Who gave him a charge over the earth? Or who hath disposed the whole world?

title: Job 34:14
text: If he set his heart upon himself, [If] he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;

title: Job 34:15
text: All flesh shall perish together, And man shall turn again unto dust.

title: Job 34:16
text: If now [thou hast] understanding, hear this: Hearken to the voice of my words.

title: Job 34:17
text: Shall even one that hateth justice govern? And wilt thou condemn him that is righteous [and] mighty?--

title: Job 34:18
text: [Him] that saith to a king, [Thou art] vile, [Or] to nobles, [Ye are] wicked;

title: Job 34:19
text: That respecteth not the persons of princes, Nor regardeth the rich more than the poor; For they all are the work of his hands.

title: Job 34:20
text: In a moment they die, even at midnight; The people are shaken and pass away, And the mighty are taken away without hand.

title: Job 34:21
text: For his eyes are upon the ways of a man, And he seeth all his goings.

title: Job 34:22
text: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, Where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

title: Job 34:23
text: For he needeth not further to consider a man, That he should go before God in judgment.

title: Job 34:24
text: He breaketh in pieces mighty men [in ways] past finding out, And setteth others in their stead.

title: Job 34:25
text: Therefore he taketh knowledge of their works; And he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

title: Job 34:26
text: He striketh them as wicked men In the open sight of others;

title: Job 34:27
text: Because they turned aside from following him, And would not have regard in any of his ways:

title: Job 34:28
text: So that they caused the cry of the poor to come unto him, And he heard the cry of the afflicted.

title: Job 34:29
text: When he giveth quietness, who then can condemn? And when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? Alike whether [it be done] unto a nation, or unto a man:

title: Job 34:30
text: That the godless man reign not, That there be none to ensnare the people.

title: Job 34:31
text: For hath any said unto God, I have borne [chastisement], I will not offend [any more] :

title: Job 34:32
text: That which I see not teach thou me: If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more?

title: Job 34:33
text: Shall his recompense be as thou wilt, that thou refusest it? For thou must choose, and not I: Therefore speak what thou knowest.

title: Job 34:34
text: Men of understanding will say unto me, Yea, every wise man that heareth me:

title: Job 34:35
text: Job speaketh without knowledge, And his words are without wisdom.

title: Job 34:36
text: Would that Job were tried unto the end, Because of his answering like wicked men.

title: Job 34:37
text: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin; He clappeth his hands among us, And multiplieth his words against God.

title: Job 35:1
text: Moreover Elihu answered and said,

title: Job 35:2
text: Thinkest thou this to be [thy] right, [Or] sayest thou, My righteousness is more than God's,

title: Job 35:3
text: That thou sayest, What advantage will it be unto thee? [And], What profit shall I have, more than if I had sinned?

title: Job 35:4
text: I will answer thee, And thy companions with thee.

title: Job 35:5
text: Look unto the heavens, and see; And behold the skies, which are higher than thou.

title: Job 35:6
text: If thou hast sinned, what effectest thou against him? And if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?

title: Job 35:7
text: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? Or what receiveth he of thy hand?

title: Job 35:8
text: Thy wickedness [may hurt] a man as thou art; And thy righteousness [may profit] a son of man.

title: Job 35:9
text: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out; They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

title: Job 35:10
text: But none saith, Where is God my Maker, Who giveth songs in the night,

title: Job 35:11
text: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, And maketh us wiser than the birds of the heavens?

title: Job 35:12
text: There they cry, but none giveth answer, Because of the pride of evil men.

title: Job 35:13
text: Surely God will not hear an empty [cry], Neither will the Almighty regard it.

title: Job 35:14
text: How much less when thou sayest thou beholdest him not, The cause is before him, and thou waitest for him!

title: Job 35:15
text: But now, because he hath not visited in his anger, Neither doth he greatly regard arrogance;

title: Job 35:16
text: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vanity; He multiplieth words without knowledge.

title: Job 36:1
text: Elihu also proceeded, and said,

title: Job 36:2
text: Suffer me a little, and I will show thee; For I have yet somewhat to say on God's behalf.

title: Job 36:3
text: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, And will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

title: Job 36:4
text: For truly my words are not false: One that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.

title: Job 36:5
text: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: He is mighty in strength of understanding.

title: Job 36:6
text: He preserveth not the life of the wicked, But giveth to the afflicted [their] right.

title: Job 36:7
text: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: But with kings upon the throne He setteth them for ever, and they are exalted.

title: Job 36:8
text: And if they be bound in fetters, And be taken in the cords of afflictions;

title: Job 36:9
text: Then he showeth them their work, And their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

title: Job 36:10
text: He openeth also their ear to instruction, And commandeth that they return from iniquity.

title: Job 36:11
text: If they hearken and serve [him], They shall spend their days in prosperity, And their years in pleasures.

title: Job 36:12
text: But if they hearken not, they shall perish by the sword, And they shall die without knowledge.

title: Job 36:13
text: But they that are godless in heart lay up anger: They cry not for help when he bindeth them.

title: Job 36:14
text: They die in youth, And their life [perisheth] among the unclean.

title: Job 36:15
text: He delivereth the afflicted by their affliction, And openeth their ear in oppression.

title: Job 36:16
text: Yea, he would have allured thee out of distress Into a broad place, where there is no straitness; And that which is set on thy table would be full of fatness.

title: Job 36:17
text: But thou art full of the judgment of the wicked: Judgment and justice take hold [on thee] .

title: Job 36:18
text: For let not wrath stir thee up against chastisements; Neither let the greatness of the ransom turn thee aside.

title: Job 36:19
text: Will thy cry avail, [that thou be] not in distress, Or all the forces of [thy] strength?

title: Job 36:20
text: Desire not the night, When peoples are cut off in their place.

title: Job 36:21
text: Take heed, regard not iniquity: For this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

title: Job 36:22
text: Behold, God doeth loftily in his power: Who is a teacher like unto him?

title: Job 36:23
text: Who hath enjoined him his way? Or who can say, Thou hast wrought unrighteousness?

title: Job 36:24
text: Remember that thou magnify his work, Whereof men have sung.

title: Job 36:25
text: All men have looked thereon; Man beholdeth it afar off.

title: Job 36:26
text: Behold, God is great, and we know him not; The number of his years is unsearchable.

title: Job 36:27
text: For he draweth up the drops of water, Which distil in rain from his vapor,

title: Job 36:28
text: Which the skies pour down And drop upon man abundantly.

title: Job 36:29
text: Yea, can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, The thunderings of his pavilion?

title: Job 36:30
text: Behold, he spreadeth his light around him; And he covereth the bottom of the sea.

title: Job 36:31
text: For by these he judgeth the peoples; He giveth food in abundance.

title: Job 36:32
text: He covereth his hands with the lightning, And giveth it a charge that it strike the mark.

title: Job 36:33
text: The noise thereof telleth concerning him, The cattle also concerning [the storm] that cometh up.

title: Job 37:1
text: Yea, at this my heart trembleth, And is moved out of its place.

title: Job 37:2
text: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, And the sound that goeth out of his mouth.

title: Job 37:3
text: He sendeth it forth under the whole heaven, And his lightning unto the ends of the earth.

title: Job 37:4
text: After it a voice roareth; He thundereth with the voice of his majesty; And he restraineth not [the lightnings] when his voice is heard.

title: Job 37:5
text: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; Great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.

title: Job 37:6
text: For he saith to the snow, Fall thou on the earth; Likewise to the shower of rain, And to the showers of his mighty rain.

title: Job 37:7
text: He sealeth up the hand of every man, That all men whom he hath made may know [it] .

title: Job 37:8
text: Then the beasts go into coverts, And remain in their dens.

title: Job 37:9
text: Out of the chamber [of the south] cometh the storm, And cold out of the north.

title: Job 37:10
text: By the breath of God ice is given; And the breadth of the waters is straitened.

title: Job 37:11
text: Yea, he ladeth the thick cloud with moisture; He spreadeth abroad the cloud of his lightning:

title: Job 37:12
text: And it is turned round about by his guidance, That they may do whatsoever he commandeth them Upon the face of the habitable world,

title: Job 37:13
text: Whether it be for correction, or for his land, Or for lovingkindness, that he cause it to come.

title: Job 37:14
text: Hearken unto this, O Job: Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

title: Job 37:15
text: Dost thou know how God layeth [his charge] upon them, And causeth the lightning of his cloud to shine?

title: Job 37:16
text: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, The wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

title: Job 37:17
text: How thy garments are warm, When the earth is still by reason of the south [wind] ?

title: Job 37:18
text: Canst thou with him spread out the sky, Which is strong as a molten mirror?

title: Job 37:19
text: Teach us what we shall say unto him; [For] we cannot set [our speech] in order by reason of darkness.

title: Job 37:20
text: Shall it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

title: Job 37:21
text: And now men see not the light which is bright in the skies; But the wind passeth, and cleareth them.

title: Job 37:22
text: Out of the north cometh golden splendor: God hath upon him terrible majesty.

title: Job 37:23
text: [ Touching] the Almighty, we cannot find him out: He is excellent in power; And in justice and plenteous righteousness he will not afflict.

title: Job 37:24
text: Men do therefore fear him: He regardeth not any that are wise of heart.

title: Job 38:1
text: Then Jehovah answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

title: Job 38:2
text: Who is this that darkeneth counsel By words without knowledge?

title: Job 38:3
text: Gird up now thy loins like a man; For I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

title: Job 38:4
text: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if thou hast understanding.

title: Job 38:5
text: Who determined the measures thereof, if thou knowest? Or who stretched the line upon it?

title: Job 38:6
text: Whereupon were the foundations thereof fastened? Or who laid the corner-stone thereof,

title: Job 38:7
text: When the morning stars sang together, And all the sons of God shouted for joy?

title: Job 38:8
text: Or [who] shut up the sea with doors, When it brake forth, [as if] it had issued out of the womb;

title: Job 38:9
text: When I made clouds the garment thereof, And thick darkness a swaddling-band for it,

title: Job 38:10
text: And marked out for it my bound, And set bars and doors,

title: Job 38:11
text: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further; And here shall thy proud waves be stayed?

title: Job 38:12
text: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days [began], [And] caused the dayspring to know its place;

title: Job 38:13
text: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, And the wicked be shaken out of it?

title: Job 38:14
text: It is changed as clay under the seal; And [all things] stand forth as a garment:

title: Job 38:15
text: And from the wicked their light is withholden, And the high arm is broken.

title: Job 38:16
text: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? Or hast thou walked in the recesses of the deep?

title: Job 38:17
text: Have the gates of death been revealed unto thee? Or hast thou seen the gates of the shadow of death?

title: Job 38:18
text: Hast thou comprehended the earth in its breadth? Declare, if thou knowest it all.

title: Job 38:19
text: Where is the way to the dwelling of light? And as for darkness, where is the place thereof,

title: Job 38:20
text: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, And that thou shouldest discern the paths to the house thereof?

title: Job 38:21
text: [ Doubtless], thou knowest, for thou wast then born, And the number of thy days is great!

title: Job 38:22
text: Hast thou entered the treasuries of the snow, Or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,

title: Job 38:23
text: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, Against the day of battle and war?

title: Job 38:24
text: By what way is the light parted, Or the east wind scattered upon the earth?

title: Job 38:25
text: Who hath cleft a channel for the waterflood, Or the way for the lightning of the thunder;

title: Job 38:26
text: To cause it to rain on a land where no man is; On the wilderness, wherein there is no man;

title: Job 38:27
text: To satisfy the waste and desolate [ground], And to cause the tender grass to spring forth?

title: Job 38:28
text: Hath the rain a father? Or who hath begotten the drops of dew?

title: Job 38:29
text: Out of whose womb came the ice? And the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?

title: Job 38:30
text: The waters hide themselves [and become] like stone, And the face of the deep is frozen.

title: Job 38:31
text: Canst thou bind the cluster of the Pleiades, Or loose the bands of Orion?

title: Job 38:32
text: Canst thou lead forth the Mazzaroth in their season? Or canst thou guide the Bear with her train?

title: Job 38:33
text: Knowest thou the ordinances of the heavens? Canst thou establish the dominion thereof in the earth?

title: Job 38:34
text: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, That abundance of waters may cover thee?

title: Job 38:35
text: Canst thou send forth lightnings, that they may go, And say unto thee, Here we are?

title: Job 38:36
text: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who hath given understanding to the mind?

title: Job 38:37
text: Who can number the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the bottles of heaven,

title: Job 38:38
text: When the dust runneth into a mass, And the clods cleave fast together?

title: Job 38:39
text: Canst thou hunt the prey for the lioness, Or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

title: Job 38:40
text: When they couch in their dens, [And] abide in the covert to lie in wait?

title: Job 38:41
text: Who provideth for the raven his prey, When his young ones cry unto God, [And] wander for lack of food?

title: Job 39:1
text: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? [Or] canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?

title: Job 39:2
text: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? Or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?

title: Job 39:3
text: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young, They cast out their pains.

title: Job 39:4
text: Their young ones become strong, they grow up in the open field; They go forth, and return not again.

title: Job 39:5
text: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? Or who hath loosed the bonds of the swift ass,

title: Job 39:6
text: Whose home I have made the wilderness, And the salt land his dwelling-place?

title: Job 39:7
text: He scorneth the tumult of the city, Neither heareth he the shoutings of the driver.

title: Job 39:8
text: The range of the mountains is his pasture, And he searcheth after every green thing.

title: Job 39:9
text: Will the wild-ox be content to serve thee? Or will he abide by thy crib?

title: Job 39:10
text: Canst thou bind the wild-ox with his band in the furrow? Or will he harrow the valleys after thee?

title: Job 39:11
text: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? Or wilt thou leave to him thy labor?

title: Job 39:12
text: Wilt thou confide in him, that he will bring home thy seed, And gather [the grain] of thy threshing-floor?

title: Job 39:13
text: The wings of the ostrich wave proudly; [But] are they the pinions and plumage of love?

title: Job 39:14
text: For she leaveth her eggs on the earth, And warmeth them in the dust,

title: Job 39:15
text: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, Or that the wild beast may trample them.

title: Job 39:16
text: She dealeth hardly with her young ones, as if they were not hers: Though her labor be in vain, [she is] without fear;

title: Job 39:17
text: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, Neither hath he imparted to her understanding.

title: Job 39:18
text: What time she lifteth up herself on high, She scorneth the horse and his rider.

title: Job 39:19
text: Hast thou given the horse [his] might? Hast thou clothed his neck with the quivering mane?

title: Job 39:20
text: Hast thou made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is terrible.

title: Job 39:21
text: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: He goeth out to meet the armed men.

title: Job 39:22
text: He mocketh at fear, and is not dismayed; Neither turneth he back from the sword.

title: Job 39:23
text: The quiver rattleth against him, The flashing spear and the javelin.

title: Job 39:24
text: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage; Neither believeth he that it is the voice of the trumpet.

title: Job 39:25
text: As oft as the trumpet [soundeth] he saith, Aha! And he smelleth the battle afar off, The thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

title: Job 39:26
text: Is it by thy wisdom that the hawk soareth, (And) stretcheth her wings toward the south?

title: Job 39:27
text: Is it at thy command that the eagle mounteth up, And maketh her nest on high?

title: Job 39:28
text: On the cliff she dwelleth, and maketh her home, Upon the point of the cliff, and the stronghold.

title: Job 39:29
text: From thence she spieth out the prey; Her eyes behold it afar off.

title: Job 39:30
text: Her young ones also suck up blood: And where the slain are, there is she.

title: Job 40:1
text: Moreover Jehovah answered Job, and said,

title: Job 40:2
text: Shall he that cavilleth contend with the Almighty? He that argueth with God, let him answer it.

title: Job 40:3
text: Then Job answered Jehovah, and said,

title: Job 40:4
text: Behold, I am of small account; What shall I answer thee? I lay my hand upon my mouth.

title: Job 40:5
text: Once have I spoken, and I will not answer; Yea, twice, but I will proceed no further.

title: Job 40:6
text: Then Jehovah answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

title: Job 40:7
text: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

title: Job 40:8
text: Wilt thou even annul my judgment? Wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be justified?

title: Job 40:9
text: Or hast thou an arm like God? And canst thou thunder with a voice like him?

title: Job 40:10
text: Deck thyself now with excellency and dignity; And array thyself with honor and majesty.

title: Job 40:11
text: Pour forth the overflowings of thine anger; And look upon every one that is proud, and abase him.

title: Job 40:12
text: Look on every one that is proud, [and] bring him low; And tread down the wicked where they stand.

title: Job 40:13
text: Hide them in the dust together; Bind their faces in the hidden [place] .

title: Job 40:14
text: Then will I also confess of thee That thine own right hand can save thee.

title: Job 40:15
text: Behold now, behemoth, which I made as well as thee; He eateth grass as an ox.

title: Job 40:16
text: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, And his force is in the muscles of his belly.

title: Job 40:17
text: He moveth his tail like a cedar: The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

title: Job 40:18
text: His bones are [as] tubes of brass; His limbs are like bars of iron.

title: Job 40:19
text: He is the chief of the ways of God: He [only] that made him giveth him his sword.

title: Job 40:20
text: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, Where all the beasts of the field do play.

title: Job 40:21
text: He lieth under the lotus-trees, In the covert of the reed, and the fen.

title: Job 40:22
text: The lotus-trees cover him with their shade; The willows of the brook compass him about.

title: Job 40:23
text: Behold, if a river overflow, he trembleth not; He is confident, though a Jordan swell even to his mouth.

title: Job 40:24
text: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, Or pierce through his nose with a snare?

title: Job 41:1
text: Canst thou draw out leviathan with a fishhook? Or press down his tongue with a cord?

title: Job 41:2
text: Canst thou put a rope into his nose? Or pierce his jaw through with a hook?

title: Job 41:3
text: Will he make many supplications unto thee? Or will he speak soft words unto thee?

title: Job 41:4
text: Will he make a covenant with thee, That thou shouldest take him for a servant for ever?

title: Job 41:5
text: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? Or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?

title: Job 41:6
text: Will the bands [of fishermen] make traffic of him? Will they part him among the merchants?

title: Job 41:7
text: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons, Or his head with fish-spears?

title: Job 41:8
text: Lay thy hand upon him; Remember the battle, and do so no more.

title: Job 41:9
text: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: Will not one be cast down even at the sight of him?

title: Job 41:10
text: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up; Who then is he that can stand before me?

title: Job 41:11
text: Who hath first given unto me, that I should repay him? [Whatsoever is] under the whole heaven is mine.

title: Job 41:12
text: I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, Nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.

title: Job 41:13
text: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who shall come within his jaws?

title: Job 41:14
text: Who can open the doors of his face? Round about his teeth is terror.

title: Job 41:15
text: [ His] strong scales are [his] pride, Shut up together [as with] a close seal.

title: Job 41:16
text: One is so near to another, That no air can come between them.

title: Job 41:17
text: They are joined one to another; They stick together, so that they cannot be sundered.

title: Job 41:18
text: His sneezings flash forth light, And his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

title: Job 41:19
text: Out of his mouth go burning torches, And sparks of fire leap forth.

title: Job 41:20
text: Out of his nostrils a smoke goeth, As of a boiling pot and [burning] rushes.

title: Job 41:21
text: His breath kindleth coals, And a flame goeth forth from his mouth.

title: Job 41:22
text: In his neck abideth strength, And terror danceth before him.

title: Job 41:23
text: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: They are firm upon him; They cannot be moved.

title: Job 41:24
text: His heart is as firm as a stone; Yea, firm as the nether millstone.

title: Job 41:25
text: When he raiseth himself up, the mighty are afraid: By reason of consternation they are beside themselves.

title: Job 41:26
text: If one lay at him with the sword, it cannot avail; Nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

title: Job 41:27
text: He counteth iron as straw, [And] brass as rotten wood.

title: Job 41:28
text: The arrow cannot make him flee: Sling-stones are turned with him into stubble.

title: Job 41:29
text: Clubs are counted as stubble: He laugheth at the rushing of the javelin.

title: Job 41:30
text: His underparts are [like] sharp potsherds: He spreadeth [as it were] a threshing-wain upon the mire.

title: Job 41:31
text: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: He maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.

title: Job 41:32
text: He maketh a path to shine after him; One would think the deep to be hoary.

title: Job 41:33
text: Upon earth there is not his like, That is made without fear.

title: Job 41:34
text: He beholdeth everything that is high: He is king over all the sons of pride.

title: Job 42:1
text: Then Job answered Jehovah, and said,

title: Job 42:2
text: I know that thou canst do all things, And that no purpose of thine can be restrained.

title: Job 42:3
text: Who is this that hideth counsel without knowledge? Therefore have I uttered that which I understood not, Things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.

title: Job 42:4
text: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak; I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

title: Job 42:5
text: I had heard of thee by the hearing of the ear; But now mine eye seeth thee:

title: Job 42:6
text: Wherefore I abhor [myself], And repent in dust and ashes.

title: Job 42:7
text: And it was so, that, after Jehovah had spoken these words unto Job, Jehovah said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends; for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.

title: Job 42:8
text: Now therefore, take unto you seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt-offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you; for him will I accept, that I deal not with you after your folly; for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.

title: Job 42:9
text: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as Jehovah commanded them: and Jehovah accepted Job.

title: Job 42:10
text: And Jehovah turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: and Jehovah gave Job twice as much as he had before.

title: Job 42:11
text: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him concerning all the evil that Jehovah had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one a ring of gold.

title: Job 42:12
text: So Jehovah blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: And he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she-asses.

title: Job 42:13
text: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

title: Job 42:14
text: And he called the name of the first, Jemimah: and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.

title: Job 42:15
text: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.

title: Job 42:16
text: And after this Job lived a hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, [even] four generations.

title: Job 42:17
text: So Job died, being old and full of days.

title: Psalms 1:1
text: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the wicked, Nor standeth in the way of sinners, Nor sitteth in the seat of scoffers:

title: Psalms 1:2
text: But his delight is in the law of Jehovah; And on his law doth he meditate day and night.

title: Psalms 1:3
text: And he shall be like a tree planted by the streams of water, That bringeth forth its fruit in its season, Whose leaf also doth not wither; And whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

title: Psalms 1:4
text: The wicked are not so, But are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

title: Psalms 1:5
text: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, Nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

title: Psalms 1:6
text: For Jehovah knoweth the way of the righteous; But the way of the wicked shall perish.

title: Psalms 2:1
text: Why do the nations rage, And the peoples meditate a vain thing?

title: Psalms 2:2
text: The kings of the earth set themselves, And the rulers take counsel together, Against Jehovah, and against his anointed, [saying] ,

title: Psalms 2:3
text: Let us break their bonds asunder, And cast away their cords from us.

title: Psalms 2:4
text: He that sitteth in the heavens will laugh: The Lord will have them in derision.

title: Psalms 2:5
text: Then will he speak unto them in his wrath, And vex them in his sore displeasure:

title: Psalms 2:6
text: Yet I have set my king Upon my holy hill of Zion.

title: Psalms 2:7
text: I will tell of the decree: Jehovah said unto me, Thou art my son; This day have I begotten thee.

title: Psalms 2:8
text: Ask of me, and I will give [thee] the nations for thine inheritance, And the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

title: Psalms 2:9
text: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; Thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.

title: Psalms 2:10
text: Now therefore be wise, O ye kings: Be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

title: Psalms 2:11
text: Serve Jehovah with fear, And rejoice with trembling.

title: Psalms 2:12
text: Kiss the son, lest he be angry, and ye perish in the way, For his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all they that take refuge in him.

title: Psalms 3
inscription: A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son

title: Psalms 3:1
text: Jehovah, how are mine adversaries increased! Many are they that rise up against me.

title: Psalms 3:2
text: Many there are that say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. {{Selah

title: Psalms 3:3
text: But thou, O Jehovah, art a shield about me; My glory and the lifter up of my head.

title: Psalms 3:4
text: I cry unto Jehovah with my voice, And he answereth me out of his holy hill. {{Selah

title: Psalms 3:5
text: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; For Jehovah sustaineth me.

title: Psalms 3:6
text: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of the people That have set themselves against me round about.

title: Psalms 3:7
text: Arise, O Jehovah; Save me, O my God: For thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; Thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.

title: Psalms 3:8
text: Salvation belongeth unto Jehovah: Thy blessing be upon thy people. {{Selah

title: Psalms 4
inscription: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 4:1
text: Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness; Thou hast set me at large [when I was] in distress: Have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

title: Psalms 4:2
text: O ye sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? [How long] will ye love vanity, and seek after falsehood? {{Selah

title: Psalms 4:3
text: But know that Jehovah hath set apart for himself him that is godly: Jehovah will hear when I call unto him.

title: Psalms 4:4
text: Stand in awe, and sin not: Commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. {{Selah

title: Psalms 4:5
text: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, And put your trust in Jehovah.

title: Psalms 4:6
text: Many there are that say, Who will show us [any] good? Jehovah, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

title: Psalms 4:7
text: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, More than [they have] when their grain and their new wine are increased.

title: Psalms 4:8
text: In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; For thou, Jehovah, alone makest me dwell in safety.

title: Psalms 5
inscription: For the Chief Musician; with the Nehiloth. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 5:1
text: Give ear to my words, O Jehovah, Consider my meditation.

title: Psalms 5:2
text: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God; For unto thee do I pray.

title: Psalms 5:3
text: O Jehovah, in the morning shalt thou hear my voice; In the morning will I order [my prayer] unto thee, and will keep watch.

title: Psalms 5:4
text: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: Evil shall not sojourn with thee.

title: Psalms 5:5
text: The arrogant shall not stand in thy sight: Thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

title: Psalms 5:6
text: Thou wilt destroy them that speak lies: Jehovah abhorreth the blood-thirsty and deceitful man.

title: Psalms 5:7
text: But as for me, in the abundance of thy lovingkindness will I come into thy house: In thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

title: Psalms 5:8
text: Lead me, O Jehovah, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; Make thy way straight before my face.

title: Psalms 5:9
text: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; Their inward part is very wickedness; Their throat is an open sepulchre; They flatter with their tongue.

title: Psalms 5:10
text: Hold them guilty, O God; Let them fall by their own counsels; Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions; For they have rebelled against thee.

title: Psalms 5:11
text: But let all those that take refuge in thee rejoice, Let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: Let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

title: Psalms 5:12
text: For thou wilt bless the righteous; O Jehovah, thou wilt compass him with favor as with a shield.

title: Psalms 6
inscription: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, set to the Sheminith. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 6:1
text: O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thine anger, Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

title: Psalms 6:2
text: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah; for I am withered away: O Jehovah, heal me; for my bones are troubled.

title: Psalms 6:3
text: My soul also is sore troubled: And thou, O Jehovah, how long?

title: Psalms 6:4
text: Return, O Jehovah, deliver my soul: Save me for thy lovingkindness' sake.

title: Psalms 6:5
text: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: In Sheol who shall give thee thanks?

title: Psalms 6:6
text: I am weary with my groaning; Every night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

title: Psalms 6:7
text: Mine eye wasteth away because of grief; It waxeth old because of all mine adversaries.

title: Psalms 6:8
text: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; For Jehovah hath heard the voice of my weeping.

title: Psalms 6:9
text: Jehovah hath heard my supplication; Jehovah will receive my prayer.

title: Psalms 6:10
text: All mine enemies shall be put to shame and sore troubled: They shall turn back, they shall be put to shame suddenly.

title: Psalms 7
inscription: Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto Jehovah, concerning the words of Cush a Benjamite

title: Psalms 7:1
text: O Jehovah my God, in thee do I take refuge: Save me from all them that pursue me, and deliver me,

title: Psalms 7:2
text: Lest they tear my soul like a lion, Rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

title: Psalms 7:3
text: O Jehovah my God, if I have done this; If there be iniquity in my hands;

title: Psalms 7:4
text: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (Yea, I have delivered him that without cause was mine adversary;)

title: Psalms 7:5
text: Let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; Yea, let him tread my life down to the earth, And lay my glory in the dust. {{Selah

title: Psalms 7:6
text: Arise, O Jehovah, in thine anger; Lift up thyself against the rage of mine adversaries, And awake for me; thou hast commanded judgment.

title: Psalms 7:7
text: And let the congregation of the peoples compass thee about; And over them return thou on high.

title: Psalms 7:8
text: Jehovah ministereth judgment to the peoples: Judge me, O Jehovah, according to my righteousness, and to mine integrity that is in me.

title: Psalms 7:9
text: O let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish thou the righteous: For the righteous God trieth the minds and hearts.

title: Psalms 7:10
text: My shield is with God, Who saveth the upright in heart.

title: Psalms 7:11
text: God is a righteous judge, Yea, a God that hath indignation every day.

title: Psalms 7:12
text: If a man turn not, he will whet his sword; He hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

title: Psalms 7:13
text: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; He maketh his arrows fiery [shafts] .

title: Psalms 7:14
text: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity; Yea, he hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

title: Psalms 7:15
text: He hath made a pit, and digged it, And is fallen into the ditch which he made.

title: Psalms 7:16
text: His mischief shall return upon his own head, And his violence shall come down upon his own pate.

title: Psalms 7:17
text: I will give thanks unto Jehovah according to his righteousness, And will sing praise to the name of Jehovah Most High.

title: Psalms 8
inscription: For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 8:1
text: O Jehovah, our Lord, How excellent is thy name in all the earth, Who hast set thy glory upon the heavens!

title: Psalms 8:2
text: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou established strength, Because of thine adversaries, That thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

title: Psalms 8:3
text: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, The moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

title: Psalms 8:4
text: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? And the son of man, that thou visitest him?

title: Psalms 8:5
text: For thou hast made him but little lower than God, And crownest him with glory and honor.

title: Psalms 8:6
text: Thou makest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; Thou hast put all things under his feet:

title: Psalms 8:7
text: All sheep and oxen, Yea, and the beasts of the field,

title: Psalms 8:8
text: The birds of the heavens, and the fish of the sea, Whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.

title: Psalms 8:9
text: O Jehovah, our Lord, How excellent is thy name in all the earth!

title: Psalms 9
inscription: For the Chief Musician; set to Muth-labben. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 9:1
text: I will give thanks unto Jehovah with my whole heart; I will show forth all thy marvellous works.

title: Psalms 9:2
text: I will be glad and exult in thee; I will sing praise to thy name, O thou Most High.

title: Psalms 9:3
text: When mine enemies turn back, They stumble and perish at thy presence.

title: Psalms 9:4
text: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; Thou sittest in the throne judging righteously.

title: Psalms 9:5
text: Thou hast rebuked the nations, thou hast destroyed the wicked; Thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.

title: Psalms 9:6
text: The enemy are come to an end, they are desolate for ever; And the cities which thou hast overthrown, The very remembrance of them is perished. [

title: Psalms 9:7
text: But Jehovah sitteth [as king] for ever: He hath prepared his throne for judgment;

title: Psalms 9:8
text: And he will judge the world in righteousness, He will minister judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

title: Psalms 9:9
text: Jehovah also will be a high tower for the oppressed, A high tower in times of trouble;

title: Psalms 9:10
text: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee; For thou, Jehovah, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

title: Psalms 9:11
text: Sing praises to Jehovah, who dwelleth in Zion: Declare among the people his doings.

title: Psalms 9:12
text: For he that maketh inquisition for blood remembereth them; He forgetteth not the cry of the poor.

title: Psalms 9:13
text: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah; Behold my affliction [which I suffer] of them that hate me, Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death;

title: Psalms 9:14
text: That I may show forth all thy praise. In the gates of the daughter of Zion I will rejoice in thy salvation.

title: Psalms 9:15
text: The nations are sunk down in the pit that they made: In the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

title: Psalms 9:16
text: Jehovah hath made himself known, he hath executed judgment: The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. {{Higgaion. Selah

title: Psalms 9:17
text: The wicked shall be turned back unto Sheol, Even all the nations that forget God.

title: Psalms 9:18
text: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten, Nor the expectation of the poor perish for ever.

title: Psalms 9:19
text: Arise, O Jehovah; Let not man prevail: Let the nations be judged in thy sight.

title: Psalms 9:20
text: Put them in fear, O Jehovah: Let the nations know themselves to be but men. {{Selah

title: Psalms 10:1
text: Why standest thou afar off, O Jehovah? Why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

title: Psalms 10:2
text: In the pride of the wicked the poor is hotly pursued; Let them be taken in the devices that they have conceived.

title: Psalms 10:3
text: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, And the covetous renounceth, [yea], contemneth Jehovah.

title: Psalms 10:4
text: The wicked, in the pride of his countenance, [saith], He will not require [it] . All his thoughts are, There is no God.

title: Psalms 10:5
text: His ways are firm at all times; Thy judgments are far above out of his sight: As for all his adversaries, he puffeth at them.

title: Psalms 10:6
text: He saith in his heart, I shall not be moved; To all generations I shall not be in adversity.

title: Psalms 10:7
text: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and oppression: Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

title: Psalms 10:8
text: He sitteth in the lurking-places of the villages; In the secret places doth he murder the innocent; His eyes are privily set against the helpless.

title: Psalms 10:9
text: He lurketh in secret as a lion in his covert; He lieth in wait to catch the poor: He doth catch the poor, when he draweth him in his net.

title: Psalms 10:10
text: He croucheth, he boweth down, And the helpless fall by his strong ones.

title: Psalms 10:11
text: He saith in his heart, God hath forgotten; He hideth his face; he will never see it.

title: Psalms 10:12
text: Arise, O Jehovah; O God, lift up thy hand: Forget not the poor.

title: Psalms 10:13
text: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God, And say in his heart, Thou wilt not require [it] ?

title: Psalms 10:14
text: Thou hast seen [it] ; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: The helpless committeth [himself] unto thee; Thou hast been the helper of the fatherless.

title: Psalms 10:15
text: Break thou the arm of the wicked; And as for the evil man, seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

title: Psalms 10:16
text: Jehovah is King for ever and ever: The nations are perished out of his land.

title: Psalms 10:17
text: Jehovah, thou hast heard the desire of the meek: Thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear;

title: Psalms 10:18
text: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, That man who is of the earth may be terrible no more.

title: Psalms 11:1
text: [For the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David]. In Jehovah do I take refuge: How say ye to my soul, Flee [as] a bird to your mountain;

title: Psalms 11:2
text: For, lo, the wicked bend the bow, They make ready their arrow upon the string, That they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart;

title: Psalms 11:3
text: If the foundations be destroyed, What can the righteous do?

title: Psalms 11:4
text: Jehovah is in his holy temple; Jehovah, his throne is in heaven; His eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

title: Psalms 11:5
text: Jehovah trieth the righteous; But the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

title: Psalms 11:6
text: Upon the wicked he will rain snares; Fire and brimstone and burning wind shall be the portion of their cup.

title: Psalms 11:7
text: For Jehovah is righteous; He loveth righteousness: The upright shall behold his face.

title: Psalms 12
inscription: For the Chief Musician; set to the Sheminith. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 12:1
text: Help, Jehovah; For the godly man ceaseth; For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

title: Psalms 12:2
text: They speak falsehood every one with his neighbor: With flattering lip, and with a double heart, do they speak.

title: Psalms 12:3
text: Jehovah will cut off all flattering lips, The tongue that speaketh great things;

title: Psalms 12:4
text: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; Our lips are our own: Who is lord over us?

title: Psalms 12:5
text: Because of the oppression of the poor, because of the sighing of the needy, Now will I arise, saith Jehovah; I will set him in the safety he panteth for.

title: Psalms 12:6
text: The words of Jehovah are pure words; As silver tried in a furnace on the earth, Purified seven times.

title: Psalms 12:7
text: Thou wilt keep them, O Jehovah, Thou wilt preserve them from this generation for ever.

title: Psalms 12:8
text: The wicked walk on every side, When vileness is exalted among the sons of men.

title: Psalms 13
inscription: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 13:1
text: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou forget me for ever? How long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

title: Psalms 13:2
text: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, Having sorrow in my heart all the day? How long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

title: Psalms 13:3
text: Consider [and] answer me, O Jehovah my God: Lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the [sleep of] death;

title: Psalms 13:4
text: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; [Lest] mine adversaries rejoice when I am moved.

title: Psalms 13:5
text: But I have trusted in thy lovingkindness; My heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

title: Psalms 13:6
text: I will sing unto Jehovah, Because he hath dealt bountifully with me.

title: Psalms 14:1
text: [For the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David]. The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works; There is none that doeth good.

title: Psalms 14:2
text: Jehovah looked down from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there were any that did understand, That did seek after God.

title: Psalms 14:3
text: They are all gone aside; They are together become filthy; There is none that doeth good, no, not one.

title: Psalms 14:4
text: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, Who eat up my people [as] they eat bread, And call not upon Jehovah?

title: Psalms 14:5
text: There were they in great fear; For God is in the generation of the righteous.

title: Psalms 14:6
text: Ye put to shame the counsel of the poor, Because Jehovah is his refuge.

title: Psalms 14:7
text: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When Jehovah bringeth back the captivity of his people, Then shall Jacob rejoice, [and] Israel shall be glad.

title: Psalms 15
inscription: A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 15:1
text: Jehovah, who shall sojourn in thy tabernacle? Who shall dwell in thy holy hill?

title: Psalms 15:2
text: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, And speaketh truth in his heart;

title: Psalms 15:3
text: He that slandereth not with his tongue, Nor doeth evil to his friend, Nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbor;

title: Psalms 15:4
text: In whose eyes a reprobate is despised, But who honoreth them that fear Jehovah; He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not;

title: Psalms 15:5
text: He that putteth not out his money to interest, Nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.

title: Psalms 16
inscription: Michtam of David

title: Psalms 16:1
text: Preserve me, O God; For in thee do I take refuge.

title: Psalms 16:2
text: [ O my soul], thou hast said unto Jehovah, Thou art my Lord: I have no good beyond thee.

title: Psalms 16:3
text: As for the saints that are in the earth, They are the excellent in whom is all my delight.

title: Psalms 16:4
text: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that give gifts for another [god] : Their drink-offerings of blood will I not offer, Nor take their names upon my lips.

title: Psalms 16:5
text: Jehovah is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: Thou maintainest my lot.

title: Psalms 16:6
text: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; Yea, I have a goodly heritage.

title: Psalms 16:7
text: I will bless Jehovah, who hath given me counsel; Yea, my heart instructeth me in the night seasons.

title: Psalms 16:8
text: I have set Jehovah always before me: Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

title: Psalms 16:9
text: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth; My flesh also shall dwell in safety.

title: Psalms 16:10
text: For thou wilt not leave my soul to Sheol; Neither wilt thou suffer thy holy one to see corruption.

title: Psalms 16:11
text: Thou wilt show me the path of life: In thy presence is fulness of joy; In thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

title: Psalms 17
inscription: A Prayer of David

title: Psalms 17:1
text: Hear the right, O Jehovah, attend unto my cry; Give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.

title: Psalms 17:2
text: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; Let thine eyes look upon equity.

title: Psalms 17:3
text: Thou hast proved my heart; Thou hast visited me in the night; Thou hast tried me, and findest nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.

title: Psalms 17:4
text: As for the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the ways of the violent.

title: Psalms 17:5
text: My steps have held fast to thy paths, My feet have not slipped.

title: Psalms 17:6
text: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt answer me, O God: Incline thine ear unto me, [and] hear my speech.

title: Psalms 17:7
text: Show thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them that take refuge [in thee] From those that rise up [against them] .

title: Psalms 17:8
text: Keep me as the apple of the eye; Hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

title: Psalms 17:9
text: From the wicked that oppress me, My deadly enemies, that compass me about.

title: Psalms 17:10
text: They are inclosed in their own fat: With their mouth they speak proudly.

title: Psalms 17:11
text: They have now compassed us in our steps; They set their eyes to cast [us] down to the earth.

title: Psalms 17:12
text: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, And as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

title: Psalms 17:13
text: Arise, O Jehovah, Confront him, cast him down: Deliver my soul from the wicked by thy sword;

title: Psalms 17:14
text: From men by thy hand, O Jehovah, From men of the world, whose portion is in [this] life, And whose belly thou fillest with thy treasure: They are satisfied with children, And leave the rest of their substance to their babes.

title: Psalms 17:15
text: As for me, I shall behold thy face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with [beholding] thy form.

title: Psalms 18:1
text: [For the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David the servant of Jehovah, who spake unto Jehovah the words of this song in the day that Jehovah delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul: and he said], I love thee, O Jehovah, my strength.

title: Psalms 18:2
text: Jehovah is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; My God, my rock, in whom I will take refuge; My shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

title: Psalms 18:3
text: I will call upon Jehovah, who is worthy to be praised: So shall I be saved from mine enemies.

title: Psalms 18:4
text: The cords of death compassed me, And the floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

title: Psalms 18:5
text: The cords of Sheol were round about me; The snares of death came upon me.

title: Psalms 18:6
text: In my distress I called upon Jehovah, And cried unto my God: He heard my voice out of his temple, And my cry before him came into his ears.

title: Psalms 18:7
text: Then the earth shook and trembled; The foundations also of the mountains quaked And were shaken, because he was wroth.

title: Psalms 18:8
text: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, And fire out of his mouth devoured: Coals were kindled by it.

title: Psalms 18:9
text: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; And thick darkness was under his feet.

title: Psalms 18:10
text: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly; Yea, he soared upon the wings of the wind.

title: Psalms 18:11
text: He made darkness his hiding-place, his pavilion round about him, Darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

title: Psalms 18:12
text: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, Hailstones and coals of fire.

title: Psalms 18:13
text: Jehovah also thundered in the heavens, And the Most High uttered his voice, Hailstones and coals of fire.

title: Psalms 18:14
text: And he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; Yea, lightnings manifold, and discomfited them.

title: Psalms 18:15
text: Then the channels of waters appeared, And the foundations of the world were laid bare, At thy rebuke, O Jehovah, At the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

title: Psalms 18:16
text: He sent from on high, he took me; He drew me out of many waters.

title: Psalms 18:17
text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, And from them that hated me; For they were too mighty for me.

title: Psalms 18:18
text: They came upon me in the day of my calamity; But Jehovah was my stay.

title: Psalms 18:19
text: He brought me forth also into a large place; He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

title: Psalms 18:20
text: Jehovah hath rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

title: Psalms 18:21
text: For I have kept the ways of Jehovah, And have not wickedly departed from my God.

title: Psalms 18:22
text: For all his ordinances were before me, And I put not away his statutes from me.

title: Psalms 18:23
text: I was also perfect with him, And I kept myself from mine iniquity.

title: Psalms 18:24
text: Therefore hath Jehovah recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

title: Psalms 18:25
text: With the merciful thou wilt show thyself merciful; With the perfect man thou wilt show thyself perfect;

title: Psalms 18:26
text: With the pure thou wilt show thyself pure; And with the perverse thou wilt show thyself froward.

title: Psalms 18:27
text: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; But the haughty eyes thou wilt bring down.

title: Psalms 18:28
text: For thou wilt light my lamp: Jehovah my God will lighten my darkness.

title: Psalms 18:29
text: For by thee I run upon a troop; And by my God do I leap over a wall.

title: Psalms 18:30
text: As for God, his way is perfect: The word of Jehovah is tried; He is a shield unto all them that take refuge in him.

title: Psalms 18:31
text: For who is God, save Jehovah? And who is a rock, besides our God,

title: Psalms 18:32
text: The God that girdeth me with strength, And maketh my way perfect?

title: Psalms 18:33
text: He maketh my feet like hinds' [feet] : And setteth me upon my high places.

title: Psalms 18:34
text: He teacheth my hands to war; So that mine arms do bend a bow of brass.

title: Psalms 18:35
text: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation; And thy right hand hath holden me up, And thy gentleness hath made me great.

title: Psalms 18:36
text: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, And my feet have not slipped.

title: Psalms 18:37
text: I will pursue mine enemies, and overtake them; Neither will I turn again till they are consumed.

title: Psalms 18:38
text: I will smite them through, so that they shall not be able to rise: They shall fall under my feet.

title: Psalms 18:39
text: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: Thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

title: Psalms 18:40
text: Thou hast also made mine enemies turn their backs unto me, That I might cut off them that hate me.

title: Psalms 18:41
text: They cried, but there was none to save; Even unto Jehovah, but he answered them not.

title: Psalms 18:42
text: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind; I did cast them out as the mire of the streets.

title: Psalms 18:43
text: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; Thou hast made me the head of the nations: A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

title: Psalms 18:44
text: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me; The foreigners shall submit themselves unto me.

title: Psalms 18:45
text: The foreigners shall fade away, And shall come trembling out of their close places.

title: Psalms 18:46
text: Jehovah liveth; And blessed be my rock; And exalted be the God of my salvation,

title: Psalms 18:47
text: Even the God that executeth vengeance for me, And subdueth peoples under me.

title: Psalms 18:48
text: He rescueth me from mine enemies; Yea, thou liftest me up above them that rise up against me; Thou deliverest me from the violent man.

title: Psalms 18:49
text: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the nations, And will sing praises unto thy name.

title: Psalms 18:50
