text: Great deliverance giveth he to his king, And showeth lovingkindness to his anointed, To David and to his seed, for evermore.

title: Psalms 19
inscription: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 19:1
text: The heavens declare the glory of God; And the firmament showeth his handiwork.

title: Psalms 19:2
text: Day unto day uttereth speech, And night unto night showeth knowledge.

title: Psalms 19:3
text: There is no speech nor language; Their voice is not heard.

title: Psalms 19:4
text: Their line is gone out through all the earth, And their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,

title: Psalms 19:5
text: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, And rejoiceth as a strong man to run his course.

title: Psalms 19:6
text: His going forth is from the end of the heavens, And his circuit unto the ends of it; And there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

title: Psalms 19:7
text: The law of Jehovah is perfect, restoring the soul: The testimony of Jehovah is sure, making wise the simple.

title: Psalms 19:8
text: The precepts of Jehovah are right, rejoicing the heart: The commandment of Jehovah is pure, enlightening the eyes.

title: Psalms 19:9
text: The fear of Jehovah is clean, enduring for ever: The ordinances of Jehovah are true, [and] righteous altogether.

title: Psalms 19:10
text: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold; Sweeter also than honey and the droppings of the honeycomb.

title: Psalms 19:11
text: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: In keeping them there is great reward.

title: Psalms 19:12
text: Who can discern [his] errors? Clear thou me from hidden [faults] .

title: Psalms 19:13
text: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous [sins] ; Let them not have dominion over me: Then shall I be upright, And I shall be clear from great transgression.

title: Psalms 19:14
text: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in thy sight, O Jehovah, my rock, and my redeemer.

title: Psalms 20
inscription: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 20:1
text: Jehovah answer thee in the day of trouble; The name of the God of Jacob set thee up on high;

title: Psalms 20:2
text: Send thee help from the sanctuary, And strengthen thee out of Zion;

title: Psalms 20:3
text: Remember all thy offerings, And accept thy burnt-sacrifice; {{Selah

title: Psalms 20:4
text: Grant thee thy heart's desire, And fulfil all thy counsel.

title: Psalms 20:5
text: We will triumph in thy salvation, And in the name of our God we will set up our banners: Jehovah fulfil all thy petitions.

title: Psalms 20:6
text: Now know I that Jehovah saveth his anointed; He will answer him from his holy heaven With the saving strength of his right hand.

title: Psalms 20:7
text: Some [trust] in chariots, and some in horses; But we will make mention of the name of Jehovah our God.

title: Psalms 20:8
text: They are bowed down and fallen; But we are risen, and stand upright.

title: Psalms 20:9
text: Save, Jehovah: Let the King answer us when we call.

title: Psalms 21
inscription: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 21:1
text: The king shall joy in thy strength, O Jehovah; And in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

title: Psalms 21:2
text: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, And hast not withholden the request of his lips. {{Selah

title: Psalms 21:3
text: For thou meetest him with the blessings of goodness: Thou settest a crown of fine gold on his head.

title: Psalms 21:4
text: He asked life of thee, thou gavest it him, Even length of days for ever and ever.

title: Psalms 21:5
text: His glory is great in thy salvation: Honor and majesty dost thou lay upon him.

title: Psalms 21:6
text: For thou makest him most blessed for ever: Thou makest him glad with joy in thy presence.

title: Psalms 21:7
text: For the king trusteth in Jehovah; And through the lovingkindness of the Most High he shall not be moved.

title: Psalms 21:8
text: Thy hand will find out all thine enemies; Thy right hand will find out those that hate thee.

title: Psalms 21:9
text: Thou wilt make them as a fiery furnace in the time of thine anger: Jehovah will swallow them up in his wrath, And the fire shall devour them.

title: Psalms 21:10
text: Their fruit wilt thou destroy from the earth, And their seed from among the children of men.

title: Psalms 21:11
text: For they intended evil against thee; They conceived a device which they are not able to perform.

title: Psalms 21:12
text: For thou wilt make them turn their back; Thou wilt make ready with thy bowstrings against their face.

title: Psalms 21:13
text: Be thou exalted, O Jehovah, in thy strength: So will we sing and praise thy power.

title: Psalms 22
inscription: For the Chief Musician; set to Aijeleth hash-Shahar. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 22:1
text: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? [Why art thou so] far from helping me, [and from] the words of my groaning?

title: Psalms 22:2
text: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou answerest not; And in the night season, and am not silent.

title: Psalms 22:3
text: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

title: Psalms 22:4
text: Our fathers trusted in thee: They trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

title: Psalms 22:5
text: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: They trusted in thee, and were not put to shame.

title: Psalms 22:6
text: But I am a worm, and no man; A reproach of men, and despised of the people.

title: Psalms 22:7
text: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: They shoot out the lip, they shake the head, [saying] ,

title: Psalms 22:8
text: Commit [thyself] unto Jehovah; Let him deliver him: Let him rescue him, seeing he delighteth in him.

title: Psalms 22:9
text: But thou art he that took me out of the womb; Thou didst make me trust [when I was] upon my mother's breasts.

title: Psalms 22:10
text: I was cast upon thee from the womb; Thou art my God since my mother bare me.

title: Psalms 22:11
text: Be not far from me; For trouble is near; For there is none to help.

title: Psalms 22:12
text: Many bulls have compassed me; Strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

title: Psalms 22:13
text: They gape upon me with their mouth, [As] a ravening and a roaring lion.

title: Psalms 22:14
text: I am poured out like water, And all my bones are out of joint: My heart is like wax; It is melted within me.

title: Psalms 22:15
text: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; And my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; And thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

title: Psalms 22:16
text: For dogs have compassed me: A company of evil-doers have inclosed me; They pierced my hands and my feet.

title: Psalms 22:17
text: I may count all my bones; They look and stare upon me.

title: Psalms 22:18
text: They part my garments among them, And upon my vesture do they cast lots.

title: Psalms 22:19
text: But be not thou far off, O Jehovah: O thou my succor, haste thee to help me.

title: Psalms 22:20
text: Deliver my soul from the sword, My darling from the power of the dog.

title: Psalms 22:21
text: Save me from the lion's mouth; Yea, from the horns of the wild-oxen thou hast answered me.

title: Psalms 22:22
text: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: In the midst of the assembly will I praise thee.

title: Psalms 22:23
text: Ye that fear Jehovah, praise him; All ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; And stand in awe of him, all ye the seed of Israel.

title: Psalms 22:24
text: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; Neither hath he hid his face from him; But when he cried unto him, he heard.

title: Psalms 22:25
text: Of thee cometh my praise in the great assembly: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

title: Psalms 22:26
text: The meek shall eat and be satisfied; They shall praise Jehovah that seek after him: Let your heart live for ever.

title: Psalms 22:27
text: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn unto Jehovah; And all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

title: Psalms 22:28
text: For the kingdom is Jehovah's; And he is the ruler over the nations.

title: Psalms 22:29
text: All the fat ones of the earth shall eat and worship: All they that go down to the dust shall bow before him, Even he that cannot keep his soul alive.

title: Psalms 22:30
text: A seed shall serve him; It shall be told of the Lord unto the [next] generation.

title: Psalms 22:31
text: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness Unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done it.

title: Psalms 23
inscription: A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 23:1
text: Jehovah is my shepherd; I shall not want.

title: Psalms 23:2
text: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures; He leadeth me beside still waters.

title: Psalms 23:3
text: He restoreth my soul: He guideth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

title: Psalms 23:4
text: Yea, thou I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; for thou art with me; Thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me.

title: Psalms 23:5
text: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: Thou hast anointed my head with oil; My cup runneth over.

title: Psalms 23:6
text: Surely goodness and lovingkindness shall follow me all the days of my life; And I shall dwell in the house of Jehovah for ever.

title: Psalms 24
inscription: A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 24:1
text: The earth is Jehovah's, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein.

title: Psalms 24:2
text: For he hath founded it upon the seas, And established it upon the floods.

title: Psalms 24:3
text: Who shall ascend into the hill of Jehovah? And who shall stand in his holy place?

title: Psalms 24:4
text: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; Who hath not lifted up his soul unto falsehood, And hath not sworn deceitfully.

title: Psalms 24:5
text: He shall receive a blessing from Jehovah, And righteousness from the God of his salvation.

title: Psalms 24:6
text: This is the generation of them that seek after him, That seek thy face, [even] Jacob. {{Selah

title: Psalms 24:7
text: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; And be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors: And the King of glory will come in.

title: Psalms 24:8
text: Who is the King of glory? Jehovah strong and mighty, Jehovah mighty in battle.

title: Psalms 24:9
text: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; Yea, lift them up, ye everlasting doors: And the King of glory will come in.

title: Psalms 24:10
text: Who is this King of glory? Jehovah of hosts, He is the King of glory. {{Selah

title: Psalms 25:1
text: [[ A Psalm] of David]. Unto thee, O Jehovah, do I lift up my soul.

title: Psalms 25:2
text: O my God, in thee have I trusted, Let me not be put to shame; Let not mine enemies triumph over me.

title: Psalms 25:3
text: Yea, none that wait for thee shall be put to shame: They shall be put to shame that deal treacherously without cause.

title: Psalms 25:4
text: Show me thy ways, O Jehovah; Teach me thy paths.

title: Psalms 25:5
text: Guide me in thy truth, and teach me; For thou art the God of my salvation; For thee do I wait all the day.

title: Psalms 25:6
text: Remember, O Jehovah, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindness; For they have been ever of old.

title: Psalms 25:7
text: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: According to thy lovingkindness remember thou me, For thy goodness' sake, O Jehovah.

title: Psalms 25:8
text: Good and upright is Jehovah: Therefore will he instruct sinners in the way.

title: Psalms 25:9
text: The meek will he guide in justice; And the meek will he teach his way.

title: Psalms 25:10
text: All the paths of Jehovah are lovingkindness and truth Unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

title: Psalms 25:11
text: For thy name's sake, O Jehovah, Pardon mine iniquity, for it is great.

title: Psalms 25:12
text: What man is he that feareth Jehovah? Him shall he instruct in the way that he shall choose.

title: Psalms 25:13
text: His soul shall dwell at ease; And his seed shall inherit the land.

title: Psalms 25:14
text: The friendship of Jehovah is with them that fear him; And he will show them his covenant.

title: Psalms 25:15
text: Mine eyes are ever toward Jehovah; For he will pluck my feet out of the net.

title: Psalms 25:16
text: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; For I am desolate and afflicted.

title: Psalms 25:17
text: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: Oh bring thou me out of my distresses.

title: Psalms 25:18
text: Consider mine affliction and my travail; And forgive all my sins.

title: Psalms 25:19
text: Consider mine enemies, for they are many; And they hate me with cruel hatred.

title: Psalms 25:20
text: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me: Let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in thee.

title: Psalms 25:21
text: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, For I wait for thee.

title: Psalms 25:22
text: Redeem Israel, O God, Out all of his troubles.

title: Psalms 26:1
text: [[ A Psalm] of David]. Judge me, O Jehovah, for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in Jehovah without wavering.

title: Psalms 26:2
text: Examine me, O Jehovah, and prove me; Try my heart and my mind.

title: Psalms 26:3
text: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes; And I have walked in thy truth.

title: Psalms 26:4
text: I have not sat with men of falsehood; Neither will I go in with dissemblers.

title: Psalms 26:5
text: I hate the assembly of evil-doers, And will not sit with the wicked.

title: Psalms 26:6
text: I will wash my hands in innocency: So will I compass thine altar, O Jehovah;

title: Psalms 26:7
text: That I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, And tell of all thy wondrous works.

title: Psalms 26:8
text: Jehovah, I love the habitation of thy house, And the place where thy glory dwelleth.

title: Psalms 26:9
text: Gather not my soul with sinners, Nor my life with men of blood;

title: Psalms 26:10
text: In whose hands is wickedness, And their right hand is full of bribes.

title: Psalms 26:11
text: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: Redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

title: Psalms 26:12
text: My foot standeth in an even place: In the congregations will I bless Jehovah.

title: Psalms 27:1
text: [[ A Psalm] of David]. Jehovah is my light and my salvation; Whom shall I fear? Jehovah is the strength of my life; Of whom shall I be afraid?

title: Psalms 27:2
text: When evil-doers came upon me to eat up my flesh, [Even] mine adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

title: Psalms 27:3
text: Though a host should encamp against me, My heart shall not fear: Though war should rise against me, Even then will I be confident.

title: Psalms 27:4
text: One thing have I asked of Jehovah, that will I seek after; That I may dwell in the house of Jehovah all the days of my life, To behold the beauty of Jehovah, And to inquire in his temple.

title: Psalms 27:5
text: For in the day of trouble he will keep me secretly in his pavilion: In the covert of his tabernacle will he hide me; He will lift me up upon a rock.

title: Psalms 27:6
text: And now shall my head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me. And I will offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto Jehovah.

title: Psalms 27:7
text: Hear, O Jehovah, when I cry with my voice: Have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

title: Psalms 27:8
text: [ When thou saidst], Seek ye my face; My heart said unto thee, Thy face, Jehovah, will I seek.

title: Psalms 27:9
text: Hide not thy face from me; Put not thy servant away in anger: Thou hast been my help; Cast me not off, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

title: Psalms 27:10
text: When my father and my mother forsake me, Then Jehovah will take me up.

title: Psalms 27:11
text: Teach me thy way, O Jehovah; And lead me in a plain path, Because of mine enemies.

title: Psalms 27:12
text: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine adversaries: For false witnesses are risen up against me, And such as breathe out cruelty.

title: Psalms 27:13
text: [ I had fainted], unless I had believed to see the goodness of Jehovah In the land of the living.

title: Psalms 27:14
text: Wait for Jehovah: Be strong, And let thy heart take courage; Yea, wait thou for Jehovah.

title: Psalms 28:1
text: [[ A Psalm] of David]. Unto thee, O Jehovah, will I call: My rock, be not thou deaf unto me; Lest, if thou be silent unto me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

title: Psalms 28:2
text: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, When I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

title: Psalms 28:3
text: Draw me not away with the wicked, And with the workers of iniquity; That speak peace with their neighbors, But mischief is in their hearts.

title: Psalms 28:4
text: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings: Give them after the operation of their hands; Render to them their desert.

title: Psalms 28:5
text: Because they regard not the works of Jehovah, Nor the operation of his hands, He will break them down and not build them up.

title: Psalms 28:6
text: Blessed be Jehovah, Because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

title: Psalms 28:7
text: Jehovah is my strength and my shield; My heart hath trusted in him, and I am helped: Therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; And with my song will I praise him.

title: Psalms 28:8
text: Jehovah is their strength, And he is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

title: Psalms 28:9
text: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: Be their shepherd also, and bear them up for ever.

title: Psalms 29
inscription: A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 29:1
text: Ascribe unto Jehovah, O ye sons of the mighty, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.

title: Psalms 29:2
text: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name; Worship Jehovah in holy array.

title: Psalms 29:3
text: The voice of Jehovah is upon the waters: The God of glory thundereth, Even Jehovah upon many waters.

title: Psalms 29:4
text: The voice of Jehovah is powerful; The voice of Jehovah is full of majesty.

title: Psalms 29:5
text: The voice of Jehovah breaketh the cedars; Yea, Jehovah breaketh in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

title: Psalms 29:6
text: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild-ox.

title: Psalms 29:7
text: The voice of Jehovah cleaveth the flames of fire.

title: Psalms 29:8
text: The voice of Jehovah shaketh the wilderness; Jehovah shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

title: Psalms 29:9
text: The voice of Jehovah maketh the hinds to calve, And strippeth the forests bare: And in his temple everything saith, Glory.

title: Psalms 29:10
text: Jehovah sat [as King] at the Flood; Yea, Jehovah sitteth as King for ever.

title: Psalms 29:11
text: Jehovah will give strength unto his people; Jehovah will bless his people with peace.

title: Psalms 30:1
text: [A Psalm; a Song at the Dedication of the House. [A Psalm] of David]. I will extol thee, O Jehovah; For thou hast raised me up, And hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

title: Psalms 30:2
text: O Jehovah my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

title: Psalms 30:3
text: O Jehovah, thou hast brought up my soul from Sheol; Thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

title: Psalms 30:4
text: Sing praise unto Jehovah, O ye saints of his, And give thanks to his holy memorial [name] .

title: Psalms 30:5
text: For his anger is but for a moment; His favor is for a life-time: Weeping may tarry for the night, But joy [cometh] in the morning.

title: Psalms 30:6
text: As for me, I said in my prosperity, I shall never be moved.

title: Psalms 30:7
text: Thou, Jehovah, of thy favor hadst made my mountain to stand strong: Thou didst hide thy face; I was troubled.

title: Psalms 30:8
text: I cried to thee, O Jehovah; And unto Jehovah I made supplication:

title: Psalms 30:9
text: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

title: Psalms 30:10
text: Hear, O Jehovah, and have mercy upon me: Jehovah, be thou my helper.

title: Psalms 30:11
text: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing; Thou hast loosed my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

title: Psalms 30:12
text: To the end that [my] glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O Jehovah my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.

title: Psalms 31
inscription: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 31:1
text: In thee, O Jehovah, do I take refuge; Let me never be put to shame: Deliver me in thy righteousness.

title: Psalms 31:2
text: Bow down thine ear unto me; Deliver me speedily: Be thou to me a strong rock, A house of defence to save me.

title: Psalms 31:3
text: For thou art my rock and my fortress; Therefore for thy name's sake lead me and guide me.

title: Psalms 31:4
text: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid privily for me; For thou art my stronghold.

title: Psalms 31:5
text: Into thy hand I commend my spirit: Thou hast redeemed me, O Jehovah, thou God of truth.

title: Psalms 31:6
text: I hate them that regard lying vanities; But I trust in Jehovah.

title: Psalms 31:7
text: I will be glad and rejoice in thy lovingkindness; For thou hast seen my affliction: Thou hast known my soul in adversities;

title: Psalms 31:8
text: And thou hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy; Thou hast set my feet in a large place.

title: Psalms 31:9
text: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah, for I am in distress: Mine eye wasteth away with grief, [yea], my soul and my body.

title: Psalms 31:10
text: For my life is spent with sorrow, And my years with sighing: My strength faileth because of mine iniquity, And my bones are wasted away.

title: Psalms 31:11
text: Because of all mine adversaries I am become a reproach, Yea, unto my neighbors exceedingly, And a fear to mine acquaintance: They that did see me without fled from me.

title: Psalms 31:12
text: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

title: Psalms 31:13
text: For I have heard the defaming of many, Terror on every side: While they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

title: Psalms 31:14
text: But I trusted in thee, O Jehovah: I said, Thou art my God.

title: Psalms 31:15
text: My times are in thy hand: Deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

title: Psalms 31:16
text: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: Save me in thy lovingkindness.

title: Psalms 31:17
text: Let me not be put to shame, O Jehovah; For I have called upon thee: Let the wicked be put to shame, let them be silent in Sheol.

title: Psalms 31:18
text: Let the lying lips be dumb, Which speak against the righteous insolently, With pride and contempt.

title: Psalms 31:19
text: Oh how great is thy goodness, Which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee, Which thou hast wrought for them that take refuge in thee, Before the sons of men!

title: Psalms 31:20
text: In the covert of thy presence wilt thou hide them from the plottings of man: Thou wilt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

title: Psalms 31:21
text: Blessed be Jehovah; For he hath showed me his marvellous lovingkindness in a strong city.

title: Psalms 31:22
text: As for me, I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: Nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications When I cried unto thee.

title: Psalms 31:23
text: Oh love Jehovah, all ye his saints: Jehovah preserveth the faithful, And plentifully rewardeth him that dealeth proudly.

title: Psalms 31:24
text: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, All ye that hope in Jehovah.

title: Psalms 32:1
text: [[ A Psalm] of David. Maschil]. Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, Whose sin is covered.

title: Psalms 32:2
text: Blessed is the man unto whom Jehovah imputeth not iniquity, And in whose spirit there is no guile.

title: Psalms 32:3
text: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away Through my groaning all the day long.

title: Psalms 32:4
text: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: My moisture was changed [as] with the drought of summer. {{Selah

title: Psalms 32:5
text: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, And mine iniquity did I not hide: I said, I will confess my transgressions unto Jehovah; And thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. {{Selah

title: Psalms 32:6
text: For this let every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: Surely when the great waters overflow they shall not reach unto him.

title: Psalms 32:7
text: Thou art my hiding-place; Thou wilt preserve me from trouble; Thou wilt compass me about with songs of deliverance. {{Selah

title: Psalms 32:8
text: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will counsel thee with mine eye upon thee.

title: Psalms 32:9
text: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding; Whose trappings must be bit and bridle to hold them in, [Else] they will not come near unto thee.

title: Psalms 32:10
text: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked; But he that trusteth in Jehovah, lovingkindness shall compass him about.

title: Psalms 32:11
text: Be glad in Jehovah, and rejoice, ye righteous; And shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

title: Psalms 33:1
text: Rejoice in Jehovah, O ye righteous: Praise is comely for the upright.

title: Psalms 33:2
text: Give thanks unto Jehovah with the harp: Sing praises unto him with the psaltery of ten strings.

title: Psalms 33:3
text: Sing unto him a new song; Play skilfully with a loud noise.

title: Psalms 33:4
text: For the word of Jehovah is right; And all his work is [done] in faithfulness.

title: Psalms 33:5
text: He loveth righteousness and justice: The earth is full of the lovingkindness of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 33:6
text: By the word of Jehovah were the heavens made, And all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

title: Psalms 33:7
text: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as a heap: He layeth up the deeps in store-houses.

title: Psalms 33:8
text: Let all the earth fear Jehovah: Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

title: Psalms 33:9
text: For he spake, and it was done; He commanded, and it stood fast.

title: Psalms 33:10
text: Jehovah bringeth the counsel of the nations to nought; He maketh the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

title: Psalms 33:11
text: The counsel of Jehovah standeth fast for ever, The thoughts of his heart to all generations.

title: Psalms 33:12
text: Blessed is the nation whose God is Jehovah, The people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

title: Psalms 33:13
text: Jehovah looketh from heaven; He beholdeth all the sons of men;

title: Psalms 33:14
text: From the place of his habitation he looketh forth Upon all the inhabitants of the earth,

title: Psalms 33:15
text: He that fashioneth the hearts of them all, That considereth all their works.

title: Psalms 33:16
text: There is no king saved by the multitude of a host: A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

title: Psalms 33:17
text: A horse is a vain thing for safety; Neither doth he deliver any by his great power.

title: Psalms 33:18
text: Behold, the eye of Jehovah is upon them that fear him, Upon them that hope in his lovingkindness;

title: Psalms 33:19
text: To deliver their soul from death, And to keep them alive in famine.

title: Psalms 33:20
text: Our soul hath waited for Jehovah: He is our help and our shield.

title: Psalms 33:21
text: For our heart shall rejoice in him, Because we have trusted in his holy name.

title: Psalms 33:22
text: Let thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, be upon us, According as we have hoped in thee.

title: Psalms 34:1
text: [[ A Psalm] of David; when he changed his behavior before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed]. I will bless Jehovah at all times: His praise shall continually be in my mouth.

title: Psalms 34:2
text: My soul shall make her boast in Jehovah: The meek shall hear thereof, and be glad.

title: Psalms 34:3
text: Oh magnify Jehovah with me, And let us exalt his name together.

title: Psalms 34:4
text: I sought Jehovah, and he answered me, And delivered me from all my fears.

title: Psalms 34:5
text: They looked unto him, and were radiant; And their faces shall never be confounded.

title: Psalms 34:6
text: This poor man cried, and Jehovah heard him, And saved him out of all his troubles.

title: Psalms 34:7
text: The angel of Jehovah encampeth round about them that fear him, And delivereth them.

title: Psalms 34:8
text: Oh taste and see that Jehovah is good: Blessed is the man that taketh refuge in him.

title: Psalms 34:9
text: Oh fear Jehovah, ye his saints; For there is no want to them that fear him.

title: Psalms 34:10
text: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger; But they that seek Jehovah shall not want any good thing.

title: Psalms 34:11
text: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 34:12
text: What man is he that desireth life, And loveth [many] days, that he may see good?

title: Psalms 34:13
text: Keep thy tongue from evil, And thy lips from speaking guile.

title: Psalms 34:14
text: Depart from evil, and do good; Seek peace, and pursue it.

title: Psalms 34:15
text: The eyes of Jehovah are toward the righteous, And his ears are [open] unto their cry.

title: Psalms 34:16
text: The face of Jehovah is against them that do evil, To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

title: Psalms 34:17
text: [ The righteous] cried, and Jehovah heard, And delivered them out of all their troubles.

title: Psalms 34:18
text: Jehovah is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart, And saveth such as are of a contrite spirit.

title: Psalms 34:19
text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous; But Jehovah delivereth him out of them all.

title: Psalms 34:20
text: He keepeth all his bones: Not one of them is broken.

title: Psalms 34:21
text: Evil shall slay the wicked; And they that hate the righteous shall be condemned.

title: Psalms 34:22
text: Jehovah redeemeth the soul of his servants; And none of them that take refuge in him shall be condemned.

title: Psalms 35:1
text: [[ A Psalm] of David]. Strive thou, O Jehovah, with them that strive with me: Fight thou against them that fight against me.

title: Psalms 35:2
text: Take hold of shield and buckler, And stand up for my help.

title: Psalms 35:3
text: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that pursue me: Say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.

title: Psalms 35:4
text: Let them be put to shame and brought to dishonor that seek after my soul: Let them be turned back and confounded that devise my hurt.

title: Psalms 35:5
text: Let them be as chaff before the wind, And the angel of Jehovah driving [them] on.

title: Psalms 35:6
text: Let their way be dark and slippery, And the angel of Jehovah pursuing them.

title: Psalms 35:7
text: For without cause have they hid for me their net [in] a pit; Without cause have they digged [a pit] for my soul.

title: Psalms 35:8
text: Let destruction come upon him unawares; And let his net that he hath hid catch himself: With destruction let him fall therein.

title: Psalms 35:9
text: And my soul shall be joyful in Jehovah: It shall rejoice in his salvation.

title: Psalms 35:10
text: All my bones shall say, Jehovah, who is like unto thee, Who deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, Yea, the poor and the needy from him that robbeth him?

title: Psalms 35:11
text: Unrighteous witnesses rise up; They ask me of things that I know not.

title: Psalms 35:12
text: They reward me evil for good, [To] the bereaving of my soul.

title: Psalms 35:13
text: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I afflicted my soul with fasting; And my prayer returned into mine own bosom.

title: Psalms 35:14
text: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother: I bowed down mourning, as one that bewaileth his mother.

title: Psalms 35:15
text: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: The abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew [it] not; They did tear me, and ceased not:

title: Psalms 35:16
text: Like the profane mockers in feasts, They gnashed upon me with their teeth.

title: Psalms 35:17
text: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? Rescue my soul from their destructions, My darling from the lions.

title: Psalms 35:18
text: I will give thee thanks in the great assembly: I will praise thee among much people.

title: Psalms 35:19
text: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; Neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

title: Psalms 35:20
text: For they speak not peace; But they devise deceitful words against them that are quiet in the land.

title: Psalms 35:21
text: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me; They said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.

title: Psalms 35:22
text: Thou hast seen it, O Jehovah; Keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

title: Psalms 35:23
text: Stir up thyself, and awake to the justice [due] unto me, [Even] unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

title: Psalms 35:24
text: Judge me, O Jehovah my God, according to thy righteousness; And let them not rejoice over me.

title: Psalms 35:25
text: Let them not say in their heart, Aha, so would we have it: Let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

title: Psalms 35:26
text: Let them be put to shame and confounded together that rejoice at my hurt: Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor that magnify themselves against me.

title: Psalms 35:27
text: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favor my righteous cause: Yea, let them say continually, Jehovah be magnified, Who hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.

title: Psalms 35:28
text: And my tongue shall talk of thy righteousness [And] of thy praise all the day long.

title: Psalms 36:1
text: [For the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David the servant of Jehovah]. The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, There is no fear of God before his eyes.

title: Psalms 36:2
text: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, That his iniquity will not be found out and be hated.

title: Psalms 36:3
text: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: He hath ceased to be wise [and] to do good.

title: Psalms 36:4
text: He deviseth iniquity upon his bed; He setteth himself in a way that is not good; He abhorreth not evil.

title: Psalms 36:5
text: Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, is in the heavens; Thy faithfulness [reacheth] unto the skies.

title: Psalms 36:6
text: Thy righteousness is like the mountains of God; Thy judgments are a great deep: O Jehovah, thou preservest man and beast.

title: Psalms 36:7
text: How precious is thy lovingkindness, O God! And the children of men take refuge under the shadow of thy wings.

title: Psalms 36:8
text: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; And thou wilt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

title: Psalms 36:9
text: For with thee is the fountain of life: In thy light shall we see light.

title: Psalms 36:10
text: Oh continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee, And thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

title: Psalms 36:11
text: Let not the foot of pride come against me, And let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.

title: Psalms 36:12
text: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

title: Psalms 37:1
text: [[ A Psalm] of David]. Fret not thyself because of evil-doers, Neither be thou envious against them that work unrighteousness.

title: Psalms 37:2
text: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, And wither as the green herb.

title: Psalms 37:3
text: Trust in Jehovah, and do good; Dwell in the land, and feed on [his] faithfulness.

title: Psalms 37:4
text: Delight thyself also in Jehovah; And he will give thee the desires of thy heart.

title: Psalms 37:5
text: Commit thy way unto Jehovah; Trust also in him, and he will bring it to pass.

title: Psalms 37:6
text: And he will make thy righteousness to go forth as the light, And thy justice as the noon-day.

title: Psalms 37:7
text: Rest in Jehovah, and wait patiently for him: Fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, Because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

title: Psalms 37:8
text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: Fret not thyself, [it tendeth] only to evil-doing.

title: Psalms 37:9
text: For evil-doers shall be cut off; But those that wait for Jehovah, they shall inherit the land.

title: Psalms 37:10
text: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: Yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and he shall not be.

title: Psalms 37:11
text: But the meek shall inherit the land, And shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

title: Psalms 37:12
text: The wicked plotteth against the just, And gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

title: Psalms 37:13
text: The Lord will laugh at him; For he seeth that his day is coming.

title: Psalms 37:14
text: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, To cast down the poor and needy, To slay such as are upright in the way.

title: Psalms 37:15
text: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, And their bows shall be broken.

title: Psalms 37:16
text: Better is a little that the righteous hath Than the abundance of many wicked.

title: Psalms 37:17
text: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken; But Jehovah upholdeth the righteous.

title: Psalms 37:18
text: Jehovah knoweth the days of the perfect; And their inheritance shall be for ever.

title: Psalms 37:19
text: They shall not be put to shame in the time of evil; And in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

title: Psalms 37:20
text: But the wicked shall perish, And the enemies of Jehovah shall be as the fat of lambs: They shall consume; in smoke shall they consume away.

title: Psalms 37:21
text: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again; But the righteous dealeth graciously, and giveth.

title: Psalms 37:22
text: For such as are blessed of him shall inherit the land; And they that are cursed of him shall be cut off.

title: Psalms 37:23
text: A man's goings are established of Jehovah; And he delighteth in his way.

title: Psalms 37:24
text: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down; For Jehovah upholdeth him with his hand.

title: Psalms 37:25
text: I have been young, and now am old; Yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, Nor his seed begging bread.

title: Psalms 37:26
text: All the day long he dealeth graciously, and lendeth; And his seed is blessed.

title: Psalms 37:27
text: Depart from evil, and do good; And dwell for evermore.

title: Psalms 37:28
text: For Jehovah loveth justice, And forsaketh not his saints; They are preserved for ever: But the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

title: Psalms 37:29
text: The righteous shall inherit the land, And dwell therein for ever.

title: Psalms 37:30
text: The mouth of the righteous talketh of wisdom, And his tongue speaketh justice.

title: Psalms 37:31
text: The law of his God is in his heart; None of his steps shall slide.

title: Psalms 37:32
text: The wicked watcheth the righteous, And seeketh to slay him.

title: Psalms 37:33
text: Jehovah will not leave him in his hand, Nor condemn him when he is judged.

title: Psalms 37:34
text: Wait for Jehovah, and keep his way, And he will exalt thee to inherit the land: When the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.

title: Psalms 37:35
text: I have seen the wicked in great power, And spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

title: Psalms 37:36
text: But one passed by, and, lo, he was not: Yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

title: Psalms 37:37
text: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright; For there is a [happy] end to the man of peace.

title: Psalms 37:38
text: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together; The end of the wicked shall be cut off.

title: Psalms 37:39
text: But the salvation of the righteous is of Jehovah; He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

title: Psalms 37:40
text: And Jehovah helpeth them, and rescueth them; He rescueth them from the wicked, and saveth them, Because they have taken refuge in him.

title: Psalms 38
inscription: A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance

title: Psalms 38:1
text: O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thy wrath; Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

title: Psalms 38:2
text: For thine arrows stick fast in me, And thy hand presseth me sore.

title: Psalms 38:3
text: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine indignation; Neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

title: Psalms 38:4
text: For mine iniquities are gone over my head: As a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

title: Psalms 38:5
text: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt, Because of my foolishness.

title: Psalms 38:6
text: I am pained and bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

title: Psalms 38:7
text: For my loins are filled with burning; And there is no soundness in my flesh.

title: Psalms 38:8
text: I am faint and sore bruised: I have groaned by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

title: Psalms 38:9
text: Lord, all my desire is before thee; And my groaning is not hid from thee.

title: Psalms 38:10
text: My heart throbbeth, my strength faileth me: As for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

title: Psalms 38:11
text: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague; And my kinsmen stand afar off.

title: Psalms 38:12
text: They also that seek after my life lay snares [for me] ; And they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, And meditate deceits all the day long.

title: Psalms 38:13
text: But I, as a deaf man, hear not; And I am as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

title: Psalms 38:14
text: Yea, I am as a man that heareth not, And in whose mouth are no reproofs.

title: Psalms 38:15
text: For in thee, O Jehovah, do I hope: Thou wilt answer, O Lord my God.

title: Psalms 38:16
text: For I said, Lest they rejoice over me: When my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

title: Psalms 38:17
text: For I am ready to fall, And my sorrow is continually before me.

title: Psalms 38:18
text: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

title: Psalms 38:19
text: But mine enemies are lively, [and] are strong; And they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

title: Psalms 38:20
text: They also that render evil for good Are adversaries unto me, because I follow the thing that is good.

title: Psalms 38:21
text: Forsake me not, O Jehovah: O my God, be not far from me.

title: Psalms 38:22
text: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation.

title: Psalms 39
inscription: For the Chief Musician, for Jeduthun. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 39:1
text: I said, I will take heed to my ways, That I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, While the wicked is before me.

title: Psalms 39:2
text: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; And my sorrow was stirred.

title: Psalms 39:3
text: My heart was hot within me; While I was musing the fire burned: [Then] spake I with my tongue:

title: Psalms 39:4
text: Jehovah, make me to know mine end, And the measure of my days, what it is; Let me know how frail I am.

title: Psalms 39:5
text: Behold, thou hast made my days [as] handbreadths; And my life-time is as nothing before thee: Surely every man at his best estate is altogether vanity. {{Selah [

title: Psalms 39:6
text: Surely every man walketh in a vain show; Surely they are disquieted in vain: He heapeth up [riches], and knoweth not who shall gather them.

title: Psalms 39:7
text: And now, Lord, what wait I for? My hope is in thee.

title: Psalms 39:8
text: Deliver me from all my transgressions: Make me not the reproach of the foolish.

title: Psalms 39:9
text: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; Because thou didst it.

title: Psalms 39:10
text: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thy hand.

title: Psalms 39:11
text: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, Thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: Surely every man is vanity. {{Selah

title: Psalms 39:12
text: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, and give ear unto my cry; Hold not thy peace at my tears: For I am a stranger with thee, A sojourner, as all my fathers were.

title: Psalms 39:13
text: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, Before I go hence, and be no more.

title: Psalms 40
inscription: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 40:1
text: I waited patiently for Jehovah; And he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

title: Psalms 40:2
text: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay; And he set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

title: Psalms 40:3
text: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: Many shall see it, and fear, And shall trust in Jehovah.

title: Psalms 40:4
text: Blessed is the man that maketh Jehovah his trust, And respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

title: Psalms 40:5
text: Many, O Jehovah my God, are the wonderful works which thou hast done, And thy thoughts which are to us-ward; They cannot be set in order unto thee; If I would declare and speak of them, They are more than can be numbered.

title: Psalms 40:6
text: Sacrifice and offering thou hast no delight in; Mine ears hast thou opened: Burnt-offering and sin-offering hast thou not required.

title: Psalms 40:7
text: Then said I, Lo, I am come; In the roll of the book it is written of me:

title: Psalms 40:8
text: I delight to do thy will, O my God; Yea, thy law is within my heart.

title: Psalms 40:9
text: I have proclaimed glad tidings of righteousness in the great assembly; Lo, I will not refrain my lips, O Jehovah, thou knowest.

title: Psalms 40:10
text: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation; I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great assembly.

title: Psalms 40:11
text: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O Jehovah; Let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

title: Psalms 40:12
text: For innumerable evils have compassed me about; Mine iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up; They are more than the hairs of my head; And my heart hath failed me.

title: Psalms 40:13
text: Be pleased, O Jehovah, to deliver me: Make haste to help me, O Jehovah.

title: Psalms 40:14
text: Let them be put to shame and confounded together That seek after my soul to destroy it: Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor That delight in my hurt.

title: Psalms 40:15
text: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame That say unto me, Aha, aha.

title: Psalms 40:16
text: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: Let such as love thy salvation say continually, Jehovah be magnified.

title: Psalms 40:17
text: But I am poor and needy; [Yet] the Lord thinketh upon me: Thou art my help and my deliverer; Make no tarrying, O my God.

title: Psalms 41
inscription: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 41:1
text: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: Jehovah will deliver him in the day of evil.

title: Psalms 41:2
text: Jehovah will preserve him, and keep him alive, And he shall be blessed upon the earth; And deliver not thou him unto the will of his enemies.

title: Psalms 41:3
text: Jehovah will support him upon the couch of languishing: Thou makest all his bed in his sickness.

title: Psalms 41:4
text: I said, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me: Heal my soul; For I have sinned against thee.

title: Psalms 41:5
text: Mine enemies speak evil against me, [saying], When will he die, and his name perish?

title: Psalms 41:6
text: And if he come to see [me], he speaketh falsehood; His heart gathereth iniquity to itself: When he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

title: Psalms 41:7
text: All that hate me whisper together against me; Against me do they devise my hurt.

title: Psalms 41:8
text: An evil disease, [say they], cleaveth fast unto him; And now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

title: Psalms 41:9
text: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, Who did eat of my bread, Hath lifted up his heel against me.

title: Psalms 41:10
text: But thou, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me, and raise me up, That I may requite them.

title: Psalms 41:11
text: By this I know that thou delightest in me, Because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

title: Psalms 41:12
text: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, And settest me before thy face for ever.

title: Psalms 41:13
text: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, From everlasting and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

title: Psalms 42
inscription: For the Chief Musician. Maschil of the sons of Korah

title: Psalms 42:1
text: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, So panteth my soul after thee, O God.

title: Psalms 42:2
text: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: When shall I come and appear before God?

title: Psalms 42:3
text: My tears have been my food day and night, While they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?

title: Psalms 42:4
text: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, How I went with the throng, and led them to the house of God, With the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping holyday.

title: Psalms 42:5
text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And [why] art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise him [For] the help of his countenance.

title: Psalms 42:6
text: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: Therefore do I remember thee from the land of the Jordan, And the Hermons, from the hill Mizar.

title: Psalms 42:7
text: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterfalls: All thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

title: Psalms 42:8
text: [ Yet] Jehovah will command his lovingkindness in the day-time; And in the night his song shall be with me, [Even] a prayer unto the God of my life.

title: Psalms 42:9
text: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? Why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

title: Psalms 42:10
text: As with a sword in my bones, mine adversaries reproach me, While they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?

title: Psalms 42:11
text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; For I shall yet praise him, [Who is] the help of my countenance, and my God.

title: Psalms 43:1
text: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: Oh deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

title: Psalms 43:2
text: For thou art the God of my strength; Why hast thou cast me off? Why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

title: Psalms 43:3
text: Oh send out thy light and thy truth; Let them lead me: Let them bring me unto thy holy hill, And to thy tabernacles.

title: Psalms 43:4
text: Then will I go unto the altar of God, Unto God my exceeding joy; And upon the harp will I praise thee, O God, my God.

title: Psalms 43:5
text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; For I shall yet praise him, [Who is] the help of my countenance, and my God.

title: Psalms 44:1
text: [For the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of the sons of Korah. Maschil]. We have heard with our ears, O God, Our fathers have told us, What work thou didst in their days, In the days of old.

title: Psalms 44:2
text: Thou didst drive out the nations with thy hand; But them thou didst plant: Thou didst afflict the peoples; But them thou didst spread abroad.

title: Psalms 44:3
text: For they gat not the land in possession by their own sword, Neither did their own arm save them; But thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, Because thou wast favorable unto them.

title: Psalms 44:4
text: Thou art my King, O God: Command deliverance for Jacob.

title: Psalms 44:5
text: Through thee will we push down our adversaries: Through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

title: Psalms 44:6
text: For I will not trust in my bow, Neither shall my sword save me.

title: Psalms 44:7
text: But thou hast saved us from our adversaries, And hast put them to shame that hate us.

title: Psalms 44:8
text: In God have we made our boast all the day long, And we will give thanks unto thy name for ever. {{Selah

title: Psalms 44:9
text: But now thou hast cast [us] off, and brought us to dishonor, And goest not forth with our hosts.

title: Psalms 44:10
text: Thou makest us to turn back from the adversary; And they that hate us take spoil for themselves.

title: Psalms 44:11
text: Thou hast made us like sheep [appointed] for food, And hast scattered us among the nations.

title: Psalms 44:12
text: Thou sellest thy people for nought, And hast not increased [thy wealth] by their price.

title: Psalms 44:13
text: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbors, A scoffing and a derision to them that are round about us.

title: Psalms 44:14
text: Thou makest us a byword among the nations, A shaking of the head among the peoples.

title: Psalms 44:15
text: All the day long is my dishonor before me, And the shame of my face hath covered me,

title: Psalms 44:16
text: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth, By reason of the enemy and the avenger.

title: Psalms 44:17
text: All this is come upon us; Yet have we not forgotten thee, Neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

title: Psalms 44:18
text: Our heart is not turned back, Neither have our steps declined from thy way,

title: Psalms 44:19
text: That thou hast sore broken us in the place of jackals, And covered us with the shadow of death.

title: Psalms 44:20
text: If we have forgotten the name of our God, Or spread forth our hands to a strange god;

title: Psalms 44:21
text: Will not God search this out? For he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

title: Psalms 44:22
text: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; We are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

title: Psalms 44:23
text: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? Arise, cast [us] not off for ever.

title: Psalms 44:24
text: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, And forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

title: Psalms 44:25
text: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: Our body cleaveth unto the earth.

title: Psalms 44:26
text: Rise up for our help, And redeem us for thy lovingkindness' sake.

title: Psalms 45:1
text: [For the Chief Musician; set to Shoshannim. [A Psalm] of the sons of Korah. Maschil. A Song of loves]. My heart overfloweth with a goodly matter; I speak the things which I have made touching the king: My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

title: Psalms 45:2
text: Thou art fairer than the children of men; Grace is poured into thy lips: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

title: Psalms 45:3
text: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O mighty one, Thy glory and thy majesty.

title: Psalms 45:4
text: And in thy majesty ride on prosperously, Because of truth and meekness [and] righteousness: And thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

title: Psalms 45:5
text: Thine arrows are sharp; The peoples fall under thee; [They are] in the heart of the king's enemies.

title: Psalms 45:6
text: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: A sceptre of equity is the sceptre of thy kingdom.

title: Psalms 45:7
text: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated wickedness: Therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee With the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

title: Psalms 45:8
text: All thy garments [smell of] myrrh, and aloes, [and] cassia; Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made thee glad.

title: Psalms 45:9
text: Kings' daughters are among thy honorable women: At thy right hand doth stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

title: Psalms 45:10
text: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; Forget also thine own people, and thy father's house:

title: Psalms 45:11
text: So will the king desire thy beauty; For he is thy lord; And reverence thou him.

title: Psalms 45:12
text: And the daughter of Tyre [shall be there] with a gift; The rich among the people shall entreat thy favor.

title: Psalms 45:13
text: The king's daughter within [the palace] is all glorious: Her clothing is inwrought with gold.

title: Psalms 45:14
text: She shall be led unto the king in broidered work: The virgins her companions that follow her Shall be brought unto thee.

title: Psalms 45:15
text: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be led: They shall enter into the king's palace.

title: Psalms 45:16
text: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, Whom thou shalt make princes in all the earth.

title: Psalms 45:17
text: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: Therefore shall the peoples give thee thanks for ever and ever.

title: Psalms 46:1
text: [For the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of the sons of Korah; set to Alamoth. A Song]. God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.

title: Psalms 46:2
text: Therefore will we not fear, though the earth do change, And though the mountains be shaken into the heart of the seas;

title: Psalms 46:3
text: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, Though the mountains tremble with the swelling thereof. {{Selah

title: Psalms 46:4
text: There is a river, the streams whereof make glad the city of God, The holy place of the tabernacles of the Most High.

title: Psalms 46:5
text: God is in the midst of her; She shall not be moved: God will help her, and that right early.

title: Psalms 46:6
text: The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved: He uttered his voice, the earth melted.

title: Psalms 46:7
text: Jehovah of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. {{Selah

title: Psalms 46:8
text: Come, behold the works of Jehovah, What desolations he hath made in the earth.

title: Psalms 46:9
text: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; He breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; He burneth the chariots in the fire.

title: Psalms 46:10
text: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.

title: Psalms 46:11
text: Jehovah of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. {{Selah

title: Psalms 47
inscription: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah

title: Psalms 47:1
text: Oh clap your hands, all ye peoples; Shout unto God with the voice of triumph.

title: Psalms 47:2
text: For Jehovah Most High is terrible; He is a great King over all the earth.

title: Psalms 47:3
text: He subdueth peoples under us, And nations under our feet.

title: Psalms 47:4
text: He chooseth our inheritance for us, The glory of Jacob whom he loved. {{Selah

title: Psalms 47:5
text: God is gone up with a shout, Jehovah with the sound of a trumpet.

title: Psalms 47:6
text: Sing praise to God, sing praises: Sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

title: Psalms 47:7
text: For God is the King of all the earth: Sing ye praises with understanding.

title: Psalms 47:8
text: God reigneth over the nations: God sitteth upon his holy throne.

title: Psalms 47:9
text: The princes of the peoples are gathered together [To be] the people of the God of Abraham: For the shields of the earth belong unto God; He is greatly exalted.

title: Psalms 48
inscription: A Song; a Psalm of the sons of Korah

title: Psalms 48:1
text: Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised, In the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

title: Psalms 48:2
text: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, Is mount Zion, [on] the sides of the north, The city of the great King.

title: Psalms 48:3
text: God hath made himself known in her palaces for a refuge.

title: Psalms 48:4
text: For, lo, the kings assembled themselves, They passed by together.

title: Psalms 48:5
text: They saw it, then were they amazed; They were dismayed, they hasted away.

title: Psalms 48:6
text: Trembling took hold of them there, Pain, as of a woman in travail.

title: Psalms 48:7
text: With the east wind Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish.

title: Psalms 48:8
text: As we have heard, so have we seen In the city of Jehovah of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. {{Selah

title: Psalms 48:9
text: We have thought on thy lovingkindness, O God, In the midst of thy temple.

title: Psalms 48:10
text: As is thy name, O God, So is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: Thy right hand is full of righteousness.

title: Psalms 48:11
text: Let mount Zion be glad, Let the daughters of Judah rejoice, Because of thy judgments.

title: Psalms 48:12
text: Walk about Zion, and go round about her; Number the towers thereof;

title: Psalms 48:13
text: Mark ye well her bulwarks; Consider her palaces: That ye may tell it to the generation following.

title: Psalms 48:14
text: For this God is our God for ever and ever: He will be our guide [even] unto death.

title: Psalms 49
inscription: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah

title: Psalms 49:1
text: Hear this, all ye peoples; Give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world,

title: Psalms 49:2
text: Both low and high, Rich and poor together.

title: Psalms 49:3
text: My mouth shall speak wisdom; And the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.

title: Psalms 49:4
text: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

title: Psalms 49:5
text: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, When iniquity at my heels compasseth me about?

title: Psalms 49:6
text: They that trust in their wealth, And boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

title: Psalms 49:7
text: None [of them] can by any means redeem his brother, Nor give to God a ransom for him;

title: Psalms 49:8
text: (For the redemption of their life is costly, And it faileth for ever;)

title: Psalms 49:9
text: That he should still live alway, That he should not see corruption.

title: Psalms 49:10
text: For he shall see it. Wise men die; The fool and the brutish alike perish, And leave their wealth to others.

title: Psalms 49:11
text: Their inward thought is, [that] their houses [shall continue] for ever, [And] their dwelling-places to all generations; They call their lands after their own names.

title: Psalms 49:12
text: But man [being] in honor abideth not: He is like the beasts that perish.

title: Psalms 49:13
text: This their way is their folly: Yet after them men approve their sayings. {{Selah

title: Psalms 49:14
text: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol; Death shall be their shepherd; And the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; And their beauty shall be for Sheol to consume, That there be no habitation for it.

title: Psalms 49:15
text: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol; For he will receive me. {{Selah

title: Psalms 49:16
text: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, When the glory of his house is increased.

title: Psalms 49:17
text: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away; His glory shall not descend after him.

title: Psalms 49:18
text: Though while he lived he blessed his soul (And men praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself,)

title: Psalms 49:19
text: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; They shall never see the light.

title: Psalms 49:20
text: Man that is in honor, and understandeth not, Is like the beasts that perish.

title: Psalms 50
inscription: A Psalm of Asaph

title: Psalms 50:1
text: The Mighty One, God, Jehovah, hath spoken, And called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

title: Psalms 50:2
text: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined forth.

title: Psalms 50:3
text: Our God cometh, and doth not keep silence: A fire devoureth before him, And it is very tempestuous round about him.

title: Psalms 50:4
text: He calleth to the heavens above, And to the earth, that he may judge his people:

title: Psalms 50:5
text: Gather my saints together unto me, Those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

title: Psalms 50:6
text: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness; For God is judge himself. {{Selah

title: Psalms 50:7
text: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify unto thee: I am God, [even] thy God.

title: Psalms 50:8
text: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices; And thy burnt-offerings are continually before me.

title: Psalms 50:9
text: I will take no bullock out of thy house, Nor he-goats out of thy folds.

title: Psalms 50:10
text: For every beast of the forest is mine, And the cattle upon a thousand hills.

title: Psalms 50:11
text: I know all the birds of the mountains; And the wild beasts of the field are mine.

title: Psalms 50:12
text: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee; For the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

title: Psalms 50:13
text: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, Or drink the blood of goats?

title: Psalms 50:14
text: Offer unto God the sacrifice of thanksgiving; And pay thy vows unto the Most High:

title: Psalms 50:15
text: And call upon me in the day of trouble; I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

title: Psalms 50:16
text: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, And that thou hast taken my covenant in thy mouth,

title: Psalms 50:17
text: Seeing thou hatest instruction, And castest my words behind thee?

title: Psalms 50:18
text: When thou sawest a thief, thou consentedst with him, And hast been partaker with adulterers.

title: Psalms 50:19
text: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, And thy tongue frameth deceit.

title: Psalms 50:20
text: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; Thou slanderest thine own mother's son.

title: Psalms 50:21
text: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; Thou thoughtest that I was altogether such a one as thyself: [But] I will reprove thee, and set [them] in order before thine eyes.

title: Psalms 50:22
text: Now consider this, ye that forget God, Lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver:

title: Psalms 50:23
text: Whoso offereth the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifieth me; And to him that ordereth his way [aright] Will I show the salvation of God.

title: Psalms 51
inscription: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David; when Nathan the prophet came unto him, after he had gone in to Bath-sheba

title: Psalms 51:1
text: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: According to the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

title: Psalms 51:2
text: Wash me thoroughly from mine iniquity, And cleanse me from my sin.

title: Psalms 51:3
text: For I know my transgressions; And my sin is ever before me.

title: Psalms 51:4
text: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, And done that which is evil in thy sight; That thou mayest be justified when thou speakest, And be clear when thou judgest.

title: Psalms 51:5
text: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity; And in sin did my mother conceive me.

title: Psalms 51:6
text: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts; And in the hidden part thou wilt make me to know wisdom.

title: Psalms 51:7
text: Purify me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: Wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

title: Psalms 51:8
text: Make me to hear joy and gladness, That the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.

title: Psalms 51:9
text: Hide thy face from my sins, And blot out all mine iniquities.

title: Psalms 51:10
text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; And renew a right spirit within me.

title: Psalms 51:11
text: Cast me not away from thy presence; And take not thy holy Spirit from me.

title: Psalms 51:12
text: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; And uphold me with a willing spirit.

title: Psalms 51:13
text: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; And sinners shall be converted unto thee.

title: Psalms 51:14
text: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation; [And] my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

title: Psalms 51:15
text: O Lord, open thou my lips; And my mouth shall show forth thy praise.

title: Psalms 51:16
text: For thou delightest not in sacrifice; else would I give it: Thou hast no pleasure in burnt-offering.

title: Psalms 51:17
text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: A broken and contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

title: Psalms 51:18
text: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: Build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

title: Psalms 51:19
text: Then will thou delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, In burnt-offering and in whole burnt-offering: Then will they offer bullocks upon thine altar.

title: Psalms 52
inscription: For the Chief Musician. Maschil of David; when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him, David is come to the house of Ahimelech

title: Psalms 52:1
text: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? The lovingkindness of God [endureth] continually.

title: Psalms 52:2
text: Thy tongue deviseth very wickedness, Like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

title: Psalms 52:3
text: Thou lovest evil more than good, And lying rather than to speak righteousness. {{Selah

title: Psalms 52:4
text: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.

title: Psalms 52:5
text: God will likewise destroy thee for ever; He will take thee up, and pluck thee out of thy tent, And root thee out of the land of the living. {{Selah

title: Psalms 52:6
text: The righteous also shall see [it], and fear, And shall laugh at him, [saying] ,

title: Psalms 52:7
text: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength, But trusted in the abundance of his riches, And strengthened himself in his wickedness.

title: Psalms 52:8
text: But as for me, I am like a green olive-tree in the house of God: I trust in the lovingkindness of God for ever and ever.

title: Psalms 52:9
text: I will give thee thanks for ever, because thou hast done it; And I will hope in thy name, for it is good, in the presence of thy saints.

title: Psalms 53
inscription: For the Chief Musician; set to Mahalath. Maschil of David

title: Psalms 53:1
text: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity; There is none that doeth good.

title: Psalms 53:2
text: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there were any that did understand, That did seek after God.

title: Psalms 53:3
text: Every one of them is gone back; They are together become filthy; There is none that doeth good, no, not one.

title: Psalms 53:4
text: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, Who eat up my people [as] they eat bread, And call not upon God?

title: Psalms 53:5
text: There were they in great fear, where no fear was; For God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: Thou hast put them to shame, because of God hath rejected them.

title: Psalms 53:6
text: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Then shall Jacob rejoice, [and] Israel shall be glad.

title: Psalms 54:1
text: [For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. Maschil of David; when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, Doth not David hide himself with us]? Save me, O God, by thy name, And judge me in thy might.

title: Psalms 54:2
text: Hear my prayer, O God; Give ear to the words of my mouth.

title: Psalms 54:3
text: For strangers are risen up against me, And violent men have sought after my soul: They have not set God before them. {{Selah

title: Psalms 54:4
text: Behold, God is my helper: The Lord is of them that uphold my soul.

title: Psalms 54:5
text: He will requite the evil unto mine enemies: Destroy thou them in thy truth.

title: Psalms 54:6
text: With a freewill-offering will I sacrifice unto thee: I will give thanks unto thy name, O Jehovah, for it is good.

title: Psalms 54:7
text: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble; And mine eye hath seen [my desire] upon mine enemies.

title: Psalms 55
inscription: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. Maschil of David

title: Psalms 55:1
text: Give ear to my prayer, O God; And hide not thyself from my supplication.

title: Psalms 55:2
text: Attend unto me, and answer me: I am restless in my complaint, and moan,

title: Psalms 55:3
text: Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the oppression of the wicked; For they cast iniquity upon me, And in anger they persecute me.

title: Psalms 55:4
text: My heart is sore pained within me: And the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

title: Psalms 55:5
text: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, And horror hath overwhelmed me.

title: Psalms 55:6
text: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then would I fly away, and be at rest.

title: Psalms 55:7
text: Lo, then would I wander far off, I would lodge in the wilderness. {{Selah

title: Psalms 55:8
text: I would haste me to a shelter From the stormy wind and tempest.

title: Psalms 55:9
text: Destroy, O Lord, [and] divide their tongue; For I have seen violence and strife in the city.

title: Psalms 55:10
text: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: Iniquity also and mischief are in the midst of it.

title: Psalms 55:11
text: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: Oppression and guile depart not from its streets.

title: Psalms 55:12
text: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; Then I could have borne it: Neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; Then I would have hid myself from him:

title: Psalms 55:13
text: But it was thou, a man mine equal, My companion, and my familiar friend.

title: Psalms 55:14
text: We took sweet counsel together; We walked in the house of God with the throng.

title: Psalms 55:15
text: Let death come suddenly upon them, Let them go down alive into Sheol; For wickedness is in their dwelling, in the midst of them.

title: Psalms 55:16
text: As for me, I will call upon God; And Jehovah will save me.

title: Psalms 55:17
text: Evening, and morning, and at noonday, will I complain, and moan; And he will hear my voice.

title: Psalms 55:18
text: He hath redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me; For they were many [that strove] with me.

title: Psalms 55:19
text: God will hear, and answer them, Even he that abideth of old, {{Selah [The men] who have no changes, And who fear not God.

title: Psalms 55:20
text: He hath put forth his hands against such as were at peace with him: He hath profaned his covenant.

title: Psalms 55:21
text: His mouth was smooth as butter, But his heart was war: His words were softer than oil, Yet were they drawn swords.

title: Psalms 55:22
text: Cast thy burden upon Jehovah, and he will sustain thee: He will never suffer the righteous to be moved.

title: Psalms 55:23
text: But thou, O God, wilt bring them down into the pit of destruction: Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; But I will trust in thee.

title: Psalms 56:1
text: [For the Chief Musician; set to Jonath elem rehokim. [A Psalm] of David. Michtam; when the Philistines took him in Gath]. Be merciful unto me, O God; For man would swallow me up: All the day long he fighting oppresseth me.

title: Psalms 56:2
text: Mine enemies would swallow me up all the day long; For they are many that fight proudly against me.

title: Psalms 56:3
text: What time I am afraid, I will put my trust in thee.

title: Psalms 56:4
text: In God (I will praise his word), In God have I put my trust, I will not be afraid; What can flesh do unto me?

title: Psalms 56:5
text: All the day long they wrest my words: All their thoughts are against me for evil.

title: Psalms 56:6
text: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, They mark my steps, Even as they have waited for my soul.

title: Psalms 56:7
text: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, O God.

title: Psalms 56:8
text: Thou numberest my wanderings: Put thou my tears into thy bottle; Are they not in thy book?

title: Psalms 56:9
text: Then shall mine enemies turn back in the day that I call: This I know, that God is for me.

title: Psalms 56:10
text: In God (I will praise [his] word), In Jehovah (I will praise [his] word),

title: Psalms 56:11
text: In God have I put my trust, I will not be afraid; What can man do unto me?

title: Psalms 56:12
text: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render thank-offerings unto thee.

title: Psalms 56:13
text: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: [Hast thou] not [delivered] my feet from falling, That I may walk before God In the light of the living?

title: Psalms 57:1
text: [For the Chief Musician; [set to] Al-tashheth. [A Psalm] of David. Michtam; when he fled from Saul, in the cave]. Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me; For my soul taketh refuge in thee: Yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I take refuge, Until [these] calamities be overpast.

title: Psalms 57:2
text: I will cry unto God Most High, Unto God that performeth [all things] for me.

title: Psalms 57:3
text: He will send from heaven, and save me, [When] he that would swallow me up reproacheth; {{Selah God will send forth his lovingkindness and his truth.

title: Psalms 57:4
text: My soul is among lions; I lie among them that are set on fire, Even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, And their tongue a sharp sword.

title: Psalms 57:5
text: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; [Let] thy glory [be] above all the earth.

title: Psalms 57:6
text: They have prepared a net for my steps; My soul is bowed down: They have digged a pit before me; They are fallen into the midst thereof themselves. {{Selah

title: Psalms 57:7
text: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing, yea, I will sing praises.

title: Psalms 57:8
text: Awake up, my glory; Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake right early.

title: Psalms 57:9
text: I will give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the peoples: I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

title: Psalms 57:10
text: For thy lovingkindness is great unto the heavens, And thy truth unto the skies.

title: Psalms 57:11
text: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; [Let] thy glory [be] above all the earth.

title: Psalms 58:1
text: [For the Chief Musician; [set to] Al-tashheth. [A Psalm] of David. Michtam]. Do ye indeed in silence speak righteousness? Do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?

title: Psalms 58:2
text: Nay, in heart ye work wickedness; Ye weigh out the violence of your hands in the earth.

title: Psalms 58:3
text: The wicked are estranged from the womb: They go astray as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

title: Psalms 58:4
text: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: [They are] like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear,

title: Psalms 58:5
text: Which hearkeneth not to the voice of charmers, Charming never so wisely.

title: Psalms 58:6
text: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: Break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Jehovah.

title: Psalms 58:7
text: Let them melt away as water that runneth apace: When he aimeth his arrows, let them be as though they were cut off.

title: Psalms 58:8
text: [ Let them be] as a snail which melteth and passeth away, [Like] the untimely birth of a woman, that hath not seen the sun.

title: Psalms 58:9
text: Before your pots can feel the thorns, He will take them away with a whirlwind, the green and the burning alike.

title: Psalms 58:10
