text: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked;

title: Psalms 58:11
text: So that men shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: Verily there is a God that judgeth in the earth.

title: Psalms 59:1
text: [For the Chief Musician; [set to] Al-tashheth. [A Psalm] of David. Michtam; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him]. Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: Set me on high from them that rise up against me.

title: Psalms 59:2
text: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, And save me from the bloodthirsty men.

title: Psalms 59:3
text: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul; The mighty gather themselves together against me: Not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Jehovah.

title: Psalms 59:4
text: They run and prepare themselves without [my] fault: Awake thou to help me, and behold.

title: Psalms 59:5
text: Even thou, O Jehovah God of hosts, the God of Israel, Arise to visit all the nations: Be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. {{Selah

title: Psalms 59:6
text: They return at evening, they howl like a dog, And go round about the city.

title: Psalms 59:7
text: Behold, they belch out with their mouth; Swords are in their lips: For who, [say they], doth hear?

title: Psalms 59:8
text: But thou, O Jehovah, wilt laugh at them; Thou wilt have all the nations in derision.

title: Psalms 59:9
text: [Because of] his strength I will give heed unto thee; For God is my high tower.

title: Psalms 59:10
text: My God with his lovingkindness will meet me: God will let me see [my desire] upon mine enemies.

title: Psalms 59:11
text: Slay them not, lest my people forget: Scatter them by thy power, and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

title: Psalms 59:12
text: [ For] the sin of their mouth, [and] the words of their lips, Let them even be taken in their pride, And for cursing and lying which they speak.

title: Psalms 59:13
text: Consume them in wrath, consume them, so that they shall be no more: And let them know that God ruleth in Jacob, Unto the ends of the earth. {{Selah

title: Psalms 59:14
text: And at evening let them return, let them howl like a dog, And go round about the city.

title: Psalms 59:15
text: They shall wander up and down for food, And tarry all night if they be not satisfied.

title: Psalms 59:16
text: But I will sing of thy strength; Yea, I will sing aloud of thy lovingkindness in the morning: For thou hast been my high tower, And a refuge in the day of my distress.

title: Psalms 59:17
text: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing praises: For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.

title: Psalms 60
inscription: For the Chief Musician; set to Shushan Eduth. Michtam of David, to teach; when he strove with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah, and Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the Valley of Salt twelve thousand

title: Psalms 60:1
text: O God thou hast cast us off, thou hast broken us down; Thou hast been angry; oh restore us again.

title: Psalms 60:2
text: Thou hast made the land to tremble; thou hast rent it: Heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

title: Psalms 60:3
text: Thou hast showed thy people hard things: Thou hast made us to drink the wine of staggering.

title: Psalms 60:4
text: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, That it may be displayed because of the truth. {{Selah

title: Psalms 60:5
text: That thy beloved may be delivered, Save with thy right hand, and answer us.

title: Psalms 60:6
text: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

title: Psalms 60:7
text: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.

title: Psalms 60:8
text: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom will I cast my shoe: Philistia, shout thou because of me.

title: Psalms 60:9
text: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who hath led me unto Edom?

title: Psalms 60:10
text: Hast not thou, O God, cast us off? And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.

title: Psalms 60:11
text: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.

title: Psalms 60:12
text: Through God we shall do valiantly; For he it is that will tread down our adversaries.

title: Psalms 61:1
text: [For the Chief Musician; on a stringed instrument. [A Psalm] of David]. Hear my cry, O God; Attend unto my prayer.

title: Psalms 61:2
text: From the end of the earth will I call unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

title: Psalms 61:3
text: For thou hast been a refuge for me, A strong tower from the enemy.

title: Psalms 61:4
text: I will dwell in thy tabernacle for ever: I will take refuge in the covert of thy wings. {{Selah

title: Psalms 61:5
text: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: Thou hast given [me] the heritage of those that fear thy name.

title: Psalms 61:6
text: Thou wilt prolong the king's life; His years shall be as many generations.

title: Psalms 61:7
text: He shall abide before God for ever: Oh prepare lovingkindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

title: Psalms 61:8
text: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, That I may daily perform my vows.

title: Psalms 62
inscription: For the Chief Musician; after the manner of Jeduthun. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 62:1
text: My soul waiteth in silence for God only: From him [cometh] my salvation.

title: Psalms 62:2
text: He only is my rock and my salvation: [He is] my high tower; I shall not be greatly moved.

title: Psalms 62:3
text: How long will ye set upon a man, That ye may slay [him], all of you, Like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

title: Psalms 62:4
text: They only consult to thrust him down from his dignity; They delight in lies; They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. {{Selah

title: Psalms 62:5
text: My soul, wait thou in silence for God only; For my expectation is from him.

title: Psalms 62:6
text: He only is my rock and my salvation: [He is] my high tower; I shall not be moved.

title: Psalms 62:7
text: With God is my salvation and my glory: The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

title: Psalms 62:8
text: Trust in him at all times, ye people; Pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. {{Selah

title: Psalms 62:9
text: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: In the balances they will go up; They are together lighter than vanity.

title: Psalms 62:10
text: Trust not in oppression, And become not vain in robbery: If riches increase, set not your heart [thereon] .

title: Psalms 62:11
text: God hath spoken once, Twice have I heard this, That power belongeth unto God.

title: Psalms 62:12
text: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth lovingkindness; For thou renderest to every man according to his work.

title: Psalms 63
inscription: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah

title: Psalms 63:1
text: O God, thou art my God; earnestly will I seek thee: My soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee, In a dry and weary land, where no water is.

title: Psalms 63:2
text: So have I looked upon thee in the sanctuary, To see thy power and thy glory.

title: Psalms 63:3
text: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, My lips shall praise thee.

title: Psalms 63:4
text: So will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

title: Psalms 63:5
text: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; And my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips;

title: Psalms 63:6
text: When I remember thee upon my bed, [And] meditate on thee in the night-watches.

title: Psalms 63:7
text: For thou hast been my help, And in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

title: Psalms 63:8
text: My soul followeth hard after thee: Thy right hand upholdeth me.

title: Psalms 63:9
text: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, Shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

title: Psalms 63:10
text: They shall be given over to the power of the sword: They shall be a portion for foxes.

title: Psalms 63:11
text: But the king shall rejoice in God: Every one that sweareth by him shall glory; For the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

title: Psalms 64
inscription: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 64:1
text: Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint: Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

title: Psalms 64:2
text: Hide me from the secret counsel of evil-doers, From the tumult of the workers of iniquity;

title: Psalms 64:3
text: Who have whet their tongue like a sword, And have aimed their arrows, even bitter words,

title: Psalms 64:4
text: That they may shoot in secret places at the perfect: Suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

title: Psalms 64:5
text: They encourage themselves in an evil purpose; They commune of laying snares privily; They say, Who will see them?

title: Psalms 64:6
text: They search out iniquities; We have accomplished, [say they], a diligent search: And the inward thought and the heart of every one is deep.

title: Psalms 64:7
text: But God will shoot at them; With an arrow suddenly shall they be wounded.

title: Psalms 64:8
text: So they shall be made to stumble, their own tongue being against them: All that see them shall wag the head.

title: Psalms 64:9
text: And all men shall fear; And they shall declare the work of God, And shall wisely consider of his doing.

title: Psalms 64:10
text: The righteous shall be glad in Jehovah, and shall take refuge in him; And all the upright in heart shall glory.

title: Psalms 65
inscription: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm. A Song of David

title: Psalms 65:1
text: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Zion; And unto thee shall the vow be performed.

title: Psalms 65:2
text: O thou that hearest prayer, Unto thee shall all flesh come.

title: Psalms 65:3
text: Iniquities prevail against me: As for our transgressions, thou wilt forgive them.

title: Psalms 65:4
text: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach [unto thee], That he may dwell in thy courts: We shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, Thy holy temple.

title: Psalms 65:5
text: By terrible things thou wilt answer us in righteousness, Oh God of our salvation, Thou that art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, And of them that are afar off upon the sea:

title: Psalms 65:6
text: Who by his strength setteth fast the mountains, Being girded about with might;

title: Psalms 65:7
text: Who stilleth the roaring of the seas, The roaring of their waves, And the tumult of the peoples.

title: Psalms 65:8
text: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: Thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

title: Psalms 65:9
text: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it, Thou greatly enrichest it; The river of God is full of water: Thou providest them grain, when thou hast so prepared the earth. [

title: Psalms 65:10
text: Thou waterest its furrows abundantly; Thou settlest the ridges thereof: Thou makest it soft with showers; Thou blessest the springing thereof.

title: Psalms 65:11
text: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; And thy paths drop fatness.

title: Psalms 65:12
text: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness; And the hills are girded with joy.

title: Psalms 65:13
text: The pastures are clothed with flocks; The valleys also are covered over with grain; They shout for joy, they also sing.

title: Psalms 66
inscription: For the Chief Musician. A Song, a Psalm

title: Psalms 66:1
text: Make a joyful noise unto God, all the earth:

title: Psalms 66:2
text: Sing forth the glory of his name: Make his praise glorious.

title: Psalms 66:3
text: Say unto God, How terrible are thy works! Through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.

title: Psalms 66:4
text: All the earth shall worship thee, And shall sing unto thee; They shall sing to thy name. {{Selah

title: Psalms 66:5
text: Come, and see the works of God; [He is] terrible in his doing toward the children of men.

title: Psalms 66:6
text: He turned the sea into dry land; They went through the river on foot: There did we rejoice in him.

title: Psalms 66:7
text: He ruleth by his might for ever; His eyes observe the nations: Let not the rebellious exalt themselves. {{Selah

title: Psalms 66:8
text: Oh bless our God, ye peoples, And make the voice of his praise to be heard;

title: Psalms 66:9
text: Who holdeth our soul in life, And suffereth not our feet to be moved.

title: Psalms 66:10
text: For thou, O God, hast proved us: Thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

title: Psalms 66:11
text: Thou broughtest us into the net; Thou layedst a sore burden upon our loins.

title: Psalms 66:12
text: Thou didst cause men to ride over our heads; We went through fire and through water; But thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.

title: Psalms 66:13
text: I will come into thy house with burnt-offerings; I will pay thee my vows,

title: Psalms 66:14
text: Which my lips uttered, And my mouth spake, when I was in distress.

title: Psalms 66:15
text: I will offer unto thee burnt-offerings of fatlings, With the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. {{Selah

title: Psalms 66:16
text: Come, and hear, all ye that fear God, And I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

title: Psalms 66:17
text: I cried unto him with my mouth, And he was extolled with my tongue.

title: Psalms 66:18
text: If I regard iniquity in my heart, The Lord will not hear:

title: Psalms 66:19
text: But verily God hath heard; He hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

title: Psalms 66:20
text: Blessed be God, Who hath not turned away my prayer, Nor his lovingkindness from me.

title: Psalms 67
inscription: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm, a Song

title: Psalms 67:1
text: God be merciful unto us, and bless us, [And] cause his face to shine upon us; {{Selah

title: Psalms 67:2
text: That thy way may be known upon earth, Thy salvation among all nations.

title: Psalms 67:3
text: Let the peoples praise thee, O God; Let all the peoples praise thee.

title: Psalms 67:4
text: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy; For thou wilt judge the peoples with equity, And govern the nations upon earth. {{Selah

title: Psalms 67:5
text: Let the peoples praise thee, O God; Let all the peoples praise thee.

title: Psalms 67:6
text: The earth hath yielded its increase: God, even our own God, will bless us.

title: Psalms 67:7
text: God will bless us; And all the ends of the earth shall fear him.

title: Psalms 68
inscription: For the Chief Musician; A Psalm of David, a Song

title: Psalms 68:1
text: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered; Let them also that hate him flee before him.

title: Psalms 68:2
text: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: As wax melteth before the fire, So let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

title: Psalms 68:3
text: But let the righteous be glad; let them exult before God: Yea, let them rejoice with gladness.

title: Psalms 68:4
text: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: Cast up a highway for him that rideth through the deserts; His name is Jehovah; and exult ye before him.

title: Psalms 68:5
text: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, Is God in his holy habitation.

title: Psalms 68:6
text: God setteth the solitary in families: He bringeth out the prisoners into prosperity; But the rebellious dwell in a parched land.

title: Psalms 68:7
text: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, When thou didst march through the wilderness; {{Selah

title: Psalms 68:8
text: The earth trembled, The heavens also dropped [rain] at the presence of God: Yon Sinai [trembled] at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

title: Psalms 68:9
text: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, Thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.

title: Psalms 68:10
text: Thy congregation dwelt therein: Thou, O God, didst prepare of thy goodness for the poor.

title: Psalms 68:11
text: The Lord giveth the word: The women that publish the tidings are a great host.

title: Psalms 68:12
text: Kings of armies flee, they flee; And she that tarrieth at home divideth the spoil.

title: Psalms 68:13
text: When ye lie among the sheepfolds, [It is as] the wings of a dove covered with silver, And her pinions with yellow gold.

title: Psalms 68:14
text: When the Almighty scattered kings therein, [It was as when] it snoweth in Zalmon.

title: Psalms 68:15
text: A mountain of God is the mountain of Bashan; A high mountain is the mountain of Bashan.

title: Psalms 68:16
text: Why look ye askance, ye high mountains, At the mountain which God hath desired for his abode? Yea, Jehovah will dwell [in it] for ever.

title: Psalms 68:17
text: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands upon thousands; The Lord is among them, [as in] Sinai, in the sanctuary.

title: Psalms 68:18
text: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led away captives; Thou hast received gifts among men, Yea, [among] the rebellious also, that Jehovah God might dwell [with them] .

title: Psalms 68:19
text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily beareth our burden, Even the God who is our salvation. {{Selah

title: Psalms 68:20
text: God is unto us a God of deliverances; And unto Jehovah the Lord belongeth escape from death.

title: Psalms 68:21
text: But God will smite through the head of his enemies, The hairy scalp of such a one as goeth on still in his guiltiness.

title: Psalms 68:22
text: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring [them] again from the depths of the sea;

title: Psalms 68:23
text: That thou mayest crush [them], [dipping] thy foot in blood, That the tongue of thy dogs may have its portion from [thine] enemies.

title: Psalms 68:24
text: They have seen thy goings, O God, Even the goings of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

title: Psalms 68:25
text: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, In the midst of the damsels playing with timbrels.

title: Psalms 68:26
text: Bless ye God in the congregations, Even the Lord, [ye that are] of the fountain of Israel.

title: Psalms 68:27
text: There is little Benjamin their ruler, The princes of Judah [and] their council, The princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.

title: Psalms 68:28
text: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: Strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.

title: Psalms 68:29
text: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem Kings shall bring presents unto thee.

title: Psalms 68:30
text: Rebuke the wild beast of the reeds, The multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the peoples, Trampling under foot the pieces of silver: He hath scattered the peoples that delight in war.

title: Psalms 68:31
text: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall haste to stretch out her hands unto God.

title: Psalms 68:32
text: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; Oh sing praises unto the Lord; {{Selah

title: Psalms 68:33
text: To him that rideth upon the heaven of heavens, which are of old; Lo, he uttereth his voice, a mighty voice.

title: Psalms 68:34
text: Ascribe ye strength unto God: His excellency is over Israel, And his strength is in the skies.

title: Psalms 68:35
text: O God, [thou art] terrible out of thy holy places: The God of Israel, he giveth strength and power unto [his] people. Blessed be God.

title: Psalms 69:1
text: [For the Chief Musician; set to Shoshannim, [A Psalm] of David]. Save me, O God; For the waters are come in unto my soul.

title: Psalms 69:2
text: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

title: Psalms 69:3
text: I am weary with my crying; my throat is dried: Mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

title: Psalms 69:4
text: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head: They that would cut me off, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: That which I took not away I have to restore.

title: Psalms 69:5
text: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; And my sins are not hid from thee.

title: Psalms 69:6
text: Let not them that wait for thee be put to shame through me, O Lord Jehovah of hosts: Let not those that seek thee be brought to dishonor through me, O God of Israel.

title: Psalms 69:7
text: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; Shame hath covered my face.

title: Psalms 69:8
text: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, And an alien unto my mother's children.

title: Psalms 69:9
text: For the zeal of thy house hath eaten me up; And the reproaches of them that reproach thee are fallen upon me.

title: Psalms 69:10
text: When I wept, [and chastened] my soul with fasting, That was to my reproach.

title: Psalms 69:11
text: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword unto them.

title: Psalms 69:12
text: They that sit in the gate talk of me; And [I am] the song of the drunkards.

title: Psalms 69:13
text: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O Jehovah, in an acceptable time: O God, in the abundance of thy lovingkindness, Answer me in the truth of thy salvation.

title: Psalms 69:14
text: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: Let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

title: Psalms 69:15
text: Let not the waterflood overwhelm me, Neither let the deep shallow me up; And let not the pit shut its mouth upon me.

title: Psalms 69:16
text: Answer me, O Jehovah; for thy lovingkindness is good: According to the multitude of thy tender mercies turn thou unto me.

title: Psalms 69:17
text: And hide not thy face from thy servant; For I am in distress; answer me speedily.

title: Psalms 69:18
text: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: Ransom me because of mine enemies.

title: Psalms 69:19
text: Thou knowest my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonor: Mine adversaries are all before thee.

title: Psalms 69:20
text: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: And I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; And for comforters, but I found none.

title: Psalms 69:21
text: They gave me also gall for my food; And in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

title: Psalms 69:22
text: Let their table before them become a snare; And when they are in peace, [let it become] a trap.

title: Psalms 69:23
text: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they cannot see; And make their loins continually to shake.

title: Psalms 69:24
text: Pour out thine indignation upon them, And let the fierceness of thine anger overtake them.

title: Psalms 69:25
text: Let their habitation be desolate; Let none dwell in their tents.

title: Psalms 69:26
text: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; And they tell of the sorrow of those whom thou hast wounded.

title: Psalms 69:27
text: Add iniquity unto their iniquity; And let them not come into thy righteousness.

title: Psalms 69:28
text: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, And not be written with the righteous.

title: Psalms 69:29
text: But I am poor and sorrowful: Let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

title: Psalms 69:30
text: I will praise the name of God with a song, And will magnify him with thanksgiving.

title: Psalms 69:31
text: And it will please Jehovah better than an ox, [Or] a bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

title: Psalms 69:32
text: The meek have seen it, and are glad: Ye that seek after God, let your heart live.

title: Psalms 69:33
text: For Jehovah heareth the needy, And despiseth not his prisoners.

title: Psalms 69:34
text: Let heaven and earth praise him, The seas, and everything that moveth therein.

title: Psalms 69:35
text: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah; And they shall abide there, and have it in possession.

title: Psalms 69:36
text: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it; And they that love his name shall dwell therein.

title: Psalms 70:1
text: [For the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David; to bring to remembrance]. [Make haste], O God, to deliver me; Make haste to help me, O Jehovah.

title: Psalms 70:2
text: Let them be put to shame and confounded That seek after my soul: Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor That delight in my hurt.

title: Psalms 70:3
text: Let them be turned back by reason of their shame That say, Aha, aha.

title: Psalms 70:4
text: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee; And let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

title: Psalms 70:5
text: But I am poor and needy; Make haste unto me, O God: Thou art my help and my deliverer; O Jehovah, make no tarrying.

title: Psalms 71:1
text: In thee, O Jehovah, do I take refuge: Let me never be put to shame.

title: Psalms 71:2
text: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and rescue me: Bow down thine ear unto me, and save me.

title: Psalms 71:3
text: Be thou to me a rock of habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: Thou hast given commandment to save me; For thou art my rock and my fortress.

title: Psalms 71:4
text: Rescue me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, Out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

title: Psalms 71:5
text: For thou art my hope, O Lord Jehovah: [Thou art] my trust from my youth.

title: Psalms 71:6
text: By thee have I been holden up from the womb; Thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: My praise shall be continually of thee.

title: Psalms 71:7
text: I am as a wonder unto many; But thou art my strong refuge.

title: Psalms 71:8
text: My mouth shall be filled with thy praise, And with thy honor all the day.

title: Psalms 71:9
text: Cast me not off in the time of old age; Forsake me not when my strength faileth.

title: Psalms 71:10
text: For mine enemies speak concerning me; And they that watch for my soul take counsel together,

title: Psalms 71:11
text: Saying, God hath forsaken him: Pursue and take him; For there is none to deliver.

title: Psalms 71:12
text: O God, be not far from me; O my God, make haste to help me.

title: Psalms 71:13
text: Let them be put to shame [and] consumed that are adversaries to my soul; Let them be covered with reproach and dishonor that seek my hurt.

title: Psalms 71:14
text: But I will hope continually, And will praise thee yet more and more.

title: Psalms 71:15
text: My mouth shall tell of thy righteousness, [And] of thy salvation all the day; For I know not the numbers [thereof] .

title: Psalms 71:16
text: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Jehovah: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.

title: Psalms 71:17
text: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth; And hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.

title: Psalms 71:18
text: Yea, even when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not, Until I have declared thy strength unto [the next] generation, Thy might to every one that is to come.

title: Psalms 71:19
text: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high; Thou who hast done great things, O God, who is like unto thee?

title: Psalms 71:20
text: Thou, who hast showed us many and sore troubles, Wilt quicken us again, And wilt bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

title: Psalms 71:21
text: Increase thou my greatness, And turn again and comfort me.

title: Psalms 71:22
text: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, [Even] thy truth, O my God: Unto thee will I sing praises with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.

title: Psalms 71:23
text: My lips shall shout for joy when I sing praises unto thee; And my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

title: Psalms 71:24
text: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long; For they are put to shame, for they are confounded, that seek my hurt.

title: Psalms 72:1
text: [[ A Psalm] of Solomon]. Give the king thy judgments, O God, And thy righteousness unto the king's son.

title: Psalms 72:2
text: He will judge thy people with righteousness, And thy poor with justice.

title: Psalms 72:3
text: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, And the hills, in righteousness.

title: Psalms 72:4
text: He will judge the poor of the people, He will save the children of the needy, And will break in pieces the oppressor.

title: Psalms 72:5
text: They shall fear thee while the sun endureth, And so long as the moon, throughout all generations.

title: Psalms 72:6
text: He will come down like rain upon the mown grass, As showers that water the earth.

title: Psalms 72:7
text: In his days shall the righteous flourish, And abundance of peace, till the moon be no more.

title: Psalms 72:8
text: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, And from the River unto the ends of the earth.

title: Psalms 72:9
text: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; And his enemies shall lick the dust.

title: Psalms 72:10
text: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall render tribute: The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

title: Psalms 72:11
text: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him; All nations shall serve him.

title: Psalms 72:12
text: For he will deliver the needy when he crieth, And the poor, that hath no helper.

title: Psalms 72:13
text: He will have pity on the poor and needy, And the souls of the needy he will save.

title: Psalms 72:14
text: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence; And precious will their blood be in his sight:

title: Psalms 72:15
text: And they shall live; and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: And men shall pray for him continually; They shall bless him all the day long.

title: Psalms 72:16
text: There shall be abundance of grain in the earth upon the top of the mountains; The fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: And they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

title: Psalms 72:17
text: His name shall endure for ever; His name shall be continued as long as the sun: And men shall be blessed in him; All nations shall call him happy.

title: Psalms 72:18
text: Blessed be Jehovah God, the God of Israel, Who only doeth wondrous things:

title: Psalms 72:19
text: And blessed be his glorious name for ever; And let the whole earth be filled with his glory. Amen, and Amen.

title: Psalms 72:20
text: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

title: Psalms 73
inscription: A Psalm of Asaph

title: Psalms 73:1
text: Surely God is good to Israel, [Even] to such as are pure in heart.

title: Psalms 73:2
text: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; My steps had well nigh slipped.

title: Psalms 73:3
text: For I was envious at the arrogant, When I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

title: Psalms 73:4
text: For there are no pangs in their death; But their strength is firm.

title: Psalms 73:5
text: They are not in trouble as [other] men; Neither are they plagued like [other] men.

title: Psalms 73:6
text: Therefore pride is as a chain about their neck; Violence covereth them as a garment.

title: Psalms 73:7
text: Their eyes stand out with fatness: They have more than heart could wish.

title: Psalms 73:8
text: They scoff, and in wickedness utter oppression: They speak loftily.

title: Psalms 73:9
text: They have set their mouth in the heavens, And their tongue walketh through the earth.

title: Psalms 73:10
text: Therefore his people return hither: And waters of a full [cup] are drained by them.

title: Psalms 73:11
text: And they say, How doth God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?

title: Psalms 73:12
text: Behold, these are the wicked; And, being alway at ease, they increase in riches.

title: Psalms 73:13
text: Surely in vain have I cleansed my heart, And washed my hands in innocency;

title: Psalms 73:14
text: For all the day long have I been plagued, And chastened every morning.

title: Psalms 73:15
text: If I had said, I will speak thus; Behold, I had dealt treacherously with the generation of thy children.

title: Psalms 73:16
text: When I thought how I might know this, It was too painful for me;

title: Psalms 73:17
text: Until I went into the sanctuary of God, And considered their latter end.

title: Psalms 73:18
text: Surely thou settest them in slippery places: Thou castest them down to destruction.

title: Psalms 73:19
text: How are they become a desolation in a moment! They are utterly consumed with terrors.

title: Psalms 73:20
text: As a dream when one awaketh, So, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou wilt despise their image.

title: Psalms 73:21
text: For my soul was grieved, And I was pricked in my heart:

title: Psalms 73:22
text: So brutish was I, and ignorant; I was [as] a beast before thee.

title: Psalms 73:23
text: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: Thou hast holden my right hand.

title: Psalms 73:24
text: Thou wilt guide me with thy counsel, And afterward receive me to glory.

title: Psalms 73:25
text: Whom have I in heaven [but thee] ? And there is none upon earth that I desire besides thee.

title: Psalms 73:26
text: My flesh and my heart faileth; [But] God is the strength of my heart and my portion for ever.

title: Psalms 73:27
text: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: Thou hast destroyed all them that play the harlot, [departing] from thee.

title: Psalms 73:28
text: But it is good for me to draw near unto God: I have made the Lord Jehovah my refuge, That I may tell of all thy works.

title: Psalms 74
inscription: Maschil of Asaph

title: Psalms 74:1
text: O God, why hast thou cast [us] off for ever? Why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

title: Psalms 74:2
text: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast gotten of old, Which thou hast redeemed to be the tribe of thine inheritance; [And] mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

title: Psalms 74:3
text: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual ruins, All the evil that the enemy hath done in the sanctuary.

title: Psalms 74:4
text: Thine adversaries have roared in the midst of thine assembly; They have set up their ensigns for signs.

title: Psalms 74:5
text: They seemed as men that lifted up Axes upon a thicket of trees.

title: Psalms 74:6
text: And now all the carved work thereof They break down with hatchet and hammers.

title: Psalms 74:7
text: They have set thy sanctuary on fire; They have profaned the dwelling-place of thy name [by casting it] to the ground.

title: Psalms 74:8
text: They said in their heart, Let us make havoc of them altogether: They have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.

title: Psalms 74:9
text: We see not our signs: There is no more any prophet; Neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.

title: Psalms 74:10
text: How long, O God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

title: Psalms 74:11
text: Why drawest thou back thy hand, even thy right hand? [Pluck it] out of thy bosom [and] consume [them] .

title: Psalms 74:12
text: Yet God is my King of old, Working salvation in the midst of the earth.

title: Psalms 74:13
text: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: Thou brakest the heads of the sea-monsters in the waters.

title: Psalms 74:14
text: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces; Thou gavest him to be food to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

title: Psalms 74:15
text: Thou didst cleave fountain and flood: Thou driedst up mighty rivers.

title: Psalms 74:16
text: The day is thine, the night also is thine: Thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

title: Psalms 74:17
text: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: Thou hast made summer and winter.

title: Psalms 74:18
text: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O Jehovah, And that a foolish people hath blasphemed thy name.

title: Psalms 74:19
text: Oh deliver not the soul of thy turtle-dove unto the wild beast: Forget not the life of thy poor for ever.

title: Psalms 74:20
text: Have respect unto the covenant; For the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of violence.

title: Psalms 74:21
text: Oh let not the oppressed return ashamed: Let the poor and needy praise thy name.

title: Psalms 74:22
text: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: Remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee all the day.

title: Psalms 74:23
text: Forget not the voice of thine adversaries: The tumult of those that rise up against thee ascendeth continually.

title: Psalms 75:1
text: [For the Chief Musician; [set to] Al-tashheth. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song]. We give thanks unto thee, O God; We give thanks, for thy name is near: Men tell of thy wondrous works.

title: Psalms 75:2
text: When I shall find the set time, I will judge uprightly.

title: Psalms 75:3
text: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I have set up the pillars of it. {{Selah

title: Psalms 75:4
text: I said unto the arrogant, Deal not arrogantly; And to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

title: Psalms 75:5
text: Lift not up your horn on high; Speak not with a stiff neck.

title: Psalms 75:6
text: For neither from the east, nor from the west, Nor yet from the south, [cometh] lifting up.

title: Psalms 75:7
text: But God is the judge: He putteth down one, and lifteth up another.

title: Psalms 75:8
text: For in the hand of Jehovah there is a cup, and the wine foameth; It is full of mixture, and he poureth out of the same: Surely the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall drain them, and drink them.

title: Psalms 75:9
text: But I will declare for ever, I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

title: Psalms 75:10
text: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; But the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.

title: Psalms 76
inscription: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song

title: Psalms 76:1
text: In Judah is God known: His name is great in Israel.

title: Psalms 76:2
text: In Salem also is his tabernacle, And his dwelling-place in Zion.

title: Psalms 76:3
text: There he brake the arrows of the bow; The shield, and the sword, and the battle. {{Selah

title: Psalms 76:4
text: Glorious art thou [and] excellent, From the mountains of prey.

title: Psalms 76:5
text: The stouthearted are made a spoil, They have slept their sleep; And none of the men of might have found their hands.

title: Psalms 76:6
text: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, Both chariot and horse are cast into a deep sleep.

title: Psalms 76:7
text: Thou, even thou, art to be feared; And who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?

title: Psalms 76:8
text: Thou didst cause sentence to be heard from heaven; The earth feared, and was still,

title: Psalms 76:9
text: When God arose to judgment, To save all the meek of the earth. {{Selah

title: Psalms 76:10
text: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: The residue of wrath shalt thou gird upon thee.

title: Psalms 76:11
text: Vow, and pay unto Jehovah your God: Let all that are round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.

title: Psalms 76:12
text: He will cut off the spirit of princes: He is terrible to the kings of the earth.

title: Psalms 77
inscription: For the Chief Musician; afer the manner of Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph

title: Psalms 77:1
text: I will cry unto God with my voice, Even unto God with my voice; and he will give ear unto me.

title: Psalms 77:2
text: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: My hand was stretched out in the night, and slacked not; My soul refused to be comforted.

title: Psalms 77:3
text: I remember God, and am disquieted: I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. {{Selah

title: Psalms 77:4
text: Thou holdest mine eyes watching: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

title: Psalms 77:5
text: I have considered the days of old, The years of ancient times.

title: Psalms 77:6
text: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart; And my spirit maketh diligent search.

title: Psalms 77:7
text: Will the Lord cast off for ever? And will he be favorable no more?

title: Psalms 77:8
text: Is his lovingkindness clean gone for ever? Doth his promise fail for evermore?

title: Psalms 77:9
text: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? Hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? {{Selah

title: Psalms 77:10
text: And I said, This is my infirmity; [But I will remember] the years of the right hand of the Most High.

title: Psalms 77:11
text: I will make mention of the deeds of Jehovah; For I will remember thy wonders of old.

title: Psalms 77:12
text: I will meditate also upon all thy work, And muse on thy doings.

title: Psalms 77:13
text: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: Who is a great god like unto God?

title: Psalms 77:14
text: Thou art the God that doest wonders: Thou hast made known thy strength among the peoples.

title: Psalms 77:15
text: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, The sons of Jacob and Joseph. {{Selah

title: Psalms 77:16
text: The waters saw thee, O God; The waters saw thee, they were afraid: The depths also trembled.

title: Psalms 77:17
text: The clouds poured out water; The skies sent out a sound: Thine arrows also went abroad.

title: Psalms 77:18
text: The voice of thy thunder was in the whirlwind; The lightnings lightened the world: The earth trembled and shook.

title: Psalms 77:19
text: Thy way was in the sea, And thy paths in the great waters, And thy footsteps were not known.

title: Psalms 77:20
text: Thou leddest thy people like a flock, By the hand of Moses and Aaron.

title: Psalms 78
inscription: Maschil of Asaph

title: Psalms 78:1
text: Give ear, O my people, to my law: Incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

title: Psalms 78:2
text: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will utter dark sayings of old,

title: Psalms 78:3
text: Which we have heard and known, And our fathers have told us.

title: Psalms 78:4
text: We will not hide them from their children, Telling to the generation to come the praises of Jehovah, And his strength, and his wondrous works that he hath done.

title: Psalms 78:5
text: For he established a testimony in Jacob, And appointed a law in Israel, Which he commanded our fathers, That they should make them known to their children;

title: Psalms 78:6
text: That the generation to come might know [them], even the children that should be born; Who should arise and tell [them] to their children,

title: Psalms 78:7
text: That they might set their hope in God, And not forget the works of God, But keep his commandments,

title: Psalms 78:8
text: And might not be as their fathers, A stubborn and rebellious generation, A generation that set not their heart aright, And whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

title: Psalms 78:9
text: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, Turned back in the day of battle.

title: Psalms 78:10
text: They kept not the covenant of God, And refused to walk in his law;

title: Psalms 78:11
text: And they forgat his doings, And his wondrous works that he had showed them.

title: Psalms 78:12
text: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, In the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

title: Psalms 78:13
text: He clave the sea, and caused them to pass through; And he made the waters to stand as a heap.

title: Psalms 78:14
text: In the day-time also he led them with a cloud, And all the night with a light of fire.

title: Psalms 78:15
text: He clave rocks in the wilderness, And gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

title: Psalms 78:16
text: He brought streams also out of the rock, And caused waters to run down like rivers.

title: Psalms 78:17
text: Yet went they on still to sin against him, To rebel against the Most High in the desert.

title: Psalms 78:18
text: And they tempted God in their heart By asking food according to their desire.

title: Psalms 78:19
text: Yea, they spake against God; They said, Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

title: Psalms 78:20
text: Behold, he smote the rock, so that waters gushed out, And streams overflowed; Can he give bread also? Will he provide flesh for his people?

title: Psalms 78:21
text: Therefore Jehovah heard, and was wroth; And a fire was kindled against Jacob, And anger also went up against Israel;

title: Psalms 78:22
text: Because they believed not in God, And trusted not in his salvation.

title: Psalms 78:23
text: Yet he commanded the skies above, And opened the doors of heaven;

title: Psalms 78:24
text: And he rained down manna upon them to eat, And gave them food from heaven.

title: Psalms 78:25
text: Man did eat the bread of the mighty: He sent them food to the full.

title: Psalms 78:26
text: He caused the east wind to blow in the heavens; And by his power he guided the south wind.

title: Psalms 78:27
text: He rained flesh also upon them as the dust, And winged birds as the sand of the seas:

title: Psalms 78:28
text: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, Round about their habitations.

title: Psalms 78:29
text: So they did eat, and were well filled; And he gave them their own desire.

title: Psalms 78:30
text: They were not estranged from that which they desired, Their food was yet in their mouths,

title: Psalms 78:31
text: When the anger of God went up against them, And slew of the fattest of them, And smote down the young men of Israel.

title: Psalms 78:32
text: For all this they sinned still, And believed not in his wondrous works.

title: Psalms 78:33
text: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, And their years in terror.

title: Psalms 78:34
text: When he slew them, then they inquired after him; And they returned and sought God earnestly.

title: Psalms 78:35
text: And they remembered that God was their rock, And the Most High God their redeemer.

title: Psalms 78:36
text: But they flattered him with their mouth, And lied unto him with their tongue.

title: Psalms 78:37
text: For their heart was not right with him, Neither were they faithful in his covenant.

title: Psalms 78:38
text: But he, being merciful, forgave [their] iniquity, and destroyed [them] not: Yea, many a time turned he his anger away, And did not stir up all his wrath.

title: Psalms 78:39
text: And he remembered that they were but flesh, A wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

title: Psalms 78:40
text: How oft did they rebel against him in the wilderness, And grieve him in the desert!

title: Psalms 78:41
text: And they turned again and tempted God, And provoked the Holy One of Israel.

title: Psalms 78:42
text: They remember not his hand, Nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

title: Psalms 78:43
text: How he set his signs in Egypt, And his wonders in the field of Zoan,

title: Psalms 78:44
text: And turned their rivers into blood, And their streams, so that they could not drink.

title: Psalms 78:45
text: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; And frogs, which destroyed them.

title: Psalms 78:46
text: He gave also their increase unto the caterpillar, And their labor unto the locust.

title: Psalms 78:47
text: He destroyed their vines with hail, And their sycomore-trees with frost.

title: Psalms 78:48
text: He gave over their cattle also to the hail, And their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

title: Psalms 78:49
text: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, Wrath, and indignation, and trouble, A band of angels of evil.

title: Psalms 78:50
text: He made a path for his anger; He spared not their soul from death, But gave their life over to the pestilence,

title: Psalms 78:51
text: And smote all the first-born in Egypt, The chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

title: Psalms 78:52
text: But he led forth his own people like sheep, And guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

title: Psalms 78:53
text: And he led them safely, so that they feared not; But the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

title: Psalms 78:54
text: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, To this mountain, which his right hand had gotten.

title: Psalms 78:55
text: He drove out the nations also before them, And allotted them for an inheritance by line, And made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

title: Psalms 78:56
text: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, And kept not his testimonies;

title: Psalms 78:57
text: But turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers: They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

title: Psalms 78:58
text: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, And moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

title: Psalms 78:59
text: When God heard [this], he was wroth, And greatly abhorred Israel;

title: Psalms 78:60
text: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, The tent which he placed among men;

title: Psalms 78:61
text: And delivered his strength into captivity, And his glory into the adversary's hand.

title: Psalms 78:62
text: He gave his people over also unto the sword, And was wroth with his inheritance.

title: Psalms 78:63
text: Fire devoured their young men; And their virgins had no marriage-song.

title: Psalms 78:64
text: Their priests fell by the sword; And their widows made no lamentation.

title: Psalms 78:65
text: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, Like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.

title: Psalms 78:66
text: And he smote his adversaries backward: He put them to a perpetual reproach.

title: Psalms 78:67
text: Moreover he refused the tent of Joseph, And chose not the tribe of Ephraim,

title: Psalms 78:68
text: But chose the tribe of Judah, The mount Zion which he loved.

title: Psalms 78:69
text: And he built his sanctuary like the heights, Like the earth which he hath established for ever.

title: Psalms 78:70
text: He chose David also his servant, And took him from the sheepfolds:

title: Psalms 78:71
text: From following the ewes that have their young he brought him, To be the shepherd of Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.

title: Psalms 78:72
text: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, And guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

title: Psalms 79
inscription: A Psalm of Asaph

title: Psalms 79:1
text: O God, the nations are come into thine inheritance; Thy holy temple have they defiled; They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

title: Psalms 79:2
text: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be food unto the birds of the heavens, The flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

title: Psalms 79:3
text: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; And there was none to bury them.

title: Psalms 79:4
text: We are become a reproach to our neighbors, A scoffing and derision to them that are round about us.

title: Psalms 79:5
text: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou be angry for ever? Shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

title: Psalms 79:6
text: Pour out thy wrath upon the nations that know thee not, And upon the kingdoms that call not upon thy name.

title: Psalms 79:7
text: For they have devoured Jacob, And laid waste his habitation.

title: Psalms 79:8
text: Remember not against us the iniquities of our forefathers: Let thy tender mercies speedily meet us; For we are brought very low.

title: Psalms 79:9
text: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name; And deliver us, and forgive our sins, for thy name's sake.

title: Psalms 79:10
text: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is their God? Let the avenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed Be known among the nations in our sight.

title: Psalms 79:11
text: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee: According to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to death;

title: Psalms 79:12
text: And render unto our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom Their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

title: Psalms 79:13
text: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture Will give thee thanks for ever: We will show forth thy praise to all generations.

title: Psalms 80
inscription: For the Chief Musician; set to Shoshannim Eduth. A Psalm of Asaph

title: Psalms 80:1
text: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, Thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; Thou that sittest [above] the cherubim, shine forth.

title: Psalms 80:2
text: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up thy might, And come to save us.

title: Psalms 80:3
text: Turn us again, O God; And cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

title: Psalms 80:4
text: O Jehovah God of hosts, How long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?

title: Psalms 80:5
text: Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears, And given them tears to drink in large measure.

title: Psalms 80:6
text: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbors; And our enemies laugh among themselves.

title: Psalms 80:7
text: Turn us again, O God of hosts; And cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

title: Psalms 80:8
text: Thou broughtest a vine out of Egypt: Thou didst drive out the nations, and plantedst it.

title: Psalms 80:9
text: Thou preparedst [room] before it, And it took deep root, and filled the land.

title: Psalms 80:10
text: The mountains were covered with the shadow of it, And the boughs thereof were [like] cedars of God.

title: Psalms 80:11
text: It sent out its branches unto the sea, And its shoots unto the River.

title: Psalms 80:12
text: Why hast thou broken down its walls, So that all they that pass by the way do pluck it?

title: Psalms 80:13
text: The boar out of the wood doth ravage it, And the wild beasts of the field feed on it.

title: Psalms 80:14
text: Turn again, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: Look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine,

title: Psalms 80:15
text: And the stock which thy right hand planted, And the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.

title: Psalms 80:16
text: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: They perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

title: Psalms 80:17
text: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, Upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.

title: Psalms 80:18
text: So shall we not go back from thee: Quicken thou us, and we will call upon thy name.

title: Psalms 80:19
text: Turn us again, O Jehovah God of hosts; Cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

title: Psalms 81:1
text: [For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. [A Psalm] of Asaph]. Sing aloud unto God our strength: Make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.

title: Psalms 81:2
text: Raise a song, and bring hither the timbrel, The pleasant harp with the psaltery.

title: Psalms 81:3
text: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, At the full moon, on our feast-day.

title: Psalms 81:4
text: For it is a statute for Israel, An ordinance of the God of Jacob.

title: Psalms 81:5
text: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, When he went out over the land of Egypt, [Where] I heard a language that I knew not.

title: Psalms 81:6
text: I removed his shoulder from the burden: His hands were freed from the basket.

title: Psalms 81:7
text: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder; I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. {{Selah

title: Psalms 81:8
text: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wouldest hearken unto me!

title: Psalms 81:9
text: There shall no strange god be in thee; Neither shalt thou worship any foreign god.

title: Psalms 81:10
text: I am Jehovah thy God, Who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt: Open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

title: Psalms 81:11
text: But my people hearkened not to my voice; And Israel would none of me.

title: Psalms 81:12
text: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their heart, That they might walk in their own counsels.

title: Psalms 81:13
text: Oh that my people would hearken unto me, That Israel would walk in my ways!

title: Psalms 81:14
text: I would soon subdue their enemies, And turn my hand against their adversaries.

title: Psalms 81:15
text: The haters of Jehovah should submit themselves unto him: But their time should endure for ever.

title: Psalms 81:16
text: He would feed them also with the finest of the wheat; And with honey out of the rock would I satisfy thee.

title: Psalms 82
inscription: A Psalm of Asaph

title: Psalms 82:1
text: God standeth in the congregation of God; He judgeth among the gods.

title: Psalms 82:2
text: How long will ye judge unjustly, And respect the persons of the wicked? {{Selah

title: Psalms 82:3
text: Judge the poor and fatherless: Do justice to the afflicted and destitute.

title: Psalms 82:4
text: Rescue the poor and needy: Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.

title: Psalms 82:5
text: They know not, neither do they understand; They walk to and fro in darkness: All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

title: Psalms 82:6
text: I said, Ye are gods, And all of you sons of the Most High.

title: Psalms 82:7
text: Nevertheless ye shall die like men, And fall like one of the princes.

title: Psalms 82:8
text: Arise, O God, judge the earth; For thou shalt inherit all the nations.

title: Psalms 83
inscription: A Song, a Psalm of Asaph

title: Psalms 83:1
text: O God, keep not thou silence: Hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.

title: Psalms 83:2
text: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult; And they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

title: Psalms 83:3
text: Thy take crafty counsel against thy people, And consult together against thy hidden ones.

title: Psalms 83:4
text: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; That the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

title: Psalms 83:5
text: For they have consulted together with one consent; Against thee do they make a covenant:

title: Psalms 83:6
text: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagarenes;

title: Psalms 83:7
text: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre:

title: Psalms 83:8
text: Assyria also is joined with them; They have helped the children of Lot. {{Selah

title: Psalms 83:9
text: Do thou unto them as unto Midian, As to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

title: Psalms 83:10
text: Who perished at Endor, Who became as dung for the earth.

title: Psalms 83:11
text: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb; Yea, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna;

title: Psalms 83:12
text: Who said, Let us take to ourselves in possession The habitations of God.

title: Psalms 83:13
text: O my God, make them like the whirling dust; As stubble before the wind.

title: Psalms 83:14
text: As the fire that burneth the forest, And as the flame that setteth the mountains on fire,

title: Psalms 83:15
text: So pursue them with thy tempest, And terrify them with thy storm.

title: Psalms 83:16
text: Fill their faces with confusion, That they may seek thy name, O Jehovah.

title: Psalms 83:17
text: Let them be put to shame and dismayed for ever; Yea, let them be confounded and perish;

title: Psalms 83:18
text: That they may know that thou alone, whose name is Jehovah, Art the Most High over all the earth.

title: Psalms 84
inscription: For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah

title: Psalms 84:1
text: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O Jehovah of hosts!

title: Psalms 84:2
text: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of Jehovah; My heart and my flesh cry out unto the living God.

title: Psalms 84:3
text: Yea, the sparrow hath found her a house, And the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, Even thine altars, O Jehovah of hosts, My King, and my God.

title: Psalms 84:4
text: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: They will be still praising thee. {{Selah

title: Psalms 84:5
text: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; In whose heart are the highways [to Zion] .

title: Psalms 84:6
text: Passing through the valley of Weeping they make it a place of springs; Yea, the early rain covereth it with blessings.

title: Psalms 84:7
text: They go from strength to strength; Every one of them appeareth before God in Zion.

title: Psalms 84:8
text: O Jehovah God of hosts, hear my prayer; Give ear, O God of Jacob. {{Selah

title: Psalms 84:9
text: Behold, O God our shield, And look upon the face of thine anointed.

title: Psalms 84:10
text: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, Than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

title: Psalms 84:11
text: For Jehovah God is a sun and a shield: Jehovah will give grace and glory; No good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

title: Psalms 84:12
text: O Jehovah of hosts, Blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.

title: Psalms 85
inscription: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm for the sons of Korah

title: Psalms 85:1
text: Jehovah, thou hast been favorable unto thy land; Thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.

title: Psalms 85:2
text: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people; Thou hast covered all their sin. {{Selah

title: Psalms 85:3
text: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath; Thou hast turned [thyself] from the fierceness of thine anger.

title: Psalms 85:4
text: Turn us, O God of our salvation, And cause thine indignation toward us to cease.

title: Psalms 85:5
text: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? Wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

title: Psalms 85:6
text: Wilt thou not quicken us again, That thy people may rejoice in thee?

title: Psalms 85:7
text: Show us thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, And grant us thy salvation.

title: Psalms 85:8
text: I will hear what God Jehovah will speak; For he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: But let them not turn again to folly.

title: Psalms 85:9
text: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him, That glory may dwell in our land.

title: Psalms 85:10
text: Mercy and truth are met together; Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

title: Psalms 85:11
text: Truth springeth out of the earth; And righteousness hath looked down from heaven.

title: Psalms 85:12
text: Yea, Jehovah will give that which is good; And our land shall yield its increase.

title: Psalms 85:13
text: Righteousness shall go before him, And shall make his footsteps a way [to walk in] .

title: Psalms 86
inscription: A Prayer of David

title: Psalms 86:1
text: Bow down thine ear, O Jehovah, and answer me; For I am poor and needy.

title: Psalms 86:2
text: Preserve my soul; For I am godly: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.

title: Psalms 86:3
text: Be merciful unto me, O Lord; For unto thee do I cry all the day long.

title: Psalms 86:4
text: Rejoice the soul of thy servant; For unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

title: Psalms 86:5
text: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive, And abundant in lovingkindness unto all them that call upon thee.

title: Psalms 86:6
text: Give ear, O Jehovah, unto my prayer; And hearken unto the voice of my supplications.

title: Psalms 86:7
text: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee; For thou wilt answer me.

title: Psalms 86:8
text: There is none like unto thee among the gods, O Lord; Neither [are there any works] like unto thy works.

title: Psalms 86:9
text: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; And they shall glorify thy name.

title: Psalms 86:10
text: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: Thou art God alone.

title: Psalms 86:11
text: Teach me thy way, O Jehovah; I will walk in thy truth: Unite my heart to fear thy name.

title: Psalms 86:12
text: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart; And I will glorify thy name for evermore.

title: Psalms 86:13
text: For great is thy lovingkindness toward me; And thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

title: Psalms 86:14
text: O God, the proud are risen up against me, And a company of violent men have sought after my soul, And have not set thee before them.

title: Psalms 86:15
text: But thou, O Lord, art a God merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness and truth.

title: Psalms 86:16
text: Oh turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; Give thy strength unto thy servant, And save the son of thy handmaid.

title: Psalms 86:17
text: Show me a token for good, That they who hate me may see it, and be put to shame, Because thou, Jehovah, hast helped me, and comforted me.

title: Psalms 87
inscription: A Psalm of the sons of Korah; a Song

title: Psalms 87:1
text: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

title: Psalms 87:2
text: Jehovah loveth the gates of Zion More than all the dwellings of Jacob.

title: Psalms 87:3
text: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. {{Selah

title: Psalms 87:4
text: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon as among them that know me: Behold, Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia: This one was born there.

title: Psalms 87:5
text: Yea, of Zion it shall be said, This one and that one was born in her; And the Most High himself will establish her.

title: Psalms 87:6
text: Jehovah will count, when he writeth up the peoples, This one was born there. {{Selah

title: Psalms 87:7
text: They that sing as well as they that dance [shall say], All my fountains are in thee.

title: Psalms 88
inscription: A Song, a Psalm of the sons of Korah; for the Chief Musician; set to Mahalath Leannoth. Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite

title: Psalms 88:1
text: O Jehovah, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee.

title: Psalms 88:2
text: Let my prayer enter into thy presence; Incline thine ear unto my cry.

title: Psalms 88:3
text: For my soul is full of troubles, And my life draweth nigh unto Sheol.

title: Psalms 88:4
text: I am reckoned with them that go down into the pit; I am as a man that hath no help,

title: Psalms 88:5
text: Cast off among the dead, Like the slain that lie in the grave, Whom thou rememberest no more, And they are cut off from thy hand.

title: Psalms 88:6
text: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, In dark places, in the deeps.

title: Psalms 88:7
text: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, And thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. {{Selah

title: Psalms 88:8
text: Thou hast put mine acquaintance far from me; Thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

title: Psalms 88:9
text: Mine eye wasteth away by reason of affliction: I have called daily upon thee, O Jehovah; I have spread forth my hands unto thee.

title: Psalms 88:10
text: Wilt thou show wonders to the dead? Shall they that are deceased arise and praise thee? {{Selah

title: Psalms 88:11
text: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? Or thy faithfulness in Destruction?

title: Psalms 88:12
text: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? And thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

title: Psalms 88:13
text: But unto thee, O Jehovah, have I cried; And in the morning shall my prayer come before thee.

title: Psalms 88:14
text: Jehovah, why castest thou off my soul? Why hidest thou thy face from me?

title: Psalms 88:15
text: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: While I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

title: Psalms 88:16
text: Thy fierce wrath is gone over me; Thy terrors have cut me off.

title: Psalms 88:17
text: They came round about me like water all the day long; They compassed me about together.

title: Psalms 88:18
text: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, And mine acquaintance into darkness.

title: Psalms 89
inscription: Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite

title: Psalms 89:1
text: I will sing of the lovingkindness of Jehovah for ever: With my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.

title: Psalms 89:2
text: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever; Thy faithfulness wilt thou establish in the very heavens.

title: Psalms 89:3
text: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant:

title: Psalms 89:4
text: Thy seed will I establish for ever, And build up thy throne to all generations. {{Selah

title: Psalms 89:5
text: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Jehovah; Thy faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

title: Psalms 89:6
text: For who in the skies can be compared unto Jehovah? Who among the sons of the mighty is like unto Jehovah,

title: Psalms 89:7
text: A God very terrible in the council of the holy ones, And to be feared above all them that are round about him?

title: Psalms 89:8
text: O Jehovah God of hosts, Who is a mighty one, like unto thee, O Jehovah? And thy faithfulness is round about thee.

title: Psalms 89:9
text: Thou rulest the pride of the sea: When the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

title: Psalms 89:10
text: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; Thou hast scattered thine enemies with the arm of thy strength.

title: Psalms 89:11
text: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: The world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

title: Psalms 89:12
text: The north and the south, thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon rejoice in thy name.

title: Psalms 89:13
text: Thou hast a mighty arm; Strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

title: Psalms 89:14
text: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of thy throne: Lovingkindness and truth go before thy face.

title: Psalms 89:15
text: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: They walk, O Jehovah, in the light of thy countenance.

title: Psalms 89:16
text: In thy name do they rejoice all the day; And in thy righteousness are they exalted.

title: Psalms 89:17
text: For thou art the glory of their strength; And in thy favor our horn shall be exalted.

title: Psalms 89:18
text: For our shield belongeth unto Jehovah; And our king to the Holy One of Israel.

title: Psalms 89:19
text: Then thou spakest in vision to thy saints, And saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

title: Psalms 89:20
text: I have found David my servant; With my holy oil have I anointed him:

title: Psalms 89:21
text: With whom my hand shall be established; Mine arm also shall strengthen him.

title: Psalms 89:22
text: The enemy shall not exact from him, Nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

title: Psalms 89:23
text: And I will beat down his adversaries before him, And smite them that hate him.

title: Psalms 89:24
text: But my faithfulness and my lovingkindness shall be with him; And in my name shall his horn be exalted.

title: Psalms 89:25
text: I will set his hand also on the sea, And his right hand on the rivers.

title: Psalms 89:26
text: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation.

title: Psalms 89:27
text: I also will make him [my] first-born, The highest of the kings of the earth.

title: Psalms 89:28
text: My lovingkindness will I keep for him for evermore; And my covenant shall stand fast with him.

title: Psalms 89:29
text: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, And his throne as the days of heaven.

title: Psalms 89:30
text: If his children forsake my law, And walk not in mine ordinances;

title: Psalms 89:31
text: If they break my statutes, And keep not my commandments;

title: Psalms 89:32
text: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, And their iniquity with stripes.

title: Psalms 89:33
text: But my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, Nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

title: Psalms 89:34
text: My covenant will I not break, Nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

title: Psalms 89:35
text: Once have I sworn by my holiness: I will not lie unto David:

title: Psalms 89:36
text: His seed shall endure for ever, And his throne as the sun before me.

title: Psalms 89:37
text: It shall be established for ever as the moon, And [as] the faithful witness in the sky. {{Selah

title: Psalms 89:38
text: But thou hast cast off and rejected, Thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

title: Psalms 89:39
text: Thou hast abhorred the covenant of thy servant: Thou hast profaned his crown [by casting it] to the ground.

title: Psalms 89:40
text: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; Thou hast brought his strongholds to ruin.

title: Psalms 89:41
text: All that pass by the way rob him: He is become a reproach to his neighbors.

title: Psalms 89:42
text: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his adversaries; Thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

title: Psalms 89:43
text: Yea, thou turnest back the edge of his sword, And hast not made him to stand in the battle.

title: Psalms 89:44
text: Thou hast made his brightness to cease, And cast his throne down to the ground.

title: Psalms 89:45
text: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: Thou hast covered him with shame. {{Selah

title: Psalms 89:46
text: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? [How long] shall thy wrath burn like fire?

title: Psalms 89:47
text: Oh remember how short my time is: For what vanity hast thou created all the children of men!

title: Psalms 89:48
text: What man is he that shall live and not see death, That shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? {{Selah

title: Psalms 89:49
text: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, Which thou swarest unto David in thy faithfulness?

title: Psalms 89:50
text: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; How I do bear in my bosom [the reproach of] all the mighty peoples,

title: Psalms 89:51
text: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O Jehovah, Wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

title: Psalms 89:52
text: Blessed be Jehovah for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

title: Psalms 90
inscription: A Prayer of Moses the man of God

title: Psalms 90:1
text: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling-place In all generations.

title: Psalms 90:2
text: Before the mountains were brought forth, Or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

title: Psalms 90:3
text: Thou turnest man to destruction, And sayest, Return, ye children of men.

title: Psalms 90:4
text: For a thousand years in thy sight Are but as yesterday when it is past, And as a watch in the night.

title: Psalms 90:5
text: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: In the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

title: Psalms 90:6
text: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; In the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

title: Psalms 90:7
text: For we are consumed in thine anger, And in thy wrath are we troubled.

title: Psalms 90:8
text: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, Our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.

title: Psalms 90:9
text: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

title: Psalms 90:10
text: The days of our years are threescore years and ten, Or even by reason of strength fourscore years; Yet is their pride but labor and sorrow; For it is soon gone, and we fly away.

title: Psalms 90:11
text: Who knoweth the power of thine anger, And thy wrath according to the fear that is due unto thee?

title: Psalms 90:12
text: So teach us to number our days, That we may get us a heart of wisdom.

title: Psalms 90:13
text: Return, O Jehovah; How long? And let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

title: Psalms 90:14
text: Oh satisfy us in the morning with thy lovingkindness, That we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

title: Psalms 90:15
text: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, And the years wherein we have seen evil.

title: Psalms 90:16
text: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, And thy glory upon their children.

title: Psalms 90:17
text: And let the favor of the Lord our God be upon us; And establish thou the work of our hands upon us; Yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

title: Psalms 91:1
text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

title: Psalms 91:2
text: I will say of Jehovah, He is my refuge and my fortress; My God, in whom I trust.

title: Psalms 91:3
text: For he will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, And from the deadly pestilence.

title: Psalms 91:4
text: He will cover thee with his pinions, And under his wings shalt thou take refuge: His truth is a shield and a buckler.

title: Psalms 91:5
text: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, Nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

title: Psalms 91:6
text: For the pestilence that walketh in darkness, Nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

title: Psalms 91:7
text: A thousand shall fall at thy side, And ten thousand at thy right hand; [But] it shall not come nigh thee.

title: Psalms 91:8
text: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, And see the reward of the wicked.

title: Psalms 91:9
text: For thou, O Jehovah, art my refuge! Thou hast made the Most High thy habitation;

title: Psalms 91:10
text: There shall no evil befall thee, Neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.

title: Psalms 91:11
text: For he will give his angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.

title: Psalms 91:12
text: They shall bear thee up in their hands, Lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

title: Psalms 91:13
text: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: The young lion and the serpent shalt thou trample under foot.

title: Psalms 91:14
text: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

title: Psalms 91:15
text: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble: I will deliver him, and honor him.

title: Psalms 91:16
text: With long life will I satisfy him, And show him my salvation.

title: Psalms 92
inscription: A Psalm, a Song for the sabbath day

title: Psalms 92:1
text: It is a good thing to give thanks unto Jehovah, And to sing praises unto thy name, O Most High;

title: Psalms 92:2
text: To show forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, And thy faithfulness every night,

title: Psalms 92:3
text: With an instrument of ten strings, and with the psaltery; With a solemn sound upon the harp.

title: Psalms 92:4
text: For thou, Jehovah, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

title: Psalms 92:5
text: How great are thy works, O Jehovah! Thy thoughts are very deep.

title: Psalms 92:6
text: A brutish man knoweth not; Neither doth a fool understand this:

title: Psalms 92:7
text: When the wicked spring as the grass, And when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; It is that they shall be destroyed for ever.

title: Psalms 92:8
text: But thou, O Jehovah, art on high for evermore.

title: Psalms 92:9
text: For, lo, thine enemies, O Jehovah, For, lo, thine enemies shall perish; All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

title: Psalms 92:10
text: But my horn hast thou exalted like [the horn of] the wild-ox: I am anointed with fresh oil.

title: Psalms 92:11
text: Mine eye also hath seen [my desire] on mine enemies, Mine ears have heard [my desire] of the evil-doers that rise up against me.

title: Psalms 92:12
text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

title: Psalms 92:13
text: They are planted in the house of Jehovah; They shall flourish in the courts of our God.

title: Psalms 92:14
text: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; They shall be full of sap and green:

title: Psalms 92:15
text: To show that Jehovah is upright; He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

title: Psalms 93:1
text: Jehovah reigneth; He is clothed with majesty; Jehovah is clothed with strength; he hath girded himself therewith: The world also is established, that it cannot be moved.

title: Psalms 93:2
text: Thy throne is established of old: Thou art from everlasting.

title: Psalms 93:3
text: The floods have lifted up, O Jehovah, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their waves.

title: Psalms 93:4
text: Above the voices of many waters, The mighty breakers of the sea, Jehovah on high is mighty.

title: Psalms 93:5
