text: Thy testimonies are very sure: Holiness becometh thy house, O Jehovah, for evermore.

title: Psalms 94:1
text: O Jehovah, thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, shine forth.

title: Psalms 94:2
text: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: Render to the proud [their] desert.

title: Psalms 94:3
text: Jehovah, how long shall the wicked, How long shall the wicked triumph?

title: Psalms 94:4
text: They prate, they speak arrogantly: All the workers of iniquity boast themselves.

title: Psalms 94:5
text: They break in pieces thy people, O Jehovah, And afflict thy heritage.

title: Psalms 94:6
text: They slay the widow and the sojourner, And murder the fatherless.

title: Psalms 94:7
text: And they say, Jehovah will not see, Neither will the God of Jacob consider.

title: Psalms 94:8
text: Consider, ye brutish among the people; And ye fools, when will ye be wise?

title: Psalms 94:9
text: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? He that formed the eye, shall he not see?

title: Psalms 94:10
text: He that chastiseth the nations, shall not he correct, [Even] he that teacheth man knowledge?

title: Psalms 94:11
text: Jehovah knoweth the thoughts of man, That they are vanity.

title: Psalms 94:12
text: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Jehovah, And teachest out of thy law;

title: Psalms 94:13
text: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, Until the pit be digged for the wicked.

title: Psalms 94:14
text: For Jehovah will not cast off his people, Neither will he forsake his inheritance.

title: Psalms 94:15
text: For judgment shall return unto righteousness; And all the upright in heart shall follow it.

title: Psalms 94:16
text: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

title: Psalms 94:17
text: Unless Jehovah had been my help, My soul had soon dwelt in silence.

title: Psalms 94:18
text: When I said, My foot slippeth; Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, held me up.

title: Psalms 94:19
text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me Thy comforts delight my soul.

title: Psalms 94:20
text: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with thee, Which frameth mischief by statute?

title: Psalms 94:21
text: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, And condemn the innocent blood.

title: Psalms 94:22
text: But Jehovah hath been my high tower, And my God the rock of my refuge.

title: Psalms 94:23
text: And he hath brought upon them their own iniquity, And will cut them off in their own wickedness; Jehovah our God will cut them off.

title: Psalms 95:1
text: Oh come, let us sing unto Jehovah; Let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

title: Psalms 95:2
text: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; Let us make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

title: Psalms 95:3
text: For Jehovah is a great God, And a great King above all gods.

title: Psalms 95:4
text: In his hand are the deep places of the earth; The heights of the mountains are his also.

title: Psalms 95:5
text: The sea is his, and he made it; And his hands formed the dry land.

title: Psalms 95:6
text: Oh come, let us worship and bow down; Let us kneel before Jehovah our Maker:

title: Psalms 95:7
text: For he is our God, And we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To-day, oh that ye would hear his voice!

title: Psalms 95:8
text: Harden not your heart, as at Meribah, As in the day of Massah in the wilderness;

title: Psalms 95:9
text: When your fathers tempted me, Proved me, and saw my work.

title: Psalms 95:10
text: Forty years long was I grieved with [that] generation, And said, It is a people that do err in their heart, And they have not known my ways:

title: Psalms 95:11
text: Wherefore I sware in my wrath, That they should not enter into my rest.

title: Psalms 96:1
text: Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song: Sing unto Jehovah, all the earth.

title: Psalms 96:2
text: Sing unto Jehovah, bless his name; Show forth his salvation from day to day.

title: Psalms 96:3
text: Declare his glory among the nations, His marvellous works among all the peoples.

title: Psalms 96:4
text: For great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised: He is to be feared above all gods.

title: Psalms 96:5
text: For all the gods of the peoples are idols; But Jehovah made the heavens.

title: Psalms 96:6
text: Honor and majesty are before him: Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

title: Psalms 96:7
text: Ascribe unto Jehovah, ye kindreds of the peoples, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.

title: Psalms 96:8
text: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name: Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

title: Psalms 96:9
text: Oh worship Jehovah in holy array: Tremble before him, all the earth.

title: Psalms 96:10
text: Say among the nations, Jehovah reigneth: The world also is established that it cannot be moved: He will judge the peoples with equity.

title: Psalms 96:11
text: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;

title: Psalms 96:12
text: Let the field exult, and all that is therein; Then shall all the trees of the wood sing for joy

title: Psalms 96:13
text: Before Jehovah; For he cometh, For he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with his truth.

title: Psalms 97:1
text: Jehovah reigneth; Let the earth rejoice; Let the multitude of isles be glad.

title: Psalms 97:2
text: Clouds and darkness are round about him: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

title: Psalms 97:3
text: A fire goeth before him, And burneth up his adversaries round about.

title: Psalms 97:4
text: His lightnings lightened the world: The earth saw, and trembled.

title: Psalms 97:5
text: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of Jehovah, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

title: Psalms 97:6
text: The heavens declare his righteousness, And all the peoples have seen his glory.

title: Psalms 97:7
text: Let all them be put to shame that serve graven images, That boast themselves of idols: Worship him, all ye gods.

title: Psalms 97:8
text: Zion heard and was glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoiced, Because of thy judgments, O Jehovah.

title: Psalms 97:9
text: For thou, Jehovah, art most high above all the earth: Thou art exalted far above all gods.

title: Psalms 97:10
text: O ye that love Jehovah, hate evil: He preserveth the souls of his saints; He delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

title: Psalms 97:11
text: Light is sown for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.

title: Psalms 97:12
text: Be glad in Jehovah, ye righteous; And give thanks to his holy memorial [name] .

title: Psalms 98
inscription: A Psalm

title: Psalms 98:1
text: Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song; For he hath done marvellous things: His right hand, and his holy arm, hath wrought salvation for him.

title: Psalms 98:2
text: Jehovah hath made known his salvation: His righteousness hath he openly showed in the sight of the nations.

title: Psalms 98:3
text: He hath remembered his lovingkindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel: All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

title: Psalms 98:4
text: Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all the earth: Break forth and sing for joy, yea, sing praises.

title: Psalms 98:5
text: Sing praises unto Jehovah with the harp; With the harp and the voice of melody.

title: Psalms 98:6
text: With trumpets and sound of cornet Make a joyful noise before the King, Jehovah.

title: Psalms 98:7
text: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein;

title: Psalms 98:8
text: Let the floods clap their hands; Let the hills sing for joy together

title: Psalms 98:9
text: Before Jehovah; For he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with equity.

title: Psalms 99:1
text: Jehovah reigneth; let the peoples tremble: He sitteth [above] the cherubim; let the earth be moved.

title: Psalms 99:2
text: Jehovah is great in Zion; And he is high above all the peoples.

title: Psalms 99:3
text: Let them praise thy great and terrible name: Holy is he.

title: Psalms 99:4
text: The king's strength also loveth justice; Thou dost establish equity; Thou executest justice and righteousness in Jacob.

title: Psalms 99:5
text: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his footstool: Holy is he.

title: Psalms 99:6
text: Moses and Aaron among his priests, And Samuel among them that call upon his name; They called upon Jehovah, and he answered them.

title: Psalms 99:7
text: He spake unto them in the pillar of cloud: They kept his testimonies, And the statute that he gave them.

title: Psalms 99:8
text: Thou answeredst them, O Jehovah our God: Thou wast a God that forgavest them, Though thou tookest vengeance of their doings.

title: Psalms 99:9
text: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his holy hill; For Jehovah our God is holy.

title: Psalms 100
inscription: A Psalm of thanksgiving

title: Psalms 100:1
text: Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all ye lands.

title: Psalms 100:2
text: Serve Jehovah with gladness: Come before his presence with singing.

title: Psalms 100:3
text: Know ye that Jehovah, he is God: It is he that hath made us, and we are his; We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

title: Psalms 100:4
text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, And into his courts with praise: Give thanks unto him, and bless his name.

title: Psalms 100:5
text: For Jehovah is good; His lovingkindness [endureth] for ever, And his faithfulness unto all generations.

title: Psalms 101
inscription: A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 101:1
text: I will sing of lovingkindness and justice: Unto thee, O Jehovah, will I sing praises.

title: Psalms 101:2
text: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way: Oh when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

title: Psalms 101:3
text: I will set no base thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; It shall not cleave unto me.

title: Psalms 101:4
text: A perverse heart shall depart from me: I will know no evil thing.

title: Psalms 101:5
text: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbor, him will I destroy: Him that hath a high look and a proud heart will I not suffer.

title: Psalms 101:6
text: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: He that walketh in a perfect way, he shall minister unto me.

title: Psalms 101:7
text: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: He that speaketh falsehood shall not be established before mine eyes.

title: Psalms 101:8
text: Morning by morning will I destroy all the wicked of the land; To cut off all the workers of iniquity from the city of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 102
inscription: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before Jehovah

title: Psalms 102:1
text: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, And let my cry come unto thee.

title: Psalms 102:2
text: Hide not thy face from me in the day of my distress: Incline thine ear unto me; In the day when I call answer me speedily.

title: Psalms 102:3
text: For my days consume away like smoke, And my bones are burned as a firebrand.

title: Psalms 102:4
text: My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; For I forget to eat my bread.

title: Psalms 102:5
text: By reason of the voice of my groaning My bones cleave to my flesh.

title: Psalms 102:6
text: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am become as an owl of the waste places.

title: Psalms 102:7
text: I watch, and am become like a sparrow That is alone upon the house-top.

title: Psalms 102:8
text: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; They that are mad against me do curse by me.

title: Psalms 102:9
text: For I have eaten ashes like bread, And mingled my drink with weeping,

title: Psalms 102:10
text: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: For thou hast taken me up, and cast me away.

title: Psalms 102:11
text: My days are like a shadow that declineth; And I am withered like grass.

title: Psalms 102:12
text: But thou, O Jehovah, wilt abide for ever; And thy memorial [name] unto all generations.

title: Psalms 102:13
text: Thou wilt arise, and have mercy upon Zion; For it is time to have pity upon her, Yea, the set time is come.

title: Psalms 102:14
text: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, And have pity upon her dust.

title: Psalms 102:15
text: So the nations shall fear the name of Jehovah, And all the kings of the earth thy glory.

title: Psalms 102:16
text: For Jehovah hath built up Zion; He hath appeared in his glory.

title: Psalms 102:17
text: He hath regarded the prayer of the destitute, And hath not despised their prayer.

title: Psalms 102:18
text: This shall be written for the generation to come; And a people which shall be created shall praise Jehovah.

title: Psalms 102:19
text: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; From heaven did Jehovah behold the earth;

title: Psalms 102:20
text: To hear the sighing of the prisoner; To loose those that are appointed to death;

title: Psalms 102:21
text: That men may declare the name of Jehovah in Zion, And his praise in Jerusalem;

title: Psalms 102:22
text: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve Jehovah.

title: Psalms 102:23
text: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.

title: Psalms 102:24
text: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: Thy years are throughout all generations.

title: Psalms 102:25
text: Of old didst thou lay the foundation of the earth; And the heavens are the work of thy hands.

title: Psalms 102:26
text: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure; Yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; As a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

title: Psalms 102:27
text: But thou art the same, And thy years shall have no end.

title: Psalms 102:28
text: The children of thy servants shall continue, And their seed shall be established before thee.

title: Psalms 103:1
text: [[ A Psalm] of David]. Bless Jehovah, O my soul; And all that is within me, [bless] his holy name.

title: Psalms 103:2
text: Bless Jehovah, O my soul, And forget not all his benefits:

title: Psalms 103:3
text: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; Who healeth all thy diseases;

title: Psalms 103:4
text: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; Who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

title: Psalms 103:5
text: Who satisfieth thy desire with good things, [So that] thy youth is renewed like the eagle.

title: Psalms 103:6
text: Jehovah executeth righteous acts, And judgments for all that are oppressed.

title: Psalms 103:7
text: He made known his ways unto Moses, His doings unto the children of Israel.

title: Psalms 103:8
text: Jehovah is merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness.

title: Psalms 103:9
text: He will not always chide; Neither will he keep [his anger] for ever.

title: Psalms 103:10
text: He hath not dealt with us after our sins, Nor rewarded us after our iniquities.

title: Psalms 103:11
text: For as the heavens are high above the earth, So great is his lovingkindness toward them that fear him.

title: Psalms 103:12
text: As far as the east is from the west, So far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

title: Psalms 103:13
text: Like as a father pitieth his children, So Jehovah pitieth them that fear him.

title: Psalms 103:14
text: For he knoweth our frame; He remembereth that we are dust.

title: Psalms 103:15
text: As for man, his days are as grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

title: Psalms 103:16
text: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; And the place thereof shall know it no more.

title: Psalms 103:17
text: But the lovingkindness of Jehovah is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, And his righteousness unto children's children;

title: Psalms 103:18
text: To such as keep his covenant, And to those that remember his precepts to do them.

title: Psalms 103:19
text: Jehovah hath established his throne in the heavens; And his kingdom ruleth over all.

title: Psalms 103:20
text: Bless Jehovah, ye his angels, That are mighty in strength, that fulfil his word, Hearkening unto the voice of his word.

title: Psalms 103:21
text: Bless Jehovah, all ye his hosts, Ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

title: Psalms 103:22
text: Bless Jehovah, all ye his works, In all places of his dominion: Bless Jehovah, O my soul.

title: Psalms 104:1
text: Bless Jehovah, O my soul. O Jehovah my God, thou art very great; Thou art clothed with honor and majesty:

title: Psalms 104:2
text: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment; Who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain;

title: Psalms 104:3
text: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters; Who maketh the clouds his chariot; Who walketh upon the wings of the wind;

title: Psalms 104:4
text: Who maketh winds his messengers; Flames of fire his ministers;

title: Psalms 104:5
text: Who laid the foundations of the earth, That it should not be moved for ever.

title: Psalms 104:6
text: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a vesture; The waters stood above the mountains.

title: Psalms 104:7
text: At thy rebuke they fled; At the voice of thy thunder they hasted away

title: Psalms 104:8
text: (The mountains rose, the valleys sank down) Unto the place which thou hadst founded for them.

title: Psalms 104:9
text: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; That they turn not again to cover the earth.

title: Psalms 104:10
text: He sendeth forth springs into the valleys; They run among the mountains;

title: Psalms 104:11
text: They give drink to every beast of the field; The wild asses quench their thirst.

title: Psalms 104:12
text: By them the birds of the heavens have their habitation; They sing among the branches.

title: Psalms 104:13
text: He watereth the mountains from his chambers: The earth is filled with the fruit of thy works.

title: Psalms 104:14
text: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, And herb for the service of man; That he may bring forth food out of the earth,

title: Psalms 104:15
text: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, [And] oil to make his face to shine, And bread that strengtheneth man's heart.

title: Psalms 104:16
text: The trees of Jehovah are filled [with moisture], The cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

title: Psalms 104:17
text: Where the birds make their nests: As for the stork, the fir-trees are her house.

title: Psalms 104:18
text: The high mountains are for the wild goats; The rocks are a refuge for the conies.

title: Psalms 104:19
text: He appointed the moon for seasons: The sun knoweth his going down.

title: Psalms 104:20
text: Thou makest darkness, and it is night, Wherein all the beasts of the forest creep forth.

title: Psalms 104:21
text: The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their food from God.

title: Psalms 104:22
text: The sun ariseth, they get them away, And lay them down in their dens.

title: Psalms 104:23
text: Man goeth forth unto his work And to his labor until the evening.

title: Psalms 104:24
text: O Jehovah, how manifold are thy works! In wisdom hast thou made them all: The earth is full of thy riches.

title: Psalms 104:25
text: Yonder is the sea, great and wide, Wherein are things creeping innumerable, Both small and great beasts.

title: Psalms 104:26
text: There go the ships; There is leviathan, whom thou hast formed to play therein.

title: Psalms 104:27
text: These wait all for thee, That thou mayest give them their food in due season.

title: Psalms 104:28
text: Thou givest unto them, they gather; Thou openest thy hand, they are satisfied with good.

title: Psalms 104:29
text: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled; Thou takest away their breath, they die, And return to their dust.

title: Psalms 104:30
text: Thou sendest forth thy Spirit, they are created; And thou renewest the face of the ground.

title: Psalms 104:31
text: Let the glory of Jehovah endure for ever; Let Jehovah rejoice in his works:

title: Psalms 104:32
text: Who looketh on the earth, and it trembleth; He toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.

title: Psalms 104:33
text: I will sing unto Jehovah as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

title: Psalms 104:34
text: Let thy meditation be sweet unto him: I will rejoice in Jehovah.

title: Psalms 104:35
text: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. And let the wicked be no more. Bless Jehovah, O my soul. Praise ye Jehovah.

title: Psalms 105:1
text: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name; Make known among the peoples his doings.

title: Psalms 105:2
text: Sing unto him, sing praises unto him; Talk ye of all his marvelous works.

title: Psalms 105:3
text: Glory ye in his holy name: Let the heart of them rejoice that seek Jehovah.

title: Psalms 105:4
text: Seek ye Jehovah and his strength; Seek his face evermore.

title: Psalms 105:5
text: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

title: Psalms 105:6
text: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, Ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

title: Psalms 105:7
text: He is Jehovah our God: His judgments are in all the earth.

title: Psalms 105:8
text: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, The word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

title: Psalms 105:9
text: [ The covenant] which he made with Abraham, And his oath unto Isaac,

title: Psalms 105:10
text: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a statute, To Israel for an everlasting covenant,

title: Psalms 105:11
text: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance;

title: Psalms 105:12
text: When they were but a few men in number, Yea, very few, and sojourners in it.

title: Psalms 105:13
text: And they went about from nation to nation, From one kingdom to another people.

title: Psalms 105:14
text: He suffered no man to do them wrong; Yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,

title: Psalms 105:15
text: [ Saying], Touch not mine anointed ones, And do my prophets no harm.

title: Psalms 105:16
text: And he called for a famine upon the land; He brake the whole staff of bread.

title: Psalms 105:17
text: He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold for a servant:

title: Psalms 105:18
text: His feet they hurt with fetters: He was laid in [chains of] iron,

title: Psalms 105:19
text: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of Jehovah tried him.

title: Psalms 105:20
text: The king sent and loosed him; Even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

title: Psalms 105:21
text: He made him lord of his house, And ruler of all his substance;

title: Psalms 105:22
text: To bind his princes at his pleasure, And teach his elders wisdom.

title: Psalms 105:23
text: Israel also came into Egypt; And Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

title: Psalms 105:24
text: And he increased his people greatly, And made them stronger than their adversaries.

title: Psalms 105:25
text: He turned their heart to hate his people, To deal subtly with his servants.

title: Psalms 105:26
text: He sent Moses his servant, [And] Aaron whom he had chosen.

title: Psalms 105:27
text: They set among them his signs, And wonders in the land of Ham.

title: Psalms 105:28
text: He sent darkness, and made it dark; And they rebelled not against his words.

title: Psalms 105:29
text: He turned their waters into blood, And slew their fish.

title: Psalms 105:30
text: Their land swarmed with frogs In the chambers of their kings.

title: Psalms 105:31
text: He spake, and there came swarms of flies, And lice in all their borders.

title: Psalms 105:32
text: He gave them hail for rain, [And] flaming fire in their land.

title: Psalms 105:33
text: He smote their vines also and their fig-trees, And brake the trees of their borders.

title: Psalms 105:34
text: He spake, and the locust came, And the grasshopper, and that without number,

title: Psalms 105:35
text: And did eat up every herb in their land, And did eat up the fruit of their ground.

title: Psalms 105:36
text: He smote also all the first-born in their land, The chief of all their strength.

title: Psalms 105:37
text: And he brought them forth with silver and gold; And there was not one feeble person among his tribes.

title: Psalms 105:38
text: Egypt was glad when they departed; For the fear of them had fallen upon them.

title: Psalms 105:39
text: He spread a cloud for a covering, And fire to give light in the night.

title: Psalms 105:40
text: They asked, and he brought quails, And satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

title: Psalms 105:41
text: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out; They ran in the dry places [like] a river.

title: Psalms 105:42
text: For he remembered his holy word, [And] Abraham his servant.

title: Psalms 105:43
text: And he brought forth his people with joy, [And] his chosen with singing.

title: Psalms 105:44
text: And he gave them the lands of the nations; And they took the labor of the peoples in possession:

title: Psalms 105:45
text: That they might keep his statutes, And observe his laws. Praise ye Jehovah.

title: Psalms 106:1
text: Praise ye Jehovah. Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 106:2
text: Who can utter the mighty acts of Jehovah, Or show forth all his praise?

title: Psalms 106:3
text: Blessed are they that keep justice, And he that doeth righteousness at all times.

title: Psalms 106:4
text: Remember me, O Jehovah, with the favor that thou bearest unto thy people; Oh visit me with thy salvation,

title: Psalms 106:5
text: That I may see the prosperity of thy chosen, That I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, That I may glory with thine inheritance.

title: Psalms 106:6
text: We have sinned with our fathers, We have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

title: Psalms 106:7
text: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; They remembered not the multitude of thy lovingkindnesses, But were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

title: Psalms 106:8
text: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, That he might make his mighty power to be known.

title: Psalms 106:9
text: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up: So he led them through the depths, as through a wilderness.

title: Psalms 106:10
text: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

title: Psalms 106:11
text: And the waters covered their adversaries; There was not one of them left.

title: Psalms 106:12
text: Then believed they his words; They sang his praise.

title: Psalms 106:13
text: They soon forgat his works; They waited not for his counsel,

title: Psalms 106:14
text: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, And tempted God in the desert.

title: Psalms 106:15
text: And he gave them their request, But sent leanness into their soul.

title: Psalms 106:16
text: They envied Moses also in the camp, [And] Aaron the saint of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 106:17
text: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, And covered the company of Abiram.

title: Psalms 106:18
text: And a fire was kindled in their company; The flame burned up the wicked.

title: Psalms 106:19
text: They made a calf in Horeb, And worshipped a molten image.

title: Psalms 106:20
text: Thus they changed their glory For the likeness of an ox that eateth grass.

title: Psalms 106:21
text: They forgat God their Saviour, Who had done great things in Egypt,

title: Psalms 106:22
text: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, [And] terrible things by the Red Sea.

title: Psalms 106:23
text: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, Had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, To turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy [them] .

title: Psalms 106:24
text: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, They believed not his word,

title: Psalms 106:25
text: But murmured in their tents, And hearkened not unto the voice of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 106:26
text: Therefore he sware unto them, That he would overthrow them in the wilderness,

title: Psalms 106:27
text: And that he would overthrow their seed among the nations, And scatter them in the lands.

title: Psalms 106:28
text: They joined themselves also unto Baal-peor, And ate the sacrifices of the dead.

title: Psalms 106:29
text: Thus they provoked him to anger with their doings; And the plague brake in upon them.

title: Psalms 106:30
text: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment; And so the plague was stayed.

title: Psalms 106:31
text: And that was reckoned unto him for righteousness, Unto all generations for evermore.

title: Psalms 106:32
text: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, So that it went ill with Moses for their sakes;

title: Psalms 106:33
text: Because they were rebellious against his spirit, And he spake unadvisedly with his lips.

title: Psalms 106:34
text: They did not destroy the peoples, As Jehovah commanded them,

title: Psalms 106:35
text: But mingled themselves with the nations, And learned their works,

title: Psalms 106:36
text: And served their idols, Which became a snare unto them.

title: Psalms 106:37
text: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto demons,

title: Psalms 106:38
text: And shed innocent blood, Even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, Whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan; And the land was polluted with blood.

title: Psalms 106:39
text: Thus were they defiled with their works, And played the harlot in their doings.

title: Psalms 106:40
text: Therefore was the wrath of Jehovah kindled against his people, And he abhorred his inheritance.

title: Psalms 106:41
text: And he gave them into the hand of the nations; And they that hated them ruled over them.

title: Psalms 106:42
text: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were brought into subjection under their hand.

title: Psalms 106:43
text: Many times did he deliver them; But they were rebellious in their counsel, And were brought low in their iniquity.

title: Psalms 106:44
text: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, When he heard their cry:

title: Psalms 106:45
text: And he remembered for them his covenant, And repented according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.

title: Psalms 106:46
text: He made them also to be pitied Of all those that carried them captive.

title: Psalms 106:47
text: Save us, O Jehovah our God, And gather us from among the nations, To give thanks unto thy holy name, And to triumph in thy praise.

title: Psalms 106:48
text: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, From everlasting even to everlasting. And let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye Jehovah.

title: Psalms 107:1
text: O give thanks unto Jehovah; For he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 107:2
text: Let the redeemed of Jehovah say [so], Whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

title: Psalms 107:3
text: And gathered out of the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the south.

title: Psalms 107:4
text: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way; They found no city of habitation.

title: Psalms 107:5
text: Hungry and thirsty, Their soul fainted in them.

title: Psalms 107:6
text: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he delivered them out of their distresses,

title: Psalms 107:7
text: He led them also by a straight way, That they might go to a city of habitation.

title: Psalms 107:8
text: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!

title: Psalms 107:9
text: For he satisfieth the longing soul, And the hungry soul he filleth with good.

title: Psalms 107:10
text: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, Being bound in affliction and iron,

title: Psalms 107:11
text: Because they rebelled against the words of God, And contemned the counsel of the Most High:

title: Psalms 107:12
text: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor; They fell down, and there was none to help.

title: Psalms 107:13
text: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he saved them out of their distresses.

title: Psalms 107:14
text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, And brake their bonds in sunder.

title: Psalms 107:15
text: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!

title: Psalms 107:16
text: For he hath broken the gates of brass, And cut the bars of iron in sunder.

title: Psalms 107:17
text: Fools because of their transgression, And because of their iniquities, are afflicted.

title: Psalms 107:18
text: Their soul abhorreth all manner of food; And they draw near unto the gates of death.

title: Psalms 107:19
text: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he saveth them out of their distresses.

title: Psalms 107:20
text: He sendeth his word, and healeth them, And delivereth [them] from their destructions.

title: Psalms 107:21
text: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!

title: Psalms 107:22
text: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, And declare his works with singing.

title: Psalms 107:23
text: They that go down to the sea in ships, That do business in great waters;

title: Psalms 107:24
text: These see the works of Jehovah, And his wonders in the deep.

title: Psalms 107:25
text: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, Which lifteth up the waves thereof.

title: Psalms 107:26
text: They mount up to the heavens, they go down again to the depths: Their soul melteth away because of trouble.

title: Psalms 107:27
text: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, And are at their wits' end.

title: Psalms 107:28
text: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he bringeth them out of their distresses.

title: Psalms 107:29
text: He maketh the storm a calm, So that the waves thereof are still.

title: Psalms 107:30
text: Then are they glad because they are quiet; So he bringeth them unto their desired haven.

title: Psalms 107:31
text: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!

title: Psalms 107:32
text: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, And praise him in the seat of the elders.

title: Psalms 107:33
text: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, And watersprings into a thirsty ground;

title: Psalms 107:34
text: A fruitful land into a salt desert, For the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

title: Psalms 107:35
text: He turneth a wilderness into a pool of water, And a dry land into watersprings.

title: Psalms 107:36
text: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, That they may prepare a city of habitation,

title: Psalms 107:37
text: And sow fields, and plant vineyards, And get them fruits of increase.

title: Psalms 107:38
text: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; And he suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

title: Psalms 107:39
text: Again, they are diminished and bowed down Through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

title: Psalms 107:40
text: He poureth contempt upon princes, And causeth them to wander in the waste, where there is no way.

title: Psalms 107:41
text: Yet setteth he the needy on high from affliction, And maketh [him] families like a flock.

title: Psalms 107:42
text: The upright shall see it, and be glad; And all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

title: Psalms 107:43
text: Whoso is wise will give heed to these things; And they will consider the lovingkindnesses of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 108
inscription: A Song, a Psalm of David

title: Psalms 108:1
text: My heart is fixed, O God; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises, even with my glory.

title: Psalms 108:2
text: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake right early.

title: Psalms 108:3
text: I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the peoples; And I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

title: Psalms 108:4
text: For thy lovingkindness is great above the heavens; And thy truth [reacheth] unto the skies.

title: Psalms 108:5
text: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens, And thy glory above all the earth.

title: Psalms 108:6
text: That thy beloved may be delivered, Save with thy right hand, and answer us.

title: Psalms 108:7
text: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

title: Psalms 108:8
text: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.

title: Psalms 108:9
text: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom will I cast my shoe; Over Philistia will I shout.

title: Psalms 108:10
text: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who hath led me unto Edom?

title: Psalms 108:11
text: Hast not thou cast us off, O God? And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.

title: Psalms 108:12
text: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.

title: Psalms 108:13
text: Through God we shall do valiantly: For he it is that will tread down our adversaries.

title: Psalms 109
inscription: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 109:1
text: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

title: Psalms 109:2
text: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit have they opened against me: They have spoken unto me with a lying tongue.

title: Psalms 109:3
text: They have compassed me about also with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.

title: Psalms 109:4
text: For my love they are my adversaries: But I [give myself unto] prayer.

title: Psalms 109:5
text: And they have rewarded me evil for good, And hatred for my love.

title: Psalms 109:6
text: Set thou a wicked man over him; And let an adversary stand at his right hand.

title: Psalms 109:7
text: When he is judged, let him come forth guilty; And let his prayer be turned into sin.

title: Psalms 109:8
text: Let his days be few; [And] let another take his office.

title: Psalms 109:9
text: Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.

title: Psalms 109:10
text: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg; And let them seek [their bread] out of their desolate places.

title: Psalms 109:11
text: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; And let strangers make spoil of his labor.

title: Psalms 109:12
text: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him; Neither let there be any to have pity on his fatherless children.

title: Psalms 109:13
text: Let his posterity be cut off; In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

title: Psalms 109:14
text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with Jehovah; And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

title: Psalms 109:15
text: Let them be before Jehovah continually, That he may cut off the memory of them from the earth;

title: Psalms 109:16
text: Because he remembered not to show kindness, But persecuted the poor and needy man, And the broken in heart, to slay [them] .

title: Psalms 109:17
text: Yea, he loved cursing, and it came unto him; And he delighted not in blessing, and it was far from him.

title: Psalms 109:18
text: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment, And it came into his inward parts like water, And like oil into his bones.

title: Psalms 109:19
text: Let it be unto him as the raiment wherewith he covereth himself, And for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

title: Psalms 109:20
text: This is the reward of mine adversaries from Jehovah, And of them that speak evil against my soul.

title: Psalms 109:21
text: But deal thou with me, O Jehovah the Lord, for thy name's sake: Because thy lovingkindness is good, deliver thou me;

title: Psalms 109:22
text: For I am poor and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.

title: Psalms 109:23
text: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

title: Psalms 109:24
text: My knees are weak through fasting; And my flesh faileth of fatness.

title: Psalms 109:25
text: I am become also a reproach unto them: When they see me, they shake their head.

title: Psalms 109:26
text: Help me, O Jehovah my God; Oh save me according to thy lovingkindness:

title: Psalms 109:27
text: That they may know that this is thy hand; [That] thou, Jehovah, hast done it.

title: Psalms 109:28
text: Let them curse, but bless thou: When they arise, they shall be put to shame, But thy servant shall rejoice.

title: Psalms 109:29
text: Let mine adversaries be clothed with dishonor, And let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

title: Psalms 109:30
text: I will give great thanks unto Jehovah with my mouth; Yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

title: Psalms 109:31
text: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, To save him from them that judge his soul.

title: Psalms 110
inscription: A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 110:1
text: Jehovah saith unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, Until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

title: Psalms 110:2
text: Jehovah will send forth the rod of thy strength out of Zion: Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

title: Psalms 110:3
text: Thy people offer themselves willingly In the day of thy power, in holy array: Out of the womb of the morning Thou hast the dew of thy youth.

title: Psalms 110:4
text: Jehovah hath sworn, and will not repent: Thou art a priest for ever After the order of Melchizedek.

title: Psalms 110:5
text: The Lord at thy right hand Will strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

title: Psalms 110:6
text: He will judge among the nations, He will fill [the places] with dead bodies; He will strike through the head in many countries.

title: Psalms 110:7
text: He will drink of the brook in the way: Therefore will he lift up the head.

title: Psalms 111:1
text: Praise ye Jehovah. I will give thanks unto Jehovah with my whole heart, In the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

title: Psalms 111:2
text: The works of Jehovah are great, Sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

title: Psalms 111:3
text: His work is honor and majesty; And his righteousness endureth for ever.

title: Psalms 111:4
text: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: Jehovah is gracious and merciful.

title: Psalms 111:5
text: He hath given food unto them that fear him: He will ever be mindful of his covenant.

title: Psalms 111:6
text: He hath showed his people the power of his works, In giving them the heritage of the nations.

title: Psalms 111:7
text: The works of his hands are truth and justice; All his precepts are sure.

title: Psalms 111:8
text: They are established for ever and ever; They are done in truth and uprightness.

title: Psalms 111:9
text: He hath sent redemption unto his people; He hath commanded his covenant for ever: Holy and reverend is his name.

title: Psalms 111:10
text: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom; A good understanding have all they that do [his commandments] : His praise endureth for ever.

title: Psalms 112:1
text: Praise ye Jehovah. Blessed is the man that feareth Jehovah, That delighteth greatly in his commandments.

title: Psalms 112:2
text: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: The generation of the upright shall be blessed.

title: Psalms 112:3
text: Wealth and riches are in his house; And his righteousness endureth for ever.

title: Psalms 112:4
text: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: [He is] gracious, and merciful, and righteous.

title: Psalms 112:5
text: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth; He shall maintain his cause in judgment.

title: Psalms 112:6
text: For he shall never be moved; The righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.

title: Psalms 112:7
text: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: His heart is fixed, trusting in Jehovah.

title: Psalms 112:8
text: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, Until he see [his desire] upon his adversaries.

title: Psalms 112:9
text: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the needy; His righteousness endureth for ever: His horn shall be exalted with honor.

title: Psalms 112:10
text: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: The desire of the wicked shall perish.

title: Psalms 113:1
text: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise, O ye servants of Jehovah, Praise the name of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 113:2
text: Blessed be the name of Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore.

title: Psalms 113:3
text: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same Jehovah's name is to be praised.

title: Psalms 113:4
text: Jehovah is high above all nations, And his glory above the heavens.

title: Psalms 113:5
text: Who is like unto Jehovah our God, That hath his seat on high,

title: Psalms 113:6
text: That humbleth himself to behold [The things that are] in heaven and in the earth?

title: Psalms 113:7
text: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, And lifteth up the needy from the dunghill;

title: Psalms 113:8
text: That he may set him with princes, Even with the princes of his people.

title: Psalms 113:9
text: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, [And to be] a joyful mother of children. Praise ye Jehovah.

title: Psalms 114:1
text: When Israel went forth out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

title: Psalms 114:2
text: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

title: Psalms 114:3
text: The sea saw it, and fled; The Jordan was driven back.

title: Psalms 114:4
text: The mountains skipped like rams, The little hills like lambs.

title: Psalms 114:5
text: What aileth thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest? Thou Jordan, that thou turnest back?

title: Psalms 114:6
text: Ye mountains, that ye skip like rams; Ye little hills, like lambs?

title: Psalms 114:7
text: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the God of Jacob,

title: Psalms 114:8
text: Who turned the rock into a pool of water, The flint into a fountain of waters.

title: Psalms 115:1
text: Not unto us, O Jehovah, not unto us, But unto thy name give glory, For thy lovingkindness, and for thy truth's sake.

title: Psalms 115:2
text: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is now their God?

title: Psalms 115:3
text: But our God is in the heavens: He hath done whatsoever he pleased.

title: Psalms 115:4
text: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of men's hands.

title: Psalms 115:5
text: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;

title: Psalms 115:6
text: They have ears, but they hear not; Noses have they, but they smell not;

title: Psalms 115:7
text: They have hands, but they handle not; Feet have they, but they walk not; Neither speak they through their throat.

title: Psalms 115:8
text: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.

title: Psalms 115:9
text: O Israel, trust thou in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.

title: Psalms 115:10
text: O house of Aaron, trust ye in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.

title: Psalms 115:11
text: Ye that fear Jehovah, trust in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.

title: Psalms 115:12
text: Jehovah hath been mindful of us; He will bless [us] : He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.

title: Psalms 115:13
text: He will bless them that fear Jehovah, Both small and great.

title: Psalms 115:14
text: Jehovah increase you more and more, You and your children.

title: Psalms 115:15
text: Blessed are ye of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.

title: Psalms 115:16
text: The heavens are the heavens of Jehovah; But the earth hath he given to the children of men.

title: Psalms 115:17
text: The dead praise not Jehovah, Neither any that go down into silence;

title: Psalms 115:18
text: But we will bless Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore. Praise ye Jehovah.

title: Psalms 116:1
text: I love Jehovah, because he heareth My voice and my supplications.

title: Psalms 116:2
text: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, Therefore will I call [upon him] as long as I live.

title: Psalms 116:3
text: The cords of death compassed me, And the pains of Sheol gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

title: Psalms 116:4
text: Then called I upon the name of Jehovah: O Jehovah, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

title: Psalms 116:5
text: Gracious is Jehovah, and righteous; Yea, our God is merciful.

title: Psalms 116:6
text: Jehovah preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he saved me.

title: Psalms 116:7
text: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; For Jehovah hath dealt bountifully with thee.

title: Psalms 116:8
text: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, Mine eyes from tears, [And] my feet from falling.

title: Psalms 116:9
text: I will walk before Jehovah In the land of the living.

title: Psalms 116:10
text: I believe, for I will speak: I was greatly afflicted:

title: Psalms 116:11
text: I said in my haste, All men are liars.

title: Psalms 116:12
text: What shall I render unto Jehovah For all his benefits toward me?

title: Psalms 116:13
text: I will take the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 116:14
text: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah, Yea, in the presence of all his people.

title: Psalms 116:15
text: Precious in the sight of Jehovah Is the death of his saints.

title: Psalms 116:16
text: O Jehovah, truly I am thy servant: I am thy servant, the son of thy handmaid; Thou hast loosed my bonds.

title: Psalms 116:17
text: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 116:18
text: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah, Yea, in the presence of all his people,

title: Psalms 116:19
text: In the courts of Jehovah's house, In the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye Jehovah.

title: Psalms 117:1
text: O praise Jehovah, all ye nations; Laud him, all ye peoples.

title: Psalms 117:2
text: For his lovingkindness is great toward us; And the truth of Jehovah [endureth] for ever. Praise ye Jehovah.

title: Psalms 118:1
text: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; For he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 118:2
text: Let Israel now say, That his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 118:3
text: Let the house of Aaron now say, That his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 118:4
text: Let them now that fear Jehovah say, That his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 118:5
text: Out of my distress I called upon Jehovah: Jehovah answered me [and set me] in a large place.

title: Psalms 118:6
text: Jehovah is on my side; I will not fear: What can man do unto me?

title: Psalms 118:7
text: Jehovah is on my side among them that help me: Therefore shall I see [my desire] upon them that hate me.

title: Psalms 118:8
text: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to put confidence in man.

title: Psalms 118:9
text: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to put confidence in princes.

title: Psalms 118:10
text: All nations compassed me about: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.

title: Psalms 118:11
text: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.

title: Psalms 118:12
text: They compassed me about like bees; They are quenched as the fire of thorns: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.

title: Psalms 118:13
text: Thou didst thrust sore at me that I might fall; But Jehovah helped me.

title: Psalms 118:14
text: Jehovah is my strength and song; And he is become my salvation.

title: Psalms 118:15
text: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: The right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.

title: Psalms 118:16
text: The right hand of Jehovah is exalted: The right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.

title: Psalms 118:17
text: I shall not die, but live, And declare the works of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 118:18
text: Jehovah hath chastened me sore; But he hath not given me over unto death.

title: Psalms 118:19
text: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will enter into them, I will give thanks unto Jehovah.

title: Psalms 118:20
text: This is the gate of Jehovah; The righteous shall enter into it.

title: Psalms 118:21
text: I will give thanks unto thee; for thou hast answered me, And art become my salvation.

title: Psalms 118:22
text: The stone which the builders rejected Is become the head of the corner.

title: Psalms 118:23
text: This is Jehovah's doing; It is marvellous in our eyes.

title: Psalms 118:24
text: This is the day which Jehovah hath made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.

title: Psalms 118:25
text: Save now, we beseech thee, O Jehovah: O Jehovah, we beseech thee, send now prosperity.

title: Psalms 118:26
text: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of Jehovah: We have blessed you out of the house of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 118:27
text: Jehovah is God, and he hath given us light: Bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.

title: Psalms 118:28
text: Thou art my God, and I will give thanks unto thee: Thou art my God, I will exalt thee.

title: Psalms 118:29
text: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; For he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 119:1
text: ALEPH. Blessed are they that are perfect in the way, Who walk in the law of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 119:2
text: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, That seek him with the whole heart.

title: Psalms 119:3
text: Yea, they do no unrighteousness; They walk in his ways.

title: Psalms 119:4
text: Thou hast commanded [us] thy precepts, That we should observe them diligently.

title: Psalms 119:5
text: Oh that my ways were established To observe thy statutes!

title: Psalms 119:6
text: Then shall I not be put to shame, When I have respect unto all thy commandments.

title: Psalms 119:7
text: I will give thanks unto thee with uprightness of heart, When I learn thy righteous judgments.

title: Psalms 119:8
text: I will observe thy statutes: Oh forsake me not utterly.

title: Psalms 119:9
text: BETH. Wherewith shall a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed [thereto] according to thy word.

title: Psalms 119:10
text: With my whole heart have I sought thee: Oh let me not wander from thy commandments.

title: Psalms 119:11
text: Thy word have I laid up in my heart, That I might not sin against thee.

title: Psalms 119:12
text: Blessed art thou, O Jehovah: Teach me thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:13
text: With my lips have I declared All the ordinances of thy mouth.

title: Psalms 119:14
text: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, As much as in all riches.

title: Psalms 119:15
text: I will meditate on thy precepts, And have respect unto thy ways.

title: Psalms 119:16
text: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.

title: Psalms 119:17
text: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live; So will I observe thy word.

title: Psalms 119:18
text: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold Wondrous things out of thy law.

title: Psalms 119:19
text: I am a sojourner in the earth: Hide not thy commandments from me.

title: Psalms 119:20
text: My soul breaketh for the longing That it hath unto thine ordinances at all times.

title: Psalms 119:21
text: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, That do wander from thy commandments.

title: Psalms 119:22
text: Take away from me reproach and contempt; For I have kept thy testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:23
text: Princes also sat and talked against me; [But] thy servant did meditate on thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:24
text: Thy testimonies also are my delight [And] my counsellors.

title: Psalms 119:25
text: DALETH. My soul cleaveth unto the dust: Quicken thou me according to thy word.

title: Psalms 119:26
text: I declared my ways, and thou answeredst me: Teach me thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:27
text: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: So shall I meditate on thy wondrous works.

title: Psalms 119:28
text: My soul melteth for heaviness: Strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

title: Psalms 119:29
text: Remove from me the way of falsehood; And grant me thy law graciously.

title: Psalms 119:30
text: I have chosen the way of faithfulness: Thine ordinances have I set [before me] .

title: Psalms 119:31
text: I cleave unto thy testimonies: O Jehovah, put me not to shame.

title: Psalms 119:32
text: I will run the way of thy commandments, When thou shalt enlarge my heart.

title: Psalms 119:33
text: HE. Teach me, O Jehovah, the way of thy statutes; And I shall keep it unto the end.

title: Psalms 119:34
text: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; Yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.

title: Psalms 119:35
text: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; For therein do I delight.

title: Psalms 119:36
text: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, And not to covetousness.

title: Psalms 119:37
text: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity, And quicken me in thy ways.

title: Psalms 119:38
text: Confirm unto thy servant thy word, Which [is in order] unto the fear of thee.

title: Psalms 119:39
text: Turn away my reproach whereof I am afraid; For thine ordinances are good.

title: Psalms 119:40
text: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: Quicken me in thy righteousness.

title: Psalms 119:41
text: VAV. Let thy lovingkindnesses also come unto me, O Jehovah, Even thy salvation, according to thy word.

title: Psalms 119:42
text: So shall I have an answer for him that reproacheth me; For I trust in thy word.

title: Psalms 119:43
text: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; For I have hoped in thine ordinances.

title: Psalms 119:44
text: So shall I observe thy law continually For ever and ever.

title: Psalms 119:45
text: And I shall walk at liberty; For I have sought thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:46
text: I will also speak of thy testimonies before kings, And shall not be put to shame.

title: Psalms 119:47
text: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, Which I have loved.

title: Psalms 119:48
text: I will lift up my hands also unto thy commandments, which I have loved; And I will meditate on thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:49
text: ZAYIN. Remember the word unto thy servant, Because thou hast made me to hope.

title: Psalms 119:50
text: This is my comfort in my affliction; For thy word hath quickened me.

title: Psalms 119:51
text: The proud have had me greatly in derision: [Yet] have I not swerved from thy law.

title: Psalms 119:52
text: I have remembered thine ordinances of old, O Jehovah, And have comforted myself.

title: Psalms 119:53
text: Hot indignation hath taken hold upon me, Because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

title: Psalms 119:54
text: Thy statutes have been my songs In the house of my pilgrimage.

title: Psalms 119:55
text: I have remembered thy name, O Jehovah, in the night, And have observed thy law.

title: Psalms 119:56
text: This I have had, Because I have kept thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:57
text: HHETH. Jehovah is my portion: I have said that I would observe thy words.

title: Psalms 119:58
text: I entreated thy favor with my whole heart: Be merciful unto me according to thy word.

title: Psalms 119:59
text: I thought on my ways, And turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:60
text: I made haste, and delayed not, To observe thy commandments.

title: Psalms 119:61
text: The cords of the wicked have wrapped me round; [But] I have not forgotten thy law.

title: Psalms 119:62
text: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee Because of thy righteous ordinances.

title: Psalms 119:63
text: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, And of them that observe thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:64
text: The earth, O Jehovah, is full of thy lovingkindness: Teach me thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:65
text: TETH. Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Jehovah, according unto thy word.

title: Psalms 119:66
text: Teach me good judgment and knowledge; For I have believed in thy commandments.

title: Psalms 119:67
text: Before I was afflicted I went astray; But now I observe thy word.

title: Psalms 119:68
text: Thou art good, and doest good; Teach me thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:69
text: The proud have forged a lie against me: With my whole heart will I keep thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:70
text: Their heart is as fat as grease; But I delight in thy law.

title: Psalms 119:71
text: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; That I may learn thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:72
text: The law of thy mouth is better unto me Than thousands of gold and silver.

title: Psalms 119:73
text: YODH. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: Give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

title: Psalms 119:74
text: They that fear thee shall see me and be glad, Because I have hoped in thy word.

title: Psalms 119:75
text: I know, O Jehovah, that thy judgments are righteous, And that in faithfulness thou hast afflicted me.

title: Psalms 119:76
text: Let, I pray thee, thy lovingkindness be for my comfort, According to thy word unto thy servant.

title: Psalms 119:77
text: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live; For thy law is my delight.

title: Psalms 119:78
text: Let the proud be put to shame; For they have overthrown me wrongfully: [But] I will meditate on thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:79
text: Let those that fear thee turn unto me; And they shall know thy testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:80
text: Let my heart be perfect in thy statutes, That I be not put to shame.

title: Psalms 119:81
text: KAPH. My soul fainteth for thy salvation; [But] I hope in thy word.

title: Psalms 119:82
text: Mine eyes fail for thy word, While I say, When wilt thou comfort me?

title: Psalms 119:83
text: For I am become like a wine-skin in the smoke; Yet do I not forget thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:84
text: How many are the days of thy servant? When wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

title: Psalms 119:85
text: The proud have digged pits for me, Who are not according to thy law.

title: Psalms 119:86
text: All thy commandments are faithful: They persecute me wrongfully; Help thou me.

title: Psalms 119:87
text: They had almost consumed me upon earth; But I forsook not thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:88
text: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; So shall I observe the testimony of thy mouth.

title: Psalms 119:89
text: LAMEDH. For ever, O Jehovah, Thy word is settled in heaven.

title: Psalms 119:90
text: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: Thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

title: Psalms 119:91
text: They abide this day according to thine ordinances; For all things are thy servants.

title: Psalms 119:92
text: Unless thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

title: Psalms 119:93
text: I will never forget thy precepts; For with them thou hast quickened me.

title: Psalms 119:94
text: I am thine, save me; For I have sought thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:95
text: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me; [But] I will consider thy testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:96
text: I have seen an end of all perfection; [But] thy commandment is exceeding broad.

title: Psalms 119:97
text: MEM. Oh how love I thy law! It is my meditation all the day.

title: Psalms 119:98
text: Thy commandments make me wiser than mine enemies; For they are ever with me.

title: Psalms 119:99
text: I have more understanding than all my teachers; For thy testimonies are my meditation.

title: Psalms 119:100
text: I understand more than the aged, Because I have kept thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:101
text: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, That I might observe thy word.

title: Psalms 119:102
text: I have not turned aside from thine ordinances; For thou hast taught me.

title: Psalms 119:103
text: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! [Yea, sweeter] than honey to my mouth!

title: Psalms 119:104
text: Through thy precepts I get understanding: Therefore I hate every false way.

title: Psalms 119:105
text: NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, And light unto my path.

title: Psalms 119:106
text: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, That I will observe thy righteous ordinances.

title: Psalms 119:107
text: I am afflicted very much: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according unto thy word.

title: Psalms 119:108
text: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill-offerings of my mouth, O Jehovah, And teach me thine ordinances.

title: Psalms 119:109
text: My soul is continually in my hand; Yet do I not forget thy law.

title: Psalms 119:110
text: The wicked have laid a snare for me; Yet have I not gone astray from thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:111
text: Thy testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever; For they are the rejoicing of my heart.

title: Psalms 119:112
text: I have inclined my heart to perform thy statutes For ever, even unto the end.

title: Psalms 119:113
text: SAMEKH. I hate them that are of a double mind; But thy law do I love.

title: Psalms 119:114
text: Thou art my hiding-place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

title: Psalms 119:115
text: Depart from me, ye evil-doers, That I may keep the commandments of my God.

title: Psalms 119:116
text: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live; And let me not be ashamed of my hope.

title: Psalms 119:117
text: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe, And shall have respect unto thy statutes continually.

title: Psalms 119:118
text: Thou hast set at nought all them that err from thy statutes; For their deceit is falsehood.

title: Psalms 119:119
text: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: Therefore I love thy testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:120
text: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; And I am afraid of thy judgments.

title: Psalms 119:121
text: AYIN. I have done justice and righteousness: Leave me not to mine oppressors.

title: Psalms 119:122
text: Be surety for thy servant for good: Let not the proud oppress me.

title: Psalms 119:123
text: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, And for thy righteous word.

title: Psalms 119:124
text: Deal with thy servant according unto thy lovingkindness, And teach me thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:125
text: I am thy servant; Give me understanding, That I may know thy testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:126
text: It is time for Jehovah to work; [For] they have made void thy law.

title: Psalms 119:127
text: Therefore I love thy commandments Above gold, yea, above fine gold.

title: Psalms 119:128
text: Therefore I esteem all [thy] precepts concerning all [things] to be right; [And] I hate every false way.

title: Psalms 119:129
text: PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful; Therefore doth my soul keep them.

title: Psalms 119:130
text: The opening of thy words giveth light; It giveth understanding unto the simple.

title: Psalms 119:131
text: I opened wide my mouth, and panted; For I longed for thy commandments.

title: Psalms 119:132
text: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me, As thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.

title: Psalms 119:133
text: Establish my footsteps in thy word; And let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

title: Psalms 119:134
text: Redeem me from the oppression of man: So will I observe thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:135
text: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; And teach me thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:136
text: Streams of water run down mine eyes, Because they observe not thy law.

title: Psalms 119:137
text: TSADHE. Righteous art thou, O Jehovah, And upright are thy judgments.

title: Psalms 119:138
text: Thou hast commanded thy testimonies in righteousness And very faithfulness.

title: Psalms 119:139
text: My zeal hath consumed me, Because mine adversaries have forgotten thy words.

title: Psalms 119:140
text: Thy word is very pure; Therefore thy servant loveth it.

title: Psalms 119:141
text: I am small and despised; [Yet] do I not forget thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:142
text: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, And thy law is truth.

title: Psalms 119:143
text: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me; [Yet] thy commandments are my delight.

title: Psalms 119:144
text: Thy testimonies are righteous for ever: Give me understanding, and I shall live.

title: Psalms 119:145
text: QOPH. I have called with my whole heart; Answer me, O Jehovah: I will keep thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:146
text: I have called unto thee; Save me, And I shall observe thy testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:147
text: I anticipated the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy words.

title: Psalms 119:148
text: Mine eyes anticipated the night-watches, That I might meditate on thy word.

title: Psalms 119:149
text: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thine ordinances.

title: Psalms 119:150
text: They draw nigh that follow after wickedness; They are far from thy law.

title: Psalms 119:151
text: Thou art nigh, O Jehovah; And all thy commandments are truth.

title: Psalms 119:152
text: Of old have I known from thy testimonies, That thou hast founded them for ever.

title: Psalms 119:153
text: RESH. Consider mine affliction, and deliver me; For I do not forget thy law.

title: Psalms 119:154
text: Plead thou my cause, and redeem me: Quicken me according to thy word.

title: Psalms 119:155
text: Salvation is far from the wicked; For they seek not thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:156
text: Great are thy tender mercies, O Jehovah: Quicken me according to thine ordinances.

title: Psalms 119:157
text: Many are my persecutors and mine adversaries; [Yet] have I not swerved from thy testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:158
text: I beheld the treacherous, and was grieved, Because they observe not thy word.

title: Psalms 119:159
text: Consider how I love thy precepts: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thy lovingkindness.

title: Psalms 119:160
text: The sum of thy word is truth; And every one of thy righteous ordinances [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 119:161
text: SHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause; But my heart standeth in awe of thy words.

title: Psalms 119:162
text: I rejoice at thy word, As one that findeth great spoil.

title: Psalms 119:163
text: I hate and abhor falsehood; [But] thy law do I love.

title: Psalms 119:164
text: Seven times a day do I praise thee, Because of thy righteous ordinances.

title: Psalms 119:165
text: Great peace have they that love thy law; And they have no occasion of stumbling.

title: Psalms 119:166
text: I have hoped for thy salvation, O Jehovah, And have done thy commandments.

title: Psalms 119:167
text: My soul hath observed thy testimonies; And I love them exceedingly.

title: Psalms 119:168
text: I have observed thy precepts and thy testimonies; For all my ways are before thee.

title: Psalms 119:169
text: TAV. Let my cry come near before thee, O Jehovah: Give me understanding according to thy word.

title: Psalms 119:170
text: Let my supplication come before thee: Deliver me according to thy word.

title: Psalms 119:171
text: Let my lips utter praise; For thou teachest me thy statutes.

title: Psalms 119:172
text: Let my tongue sing of thy word; For all thy commandments are righteousness.

title: Psalms 119:173
text: Let thy hand be ready to help me; For I have chosen thy precepts.

title: Psalms 119:174
text: I have longed for thy salvation, O Jehovah; And thy law is my delight.

title: Psalms 119:175
text: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; And let thine ordinances help me.

title: Psalms 119:176
text: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; Seek thy servant; For I do not forget thy commandments.

title: Psalms 120
inscription: A Song of Ascents

title: Psalms 120:1
text: In my distress I cried unto Jehovah, And he answered me.

title: Psalms 120:2
text: Deliver my soul, O Jehovah, from lying lips, [And] from a deceitful tongue.

title: Psalms 120:3
text: What shall be given unto thee, and what shall be done more unto thee, Thou deceitful tongue?

title: Psalms 120:4
text: Sharp arrows of the mighty, With coals of juniper.

title: Psalms 120:5
text: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Meshech, That I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

title: Psalms 120:6
text: My soul hath long had her dwelling With him that hateth peace.

title: Psalms 120:7
text: I am [for] peace: But when I speak, they are for war.

title: Psalms 121
inscription: A Song of Ascents

title: Psalms 121:1
text: I will lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: From whence shall my help come?

title: Psalms 121:2
text: My help [cometh] from Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.

title: Psalms 121:3
text: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: He that keepeth thee will not slumber.

title: Psalms 121:4
text: Behold, he that keepeth Israel Will neither slumber nor sleep.

title: Psalms 121:5
text: Jehovah is thy keeper: Jehovah is thy shade upon thy right hand.

title: Psalms 121:6
text: The sun shall not smite thee by day, Nor the moon by night.

title: Psalms 121:7
text: Jehovah will keep thee from all evil; He will keep thy soul.

title: Psalms 121:8
text: Jehovah will keep thy going out and thy coming in From this time forth and for evermore.

title: Psalms 122
inscription: A Song of Ascents; of David

title: Psalms 122:1
text: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go unto the house of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 122:2
text: Our feet are standing Within thy gates, O Jerusalem,

title: Psalms 122:3
text: Jerusalem, that art builded As a city that is compact together;

title: Psalms 122:4
text: Whither the tribes go up, even the tribes of Jehovah, [For] an ordinance for Israel, To give thanks unto the name of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 122:5
text: For there are set thrones for judgment, The thrones of the house of David.

title: Psalms 122:6
text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: They shall prosper that love thee.

title: Psalms 122:7
text: Peace be within thy walls, And prosperity within thy palaces.

title: Psalms 122:8
text: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.

title: Psalms 122:9
text: For the sake of the house of Jehovah our God I will seek thy good.

title: Psalms 123
inscription: A Song of Ascents

title: Psalms 123:1
text: Unto thee do I lift up mine eyes, O thou that sittest in the heavens.

title: Psalms 123:2
text: Behold, as the eyes of servants [look] unto the hand of their master, As the eyes of a maid unto the hand of her mistress; So our eyes [look] unto Jehovah our God, Until he have mercy upon us.

title: Psalms 123:3
text: Have mercy upon us, O Jehovah, have mercy upon us; For we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

title: Psalms 123:4
text: Our soul is exceedingly filled With the scoffing of those that are at ease, And with the contempt of the proud.

title: Psalms 124
inscription: A Song of Ascents; of David

title: Psalms 124:1
text: If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side, Let Israel now say,

title: Psalms 124:2
text: If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side, When men rose up against us;

title: Psalms 124:3
text: Then they had swallowed us up alive, When their wrath was kindled against us;

title: Psalms 124:4
text: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, The stream had gone over our soul;

title: Psalms 124:5
text: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

title: Psalms 124:6
text: Blessed be Jehovah, Who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

title: Psalms 124:7
text: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: The snare is broken, and we are escaped.

title: Psalms 124:8
text: Our help is in the name of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.

title: Psalms 125
inscription: A Song of Ascents

title: Psalms 125:1
text: They that trust in Jehovah Are as mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abideth for ever.

title: Psalms 125:2
text: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, So Jehovah is round about his people From this time forth and for evermore.

title: Psalms 125:3
text: For the sceptre of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; That the righteous put not forth their hands unto iniquity.

title: Psalms 125:4
text: Do good, O Jehovah, unto those that are good, And to them that are upright in their hearts.

title: Psalms 125:5
text: But as for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, Jehovah will lead them forth with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel.

title: Psalms 126
inscription: A Song of Ascents

title: Psalms 126:1
text: When Jehovah brought back those that returned to Zion, We were like unto them that dream.

title: Psalms 126:2
text: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, And our tongue with singing: Then said they among the nations, Jehovah hath done great things for them.

title: Psalms 126:3
text: Jehovah hath done great things for us, [Whereof] we are glad.

title: Psalms 126:4
text: Turn again our captivity, O Jehovah, As the streams in the South.

title: Psalms 126:5
text: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

title: Psalms 126:6
text: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing seed for sowing, Shall doubtless come again with joy, bringing his sheaves [with him] .

title: Psalms 127
inscription: A Song of Ascents; of Solomon

title: Psalms 127:1
text: Except Jehovah build the house, They labor in vain that build it: Except Jehovah keep the city, The watchman waketh but in vain.

title: Psalms 127:2
text: It is vain for you to rise up early, To take rest late, To eat the bread of toil; [For] so he giveth unto his beloved sleep.

title: Psalms 127:3
text: Lo, children are a heritage of Jehovah; [And] the fruit of the womb is [his] reward.

title: Psalms 127:4
text: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, So are the children of youth.

title: Psalms 127:5
text: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: They shall not be put to shame, When they speak with their enemies in the gate.

title: Psalms 128
inscription: A Song of Ascents

title: Psalms 128:1
text: Blessed is every one that feareth Jehovah, That walketh in his ways.

title: Psalms 128:2
text: For thou shalt eat the labor of thy hands: Happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

title: Psalms 128:3
text: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine, In the innermost parts of thy house; Thy children like olive plants, Round about thy table.

title: Psalms 128:4
text: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed That feareth Jehovah.

title: Psalms 128:5
text: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion: And see thou the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

title: Psalms 128:6
text: Yea, see thou thy children's children. Peace be upon Israel.

title: Psalms 129
inscription: A Song of Ascents

title: Psalms 129:1
text: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up, Let Israel now say,

title: Psalms 129:2
text: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up: Yet they have not prevailed against me.

title: Psalms 129:3
text: The plowers plowed upon my back; They made long their furrows.

title: Psalms 129:4
text: Jehovah is righteous: He hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

title: Psalms 129:5
text: Let them be put to shame and turned backward, All they that hate Zion.

title: Psalms 129:6
text: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, Which withereth before it groweth up;

title: Psalms 129:7
text: Wherewith the reaper filleth not his hand, Nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

title: Psalms 129:8
text: Neither do they that go by say, The blessing of Jehovah be upon you; We bless you in the name of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 130
