inscription: A Song of Ascents

title: Psalms 130:1
text: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Jehovah.

title: Psalms 130:2
text: Lord, hear my voice: Let thine ears be attentive To the voice of my supplications.

title: Psalms 130:3
text: If thou, Jehovah, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?

title: Psalms 130:4
text: But there is forgiveness with thee, That thou mayest be feared.

title: Psalms 130:5
text: I wait for Jehovah, my soul doth wait, And in his word do I hope.

title: Psalms 130:6
text: My soul [waiteth] for the Lord More than watchmen [wait] for the morning; [Yea, more than] watchmen for the morning.

title: Psalms 130:7
text: O Israel, hope in Jehovah; For with Jehovah there is lovingkindness, And with him is plenteous redemption.

title: Psalms 130:8
text: And he will redeem Israel From all his iniquities.

title: Psalms 131
inscription: A Song of Ascents; of David

title: Psalms 131:1
text: Jehovah, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty; Neither do I exercise myself in great matters, Or in things too wonderful for me.

title: Psalms 131:2
text: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; Like a weaned child with his mother, Like a weaned child is my soul within me.

title: Psalms 131:3
text: O Israel, hope in Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore.

title: Psalms 132
inscription: A Song of Ascents

title: Psalms 132:1
text: Jehovah, remember for David All his affliction;

title: Psalms 132:2
text: How he sware unto Jehovah, And vowed unto the Mighty One of Jacob:

title: Psalms 132:3
text: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, Nor go up into my bed;

title: Psalms 132:4
text: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, Or slumber to mine eyelids;

title: Psalms 132:5
text: Until I find out a place for Jehovah, A tabernacle for the Mighty One of Jacob.

title: Psalms 132:6
text: Lo, we heard of it in Ephrathah: We found it in the field of the wood.

title: Psalms 132:7
text: We will go into his tabernacles; We will worship at his footstool.

title: Psalms 132:8
text: Arise, O Jehovah, into thy resting-place; Thou, and the ark of thy strength.

title: Psalms 132:9
text: Let thy priest be clothed with righteousness; And let thy saints shout for joy.

title: Psalms 132:10
text: For thy servant David's sake Turn not away the face of thine anointed.

title: Psalms 132:11
text: Jehovah hath sworn unto David in truth; He will not turn from it: Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

title: Psalms 132:12
text: If thy children will keep my covenant And my testimony that I shall teach them, Their children also shall sit upon thy throne for evermore.

title: Psalms 132:13
text: For Jehovah hath chosen Zion; He hath desired it for his habitation.

title: Psalms 132:14
text: This is my resting-place for ever: Here will I dwell; For I have desired it.

title: Psalms 132:15
text: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

title: Psalms 132:16
text: Her priests also will I clothe with salvation; And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

title: Psalms 132:17
text: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

title: Psalms 132:18
text: His enemies will I clothe with shame; But upon himself shall his crown flourish.

title: Psalms 133
inscription: A Song of Ascents; of David

title: Psalms 133:1
text: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity!

title: Psalms 133:2
text: It is like the precious oil upon the head, That ran down upon the beard, Even Aaron's beard; That came down upon the skirt of his garments;

title: Psalms 133:3
text: Like the dew of Hermon, That cometh down upon the mountains of Zion: For there Jehovah commanded the blessing, Even life for evermore.

title: Psalms 134
inscription: A Song of Ascents

title: Psalms 134:1
text: Behold, bless ye Jehovah, all ye servants of Jehovah, That by night stand in the house of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 134:2
text: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary, And bless ye Jehovah.

title: Psalms 134:3
text: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion; Even he that made heaven and earth.

title: Psalms 135:1
text: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise ye the name of Jehovah; Praise [him], O ye servants of Jehovah,

title: Psalms 135:2
text: Ye that stand in the house of Jehovah, In the courts of the house of our God.

title: Psalms 135:3
text: Praise ye Jehovah; For Jehovah is good: Sing praises unto his name; For it is pleasant.

title: Psalms 135:4
text: For Jehovah hath chosen Jacob unto himself, [And] Israel for his own possession.

title: Psalms 135:5
text: For I know that Jehovah is great, And that our Lord is above all gods.

title: Psalms 135:6
text: Whatsoever Jehovah pleased, that hath he done, In heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps;

title: Psalms 135:7
text: Who causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; Who maketh lightnings for the rain; Who bringeth forth the wind out of his treasuries;

title: Psalms 135:8
text: Who smote the first-born of Egypt, Both of man and beast;

title: Psalms 135:9
text: Who sent signs and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, Upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants;

title: Psalms 135:10
text: Who smote many nations, And slew mighty kings,

title: Psalms 135:11
text: Sihon king of the Amorites, And Og king of Bashan, And all the kingdoms of Canaan,

title: Psalms 135:12
text: And gave their land for a heritage, A heritage unto Israel his people.

title: Psalms 135:13
text: Thy name, O Jehovah, [endureth] for ever; Thy memorial [name], O Jehovah, throughout all generations.

title: Psalms 135:14
text: For Jehovah will judge his people, And repent himself concerning his servants.

title: Psalms 135:15
text: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, The work of men's hands.

title: Psalms 135:16
text: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;

title: Psalms 135:17
text: They have ears, but they hear not; Neither is there any breath in their mouths.

title: Psalms 135:18
text: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.

title: Psalms 135:19
text: O house of Israel, bless ye Jehovah: O house of Aaron, bless ye Jehovah:

title: Psalms 135:20
text: O house of Levi, bless ye Jehovah: Ye that fear Jehovah, bless ye Jehovah.

title: Psalms 135:21
text: Blessed be Jehovah out of Zion, Who dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye Jehovah.

title: Psalms 136:1
text: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; For he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 136:2
text: Oh give thanks unto the God of gods; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 136:3
text: Oh give thanks unto the Lord of lords; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

title: Psalms 136:4
text: To him who alone doeth great wonders; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

title: Psalms 136:5
text: To him that by understanding made the heavens; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

title: Psalms 136:6
text: To him that spread forth the earth above the waters; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

title: Psalms 136:7
text: To him that made great lights; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

title: Psalms 136:8
text: The sun to rule by day; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:9
text: The moon and stars to rule by night; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

title: Psalms 136:10
text: To him that smote Egypt in their first-born; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:11
text: And brought out Israel from among them; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:12
text: With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

title: Psalms 136:13
text: To him that divided the Red Sea in sunder; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:14
text: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:15
text: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red Sea; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

title: Psalms 136:16
text: To him that led his people through the wilderness; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

title: Psalms 136:17
text: To him that smote great kings; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:18
text: And slew famous kings; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

title: Psalms 136:19
text: Sihon king of the Amorites; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:20
text: And Og king of Bashan; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:21
text: And gave their land for a heritage; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:22
text: Even a heritage unto Israel his servant; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

title: Psalms 136:23
text: Who remembered us in our low estate; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

title: Psalms 136:24
text: And hath delivered us from our adversaries; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

title: Psalms 136:25
text: Who giveth food to all flesh; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 136:26
text: Oh give thanks unto the God of heaven; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

title: Psalms 137:1
text: By the rivers of Babylon, There we sat down, yea, we wept, When we remembered Zion.

title: Psalms 137:2
text: Upon the willows in the midst thereof We hanged up our harps.

title: Psalms 137:3
text: For there they that led us captive required of us songs, And they that wasted us [required of us] mirth, [saying], Sing us one of the songs of Zion.

title: Psalms 137:4
text: How shall we sing Jehovah's song In a foreign land?

title: Psalms 137:5
text: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, Let my right hand forget [her skill] .

title: Psalms 137:6
text: Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth, If I remember thee not; If I prefer not Jerusalem Above my chief joy.

title: Psalms 137:7
text: Remember, O Jehovah, against the children of Edom The day of Jerusalem; Who said, Rase it, rase it, Even to the foundation thereof.

title: Psalms 137:8
text: O daughter of Babylon, that art to be destroyed, Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee As thou hast served us.

title: Psalms 137:9
text: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones Against the rock.

title: Psalms 138:1
text: [[ A Psalm] of David]. I will give thee thanks with my whole heart: Before the gods will I sing praises unto thee.

title: Psalms 138:2
text: I will worship toward thy holy temple, And give thanks unto thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: For thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

title: Psalms 138:3
text: In the day that I called thou answeredst me, Thou didst encourage me with strength in my soul.

title: Psalms 138:4
text: All the kings of the earth shall give thee thanks, O Jehovah, For they have heard the words of thy mouth.

title: Psalms 138:5
text: Yea, they shall sing of the ways of Jehovah; For great is the glory of Jehovah.

title: Psalms 138:6
text: For though Jehovah is high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly; But the haughty he knoweth from afar.

title: Psalms 138:7
text: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me; Thou wilt stretch forth thy hand against the wrath of mine enemies, And thy right hand will save me.

title: Psalms 138:8
text: Jehovah will perfect that which concerneth me: Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, [endureth] for ever; Forsake not the works of thine own hands.

title: Psalms 139
inscription: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 139:1
text: O Jehovah, thou hast searched me, and known [me] .

title: Psalms 139:2
text: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising; Thou understandest my thought afar off.

title: Psalms 139:3
text: Thou searchest out my path and my lying down, And art acquainted with all my ways.

title: Psalms 139:4
text: For there is not a word in my tongue, But, lo, O Jehovah, thou knowest it altogether.

title: Psalms 139:5
text: Thou hast beset me behind and before, And laid thy hand upon me.

title: Psalms 139:6
text: [ Such] knowledge is too wonderful for me; It is high, I cannot attain unto it.

title: Psalms 139:7
text: Whither shall I go from thy Spirit? Or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

title: Psalms 139:8
text: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, thou art there.

title: Psalms 139:9
text: If I take the wings of the morning, And dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

title: Psalms 139:10
text: Even there shall thy hand lead me, And thy right hand shall hold me.

title: Psalms 139:11
text: If I say, Surely the darkness shall overwhelm me, And the light about me shall be night;

title: Psalms 139:12
text: Even the darkness hideth not from thee, But the night shineth as the day: The darkness and the light are both alike [to thee] .

title: Psalms 139:13
text: For thou didst form my inward parts: Thou didst cover me in my mother's womb.

title: Psalms 139:14
text: I will give thanks unto thee; For I am fearfully and wonderfully made: Wonderful are thy works; And that my soul knoweth right well.

title: Psalms 139:15
text: My frame was not hidden from thee, When I was made in secret, [And] curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

title: Psalms 139:16
text: Thine eyes did see mine unformed substance; And in thy book they were all written, [Even] the days that were ordained [for me], When as yet there was none of them.

title: Psalms 139:17
text: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! How great is the sum of them!

title: Psalms 139:18
text: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: When I awake, I am still with thee.

title: Psalms 139:19
text: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: Depart from me therefore, ye bloodthirsty men.

title: Psalms 139:20
text: For they speak against thee wickedly, And thine enemies take [thy name] in vain.

title: Psalms 139:21
text: Do not I hate them, O Jehovah, that hate thee? And am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

title: Psalms 139:22
text: I hate them with perfect hatred: They are become mine enemies.

title: Psalms 139:23
text: Search me, O God, and know my heart: Try me, and know my thoughts;

title: Psalms 139:24
text: And see if there be any wicked way in me, And lead me in the way everlasting.

title: Psalms 140
inscription: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 140:1
text: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from the evil man; Preserve me from the violent man:

title: Psalms 140:2
text: Who devise mischiefs in their heart; Continually do they gather themselves together for war.

title: Psalms 140:3
text: They have sharpened their tongue like a serpent; Adders' poison is under their lips. {{Selah

title: Psalms 140:4
text: Keep me, O Jehovah, from the hands of the wicked; Preserve me from the violent man: Who have purposed to thrust aside my steps.

title: Psalms 140:5
text: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; They have spread a net by the wayside; They have set gins for me. {{Selah

title: Psalms 140:6
text: I said unto Jehovah, Thou art my God: Give ear unto the voice of my supplications, O Jehovah.

title: Psalms 140:7
text: O Jehovah the Lord, the strength of my salvation, Thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

title: Psalms 140:8
text: Grant not, O Jehovah, the desires of the wicked; Further not his evil device, [lest] they exalt themselves. {{Selah

title: Psalms 140:9
text: As for the head of those that compass me about, Let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

title: Psalms 140:10
text: Let burning coals fall upon them: Let them be cast into the fire, Into deep pits, whence they shall not rise.

title: Psalms 140:11
text: An evil speaker shall not be established in the earth: Evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

title: Psalms 140:12
text: I know that Jehovah will maintain the cause of the afflicted, And justice for the needy.

title: Psalms 140:13
text: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: The upright shall dwell in thy presence.

title: Psalms 141
inscription: A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 141:1
text: Jehovah, I have called upon thee; Make haste unto me: Give ear unto my voice, when I call unto thee.

title: Psalms 141:2
text: Let my prayer be set forth as incense before thee; The lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

title: Psalms 141:3
text: Set a watch, O Jehovah, before my mouth; Keep the door of my lips.

title: Psalms 141:4
text: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, To practise deeds of wickedness With men that work iniquity: And let me not eat of their dainties.

title: Psalms 141:5
text: Let the righteous smite me, [it shall be] a kindness; And let him reprove me, [it shall be as] oil upon the head; Let not my head refuse it: For even in their wickedness shall my prayer continue.

title: Psalms 141:6
text: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock; And they shall hear my words; For they are sweet.

title: Psalms 141:7
text: As when one ploweth and cleaveth the earth, Our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.

title: Psalms 141:8
text: For mine eyes are unto thee, O Jehovah the Lord: In thee do I take refuge; leave not my soul destitute.

title: Psalms 141:9
text: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, And from the gins of the workers of iniquity.

title: Psalms 141:10
text: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, Whilst that I withal escape.

title: Psalms 142
inscription: Maschil of David, when he was in the cave; a Prayer

title: Psalms 142:1
text: I cry with my voice unto Jehovah; With my voice unto Jehovah do I make supplication.

title: Psalms 142:2
text: I pour out my complaint before him; I show before him my trouble.

title: Psalms 142:3
text: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, Thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walk Have they hidden a snare for me.

title: Psalms 142:4
text: Look on [my] right hand, and see; For there is no man that knoweth me: Refuge hath failed me; No man careth for my soul.

title: Psalms 142:5
text: I cried unto thee, O Jehovah; I said, Thou art my refuge, My portion in the land of the living.

title: Psalms 142:6
text: Attend unto my cry; For I am brought very low: Deliver me from my persecutors; For they are stronger than I.

title: Psalms 142:7
text: Bring my soul out of prison, That I may give thanks unto thy name: The righteous shall compass me about; For thou wilt deal bountifully with me.

title: Psalms 143
inscription: A Psalm of David

title: Psalms 143:1
text: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah; Give ear to my supplications: In thy faithfulness answer me, [and] in thy righteousness.

title: Psalms 143:2
text: And enter not into judgment with thy servant; For in thy sight no man living is righteous.

title: Psalms 143:3
text: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; He hath smitten my life down to the ground: He hath made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.

title: Psalms 143:4
text: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; My heart within me is desolate.

title: Psalms 143:5
text: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy doings; I muse on the work of thy hands.

title: Psalms 143:6
text: I spread forth my hands unto thee: My soul [thirsteth] after thee, as a weary land. {{Selah

title: Psalms 143:7
text: Make haste to answer me, O Jehovah; My spirit faileth: Hide not thy face from me, Lest I become like them that go down into the pit.

title: Psalms 143:8
text: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; For in thee do I trust: Cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; For I lift up my soul unto thee.

title: Psalms 143:9
text: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.

title: Psalms 143:10
text: Teach me to do thy will; For thou art my God: Thy Spirit is good; Lead me in the land of uprightness.

title: Psalms 143:11
text: Quicken me, O Jehovah, for thy name's sake: In thy righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.

title: Psalms 143:12
text: And in thy lovingkindness cut off mine enemies, And destroy all them that afflict my soul; For I am thy servant.

title: Psalms 144:1
text: [[ A Psalm] of David]. Blessed be Jehovah my rock, Who teacheth my hands to war, [And] my fingers to fight:

title: Psalms 144:2
text: My lovingkindness, and my fortress, My high tower, and my deliverer; My shield, and he in whom I take refuge; Who subdueth my people under me.

title: Psalms 144:3
text: Jehovah, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him? Or the son of man, that thou makest account of him?

title: Psalms 144:4
text: Man is like to vanity: His days are as a shadow that passeth away.

title: Psalms 144:5
text: Bow thy heavens, O Jehovah, and come down: Touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

title: Psalms 144:6
text: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them; Send out thine arrows, and discomfit them.

title: Psalms 144:7
text: Stretch forth thy hand from above; Rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, Out of the hand of aliens;

title: Psalms 144:8
text: Whose mouth speaketh deceit, And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

title: Psalms 144:9
text: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: Upon a psaltery of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.

title: Psalms 144:10
text: Thou art he that giveth salvation unto kings; Who rescueth David his servant from the hurtful sword.

title: Psalms 144:11
text: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hand of aliens, Whose mouth speaketh deceit, And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

title: Psalms 144:12
text: When our sons shall be as plants grown up in their youth, And our daughters as corner-stones hewn after the fashion of a palace;

title: Psalms 144:13
text: [ When] our garners are full, affording all manner of store, [And] our sheep bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our fields;

title: Psalms 144:14
text: [ When] our oxen are well laden; [When there is] no breaking in, and no going forth, And no outcry in our streets:

title: Psalms 144:15
text: Happy is the people that is in such a case; [Yea], happy is the people whose God is Jehovah.

title: Psalms 145:1
text: [[ A Psalm of] praise; of David]. I will extol thee, my God, O King; And I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

title: Psalms 145:2
text: Every day will I bless thee; And I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

title: Psalms 145:3
text: Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised; And his greatness is unsearchable.

title: Psalms 145:4
text: One generation shall laud thy works to another, And shall declare thy mighty acts.

title: Psalms 145:5
text: Of the glorious majesty of thine honor, And of thy wondrous works, will I meditate.

title: Psalms 145:6
text: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts; And I will declare thy greatness.

title: Psalms 145:7
text: They shall utter the memory of thy great goodness, And shall sing of thy righteousness.

title: Psalms 145:8
text: Jehovah is gracious, and merciful; Slow to anger, and of great lovingkindness.

title: Psalms 145:9
text: Jehovah is good to all; And his tender mercies are over all his works.

title: Psalms 145:10
text: All thy works shall give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah; And thy saints shall bless thee.

title: Psalms 145:11
text: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, And talk of thy power;

title: Psalms 145:12
text: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, And the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

title: Psalms 145:13
text: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And thy dominion [endureth] throughout all generations.

title: Psalms 145:14
text: Jehovah upholdeth all that fall, And raiseth up all those that are bowed down.

title: Psalms 145:15
text: The eyes of all wait for thee; And thou givest them their food in due season.

title: Psalms 145:16
text: Thou openest thy hand, And satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

title: Psalms 145:17
text: Jehovah is righteous in all his ways, And gracious in all his works.

title: Psalms 145:18
text: Jehovah is nigh unto all them that call upon him, To all that call upon him in truth.

title: Psalms 145:19
text: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him; He also will hear their cry and will save them.

title: Psalms 145:20
text: Jehovah preserveth all them that love him; But all the wicked will he destroy.

title: Psalms 145:21
text: My mouth shall speak the praise of Jehovah; And let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

title: Psalms 146:1
text: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise Jehovah, O my soul.

title: Psalms 146:2
text: While I live will I praise Jehovah: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.

title: Psalms 146:3
text: Put not your trust in princes, Nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

title: Psalms 146:4
text: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; In that very day his thoughts perish.

title: Psalms 146:5
text: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, Whose hope is in Jehovah his God:

title: Psalms 146:6
text: Who made heaven and earth, The sea, and all that in them is; Who keepeth truth for ever;

title: Psalms 146:7
text: Who executeth justice for the oppressed; Who giveth food to the hungry. Jehovah looseth the prisoners;

title: Psalms 146:8
text: Jehovah openeth [the eyes of] the blind; Jehovah raiseth up them that are bowed down; Jehovah loveth the righteous;

title: Psalms 146:9
text: Jehovah preserveth the sojourners; He upholdeth the fatherless and widow; But the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.

title: Psalms 146:10
text: Jehovah will reign for ever, Thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye Jehovah.

title: Psalms 147:1
text: Praise ye Jehovah; For it is good to sing praises unto our God; For it is pleasant, [and] praise is comely.

title: Psalms 147:2
text: Jehovah doth build up Jerusalem; He gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.

title: Psalms 147:3
text: He healeth the broken in heart, And bindeth up their wounds.

title: Psalms 147:4
text: He counteth the number of the stars; He calleth them all by [their] names.

title: Psalms 147:5
text: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding is infinite.

title: Psalms 147:6
text: Jehovah upholdeth the meek: He bringeth the wicked down to the ground.

title: Psalms 147:7
text: Sing unto Jehovah with thanksgiving; Sing praises upon the harp unto our God,

title: Psalms 147:8
text: Who covereth the heavens with clouds, Who prepareth rain for the earth, Who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.

title: Psalms 147:9
text: He giveth to the beast his food, [And] to the young ravens which cry.

title: Psalms 147:10
text: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: He taketh no pleasure in the legs of a man.

title: Psalms 147:11
text: Jehovah taketh pleasure in them that fear him, In those that hope in his lovingkindness.

title: Psalms 147:12
text: Praise Jehovah, O Jerusalem; Praise thy God, O Zion.

title: Psalms 147:13
text: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; He hath blessed thy children within thee.

title: Psalms 147:14
text: He maketh peace in thy borders; He filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.

title: Psalms 147:15
text: He sendeth out his commandment upon earth; His word runneth very swiftly.

title: Psalms 147:16
text: He giveth snow like wool; He scattereth the hoar-frost like ashes.

title: Psalms 147:17
text: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: Who can stand before his cold?

title: Psalms 147:18
text: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: He causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

title: Psalms 147:19
text: He showeth his word unto Jacob, His statutes and his ordinances unto Israel.

title: Psalms 147:20
text: He hath not dealt so with any nation; And as for his ordinances, they have not known them. Praise ye Jehovah.

title: Psalms 148:1
text: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah from the heavens: Praise him in the heights.

title: Psalms 148:2
text: Praise ye him, all his angels: Praise ye him, all his host.

title: Psalms 148:3
text: Praise ye him, sun and moon: Praise him, all ye stars of light.

title: Psalms 148:4
text: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, And ye waters that are above the heavens.

title: Psalms 148:5
text: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For he commanded, and they were created.

title: Psalms 148:6
text: He hath also established them for ever and ever: He hath made a decree which shall not pass away.

title: Psalms 148:7
text: Praise Jehovah from the earth, Ye sea-monsters, and all deeps.

title: Psalms 148:8
text: Fire and hail, snow and vapor; Stormy wind, fulfilling his word;

title: Psalms 148:9
text: Mountains and all hills; Fruitful trees and all cedars;

title: Psalms 148:10
text: Beasts and all cattle; Creeping things and flying birds;

title: Psalms 148:11
text: Kings of the earth and all peoples; Princes and all judges of the earth;

title: Psalms 148:12
text: Both young men and virgins; Old men and children:

title: Psalms 148:13
text: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For his name alone is exalted; His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

title: Psalms 148:14
text: And he hath lifted up the horn of his people, The praise of all his saints; Even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye Jehovah.

title: Psalms 149:1
text: Praise ye Jehovah. Sing unto Jehovah a new song, And his praise in the assembly of the saints.

title: Psalms 149:2
text: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

title: Psalms 149:3
text: Let them praise his name in the dance: Let them sing praises unto him with timbrel and harp.

title: Psalms 149:4
text: For Jehovah taketh pleasure in his people: He will beautify the meek with salvation.

title: Psalms 149:5
text: Let the saints exult in glory: Let them sing for joy upon their beds.

title: Psalms 149:6
text: [ Let] the high praises of God [be] in their mouth, And a two-edged sword in their hand;

title: Psalms 149:7
text: To execute vengeance upon the nations, And punishments upon the peoples;

title: Psalms 149:8
text: To bind their kings with chains, And their nobles with fetters of iron;

title: Psalms 149:9
text: To execute upon them the judgment written: This honor have all his saints. Praise ye Jehovah.

title: Psalms 150:1
text: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise God in his sanctuary: Praise him in the firmament of his power.

title: Psalms 150:2
text: Praise him for his mighty acts: Praise him according to his excellent greatness.

title: Psalms 150:3
text: Praise him with trumpet sound: Praise him with psaltery and harp.

title: Psalms 150:4
text: Praise him with timbrel and dance: Praise him with stringed instruments and pipe.

title: Psalms 150:5
text: Praise him with loud cymbals: Praise him with high sounding cymbals.

title: Psalms 150:6
text: Let everything that hath breath praise Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah.

title: Proverbs 1:1
text: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel:

title: Proverbs 1:2
text: To know wisdom and instruction; To discern the words of understanding;

title: Proverbs 1:3
text: To receive instruction in wise dealing, In righteousness and justice and equity;

title: Proverbs 1:4
text: To give prudence to the simple, To the young man knowledge and discretion:

title: Proverbs 1:5
text: That the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; And that the man of understanding may attain unto sound counsels:

title: Proverbs 1:6
text: To understand a proverb, and a figure, The words of the wise, and their dark sayings.

title: Proverbs 1:7
text: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of knowledge; [But] the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

title: Proverbs 1:8
text: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, And forsake not the law of thy mother:

title: Proverbs 1:9
text: For they shall be a chaplet of grace unto thy head, And chains about thy neck.

title: Proverbs 1:10
text: My son, if sinners entice thee, Consent thou not.

title: Proverbs 1:11
text: If they say, Come with us, Let us lay wait for blood; Let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause;

title: Proverbs 1:12
text: Let us swallow them up alive as Sheol, And whole, as those that go down into the pit;

title: Proverbs 1:13
text: We shall find all precious substance; We shall fill our houses with spoil;

title: Proverbs 1:14
text: Thou shalt cast thy lot among us; We will all have one purse:

title: Proverbs 1:15
text: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; Refrain thy foot from their path:

title: Proverbs 1:16
text: For their feet run to evil, And they make haste to shed blood.

title: Proverbs 1:17
text: For in vain is the net spread In the sight of any bird:

title: Proverbs 1:18
text: And these lay wait for their own blood; They lurk privily for their own lives.

title: Proverbs 1:19
text: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; It taketh away the life of the owners thereof.

title: Proverbs 1:20
text: Wisdom crieth aloud in the street; She uttereth her voice in the broad places;

title: Proverbs 1:21
text: She crieth in the chief place of concourse; At the entrance of the gates, In the city, she uttereth her words:

title: Proverbs 1:22
text: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? And scoffers delight them in scoffing, And fools hate knowledge?

title: Proverbs 1:23
text: Turn you at my reproof: Behold, I will pour out my spirit upon you; I will make known my words unto you.

title: Proverbs 1:24
text: Because I have called, and ye have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man hath regarded;

title: Proverbs 1:25
text: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, And would none of my reproof:

title: Proverbs 1:26
text: I also will laugh in [the day of] your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;

title: Proverbs 1:27
text: When your fear cometh as a storm, And your calamity cometh on as a whirlwind; When distress and anguish come upon you.

title: Proverbs 1:28
text: Then will they call upon me, but I will not answer; They will seek me diligently, but they shall not find me:

title: Proverbs 1:29
text: For that they hated knowledge, And did not choose the fear of Jehovah:

title: Proverbs 1:30
text: They would none of my counsel; They despised all my reproof.

title: Proverbs 1:31
text: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, And be filled with their own devices.

title: Proverbs 1:32
text: For the backsliding of the simple shall slay them, And the careless ease of fools shall destroy them.

title: Proverbs 1:33
text: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell securely, And shall be quiet without fear of evil.

title: Proverbs 2:1
text: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, And lay up my commandments with thee;

title: Proverbs 2:2
text: So as to incline thine ear unto wisdom, And apply thy heart to understanding;

title: Proverbs 2:3
text: Yea, if thou cry after discernment, And lift up thy voice for understanding;

title: Proverbs 2:4
text: If thou seek her as silver, And search for her as for hid treasures:

title: Proverbs 2:5
text: Then shalt thou understand the fear of Jehovah, And find the knowledge of God.

title: Proverbs 2:6
text: For Jehovah giveth wisdom; Out of his mouth [cometh] knowledge and understanding:

title: Proverbs 2:7
text: He layeth up sound wisdom for the upright; [He is] a shield to them that walk in integrity;

title: Proverbs 2:8
text: That he may guard the paths of justice, And preserve the way of his saints.

title: Proverbs 2:9
text: Then shalt thou understand righteousness and justice, And equity, [yea], every good path.

title: Proverbs 2:10
text: For wisdom shall enter into thy heart, And knowledge shall be pleasant unto thy soul;

title: Proverbs 2:11
text: Discretion shall watch over thee; Understanding shall keep thee:

title: Proverbs 2:12
text: To deliver thee from the way of evil, From the men that speak perverse things;

title: Proverbs 2:13
text: Who forsake the paths of uprightness, To walk in the ways of darkness;

title: Proverbs 2:14
text: Who rejoice to do evil, And delight in the perverseness of evil;

title: Proverbs 2:15
text: Who are crooked in their ways, And wayward in their paths:

title: Proverbs 2:16
text: To deliver thee from the strange woman, Even from the foreigner that flattereth with her words;

title: Proverbs 2:17
text: That forsaketh the friend of her youth, And forgetteth the covenant of her God:

title: Proverbs 2:18
text: For her house inclineth unto death, And her paths unto the dead;

title: Proverbs 2:19
text: None that go unto her return again, Neither do they attain unto the paths of life:

title: Proverbs 2:20
text: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, And keep the paths of the righteous.

title: Proverbs 2:21
text: For the upright shall dwell in the land, And the perfect shall remain in it.

title: Proverbs 2:22
text: But the wicked shall be cut off from the land, And the treacherous shall be rooted out of it.

title: Proverbs 3:1
text: My son, forget not my law; But let thy heart keep my commandments:

title: Proverbs 3:2
text: For length of days, and years of life, And peace, will they add to thee.

title: Proverbs 3:3
text: Let not kindness and truth forsake thee: Bind them about thy neck; Write them upon the tablet of thy heart:

title: Proverbs 3:4
text: So shalt thou find favor and good understanding In the sight of God and man.

title: Proverbs 3:5
text: Trust in Jehovah with all thy heart, And lean not upon thine own understanding:

title: Proverbs 3:6
text: In all thy ways acknowledge him, And he will direct thy paths.

title: Proverbs 3:7
text: Be not wise in thine own eyes; Fear Jehovah, and depart from evil:

title: Proverbs 3:8
text: It will be health to thy navel, And marrow to thy bones.

title: Proverbs 3:9
text: Honor Jehovah with thy substance, And with the first-fruits of all thine increase:

title: Proverbs 3:10
text: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, And thy vats shall overflow with new wine.

title: Proverbs 3:11
text: My son, despise not the chastening of Jehovah; Neither be weary of his reproof:

title: Proverbs 3:12
text: For whom Jehovah loveth he reproveth; Even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.

title: Proverbs 3:13
text: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, And the man that getteth understanding.

title: Proverbs 3:14
text: For the gaining of it is better than the gaining of silver, And the profit thereof than fine gold.

title: Proverbs 3:15
text: She is more precious than rubies: And none of the things thou canst desire are to be compared unto her.

title: Proverbs 3:16
text: Length of days is in her right hand; In her left hand are riches and honor.

title: Proverbs 3:17
text: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, And all her paths are peace.

title: Proverbs 3:18
text: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: And happy is every one that retaineth her.

title: Proverbs 3:19
text: Jehovah by wisdom founded the earth; By understanding he established the heavens.

title: Proverbs 3:20
text: By his knowledge the depths were broken up, And the skies drop down the dew.

title: Proverbs 3:21
text: My son, let them not depart from thine eyes; Keep sound wisdom and discretion:

title: Proverbs 3:22
text: So shall they be life unto thy soul, And grace to thy neck.

title: Proverbs 3:23
text: Then shalt thou walk in thy way securely, And thy foot shall not stumble.

title: Proverbs 3:24
text: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: Yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

title: Proverbs 3:25
text: Be not afraid of sudden fear, Neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh:

title: Proverbs 3:26
text: For Jehovah will be thy confidence, And will keep thy foot from being taken.

title: Proverbs 3:27
text: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, When it is in the power of thy hand to do it.

title: Proverbs 3:28
text: Say not unto thy neighbor, Go, and come again, And to-morrow I will give; When thou hast it by thee.

title: Proverbs 3:29
text: Devise not evil against thy neighbor, Seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.

title: Proverbs 3:30
text: Strive not with a man without cause, If he have done thee no harm.

title: Proverbs 3:31
text: Envy thou not the man of violence, And choose none of his ways.

title: Proverbs 3:32
text: For the perverse is an abomination to Jehovah; But his friendship is with the upright.

title: Proverbs 3:33
text: The curse of Jehovah is in the house of the wicked; But he blesseth the habitation of the righteous.

title: Proverbs 3:34
text: Surely he scoffeth at the scoffers; But he giveth grace unto the lowly.

title: Proverbs 3:35
text: The wise shall inherit glory; But shame shall be the promotion of fools.

title: Proverbs 4:1
text: Hear, [my] sons, the instruction of a father, And attend to know understanding:

title: Proverbs 4:2
text: For I give you good doctrine; Forsake ye not my law.

title: Proverbs 4:3
text: For I was a son unto my father, Tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.

title: Proverbs 4:4
text: And he taught me, and said unto me: Let thy heart retain my words; Keep my commandments, and live;

title: Proverbs 4:5
text: Get wisdom, get understanding; Forget not, neither decline from the words of my mouth;

title: Proverbs 4:6
text: Forsake her not, and she will preserve thee; Love her, and she will keep thee.

title: Proverbs 4:7
text: Wisdom [is] the principal thing; [Therefore] get wisdom; Yea, with all thy getting get understanding.

title: Proverbs 4:8
text: Exalt her, and she will promote thee; She will bring thee to honor, when thou dost embrace her.

title: Proverbs 4:9
text: She will give to thy head a chaplet of grace; A crown of beauty will she deliver to thee.

title: Proverbs 4:10
text: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; And the years of thy life shall be many.

title: Proverbs 4:11
text: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in paths of uprightness.

title: Proverbs 4:12
text: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; And if thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.

title: Proverbs 4:13
text: Take fast hold of instruction; Let her not go: Keep her; For she is thy life.

title: Proverbs 4:14
text: Enter not into the path of the wicked, And walk not in the way of evil men.

title: Proverbs 4:15
text: Avoid it, pass not by it; Turn from it, and pass on.

title: Proverbs 4:16
text: For they sleep not, except they do evil; And their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.

title: Proverbs 4:17
text: For they eat the bread of wickedness, And drink the wine of violence.

title: Proverbs 4:18
text: But the path of the righteous is as the dawning light, That shineth more and more unto the perfect day.

title: Proverbs 4:19
text: The way of the wicked is as darkness: They know not at what they stumble.

title: Proverbs 4:20
text: My son, attend to my words; Incline thine ear unto my sayings.

title: Proverbs 4:21
text: Let them not depart from thine eyes; Keep them in the midst of thy heart.

title: Proverbs 4:22
text: For they are life unto those that find them, And health to all their flesh.

title: Proverbs 4:23
text: Keep thy heart with all diligence; For out of it are the issues of life.

title: Proverbs 4:24
text: Put away from thee a wayward mouth, And perverse lips put far from thee.

title: Proverbs 4:25
text: Let thine eyes look right on, And let thine eyelids look straight before thee.

title: Proverbs 4:26
text: Make level the path of thy feet, And let all thy ways be established.

title: Proverbs 4:27
text: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: Remove thy foot from evil.

title: Proverbs 5:1
text: My son, attend unto my wisdom; Incline thine ear to my understanding:

title: Proverbs 5:2
text: That thou mayest preserve discretion, And that thy lips may keep knowledge.

title: Proverbs 5:3
text: For the lips of a strange woman drop honey, And her mouth is smoother than oil:

title: Proverbs 5:4
text: But in the end she is bitter as wormwood, Sharp as a two-edged sword.

title: Proverbs 5:5
text: Her feet go down to death; Her steps take hold on Sheol;

title: Proverbs 5:6
text: So that she findeth not the level path of life: Her ways are unstable, [and] she knoweth [it] not.

title: Proverbs 5:7
text: Now therefore, [my] sons, hearken unto me, And depart not from the words of my mouth.

title: Proverbs 5:8
text: Remove thy way far from her, And come not nigh the door of her house;

title: Proverbs 5:9
text: Lest thou give thine honor unto others, And thy years unto the cruel;

title: Proverbs 5:10
text: Lest strangers be filled with thy strength, And thy labors [be] in the house of an alien,

title: Proverbs 5:11
text: And thou mourn at thy latter end, When thy flesh and thy body are consumed,

title: Proverbs 5:12
text: And say, How have I hated instruction, And my heart despised reproof;

title: Proverbs 5:13
text: Neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers, Nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!

title: Proverbs 5:14
text: I was well-nigh in all evil In the midst of the assembly and congregation.

title: Proverbs 5:15
text: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, And running waters out of thine own well.

title: Proverbs 5:16
text: Should thy springs be dispersed abroad, And streams of water in the streets?

title: Proverbs 5:17
text: Let them be for thyself alone, And not for strangers with thee.

title: Proverbs 5:18
text: Let thy fountain be blessed; And rejoice in the wife of thy youth.

title: Proverbs 5:19
text: [ As] a loving hind and a pleasant doe, Let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; And be thou ravished always with her love.

title: Proverbs 5:20
text: For why shouldest thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, And embrace the bosom of a foreigner?

title: Proverbs 5:21
text: For the ways of man are before the eyes of Jehovah; And he maketh level all his paths.

title: Proverbs 5:22
text: His own iniquities shall take the wicked, And he shall be holden with the cords of his sin.

title: Proverbs 5:23
text: He shall die for lack of instruction; And in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.

title: Proverbs 6:1
text: My son, if thou art become surety for thy neighbor, If thou hast stricken thy hands for a stranger;

title: Proverbs 6:2
text: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, Thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.

title: Proverbs 6:3
text: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, Seeing thou art come into the hand of thy neighbor: Go, humble thyself, and importune thy neighbor;

title: Proverbs 6:4
text: Give not sleep to thine eyes, Nor slumber to thine eyelids;

title: Proverbs 6:5
text: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand [of the hunter], And as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

title: Proverbs 6:6
text: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; Consider her ways, and be wise:

title: Proverbs 6:7
text: Which having no chief, Overseer, or ruler,

title: Proverbs 6:8
text: Provideth her bread in the summer, And gathereth her food in the harvest.

title: Proverbs 6:9
text: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? When wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?

title: Proverbs 6:10
text: [ Yet] a little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to sleep:

title: Proverbs 6:11
text: So shall thy poverty come as a robber, And thy want as an armed man.

title: Proverbs 6:12
text: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, Is he that walketh with a perverse mouth;

title: Proverbs 6:13
text: That winketh with his eyes, that speaketh with his feet, That maketh signs with his fingers;

title: Proverbs 6:14
text: In whose heart is perverseness, Who deviseth evil continually, Who soweth discord.

title: Proverbs 6:15
text: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; On a sudden shall he be broken, and that without remedy.

title: Proverbs 6:16
text: There are six things which Jehovah hateth; Yea, seven which are an abomination unto him:

title: Proverbs 6:17
text: Haughty eyes, a lying tongue, And hands that shed innocent blood;

title: Proverbs 6:18
text: A heart that deviseth wicked purposes, Feet that are swift in running to mischief,

title: Proverbs 6:19
text: A false witness that uttereth lies, And he that soweth discord among brethren.

title: Proverbs 6:20
text: My son, keep the commandment of thy father, And forsake not the law of thy mother:

title: Proverbs 6:21
text: Bind them continually upon thy heart; Tie them about thy neck.

title: Proverbs 6:22
text: When thou walkest, it shall lead thee; When thou sleepest, it shall watch over thee; And when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.

title: Proverbs 6:23
text: For the commandment is a lamp; And the law is light; And reproofs of instruction are the way of life:

title: Proverbs 6:24
text: To keep thee from the evil woman, From the flattery of the foreigner's tongue.

title: Proverbs 6:25
text: Lust not after her beauty in thy heart; Neither let her take thee with her eyelids.

title: Proverbs 6:26
text: For on account of a harlot [a man is brought] to a piece of bread; And the adulteress hunteth for the precious life.

title: Proverbs 6:27
text: Can a man take fire in his bosom, And his clothes not be burned?

title: Proverbs 6:28
text: Or can one walk upon hot coals, And his feet not be scorched?

title: Proverbs 6:29
text: So he that goeth in to his neighbor's wife; Whosoever toucheth her shall not be unpunished.

title: Proverbs 6:30
text: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal To satisfy himself when he is hungry:

title: Proverbs 6:31
text: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; He shall give all the substance of his house.

title: Proverbs 6:32
text: He that committeth adultery with a woman is void of understanding: He doeth it who would destroy his own soul.

title: Proverbs 6:33
text: Wounds and dishonor shall he get; And his reproach shall not be wiped away.

title: Proverbs 6:34
text: For jealousy is the rage of a man; And he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

title: Proverbs 6:35
text: He will not regard any ransom; Neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.

title: Proverbs 7:1
text: My son, keep my words, And lay up my commandments with thee.

title: Proverbs 7:2
text: Keep my commandments and live; And my law as the apple of thine eye.

title: Proverbs 7:3
text: Bind them upon thy fingers; Write them upon the tablet of thy heart.

title: Proverbs 7:4
text: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; And call understanding [thy] kinswoman:

title: Proverbs 7:5
text: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, From the foreigner that flattereth with her words.

title: Proverbs 7:6
text: For at the window of my house I looked forth through my lattice;

title: Proverbs 7:7
text: And I beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, A young man void of understanding,

title: Proverbs 7:8
text: Passing through the street near her corner; And he went the way to her house,

title: Proverbs 7:9
text: In the twilight, in the evening of the day, In the middle of the night and in the darkness.

title: Proverbs 7:10
text: And, behold, there met him a woman With the attire of a harlot, and wily of heart.

title: Proverbs 7:11
text: (She is clamorous and wilful; Her feet abide not in her house:

title: Proverbs 7:12
text: Now she is in the streets, now in the broad places, And lieth in wait at every corner.)

title: Proverbs 7:13
text: So she caught him, and kissed him, [And] with an impudent face she said unto him:

title: Proverbs 7:14
text: Sacrifices of peace-offerings are with me; This day have I paid my vows.

title: Proverbs 7:15
text: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, Diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.

title: Proverbs 7:16
text: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, With striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

title: Proverbs 7:17
text: I have perfumed my bed With myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

title: Proverbs 7:18
text: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning; Let us solace ourselves with loves.

title: Proverbs 7:19
text: For the man is not at home; He is gone a long journey:

title: Proverbs 7:20
text: He hath taken a bag of money with him; He will come home at the full moon.

title: Proverbs 7:21
text: With her much fair speech she causeth him to yield; With the flattering of her lips she forceth him along.

title: Proverbs 7:22
text: He goeth after her straightway, As an ox goeth to the slaughter, Or as [one in] fetters to the correction of the fool;

title: Proverbs 7:23
text: Till an arrow strike through his liver; As a bird hasteth to the snare, And knoweth not that it is for his life.

title: Proverbs 7:24
text: Now therefore, [my] sons, hearken unto me, And attend to the words of my mouth.

title: Proverbs 7:25
text: Let not thy heart decline to her ways; Go not astray in her paths.

title: Proverbs 7:26
text: For she hath cast down many wounded: Yea, all her slain are a mighty host.

title: Proverbs 7:27
text: Her house is the way to Sheol, Going down to the chambers of death.

title: Proverbs 8:1
text: Doth not wisdom cry, And understanding put forth her voice?

title: Proverbs 8:2
text: On the top of high places by the way, Where the paths meet, she standeth;

title: Proverbs 8:3
text: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, At the coming in at the doors, she crieth aloud:

title: Proverbs 8:4
text: Unto you, O men, I call; And my voice is to the sons of men.

title: Proverbs 8:5
text: O ye simple, understand prudence; And, ye fools, be of an understanding heart.

title: Proverbs 8:6
text: Hear, for I will speak excellent things; And the opening of my lips shall be right things.

title: Proverbs 8:7
text: For my mouth shall utter truth; And wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

title: Proverbs 8:8
text: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

title: Proverbs 8:9
text: They are all plain to him that understandeth, And right to them that find knowledge.

title: Proverbs 8:10
text: Receive my instruction, and not silver; And knowledge rather than choice gold.

title: Proverbs 8:11
text: For wisdom is better than rubies; And all the things that may be desired are not to be compared unto it.

title: Proverbs 8:12
text: I wisdom have made prudence my dwelling, And find out knowledge [and] discretion.

title: Proverbs 8:13
text: The fear of Jehovah is to hate evil: Pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, And the perverse mouth, do I hate.

title: Proverbs 8:14
text: Counsel is mine, and sound knowledge: I am understanding; I have might.

title: Proverbs 8:15
text: By me kings reign, And princes decree justice.

title: Proverbs 8:16
text: By me princes rule, And nobles, [even] all the judges of the earth.

title: Proverbs 8:17
text: I love them that love me; And those that seek me diligently shall find me.

title: Proverbs 8:18
text: Riches and honor are with me; [Yea], durable wealth and righteousness.

title: Proverbs 8:19
text: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; And my revenue than choice silver.

title: Proverbs 8:20
text: I walk in the way of righteousness, In the midst of the paths of justice;

title: Proverbs 8:21
text: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance, And that I may fill their treasuries.

title: Proverbs 8:22
text: Jehovah possessed me in the beginning of his way, Before his works of old.

title: Proverbs 8:23
text: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, Before the earth was.

title: Proverbs 8:24
text: When there were no depths, I was brought forth, When there were no fountains abounding with water.

title: Proverbs 8:25
text: Before the mountains were settled, Before the hills was I brought forth;

title: Proverbs 8:26
text: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, Nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

title: Proverbs 8:27
text: When he established the heavens, I was there: When he set a circle upon the face of the deep,

title: Proverbs 8:28
text: When he made firm the skies above, When the fountains of the deep became strong,

title: Proverbs 8:29
text: When he gave to the sea its bound, That the waters should not transgress his commandment, When he marked out the foundations of the earth;

title: Proverbs 8:30
text: Then I was by him, [as] a master workman; And I was daily [his] delight, Rejoicing always before him,

title: Proverbs 8:31
text: Rejoicing in his habitable earth; And my delight was with the sons of men.

title: Proverbs 8:32
text: Now therefore, [my] sons, hearken unto me; For blessed are they that keep my ways.

title: Proverbs 8:33
text: Hear instruction, and be wise, And refuse it not.

title: Proverbs 8:34
text: Blessed is the man that heareth me, Watching daily at my gates, Waiting at the posts of my doors.

title: Proverbs 8:35
text: For whoso findeth me findeth life, And shall obtain favor of Jehovah.

title: Proverbs 8:36
text: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: All they that hate me love death.

title: Proverbs 9:1
text: Wisdom hath builded her house; She hath hewn out her seven pillars:

title: Proverbs 9:2
text: She hath killed her beasts; She hath mingled her wine; She hath also furnished her table:

title: Proverbs 9:3
text: She hath sent forth her maidens; She crieth upon the highest places of the city:

title: Proverbs 9:4
text: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: As for him that is void of understanding, she saith to him,

title: Proverbs 9:5
text: Come, eat ye of my bread, And drink of the wine which I have mingled.

title: Proverbs 9:6
text: Leave off, ye simple ones, and live; And walk in the way of understanding.

title: Proverbs 9:7
text: He that correcteth a scoffer getteth to himself reviling; And he that reproveth a wicked man [getteth] himself a blot.

title: Proverbs 9:8
text: Reprove not a scoffer, lest he hate thee: Reprove a wise man, and he will love thee.

title: Proverbs 9:9
text: Give [instruction] to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: Teach a righteous man, and he will increase in learning.

title: Proverbs 9:10
text: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom; And the knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

title: Proverbs 9:11
text: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, And the years of thy life shall be increased.

title: Proverbs 9:12
text: If thou art wise, thou art wise for thyself; And if thou scoffest, thou alone shalt bear it.

title: Proverbs 9:13
text: The foolish woman is clamorous; [She is] simple, and knoweth nothing.

title: Proverbs 9:14
text: And she sitteth at the door of her house, On a seat in the high places of the city,

title: Proverbs 9:15
text: To call to them that pass by, Who go right on their ways:

title: Proverbs 9:16
text: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither; And as for him that is void of understanding, she saith to him,

title: Proverbs 9:17
text: Stolen waters are sweet, And bread [eaten] in secret is pleasant.

title: Proverbs 9:18
text: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; That her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

title: Proverbs 10:1
text: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father; But a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.

title: Proverbs 10:2
text: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing; But righteousness delivereth from death.

title: Proverbs 10:3
text: Jehovah will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish; But he thrusteth away the desire of the wicked.

title: Proverbs 10:4
text: He becometh poor that worketh with a slack hand; But the hand of the diligent maketh rich.

title: Proverbs 10:5
text: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son; [But] he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.

title: Proverbs 10:6
text: Blessings are upon the head of the righteous; But violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

title: Proverbs 10:7
text: The memory of the righteous is blessed; But the name of the wicked shall rot.

title: Proverbs 10:8
text: The wise in heart will receive commandments; But a prating fool shall fall.

title: Proverbs 10:9
text: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely; But he that perverteth his ways shall be known.

title: Proverbs 10:10
text: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow; But a prating fool shall fall.

title: Proverbs 10:11
text: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life; But violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

title: Proverbs 10:12
text: Hatred stirreth up strifes; But love covereth all transgressions.

title: Proverbs 10:13
text: In the lips of him that hath discernment wisdom is found; But a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.

title: Proverbs 10:14
text: Wise men lay up knowledge; But the mouth of the foolish is a present destruction.

title: Proverbs 10:15
text: The rich man's wealth is his strong city: The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

title: Proverbs 10:16
text: The labor of the righteous [tendeth] to life; The increase of the wicked, to sin.

title: Proverbs 10:17
text: He is in the way of life that heedeth correction; But he that forsaketh reproof erreth.

title: Proverbs 10:18
text: He that hideth hatred is of lying lips; And he that uttereth a slander is a fool.

title: Proverbs 10:19
text: In the multitude of words there wanteth not transgression; But he that refraineth his lips doeth wisely.

title: Proverbs 10:20
text: The tongue of the righteous is [as] choice silver: The heart of the wicked is little worth.

title: Proverbs 10:21
text: The lips of the righteous feed many; But the foolish die for lack of understanding.

title: Proverbs 10:22
text: The blessing of Jehovah, it maketh rich; And he addeth no sorrow therewith.

title: Proverbs 10:23
text: It is as sport to a fool to do wickedness; And [so is] wisdom to a man of understanding.

title: Proverbs 10:24
text: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him; And the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

title: Proverbs 10:25
text: When the whirlwind passeth, the wicked is no more; But the righteous is an everlasting foundation.

title: Proverbs 10:26
text: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, So is the sluggard to them that send him.

title: Proverbs 10:27
text: The fear of Jehovah prolongeth days; But the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

title: Proverbs 10:28
text: The hope of the righteous [shall be] gladness; But the expectation of the wicked shall perish.

title: Proverbs 10:29
text: The way of Jehovah is a stronghold to the upright; But it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

title: Proverbs 10:30
text: The righteous shall never be removed; But the wicked shall not dwell in the land.

title: Proverbs 10:31
text: The mouth of the righteous bringeth forth wisdom; But the perverse tongue shall be cut off.

title: Proverbs 10:32
text: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable; But the mouth of the wicked [speaketh] perverseness.

title: Proverbs 11:1
text: A false balance is an abomination to Jehovah; But a just weight is his delight.

title: Proverbs 11:2
text: When pride cometh, then cometh shame; But with the lowly is wisdom.

title: Proverbs 11:3
text: The integrity of the upright shall guide them; But the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

title: Proverbs 11:4
text: Riches profit not in the day of wrath; But righteousness delivereth from death.

title: Proverbs 11:5
text: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way; But the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

title: Proverbs 11:6
text: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them; But the treacherous shall be taken in their own iniquity.

title: Proverbs 11:7
text: When a wicked man dieth, [his] expectation shall perish; And the hope of iniquity perisheth.

title: Proverbs 11:8
text: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, And the wicked cometh in his stead.

title: Proverbs 11:9
text: With his mouth the godless man destroyeth his neighbor; But through knowledge shall the righteous be delivered.

title: Proverbs 11:10
text: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth; And when the wicked perish, there is shouting.

title: Proverbs 11:11
text: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted; But it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

title: Proverbs 11:12
text: He that despiseth his neighbor is void of wisdom; But a man of understanding holdeth his peace.

title: Proverbs 11:13
text: He that goeth about as a tale-bearer revealeth secrets; But he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth a matter.

title: Proverbs 11:14
text: Where no wise guidance is, the people falleth; But in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.

title: Proverbs 11:15
text: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it; But he that hateth suretyship is secure.

title: Proverbs 11:16
text: A gracious woman obtaineth honor; And violent men obtain riches.

title: Proverbs 11:17
text: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul; But he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.

title: Proverbs 11:18
text: The wicked earneth deceitful wages; But he that soweth righteousness [hath] a sure reward.

title: Proverbs 11:19
text: He that is stedfast in righteousness [shall attain] unto life; And he that pursueth evil [doeth it] to his own death.

title: Proverbs 11:20
text: They that are perverse in heart are an abomination to Jehovah; But such as are perfect in [their] way are his delight.

title: Proverbs 11:21
text: [Though] hand [join] in hand, the evil man shall not be unpunished; But the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

title: Proverbs 11:22
text: [ As] a ring of gold in a swine's snout, [So is] a fair woman that is without discretion.

title: Proverbs 11:23
text: The desire of the righteous is only good; [But] the expectation of the wicked is wrath.

title: Proverbs 11:24
text: There is that scattereth, and increaseth yet more; And there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but [it tendeth] only to want.

title: Proverbs 11:25
text: The liberal soul shall be made fat; And he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

title: Proverbs 11:26
text: He that withholdeth grain, the people shall curse him; But blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.

title: Proverbs 11:27
text: He that diligently seeketh good seeketh favor; But he that searcheth after evil, it shall come unto him.

title: Proverbs 11:28
text: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; But the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.

title: Proverbs 11:29
text: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind; And the foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

title: Proverbs 11:30
text: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; And he that is wise winneth souls.

title: Proverbs 11:31
text: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: How much more the wicked and the sinner!

title: Proverbs 12:1
text: Whoso loveth correction loveth knowledge; But he that hateth reproof is brutish.

title: Proverbs 12:2
text: A good man shall obtain favor of Jehovah; But a man of wicked devices will he condemn.

title: Proverbs 12:3
text: A man shall not be established by wickedness; But the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

title: Proverbs 12:4
text: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband; But she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.

title: Proverbs 12:5
text: The thoughts of the righteous are just; [But] the counsels of the wicked are deceit.

title: Proverbs 12:6
text: The words of the wicked are of lying in wait for blood; But the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

title: Proverbs 12:7
text: The wicked are overthrown, and are not; But the house of the righteous shall stand.

title: Proverbs 12:8
text: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom; But he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.

title: Proverbs 12:9
text: Better is he that is lightly esteemed, and hath a servant, Than he that honoreth himself, and lacketh bread.

title: Proverbs 12:10
text: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast; But the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

title: Proverbs 12:11
text: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread; But he that followeth after vain [persons] is void of understanding.

title: Proverbs 12:12
text: The wicked desireth the net of evil men; But the root of the righteous yieldeth [fruit] .

title: Proverbs 12:13
text: In the transgression of the lips is a snare to the evil man; But the righteous shall come out of trouble.

title: Proverbs 12:14
text: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth; And the doings of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.

title: Proverbs 12:15
text: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes; But he that is wise hearkeneth unto counsel.

title: Proverbs 12:16
text: A fool's vexation is presently known; But a prudent man concealeth shame.

title: Proverbs 12:17
text: He that uttereth truth showeth forth righteousness; But a false witness, deceit.

title: Proverbs 12:18
text: There is that speaketh rashly like the piercings of a sword; But the tongue of the wise is health.

title: Proverbs 12:19
text: The lip of truth shall be established for ever; But a lying tongue is but for a moment.

title: Proverbs 12:20
text: Deceit is in the heart of them that devise evil; But to the counsellors of peace is joy.

title: Proverbs 12:21
text: There shall no mischief happen to the righteous; But the wicked shall be filled with evil.

title: Proverbs 12:22
text: Lying lips are an abomination to Jehovah; But they that deal truly are his delight.

title: Proverbs 12:23
text: A prudent man concealeth knowledge; But the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.

title: Proverbs 12:24
text: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule; But the slothful shall be put under taskwork.

title: Proverbs 12:25
text: Heaviness in the heart of a man maketh it stoop; But a good word maketh it glad.

title: Proverbs 12:26
text: The righteous is a guide to his neighbor; But the way of the wicked causeth them to err.

title: Proverbs 12:27
text: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting; But the precious substance of men [is to] the diligent.

title: Proverbs 12:28
text: In the way of righteousness is life; And in the pathway thereof there is no death.

title: Proverbs 13:1
text: A wise son [heareth] his father's instruction; But a scoffer heareth not rebuke.

title: Proverbs 13:2
text: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth; But the soul of the treacherous [shall eat] violence.

title: Proverbs 13:3
text: He that guardeth his mouth keepeth his life; [But] he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.

title: Proverbs 13:4
text: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing; But the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.

title: Proverbs 13:5
text: A righteous man hateth lying; But a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.

title: Proverbs 13:6
text: Righteousness guardeth him that is upright in the way; But wickedness overthroweth the sinner.

title: Proverbs 13:7
text: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: There is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great wealth.

title: Proverbs 13:8
text: The ransom of a man's life is his riches; But the poor heareth no threatening.

title: Proverbs 13:9
text: The light of the righteous rejoiceth; But the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

title: Proverbs 13:10
text: By pride cometh only contention; But with the well-advised is wisdom.

title: Proverbs 13:11
text: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished; But he that gathereth by labor shall have increase.

title: Proverbs 13:12
text: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick; But when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.

title: Proverbs 13:13
text: Whoso despiseth the word bringeth destruction on himself; But he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.

title: Proverbs 13:14
text: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, That one may depart from the snares of death.

title: Proverbs 13:15
text: Good understanding giveth favor; But the way of the transgressor is hard.

title: Proverbs 13:16
text: Every prudent man worketh with knowledge; But a fool flaunteth [his] folly.

title: Proverbs 13:17
text: A wicked messenger falleth into evil; But a faithful ambassador is health.

title: Proverbs 13:18
text: Poverty and shame [shall be to] him that refuseth correction; But he that regardeth reproof shall be honored.

title: Proverbs 13:19
text: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul; But it is an abomination to fools to depart from evil.

title: Proverbs 13:20
text: Walk with wise men, and thou shalt be wise; But the companion of fools shall smart for it.

title: Proverbs 13:21
text: Evil pursueth sinners; But the righteous shall be recompensed with good.

title: Proverbs 13:22
text: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children's children; And the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the righteous.

title: Proverbs 13:23
text: Much food [is in] the tillage of the poor; But there is that is destroyed by reason of injustice.

title: Proverbs 13:24
text: He that spareth his rod hateth his son; But he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.

title: Proverbs 13:25
text: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul; But the belly of the wicked shall want.

title: Proverbs 14:1
text: Every wise woman buildeth her house; But the foolish plucketh it down with her own hands.

title: Proverbs 14:2
text: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth Jehovah; But he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.

title: Proverbs 14:3
text: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod for [his] pride; But the lips of the wise shall preserve them.

title: Proverbs 14:4
text: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean; But much increase is by the strength of the ox.

title: Proverbs 14:5
text: A faithful witness will not lie; But a false witness uttereth lies.

title: Proverbs 14:6
text: A scoffer seeketh wisdom, and [findeth it] not; But knowledge is easy unto him that hath understanding.

title: Proverbs 14:7
text: Go into the presence of a foolish man, And thou shalt not perceive [in him] the lips of knowledge.

title: Proverbs 14:8
text: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way; But the folly of fools is deceit.

title: Proverbs 14:9
text: A trespass-offering mocketh fools; But among the upright there is good will.

title: Proverbs 14:10
text: The heart knoweth its own bitterness; And a stranger doth not intermeddle with its joy.

title: Proverbs 14:11
text: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown; But the tent of the upright shall flourish.

title: Proverbs 14:12
text: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man; But the end thereof are the ways of death.

title: Proverbs 14:13
text: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; And the end of mirth is heaviness.

title: Proverbs 14:14
text: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways; And a good man [shall be satisfied] from himself.

title: Proverbs 14:15
text: The simple believeth every word; But the prudent man looketh well to his going.

title: Proverbs 14:16
text: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil; But the fool beareth himself insolently, and is confident.

title: Proverbs 14:17
text: He that is soon angry will deal foolishly; And a man of wicked devices is hated.

title: Proverbs 14:18
text: The simple inherit folly; But the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

title: Proverbs 14:19
text: The evil bow down before the good; And the wicked, at the gates of the righteous.

title: Proverbs 14:20
text: The poor is hated even of his own neighbor; But the rich hath many friends.

title: Proverbs 14:21
text: He that despiseth his neighbor sinneth; But he that hath pity on the poor, happy is he.

title: Proverbs 14:22
text: Do they not err that devise evil? But mercy and truth [shall be to] them that devise good.

title: Proverbs 14:23
text: In all labor there is profit; But the talk of the lips [tendeth] only to penury.

title: Proverbs 14:24
text: The crown of the wise is their riches; [But] the folly of fools is [only] folly.

title: Proverbs 14:25
text: A true witness delivereth souls; But he that uttereth lies [causeth] deceit.

title: Proverbs 14:26
text: In the fear of Jehovah is strong confidence; And his children shall have a place of refuge.

title: Proverbs 14:27
text: The fear of Jehovah is a fountain of life, That one may depart from the snares of death.

title: Proverbs 14:28
text: In the multitude of people is the king's glory; But in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.

title: Proverbs 14:29
text: He that is slow to anger is of great understanding; But he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.

title: Proverbs 14:30
text: A tranquil heart is the life of the flesh; But envy is the rottenness of the bones.

title: Proverbs 14:31
text: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker; But he that hath mercy on the needy honoreth him.

title: Proverbs 14:32
text: The wicked is thrust down in his evil-doing; But the righteous hath a refuge in his death.

title: Proverbs 14:33
text: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding; But [that which is] in the inward part of fools is made known.

title: Proverbs 14:34
text: Righteousness exalteth a nation; But sin is a reproach to any people.

title: Proverbs 14:35
text: The king's favor is toward a servant that dealeth wisely; But his wrath will be [against] him that causeth shame.

title: Proverbs 15:1
text: A soft answer turneth away wrath; But a grievous word stirreth up anger.

title: Proverbs 15:2
text: The tongue of the wise uttereth knowledge aright; But the mouth of fools poureth out folly.

title: Proverbs 15:3
text: The eyes of Jehovah are in every place, Keeping watch upon the evil and the good.

title: Proverbs 15:4
text: A gentle tongue is a tree of life; But perverseness therein is a breaking of the spirit.

title: Proverbs 15:5
text: A fool despiseth his father's correction; But he that regardeth reproof getteth prudence.

title: Proverbs 15:6
text: In the house of the righteous is much treasure; But in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.

title: Proverbs 15:7
text: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge; But the heart of the foolish [doeth] not so.

title: Proverbs 15:8
text: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to Jehovah; But the prayer of the upright is his delight.

title: Proverbs 15:9
text: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Jehovah; But he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.

title: Proverbs 15:10
text: There is grievous correction for him that forsaketh the way; [And] he that hateth reproof shall die.

title: Proverbs 15:11
text: Sheol and Abaddon are before Jehovah: How much more then the hearts of the children of men!

title: Proverbs 15:12
text: A scoffer loveth not to be reproved; He will not go unto the wise.

title: Proverbs 15:13
text: A glad heart maketh a cheerful countenance; But by sorrow of heart the spirit is broken.

title: Proverbs 15:14
text: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge; But the mouth of fools feedeth on folly.

title: Proverbs 15:15
text: All the days of the afflicted are evil; But he that is of a cheerful heart [hath] a continual feast.

title: Proverbs 15:16
text: Better is little, with the fear of Jehovah, Than great treasure and trouble therewith.

title: Proverbs 15:17
text: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, Than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.

title: Proverbs 15:18
text: A wrathful man stirreth up contention; But he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.

title: Proverbs 15:19
text: The way of the sluggard is as a hedge of thorns; But the path of the upright is made a highway.

title: Proverbs 15:20
