title: Isaiah 14:14
text: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will make myself like the Most High.

title: Isaiah 14:15
text: Yet thou shalt be brought down to Sheol, to the uttermost parts of the pit.

title: Isaiah 14:16
text: They that see thee shall gaze at thee, they shall consider thee, [saying], Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;

title: Isaiah 14:17
text: that made the world as a wilderness, and overthrew the cities thereof; that let not loose his prisoners to their home?

title: Isaiah 14:18
text: All the kings of the nations, all of them, sleep in glory, every one in his own house.

title: Isaiah 14:19
text: But thou art cast forth away from thy sepulchre like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain, that are thrust through with the sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a dead body trodden under foot.

title: Isaiah 14:20
text: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, thou hast slain thy people; the seed of evil-doers shall not be named for ever.

title: Isaiah 14:21
text: Prepare ye slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers, that they rise not up, and possess the earth, and fill the face of the world with cities.

title: Isaiah 14:22
text: And I will rise up against them, saith Jehovah of hosts, and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son's son, saith Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 14:23
text: I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Isaiah 14:24
text: Jehovah of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely, as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:

title: Isaiah 14:25
text: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulder.

title: Isaiah 14:26
text: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth; and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.

title: Isaiah 14:27
text: For Jehovah of hosts hath purposed, and who shall annul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?

title: Isaiah 14:28
text: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.

title: Isaiah 14:29
text: Rejoice not, O Philistia, all of thee, because the rod that smote thee is broken; for out of the serpent's root shall come forth an adder, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.

title: Isaiah 14:30
text: And the first-born of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety; and I will kill thy root with famine, and thy remnant shall be slain.

title: Isaiah 14:31
text: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou art melted away, O Philistia, all of thee; for there cometh a smoke out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.

title: Isaiah 14:32
text: What then shall one answer the messengers of the nation? That Jehovah hath founded Zion, and in her shall the afflicted of his people take refuge.

title: Isaiah 15:1
text: The burden of Moab. For in a night Ar of Moab is laid waste, [and] brought to nought; for in a night Kir of Moab is laid waste, [and] brought to nought.

title: Isaiah 15:2
text: They are gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep: Moab waileth over Nebo, and over Medeba; on all their heads is baldness, every beard is cut off.

title: Isaiah 15:3
text: In their streets they gird themselves with sackcloth; on their housetops, and in their broad places, every one waileth, weeping abundantly.

title: Isaiah 15:4
text: And Heshbon crieth out, and Elealeh; their voice is heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud; his soul trembleth within him.

title: Isaiah 15:5
text: My heart crieth out for Moab; her nobles [flee] unto Zoar, to Eglath-shelishi-yah: for by the ascent of Luhith with weeping they go up; for in the way of Horonaim they raise up a cry of destruction.

title: Isaiah 15:6
text: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate; for the grass is withered away, the tender grass faileth, there is no green thing.

title: Isaiah 15:7
text: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away over the brook of the willows.

title: Isaiah 15:8
text: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the wailing thereof unto Eglaim, and the wailing thereof unto Beer-elim.

title: Isaiah 15:9
text: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more upon Dimon, a lion upon them of Moab that escape, and upon the remnant of the land.

title: Isaiah 16:1
text: Send ye the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.

title: Isaiah 16:2
text: For it shall be that, as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so shall the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.

title: Isaiah 16:3
text: Give counsel, execute justice; make thy shade as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; betray not the fugitive.

title: Isaiah 16:4
text: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee; as for Moab, be thou a covert to him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortioner is brought to nought, destruction ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.

title: Isaiah 16:5
text: And a throne shall be established in lovingkindness; and one shall sit thereon in truth, in the tent of David, judging, and seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.

title: Isaiah 16:6
text: We have heard of the pride of Moab, [that] he is very proud; even of his arrogancy, and his pride, and his wrath; his boastings are nought.

title: Isaiah 16:7
text: Therefore shall Moab wail for Moab, every one shall wail: for the raisin-cakes of Kir-hareseth shall ye mourn, utterly stricken.

title: Isaiah 16:8
text: For the fields of Heshbon languish, [and] the vine of Sibmah; the lords of the nations have broken down the choice branches thereof, which reached even unto Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness; its shoots were spread abroad, they passed over the sea.

title: Isaiah 16:9
text: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah; I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for upon thy summer fruits and upon thy harvest the [battle] shout is fallen.

title: Isaiah 16:10
text: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither joyful noise: no treader shall tread out wine in the presses; I have made the [vintage] shout to cease.

title: Isaiah 16:11
text: Wherefore my heart soundeth like a harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kir-heres.

title: Isaiah 16:12
text: And it shall come to pass, when Moab presenteth himself, when he wearieth himself upon the high place, and shall come to his sanctuary to pray, that he shall not prevail.

title: Isaiah 16:13
text: This is the word that Jehovah spake concerning Moab in time past.

title: Isaiah 16:14
text: But now Jehovah hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of a hireling, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and of no account.

title: Isaiah 17:1
text: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.

title: Isaiah 17:2
text: The cities of Aroer are forsaken; they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

title: Isaiah 17:3
text: And the fortress shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria; they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Isaiah 17:4
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.

title: Isaiah 17:5
text: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the standing grain, and his arm reapeth the ears; yea, it shall be as when one gleaneth ears in the valley of Rephaim.

title: Isaiah 17:6
text: Yet there shall be left therein gleanings, as the shaking of an olive-tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost branches of a fruitful tree, saith Jehovah, the God of Israel.

title: Isaiah 17:7
text: In that day shall men look unto their Maker, and their eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.

title: Isaiah 17:8
text: And they shall not look to the altars, the work of their hands; neither shall they have respect to that which their fingers have made, either the Asherim, or the sun-images.

title: Isaiah 17:9
text: In that day shall their strong cities be as the forsaken places in the wood and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel; and it shall be a desolation.

title: Isaiah 17:10
text: For thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength; therefore thou plantest pleasant plants, and settest it with strange slips.

title: Isaiah 17:11
text: In the day of thy planting thou hedgest it in, and in the morning thou makest thy seed to blossom; but the harvest fleeth away in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.

title: Isaiah 17:12
text: Ah, the uproar of many peoples, that roar like the roaring of the seas; and the rushing of nations, that rush like the rushing of mighty waters!

title: Isaiah 17:13
text: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but he shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like the whirling dust before the storm.

title: Isaiah 17:14
text: At eventide, behold, terror; [and] before the morning they are not. This is the portion of them that despoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.

title: Isaiah 18:1
text: Ah, the land of the rustling of wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia;

title: Isaiah 18:2
text: that sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of papyrus upon the waters, [saying], Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people terrible from their beginning onward, a nation that meteth out and treadeth down, whose land the rivers divide!

title: Isaiah 18:3
text: All ye inhabitants of the world, and ye dwellers on the earth, when an ensign is lifted up on the mountains, see ye; and when the trumpet is blown, hear ye.

title: Isaiah 18:4
text: For thus hath Jehovah said unto me, I will be still, and I will behold in my dwelling-place, like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.

title: Isaiah 18:5
text: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becometh a ripening grape, he will cut off the sprigs with pruning-hooks, and the spreading branches will he take away [and] cut down.

title: Isaiah 18:6
text: They shall be left together unto the ravenous birds of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth; and the ravenous birds shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.

title: Isaiah 18:7
text: In that time shall a present be brought unto Jehovah of hosts [from] a people tall and smooth, even from a people terrible from their beginning onward, a nation that meteth out and treadeth down, whose land the rivers divide, to the place of the name of Jehovah of hosts, the mount Zion.

title: Isaiah 19:1
text: The burden of Egypt. Behold, Jehovah rideth upon a swift cloud, and cometh unto Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall tremble at his presence; and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.

title: Isaiah 19:2
text: And I will stir up the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbor; city against city, [and] kingdom against kingdom.

title: Isaiah 19:3
text: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst of it; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek unto the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.

title: Isaiah 19:4
text: And I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.

title: Isaiah 19:5
text: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and become dry.

title: Isaiah 19:6
text: And the rivers shall become foul; the streams of Egypt shall be diminished and dried up; the reeds and flags shall wither away.

title: Isaiah 19:7
text: The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the sown fields of the Nile, shall become dry, be driven away, and be no more.

title: Isaiah 19:8
text: And the fishers shall lament, and all they that cast angle into the Nile shall mourn, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.

title: Isaiah 19:9
text: Moreover they that work in combed flax, and they that weave white cloth, shall be confounded.

title: Isaiah 19:10
text: And the pillars [of Egypt] shall be broken in pieces; all they that work for hire [shall be] grieved in soul.

title: Isaiah 19:11
text: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish; the counsel of the wisest counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?

title: Isaiah 19:12
text: Where then are thy wise men? and let them tell thee now; and let them know what Jehovah of hosts hath purposed concerning Egypt.

title: Isaiah 19:13
text: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Memphis are deceived; they have caused Egypt to go astray, that are the corner-stone of her tribes.

title: Isaiah 19:14
text: Jehovah hath mingled a spirit of perverseness in the midst of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.

title: Isaiah 19:15
text: Neither shall there be for Egypt any work, which head or tail, palm-branch or rush, may do.

title: Isaiah 19:16
text: In that day shall the Egyptians be like unto women; and they shall tremble and fear because of the shaking of the hand of Jehovah of hosts, which he shaketh over them.

title: Isaiah 19:17
text: And the land of Judah shall become a terror unto Egypt; every one to whom mention is made thereof shall be afraid, because of the purpose of Jehovah of hosts, which he purposeth against it.

title: Isaiah 19:18
text: In that day there shall be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to Jehovah of hosts; one shall be called The city of destruction.

title: Isaiah 19:19
text: In that day shall there be an altar to Jehovah in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 19:20
text: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto Jehovah of hosts in the land of Egypt; for they shall cry unto Jehovah because of oppressors, and he will send them a saviour, and a defender, and he will deliver them.

title: Isaiah 19:21
text: And Jehovah shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know Jehovah in that day; yea, they shall worship with sacrifice and oblation, and shall vow a vow unto Jehovah, and shall perform it.

title: Isaiah 19:22
text: And Jehovah will smite Egypt, smiting and healing; and they shall return unto Jehovah, and he will be entreated of them, and will heal them.

title: Isaiah 19:23
text: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians shall worship with the Assyrians.

title: Isaiah 19:24
text: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth;

title: Isaiah 19:25
text: for that Jehovah of hosts hath blessed them, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.

title: Isaiah 20:1
text: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it;

title: Isaiah 20:2
text: at that time Jehovah spake by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go, and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put thy shoe from off thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.

title: Isaiah 20:3
text: And Jehovah said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder concerning Egypt and concerning Ethiopia;

title: Isaiah 20:4
text: so shall the king of Assyria lead away the captives of Egypt, and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

title: Isaiah 20:5
text: And they shall be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

title: Isaiah 20:6
text: And the inhabitant of this coast-land shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, whither we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and we, how shall we escape?

title: Isaiah 21:1
text: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it cometh from the wilderness, from a terrible land.

title: Isaiah 21:2
text: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous man dealeth treacherously, and the destroyer destroyeth. Go up, O Elam; besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.

title: Isaiah 21:3
text: Therefore are my loins filled with anguish; pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman in travail: I am pained so that I cannot hear; I am dismayed so that I cannot see.

title: Isaiah 21:4
text: My heart fluttereth, horror hath affrighted me; the twilight that I desired hath been turned into trembling unto me.

title: Isaiah 21:5
text: They prepare the table, they set the watch, they eat, they drink: rise up, ye princes, anoint the shield.

title: Isaiah 21:6
text: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman: let him declare what he seeth:

title: Isaiah 21:7
text: and when he seeth a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of asses, a troop of camels, he shall hearken diligently with much heed.

title: Isaiah 21:8
text: And he cried as a lion: O Lord, I stand continually upon the watch-tower in the day-time, and am set in my ward whole nights;

title: Isaiah 21:9
text: and, behold, here cometh a troop of men, horsemen in pairs. And he answered and said, Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the graven images of her gods are broken unto the ground.

title: Isaiah 21:10
text: O thou my threshing, and the grain of my floor! that which I have heard from Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.

title: Isaiah 21:11
text: The burden of Dumah. One calleth unto me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?

title: Isaiah 21:12
text: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will inquire, inquire ye: turn ye, come.

title: Isaiah 21:13
text: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye caravans of Dedanites.

title: Isaiah 21:14
text: Unto him that was thirsty they brought water; the inhabitants of the land of Tema did meet the fugitives with their bread.

title: Isaiah 21:15
text: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.

title: Isaiah 21:16
text: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of a hireling, all the glory of Kedar shall fail;

title: Isaiah 21:17
text: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be few; for Jehovah, the God of Israel, hath spoken it.

title: Isaiah 22:1
text: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?

title: Isaiah 22:2
text: O thou that art full of shoutings, a tumultuous city, a joyous town; thy slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.

title: Isaiah 22:3
text: All thy rulers fled away together, they were bound by the archers; all that were found of thee were bound together; they fled afar off.

title: Isaiah 22:4
text: Therefore said I, Look away from me, I will weep bitterly; labor not to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

title: Isaiah 22:5
text: For it is a day of discomfiture, and of treading down, and of perplexity, from the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, in the valley of vision; a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains. [

title: Isaiah 22:6
text: And Elam bare the quiver, with chariots of men [and] horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.

title: Isaiah 22:7
text: And it came to pass, that thy choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.

title: Isaiah 22:8
text: And he took away the covering of Judah; and thou didst look in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.

title: Isaiah 22:9
text: And ye saw the breaches of the city of David, that they were many; and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool;

title: Isaiah 22:10
text: and ye numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and ye brake down the houses to fortify the wall;

title: Isaiah 22:11
text: ye made also a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But ye looked not unto him that had done this, neither had ye respect unto him that purposed it long ago.

title: Isaiah 22:12
text: And in that day did the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:

title: Isaiah 22:13
text: and behold, joy and gladness, slaying oxen and killing sheep, eating flesh and drinking wine: let us eat and drink, for to-morrow we shall die.

title: Isaiah 22:14
text: And Jehovah of hosts revealed himself in mine ears, Surely this iniquity shall not be forgiven you till ye die, saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.

title: Isaiah 22:15
text: Thus saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, who is over the house, [and say] ,

title: Isaiah 22:16
text: What doest thou here? and whom has thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out here a sepulchre? hewing him out a sepulchre on high, graving a habitation for himself in the rock!

title: Isaiah 22:17
text: Behold, Jehovah, like a [strong] man, will hurl thee away violently; yea, he will wrap thee up closely.

title: Isaiah 22:18
text: He will surely wind thee round and round, [and toss thee] like a ball into a large country; there shalt thou die, and there shall be the chariots of thy glory, thou shame of thy lord's house.

title: Isaiah 22:19
text: And I will thrust thee from thine office; and from thy station shalt thou be pulled down.

title: Isaiah 22:20
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:

title: Isaiah 22:21
text: and I will cloth him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand; and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

title: Isaiah 22:22
text: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; and he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.

title: Isaiah 22:23
text: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a throne of glory to his father's house.

title: Isaiah 22:24
text: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father's house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the flagons.

title: Isaiah 22:25
text: In that day, saith Jehovah of hosts, shall the nail that was fastened in a sure place give way; and it shall be hewn down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off; for Jehovah hath spoken it.

title: Isaiah 23:1
text: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Kittim it is revealed to them.

title: Isaiah 23:2
text: Be still, ye inhabitants of the coast, thou whom the merchants of Sidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.

title: Isaiah 23:3
text: And on great waters the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue; and she was the mart of nations.

title: Isaiah 23:4
text: Be thou ashamed, O Sidon; for the sea hath spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, I have not travailed, nor brought forth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.

title: Isaiah 23:5
text: When the report cometh to Egypt, they shall be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.

title: Isaiah 23:6
text: Pass ye over to Tarshish; wail, ye inhabitants of the coast.

title: Isaiah 23:7
text: Is this your joyous [city], whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her afar off to sojourn?

title: Isaiah 23:8
text: Who hath purposed this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honorable of the earth?

title: Isaiah 23:9
text: Jehovah of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.

title: Isaiah 23:10
text: Pass through thy land as the Nile, O daughter of Tarshish; there is no restraint any more.

title: Isaiah 23:11
text: He hath stretched out his hand over the sea, he hath shaken the kingdoms: Jehovah hath given commandment concerning Canaan, to destroy the strongholds thereof.

title: Isaiah 23:12
text: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon: arise, pass over to Kittim; even there shalt thou have no rest.

title: Isaiah 23:13
text: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans: this people was not; the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness; they set up their towers; they overthrew the palaces thereof; they made it a ruin.

title: Isaiah 23:14
text: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for your stronghold is laid waste.

title: Isaiah 23:15
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years it shall be unto Tyre as in the song of the harlot.

title: Isaiah 23:16
text: Take a harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.

title: Isaiah 23:17
text: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that Jehovah will visit Tyre, and she shall return to her hire, and shall play the harlot with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.

title: Isaiah 23:18
text: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to Jehovah: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before Jehovah, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

title: Isaiah 24:1
text: Behold, Jehovah maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.

title: Isaiah 24:2
text: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest to him.

title: Isaiah 24:3
text: The earth shall be utterly emptied, and utterly laid waste; for Jehovah hath spoken this word.

title: Isaiah 24:4
text: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the lofty people of the earth do languish.

title: Isaiah 24:5
text: The earth also is polluted under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, broken the everlasting covenant.

title: Isaiah 24:6
text: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are found guilty: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.

title: Isaiah 24:7
text: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merry-hearted do sigh.

title: Isaiah 24:8
text: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.

title: Isaiah 24:9
text: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.

title: Isaiah 24:10
text: The waste city is broken down; every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

title: Isaiah 24:11
text: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.

title: Isaiah 24:12
text: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.

title: Isaiah 24:13
text: For thus shall it be in the midst of the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive-tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.

title: Isaiah 24:14
text: These shall lift up their voice, they shall shout; for the majesty of Jehovah they cry aloud from the sea.

title: Isaiah 24:15
text: Wherefore glorify ye Jehovah in the east, even the name of Jehovah, the God of Israel, in the isles of the sea.

title: Isaiah 24:16
text: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs: Glory to the righteous. But I said, I pine away, I pine away, woe is me! the treacherous have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.

title: Isaiah 24:17
text: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.

title: Isaiah 24:18
text: And it shall come to pass, that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.

title: Isaiah 24:19
text: The earth is utterly broken, the earth is rent asunder, the earth is shaken violently.

title: Isaiah 24:20
text: The earth shall stagger like a drunken man, and shall sway to and fro like a hammock; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it, and it shall fall, and not rise again.

title: Isaiah 24:21
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Jehovah will punish the host of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.

title: Isaiah 24:22
text: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison; and after many days shall they be visited.

title: Isaiah 24:23
text: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for Jehovah of hosts will reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem; and before his elders shall be glory.

title: Isaiah 25:1
text: O Jehovah, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things, [even] counsels of old, in faithfulness [and] truth.

title: Isaiah 25:2
text: For thou hast made of a city a heap, of a fortified city a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.

title: Isaiah 25:3
text: Therefore shall a strong people glorify thee; a city of terrible nations shall fear thee.

title: Isaiah 25:4
text: For thou hast been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.

title: Isaiah 25:5
text: As the heat in a dry place wilt thou bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the terrible ones shall be brought low.

title: Isaiah 25:6
text: And in this mountain will Jehovah of hosts make unto all peoples a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.

title: Isaiah 25:7
text: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering that covereth all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.

title: Isaiah 25:8
text: He hath swallowed up death for ever; and the Lord Jehovah will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the reproach of his people will he take away from off all the earth: for Jehovah hath spoken it.

title: Isaiah 25:9
text: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is Jehovah; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.

title: Isaiah 25:10
text: For in this mountain will the hand of Jehovah rest; and Moab shall be trodden down in his place, even as straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.

title: Isaiah 25:11
text: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst thereof, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth [his hands] to swim; but [Jehovah] will lay low his pride [ together with the craft of his hands.

title: Isaiah 25:12
text: And the high fortress of thy walls hath he brought down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.

title: Isaiah 26:1
text: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah: we have a strong city; salvation will he appoint for walls and bulwarks.

title: Isaiah 26:2
text: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth faith may enter in.

title: Isaiah 26:3
text: Thou wilt keep [him] in perfect peace, [whose] mind [is] stayed [on thee] ; because he trusteth in thee.

title: Isaiah 26:4
text: Trust ye in Jehovah for ever; for in Jehovah, [even] Jehovah, is an everlasting rock.

title: Isaiah 26:5
text: For he hath brought down them that dwell on high, the lofty city: he layeth it low, he layeth it low even to the ground; he bringeth it even to the dust.

title: Isaiah 26:6
text: The foot shall tread it down; even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.

title: Isaiah 26:7
text: The way of the just is uprightness: thou that art upright dost direct the path of the just.

title: Isaiah 26:8
text: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O Jehovah, have we waited for thee; to thy name, even to thy memorial [name], is the desire of our soul.

title: Isaiah 26:9
text: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee earnestly: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.

title: Isaiah 26:10
text: Let favor be showed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness; in the land of uprightness will he deal wrongfully, and will not behold the majesty of Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 26:11
text: Jehovah, thy hand is lifted up, yet they see not: but they shall see [thy] zeal for the people, and be put to shame; yea, fire shall devour thine adversaries. [

title: Isaiah 26:12
text: Jehovah, thou wilt ordain peace for us; for thou hast also wrought all our works for us.

title: Isaiah 26:13
text: O Jehovah our God, other lords besides thee have had dominion over us; but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.

title: Isaiah 26:14
text: [They are] dead, they shall not live; [they are] deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all remembrance of them to perish.

title: Isaiah 26:15
text: Thou hast increased the nation, O Jehovah, thou hast increased the nation; thou art glorified; thou hast enlarged all the borders of the land.

title: Isaiah 26:16
text: Jehovah, in trouble have they visited thee; they poured out a prayer [when] thy chastening was upon them.

title: Isaiah 26:17
text: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain and crieth out in her pangs; so we have been before thee, O Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 26:18
text: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

title: Isaiah 26:19
text: Thy dead shall live; my dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in the dust; for thy dew is [as] the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast forth the dead.

title: Isaiah 26:20
text: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.

title: Isaiah 26:21
text: For, behold, Jehovah cometh forth out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.

title: Isaiah 27:1
text: In that day Jehovah with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan the swift serpent, and leviathan the crooked serpent; and he will slay the monster that is in the sea.

title: Isaiah 27:2
text: In that day: A vineyard of wine, sing ye unto it.

title: Isaiah 27:3
text: I Jehovah am its keeper; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.

title: Isaiah 27:4
text: Wrath is not in me: would that the briers and thorns were against me in battle! I would march upon them, I would burn them together.

title: Isaiah 27:5
text: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; [yea], let him make peace with me.

title: Isaiah 27:6
text: In days to come shall Jacob take root; Israel shall blossom and bud; and they shall fill the face of the world with fruit.

title: Isaiah 27:7
text: Hath he smitten them as he smote those that smote them? or are they slain according to the slaughter of them that were slain by them?

title: Isaiah 27:8
text: In measure, when thou sendest them away, thou dost contend with them; he hath removed [them] with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.

title: Isaiah 27:9
text: Therefore by this shall the iniquity of Jacob be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, [so that] the Asherim and the sun-images shall rise no more.

title: Isaiah 27:10
text: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.

title: Isaiah 27:11
text: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off; the women shall come, and set them on fire; for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have compassion upon them, and he that formed them will show them no favor.

title: Isaiah 27:12
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Jehovah will beat off [his fruit] from the flood of the River unto the brook of Egypt; and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.

title: Isaiah 27:13
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a great trumpet shall be blown; and they shall come that were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and they that were outcasts in the land of Egypt; and they shall worship Jehovah in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.

title: Isaiah 28:1
text: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley of them that are overcome with wine!

title: Isaiah 28:2
text: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one; as a tempest of hail, a destroying storm, as a tempest of mighty waters overflowing, will he cast down to the earth with the hand.

title: Isaiah 28:3
text: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim shall be trodden under foot:

title: Isaiah 28:4
text: and the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be as the first-ripe fig before the summer; which when he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.

title: Isaiah 28:5
text: In that day will Jehovah of hosts become a crown of glory, and a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people;

title: Isaiah 28:6
text: and a spirit of justice to him that sitteth in judgment, and strength to them that turn back the battle at the gate.

title: Isaiah 28:7
text: And even these reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink; the priest and the prophet reel with strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they stagger with strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment.

title: Isaiah 28:8
text: For all tables are full of vomit [and] filthiness, [so that there is] no place [clean] .

title: Isaiah 28:9
text: Whom will he teach knowledge? and whom will he make to understand the message? them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?

title: Isaiah 28:10
text: For it is precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, there a little.

title: Isaiah 28:11
text: Nay, but by [men of] strange lips and with another tongue will he speak to this people;

title: Isaiah 28:12
text: to whom he said, This is the rest, give ye rest to him that is weary; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.

title: Isaiah 28:13
text: Therefore shall the word of Jehovah be unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, there a little; that they may go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.

title: Isaiah 28:14
text: Wherefore hear the word of Jehovah, ye scoffers, that rule this people that is in Jerusalem:

title: Isaiah 28:15
text: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with Sheol are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us; for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:

title: Isaiah 28:16
text: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner-[ stone] of sure foundation: he that believeth shall not be in haste.

title: Isaiah 28:17
text: And I will make justice the line, and righteousness the plummet; and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding-place.

title: Isaiah 28:18
text: And your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.

title: Isaiah 28:19
text: As often as it passeth though, it shall take you; for morning by morning shall it pass through, by day and by night: and it shall be nought but terror to understand the message.

title: Isaiah 28:20
text: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it; and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.

title: Isaiah 28:21
text: For Jehovah will rise up as in mount Perazim, he will be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon; that he may do his work, his strange work, and bring to pass his act, his strange act.

title: Isaiah 28:22
text: Now therefore be ye not scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for a decree of destruction have I heard from the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, upon the whole earth.

title: Isaiah 28:23
text: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.

title: Isaiah 28:24
text: Doth he that ploweth to sow plow continually? doth he [continually] open and harrow his ground?

title: Isaiah 28:25
text: When he hath levelled the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and put in the wheat in rows, and the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in the border thereof?

title: Isaiah 28:26
text: For his God doth instruct him aright, [and] doth teach him.

title: Isaiah 28:27
text: For the fitches are not threshed with a sharp [threshing] instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.

title: Isaiah 28:28
text: Bread [grain] is ground; for he will not be always threshing it: and though the wheel of his cart and his horses scatter it, he doth not grind it.

title: Isaiah 28:29
text: This also cometh forth from Jehovah of hosts, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.

title: Isaiah 29:1
text: Ho Ariel, Ariel, the city where David encamped! add ye year to year; let the feasts come round:

title: Isaiah 29:2
text: then will I distress Ariel, and there shall be mourning and lamentation; and she shall be unto me as Ariel.

title: Isaiah 29:3
text: And I will encamp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with posted troops, and I will raise siege works against thee.

title: Isaiah 29:4
text: And thou shalt be brought down, and shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust; and thy voice shall be as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.

title: Isaiah 29:5
text: But the multitude of thy foes shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be in an instant suddenly.

title: Isaiah 29:6
text: She shall be visited of Jehovah of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with whirlwind and tempest, and the flame of a devouring fire.

title: Isaiah 29:7
text: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her stronghold, and that distress her, shall be as a dream, a vision of the night.

title: Isaiah 29:8
text: And it shall be as when a hungry man dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold, he is faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.

title: Isaiah 29:9
text: Tarry ye and wonder; take your pleasure and be blind: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.

title: Isaiah 29:10
text: For Jehovah hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes, the prophets; and your heads, the seers, hath he covered.

title: Isaiah 29:11
text: And all vision is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee; and he saith, I cannot, for it is sealed:

title: Isaiah 29:12
text: and the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee; and he saith, I am not learned.

title: Isaiah 29:13
text: And the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw nigh [unto me], and with their mouth and with their lips to honor me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment of men which hath been taught [them] ;

title: Isaiah 29:14
text: therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.

title: Isaiah 29:15
text: Woe unto them that hide deep their counsel from Jehovah, and whose works are in the dark, and that say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?

title: Isaiah 29:16
text: Ye turn things upside down! Shall the potter be esteemed as clay; that the thing made should say of him that made it, He made me not; or the thing formed say of him that formed it, He hath no understanding?

title: Isaiah 29:17
text: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?

title: Isaiah 29:18
text: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity and out of darkness.

title: Isaiah 29:19
text: The meek also shall increase their joy in Jehovah, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

title: Isaiah 29:20
text: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scoffer ceaseth, and all they that watch for iniquity are cut off;

title: Isaiah 29:21
text: that make a man an offender in [his] cause, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just with a thing of nought.

title: Isaiah 29:22
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob: Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.

title: Isaiah 29:23
text: But when he seeth his children, the work of my hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name; yea, they shall sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall stand in awe of the God of Israel.

title: Isaiah 29:24
text: They also that err in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmur shall receive instruction.

title: Isaiah 30:1
text: Woe to the rebellious children, saith Jehovah, that take counsel, but not of me; and that make a league, but not of my Spirit, that they may add sin to sin,

title: Isaiah 30:2
text: that set out to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt!

title: Isaiah 30:3
text: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.

title: Isaiah 30:4
text: For their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors are come to Hanes.

title: Isaiah 30:5
text: They shall all be ashamed because of a people that cannot profit them, that are not a help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.

title: Isaiah 30:6
text: The burden of the beasts of the South. Through the land of trouble and anguish, from whence come the lioness and the lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the humps of camels, to a people that shall not profit [them] .

title: Isaiah 30:7
text: For Egypt helpeth in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I called her Rahab that sitteth still.

title: Isaiah 30:8
text: Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever.

title: Isaiah 30:9
text: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of Jehovah;

title: Isaiah 30:10
text: that say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits,

title: Isaiah 30:11
text: get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.

title: Isaiah 30:12
text: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and rely thereon;

title: Isaiah 30:13
text: therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly in an instant.

title: Isaiah 30:14
text: And he shall break it as a potter's vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing; so that there shall not be found among the pieces thereof a sherd wherewith to take fire from the hearth, or to dip up water out of the cistern.

title: Isaiah 30:15
text: For thus said the Lord Jehovah, the Holy One of Israel, In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength. And ye would not:

title: Isaiah 30:16
text: but ye said, No, for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.

title: Isaiah 30:17
text: One thousand [shall flee] at the threat of one; at the threat of five shall ye flee: till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on a hill.

title: Isaiah 30:18
text: And therefore will Jehovah wait, that he may be gracious unto you; and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for Jehovah is a God of justice; blessed are all they that wait for him.

title: Isaiah 30:19
text: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem; thou shalt weep no more; he will surely be gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry; when he shall hear, he will answer thee.

title: Isaiah 30:20
text: And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be hidden anymore, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers;

title: Isaiah 30:21
text: and thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it; when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.

title: Isaiah 30:22
text: And ye shall defile the overlaying of thy graven images of silver, and the plating of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as an unclean thing; thou shalt say unto it, Get thee hence.

title: Isaiah 30:23
text: And he will give the rain for thy seed, wherewith thou shalt sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground, and it shall be fat and plenteous. In that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures;

title: Isaiah 30:24
text: the oxen likewise and the young asses that till the ground shall eat savory provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork.

title: Isaiah 30:25
text: And there shall be upon every lofty mountain, and upon every high hill, brooks [and] streams of waters, in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

title: Isaiah 30:26
text: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that Jehovah bindeth up the hurt of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.

title: Isaiah 30:27
text: Behold, the name of Jehovah cometh from far, burning with his anger, and in thick rising smoke: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue is as a devouring fire;

title: Isaiah 30:28
text: and his breath is as an overflowing stream, that reacheth even unto the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction: and a bridle that causeth to err [shall be] in the jaws of the peoples.

title: Isaiah 30:29
text: Ye shall have a song as in the night when a holy feast is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come unto the mountain of Jehovah, to the Rock of Israel.

title: Isaiah 30:30
text: And Jehovah will cause his glorious voice to be heard, and will show the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of [his] anger, and the flame of a devouring fire, with a blast, and tempest, and hailstones.

title: Isaiah 30:31
text: For through the voice of Jehovah shall the Assyrian be dismayed; with his rod will he smite [him] .

title: Isaiah 30:32
text: And every stroke of the appointed staff, which Jehovah shall lay upon him, shall be with [the sound of] tabrets and harps; and in battles with the brandishing [of his arm] will he fight with them.

title: Isaiah 30:33
text: For a Topheth is prepared of old; yea, for the king it is made ready; he hath made it deep and large; the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of Jehovah, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.

title: Isaiah 31:1
text: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in horsemen because they are very strong, but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek Jehovah!

title: Isaiah 31:2
text: Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words, but will arise against the house of the evil-doers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.

title: Isaiah 31:3
text: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit: and when Jehovah shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall stumble, and he that is helped shall fall, and they all shall be consumed together.

title: Isaiah 31:4
text: For thus saith Jehovah unto me, As the lion and the young lion growling over his prey, if a multitude of shepherds be called forth against him, will not be dismayed at their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so will Jehovah of hosts come down to fight upon mount Zion, and upon the hill thereof.

title: Isaiah 31:5
text: As birds hovering, so will Jehovah of hosts protect Jerusalem; he will protect and deliver [it], he will pass over and preserve [it] .

title: Isaiah 31:6
text: Turn ye unto him from whom ye have deeply revolted, O children of Israel.

title: Isaiah 31:7
text: For in that day they shall cast away every man his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.

title: Isaiah 31:8
text: And the Assyrian shall fall by the sword, not of man; and the sword, not of men, shall devour him; and he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall become subject to taskwork.

title: Isaiah 31:9
text: And his rock shall pass away by reason of terror, and his princes shall be dismayed at the ensign, saith Jehovah, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.

title: Isaiah 32:1
text: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in justice.

title: Isaiah 32:2
text: And a man shall be as a hiding-place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest, as streams of water in a dry place, as the shade of a great rock in a weary land.

title: Isaiah 32:3
text: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.

title: Isaiah 32:4
text: And the heart of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.

title: Isaiah 32:5
text: The fool shall be no more called noble, nor the churl said to be bountiful.

title: Isaiah 32:6
text: For the fool will speak folly, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise profaneness, and to utter error against Jehovah, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and to cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

title: Isaiah 32:7
text: And the instruments of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the meek with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.

title: Isaiah 32:8
text: But the noble deviseth noble things; and in noble things shall he continue.

title: Isaiah 32:9
text: Rise up, ye women that are at ease, [and] hear my voice; ye careless daughters, give ear unto my speech.

title: Isaiah 32:10
text: For days beyond a year shall ye be troubled, ye careless women; for the vintage shall fail, the ingathering shall not come.

title: Isaiah 32:11
text: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones; strip you, and make you bare, and gird [sackcloth] upon your loins.

title: Isaiah 32:12
text: They shall smite upon the breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

title: Isaiah 32:13
text: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city.

title: Isaiah 32:14
text: For the palace shall be forsaken; the populous city shall be deserted; the hill and the watch-tower shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;

title: Isaiah 32:15
text: until the Spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness become a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be esteemed as a forest.

title: Isaiah 32:16
text: Then justice shall dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness shall abide in the fruitful field.

title: Isaiah 32:17
text: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence for ever.

title: Isaiah 32:18
text: And my people shall abide in a peaceable habitation, and in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting-places.

title: Isaiah 32:19
text: But it shall hail in the downfall of the forest; and the city shall be utterly laid low.

title: Isaiah 32:20
text: Blessed are yet that sow beside all waters, that send forth the feet of the ox and the ass.

title: Isaiah 33:1
text: Woe to thee that destroyest, and thou wast not destroyed; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! When thou hast ceased to destroy, thou shalt be destroyed; and when thou hast made an end of dealing treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.

title: Isaiah 33:2
text: O Jehovah, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou our arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

title: Isaiah 33:3
text: At the noise of the tumult the peoples are fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations are scattered.

title: Isaiah 33:4
text: And your spoil shall be gathered as the caterpillar gathereth: as locusts leap shall men leap upon it.

title: Isaiah 33:5
text: Jehovah is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with justice and righteousness.

title: Isaiah 33:6
text: And there shall be stability in thy times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge: the fear of Jehovah is thy treasure.

title: Isaiah 33:7
text: Behold, their valiant ones cry without; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.

title: Isaiah 33:8
text: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: [the enemy] hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth not man.

title: Isaiah 33:9
text: The land mourneth and languisheth; Lebanon is confounded and withereth away; Sharon is like a desert; and Bashan and Carmel shake off [their leaves] .

title: Isaiah 33:10
text: Now will I arise, saith Jehovah; now will I lift up myself; now will I be exalted.

title: Isaiah 33:11
text: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath is a fire that shall devour you.

title: Isaiah 33:12
text: And the peoples shall be as the burnings of lime, as thorns cut down, that are burned in the fire.

title: Isaiah 33:13
text: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.

title: Isaiah 33:14
text: The sinners in Zion are afraid; trembling hath seized the godless ones: Who among us can dwell with the devouring fire? who among us can dwell with everlasting burnings?

title: Isaiah 33:15
text: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from taking a bribe, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from looking upon evil:

title: Isaiah 33:16
text: He shall dwell on high; his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks; his bread shall be given [him] ; his waters shall be sure.

title: Isaiah 33:17
text: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold a land that reacheth afar.

title: Isaiah 33:18
text: Thy heart shall muse on the terror: Where is he that counted, where is he that weighed [the tribute] ? where is he that counted the towers?

title: Isaiah 33:19
text: Thou shalt not see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that thou canst not comprehend, of a strange tongue that thou canst not understand.

title: Isaiah 33:20
text: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tent that shall not be removed, the stakes whereof shall never be plucked up, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.

title: Isaiah 33:21
text: But there Jehovah will be with us in majesty, a place of broad rivers and streams, wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.

title: Isaiah 33:22
text: For Jehovah is our judge, Jehovah is our lawgiver, Jehovah is our king; he will save us.

title: Isaiah 33:23
text: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not strengthen the foot of their mast, they could not spread the sail: then was the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame took the prey.

title: Isaiah 33:24
text: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.

title: Isaiah 34:1
text: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye peoples: let the earth hear, and the fulness thereof; the world, and all things that come forth from it.

title: Isaiah 34:2
text: For Jehovah hath indignation against all the nations, and wrath against all their host: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.

title: Isaiah 34:3
text: Their slain also shall be cast out, and the stench of their dead bodies shall come up; and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.

title: Isaiah 34:4
text: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll; and all their host shall fade away, as the leaf fadeth from off the vine, and as a fading [leaf] from the fig-tree.

title: Isaiah 34:5
text: For my sword hath drunk its fill in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Edom, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.

title: Isaiah 34:6
text: The sword of Jehovah is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams; for Jehovah hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

title: Isaiah 34:7
text: And the wild-oxen shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls: and their land shall be drunken with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.

title: Isaiah 34:8
text: For Jehovah hath a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.

title: Isaiah 34:9
text: And the streams of [Edom] shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.

title: Isaiah 34:10
text: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever; from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.

title: Isaiah 34:11
text: But the pelican and the porcupine shall possess it; and the owl and the raven shall dwell therein: and he will stretch over it the line of confusion, and the plummet of emptiness.

title: Isaiah 34:12
text: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there; and all its princes shall be nothing.

title: Isaiah 34:13
text: And thorns shall come up in its palaces, nettles and thistles in the fortresses thereof; and it shall be a habitation of jackals, a court for ostriches.

title: Isaiah 34:14
text: And the wild beasts of the desert shall meet with the wolves, and the wild goat shall cry to his fellow; yea, the night-monster shall settle there, and shall find her a place of rest.

title: Isaiah 34:15
text: There shall the dart-snake make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shade; yea, there shall the kites be gathered, every one with her mate.

title: Isaiah 34:16
text: Seek ye out of the book of Jehovah, and read: no one of these shall be missing, none shall want her mate; for my mouth, it hath commanded, and his Spirit, it hath gathered them.

title: Isaiah 34:17
text: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever; from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.

title: Isaiah 35:1
text: The wilderness and the dry land shall be glad; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.

title: Isaiah 35:2
text: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing; the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon: they shall see the glory of Jehovah, the excellency of our God.

title: Isaiah 35:3
text: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.

title: Isaiah 35:4
text: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come [with] vengeance, [with] the recompense of God; he will come and save you.

title: Isaiah 35:5
text: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.

title: Isaiah 35:6
text: Then shall the lame man leap as a hart, and the tongue of the dumb shall sing; for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.

title: Isaiah 35:7
text: And the glowing sand shall become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water: in the habitation of jackals, where they lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes. [

title: Isaiah 35:8
text: And a highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but is shall be for [the redeemed] : the wayfaring men, yea fools, shall not err [therein] .

title: Isaiah 35:9
text: No lion shall be there, nor shall any ravenous beast go up thereon; they shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk [there] :

title: Isaiah 35:10
text: and the ransomed of Jehovah shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their heads: they shall obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

title: Isaiah 36:1
text: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah, and took them.

title: Isaiah 36:2
text: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field.

title: Isaiah 36:3
text: Then came forth unto him Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder.

title: Isaiah 36:4
text: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?

title: Isaiah 36:5
text: I say, [thy] counsel and strength for the war are but vain words: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou hast rebelled against me?

title: Isaiah 36:6
text: Behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed, even upon Egypt, whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust on him.

title: Isaiah 36:7
text: But if thou say unto me, We trust in Jehovah our God: is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?

title: Isaiah 36:8
text: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.

title: Isaiah 36:9
text: How then canst thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

title: Isaiah 36:10
text: And am I now come up without Jehovah against this land to destroy it? Jehovah said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

title: Isaiah 36:11
text: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and speak not to us in the Jews' language, in the ears of the people that are on the wall.

title: Isaiah 36:12
text: But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words? [hath he] not [sent me] to the men that sit upon the wall, to eat their own dung, and to drink their own water with you?

title: Isaiah 36:13
text: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.

title: Isaiah 36:14
text: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you; for he will not be able to deliver you:

title: Isaiah 36:15
text: neither let Hezekiah make you trust in Jehovah, saying, Jehovah will surely deliver us; this city shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

title: Isaiah 36:16
text: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig-tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;

title: Isaiah 36:17
text: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

title: Isaiah 36:18
text: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, Jehovah will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

title: Isaiah 36:19
text: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

title: Isaiah 36:20
text: Who are they among all the gods of these countries, that have delivered their country out of my hand, that Jehovah should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?

title: Isaiah 36:21
text: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word; for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

title: Isaiah 36:22
text: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.

title: Isaiah 37:1
text: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 37:2
text: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

title: Isaiah 37:3
text: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of contumely; for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.

title: Isaiah 37:4
text: It may be Jehovah thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which Jehovah thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left.

title: Isaiah 37:5
text: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

title: Isaiah 37:6
text: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith Jehovah, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

title: Isaiah 37:7
text: Behold, I will put a spirit in him, and he shall hear tidings, and shall return unto his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

title: Isaiah 37:8
text: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah; for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.

title: Isaiah 37:9
text: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come out to fight against thee. And when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

title: Isaiah 37:10
text: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

title: Isaiah 37:11
text: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?

title: Isaiah 37:12
text: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed, Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden that were in Telassar?

title: Isaiah 37:13
text: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?

title: Isaiah 37:14
text: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it; and Hezekiah went up unto the house of Jehovah, and spread it before Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 37:15
text: And Hezekiah prayed unto Jehovah, saying,

title: Isaiah 37:16
text: O Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, that sittest [above] the cherubim, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; thou hast made heaven and earth.

title: Isaiah 37:17
text: Incline thine ear, O Jehovah, and hear; open thine eyes, O Jehovah, and see; and hear all the words of Sennacherib, who hath sent to defy the living God.

title: Isaiah 37:18
text: Of a truth, Jehovah, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the countries, and their land,

title: Isaiah 37:19
text: and have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone; therefore they have destroyed them.

title: Isaiah 37:20
text: Now therefore, O Jehovah our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art Jehovah, even thou only.

title: Isaiah 37:21
text: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria,

title: Isaiah 37:22
text: this is the word which Jehovah hath spoken concerning him: The virgin daughter of Zion hath despised thee and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.

title: Isaiah 37:23
text: Whom hast thou defied and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice and lifted up thine eyes on high? [even] against the Holy One of Israel.

title: Isaiah 37:24
text: By thy servants hast thou defied the Lord, and hast said, With the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof, and the choice fir-trees thereof; and I will enter into its farthest height, the forest of its fruitful field;

title: Isaiah 37:25
text: I have digged and drunk water, and with the sole of my feet will I dry up all the rivers of Egypt.

title: Isaiah 37:26
text: Hast thou not heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it of ancient times? now have I brought it to pass, that it should be thine to lay waste fortified cities into ruinous heaps.

title: Isaiah 37:27
text: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as a field [of grain] before it is grown up.

title: Isaiah 37:28
text: But I know thy sitting down, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy raging against me.

title: Isaiah 37:29
text: Because of thy raging against me, and because thine arrogancy is come up into mine ears, therefore will I put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

title: Isaiah 37:30
text: And this shall be the sign unto thee: ye shall eat this year that which groweth of itself, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.

title: Isaiah 37:31
text: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

title: Isaiah 37:32
text: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and out of mount Zion they that shall escape. The zeal of Jehovah of hosts will perform this.

title: Isaiah 37:33
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come unto this city, nor shoot an arrow there, neither shall he come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.

title: Isaiah 37:34
text: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and he shall not come unto this city, saith Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 37:35
text: For I will defend this city to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.

title: Isaiah 37:36
text: And the angel of Jehovah went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand; and when men arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.

title: Isaiah 37:37
text: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

title: Isaiah 37:38
text: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. And Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.

title: Isaiah 38:1
text: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith Jehovah, Set thy house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.

title: Isaiah 38:2
text: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto Jehovah,

title: Isaiah 38:3
text: and said, Remember now, O Jehovah, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.

title: Isaiah 38:4
text: Then came the word of Jehovah to Isaiah, saying,

title: Isaiah 38:5
