text: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.

title: Isaiah 38:6
text: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city.

title: Isaiah 38:7
text: And this shall be the sign unto thee from Jehovah, that Jehovah will do this thing that he hath spoken:

title: Isaiah 38:8
text: behold, I will cause the shadow on the steps, which is gone down on the dial of Ahaz with the sun, to return backward ten steps. So the sun returned ten steps on the dial whereon it was gone down.

title: Isaiah 38:9
text: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness.

title: Isaiah 38:10
text: I said, In the noontide of my days I shall go into the gates of Sheol: I am deprived of the residue of my years.

title: Isaiah 38:11
text: I said, I shall not see Jehovah, [even] Jehovah in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.

title: Isaiah 38:12
text: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me as a shepherd's tent: I have rolled up, like a weaver, my life; he will cut me off from the loom: From day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.

title: Isaiah 38:13
text: I quieted [myself] until morning; as a lion, so he breaketh all my bones: From day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.

title: Isaiah 38:14
text: Like a swallow [or] a crane, so did I chatter; I did moan as a dove; mine eyes fail [with looking] upward: O Lord, I am oppressed, be thou my surety.

title: Isaiah 38:15
text: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years because of the bitterness of my soul.

title: Isaiah 38:16
text: O Lord, by these things men live; And wholly therein is the life of my spirit: Wherefore recover thou me, and make me to live.

title: Isaiah 38:17
text: Behold, [it was] for [my] peace [that] I had great bitterness: But thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; For thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.

title: Isaiah 38:18
text: For Sheol cannot praise thee, death cannot celebrate thee: They that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.

title: Isaiah 38:19
text: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I do this day: The father to the children shall make known thy truth.

title: Isaiah 38:20
text: Jehovah is [ready] to save me: Therefore we will sing my songs with stringed instruments All the days of our life in the house of Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 38:21
text: Now Isaiah had said, Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it for a plaster upon the boil, and he shall recover.

title: Isaiah 38:22
text: Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of Jehovah?

title: Isaiah 39:1
text: At that time Merodach-baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah; for he heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.

title: Isaiah 39:2
text: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and showed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious oil, and all the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah showed them not.

title: Isaiah 39:3
text: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.

title: Isaiah 39:4
text: Then said he, What have they seen in thy house? And Hezekiah answered, All that is in my house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not showed them.

title: Isaiah 39:5
text: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of Jehovah of hosts:

title: Isaiah 39:6
text: Behold, the days are coming, when all that is in thy house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 39:7
text: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, whom thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

title: Isaiah 39:8
text: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of Jehovah which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.

title: Isaiah 40:1
text: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.

title: Isaiah 40:2
text: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem; and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she hath received of Jehovah's hand double for all her sins.

title: Isaiah 40:3
text: The voice of one that crieth, Prepare ye in the wilderness the way of Jehovah; make level in the desert a highway for our God.

title: Isaiah 40:4
text: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low; and the uneven shall be made level, and the rough places a plain:

title: Isaiah 40:5
text: and the glory of Jehovah shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of Jehovah hath spoken it.

title: Isaiah 40:6
text: The voice of one saying, Cry. And one said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field.

title: Isaiah 40:7
text: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth, because the breath of Jehovah bloweth upon it; surely the people is grass.

title: Isaiah 40:8
text: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth; but the word of our God shall stand forever.

title: Isaiah 40:9
text: O thou that tellest good tidings to Zion, get thee up on a high mountain; O thou that tellest good tidings to Jerusalem, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold, your God!

title: Isaiah 40:10
text: Behold, the Lord Jehovah will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him: Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.

title: Isaiah 40:11
text: He will feed his flock like a shepherd, he will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom, [and] will gently lead those that have their young.

title: Isaiah 40:12
text: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

title: Isaiah 40:13
text: Who hath directed the Spirit of Jehovah, or being his counsellor hath taught him?

title: Isaiah 40:14
text: With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed to him the way of understanding?

title: Isaiah 40:15
text: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are accounted as the small dust of the balance: Behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.

title: Isaiah 40:16
text: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt-offering.

title: Isaiah 40:17
text: All the nations are as nothing before him; they are accounted by him as less than nothing, and vanity.

title: Isaiah 40:18
text: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?

title: Isaiah 40:19
text: The image, a workman hath cast [it], and the goldsmith overlayeth it with gold, and casteth [for it] silver chains.

title: Isaiah 40:20
text: He that is too impoverished for [such] an oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeketh unto him a skilful workman to set up a graven image, that shall not be moved.

title: Isaiah 40:21
text: Have ye not known? have yet not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?

title: Isaiah 40:22
text: [ It is] he that sitteth above the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in;

title: Isaiah 40:23
text: that bringeth princes to nothing; that maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.

title: Isaiah 40:24
text: Yea, they have not been planted; yea, they have not been sown; yea, their stock hath not taken root in the earth: moreover he bloweth upon them, and they wither, and the whirlwind taketh them away as stubble.

title: Isaiah 40:25
text: To whom then will ye liken me, that I should be equal [to him] ? saith the Holy One.

title: Isaiah 40:26
text: Lift up your eyes on high, and see who hath created these, that bringeth out their host by number; he calleth them all by name; by the greatness of his might, and for that he is strong in power, not one is lacking.

title: Isaiah 40:27
text: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from Jehovah, and the justice [due] to me is passed away from my God?

title: Isaiah 40:28
text: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard? The everlasting God, Jehovah, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary; there is no searching of his understanding.

title: Isaiah 40:29
text: He giveth power to the faint; and to him that hath no might he increaseth strength.

title: Isaiah 40:30
text: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:

title: Isaiah 40:31
text: but they that wait for Jehovah shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; they shall walk, and not faint.

title: Isaiah 41:1
text: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the peoples renew their strength: let them come near; then let them speak; let us come near together to judgment.

title: Isaiah 41:2
text: Who hath raised up one from the east, whom he calleth in righteousness to his foot? he giveth nations before him, and maketh him rule over kings; he giveth them as the dust to his sword, as the driven stubble to his bow.

title: Isaiah 41:3
text: He pursueth them, and passeth on safely, even by a way that he had not gone with his feet.

title: Isaiah 41:4
text: Who hath wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, Jehovah, the first, and with the last, I am he.

title: Isaiah 41:5
text: The isles have seen, and fear; the ends of the earth tremble; they draw near, and come.

title: Isaiah 41:6
text: They help every one his neighbor; and [every one] saith to his brother, Be of good courage.

title: Isaiah 41:7
text: So the carpenter encourageth the goldsmith, [and] he that smootheth with the hammer him that smiteth the anvil, saying of the soldering, It is good; and he fasteneth it with nails, that it should not be moved.

title: Isaiah 41:8
text: But thou, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend,

title: Isaiah 41:9
text: thou whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, and called from the corners thereof, and said unto thee, Thou art my servant, I have chosen thee and not cast thee away;

title: Isaiah 41:10
text: Fear thou not, for I am with thee; be not dismayed, for I am thy God; I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

title: Isaiah 41:11
text: Behold, all they that are incensed against thee shall be put to shame and confounded: they that strive with thee shall be as nothing, and shall perish.

title: Isaiah 41:12
text: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even them that contend with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.

title: Isaiah 41:13
text: For I, Jehovah thy God, will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.

title: Isaiah 41:14
text: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith Jehovah, and thy Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.

title: Isaiah 41:15
text: Behold, I have made thee [to be] a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth; thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff.

title: Isaiah 41:16
text: Thou shalt winnow them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them; and thou shalt rejoice in Jehovah, thou shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.

title: Isaiah 41:17
text: The poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue faileth for thirst; I, Jehovah, will answer them, I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.

title: Isaiah 41:18
text: I will open rivers on the bare heights, and fountains in the midst of the valleys; I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

title: Isaiah 41:19
text: I will put in the wilderness the cedar, the acacia, and the myrtle, and the oil-tree; I will set in the desert the fir-tree, the pine, and the box-tree together:

title: Isaiah 41:20
text: that they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of Jehovah hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.

title: Isaiah 41:21
text: Produce your cause, saith Jehovah; bring forth your strong reasons, saith the King of Jacob.

title: Isaiah 41:22
text: Let them bring forth, and declare unto us what shall happen: declare ye the former things, what they are, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or show us things to come.

title: Isaiah 41:23
text: Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold it together.

title: Isaiah 41:24
text: Behold, ye are of nothing, and your work is of nought; an abomination is he that chooseth you.

title: Isaiah 41:25
text: I have raised up one from the north, and he is come; from the rising of the sun one that calleth upon my name: and he shall come upon rulers as upon mortar, and as the potter treadeth clay.

title: Isaiah 41:26
text: Who hath declared it from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, [He is] right? yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that showeth, yea, there is none that heareth your words.

title: Isaiah 41:27
text: [ I am the] first [that saith] unto Zion, Behold, behold them; and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.

title: Isaiah 41:28
text: And when I look, there is no man: even among them there is no counsellor, that, when I ask of them, can answer a word.

title: Isaiah 41:29
text: Behold, all of them, their works are vanity [and] nought; their molten images are wind and confusion.

title: Isaiah 42:1
text: Behold, my servant, whom I uphold; my chosen, in whom my soul delighteth: I have put my Spirit upon him; he will bring forth justice to the Gentiles.

title: Isaiah 42:2
text: He will not cry, nor lift up his voice, nor cause it to be heard in the street.

title: Isaiah 42:3
text: A bruised reed will he not break, and a dimly burning wick will he not quench: he will bring forth justice in truth.

title: Isaiah 42:4
text: He will not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set justice in the earth; and the isles shall wait for his law.

title: Isaiah 42:5
text: Thus saith God Jehovah, he that created the heavens, and stretched them forth; he that spread abroad the earth and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:

title: Isaiah 42:6
text: I, Jehovah, have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thy hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;

title: Isaiah 42:7
text: to open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the dungeon, and them that sit in darkness out of the prison-house.

title: Isaiah 42:8
text: I am Jehovah, that is my name; and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise unto graven images.

title: Isaiah 42:9
text: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare; before they spring forth I tell you of them.

title: Isaiah 42:10
text: Sing unto Jehovah a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth; ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.

title: Isaiah 42:11
text: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up [their voice], the villages that Kedar doth inhabit; let the inhabitants of Sela sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.

title: Isaiah 42:12
text: Let them give glory unto Jehovah, and declare his praise in the islands.

title: Isaiah 42:13
text: Jehovah will go forth as a mighty man; he will stir up [his] zeal like a man of war: he will cry, yea, he will shout aloud; he will do mightily against his enemies.

title: Isaiah 42:14
text: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself: [now] will I cry out like a travailing woman; I will gasp and pant together.

title: Isaiah 42:15
text: I will lay waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and will dry up the pools.

title: Isaiah 42:16
text: And I will bring the blind by a way that they know not; in paths that they know not will I lead them; I will make darkness light before them, and crooked places straight. These things will I do, and I will not forsake them.

title: Isaiah 42:17
text: They shall be turned back, they shall be utterly put to shame, that trust in graven images, that say unto molten images, Ye are our gods.

title: Isaiah 42:18
text: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.

title: Isaiah 42:19
text: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I send? who is blind as he that is at peace [with me], and blind as Jehovah's servant?

title: Isaiah 42:20
text: Thou seest many things, but thou observest not; his ears are open, but he heareth not.

title: Isaiah 42:21
text: It pleased Jehovah, for his righteousness' sake, to magnify the law, and make it honorable.

title: Isaiah 42:22
text: But this is a people robbed and plundered; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison-houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.

title: Isaiah 42:23
text: Who is there among you that will give ear to this? that will hearken and hear for the time to come?

title: Isaiah 42:24
text: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not Jehovah? he against whom we have sinned, and in whose ways they would not walk, neither were they obedient unto his law.

title: Isaiah 42:25
text: Therefore he poured upon him the fierceness of his anger, and the strength of battle; and it set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.

title: Isaiah 43:1
text: But now thus saith Jehovah that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel: Fear not, for I have redeemed thee; I have called thee by thy name, thou art mine.

title: Isaiah 43:2
text: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned, neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

title: Isaiah 43:3
text: For I am Jehovah thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour; I have given Egypt as thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in thy stead.

title: Isaiah 43:4
text: Since thou hast been precious in my sight, [and] honorable, and I have loved thee; therefore will I give men in thy stead, and peoples instead of thy life.

title: Isaiah 43:5
text: Fear not; for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;

title: Isaiah 43:6
text: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back; bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the end of the earth;

title: Isaiah 43:7
text: every one that is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yea, whom I have made.

title: Isaiah 43:8
text: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.

title: Isaiah 43:9
text: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled: who among them can declare this, and show us former things? let them bring their witnesses, that they may be justified; or let them hear, and say, It is truth.

title: Isaiah 43:10
text: Ye are my witnesses, saith Jehovah, and my servant whom I have chosen; that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.

title: Isaiah 43:11
text: I, even I, am Jehovah; and besides me there is no saviour.

title: Isaiah 43:12
text: I have declared, and I have saved, and I have showed; and there was no strange [god] among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, saith Jehovah, and I am God.

title: Isaiah 43:13
text: Yea, since the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who can hinder it?

title: Isaiah 43:14
text: Thus saith Jehovah, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring down all of them as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.

title: Isaiah 43:15
text: I am Jehovah, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.

title: Isaiah 43:16
text: Thus saith Jehovah, who maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;

title: Isaiah 43:17
text: who bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the mighty man (they lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinct, they are quenched as a wick):

title: Isaiah 43:18
text: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.

title: Isaiah 43:19
text: Behold, I will do a new thing; now shall it spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

title: Isaiah 43:20
text: The beasts of the field shall honor me, the jackals and the ostriches; because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen,

title: Isaiah 43:21
text: the people which I formed for myself, that they might set forth my praise.

title: Isaiah 43:22
text: Yet thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.

title: Isaiah 43:23
text: Thou hast not brought me of thy sheep for burnt-offerings; neither hast thou honored me with thy sacrifices. I have not burdened thee with offerings, nor wearied thee with frankincense.

title: Isaiah 43:24
text: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices; but thou hast burdened me with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.

title: Isaiah 43:25
text: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake; and I will not remember thy sins.

title: Isaiah 43:26
text: Put me in remembrance; let us plead together: set thou forth [thy cause], that thou mayest be justified.

title: Isaiah 43:27
text: Thy first father sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.

title: Isaiah 43:28
text: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel a reviling.

title: Isaiah 44:1
text: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant, and Israel, who I have chosen:

title: Isaiah 44:2
text: Thus saith Jehovah that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, who will help thee: Fear not, O Jacob my servant; and thou, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

title: Isaiah 44:3
text: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and streams upon the dry ground; I will pour my Spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:

title: Isaiah 44:4
text: and they shall spring up among the grass, as willows by the watercourses.

title: Isaiah 44:5
text: One shall say, I am Jehovah's; and another shall call [himself] by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto Jehovah, and surname [himself] by the name of Israel.

title: Isaiah 44:6
text: Thus saith Jehovah, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, Jehovah of hosts: I am the first, and I am the last; and besides me there is no God.

title: Isaiah 44:7
text: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I established the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and that shall come to pass, let them declare.

title: Isaiah 44:8
text: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have I not declared unto thee of old, and showed it? and ye are my witnesses. Is there a God besides me? yea, there is no Rock; I know not any.

title: Isaiah 44:9
text: They that fashion a graven image are all of them vanity; and the things that they delight in shall not profit; and their own witnesses see not, nor know: that they may be put to shame.

title: Isaiah 44:10
text: Who hath fashioned a god, or molten an image that is profitable for nothing?

title: Isaiah 44:11
text: Behold, all his fellows shall be put to shame; and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; they shall fear, they shall be put to shame together.

title: Isaiah 44:12
text: The smith [maketh] an axe, and worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with his strong arm: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth; he drinketh no water, and is faint.

title: Isaiah 44:13
text: The carpenter stretcheth out a line; he marketh it out with a pencil; he shapeth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compasses, and shapeth it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man, to dwell in a house.

title: Isaiah 44:14
text: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the holm-tree and the oak, and strengtheneth for himself one among the trees of the forest: he planteth a fir-tree, and the rain doth nourish it.

title: Isaiah 44:15
text: Then shall it be for a man to burn; and he taketh thereof, and warmeth himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread: yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.

title: Isaiah 44:16
text: He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied; yea, he warmeth himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire.

title: Isaiah 44:17
text: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image; he falleth down unto it and worshippeth, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou art my god.

title: Isaiah 44:18
text: They know not, neither do they consider: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.

title: Isaiah 44:19
text: And none calleth to mind, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh and eaten it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?

title: Isaiah 44:20
text: He feedeth on ashes; a deceived heart hath turned him aside; and he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?

title: Isaiah 44:21
text: Remember these things, O Jacob, and Israel; for thou art my servant: I have formed thee; thou art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.

title: Isaiah 44:22
text: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.

title: Isaiah 44:23
text: Sing, O ye heavens, for Jehovah hath done it; shout, ye lower parts of the earth; break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for Jehovah hath redeemed Jacob, and will glorify himself in Israel.

title: Isaiah 44:24
text: Thus saith Jehovah, thy Redeemer, and he that formed thee from the womb: I am Jehovah, that maketh all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth (who is with me?);

title: Isaiah 44:25
text: that frustrateth the signs of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;

title: Isaiah 44:26
text: that confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith of Jerusalem, She shall be inhabited; and of the cities of Judah, They shall be built, and I will raise up the waste places thereof;

title: Isaiah 44:27
text: that saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers;

title: Isaiah 44:28
text: That saith of Cyrus, [He is] my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure, even saying of Jerusalem, She shall be built; and of the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.

title: Isaiah 45:1
text: Thus saith Jehovah to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him, and I will loose the loins of kings; to open the doors before him, and the gates shall not be shut:

title: Isaiah 45:2
text: I will go before thee, and make the rough places smooth; I will break in pieces the doors of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron;

title: Isaiah 45:3
text: and I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that it is I, Jehovah, who call thee by thy name, even the God of Israel.

title: Isaiah 45:4
text: For Jacob my servant's sake, and Israel my chosen, I have called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.

title: Isaiah 45:5
text: I am Jehovah, and there is none else; besides me there is no God. I will gird thee, though thou hast not known me;

title: Isaiah 45:6
text: that they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none besides me: I am Jehovah, and there is none else.

title: Isaiah 45:7
text: I form the light, and create darkness; I make peace, and create evil. I am Jehovah, that doeth all these things.

title: Isaiah 45:8
text: Distil, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, that it may bring forth salvation, and let it cause righteousness to spring up together; I, Jehovah, have created it.

title: Isaiah 45:9
text: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! a potsherd among the potsherds of the earth! Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?

title: Isaiah 45:10
text: Woe unto him that saith unto a father, What begettest thou? or to a woman, With what travailest thou?

title: Isaiah 45:11
text: Thus saith Jehovah, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker: Ask me of the things that are to come; concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands, command ye me.

title: Isaiah 45:12
text: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens; and all their host have I commanded.

title: Isaiah 45:13
text: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will make straight all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let my exiles go free, not for price nor reward, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Isaiah 45:14
text: Thus saith Jehovah, The labor of Egypt, and the merchandise of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall go after thee, in chains they shall come over; and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee, [saying], Surely God is in thee; and there is none else, there is no God.

title: Isaiah 45:15
text: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.

title: Isaiah 45:16
text: They shall be put to shame, yea, confounded, all of them; they shall go into confusion together that are makers of idols.

title: Isaiah 45:17
text: [ But] Israel shall be saved by Jehovah with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be put to shame nor confounded world without end.

title: Isaiah 45:18
text: For thus saith Jehovah that created the heavens, the God that formed the earth and made it, that established it and created it not a waste, that formed it to be inhabited: I am Jehovah; and there is none else.

title: Isaiah 45:19
text: I have not spoken in secret, in a place of the land of darkness; I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I, Jehovah, speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.

title: Isaiah 45:20
text: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that carry the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.

title: Isaiah 45:21
text: Declare ye, and bring [it] forth; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath showed this from ancient time? who hath declared it of old? have not I, Jehovah? and there is no God else besides me, a just God and a Saviour; there is none besides me.

title: Isaiah 45:22
text: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is none else.

title: Isaiah 45:23
text: By myself have I sworn, the word is gone forth from my mouth [in] righteousness, and shall not return, that unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.

title: Isaiah 45:24
text: Only in Jehovah, it is said of me, is righteousness and strength; even to him shall men come; and all they that were incensed against him shall be put to shame.

title: Isaiah 45:25
text: In Jehovah shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.

title: Isaiah 46:1
text: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth; their idols are upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: the things that ye carried about are made a load, a burden to the weary [beast] .

title: Isaiah 46:2
text: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.

title: Isaiah 46:3
text: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been borne [by me] from their birth, that have been carried from the womb;

title: Isaiah 46:4
text: and even to old age I am he, and even to hoar hairs will I carry [you] ; I have made, and I will bear; yea, I will carry, and will deliver.

title: Isaiah 46:5
text: To whom will ye like me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?

title: Isaiah 46:6
text: Such as lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, they hire a goldsmith, and he maketh it a god; they fall down, yea, they worship.

title: Isaiah 46:7
text: They bear it upon the shoulder, they carry it, and set it in its place, and it standeth, from its place shall it not remove: yea, one may cry unto it, yet can it not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.

title: Isaiah 46:8
text: Remember this, and show yourselves men; bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.

title: Isaiah 46:9
text: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; [I am] God, and there is none like me;

title: Isaiah 46:10
text: declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not [yet] done; saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure;

title: Isaiah 46:11
text: calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country; yea, I have spoken, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed, I will also do it.

title: Isaiah 46:12
text: Hearken unto me, ye stout-hearted, that are far from righteousness:

title: Isaiah 46:13
text: I bring near my righteousness, it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry; and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.

title: Isaiah 47:1
text: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon; sit on the ground without a throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.

title: Isaiah 47:2
text: Take the millstones, and grind meal; remove thy veil, strip off the train, uncover the leg, pass through the rivers.

title: Isaiah 47:3
text: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and will spare no man.

title: Isaiah 47:4
text: Our Redeemer, Jehovah of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.

title: Isaiah 47:5
text: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans; for thou shalt no more be called The mistress of kingdoms.

title: Isaiah 47:6
text: I was wroth with my people, I profaned mine inheritance, and gave them into thy hand: thou didst show them no mercy; upon the aged hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.

title: Isaiah 47:7
text: And thou saidst, I shall be mistress for ever; so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end thereof.

title: Isaiah 47:8
text: Now therefore hear this, thou that art given to pleasures, that sittest securely, that sayest in thy heart, I am, and there is none else besides me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:

title: Isaiah 47:9
text: but these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood; in their full measure shall they come upon thee, in the multitude of thy sorceries, and the great abundance of thine enchantments.

title: Isaiah 47:10
text: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness; thou hast said, None seeth me; thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee, and thou hast said in thy heart, I am, and there is none else besides me.

title: Isaiah 47:11
text: Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know the dawning thereof: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it away: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou knowest not.

title: Isaiah 47:12
text: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast labored from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.

title: Isaiah 47:13
text: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels: let now the astrologers, the star-gazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from the things that shall come upon thee.

title: Isaiah 47:14
text: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: it shall not be a coal to warm at, nor a fire to sit before.

title: Isaiah 47:15
text: Thus shall the things be unto thee wherein thou hast labored: they that have trafficked with thee from thy youth shall wander every one to his quarter; there shall be none to save thee.

title: Isaiah 48:1
text: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah; who swear by the name of Jehovah, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness

title: Isaiah 48:2
text: (for they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; Jehovah of hosts is his name):

title: Isaiah 48:3
text: I have declared the former things from of old; yea, they went forth out of my mouth, and I showed them: suddenly I did them, and they came to pass.

title: Isaiah 48:4
text: Because I knew that thou art obstinate, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;

title: Isaiah 48:5
text: therefore I have declared it to thee from of old; before it came to pass I showed it thee; lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.

title: Isaiah 48:6
text: Thou hast heard it; behold all this; and ye, will ye not declare it? I have showed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, which thou hast not known.

title: Isaiah 48:7
text: They are created now, and not from of old; and before this day thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.

title: Isaiah 48:8
text: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from of old thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou didst deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.

title: Isaiah 48:9
text: For my name's sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.

title: Isaiah 48:10
text: Behold, I have refined thee, but not as silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.

title: Isaiah 48:11
text: For mine own sake, for mine own sake, will I do it; for how should [my name] be profaned? and my glory will I not give to another.

title: Isaiah 48:12
text: Hearken unto me, O Jacob, and Israel my called: I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.

title: Isaiah 48:13
text: Yea, my hand hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spread out the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.

title: Isaiah 48:14
text: Assemble yourselves, all ye, and hear; who among them hath declared these things? He whom Jehovah loveth shall perform his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm [shall be on] the Chaldeans. [

title: Isaiah 48:15
text: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him; I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.

title: Isaiah 48:16
text: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; from the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord Jehovah hath sent me, and his Spirit.

title: Isaiah 48:17
text: Thus saith Jehovah, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: I am Jehovah thy God, who teacheth thee to profit, who leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.

title: Isaiah 48:18
text: Oh that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:

title: Isaiah 48:19
text: thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the grains thereof: his name would not be cut off nor destroyed from before me.

title: Isaiah 48:20
text: Go ye forth from Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans; with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth: say ye, Jehovah hath redeemed his servant Jacob.

title: Isaiah 48:21
text: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts; he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them; he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.

title: Isaiah 48:22
text: There is no peace, saith Jehovah, to the wicked.

title: Isaiah 49:1
text: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye peoples, from far: Jehovah hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name:

title: Isaiah 49:2
text: and he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me: and he hath made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he kept me close:

title: Isaiah 49:3
text: and he said unto me, Thou art my servant; Israel, in whom I will be glorified.

title: Isaiah 49:4
text: But I said, I have labored in vain, I have spent my strength for nought and vanity; yet surely the justice [due] to me is with Jehovah, and my recompense with my God.

title: Isaiah 49:5
text: And now saith Jehovah that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, and that Israel be gathered unto him (for I am honorable in the eyes of Jehovah, and my God is become my strength);

title: Isaiah 49:6
text: yea, he saith, It is too light a thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

title: Isaiah 49:7
text: Thus saith Jehovah, the Redeemer of Israel, [and] his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers: Kings shall see and arise; princes, and they shall worship; because of Jehovah that is faithful, [even] the Holy One of Israel, who hath chosen thee.

title: Isaiah 49:8
text: Thus saith Jehovah, In an acceptable time have I answered thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee; and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to raise up the land, to make them inherit the desolate heritages:

title: Isaiah 49:9
text: saying to them that are bound, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Show yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and on all bare heights shall be their pasture.

title: Isaiah 49:10
text: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them will lead them, even by springs of water will he guide them.

title: Isaiah 49:11
text: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.

title: Isaiah 49:12
text: Lo, these shall come from far; and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.

title: Isaiah 49:13
text: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for Jehovah hath comforted his people, and will have compassion upon his afflicted.

title: Isaiah 49:14
text: But Zion said, Jehovah hath forsaken me, and the Lord hath forgotten me.

title: Isaiah 49:15
text: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, these may forget, yet will not I forget thee.

title: Isaiah 49:16
text: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.

title: Isaiah 49:17
text: Thy children make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth from thee.

title: Isaiah 49:18
text: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to thee. As I live, saith Jehovah, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all as with an ornament, and gird thyself with them, like a bride.

title: Isaiah 49:19
text: For, as for thy waste and thy desolate places, and thy land that hath been destroyed, surely now shalt thou be too strait for the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.

title: Isaiah 49:20
text: The children of thy bereavement shall yet say in thine ears, The place is too strait for me; give place to me that I may dwell.

title: Isaiah 49:21
text: Then shalt thou say in thy heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have been bereaved of my children, and am solitary, an exile, and wandering to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where were they?

title: Isaiah 49:22
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I will lift up my hand to the nations, and set up my ensign to the peoples; and they shall bring thy sons in their bosom, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.

title: Isaiah 49:23
text: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their faces to the earth, and lick the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah; and they that wait for me shall not be put to shame.

title: Isaiah 49:24
text: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captives be delivered?

title: Isaiah 49:25
text: But thus saith Jehovah, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered; for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.

title: Isaiah 49:26
text: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I, Jehovah, am thy Saviour, and thy Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

title: Isaiah 50:1
text: Thus saith Jehovah, Where is the bill of your mother's divorcement, wherewith I have put her away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities were ye sold, and for your transgressions was your mother put away.

title: Isaiah 50:2
text: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? Behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stink, because there is no water, and die for thirst.

title: Isaiah 50:3
text: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.

title: Isaiah 50:4
text: The Lord Jehovah hath given me the tongue of them that are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as they that are taught.

title: Isaiah 50:5
text: The Lord Jehovah hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away backward.

title: Isaiah 50:6
text: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair; I hid not my face from shame and spitting.

title: Isaiah 50:7
text: For the Lord Jehovah will help me; therefore have I not been confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be put to shame.

title: Isaiah 50:8
text: He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand up together: who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.

title: Isaiah 50:9
text: Behold, the Lord Jehovah will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? behold, all they shall wax old as a garment, the moth shall eat them up.

title: Isaiah 50:10
text: Who is among you that feareth Jehovah, that obeyeth the voice of his servant? he that walketh in darkness, and hath no light, let him trust in the name of Jehovah, and rely upon his God.

title: Isaiah 50:11
text: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that gird yourselves about with firebrands; walk ye in the flame of your fire, and among the brands that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of my hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.

title: Isaiah 51:1
text: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek Jehovah: look unto the rock whence ye were hewn, and to the hole of the pit whence ye were digged.

title: Isaiah 51:2
text: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you; for when he was but one I called him, and I blessed him, and made him many.

title: Isaiah 51:3
text: For Jehovah hath comforted Zion; he hath comforted all her waste places, and hath made her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of Jehovah; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

title: Isaiah 51:4
text: Attend unto me, O my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall go forth from me, and I will establish my justice for a light of the peoples.

title: Isaiah 51:5
text: My righteousness is near, my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms shall judge the peoples; the isles shall wait for me, and on mine arm shall they trust.

title: Isaiah 51:6
text: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath; for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment; and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.

title: Isaiah 51:7
text: Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye dismayed at their revilings.

title: Isaiah 51:8
text: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool; but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation unto all generations.

title: Isaiah 51:9
text: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of Jehovah; awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Is it not thou that didst cut Rahab in pieces, that didst pierce the monster?

title: Isaiah 51:10
text: Is it not thou that driedst up the sea, the waters of the great deep; that madest the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed to pass over?

title: Isaiah 51:11
text: And the ransomed of Jehovah shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their heads: they shall obtain gladness and joy; [and] sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

title: Isaiah 51:12
text: I, even I, am he that comforteth you: who art thou, that thou art afraid of man that shall die, and of the son of man that shall be made as grass;

title: Isaiah 51:13
text: and hast forgotten Jehovah thy Maker, that stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and fearest continually all the day because of the fury of the oppressor, when he maketh ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?

title: Isaiah 51:14
text: The captive exile shall speedily be loosed; and he shall not die [and go down] into the pit, neither shall his bread fail.

title: Isaiah 51:15
text: For I am Jehovah thy God, who stirreth up the sea, so that the waves thereof roar: Jehovah of hosts is his name.

title: Isaiah 51:16
text: And I have put my words in thy mouth, and have covered thee in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou art my people.

title: Isaiah 51:17
text: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, that hast drunk at the hand of Jehovah the cup of his wrath; thou hast drunken the bowl of the cup of staggering, and drained it.

title: Isaiah 51:18
text: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand among all the sons that she hath brought up.

title: Isaiah 51:19
text: These two things are befallen thee, who shall bemoan thee? desolation and destruction, and the famine and the sword; how shall I comfort thee?

title: Isaiah 51:20
text: Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as an antelope in a net; they are full of the wrath of Jehovah, the rebuke of thy God.

title: Isaiah 51:21
text: Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but now with wine:

title: Isaiah 51:22
text: Thus saith thy Lord Jehovah, and thy God that pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of thy hand the cup of staggering, even the bowl of the cup of my wrath; thou shalt no more drink it again:

title: Isaiah 51:23
text: and I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee, that have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over; and thou hast laid thy back as the ground, and as the street, to them that go over.

title: Isaiah 52:1
text: Awake, awake, put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.

title: Isaiah 52:2
text: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, sit [on thy throne], O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bonds of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.

title: Isaiah 52:3
text: For thus saith Jehovah, Ye were sold for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.

title: Isaiah 52:4
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah, My people went down at the first into Egypt to sojourn there: and the Assyrian hath oppressed them without cause.

title: Isaiah 52:5
text: Now therefore, what do I here, saith Jehovah, seeing that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them do howl, saith Jehovah, and my name continually all the day is blasphemed.

title: Isaiah 52:6
text: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore [they shall know] in that day that I am he that doth speak; behold, it is I.

title: Isaiah 52:7
text: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace, that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation, that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!

title: Isaiah 52:8
text: The voice of thy watchmen! they lift up the voice, together do they sing; for they shall see eye to eye, when Jehovah returneth to Zion.

title: Isaiah 52:9
text: Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem; for Jehovah hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.

title: Isaiah 52:10
text: Jehovah hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

title: Isaiah 52:11
text: Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean thing; go ye out of the midst of her; cleanse yourselves, ye that bear the vessels of Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 52:12
text: For ye shall not go out in haste, neither shall ye go by flight: for Jehovah will go before you; and the God of Israel will be your rearward.

title: Isaiah 52:13
text: Behold, my servant shall deal wisely, he shall be exalted and lifted up, and shall be very high.

title: Isaiah 52:14
text: Like as many were astonished at thee (his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men),

title: Isaiah 52:15
text: so shall he sprinkle many nations; kings shall shut their mouths at him: for that which had not been told them shall they see; and that which they had not heard shall they understand.

title: Isaiah 53:1
text: Who hath believed our message? and to whom hath the arm of Jehovah been revealed?

title: Isaiah 53:2
text: For he grew up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.

title: Isaiah 53:3
text: He was despised, and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and as one from whom men hide their face he was despised; and we esteemed him not.

title: Isaiah 53:4
text: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows; yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.

title: Isaiah 53:5
text: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities; the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

title: Isaiah 53:6
text: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and Jehovah hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.

title: Isaiah 53:7
text: He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he opened not his mouth; as a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a sheep that before its shearers is dumb, so he opened not his mouth.

title: Isaiah 53:8
text: By oppression and judgment he was taken away; and as for his generation, who [among them] considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living for the transgression of my people to whom the stroke [was due] ?

title: Isaiah 53:9
text: And they made his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his death; although he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth.

title: Isaiah 53:10
text: Yet it pleased Jehovah to bruise him; he hath put him to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see [his] seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of Jehovah shall prosper in his hand.

title: Isaiah 53:11
text: He shall see of the travail of his soul, [and] shall be satisfied: by the knowledge of himself shall my righteous servant justify many; and he shall bear their iniquities.

title: Isaiah 53:12
text: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he poured out his soul unto death, and was numbered with the transgressors: yet he bare the sin of many, and [ made intercession for the transgressors.

title: Isaiah 54:1
text: Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 54:2
text: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thy habitations; spare not: lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes.

title: Isaiah 54:3
text: For thou shalt spread abroad on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall possess the nations, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.

title: Isaiah 54:4
text: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth; and the reproach of thy widowhood shalt thou remember no more.

title: Isaiah 54:5
text: For thy Maker is thy husband; Jehovah of hosts is his name: and the Holy One of Israel is thy Redeemer; the God of the whole earth shall he be called.

title: Isaiah 54:6
text: For Jehovah hath called thee as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, even a wife of youth, when she is cast off, saith thy God.

title: Isaiah 54:7
text: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.

title: Isaiah 54:8
text: In overflowing wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting lovingkindness will I have mercy on thee, saith Jehovah thy Redeemer.

title: Isaiah 54:9
text: For this is [as] the waters of Noah unto me; for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah shall no more go over the earth, so have I sworn that I will not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.

title: Isaiah 54:10
text: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed; but my lovingkindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall my covenant of peace be removed, saith Jehovah that hath mercy on thee.

title: Isaiah 54:11
text: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will set thy stones in fair colors, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.

title: Isaiah 54:12
text: And I will make thy pinnacles of rubies, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy border of precious stones.

title: Isaiah 54:13
text: And all thy children shall be taught of Jehovah; and great shall be the peace of thy children.

title: Isaiah 54:14
text: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression, for thou shalt not fear; and from terror, for it shall not come near thee.

title: Isaiah 54:15
text: Behold, they may gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall because of thee.

title: Isaiah 54:16
text: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the fire of coals, and bringeth forth a weapon for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.

title: Isaiah 54:17
text: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of Jehovah, and their righteousness which is of me, saith Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 55:1
text: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

title: Isaiah 55:2
text: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread? and your labor for that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.

title: Isaiah 55:3
text: Incline your ear, and come unto me; hear, and your soul shall live: and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.

title: Isaiah 55:4
text: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander to the peoples.

title: Isaiah 55:5
text: Behold, thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not; and a nation that knew not thee shall run unto thee, because of Jehovah thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.

title: Isaiah 55:6
text: Seek ye Jehovah while he may be found; call ye upon him while he is near:

title: Isaiah 55:7
text: let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts; and let him return unto Jehovah, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.

title: Isaiah 55:8
text: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 55:9
text: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

title: Isaiah 55:10
text: For as the rain cometh down and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, and giveth seed to the sower and bread to the eater;

title: Isaiah 55:11
text: so shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.

title: Isaiah 55:12
text: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing; and all the trees of the fields shall clap their hands.

title: Isaiah 55:13
text: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir-tree; and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle-tree: and it shall be to Jehovah for a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.

title: Isaiah 56:1
text: Thus saith Jehovah, Keep ye justice, and do righteousness; for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.

title: Isaiah 56:2
text: Blessed is the man that doeth this, and the son of man that holdeth it fast; that keepeth the sabbath from profaning it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.

title: Isaiah 56:3
text: Neither let the foreigner, that hath joined himself to Jehovah, speak, saying, Jehovah will surely separate me from his people; neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.

title: Isaiah 56:4
text: For thus saith Jehovah of the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose the things that please me, and hold fast my covenant:

title: Isaiah 56:5
text: Unto them will I give in my house and within my walls a memorial and a name better than of sons and of daughters; I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.

title: Isaiah 56:6
text: Also the foreigners that join themselves to Jehovah, to minister unto him, and to love the name of Jehovah, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from profaning it, and holdeth fast my covenant;

title: Isaiah 56:7
text: even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt-offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for my house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples.

title: Isaiah 56:8
text: The Lord Jehovah, who gathereth the outcasts of Israel, saith, Yet will I gather [others] to him, besides his own that are gathered.

title: Isaiah 56:9
text: All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, [yea], all ye beasts in the forest.

title: Isaiah 56:10
text: His watchmen are blind, they are all without knowledge; they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber.

title: Isaiah 56:11
text: Yea, the dogs are greedy, they can never have enough; and these are shepherds that cannot understand: they have all turned to their own way, each one to his gain, from every quarter.

title: Isaiah 56:12
text: Come ye, [say they], I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to-morrow shall be as this day, [a day] great beyond measure.

title: Isaiah 57:1
text: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart; and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil [to come] .

title: Isaiah 57:2
text: He entereth into peace; they rest in their beds, each one that walketh in his uprightness.

title: Isaiah 57:3
text: But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the harlot.

title: Isaiah 57:4
text: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and put out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,

title: Isaiah 57:5
text: ye that inflame yourselves among the oaks, under every green tree; that slay the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?

title: Isaiah 57:6
text: Among the smooth [stones] of the valley is thy portion; they, they are thy lot; even to them hast thou poured a drink-offering, thou hast offered an oblation. Shall I be appeased for these things?

title: Isaiah 57:7
text: Upon a high and lofty mountain hast thou set thy bed; thither also wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.

title: Isaiah 57:8
text: And behind the doors and the posts hast thou set up thy memorial: for thou hast uncovered [thyself] to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee a covenant with them: thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it.

title: Isaiah 57:9
text: And thou wentest to the king with oil, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thine ambassadors far off, and didst debase thyself even unto Sheol.

title: Isaiah 57:10
text: Thou wast wearied with the length of thy way; yet saidst thou not, It is in vain: thou didst find a quickening of thy strength; therefore thou wast not faint.

title: Isaiah 57:11
text: And of whom hast thou been afraid and in fear, that thou liest, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of long time, and thou fearest me not?

title: Isaiah 57:12
text: I will declare thy righteousness; and as for thy works, they shall not profit thee.

title: Isaiah 57:13
text: When thou criest, let them that thou hast gathered deliver thee; but the wind shall take them, a breath shall carry them all away: but he that taketh refuge in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain.

title: Isaiah 57:14
text: And he will say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumbling-block out of the way of my people.

title: Isaiah 57:15
text: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy: I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.

title: Isaiah 57:16
text: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls that I have made.

title: Isaiah 57:17
text: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him; I hid [my face] and was wroth; and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.

title: Isaiah 57:18
text: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.

title: Isaiah 57:19
text: I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him that is far off and to him that is near, saith Jehovah; and I will heal him.

title: Isaiah 57:20
text: But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it cannot rest, and its waters cast up mire and dirt.

title: Isaiah 57:21
text: There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.

title: Isaiah 58:1
text: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and declare unto my people their transgression, and to the house of Jacob their sins.

title: Isaiah 58:2
text: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways: as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God, they ask of me righteous judgments; they delight to draw near unto God.

title: Isaiah 58:3
text: Wherefore have we fasted, [say they], and thou seest not? [wherefore] have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find [your own] pleasure, and exact all your labors.

title: Isaiah 58:4
text: Behold, ye fast for strife and contention, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye fast not this day so as to make your voice to be heard on high.

title: Isaiah 58:5
text: Is such the fast that I have chosen? the day for a man to afflict his soul? Is it to bow down his head as a rush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to Jehovah?

title: Isaiah 58:6
text: Is not this the fast that I have chosen: to loose the bonds of wickedness, to undo the bands of the yoke, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?

title: Isaiah 58:7
text: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?

title: Isaiah 58:8
text: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thy healing shall spring forth speedily; and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of Jehovah shall by thy rearward.

title: Isaiah 58:9
text: Then shalt thou call, and Jehovah will answer; thou shalt cry, and he will say, Here I am. If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking wickedly;

title: Isaiah 58:10
text: and if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul: then shall thy light rise in darkness, and thine obscurity be as the noonday;

title: Isaiah 58:11
text: and Jehovah will guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in dry places, and make strong thy bones; and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.

title: Isaiah 58:12
text: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places; thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.

title: Isaiah 58:13
text: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, [and] the holy of Jehovah honorable; and shalt honor it, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking [thine own] words:

title: Isaiah 58:14
text: then shalt thou delight thyself in Jehovah; and I will make thee to ride upon the high places of the earth; and I will feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of Jehovah hath spoken it.

title: Isaiah 59:1
text: Behold, Jehovah's hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:

title: Isaiah 59:2
text: but your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, so that he will not hear.

title: Isaiah 59:3
text: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue muttereth wickedness.

title: Isaiah 59:4
text: None sueth in righteousness, and none pleadeth in truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.

title: Isaiah 59:5
text: They hatch adders' eggs, and weave the spider's web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth; and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.

title: Isaiah 59:6
text: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.

title: Isaiah 59:7
text: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; desolation and destruction are in their paths.

title: Isaiah 59:8
text: The way of peace they know not; and there is no justice in their goings: they have made them crooked paths; whosoever goeth therein doth not know peace.

title: Isaiah 59:9
text: Therefore is justice far from us, neither doth righteousness overtake us: we look for light, but, behold, darkness; for brightness, but we walk in obscurity.

title: Isaiah 59:10
text: We grope for the wall like the blind; yea, we grope as they that have no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the twilight; among them that are lusty we are as dead men.

title: Isaiah 59:11
text: We roar all like bears, and moan sore like doves: we look for justice, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.

title: Isaiah 59:12
text: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:

title: Isaiah 59:13
text: transgressing and denying Jehovah, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

title: Isaiah 59:14
text: And justice is turned away backward, and righteousness standeth afar off; for truth is fallen in the street, and uprightness cannot enter.

title: Isaiah 59:15
text: Yea, truth is lacking; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey. And Jehovah saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice.

title: Isaiah 59:16
text: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his own arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it upheld him.

title: Isaiah 59:17
text: And he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a mantle.

title: Isaiah 59:18
text: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompense.

title: Isaiah 59:19
text: So shall they fear the name of Jehovah from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come as a rushing stream, which the breath of Jehovah driveth.

title: Isaiah 59:20
text: And a Redeemer will come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 59:21
text: And as for me, this is my covenant with them, saith Jehovah: my Spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed's seed, saith Jehovah, from henceforth and for ever.

title: Isaiah 60:1
text: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of Jehovah is risen upon thee.

title: Isaiah 60:2
text: For, behold, darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the peoples; but Jehovah will arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.

title: Isaiah 60:3
text: And nations shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.

title: Isaiah 60:4
text: Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: they all gather themselves together, they come to thee; thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be carried in the arms.

title: Isaiah 60:5
text: Then thou shalt see and be radiant, and thy heart shall thrill and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be turned unto thee, the wealth of the nations shall come unto thee.

title: Isaiah 60:6
text: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come; they shall bring gold and frankincense, and shall proclaim the praises of Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 60:7
text: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee; they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar; and I will glorify the house of my glory.

title: Isaiah 60:8
text: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?

title: Isaiah 60:9
text: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, for the name of Jehovah thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel, because he hath [ glorified thee.

title: Isaiah 60:10
text: And foreigners shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favor have I had mercy on thee.

title: Isaiah 60:11
text: Thy gates also shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the wealth of the nations, and their kings led captive.

title: Isaiah 60:12
text: For that nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.

title: Isaiah 60:13
text: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir-tree, the pine, and the box-tree together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.

title: Isaiah 60:14
text: And the sons of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee The city of Jehovah, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

title: Isaiah 60:15
text: Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man passed through thee, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.

title: Isaiah 60:16
