text: and I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants; and afterwards it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 46:27
text: But fear not thou, O Jacob my servant, neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be quiet and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.

title: Jeremiah 46:28
text: Fear not thou, O Jacob my servant, saith Jehovah; for I am with thee: for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee; but I will not make a full end of thee, but I will correct thee in measure, and will in no wise leave thee unpunished.

title: Jeremiah 47:1
text: The word of Jehovah that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.

title: Jeremiah 47:2
text: Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall become an overflowing stream, and shall overflow the land and all that is therein, the city and them that dwell therein; and the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall wail.

title: Jeremiah 47:3
text: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong ones, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers look not back to their children for feebleness of hands;

title: Jeremiah 47:4
text: because of the day that cometh to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper that remaineth: for Jehovah will destroy the Philistines, the remnant of the isle of Caphtor.

title: Jeremiah 47:5
text: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nought, the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?

title: Jeremiah 47:6
text: O thou sword of Jehovah, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard; rest, and be still.

title: Jeremiah 47:7
text: How canst thou be quiet, seeing Jehovah hath given thee a charge? Against Ashkelon, and against the sea-shore, there hath he appointed it.

title: Jeremiah 48:1
text: Of Moab. Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Woe unto Nebo! for it is laid waste; Kiriathaim is put to shame, it is taken; Misgab is put to shame and broken down.

title: Jeremiah 48:2
text: The praise of Moab is no more; in Heshbon they have devised evil against her: Come, and let us cut her off from being a nation. Thou also, O Madmen, shalt be brought to silence: the sword shall pursue thee.

title: Jeremiah 48:3
text: The sound of a cry from Horonaim, desolation and great destruction!

title: Jeremiah 48:4
text: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

title: Jeremiah 48:5
text: For by the ascent of Luhith with continual weeping shall they go up; for at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distress of the cry of destruction.

title: Jeremiah 48:6
text: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.

title: Jeremiah 48:7
text: For, because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou also shalt be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

title: Jeremiah 48:8
text: And the destroyer shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape; the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed; as Jehovah hath spoken.

title: Jeremiah 48:9
text: Give wings unto Moab, that she may fly and get her away: and her cities shall become a desolation, without any to dwell therein.

title: Jeremiah 48:10
text: Cursed be he that doeth the work of Jehovah negligently; and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.

title: Jeremiah 48:11
text: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remaineth in him, and his scent is not changed.

title: Jeremiah 48:12
text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that I will send unto him them that pour off, and they shall pour him off; and they shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles in pieces.

title: Jeremiah 48:13
text: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Beth-el their confidence.

title: Jeremiah 48:14
text: How say ye, We are mighty men, and valiant men for the war?

title: Jeremiah 48:15
text: Moab is laid waste, and they are gone up into his cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name is Jehovah of hosts.

title: Jeremiah 48:16
text: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.

title: Jeremiah 48:17
text: All ye that are round about him, bemoan him, and all ye that know his name; say, How is the strong staff broken, the beautiful rod!

title: Jeremiah 48:18
text: O thou daughter that dwellest in Dibon, come down from thy glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab is come up against thee, he hath destroyed thy strongholds.

title: Jeremiah 48:19
text: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and watch: ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth; say, What hath been done?

title: Jeremiah 48:20
text: Moab is put to shame; for it is broken down: wail and cry; tell ye it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.

title: Jeremiah 48:21
text: And judgment is come upon the plain country, upon Holon, and upon Jahzah, and upon Mephaath,

title: Jeremiah 48:22
text: and upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Beth-diblathaim,

title: Jeremiah 48:23
text: and upon Kiriathaim, and upon Beth-gamul, and upon Beth-meon,

title: Jeremiah 48:24
text: and upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

title: Jeremiah 48:25
text: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 48:26
text: Make ye him drunken; for he magnified himself against Jehovah: and Moab shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.

title: Jeremiah 48:27
text: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? was he found among thieves? for as often as thou speakest of him, thou waggest the head.

title: Jeremiah 48:28
text: O ye inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock; and be like the dove that maketh her nest over the mouth of the abyss.

title: Jeremiah 48:29
text: We have heard of the pride of Moab, [that] he is very proud; his loftiness, and his pride, and his arrogancy, and the haughtiness of his heart.

title: Jeremiah 48:30
text: I know his wrath, saith Jehovah, that it is nought; his boastings have wrought nothing.

title: Jeremiah 48:31
text: Therefore will I wail for Moab; yea, I will cry out for all Moab: for the men of Kir-heres shall they mourn.

title: Jeremiah 48:32
text: With more than the weeping of Jazer will I weep for thee, O vine of Sibmah: thy branches passed over the sea, they reached even to the sea of Jazer: upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage the destroyer is fallen.

title: Jeremiah 48:33
text: And gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to cease from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; the shouting shall be no shouting.

title: Jeremiah 48:34
text: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, even unto Jahaz have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, to Eglath-shelishiyah: for the waters of Nimrim also shall become desolate.

title: Jeremiah 48:35
text: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith Jehovah, him that offereth in the high place, and him that burneth incense to his gods.

title: Jeremiah 48:36
text: Therefore my heart soundeth for Moab like pipes, and my heart soundeth like pipes for the men of Kir-heres: therefore the abundance that he hath gotten is perished.

title: Jeremiah 48:37
text: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands are cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.

title: Jeremiah 48:38
text: On all the housetops of Moab and in the streets thereof there is lamentation every where; for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein none delighteth, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 48:39
text: How is it broken down! [how] do they wail! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab become a derision and a terror to all that are round about him.

title: Jeremiah 48:40
text: For thus saith Jehovah: Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread out his wings against Moab.

title: Jeremiah 48:41
text: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized, and the heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

title: Jeremiah 48:42
text: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 48:43
text: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 48:44
text: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon him, even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 48:45
text: They that fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon; for a fire is gone forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and hath devoured the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.

title: Jeremiah 48:46
text: Woe unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh is undone; for thy sons are taken away captive, and thy daughters into captivity.

title: Jeremiah 48:47
text: Yet will I bring back the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith Jehovah. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.

title: Jeremiah 49:1
text: Of the children of Ammon. Thus saith Jehovah: Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth Malcam possess Gad, and his people dwell in the cities thereof?

title: Jeremiah 49:2
text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard against Rabbah of the children of Ammon; and it shall become a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel possess them that did possess him, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 49:3
text: Wail, O Heshbon, for Ai is laid waste; cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth: lament, and run to and fro among the fences; for Malcam shall go into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

title: Jeremiah 49:4
text: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, [saying], Who shall come unto me?

title: Jeremiah 49:5
text: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, from all that are round about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth, and there shall be none to gather together the fugitives.

title: Jeremiah 49:6
text: But afterward I will bring back the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 49:7
text: Of Edom. Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?

title: Jeremiah 49:8
text: Flee ye, turn back, dwell in the depths, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I shall visit him.

title: Jeremiah 49:9
text: If grape-gatherers came to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, would they not destroy till they had enough?

title: Jeremiah 49:10
text: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is destroyed, and his brethren, and his neighbors; and he is not.

title: Jeremiah 49:11
text: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.

title: Jeremiah 49:12
text: For thus saith Jehovah: Behold, they to whom it pertained not to drink of the cup shall assuredly drink; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink.

title: Jeremiah 49:13
text: For I have sworn by myself, saith Jehovah, that Bozrah shall become an astonishment, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.

title: Jeremiah 49:14
text: I have heard tidings from Jehovah, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, [saying], Gather yourselves together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.

title: Jeremiah 49:15
text: For, behold, I have made thee small among the nations, and despised among men.

title: Jeremiah 49:16
text: As for thy terribleness, the pride of thy heart hath deceived thee, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 49:17
text: And Edom shall become an astonishment: every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.

title: Jeremiah 49:18
text: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbor cities thereof, saith Jehovah, no man shall dwell there, neither shall any son of man sojourn therein.

title: Jeremiah 49:19
text: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation: for I will suddenly make them run away from it; and whoso is chosen, him will I appoint over it: for who is like me? and who will appoint me a time? and who is the shepherd that will stand before me?

title: Jeremiah 49:20
text: Therefore hear ye the counsel of Jehovah, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely they shall drag them away, [even] the little ones of the flock; surely he shall make their habitation desolate over them.

title: Jeremiah 49:21
text: The earth trembleth at the noise of their fall; there is a cry, the noise whereof is heard in the Red Sea.

title: Jeremiah 49:22
text: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread out his wings against Bozrah: and the heart of the mighty men of Edom at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

title: Jeremiah 49:23
text: Of Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad; for they have heard evil tidings, they are melted away: there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.

title: Jeremiah 49:24
text: Damascus is waxed feeble, she turneth herself to flee, and trembling hath seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken hold of her, as of a woman in travail.

title: Jeremiah 49:25
text: How is the city of praise not forsaken, the city of my joy?

title: Jeremiah 49:26
text: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be brought to silence in that day, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Jeremiah 49:27
text: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall devour the palaces of Ben-hadad.

title: Jeremiah 49:28
text: Of Kedar, and of the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote. Thus saith Jehovah: Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and destroy the children of the east.

title: Jeremiah 49:29
text: Their tents and their flocks shall they take; they shall carry away for themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Terror on every side!

title: Jeremiah 49:30
text: Flee ye, wander far off, dwell in the depths, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith Jehovah; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.

title: Jeremiah 49:31
text: Arise, get you up unto a nation that is at ease, that dwelleth without care, saith Jehovah; that have neither gates nor bars, that dwell alone.

title: Jeremiah 49:32
text: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter unto all winds them that have the corners [of their hair] cut off; and I will bring their calamity from every side of them, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 49:33
text: And Hazor shall be a dwelling-place of jackals, a desolation for ever: no man shall dwell there, neither shall any son of man sojourn therein.

title: Jeremiah 49:34
text: The word of Jehovah that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 49:35
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

title: Jeremiah 49:36
text: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.

title: Jeremiah 49:37
text: And I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life; and I will bring evil upon them, even my fierce anger, saith Jehovah; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them;

title: Jeremiah 49:38
text: and I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence king and princes, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 49:39
text: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring back the captivity of Elam, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 50:1
text: The word that Jehovah spake concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, by Jeremiah the prophet.

title: Jeremiah 50:2
text: Declare ye among the nations and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is put to shame, Merodach is dismayed; her images are put to shame, her idols are dismayed.

title: Jeremiah 50:3
text: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they are fled, they are gone, both man and beast.

title: Jeremiah 50:4
text: In those days, and in that time, saith Jehovah, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together; they shall go on their way weeping, and shall seek Jehovah their God.

title: Jeremiah 50:5
text: They shall inquire concerning Zion with their faces thitherward, [saying], Come ye, and join yourselves to Jehovah in an everlasting covenant that shall not be forgotten.

title: Jeremiah 50:6
text: My people have been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray; they have turned them away on the mountains; they have gone from mountain to hill; they have forgotten their resting-place.

title: Jeremiah 50:7
text: All that found them have devoured them; and their adversaries said, We are not guilty, because they have sinned against Jehovah, the habitation of righteousness, even Jehovah, the hope of their fathers.

title: Jeremiah 50:8
text: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he-goats before the flocks.

title: Jeremiah 50:9
text: For, lo, I will stir up and cause to come up against Babylon a company of great nations from the north country; and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of an expert mighty man; none shall return in vain.

title: Jeremiah 50:10
text: And Chaldea shall be a prey: all that prey upon her shall be satisfied, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 50:11
text: Because ye are glad, because ye rejoice, O ye that plunder my heritage, because ye are wanton as a heifer that treadeth out [the grain], and neigh as strong horses;

title: Jeremiah 50:12
text: your mother shall be utterly put to shame; she that bare you shall be confounded: behold, she shall be the hindermost of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

title: Jeremiah 50:13
text: Because of the wrath of Jehovah she shall not be inhabited, but she shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.

title: Jeremiah 50:14
text: Set yourselves in array against Babylon round about, all ye that bend the bow; shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 50:15
text: Shout against her round about: she hath submitted herself; her bulwarks are fallen, her walls are thrown down; for it is the vengeance of Jehovah: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.

title: Jeremiah 50:16
text: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.

title: Jeremiah 50:17
text: Israel is a hunted sheep; the lions have driven him away: first, the king of Assyria devoured him; and now at last Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.

title: Jeremiah 50:18
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.

title: Jeremiah 50:19
text: And I will bring Israel again to his pasture, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead.

title: Jeremiah 50:20
text: In those days, and in that time, saith Jehovah, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I leave as a remnant.

title: Jeremiah 50:21
text: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: slay and utterly destroy after them, saith Jehovah, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.

title: Jeremiah 50:22
text: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.

title: Jeremiah 50:23
text: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!

title: Jeremiah 50:24
text: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 50:25
text: Jehovah hath opened his armory, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation; for the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, hath a work [to do] in the land of the Chaldeans.

title: Jeremiah 50:26
text: Come against her from the utmost border; open her store-houses; cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly; let nothing of her be left. [

title: Jeremiah 50:27
text: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.

title: Jeremiah 50:28
text: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of Jehovah our God, the vengeance of his temple.

title: Jeremiah 50:29
text: Call together the archers against Babylon, all them that bend the bow; encamp against her round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her; for she hath been proud against Jehovah, against the Holy One of Israel.

title: Jeremiah 50:30
text: Therefore shall her young men fall in her streets, and all her men of war shall be brought to silence in that day, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 50:31
text: Behold, I am against thee, O thou proud one, saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts; for thy day is come, the time that I will visit thee.

title: Jeremiah 50:32
text: And the proud one shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up; and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all that are round about him.

title: Jeremiah 50:33
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: The children of Israel and the children of Judah are oppressed together; and all that took them captive hold them fast; they refuse to let them go.

title: Jeremiah 50:34
text: Their Redeemer is strong; Jehovah of hosts is his name: he will thoroughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the earth, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 50:35
text: A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith Jehovah, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.

title: Jeremiah 50:36
text: A sword is upon the boasters, and they shall become fools; a sword is upon her mighty men, and they shall be dismayed.

title: Jeremiah 50:37
text: A sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword is upon her treasures, and they shall be robbed.

title: Jeremiah 50:38
text: A drought is upon her waters, and they shall be dried up; for it is a land of graven images, and they are mad over idols.

title: Jeremiah 50:39
text: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wolves shall dwell there, and the ostriches shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.

title: Jeremiah 50:40
text: As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbor cities thereof, saith Jehovah, so shall no man dwell there, neither shall any son of man sojourn therein.

title: Jeremiah 50:41
text: Behold, a people cometh from the north; and a great nation and many kings shall be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

title: Jeremiah 50:42
text: They lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, every one set in array, as a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 50:43
text: The king of Babylon hath heard the tidings of them, and his hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of him, [and] pangs as of a woman in travail.

title: Jeremiah 50:44
text: Behold, [the enemy] shall come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation: for I will suddenly make them run away from it; and whoso is chosen, him will I appoint over it: for who is like me? and who will appoint me a time? and who is the shepherd that can stand before me?

title: Jeremiah 50:45
text: Therefore hear ye the counsel of Jehovah, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely they shall drag them away, [even] the little ones of the flock; surely he shall make their habitation desolate over them.

title: Jeremiah 50:46
text: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth trembleth, and the cry is heard among the nations.

title: Jeremiah 51:1
text: Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in Leb-kamai, a destroying wind.

title: Jeremiah 51:2
text: And I will send unto Babylon strangers, that shall winnow her; and they shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.

title: Jeremiah 51:3
text: Against [him that] bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against [him that] lifteth himself up in his coat of mail: and spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.

title: Jeremiah 51:4
text: And they shall fall down slain in the land of the Chaldeans, and thrust through in her streets.

title: Jeremiah 51:5
text: For Israel is not forsaken, nor Judah, of his God, of Jehovah of hosts; though their land is full of guilt against the Holy One of Israel.

title: Jeremiah 51:6
text: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and save every man his life; be not cut off in her iniquity: for it is the time of Jehovah's vengeance; he will render unto her a recompense.

title: Jeremiah 51:7
text: Babylon hath been a golden cup in Jehovah's hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunk of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.

title: Jeremiah 51:8
text: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: wail for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.

title: Jeremiah 51:9
text: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country; for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.

title: Jeremiah 51:10
text: Jehovah hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of Jehovah our God.

title: Jeremiah 51:11
text: Make sharp the arrows; hold firm the shields: Jehovah hath stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes; because his purpose is against Babylon, to destroy it: for it is the vengeance of Jehovah, the vengeance of his temple.

title: Jeremiah 51:12
text: Set up a standard against the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set the watchmen, prepare the ambushes; for Jehovah hath both purposed and done that which he spake concerning the inhabitants of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 51:13
text: O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, the measure of thy covetousness.

title: Jeremiah 51:14
text: Jehovah of hosts hath sworn by himself, [saying], Surely I will fill thee with men, as with the canker-worm; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.

title: Jeremiah 51:15
text: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding hath he stretched out the heavens:

title: Jeremiah 51:16
text: when he uttereth his voice, there is a tumult of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasuries.

title: Jeremiah 51:17
text: Every man is become brutish [and is] without knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

title: Jeremiah 51:18
text: They are vanity, a work of delusion: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

title: Jeremiah 51:19
text: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the former of all things; and [Israel] is the tribe of his inheritance: Jehovah of hosts is his name.

title: Jeremiah 51:20
text: Thou art my battle-axe and weapons of war: and with thee will I break in pieces the nations; and with thee will I destroy kingdoms;

title: Jeremiah 51:21
text: and with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider;

title: Jeremiah 51:22
text: and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and him that rideth therein; and with thee will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces the old man and the youth; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the virgin;

title: Jeremiah 51:23
text: and with thee will I break in pieces the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke [of oxen] ; and with thee will I break in pieces governors and deputies.

title: Jeremiah 51:24
text: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 51:25
text: Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith Jehovah, which destroyest all the earth; and I will stretch out my hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.

title: Jeremiah 51:26
text: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 51:27
text: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz: appoint a marshal against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough canker-worm.

title: Jeremiah 51:28
text: Prepare against her the nations, the kings of the Medes, the governors thereof, and all the deputies thereof, and all the land of their dominion.

title: Jeremiah 51:29
text: And the land trembleth and is in pain; for the purposes of Jehovah against Babylon do stand, to make the land of Babylon a desolation, without inhabitant.

title: Jeremiah 51:30
text: The mighty men of Babylon have forborne to fight, they remain in their strongholds; their might hath failed; they are become as women: her dwelling-places are set on fire; her bars are broken.

title: Jeremiah 51:31
text: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to show the king of Babylon that his city is taken on every quarter:

title: Jeremiah 51:32
text: and the passages are seized, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.

title: Jeremiah 51:33
text: For thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing-floor at the time when it is trodden; yet a little while, and the time of harvest shall come for her.

title: Jeremiah 51:34
text: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath, like a monster, swallowed [ me up, he hath filled his maw with my delicacies; he hath cast me out.

title: Jeremiah 51:35
text: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and, My blood be upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.

title: Jeremiah 51:36
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; and I will dry up her sea, and make her fountain dry.

title: Jeremiah 51:37
text: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwelling-place for jackals, an astonishment, and a hissing, without inhabitant.

title: Jeremiah 51:38
text: They shall roar together like young lions; they shall growl as lions' whelps.

title: Jeremiah 51:39
text: When they are heated, I will make their feast, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 51:40
text: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he-goats.

title: Jeremiah 51:41
text: How is Sheshach taken! and the praise of the whole earth seized! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!

title: Jeremiah 51:42
text: The sea is come up upon Babylon; she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.

title: Jeremiah 51:43
text: Her cities are become a desolation, a dry land, and a desert, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.

title: Jeremiah 51:44
text: And I will execute judgment upon Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up; and the nations shall not flow any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.

title: Jeremiah 51:45
text: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and save yourselves every man from the fierce anger of Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 51:46
text: And let not your heart faint, neither fear ye for the tidings that shall be heard in the land; for tidings shall come one year, and after that in another year [shall come] tidings, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.

title: Jeremiah 51:47
text: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will execute judgment upon the graven images of Babylon; and her whole land shall be confounded; and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.

title: Jeremiah 51:48
text: Then the heavens and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for joy over Babylon; for the destroyers shall come unto her from the north, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 51:49
text: As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the land.

title: Jeremiah 51:50
text: Ye that have escaped the sword, go ye, stand not still; remember Jehovah from afar, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.

title: Jeremiah 51:51
text: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach; confusion hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of Jehovah's house.

title: Jeremiah 51:52
text: Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that I will execute judgment upon her graven images; and through all her land the wounded shall groan.

title: Jeremiah 51:53
text: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall destroyers come unto her, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 51:54
text: The sound of a cry from Babylon, and of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans!

title: Jeremiah 51:55
text: For Jehovah layeth Babylon waste, and destroyeth out of her the great voice; and their waves roar like many waters; the noise of their voice is uttered:

title: Jeremiah 51:56
text: for the destroyer is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, their bows are broken in pieces; for Jehovah is a God of recompenses, he will surely requite.

title: Jeremiah 51:57
text: And I will make drunk her princes and her wise men, her governors and her deputies, and her mighty men; and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name is Jehovah of hosts.

title: Jeremiah 51:58
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly overthrown, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the peoples shall labor for vanity, and the nations for the fire; and they shall be weary.

title: Jeremiah 51:59
text: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Now Seraiah was chief chamberlain.

title: Jeremiah 51:60
text: And Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written concerning Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 51:61
text: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When thou comest to Babylon, then see that thou read all these words,

title: Jeremiah 51:62
text: and say, O Jehovah, thou hast spoken concerning this place, to cut it off, that none shall dwell therein, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.

title: Jeremiah 51:63
text: And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book, that thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of the Euphrates:

title: Jeremiah 51:64
text: and thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise again because of the evil that I will bring upon her; and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.

title: Jeremiah 52:1
text: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

title: Jeremiah 52:2
text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

title: Jeremiah 52:3
text: For through the anger of Jehovah did it come to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. And Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 52:4
text: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it round about.

title: Jeremiah 52:5
text: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

title: Jeremiah 52:6
text: In the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

title: Jeremiah 52:7
text: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king's garden; (now the Chaldeans were against the city round about;) and they went toward the Arabah.

title: Jeremiah 52:8
text: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

title: Jeremiah 52:9
text: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he gave judgment upon him.

title: Jeremiah 52:10
text: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.

title: Jeremiah 52:11
text: And he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.

title: Jeremiah 52:12
text: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, who stood before the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem:

title: Jeremiah 52:13
text: and he burned the house of Jehovah, and the king's house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, burned he with fire.

title: Jeremiah 52:14
text: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.

title: Jeremiah 52:15
text: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the poorest of the people, and the residue of the people that were left in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the residue of the multitude.

title: Jeremiah 52:16
text: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.

title: Jeremiah 52:17
text: And the pillars of brass that were in the house of Jehovah, and the bases and the brazen sea that were in the house of Jehovah, did the Chaldeans break in pieces, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 52:18
text: The pots also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the basins, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

title: Jeremiah 52:19
text: And the cups, and the firepans, and the basins, and the pots, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the bowls--that which was of gold, in gold, and that which was of silver, in silver,--the captain of the guard took away.

title: Jeremiah 52:20
text: The two pillars, the one sea, and the twelve brazen bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had made for the house of Jehovah--the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

title: Jeremiah 52:21
text: And as for the pillars, the height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a line of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof was four fingers: it was hollow.

title: Jeremiah 52:22
text: And a capital of brass was upon it; and the height of the one capital was five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the capital round about, all of brass: and the second pillar also had like unto these, and pomegranates.

title: Jeremiah 52:23
text: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on the sides; all the pomegranates were a hundred upon the network round about.

title: Jeremiah 52:24
text: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold:

title: Jeremiah 52:25
text: and out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war; and seven men of them that saw the king's face, that were found in the city; and the scribe of the captain of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.

title: Jeremiah 52:26
text: And Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

title: Jeremiah 52:27
text: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.

title: Jeremiah 52:28
text: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Jews and three and twenty;

title: Jeremiah 52:29
text: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty and two persons;

title: Jeremiah 52:30
text: in the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.

title: Jeremiah 52:31
text: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon, in the [first] year of his reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison;

title: Jeremiah 52:32
text: and he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon,

title: Jeremiah 52:33
text: and changed his prison garments. And [Jehoiachin] did eat bread before him continually all the days of his life:

title: Jeremiah 52:34
text: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him by the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

title: Lamentations 1:1
text: How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! She is become as a widow, that was great among the nations! She that was a princess among the provinces is become tributary!

title: Lamentations 1:2
text: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks; Among all her lovers she hath none to comfort her: All her friends have dealt treacherously with her; they are become her enemies.

title: Lamentations 1:3
text: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude; She dwelleth among the nations, she findeth no rest: All her persecutors overtook her within the straits.

title: Lamentations 1:4
text: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn assembly; All her gates are desolate, her priests do sigh: Her virgins are afflicted, and she herself is in bitterness.

title: Lamentations 1:5
text: Her adversaries are become the head, her enemies prosper; For Jehovah hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: Her young children are gone into captivity before the adversary.

title: Lamentations 1:6
text: And from the daughter of Zion all her majesty is departed: Her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, And they are gone without strength before the pursuer.

title: Lamentations 1:7
text: Jerusalem remembereth in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old: When her people fell into the hand of the adversary, and none did help her, The adversaries saw her, they did mock at her desolations.

title: Lamentations 1:8
text: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is become as an unclean thing; All that honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: Yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.

title: Lamentations 1:9
text: Her filthiness was in her skirts; she remembered not her latter end; Therefore is she come down wonderfully; she hath no comforter: Behold, O Jehovah, my affliction; for the enemy hath magnified himself.

title: Lamentations 1:10
text: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: For she hath seen that the nations are entered into her sanctuary, Concerning whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thine assembly.

title: Lamentations 1:11
text: All her people sigh, they seek bread; They have given their pleasant things for food to refresh the soul: See, O Jehovah, and behold; for I am become abject.

title: Lamentations 1:12
text: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? Behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is brought upon me, Wherewith Jehovah hath afflicted [me] in the day of his fierce anger.

title: Lamentations 1:13
text: From on high hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them; He hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: He hath made me desolate and faint all the day.

title: Lamentations 1:14
text: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand; They are knit together, they are come up upon my neck; He hath made my strength to fail: The Lord hath delivered me into their hands, against whom I am not able to stand.

title: Lamentations 1:15
text: The Lord hath set at nought all my mighty men in the midst of me; He hath called a solemn assembly against me to crush my young men: The Lord hath trodden as in a winepress the virgin daughter of Judah.

title: Lamentations 1:16
text: For these things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water; Because the comforter that should refresh my soul is far from me: My children are desolate, because the enemy hath prevailed.

title: Lamentations 1:17
text: Zion spreadeth forth her hands; there is none to comfort her; Jehovah hath commanded concerning Jacob, that they that are round about him should be his adversaries: Jerusalem is among them as an unclean thing.

title: Lamentations 1:18
text: Jehovah is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: Hear, I pray you, all ye peoples, and behold my sorrow: My virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.

title: Lamentations 1:19
text: I called for my lovers, [but] they deceived me: My priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, While they sought them food to refresh their souls.

title: Lamentations 1:20
text: Behold, O Jehovah; for I am in distress; my heart is troubled; My heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: Abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.

title: Lamentations 1:21
text: They have heard that I sigh; there is none to comfort me; all mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done it: Thou wilt bring the day that thou hast proclaimed, and they shall be like unto me.

title: Lamentations 1:22
text: Let all their wickedness come before thee; And do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: For my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.

title: Lamentations 2:1
text: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger! He hath cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, And hath not remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.

title: Lamentations 2:2
text: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: He hath thrown down in his wrath the strongholds of the daughter of Judah; He hath brought them down to the ground; he hath profaned the kingdom and the princes thereof.

title: Lamentations 2:3
text: He hath cut off in fierce anger all the horn of Israel; He hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy: And he hath burned up Jacob like a flaming fire, which devoureth round about.

title: Lamentations 2:4
text: He hath bent his bow like an enemy, he hath stood with his right hand as an adversary, And hath slain all that were pleasant to the eye: In the tent of the daughter of Zion he hath poured out his wrath like fire.

title: Lamentations 2:5
text: The Lord is become as an enemy, he hath swallowed up Israel; He hath swallowed up all her palaces, he hath destroyed his strongholds; And he hath multiplied in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.

title: Lamentations 2:6
text: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden; he hath destroyed his place of assembly: Jehovah hath caused solemn assembly and sabbath to be forgotten in Zion, And hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.

title: Lamentations 2:7
text: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary; He hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces: They have made a noise in the house of Jehovah, as in the day of a solemn assembly.

title: Lamentations 2:8
text: Jehovah hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion; He hath stretched out the line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying; And he hath made the rampart and wall to lament; they languish together.

title: Lamentations 2:9
text: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not; Yea, her prophets find no vision from Jehovah.

title: Lamentations 2:10
text: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, they keep silence; They have cast up dust upon their heads; They have girded themselves with sackcloth: The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

title: Lamentations 2:11
text: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my heart is troubled; My liver is poured upon the earth, because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, Because the young children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.

title: Lamentations 2:12
text: They say to their mothers, Where is grain and wine? When they swoon as the wounded in the streets of the city, When their soul is poured out into their mothers' bosom.

title: Lamentations 2:13
text: What shall I testify unto thee? what shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? For thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?

title: Lamentations 2:14
text: Thy prophets have seen for thee false and foolish visions; And they have not uncovered thine iniquity, to bring back thy captivity, But have seen for thee false oracles and causes of banishment.

title: Lamentations 2:15
text: All that pass by clap their hands at thee; They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, [saying], Is this the city that men called The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?

title: Lamentations 2:16
text: All thine enemies have opened their mouth wide against thee; They hiss and gnash the teeth; they say, We have swallowed her up; Certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.

title: Lamentations 2:17
text: Jehovah hath done that which he purposed; He hath fulfilled his word that he commanded in the days of old; He hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: And he hath caused the enemy to rejoice over thee; He hath exalted the horn of thine adversaries.

title: Lamentations 2:18
text: Their heart cried unto the Lord: O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night; Give thyself no respite; let not the apple of thine eye cease.

title: Lamentations 2:19
text: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches; Pour out thy heart like water before the face of the Lord: Lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger at the head of every street.

title: Lamentations 2:20
text: See, O Jehovah, and behold to whom thou hast done thus! Shall the women eat their fruit, the children that are dandled in the hands? Shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?

title: Lamentations 2:21
text: The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets; My virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword: Thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger; Thou hast slaughtered, [and] not pitied.

title: Lamentations 2:22
text: Thou hast called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side; And there was none that escaped or remained in the day of Jehovah's anger: Those that I have dandled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.

title: Lamentations 3:1
text: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

title: Lamentations 3:2
text: He hath led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.

title: Lamentations 3:3
text: Surely against me he turneth his hand again and again all the day.

title: Lamentations 3:4
text: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.

title: Lamentations 3:5
text: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.

title: Lamentations 3:6
text: He hath made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.

title: Lamentations 3:7
text: He hath walled me about, that I cannot go forth; he hath made my chain heavy.

title: Lamentations 3:8
text: Yea, when I cry, and call for help, he shutteth out my prayer.

title: Lamentations 3:9
text: He hath walled up my ways with hewn stone; he hath made my paths crooked.

title: Lamentations 3:10
text: He is unto me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in secret places.

title: Lamentations 3:11
text: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces; he hath made me desolate.

title: Lamentations 3:12
text: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

title: Lamentations 3:13
text: He hath caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my reins.

title: Lamentations 3:14
text: I am become a derision to all my people, and their song all the day.

title: Lamentations 3:15
text: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath sated me with wormwood.

title: Lamentations 3:16
text: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones; he hath covered me with ashes.

title: Lamentations 3:17
text: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace; I forgat prosperity.

title: Lamentations 3:18
text: And I said, My strength is perished, and mine expectation from Jehovah.

title: Lamentations 3:19
text: Remember mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

title: Lamentations 3:20
text: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is bowed down within me.

title: Lamentations 3:21
text: This I recall to my mind; therefore have I hope.

title: Lamentations 3:22
text: [ It is of] Jehovah's lovingkindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

title: Lamentations 3:23
text: They are new every morning; great is thy faithfulness.

title: Lamentations 3:24
text: Jehovah is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

title: Lamentations 3:25
text: Jehovah is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

title: Lamentations 3:26
text: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Jehovah.

title: Lamentations 3:27
text: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

title: Lamentations 3:28
text: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he hath laid it upon him.

title: Lamentations 3:29
text: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if so be there may be hope.

title: Lamentations 3:30
text: Let him give his cheek to him that smiteth him; let him be filled full with reproach.

title: Lamentations 3:31
text: For the Lord will not cast off for ever.

title: Lamentations 3:32
text: For though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.

title: Lamentations 3:33
text: For he doth not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.

title: Lamentations 3:34
text: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,

title: Lamentations 3:35
text: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the Most High,

title: Lamentations 3:36
text: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.

title: Lamentations 3:37
text: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?

title: Lamentations 3:38
text: Out of the mouth of the Most High cometh there not evil and good?

title: Lamentations 3:39
text: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

title: Lamentations 3:40
text: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Jehovah.

title: Lamentations 3:41
text: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.

title: Lamentations 3:42
text: We have transgressed and have rebelled; thou hast not pardoned.

title: Lamentations 3:43
text: Thou hast covered with anger and pursued us; thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.

title: Lamentations 3:44
text: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.

title: Lamentations 3:45
text: Thou hast made us an off-scouring and refuse in the midst of the peoples.

title: Lamentations 3:46
text: All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.

title: Lamentations 3:47
text: Fear and the pit are come upon us, devastation and destruction.

title: Lamentations 3:48
text: Mine eye runneth down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

title: Lamentations 3:49
text: Mine eye poureth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,

title: Lamentations 3:50
text: Till Jehovah look down, and behold from heaven.

title: Lamentations 3:51
text: Mine eye affecteth my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.

title: Lamentations 3:52
text: They have chased me sore like a bird, they that are mine enemies without cause.

title: Lamentations 3:53
text: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone upon me.

title: Lamentations 3:54
text: Waters flowed over my head; I said, I am cut off.

title: Lamentations 3:55
text: I called upon thy name, O Jehovah, out of the lowest dungeon.

title: Lamentations 3:56
text: Thou heardest my voice; hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.

title: Lamentations 3:57
text: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee; thou saidst, Fear not.

title: Lamentations 3:58
text: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.

title: Lamentations 3:59
text: O Jehovah, thou hast seen my wrong; judge thou my cause.

title: Lamentations 3:60
text: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their devices against me.

title: Lamentations 3:61
text: Thou hast heard their reproach, O Jehovah, and all their devices against me,

title: Lamentations 3:62
text: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

title: Lamentations 3:63
text: Behold thou their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their song.

title: Lamentations 3:64
text: Thou wilt render unto them a recompense, O Jehovah, according to the work of their hands.

title: Lamentations 3:65
text: Thou wilt give them hardness of heart, thy curse unto them.

title: Lamentations 3:66
text: Thou wilt pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Jehovah.

title: Lamentations 4:1
text: How is the gold become dim! [how] is the most pure gold changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.

title: Lamentations 4:2
text: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, How are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

title: Lamentations 4:3
text: Even the jackals draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: The daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

title: Lamentations 4:4
text: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: The young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.

title: Lamentations 4:5
text: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: They that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.

title: Lamentations 4:6
text: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, That was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands were laid upon her.

title: Lamentations 4:7
text: Her nobles were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk; They were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was as of sapphire.

title: Lamentations 4:8
text: Their visage is blacker than a coal; They are not known in the streets: Their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.

title: Lamentations 4:9
text: They that are slain with the sword are better than they that are slain with hunger; For these pine away, stricken through, for want of the fruits of the field.

title: Lamentations 4:10
text: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children; They were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

title: Lamentations 4:11
text: Jehovah hath accomplished his wrath, he hath poured out his fierce anger; And he hath kindled a fire in Zion, which hath devoured the foundations thereof.

title: Lamentations 4:12
text: The kings of the earth believed not, neither all the inhabitants of the world, That the adversary and the enemy would enter into the gates of Jerusalem.

title: Lamentations 4:13
text: [ It is] because of the sins of her prophets, [and] the iniquities of her priests, That have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her.

title: Lamentations 4:14
text: They wander as blind men in the streets, they are polluted with blood, So that men cannot touch their garments.

title: Lamentations 4:15
text: Depart ye, they cried unto them, Unclean! depart, depart, touch not! When they fled away and wandered, men said among the nations, They shall no more sojourn [here] .

title: Lamentations 4:16
text: The anger of Jehovah hath scattered them; He will no more regard them: They respected not the persons of the priests, they favored not the elders.

title: Lamentations 4:17
text: Our eyes do yet fail [in looking] for our vain help: In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.

title: Lamentations 4:18
text: They hunt our steps, so that we cannot go in our streets: Our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.

title: Lamentations 4:19
text: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the heavens: They chased us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.

title: Lamentations 4:20
text: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Jehovah, was taken in their pits; Of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the nations.

title: Lamentations 4:21
text: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz: The cup shall pass through unto thee also; thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.

title: Lamentations 4:22
text: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; He will no more carry thee away into captivity: He will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will uncover thy sins. [

title: Lamentations 5:1
text: Remember, O Jehovah, what is come upon us: Behold, and see our reproach.

title: Lamentations 5:2
text: Our inheritance is turned unto strangers, Our houses unto aliens.

title: Lamentations 5:3
text: We are orphans and fatherless; Our mothers are as widows.

title: Lamentations 5:4
text: We have drunken our water for money; Our wood is sold unto us.

title: Lamentations 5:5
text: Our pursuers are upon our necks: We are weary, and have no rest.

title: Lamentations 5:6
text: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, And to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

title: Lamentations 5:7
text: Our fathers sinned, and are not; And we have borne their iniquities.

title: Lamentations 5:8
text: Servants rule over us: There is none to deliver us out of their hand.

title: Lamentations 5:9
text: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, Because of the sword of the wilderness.

title: Lamentations 5:10
text: Our skin is black like an oven, Because of the burning heat of famine.

title: Lamentations 5:11
text: They ravished the women in Zion, The virgins in the cities of Judah.

title: Lamentations 5:12
text: Princes were hanged up by their hand: The faces of elders were not honored.

title: Lamentations 5:13
text: The young men bare the mill; And the children stumbled under the wood.

title: Lamentations 5:14
text: The elders have ceased from the gate, The young men from their music.

title: Lamentations 5:15
text: The joy of our heart is ceased; Our dance is turned into mourning.

title: Lamentations 5:16
text: The crown is fallen from our head: Woe unto us! for we have sinned.

title: Lamentations 5:17
text: For this our heart is faint; For these things our eyes are dim;

title: Lamentations 5:18
text: For the mountain of Zion, which is desolate: The foxes walk upon it.

title: Lamentations 5:19
text: Thou, O Jehovah, abidest for ever; Thy throne is from generation to generation.

title: Lamentations 5:20
text: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, [And] forsake us so long time?

title: Lamentations 5:21
text: Turn thou us unto thee, O Jehovah, and we shall be turned; Renew our days as of old.

title: Lamentations 5:22
text: But thou hast utterly rejected us; Thou art very wroth against us.

title: Ezekiel 1:1
text: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth [month], in the fifth [day] of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

title: Ezekiel 1:2
text: In the fifth [day] of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity,

title: Ezekiel 1:3
text: the word of Jehovah came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of Jehovah was there upon him.

title: Ezekiel 1:4
text: And I looked, and, behold, a stormy wind came out of the north, a great cloud, with a fire infolding itself, and a brightness round about it, and out of the midst thereof as it were glowing metal, out of the midst of the fire.

title: Ezekiel 1:5
text: And out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance: they had the likeness of a man.

title: Ezekiel 1:6
text: And every one had four faces, and every one of them had four wings.

title: Ezekiel 1:7
text: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot; and they sparkled like burnished brass.

title: Ezekiel 1:8
text: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings [thus] :

title: Ezekiel 1:9
text: their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.

title: Ezekiel 1:10
text: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man; and they four had the face of a lion on the right side; and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four had also the face of an eagle.

title: Ezekiel 1:11
text: And their faces and their wings were separate above; two [wings] of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.

title: Ezekiel 1:12
text: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; they turned not when they went.

title: Ezekiel 1:13
text: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches: [the fire] went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.

title: Ezekiel 1:14
text: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

title: Ezekiel 1:15
text: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold, one wheel upon the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces thereof.

title: Ezekiel 1:16
text: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto a beryl: and they four had one likeness; and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.

title: Ezekiel 1:17
text: When they went, they went in their four directions: they turned not when they went.

title: Ezekiel 1:18
text: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and they four had their rims full of eyes round about.

title: Ezekiel 1:19
text: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them; and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

title: Ezekiel 1:20
text: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went; thither was the spirit to go: and the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

title: Ezekiel 1:21
text: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

title: Ezekiel 1:22
text: And over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of a firmament, like the terrible crystal to look upon, stretched forth over their heads above.

title: Ezekiel 1:23
text: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two which covered on this side, and every one had two which covered on that side, their bodies.

title: Ezekiel 1:24
text: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of a host: when they stood, they let down their wings.

title: Ezekiel 1:25
text: And there was a voice above the firmament that was over their heads: when they stood, they let down their wings.

title: Ezekiel 1:26
text: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone; and upon the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man upon it above.

title: Ezekiel 1:27
text: And I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it round about, from the appearance of his loins and upward; and from the appearance of his loins and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness round about him.

title: Ezekiel 1:28
text: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of Jehovah. And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.

title: Ezekiel 2:1
text: And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak with thee.

title: Ezekiel 2:2
text: And the Spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet; and I heard him that spake unto me.

title: Ezekiel 2:3
text: And he said unto me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to nations that are rebellious, which have rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me even unto this very day.

title: Ezekiel 2:4
text: And the children are impudent and stiffhearted: I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 2:5
text: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they are a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.

title: Ezekiel 2:6
text: And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.

title: Ezekiel 2:7
text: And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear; for they are most rebellious.

title: Ezekiel 2:8
text: But thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that which I give thee.

title: Ezekiel 2:9
text: And when I looked, behold, a hand was put forth unto me; and, lo, a roll of a book was therein;

title: Ezekiel 2:10
text: And he spread it before me: and it was written within and without; and there were written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.

title: Ezekiel 3:1
text: And he said unto me, Son of man, eat that which thou findest; eat this roll, and go, speak unto the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 3:2
text: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the roll.

title: Ezekiel 3:3
text: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.

title: Ezekiel 3:4
text: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.

title: Ezekiel 3:5
text: For thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel;

title: Ezekiel 3:6
text: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, if I sent thee to them, they would hearken unto thee.

title: Ezekiel 3:7
text: But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Israel are of hard forehead and of a stiff heart.

title: Ezekiel 3:8
text: Behold, I have made thy face hard against their faces, and thy forehead hard against their foreheads.

title: Ezekiel 3:9
text: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.

title: Ezekiel 3:10
text: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thy heart, and hear with thine ears.

title: Ezekiel 3:11
text: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.

title: Ezekiel 3:12
text: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, [saying], Blessed be the glory of Jehovah from his place.

title: Ezekiel 3:13
text: And [I heard] the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.

title: Ezekiel 3:14
text: So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and the hand of Jehovah was strong upon me.

title: Ezekiel 3:15
text: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel-abib, that dwelt by the river Chebar, and to where they dwelt; and I sat there overwhelmed among them seven days.

title: Ezekiel 3:16
text: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 3:17
text: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.

title: Ezekiel 3:18
text: When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thy hand.

title: Ezekiel 3:19
text: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.

title: Ezekiel 3:20
text: Again, when a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thy hand.

title: Ezekiel 3:21
text: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man, that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he took warning; and thou hast delivered thy soul.

title: Ezekiel 3:22
text: And the hand of Jehovah was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.

title: Ezekiel 3:23
text: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of Jehovah stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.

title: Ezekiel 3:24
text: Then the Spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet; and he spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thy house.

title: Ezekiel 3:25
text: But thou, son of man, behold, they shall lay bands upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:

title: Ezekiel 3:26
text: and I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover; for they are a rebellious house.

title: Ezekiel 3:27
text: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.

title: Ezekiel 4:1
