text: Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and portray upon it a city, even Jerusalem:

title: Ezekiel 4:2
text: and lay siege against it, and build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it; set camps also against it, and plant battering rams against it round about.

title: Ezekiel 4:3
text: And take thou unto thee an iron pan, and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city: and set thy face toward it, and it shall be besieged, and thou shalt lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 4:4
text: Moreover lie thou upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it; [according to] the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it, thou shalt bear their iniquity.

title: Ezekiel 4:5
text: For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be unto thee a number of days, even three hundred and ninety days: so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 4:6
text: And again, when thou hast accomplished these, thou shalt lie on thy right side, and shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah: forty days, each day for a year, have I appointed it unto thee.

title: Ezekiel 4:7
text: And thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with thine arm uncovered; and thou shalt prophesy against it.

title: Ezekiel 4:8
text: And, behold, I lay bands upon thee, and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to the other, till thou hast accomplished the days of thy siege.

title: Ezekiel 4:9
text: Take thou also unto thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentils, and millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel, and make thee bread thereof; [according to] the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side, even three hundred and ninety days, shalt thou eat thereof.

title: Ezekiel 4:10
text: And thy food which thou shalt eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shalt thou eat it.

title: Ezekiel 4:11
text: And thou shalt drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin: from time to time shalt thou drink.

title: Ezekiel 4:12
text: And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it in their sight with dung that cometh out of man.

title: Ezekiel 4:13
text: And Jehovah said, Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations whither I will drive them.

title: Ezekiel 4:14
text: Then said I, Ah Lord Jehovah! behold, my soul hath not been polluted; for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself, or is torn of beasts; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth.

title: Ezekiel 4:15
text: Then he said unto me, See, I have given thee cow's dung for man's dung, and thou shalt prepare thy bread thereon.

title: Ezekiel 4:16
text: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem: and they shall eat bread by weight, and with fearfulness; and they shall drink water by measure, and in dismay:

title: Ezekiel 4:17
text: that they may want bread and water, and be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.

title: Ezekiel 5:1
text: And thou, son of man, take thee a sharp sword; [as] a barber's razor shalt thou take it unto thee, and shalt cause it to pass upon thy head and upon thy beard: then take thee balances to weigh, and divide the hair.

title: Ezekiel 5:2
text: A third part shalt thou burn in the fire in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled; and thou shalt take a third part, and smite with the sword round about it; and a third part thou shalt scatter to the wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.

title: Ezekiel 5:3
text: And thou shalt take thereof a few in number, and bind them in thy skirts.

title: Ezekiel 5:4
text: And of these again shalt thou take, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire; therefrom shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 5:5
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: This is Jerusalem; I have set her in the midst of the nations, and countries are round about her.

title: Ezekiel 5:6
text: And she hath rebelled against mine ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are round about her; for they have rejected mine ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.

title: Ezekiel 5:7
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye are turbulent more than the nations that are round about you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept mine ordinances, neither have done after the ordinances of the nations that are round about you;

title: Ezekiel 5:8
text: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I, even I, am against thee; and I will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations.

title: Ezekiel 5:9
text: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.

title: Ezekiel 5:10
text: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments on thee; and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter unto all the winds.

title: Ezekiel 5:11
text: Wherefore, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, surely, because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, and with all thine abominations, therefore will I also diminish [thee] ; neither shall mine eye spare, and I also will have no pity.

title: Ezekiel 5:12
text: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee; and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee; and a third part I will scatter unto all the winds, and will draw out a sword after them.

title: Ezekiel 5:13
text: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, and I will cause my wrath toward them to rest, and I shall be comforted; and they shall know that I, Jehovah, have spoken in my zeal, when I have accomplished my wrath upon them.

title: Ezekiel 5:14
text: Moreover I will make thee a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are round about thee, in the sight of all that pass by.

title: Ezekiel 5:15
text: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, unto the nations that are round about thee, when I shall execute judgments on thee in anger and in wrath, and in wrathful rebukes; (I, Jehovah, have spoken it;)

title: Ezekiel 5:16
text: when I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, that are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread;

title: Ezekiel 5:17
text: and I will send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; and I will bring the sword upon thee: I, Jehovah, have spoken it.

title: Ezekiel 6:1
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 6:2
text: Son of man, set thy face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy unto them,

title: Ezekiel 6:3
text: and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Jehovah: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys: Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.

title: Ezekiel 6:4
text: And your altars shall become desolate, and your sun-images shall be broken; and I will cast down your slain men before your idols.

title: Ezekiel 6:5
text: And I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars.

title: Ezekiel 6:6
text: In all your dwelling-places the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your sun-images may be hewn down, and your works may be abolished.

title: Ezekiel 6:7
text: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 6:8
text: Yet will I leave a remnant, in that ye shall have some that escape the sword among the nations, when ye shall be scattered through the countries.

title: Ezekiel 6:9
text: And those of you that escape shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captive, how that I have been broken with their lewd heart, which hath departed from me, and with they eyes, which play the harlot after their idols: and they shall loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

title: Ezekiel 6:10
text: And they shall know that I am Jehovah: I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them.

title: Ezekiel 6:11
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Smite with thy hand, and stamp with thy foot, and say, Alas! because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel; for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.

title: Ezekiel 6:12
text: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my wrath upon them.

title: Ezekiel 6:13
text: And ye shall know that I am Jehovah, when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick [ oak, the places where they offered sweet savor to all their idols.

title: Ezekiel 6:14
text: And I will stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout all their habitations: and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 7:1
text: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 7:2
text: And thou, son of man, thus saith the Lord Jehovah unto the land of Israel, An end: the end is come upon the four corners of the land.

title: Ezekiel 7:3
text: Now is the end upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways; and I will bring upon thee all thine abominations.

title: Ezekiel 7:4
text: And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity; but I will bring thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 7:5
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: An evil, an only evil; behold, it cometh.

title: Ezekiel 7:6
text: An end is come, the end is come; it awaketh against thee; behold, it cometh.

title: Ezekiel 7:7
text: Thy doom is come unto thee, O inhabitant of the land: the time is come, the day is near, [a day of] tumult, and not [of] joyful shouting, upon the mountains.

title: Ezekiel 7:8
text: Now will I shortly pour out my wrath upon thee, and accomplish mine anger against thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways; and I will bring upon thee all thine abominations.

title: Ezekiel 7:9
text: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will bring upon thee according to thy ways; and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I, Jehovah, do smite.

title: Ezekiel 7:10
text: Behold, the day, behold, it cometh: thy doom is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.

title: Ezekiel 7:11
text: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness; none of them [shall remain], nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth: neither shall there be eminency among them.

title: Ezekiel 7:12
text: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.

title: Ezekiel 7:13
text: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they be yet alive: for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof, none shall return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.

title: Ezekiel 7:14
text: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but none goeth to the battle; for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.

title: Ezekiel 7:15
text: The sword is without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that is in the field shall die with the sword: and he that is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.

title: Ezekiel 7:16
text: But those of them that escape shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, every one in his iniquity.

title: Ezekiel 7:17
text: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.

title: Ezekiel 7:18
text: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.

title: Ezekiel 7:19
text: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be as an unclean thing; their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of Jehovah: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels; because it hath been the stumblingblock of their iniquity.

title: Ezekiel 7:20
text: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations [and] their detestable things therein: therefore have I made it unto them as an unclean thing.

title: Ezekiel 7:21
text: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall profane it.

title: Ezekiel 7:22
text: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall profane my secret [place] ; and robbers shall enter into it, and profane it.

title: Ezekiel 7:23
text: Make the chain; for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.

title: Ezekiel 7:24
text: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pride of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be profaned.

title: Ezekiel 7:25
text: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.

title: Ezekiel 7:26
text: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumor shall be upon rumor; and they shall seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.

title: Ezekiel 7:27
text: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 8:1
text: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth [month], in the fifth [day] of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord Jehovah fell there upon me.

title: Ezekiel 8:2
text: Then I beheld, and, lo, a likeness as the appearance of fire; from the appearance of his loins and downward, fire; and from his loins and upward, as the appearance of brightness, as it were glowing metal.

title: Ezekiel 8:3
text: And he put forth the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner [court] that looketh toward the north; where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.

title: Ezekiel 8:4
text: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the appearance that I saw in the plain.

title: Ezekiel 8:5
text: Then said he unto me, Son of man, lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north, and behold, northward of the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.

title: Ezekiel 8:6
text: And he said unto me, Son of man, seest thou what they do? even the great abominations that the house of Israel do commit here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? But thou shalt again see yet other great abominations.

title: Ezekiel 8:7
text: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.

title: Ezekiel 8:8
text: Then said he unto me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold, a door.

title: Ezekiel 8:9
text: And he said unto me, Go in, and see the wicked abominations that they do here.

title: Ezekiel 8:10
text: So I went in and saw; and behold, every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed upon the wall round about.

title: Ezekiel 8:11
text: And there stood before them seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel; and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, every man with his censer in his hand; and the odor of the cloud of incense went up.

title: Ezekiel 8:12
text: Then said he unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his chambers of imagery? for they say, Jehovah seeth us not; Jehovah hath forsaken the land.

title: Ezekiel 8:13
text: He said also unto me, Thou shalt again see yet other great abominations which they do.

title: Ezekiel 8:14
text: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of Jehovah's house which was toward the north; and behold, there sat the women weeping for Tammuz.

title: Ezekiel 8:15
text: Then said he unto me, Hast thou seen [this], O son of man? thou shalt again see yet greater abominations than these.

title: Ezekiel 8:16
text: And he brought me into the inner court of Jehovah's house; and behold, at the door of the temple of Jehovah, between the porch and the altar, were about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of Jehovah, and their faces toward the east; and they were worshipping the sun toward the east.

title: Ezekiel 8:17
text: Then he said unto me, Hast thou seen [this], O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have turned again to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose.

title: Ezekiel 8:18
text: Therefore will I also deal in wrath; mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity; and though they cry in mine ears with a loud voice, yet will I not hear them.

title: Ezekiel 9:1
text: Then he cried in mine ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause ye them that have charge over the city to draw near, every man with his destroying weapon in his hand.

title: Ezekiel 9:2
text: And behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lieth toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand; and one man in the midst of them clothed in linen, with a writer's inkhorn by his side. And they went in, and stood beside the brazen altar.

title: Ezekiel 9:3
text: And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house: and he called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writer's inkhorn by his side.

title: Ezekiel 9:4
text: And Jehovah said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry over all the abominations that are done in the midst thereof.

title: Ezekiel 9:5
text: And to the others he said in my hearing, Go ye through the city after him, and smite: let not your eye spare, neither have ye pity;

title: Ezekiel 9:6
text: slay utterly the old man, the young man and the virgin, and little children and women; but come not near any man upon whom is the mark: and begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the old men that were before the house.

title: Ezekiel 9:7
text: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go ye forth. And they went forth, and smote in the city.

title: Ezekiel 9:8
text: And it came to pass, while they were smiting, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Lord Jehovah! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy wrath upon Jerusalem?

title: Ezekiel 9:9
text: Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of wresting [of judgment] : for they say, Jehovah hath forsaken the land, and Jehovah seeth not.

title: Ezekiel 9:10
text: And as for me also, mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, but I will bring their way upon their head.

title: Ezekiel 9:11
text: And behold, the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as thou hast commanded me.

title: Ezekiel 10:1
text: Then I looked, and behold, in the firmament that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

title: Ezekiel 10:2
text: And he spake unto the man clothed in linen, and said, Go in between the whirling [wheels], even under the cherub, and fill both thy hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city. And he went in in my sight.

title: Ezekiel 10:3
text: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

title: Ezekiel 10:4
text: And the glory of Jehovah mounted up from the cherub, [and stood] over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of Jehovah's glory.

title: Ezekiel 10:5
text: And the sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaketh.

title: Ezekiel 10:6
text: And it came to pass, when he commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim, that he went in, and stood beside a wheel.

title: Ezekiel 10:7
text: And the cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubim unto the fire that was between the cherubim, and took [thereof], and put it into the hands of him that was clothed in linen, who took it and went out.

title: Ezekiel 10:8
text: And there appeared in the cherubim the form of a man's hand under their wings.

title: Ezekiel 10:9
text: And I looked, and behold, four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub; and the appearance of the wheels was like unto a beryl stone.

title: Ezekiel 10:10
text: And as for their appearance, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been within a wheel.

title: Ezekiel 10:11
text: When they went, they went in their four directions: they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.

title: Ezekiel 10:12
text: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes round about, [even] the wheels that they four had.

title: Ezekiel 10:13
text: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing, the whirling [wheels] .

title: Ezekiel 10:14
text: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of the cherub, and the second face was the face of a man, and the third face the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

title: Ezekiel 10:15
text: And the cherubim mounted up: this is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.

title: Ezekiel 10:16
text: And when the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels also turned not from beside them.

title: Ezekiel 10:17
text: When they stood, these stood; and when they mounted up, these mounted up with them: for the spirit of the living creature was in them.

title: Ezekiel 10:18
text: And the glory of Jehovah went forth from over the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubim.

title: Ezekiel 10:19
text: And the cherubim lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went forth, and the wheels beside them: and they stood at the door of the east gate of Jehovah's house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

title: Ezekiel 10:20
text: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.

title: Ezekiel 10:21
text: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.

title: Ezekiel 10:22
text: And as for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves; they went every one straight forward.

title: Ezekiel 11:1
text: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of Jehovah's house, which looketh eastward: and behold, at the door of the gate five and twenty men; and I saw in the midst of them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

title: Ezekiel 11:2
text: And he said unto me, Son of man, these are the men that devise iniquity, and that give wicked counsel in this city;

title: Ezekiel 11:3
text: that say, [The time] is not near to build houses: this [city] is the caldron, and we are the flesh.

title: Ezekiel 11:4
text: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.

title: Ezekiel 11:5
text: And the Spirit of Jehovah fell upon me, and he said unto me, Speak, Thus saith Jehovah: Thus have ye said, O house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.

title: Ezekiel 11:6
text: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.

title: Ezekiel 11:7
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they are the flesh, and this [city] is the caldron; but ye shall be brought forth out of the midst of it.

title: Ezekiel 11:8
text: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword upon you, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 11:9
text: And I will bring you forth out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

title: Ezekiel 11:10
text: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 11:11
text: This [city] shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; I will judge you in the border of Israel;

title: Ezekiel 11:12
text: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither have ye executed mine ordinances, but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are round about you.

title: Ezekiel 11:13
text: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord Jehovah! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?

title: Ezekiel 11:14
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 11:15
text: Son of man, thy brethren, even thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel, all of them, [are they] unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from Jehovah; unto us is this land given for a possession.

title: Ezekiel 11:16
text: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Whereas I have removed them far off among the nations, and whereas I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they are come.

title: Ezekiel 11:17
text: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 11:18
text: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.

title: Ezekiel 11:19
text: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh;

title: Ezekiel 11:20
text: that they may walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.

title: Ezekiel 11:21
text: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 11:22
text: Then did the cherubim lift up their wings, and the wheels were beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

title: Ezekiel 11:23
text: And the glory of Jehovah went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.

title: Ezekiel 11:24
text: And the Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.

title: Ezekiel 11:25
text: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that Jehovah had showed me.

title: Ezekiel 12:1
text: The word of Jehovah also came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 12:2
text: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of the rebellious house, that have eyes to see, and see not, that have ears to hear, and hear not; for they are a rebellious house.

title: Ezekiel 12:3
text: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they are a rebellious house.

title: Ezekiel 12:4
text: And thou shalt bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing; and thou shalt go forth thyself at even in their sight, as when men go forth into exile.

title: Ezekiel 12:5
text: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.

title: Ezekiel 12:6
text: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulder, and carry it forth in the dark; thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the land: for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 12:7
text: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for removing, and in the even I digged through the wall with my hand; I brought it forth in the dark, and bare it upon my shoulder in their sight.

title: Ezekiel 12:8
text: And in the morning came the word of Jehovah unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 12:9
text: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?

title: Ezekiel 12:10
text: Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: This burden [concerneth] the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are.

title: Ezekiel 12:11
text: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them; they shall go into exile, into captivity.

title: Ezekiel 12:12
text: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the dark, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, because he shall not see the land with his eyes.

title: Ezekiel 12:13
text: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare; and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.

title: Ezekiel 12:14
text: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are round about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.

title: Ezekiel 12:15
text: And they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall disperse them among the nations, and scatter them through the countries.

title: Ezekiel 12:16
text: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the nations whither they come; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 12:17
text: Moreover the word of Jehovah came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 12:18
text: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with fearfulness;

title: Ezekiel 12:19
text: and say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the land of Israel: They shall eat their bread with fearfulness, and drink their water in dismay, that her land may be desolate, [and despoiled] of all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.

title: Ezekiel 12:20
text: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be a desolation; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 12:21
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 12:22
text: Son of man, what is this proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?

title: Ezekiel 12:23
text: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the fulfilment of every vision.

title: Ezekiel 12:24
text: For there shall be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 12:25
text: For I am Jehovah; I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall be performed; it shall be no more deferred: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I speak the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 12:26
text: Again the word of Jehovah came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 12:27
text: Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth is for many day to come, and he prophesieth of times that are far off.

title: Ezekiel 12:28
text: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: There shall none of my words be deferred any more, but the word which I shall speak shall be performed, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 13:1
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 13:2
text: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own heart, Hear ye the word of Jehovah:

title: Ezekiel 13:3
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!

title: Ezekiel 13:4
text: O Israel, thy prophets have been like foxes in the waste places.

title: Ezekiel 13:5
text: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in the day of Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 13:6
text: They have seen falsehood and lying divination, that say, Jehovah saith; but Jehovah hath not sent them: and they have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed.

title: Ezekiel 13:7
text: Have ye not seen a false vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, in that ye say, Jehovah saith; albeit I have not spoken?

title: Ezekiel 13:8
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye have spoken falsehood, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 13:9
text: And my hand shall be against the prophets that see false visions, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the council of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 13:10
text: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there is no peace; and when one buildeth up a wall, behold, they daub it with untempered [mortar] :

title: Ezekiel 13:11
text: say unto them that daub it with untempered [mortar], that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it.

title: Ezekiel 13:12
text: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it?

title: Ezekiel 13:13
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my wrath; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in wrath to consume it.

title: Ezekiel 13:14
text: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered [mortar], and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be uncovered; and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 13:15
text: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered [mortar] ; and I will say unto you, The wall is no more, neither they that daubed it;

title: Ezekiel 13:16
text: [ to wit], the prophets of Israel that prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and that see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 13:17
text: And thou, son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, that prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,

title: Ezekiel 13:18
text: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe to the women that sew pillows upon all elbows, and make kerchiefs for the head of [persons of] every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and save souls alive for yourselves?

title: Ezekiel 13:19
text: And ye have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hearken unto lies.

title: Ezekiel 13:20
text: Wherefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make [them] fly, and I will tear them from your arms; and I will let the souls go, even the souls that ye hunt to make [them] fly.

title: Ezekiel 13:21
text: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 13:22
text: Because with lies ye have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, and be saved alive;

title: Ezekiel 13:23
text: therefore ye shall no more see false visions, nor divine divinations: and I will deliver my people out of your hand; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 14:1
text: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.

title: Ezekiel 14:2
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 14:3
text: Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be inquired of at all by them?

title: Ezekiel 14:4
text: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Every man of the house of Israel that taketh his idols into his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I Jehovah will answer him therein according to the multitude of his idols;

title: Ezekiel 14:5
text: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.

title: Ezekiel 14:6
text: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Return ye, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.

title: Ezekiel 14:7
text: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that separateth himself from me, and taketh his idols into his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet to inquire for himself of me; I Jehovah will answer him by myself:

title: Ezekiel 14:8
text: and I will set my face against that man, and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 14:9
text: And if the prophet be deceived and speak a word, I, Jehovah, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.

title: Ezekiel 14:10
text: And they shall bear their iniquity: the iniquity of the prophet shall be even as the iniquity of him that seeketh [unto him] ;

title: Ezekiel 14:11
text: that the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither defile themselves any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 14:12
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 14:13
text: Son of man, when a land sinneth against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand upon it, and break the staff of the bread thereof, and send famine upon it, and cut off from it man and beast;

title: Ezekiel 14:14
text: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 14:15
text: If I cause evil beasts to pass through the land, and they ravage it, and it be made desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the beasts;

title: Ezekiel 14:16
text: though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, they should deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only should be delivered, but the land should be desolate.

title: Ezekiel 14:17
text: Or if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off from it man and beast;

title: Ezekiel 14:18
text: though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, they should deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only should be delivered themselves.

title: Ezekiel 14:19
text: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my wrath upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast;

title: Ezekiel 14:20
text: though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, they should deliver neither son nor daughter; they should but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.

title: Ezekiel 14:21
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the evil beasts, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast!

title: Ezekiel 14:22
text: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be carried forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings; and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it.

title: Ezekiel 14:23
text: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their way and their doings; and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 15:1
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 15:2
text: Son of man, what is the vine-tree more than any tree, the vine-branch which is among the trees of the forest?

title: Ezekiel 15:3
text: Shall wood be taken thereof to make any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?

title: Ezekiel 15:4
text: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire hath devoured both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned: is it profitable for any work?

title: Ezekiel 15:5
text: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned, shall it yet be meet for any work!

title: Ezekiel 15:6
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: As the vine-tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

title: Ezekiel 15:7
text: And I will set my face against them; they shall go forth from the fire, but the fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah, when I set my face against them.

title: Ezekiel 15:8
text: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 16:1
text: Again the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 16:2
text: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;

title: Ezekiel 16:3
text: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah unto Jerusalem: Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of the Canaanite; the Amorite was thy father, and thy mother was a Hittite.

title: Ezekiel 16:4
text: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to cleanse thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.

title: Ezekiel 16:5
text: No eye pitied thee, to do any of these things unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, for that thy person was abhorred, in the day that thou wast born.

title: Ezekiel 16:6
text: And when I passed by thee, and saw thee weltering in thy blood, I said unto thee, [Though thou art] in thy blood, live; yea, I said unto thee, [Though thou art] in thy blood, live.

title: Ezekiel 16:7
text: I caused thee to multiply as that which groweth in the field, and thou didst increase and wax great, and thou attainedst to excellent ornament; thy breasts were fashioned, and thy hair was grown; yet thou wast naked and bare.

title: Ezekiel 16:8
text: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord Jehovah, and thou becamest mine.

title: Ezekiel 16:9
text: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I thoroughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.

title: Ezekiel 16:10
text: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with sealskin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and covered thee with silk.

title: Ezekiel 16:11
text: And I decked thee with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.

title: Ezekiel 16:12
text: And I put a ring upon thy nose, and ear-rings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thy head.

title: Ezekiel 16:13
text: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil; and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper unto royal estate.

title: Ezekiel 16:14
text: And thy renown went forth among the nations for thy beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 16:15
text: But thou didst trust in thy beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy whoredoms on every one that passed by; his it was.

title: Ezekiel 16:16
text: And thou didst take of thy garments, and madest for thee high places decked with divers colors, and playedst the harlot upon them: [the like things] shall not come, neither shall it be [so] .

title: Ezekiel 16:17
text: Thou didst also take thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest for thee images of men, and didst play the harlot with them;

title: Ezekiel 16:18
text: and thou tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them, and didst set mine oil and mine incense before them.

title: Ezekiel 16:19
text: My bread also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed thee, thou didst even set it before them for a sweet savor; and [thus] it was, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 16:20
text: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Were thy whoredoms a small matter,

title: Ezekiel 16:21
text: that thou hast slain my children, and delivered them up, in causing them to pass through [the fire] unto them?

title: Ezekiel 16:22
text: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, and wast weltering in thy blood.

title: Ezekiel 16:23
text: And it is come to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord Jehovah,)

title: Ezekiel 16:24
text: that thou hast built unto thee a vaulted place, and hast made thee a lofty place in every street.

title: Ezekiel 16:25
text: Thou hast built thy lofty place at the head of every way, and hast made thy beauty an abomination, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredom.

title: Ezekiel 16:26
text: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians, thy neighbors, great of flesh; and hast multiplied thy whoredom, to provoke me to anger.

title: Ezekiel 16:27
text: Behold therefore, I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary [food], and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, that are ashamed of thy lewd way.

title: Ezekiel 16:28
text: Thou hast played the harlot also with the Assyrians, because thou wast insatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet thou wast not satisfied.

title: Ezekiel 16:29
text: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy whoredom unto the land of traffic, unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.

title: Ezekiel 16:30
text: How weak is thy heart, saith the Lord Jehovah, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of an impudent harlot;

title: Ezekiel 16:31
text: in that thou buildest thy vaulted place at the head of every way, and makest thy lofty place in every street, and hast not been as a harlot, in that thou scornest hire.

title: Ezekiel 16:32
text: A wife that committeth adultery! that taketh strangers instead of her husband!

title: Ezekiel 16:33
text: They give gifts to all harlots; but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and bribest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredoms.

title: Ezekiel 16:34
text: And thou art different from [other] women in thy whoredoms, in that none followeth thee to play the harlot; and whereas thou givest hire, and no hire is given unto thee, therefore thou art different.

title: Ezekiel 16:35
text: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of Jehovah:

title: Ezekiel 16:36
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness uncovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers; and because of all the idols of thy abominations, and for the blood of thy children, that thou didst give unto them;

title: Ezekiel 16:37
text: therefore behold, I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all them that thou hast loved, with all them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them against thee on every side, and will uncover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.

title: Ezekiel 16:38
text: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring upon thee the blood of wrath and jealousy.

title: Ezekiel 16:39
text: I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thy vaulted place, and break down thy lofty places; and they shall strip thee of thy clothes, and take thy fair jewels; and they shall leave thee naked and bare.

title: Ezekiel 16:40
text: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.

title: Ezekiel 16:41
text: And they shall burn thy houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women; and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou shalt also give no hire any more.

title: Ezekiel 16:42
text: So will I cause my wrath toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.

title: Ezekiel 16:43
text: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring thy way upon thy head, saith the Lord Jehovah: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness with all thine abominations.

title: Ezekiel 16:44
text: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use [this] proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.

title: Ezekiel 16:45
text: Thou art the daughter of thy mother, that loatheth her husband and her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children: your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

title: Ezekiel 16:46
text: And thine elder sister is Samaria, that dwelleth at thy left hand, she and her daughters; and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.

title: Ezekiel 16:47
text: Yet hast thou not walked in their ways, nor done after their abominations; but, as [if that were] a very little [thing], thou wast more corrupt than they in all thy ways.

title: Ezekiel 16:48
text: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.

title: Ezekiel 16:49
text: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom: pride, fulness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters; neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

title: Ezekiel 16:50
text: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw [good] .

title: Ezekiel 16:51
text: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters by all thine abominations which thou hast done.

title: Ezekiel 16:52
text: Thou also, bear thou thine own shame, in that thou hast given judgment for thy sisters; through thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous that thou: yea, be thou also confounded, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.

title: Ezekiel 16:53
text: And I will turn again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them;

title: Ezekiel 16:54
text: that thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be ashamed because of all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.

title: Ezekiel 16:55
text: And thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate; and thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.

title: Ezekiel 16:56
text: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,

title: Ezekiel 16:57
text: before thy wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, that do despite unto thee round about.

title: Ezekiel 16:58
text: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 16:59
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also deal with thee as thou hast done, who hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

title: Ezekiel 16:60
text: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.

title: Ezekiel 16:61
text: Then shalt thou remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder [sisters] and thy younger; and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.

title: Ezekiel 16:62
text: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah;

title: Ezekiel 16:63
text: that thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more, because of thy shame, when I have forgiven thee all that thou hast done, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 17:1
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 17:2
text: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;

title: Ezekiel 17:3
text: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: A great eagle with great wings and long pinions, full of feathers, which had divers colors, came unto Lebanon, and took the top of the cedar:

title: Ezekiel 17:4
text: he cropped off the topmost of the young twigs thereof, and carried it unto a land of traffic; he set it in a city of merchants.

title: Ezekiel 17:5
text: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful soil; he placed it beside many waters; he set it as a willow-tree.

title: Ezekiel 17:6
text: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.

title: Ezekiel 17:7
text: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend its roots toward him, and shot forth its branches toward him, from the beds of its plantation, that he might water it.

title: Ezekiel 17:8
text: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.

title: Ezekiel 17:9
text: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it may wither; that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? and not by a strong arm or much people can it be raised from the roots thereof.

title: Ezekiel 17:10
text: Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the beds where it grew.

title: Ezekiel 17:11
text: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 17:12
text: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these things mean? tell them, Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and brought them to him to Babylon:

title: Ezekiel 17:13
text: and he took of the seed royal, and made a covenant with him; he also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land;

title: Ezekiel 17:14
text: that the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.

title: Ezekiel 17:15
text: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such things? shall he break the covenant, and yet escape?

title: Ezekiel 17:16
text: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.

title: Ezekiel 17:17
text: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts, to cut off many persons.

title: Ezekiel 17:18
text: For he hath despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet hath done all these things; he shall not escape.

title: Ezekiel 17:19
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: As I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, I will even bring it upon his own head.

title: Ezekiel 17:20
text: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.

title: Ezekiel 17:21
text: And all his fugitives in all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward every wind: and ye shall know that I, Jehovah, have spoken it.

title: Ezekiel 17:22
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also take of the lofty top of the cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it upon a high and lofty mountain:

title: Ezekiel 17:23
text: in the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it; and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all birds of every wing; in the shade of the branches thereof shall they dwell.

title: Ezekiel 17:24
text: And all the trees of the field shall know that I, Jehovah, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish; I, Jehovah, have spoken and have done it.

title: Ezekiel 18:1
text: The word of Jehovah came unto me again, saying,

title: Ezekiel 18:2
text: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge?

title: Ezekiel 18:3
text: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, ye shall not have [occasion] any more to use this proverb in Israel.

title: Ezekiel 18:4
text: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.

title: Ezekiel 18:5
text: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,

title: Ezekiel 18:6
text: and hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbor's wife, neither hath come near to a woman in her impurity,

title: Ezekiel 18:7
text: and hath not wronged any, but hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath taken nought by robbery, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;

title: Ezekiel 18:8
text: he that hath not given forth upon interest, neither hath taken any increase, that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true justice between man and man,

title: Ezekiel 18:9
text: hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept mine ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 18:10
text: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth any one of these things,

title: Ezekiel 18:11
text: and that doeth not any of those [duties], but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbor's wife,

title: Ezekiel 18:12
text: hath wronged the poor and needy, hath taken by robbery, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,

title: Ezekiel 18:13
text: hath given forth upon interest, and hath taken increase; shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.

title: Ezekiel 18:14
text: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that seeth all his father's sins, which he hath done, and feareth, and doeth not such like;

title: Ezekiel 18:15
text: that hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbor's wife,

title: Ezekiel 18:16
text: neither hath wronged any, hath not taken aught to pledge, neither hath taken by robbery, but hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;

title: Ezekiel 18:17
text: that hath withdrawn his hand from the poor, that hath not received interest nor increase, hath executed mine ordinances, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.

title: Ezekiel 18:18
text: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he shall die in his iniquity.

title: Ezekiel 18:19
text: Yet say ye, Wherefore doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? when the son hath done that which is lawful and right, and hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.

title: Ezekiel 18:20
text: The soul that sinneth, it shall die: the son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son; the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.

title: Ezekiel 18:21
text: But if the wicked turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

title: Ezekiel 18:22
text: None of his transgressions that he hath committed shall be remembered against him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.

title: Ezekiel 18:23
text: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked? saith the Lord Jehovah; and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?

title: Ezekiel 18:24
text: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth, shall he live? None of his righteous deeds that he hath done shall be remembered: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.

title: Ezekiel 18:25
text: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel: Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?

title: Ezekiel 18:26
text: When the righteous man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth therein; in his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.

title: Ezekiel 18:27
text: Again, when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.

title: Ezekiel 18:28
text: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

title: Ezekiel 18:29
text: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?

title: Ezekiel 18:30
text: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord Jehovah. Return ye, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.

title: Ezekiel 18:31
text: Cast away from you all your transgressions, wherein ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

title: Ezekiel 18:32
text: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord Jehovah: wherefore turn yourselves, and live.

title: Ezekiel 19:1
text: Moreover, take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

title: Ezekiel 19:2
text: and say, What was thy mother? A lioness: she couched among lions, in the midst of the young lions she nourished her whelps.

title: Ezekiel 19:3
text: And she brought up one of her whelps: he became a young lion, and he learned to catch the prey; he devoured men.

title: Ezekiel 19:4
text: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit; and they brought him with hooks unto the land of Egypt.

title: Ezekiel 19:5
text: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.

title: Ezekiel 19:6
text: And he went up and down among the lions; he became a young lion, and he learned to catch the prey; he devoured men.

title: Ezekiel 19:7
text: And he knew their palaces, and laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, because of the noise of his roaring.

title: Ezekiel 19:8
text: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces; and they spread their net over him; he was taken in their pit.

title: Ezekiel 19:9
text: And they put him in a cage with hooks, and brought him to the king of Babylon; they brought him into strongholds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 19:10
text: Thy mother was like a vine, in thy blood, planted by the waters: it was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

title: Ezekiel 19:11
text: And it had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and their stature was exalted among the thick boughs, and they were seen in [ their height with the multitude of their branches.

title: Ezekiel 19:12
text: But it was plucked up in fury, it was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up its fruit: its strong rods were broken off and withered; the fire consumed them.

title: Ezekiel 19:13
text: And now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.

title: Ezekiel 19:14
text: And fire is gone out of the rods of its branches, it hath devoured its fruit, so that there is in it no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.

title: Ezekiel 20:1
text: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth [month], the tenth [day] of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to inquire of Jehovah, and sat before me.

title: Ezekiel 20:2
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 20:3
text: Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Is it to inquire of me that ye are come? As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will not be inquired of by you.

title: Ezekiel 20:4
text: Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge them? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers;

title: Ezekiel 20:5
text: and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In the day when I chose Israel, and sware unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I sware unto them, saying, I am Jehovah your God;

title: Ezekiel 20:6
text: in that day I sware unto them, to bring them forth out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands.

title: Ezekiel 20:7
text: And I said unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt; I am Jehovah your God.

title: Ezekiel 20:8
text: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me; they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt. Then I said I would pour out my wrath upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.

title: Ezekiel 20:9
text: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, among which they were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.

title: Ezekiel 20:10
text: So I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.

title: Ezekiel 20:11
text: And I gave them my statutes, and showed them mine ordinances, which if a man do, he shall live in them.

title: Ezekiel 20:12
text: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am Jehovah that sanctifieth them.

title: Ezekiel 20:13
text: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they rejected mine ordinances, which if a man keep, he shall live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly profaned. Then I said I would pour out my wrath upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.

title: Ezekiel 20:14
text: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.

title: Ezekiel 20:15
text: Moreover also I sware unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;

title: Ezekiel 20:16
text: because they rejected mine ordinances, and walked not in my statutes, and profaned my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.

title: Ezekiel 20:17
text: Nevertheless mine eye spared them, and I destroyed them not, neither did I make a full end of them in the wilderness.

title: Ezekiel 20:18
text: And I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their ordinances, nor defile yourselves with their idols.

title: Ezekiel 20:19
text: I am Jehovah your God: walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them;

title: Ezekiel 20:20
text: and hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I am Jehovah your God.

title: Ezekiel 20:21
text: But the children rebelled against me; they walked not in my statutes, neither kept mine ordinances to do them, which if a man do, he shall live in them; they profaned my sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.

title: Ezekiel 20:22
text: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand, and wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them forth.

title: Ezekiel 20:23
text: Moreover I sware unto them in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the nations, and disperse them through the countries;

title: Ezekiel 20:24
text: because they had not executed mine ordinances, but had rejected my statutes, and had profaned my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.

title: Ezekiel 20:25
text: Moreover also I gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances wherein they should not live;

title: Ezekiel 20:26
text: and I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through [the fire] all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 20:27
text: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In this moreover have your fathers blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.

title: Ezekiel 20:28
text: For when I had brought them into the land, which I sware to give unto them, then they saw every high hill, and every thick tree, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering; there also they made their sweet savor, and they poured out there their drink-offerings.

title: Ezekiel 20:29
text: Then I said unto them, What meaneth the high place whereunto ye go? So the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.

title: Ezekiel 20:30
text: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Do ye pollute yourselves after the manner of your fathers? and play ye the harlot after their abominations?

title: Ezekiel 20:31
text: and when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, do ye pollute yourselves with all your idols unto this day? and shall I be inquired of by you, O house of Israel? As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will not be inquired of by you;

title: Ezekiel 20:32
text: and that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, in that ye say, We will be as the nations, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.

title: Ezekiel 20:33
text: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, surely with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, will I be king over you:

title: Ezekiel 20:34
text: and I will bring you out from the peoples, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out;

title: Ezekiel 20:35
text: and I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there will I enter into judgment with you face to face.

title: Ezekiel 20:36
text: Like as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I enter into judgment with you, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 20:37
text: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant;

title: Ezekiel 20:38
text: and I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me; I will bring them forth out of the land where they sojourn, but they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 20:39
text: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Go ye, serve every one his idols, and hereafter also, if ye will not hearken unto me; but my holy name shall ye no more profane with your gifts, and with your idols.

title: Ezekiel 20:40
text: For in my holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them, serve me in the land: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the first-fruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.

title: Ezekiel 20:41
text: As a sweet savor will I accept you, when I bring you out from the peoples, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you in the sight of the nations.

title: Ezekiel 20:42
text: And ye shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country which I sware to give unto your fathers.

title: Ezekiel 20:43
text: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have polluted yourselves; and ye shall loathe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.

title: Ezekiel 20:44
text: And ye shall know that I am Jehovah, when I have dealt with you for my name's sake, not according to your evil ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 20:45
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 20:46
text: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop [thy word] toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the field in the South;

title: Ezekiel 20:47
text: and say to the forest of the South, Hear the word of Jehovah: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burnt thereby.

title: Ezekiel 20:48
text: And all flesh shall see that I, Jehovah, have kindled it; it shall not be quenched.

title: Ezekiel 20:49
text: Then said I, Ah Lord Jehovah! they say of me, Is he not a speaker of parables?

title: Ezekiel 21:1
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 21:2
text: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop [thy word] toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel;

title: Ezekiel 21:3
text: and say to the land of Israel, Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.

title: Ezekiel 21:4
text: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:

title: Ezekiel 21:5
text: and all flesh shall know that I, Jehovah, have drawn forth my sword out of its sheath; it shall not return any more.

title: Ezekiel 21:6
text: Sigh therefore, thou son of man; with the breaking of thy loins and with bitterness shalt thou sigh before their eyes.

title: Ezekiel 21:7
text: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt say, Because of the tidings, for it cometh; and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it cometh, and it shall be done, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 21:8
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 21:9
text: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith Jehovah: Say, A sword, a sword, it is sharpened, and also furbished;

title: Ezekiel 21:10
