text: it is sharpened that it may make a slaughter; it is furbished that it may be as lightning: shall we then make mirth? the rod of my son, it contemneth every tree.

title: Ezekiel 21:11
text: And it is given to be furbished, that it may be handled: the sword, it is sharpened, yea, it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.

title: Ezekiel 21:12
text: Cry and wail, son of man; for it is upon my people, it is upon all the princes of Israel: they are delivered over to the sword with my people; smite therefore upon thy thigh.

title: Ezekiel 21:13
text: For there is a trial; and what if even the rod that contemneth shall be no more? saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 21:14
text: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite thy hands together; and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the deadly wounded: it is the sword of the great one that is deadly wounded, which entereth into their chambers.

title: Ezekiel 21:15
text: I have set the threatening sword against all their gates, that their heart may melt, and their stumblings be multiplied: ah! it is made as lightning, it is pointed for slaughter.

title: Ezekiel 21:16
text: Gather thee together, go to the right, set thyself in array, go to the left, whithersoever thy face is set.

title: Ezekiel 21:17
text: I will also smite my hands together, and I will cause my wrath to rest: I, Jehovah, have spoken it.

title: Ezekiel 21:18
text: The word of Jehovah came unto me again, saying,

title: Ezekiel 21:19
text: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come; they twain shall come forth out of one land: and mark out a place, mark it out at the head of the way to the city.

title: Ezekiel 21:20
text: Thou shalt appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.

title: Ezekiel 21:21
text: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he shook the arrows to and fro, he consulted the teraphim, he looked in the liver.

title: Ezekiel 21:22
text: In his right hand was the divination [for] Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up mounds, to build forts.

title: Ezekiel 21:23
text: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, who have sworn oaths unto them; but he bringeth iniquity to remembrance, that they may be taken.

title: Ezekiel 21:24
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.

title: Ezekiel 21:25
text: And thou, O deadly wounded wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day is come, in the time of the iniquity of the end,

title: Ezekiel 21:26
text: thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Remove the mitre, and take off the crown; this [shall be] no more the same; exalt that which is low, and abase that which is high. [

title: Ezekiel 21:27
text: I will overturn, overturn, overturn it: this also shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it [him] .

title: Ezekiel 21:28
text: And thou, son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach; and say thou, A sword, a sword is drawn, for the slaughter it is furbished, to cause it to devour, that it may be as lightning;

title: Ezekiel 21:29
text: while they see for thee false visions, while they divine lies unto thee, to lay thee upon the necks of the wicked that are deadly wounded, whose day is come in the time of the iniquity of the end.

title: Ezekiel 21:30
text: Cause it to return into its sheath. In the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy birth, will I judge thee.

title: Ezekiel 21:31
text: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee; I will blow upon thee with the fire of my wrath; and I will deliver thee into the hand of brutish men, skilful to destroy.

title: Ezekiel 21:32
text: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no more remembered: for I, Jehovah, have spoken it.

title: Ezekiel 22:1
text: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 22:2
text: And thou, son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? then cause her to know all her abominations.

title: Ezekiel 22:3
text: And thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: A city that sheddeth blood in the midst of her, that her time may come, and that maketh idols against herself to defile her!

title: Ezekiel 22:4
text: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed, and art defiled in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the nations, and a mocking to all the countries.

title: Ezekiel 22:5
text: Those that are near, and those that are far from thee, shall mock thee, thou infamous one [and] full of tumult.

title: Ezekiel 22:6
text: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one according to his power, have been in thee to shed blood.

title: Ezekiel 22:7
text: In thee have they set light by father and mother; in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the sojourner; in thee have they wronged the fatherless and the widow.

title: Ezekiel 22:8
text: Thou hast despised my holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.

title: Ezekiel 22:9
text: Slanderous men have been in thee to shed blood; and in thee they have eaten upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they have committed lewdness.

title: Ezekiel 22:10
text: In thee have they uncovered their fathers' nakedness; in thee have they humbled her that was unclean in her impurity.

title: Ezekiel 22:11
text: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbor's wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father's daughter.

title: Ezekiel 22:12
text: In thee have they taken bribes to shed blood; thou hast taken interest and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbors by oppression, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 22:13
text: Behold, therefore, I have smitten my hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.

title: Ezekiel 22:14
text: Can thy heart endure, or can thy hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I, Jehovah, have spoken it, and will do it.

title: Ezekiel 22:15
text: And I will scatter thee among the nations, and disperse thee through the countries; and I will consume thy filthiness out of thee.

title: Ezekiel 22:16
text: And thou shalt be profaned in thyself, in the sight of the nations; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 22:17
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 22:18
text: Son of man, the house of Israel is become dross unto me: all of them are brass and tin and iron and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are the dross of silver.

title: Ezekiel 22:19
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye are all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.

title: Ezekiel 22:20
text: As they gather silver and brass and iron and lead and tin into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my wrath, and I will lay you there, and melt you.

title: Ezekiel 22:21
text: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you with the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.

title: Ezekiel 22:22
text: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I, Jehovah, have poured out my wrath upon you.

title: Ezekiel 22:23
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 22:24
text: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art a land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.

title: Ezekiel 22:25
text: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey: they have devoured souls; they take treasure and precious things; they have made her widows many in the midst thereof.

title: Ezekiel 22:26
text: Her priests have done violence to my law, and have profaned my holy things: they have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.

title: Ezekiel 22:27
text: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, [and] to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.

title: Ezekiel 22:28
text: And her prophets have daubed for them with untempered [mortar], seeing false visions, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, when Jehovah hath not spoken.

title: Ezekiel 22:29
text: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery; yea, they have vexed the poor and needy, and have oppressed the sojourner wrongfully.

title: Ezekiel 22:30
text: And I sought for a man among them, that should build up the wall, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it; but I found none.

title: Ezekiel 22:31
text: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I brought upon their heads, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 23:1
text: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 23:2
text: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:

title: Ezekiel 23:3
text: and they played the harlot in Egypt; they played the harlot in their youth; there were their breasts pressed, and there was handled the bosom of their virginity.

title: Ezekiel 23:4
text: And the names of them were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister: and they became mine, and they bare sons and daughters. And as for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.

title: Ezekiel 23:5
text: And Oholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians [her] neighbors,

title: Ezekiel 23:6
text: who were clothed with blue, governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.

title: Ezekiel 23:7
text: And she bestowed her whoredoms upon them, the choicest men of Assyria all of them; and on whomsoever she doted, with all their idols she defiled herself.

title: Ezekiel 23:8
text: Neither hath she left her whoredoms since [the days of] Egypt; for in her youth they lay with her, and they handled the bosom of her virginity; and they poured out their whoredom upon her. [

title: Ezekiel 23:9
text: Wherefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.

title: Ezekiel 23:10
text: These uncovered her nakedness; they took her sons and her daughters; and her they slew with the sword: and she became a byword among women; for they executed judgments upon her.

title: Ezekiel 23:11
text: And her sister Oholibah saw this, yet was she more corrupt in her doting than she, and in her whoredoms which were more than the whoredoms of her sister.

title: Ezekiel 23:12
text: She doted upon the Assyrians, governors and rulers, [her] neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.

title: Ezekiel 23:13
text: And I saw that she was defiled; they both took one way.

title: Ezekiel 23:14
text: And she increased her whoredoms; for she saw men portrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans portrayed with vermilion,

title: Ezekiel 23:15
text: girded with girdles upon their loins, with flowing turbans upon their heads, all of them princes to look upon, after the likeness of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their nativity.

title: Ezekiel 23:16
text: And as soon as she saw them she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.

title: Ezekiel 23:17
text: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her soul was alienated from them.

title: Ezekiel 23:18
text: So she uncovered her whoredoms, and uncovered her nakedness: then my soul was alienated from her, like as my soul was alienated from her sister.

title: Ezekiel 23:19
text: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, remembering the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.

title: Ezekiel 23:20
text: And she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.

title: Ezekiel 23:21
text: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in the handling of thy bosom by the Egyptians for the breasts of thy youth.

title: Ezekiel 23:22
text: Therefore, O Oholibah, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy soul is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side:

title: Ezekiel 23:23
text: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, [and] all the Assyrians with them; desirable young men, governors and rulers all of them, princes and men of renown, all of them riding upon horses.

title: Ezekiel 23:24
text: And they shall come against thee with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a company of peoples; they shall set themselves against thee with buckler and shield and helmet round about; and I will commit the judgment unto them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.

title: Ezekiel 23:25
text: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal with thee in fury; they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy residue shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.

title: Ezekiel 23:26
text: They shall also strip thee of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.

title: Ezekiel 23:27
text: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom [brought] from the land of Egypt; so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.

title: Ezekiel 23:28
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest, into the hand of them from whom thy soul is alienated;

title: Ezekiel 23:29
text: and they shall deal with thee in hatred, and shall take away all thy labor, and shall leave thee naked and bare; and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be uncovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

title: Ezekiel 23:30
text: These things shall be done unto thee, for that thou hast played the harlot after the nations, and because thou art polluted with their idols.

title: Ezekiel 23:31
text: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thy hand.

title: Ezekiel 23:32
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Thou shalt drink of thy sister's cup, which is deep and large; thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.

title: Ezekiel 23:33
text: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.

title: Ezekiel 23:34
text: Thou shalt even drink it and drain it out, and thou shalt gnaw the sherds thereof, and shalt tear thy breasts; for I have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 23:35
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

title: Ezekiel 23:36
text: Jehovah said moreover unto me: Son of man, wilt thou judge Oholah and Oholibah? then declare unto them their abominations.

title: Ezekiel 23:37
text: For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands; and with their idols have they committed adultery; and they have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass through [the fire] unto them to be devoured.

title: Ezekiel 23:38
text: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.

title: Ezekiel 23:39
text: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of my house.

title: Ezekiel 23:40
text: And furthermore ye have sent for men that come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent, and, lo, they came; for whom thou didst wash thyself, paint thine eyes, and deck thyself with ornaments, [

title: Ezekiel 23:41
text: and sit upon a stately bed, with a table prepared before it, whereupon thou didst set mine incense and mine oil.

title: Ezekiel 23:42
text: And the voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with men of the common sort were brought drunkards from the wilderness; and they put bracelets upon the hands of them [twain], and beautiful crowns upon their heads.

title: Ezekiel 23:43
text: Then said I of her that was old in adulteries, Now will they play the harlot with her, and she [with them] .

title: Ezekiel 23:44
text: And they went in unto her, as they go in unto a harlot: so went they in unto Oholah and unto Oholibah, the lewd women.

title: Ezekiel 23:45
text: And righteous men, they shall judge them with the judgment of adulteresses, and with the judgment of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.

title: Ezekiel 23:46
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will bring up a company against them, and will give them to be tossed to and fro and robbed.

title: Ezekiel 23:47
text: And the company shall stone them with stones, and despatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

title: Ezekiel 23:48
text: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.

title: Ezekiel 23:49
text: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols; and ye shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 24:1
text: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth [day] of the month, the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 24:2
text: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, [even] of this selfsame day: the king of Babylon drew close unto Jerusalem this selfsame day.

title: Ezekiel 24:3
text: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Set on the caldron, set it on, and also pour water into it:

title: Ezekiel 24:4
text: gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.

title: Ezekiel 24:5
text: Take the choice of the flock, and also a pile [of wood] for the bones under [the caldron] ; make it boil well; yea, let the bones thereof be boiled in the midst of it.

title: Ezekiel 24:6
text: Wherefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe to the bloody city, to the caldron whose rust is therein, and whose rust is not gone out of it! take out of it piece after piece; No lot is fallen upon it.

title: Ezekiel 24:7
text: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the bare rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust.

title: Ezekiel 24:8
text: That it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance, I have set her blood upon the bare rock, that it should not be covered.

title: Ezekiel 24:9
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe to the bloody city! I also will make the pile great.

title: Ezekiel 24:10
text: Heap on the wood, make the fire hot, boil well the flesh, and make thick the broth, and let the bones be burned.

title: Ezekiel 24:11
text: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that it may be hot, and the brass thereof may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the rust of it may be consumed.

title: Ezekiel 24:12
text: She hath wearied [herself] with toil; yet her great rust goeth not forth out of her; her rust [goeth not forth] by fire.

title: Ezekiel 24:13
text: In thy filthiness is lewdness: because I have cleansed thee and thou wast not cleansed, thou shalt not be cleansed from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my wrath toward thee to rest. [

title: Ezekiel 24:14
text: I, Jehovah, have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it: I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 24:15
text: Also the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 24:16
text: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet thou shalt neither mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.

title: Ezekiel 24:17
text: Sigh, but not aloud, make no mourning for the dead; bind thy headtire upon thee, and put thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not thy lips, and eat not the bread of men.

title: Ezekiel 24:18
text: So I spake unto the people in the morning; and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.

title: Ezekiel 24:19
text: And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us, that thou doest so?

title: Ezekiel 24:20
text: Then I said unto them, The word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 24:21
text: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left behind shall fall by the sword.

title: Ezekiel 24:22
text: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.

title: Ezekiel 24:23
text: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.

title: Ezekiel 24:24
text: Thus shall Ezekiel be unto you a sign; according to all that he hath done shall ye do: when this cometh, then shall ye know that I am the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 24:25
text: And thou, son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their heart, their sons and their daughters,

title: Ezekiel 24:26
text: that in that day he that escapeth shall come unto thee, to cause thee to hear it with thine ears?

title: Ezekiel 24:27
text: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him that is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: so shalt thou be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 25:1
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 25:2
text: Son of man, set thy face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them:

title: Ezekiel 25:3
text: and say unto the children of Ammon, Hear the word of the Lord Jehovah: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was made desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity:

title: Ezekiel 25:4
text: therefore, behold, I will deliver thee to the children of the east for a possession, and they shall set their encampments in thee, and make their dwellings in thee; they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.

title: Ezekiel 25:5
text: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the children of Ammon a couching-place for flocks: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 25:6
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast clapped thy hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the despite of thy soul against the land of Israel;

title: Ezekiel 25:7
text: therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the nations; and I will cut thee off from the peoples, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 25:8
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the nations;

title: Ezekiel 25:9
text: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,

title: Ezekiel 25:10
text: unto the children of the east, [to go] against the children of Ammon; and I will give them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations.

title: Ezekiel 25:11
text: and I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 25:12
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;

title: Ezekiel 25:13
text: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, I will stretch out my hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; even unto Dedan shall they fall by the sword.

title: Ezekiel 25:14
text: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel; and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my wrath; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 25:15
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with despite of soul to destroy with perpetual enmity;

title: Ezekiel 25:16
text: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I will stretch out my hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.

title: Ezekiel 25:17
text: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with wrathful rebukes; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.

title: Ezekiel 26:1
text: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first [day] of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 26:2
text: Son of man, because that Tyre hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken [that was] the gate of the peoples; she is turned unto me; I shall be replenished, now that she is laid waste:

title: Ezekiel 26:3
text: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I am against thee, O Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth its waves to come up.

title: Ezekiel 26:4
text: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.

title: Ezekiel 26:5
text: She shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea; for I have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah; and she shall become a spoil to the nations.

title: Ezekiel 26:6
text: And her daughters that are in the field shall be slain with the sword: and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 26:7
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will bring upon Tyre Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and a company, and much people.

title: Ezekiel 26:8
text: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field; and he shall make forts against thee, and cast up a mound against thee, and raise up the buckler against thee.

title: Ezekiel 26:9
text: And he shall set his battering engines against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.

title: Ezekiel 26:10
text: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.

title: Ezekiel 26:11
text: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets; he shall slay thy people with the sword; and the pillars of thy strength shall go down to the ground.

title: Ezekiel 26:12
text: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise; and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses; and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the waters.

title: Ezekiel 26:13
text: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.

title: Ezekiel 26:14
text: And I will make thee a bare rock; thou shalt be a place for the spreading of nets; thou shalt be built no more: for I Jehovah have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 26:15
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah to Tyre: shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?

title: Ezekiel 26:16
text: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble every moment, and be astonished at thee.

title: Ezekiel 26:17
text: And they shall take up a lamentation over thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited by seafaring men, the renowned city, that was strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, that caused their terror to be on all that dwelt there!

title: Ezekiel 26:18
text: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be dismayed at thy departure.

title: Ezekiel 26:19
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and the great waters shall cover thee;

title: Ezekiel 26:20
text: then will I bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make thee to dwell in the nether parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.

title: Ezekiel 26:21
text: I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt no more have any being; though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 27:1
text: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 27:2
text: And thou, son of man, take up a lamentation over Tyre;

title: Ezekiel 27:3
text: and say unto Tyre, O thou that dwellest at the entry of the sea, that art the merchant of the peoples unto many isles, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Thou, O Tyre, hast said, I am perfect in beauty.

title: Ezekiel 27:4
text: Thy borders are in the heart of the seas; thy builders have perfected thy beauty.

title: Ezekiel 27:5
text: They have made all thy planks of fir-trees from Senir; they have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for thee.

title: Ezekiel 27:6
text: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; they have made thy benches of ivory inlaid in boxwood, from the isles of Kittim.

title: Ezekiel 27:7
text: Of fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was thy sail, that it might be to thee for an ensign; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was thine awning.

title: Ezekiel 27:8
text: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were thy rowers: thy wise men, O Tyre, were in thee, they were thy pilots.

title: Ezekiel 27:9
text: The old men of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to deal in thy merchandise.

title: Ezekiel 27:10
text: Persia and Lud and Put were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.

title: Ezekiel 27:11
text: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, and valorous men were in thy towers; they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have perfected thy beauty.

title: Ezekiel 27:12
text: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded for thy wares.

title: Ezekiel 27:13
text: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy traffickers; they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass for thy merchandise.

title: Ezekiel 27:14
text: They of the house of Togarmah traded for thy wares with horses and war-horses and mules.

title: Ezekiel 27:15
text: The men of Dedan were thy traffickers; many isles were the mart of thy hand: they brought thee in exchange horns of ivory and ebony.

title: Ezekiel 27:16
text: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of thy handiworks: they traded for thy wares with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and rubies.

title: Ezekiel 27:17
text: Judah, and the land of Israel, they were thy traffickers: they traded for thy merchandise wheat of Minnith, and pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.

title: Ezekiel 27:18
text: Damascus was thy merchant for the multitude of thy handiworks, by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

title: Ezekiel 27:19
text: Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for thy wares: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were among thy merchandise.

title: Ezekiel 27:20
text: Dedan was thy trafficker in precious cloths for riding.

title: Ezekiel 27:21
text: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they were the merchants of thy hand; in lambs, and rams, and goats, in these were they thy merchants.

title: Ezekiel 27:22
text: The traffickers of Sheba and Raamah, they were thy traffickers; they traded for thy wares with the chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.

title: Ezekiel 27:23
text: Haran and Canneh and Eden, the traffickers of Sheba, Asshur [and] Chilmad, were thy traffickers.

title: Ezekiel 27:24
text: These were thy traffickers in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.

title: Ezekiel 27:25
text: The ships of Tarshish were thy caravans for thy merchandise: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the heart of the seas.

title: Ezekiel 27:26
text: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the heart of the seas.

title: Ezekiel 27:27
text: Thy riches, and thy wares, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the dealers in thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that are in thee, with all thy company which is in the midst of thee, shall fall into the heart of the seas in the day of thy ruin.

title: Ezekiel 27:28
text: At the sound of the cry of thy pilots the suburbs shall shake.

title: Ezekiel 27:29
text: And all that handled the oar, the mariners, [and] all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships; they shall stand upon the land,

title: Ezekiel 27:30
text: and shall cause their voice to be heard over thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:

title: Ezekiel 27:31
text: and they shall make themselves bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee in bitterness of soul with bitter mourning.

title: Ezekiel 27:32
text: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, [saying], Who is there like Tyre, like her that is brought to silence in the midst of the sea?

title: Ezekiel 27:33
text: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many peoples; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.

title: Ezekiel 27:34
text: In the time that thou wast broken by the seas in the depths of the waters, thy merchandise and all thy company did fall in the midst of thee.

title: Ezekiel 27:35
text: All the inhabitants of the isles are astonished at thee, and their kings are horribly afraid; they are troubled in their countenance.

title: Ezekiel 27:36
text: The merchants among the peoples hiss at thee; thou art become a terror, and thou shalt nevermore have any being.

title: Ezekiel 28:1
text: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 28:2
text: Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyre, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thy heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a god, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou art man, and not God, though thou didst set thy heart as the heart of God;--

title: Ezekiel 28:3
text: behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that is hidden from thee;

title: Ezekiel 28:4
text: by thy wisdom and by thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures;

title: Ezekiel 28:5
text: by thy great wisdom [and] by thy traffic hast thou increased thy riches, and thy heart is lifted up because of thy riches;--

title: Ezekiel 28:6
text: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast set thy heart as the heart of God,

title: Ezekiel 28:7
text: therefore, behold, I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations; and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.

title: Ezekiel 28:8
text: They shall bring thee down to the pit; and thou shalt die the death of them that are slain, in the heart of the seas.

title: Ezekiel 28:9
text: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I am God? but thou art man, and not God, in the hand of him that woundeth thee.

title: Ezekiel 28:10
text: Thou shalt die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 28:11
text: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 28:12
text: Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

title: Ezekiel 28:13
text: Thou wast in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, the topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was in thee; in the day that thou wast created they were prepared.

title: Ezekiel 28:14
text: Thou wast the anointed cherub that covereth: and I set thee, [so that] thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.

title: Ezekiel 28:15
text: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till unrighteousness was found in thee.

title: Ezekiel 28:16
text: By the abundance of thy traffic they filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore have I cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God; and I have destroyed thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.

title: Ezekiel 28:17
text: Thy heart was lifted up because of thy beauty; thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I have cast thee to the ground; I have laid thee before kings, that they may behold thee.

title: Ezekiel 28:18
text: By the multitude of thine iniquities, in the unrighteousness of thy traffic, thou hast profaned thy sanctuaries; therefore have I brought forth a fire from the midst of thee; it hath devoured thee, and I have turned thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.

title: Ezekiel 28:19
text: All they that know thee among the peoples shall be astonished at thee: thou art become a terror, and thou shalt nevermore have any being.

title: Ezekiel 28:20
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 28:21
text: Son of man, set thy face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it,

title: Ezekiel 28:22
text: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, O Sidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.

title: Ezekiel 28:23
text: For I will send pestilence into her, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall fall in the midst of her, with the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I am Jehovah. [

title: Ezekiel 28:24
text: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor a hurting thorn of any that are round about them, that did despite unto them; and they shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 28:25
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the nations, then shall they dwell in their own land which I gave to my servant Jacob.

title: Ezekiel 28:26
text: And they shall dwell securely therein; yea, they shall build houses, and plant vineyards, and shall dwell securely, when I have executed judgments upon all those that do them despite round about them; and they shall know that I am Jehovah their God.

title: Ezekiel 29:1
text: In the tenth year, in the tenth [month], in the twelfth [day] of the month, the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 29:2
text: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt;

title: Ezekiel 29:3
text: speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great monster that lieth in the midst of his rivers, that hath said, My river is mine own, and I have made it for myself.

title: Ezekiel 29:4
text: And I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales; and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, with all the fish of thy rivers which stick unto thy scales.

title: Ezekiel 29:5
text: And I will cast thee forth into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open field; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered; I have given thee for food to the beasts of the earth and to the birds of the heavens.

title: Ezekiel 29:6
text: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am Jehovah, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 29:7
text: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and didst rend all their shoulders; and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.

title: Ezekiel 29:8
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and will cut off from thee man and beast.

title: Ezekiel 29:9
text: And the land of Egypt shall be a desolation and a waste; and they shall know that I am Jehovah. Because he hath said, The river is mine, and I have made it;

title: Ezekiel 29:10
text: therefore, behold, I am against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from the tower of Seveneh even unto the border of Ethiopia.

title: Ezekiel 29:11
text: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.

title: Ezekiel 29:12
text: And I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the midst of the countries that are desolate; and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be a desolation forty years; and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

title: Ezekiel 29:13
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the peoples whither they were scattered;

title: Ezekiel 29:14
text: and I will bring back the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their birth; and they shall be there a base kingdom.

title: Ezekiel 29:15
text: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it any more lift itself up above the nations: and I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.

title: Ezekiel 29:16
text: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to remembrance, when they turn to look after them: and they shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 29:17
text: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first [month], in the first [day] of the month, the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 29:18
text: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was worn; yet had he no wages, nor his army, from Tyre, for the service that he had served against it.

title: Ezekiel 29:19
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall carry off her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.

title: Ezekiel 29:20
text: I have given him the land of Egypt as his recompense for which he served, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 29:21
text: In that day will I cause a horn to bud forth unto the house of Israel, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 30:1
text: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 30:2
text: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Wail ye, Alas for the day!

title: Ezekiel 30:3
text: For the day is near, even the day of Jehovah is near; it shall be a day of clouds, a time of the nations.

title: Ezekiel 30:4
text: And a sword shall come upon Egypt, and anguish shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt; and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.

title: Ezekiel 30:5
text: Ethiopia, and Put, and Lud, and all the mingled people, and Cub, and the children of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.

title: Ezekiel 30:6
text: Thus saith Jehovah: They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Seveneh shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 30:7
text: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate; and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.

title: Ezekiel 30:8
text: And they shall know at I am Jehovah, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and all her helpers are destroyed.

title: Ezekiel 30:9
text: In that day shall messengers go forth from before me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid; and there shall be anguish upon them, as in the day of Egypt; for, lo, it cometh.

title: Ezekiel 30:10
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease, by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.

title: Ezekiel 30:11
text: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought in to destroy the land; and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.

title: Ezekiel 30:12
text: And I will make the rivers dry, and will sell the land into the hand of evil men; and I will make the land desolate, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I, Jehovah, have spoken it.

title: Ezekiel 30:13
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause the images to cease from Memphis; and there shall be no more a prince from the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.

title: Ezekiel 30:14
text: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set a fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments upon No.

title: Ezekiel 30:15
text: And I will pour my wrath upon Sin, the stronghold of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.

title: Ezekiel 30:16
text: And I will set a fire in Egypt: Sin shall be in great anguish, and No shall be broken up; and Memphis [shall have] adversaries in the day-time.

title: Ezekiel 30:17
text: The young men of Aven and of Pi-beseth shall fall by the sword; and these [cities] shall go into captivity.

title: Ezekiel 30:18
text: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall withdraw itself, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt, and the pride of her power shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.

title: Ezekiel 30:19
text: Thus will I execute judgments upon Egypt; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 30:20
text: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first [month], in the seventh [day] of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 30:21
text: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it hath not been bound up, to apply [healing] medicines, to put a bandage to bind it, that it be strong to hold the sword.

title: Ezekiel 30:22
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong [arm], and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

title: Ezekiel 30:23
text: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

title: Ezekiel 30:24
text: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man.

title: Ezekiel 30:25
text: And I will hold up the arms of the king of Babylon; and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.

title: Ezekiel 30:26
text: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them through the countries; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 31:1
text: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third [month], in the first [day] of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 31:2
text: Son of man, say unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude: Whom art thou like in thy greatness?

title: Ezekiel 31:3
text: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a forest-like shade, and of high stature; and its top was among the thick boughs.

title: Ezekiel 31:4
text: The waters nourished it, the deep made it to grow: the rivers thereof ran round about its plantation; and it sent out its channels unto all the trees of the field.

title: Ezekiel 31:5
text: Therefore its stature was exalted above all the trees of the field; and its boughs were multiplied, and its branches became long by reason of many waters, when it shot [them] forth.

title: Ezekiel 31:6
text: All the birds of the heavens made their nests in its boughs; and under its branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young; and under its shadow dwelt all great nations.

title: Ezekiel 31:7
text: Thus was it fair in its greatness, in the length of its branches; for its root was by many waters.

title: Ezekiel 31:8
text: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it; the fir-trees were not like its boughs, and the plane-trees were not as its branches; nor was any tree in the garden of God like unto it in its beauty.

title: Ezekiel 31:9
text: I made it fair by the multitude of its branches, so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied it.

title: Ezekiel 31:10
text: Therefore thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because thou art exalted in stature, and he hath set his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height; [

title: Ezekiel 31:11
text: I will even deliver him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations; he shall surely deal with him; I have driven him out for his wickedness.

title: Ezekiel 31:12
text: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the watercourses of the land; and all the peoples of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.

title: Ezekiel 31:13
text: Upon his ruin all the birds of the heavens shall dwell, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches;

title: Ezekiel 31:14
text: to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature, neither set their top among the thick boughs, nor that their mighty ones stand up on their height, [even] all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.

title: Ezekiel 31:15
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In the day when he went down to Sheol I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the rivers thereof; and the great waters were stayed; and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

title: Ezekiel 31:16
text: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to Sheol with them that descend into the pit; and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the nether parts of the earth.

title: Ezekiel 31:17
text: They also went down into Sheol with him unto them that are slain by the sword; yea, they that were his arm, [that] dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the nations.

title: Ezekiel 31:18
text: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised, with them that are slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 32:1
text: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first [day] of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 32:2
text: Son of man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, Thou wast likened unto a young lion of the nations: yet art thou as a monster in the seas; and thou didst break forth with thy rivers, and troubledst the waters with thy feet, and fouledst their rivers.

title: Ezekiel 32:3
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will spread out my net upon thee with a company of many peoples; and they shall bring thee up in my net.

title: Ezekiel 32:4
text: And I will leave thee upon the land, I will cast thee forth upon the open field, and will cause all the birds of the heavens to settle upon thee, and I will satisfy the beasts of the whole earth with thee.

title: Ezekiel 32:5
text: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with thy height.

title: Ezekiel 32:6
text: I will also water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest, even to the mountains; and the watercourses shall be full of thee.

title: Ezekiel 32:7
text: And when I shall extinguish thee, I will cover the heavens, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give its light.

title: Ezekiel 32:8
text: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee, and set darkness upon thy land, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 32:9
text: I will also vex the hearts of many peoples, when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which thou hast not known.

title: Ezekiel 32:10
text: Yea, I will make many peoples amazed at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall.

title: Ezekiel 32:11
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.

title: Ezekiel 32:12
text: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall; the terrible of the nations are they all: and they shall bring to nought the pride of Egypt, and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.

title: Ezekiel 32:13
text: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside many waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.

title: Ezekiel 32:14
text: Then will I make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 32:15
text: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate and waste, a land destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 32:16
text: This is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament; the daughters of the nations shall lament therewith; over Egypt, and over all her multitude, shall they lament therewith, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 32:17
text: It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth [day] of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 32:18
text: Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.

title: Ezekiel 32:19
text: Whom dost thou pass in beauty? go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.

title: Ezekiel 32:20
text: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword; draw her away and all her multitudes.

title: Ezekiel 32:21
text: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of Sheol with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie still, even the uncircumcised, slain by the sword.

title: Ezekiel 32:22
text: Asshur is there and all her company; her graves are round about her; all of them slain, fallen by the sword;

title: Ezekiel 32:23
text: whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit, and her company is round about her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who caused terror in the land of the living.

title: Ezekiel 32:24
text: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, who caused their terror in the land of the living, and have borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.

title: Ezekiel 32:25
text: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude; her graves are round about her; all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for their terror was caused in the land of the living, and they have borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of them that are slain.

title: Ezekiel 32:26
text: There is Meshech, Tubal, and all their multitude; their graves are round about them; all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for they caused their terror in the land of the living.

title: Ezekiel 32:27
text: And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised, that are gone down to Sheol with their weapons of war, and have laid their swords under their heads, and their iniquities are upon their bones; for [they were] the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.

title: Ezekiel 32:28
text: But thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with them that are slain by the sword.

title: Ezekiel 32:29
text: There is Edom, her kings and all her princes, who in their might are laid with them that are slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit. [

title: Ezekiel 32:30
text: There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who are gone down with the slain; in the terror which they caused by their might they are put to shame; and they lie uncircumcised with them that are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.

title: Ezekiel 32:31
text: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 32:32
text: For I have put his terror in the land of the living; and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised, with them that are slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 33:1
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 33:2
text: Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, and the people of the land take a man from among them, and set him for their watchman;

title: Ezekiel 33:3
text: if, when he seeth the sword come upon the land, he blow the trumpet, and warn the people;

title: Ezekiel 33:4
text: then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet, and taketh not warning, if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.

title: Ezekiel 33:5
text: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him; whereas if he had taken warning, he would have delivered his soul.

title: Ezekiel 33:6
text: But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned, and the sword come, and take any person from among them; he is taken away in his iniquity, but his blood will I require at the watchman's hand.

title: Ezekiel 33:7
text: So thou, son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.

title: Ezekiel 33:8
text: When I say unto the wicked, O wicked man, thou shalt surely die, and thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way; that wicked man shall die in his iniquity, but his blood will I require at thy hand.

title: Ezekiel 33:9
text: Nevertheless, if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he turn not from his way; he shall die in his iniquity, but thou hast delivered thy soul.

title: Ezekiel 33:10
text: And thou, son of man, say unto the house of Israel: Thus ye speak, saying, Our transgressions and our sins are upon us, and we pine away in them; how then can we live?

title: Ezekiel 33:11
text: Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

title: Ezekiel 33:12
text: And thou, son of man, say unto the children of thy people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression; and as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall he that is righteous be able to live thereby in the day that he sinneth.

title: Ezekiel 33:13
text: When I say to the righteous, that he shall surely live; if he trust to his righteousness, and commit iniquity, none of his righteous deeds shall be remembered; but in his iniquity that he hath committed, therein shall he die.

title: Ezekiel 33:14
text: Again, when I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;

title: Ezekiel 33:15
text: if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.

title: Ezekiel 33:16
text: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be remembered against him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.

title: Ezekiel 33:17
text: Yet the children of thy people say, The way of the Lord is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.

title: Ezekiel 33:18
text: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall even die therein.

title: Ezekiel 33:19
text: And when the wicked turneth from his wickedness, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.

title: Ezekiel 33:20
text: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.

title: Ezekiel 33:21
text: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth [month], in the fifth [day] of the month, that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying, The city is smitten.

title: Ezekiel 33:22
text: Now the hand of Jehovah had been upon me in the evening, before he that was escaped came; and he had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.

title: Ezekiel 33:23
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 33:24
text: Son of man, they that inhabit those waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we are many; the land is given us for inheritance.

title: Ezekiel 33:25
text: Wherefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Ye eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes unto your idols, and shed blood: and shall ye possess the land?

title: Ezekiel 33:26
text: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbor's wife: and shall ye possess the land?

title: Ezekiel 33:27
text: Thus shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: As I live, surely they that are in the waste places shall fall by the sword; and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured; and they that are in the strongholds and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.

title: Ezekiel 33:28
text: And I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment; and the pride of her power shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate, so that none shall pass through.

title: Ezekiel 33:29
text: Then shall they know that I am Jehovah, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment, because of all their abominations which they have committed.

title: Ezekiel 33:30
text: And as for thee, son of man, the children of thy people talk of thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 33:31
text: And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words, but do them not; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goeth after their gain.

title: Ezekiel 33:32
text: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for they hear thy words, but they do them not.

title: Ezekiel 33:33
text: And when this cometh to pass, (behold, it cometh,) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.

title: Ezekiel 34:1
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 34:2
text: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, even to the shepherds, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe unto the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the sheep?

title: Ezekiel 34:3
text: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill the fatlings; but ye feed not the sheep.

title: Ezekiel 34:4
text: The diseased have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up that which was broken, neither have ye brought back that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force and with rigor have ye ruled over them.

title: Ezekiel 34:5
text: And they were scattered, because there was no shepherd; and they became food to all the beasts of the field, and were scattered.

title: Ezekiel 34:6
text: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my sheep were scattered upon all the face of the earth; and there was none that did search or seek [after them] .

title: Ezekiel 34:7
text: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of Jehovah:

title: Ezekiel 34:8
text: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, surely forasmuch as my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the beasts of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my sheep;

title: Ezekiel 34:9
text: therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of Jehovah:

title: Ezekiel 34:10
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; and I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.

title: Ezekiel 34:11
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.

title: Ezekiel 34:12
text: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so will I seek out my sheep; and I will deliver them out of all places whither they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

title: Ezekiel 34:13
text: And I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land; and I will feed them upon the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.

title: Ezekiel 34:14
text: I will feed them with good pasture; and upon the mountains of the height of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie down in a good fold; and on fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 34:15
text: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 34:16
text: I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but the fat and the strong I will destroy; I will feed them in justice.

title: Ezekiel 34:17
text: And as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the he-goats.

title: Ezekiel 34:18
text: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have fed upon the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? and to have drunk of the clear waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?

title: Ezekiel 34:19
text: And as for my sheep, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.

title: Ezekiel 34:20
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah unto them: Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

title: Ezekiel 34:21
text: Because ye thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;

title: Ezekiel 34:22
text: therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between sheep and sheep.

title: Ezekiel 34:23
text: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.

title: Ezekiel 34:24
text: And I, Jehovah, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them; I, Jehovah, have spoken it.

title: Ezekiel 34:25
text: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil beasts to cease out of the land; and they shall dwell securely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.

title: Ezekiel 34:26
text: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in its season; there shall be showers of blessing.

title: Ezekiel 34:27
text: And the tree of the field shall yield its fruit, and the earth shall yield its increase, and they shall be secure in their land; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those that made bondmen of them.

title: Ezekiel 34:28
text: And they shall no more be a prey to the nations, neither shall the beasts of the earth devour them; but they shall dwell securely, and none shall make them afraid.

title: Ezekiel 34:29
text: And I will raise up unto them a plantation for renown, and they shall be no more consumed with famine in the land, neither bear the shame of the nations any more.

title: Ezekiel 34:30
text: And they shall know that I, Jehovah, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 34:31
text: And ye my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 35:1
text: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 35:2
text: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

title: Ezekiel 35:3
text: and say unto it, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, O mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against thee, and I will make thee a desolation and an astonishment.

title: Ezekiel 35:4
text: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 35:5
text: Because thou hast had a perpetual enmity, and hast given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end;

title: Ezekiel 35:6
text: therefore, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: since thou hast not hated blood, therefore blood shall pursue thee.

title: Ezekiel 35:7
text: Thus will I make mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation; and I will cut off from it him that passeth through and him that returneth.

title: Ezekiel 35:8
text: And I will fill its mountains with its slain: in thy hills and in thy valleys and in all thy watercourses shall they fall that are slain with the sword.

title: Ezekiel 35:9
text: I will make thee a perpetual desolation, and thy cities shall not be inhabited; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 35:10
text: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas Jehovah was there:

title: Ezekiel 35:11
text: therefore, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast showed out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I shall judge thee.

title: Ezekiel 35:12
text: And thou shalt know that I, Jehovah, have heard all thy revilings which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to devour.

title: Ezekiel 35:13
text: And ye have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard it.

title: Ezekiel 35:14
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.

title: Ezekiel 35:15
text: As thou didst rejoice over the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 36:1
text: And thou, son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 36:2
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha! and, The ancient high places are ours in possession;

title: Ezekiel 36:3
text: therefore prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because, even because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the nations, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;

title: Ezekiel 36:4
text: therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Jehovah: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which are become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are round about;

title: Ezekiel 36:5
text: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land unto themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.

title: Ezekiel 36:6
text: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because ye have borne the shame of the nations:

title: Ezekiel 36:7
text: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I have sworn, [saying], Surely the nations that are round about you, they shall bear their shame.

title: Ezekiel 36:8
text: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come.

title: Ezekiel 36:9
text: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown;

title: Ezekiel 36:10
text: and I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, even all of it; and the cities shall be inhabited, and the waste places shall be builded;

title: Ezekiel 36:11
text: and I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and be fruitful; and I will cause you to be inhabited after your former estate, and will do better [unto you] than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 36:12
text: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of children.

title: Ezekiel 36:13
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because they say unto you, Thou [land] art a devourer of men, and hast been a bereaver of thy nation;

title: Ezekiel 36:14
text: therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nation any more, saith the Lord Jehovah;

title: Ezekiel 36:15
text: neither will I let thee hear any more the shame of the nations, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the peoples any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nation to stumble any more, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 36:16
text: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 36:17
text: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their way and by their doings: their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.

title: Ezekiel 36:18
text: Wherefore I poured out my wrath upon them for the blood which they had poured out upon the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols;

title: Ezekiel 36:19
text: and I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.

title: Ezekiel 36:20
text: And when they came unto the nations, whither they went, they profaned my holy name; in that men said of them, These are the people of Jehovah, and are gone forth out of his land.

title: Ezekiel 36:21
text: But I had regard for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations, whither they went.

title: Ezekiel 36:22
