text: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I do not [this] for your sake, O house of Israel, but for my holy name, which ye have profaned among the nations, whither ye went.

title: Ezekiel 36:23
text: And I will sanctify my great name, which hath been profaned among the nations, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the nations shall know that I am Jehovah, saith the Lord Jehovah, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.

title: Ezekiel 36:24
text: For I will take you from among the nations, and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.

title: Ezekiel 36:25
text: And I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.

title: Ezekiel 36:26
text: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you; and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.

title: Ezekiel 36:27
text: And I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep mine ordinances, and do them.

title: Ezekiel 36:28
text: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.

title: Ezekiel 36:29
text: And I will save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the grain, and will multiply it, and lay no famine upon you.

title: Ezekiel 36:30
text: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.

title: Ezekiel 36:31
text: Then shall ye remember your evil ways, and your doings that were not good; and ye shall loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

title: Ezekiel 36:32
text: Not for your sake do I [this], saith the Lord Jehovah, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your ways, O house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 36:33
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the waste places shall be builded.

title: Ezekiel 36:34
text: And the land that was desolate shall be tilled, whereas it was a desolation in the sight of all that passed by.

title: Ezekiel 36:35
text: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.

title: Ezekiel 36:36
text: Then the nations that are left round about you shall know that I, Jehovah, have builded the ruined places, and planted that which was desolate: I, Jehovah, have spoken it, and I will do it.

title: Ezekiel 36:37
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: For this, moreover, will I be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.

title: Ezekiel 36:38
text: As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 37:1
text: The hand of Jehovah was upon me, and he brought me out in the Spirit of Jehovah, and set me down in the midst of the valley; and it was full of bones.

title: Ezekiel 37:2
text: And he caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.

title: Ezekiel 37:3
text: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord Jehovah, thou knowest.

title: Ezekiel 37:4
text: Again he said unto me, Prophesy over these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 37:5
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah unto these bones: Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live.

title: Ezekiel 37:6
text: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 37:7
text: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and, behold, an earthquake; and the bones came together, bone to its bone.

title: Ezekiel 37:8
text: And I beheld, and, lo, there were sinews upon them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.

title: Ezekiel 37:9
text: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.

title: Ezekiel 37:10
text: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.

title: Ezekiel 37:11
text: Then he said unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: behold, they say, Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost; we are clean cut off.

title: Ezekiel 37:12
text: Therefore prophesy, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, O my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 37:13
text: And ye shall know that I am Jehovah, when I have opened your graves, and caused you to come up out of your graves, O my people.

title: Ezekiel 37:14
text: And I will put my Spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I will place you in your own land: and ye shall know that I, Jehovah, have spoken it and performed it, saith Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 37:15
text: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 37:16
text: And thou, son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and [for] all the house of Israel his companions:

title: Ezekiel 37:17
text: and join them for thee one to another into one stick, that they may become one in thy hand.

title: Ezekiel 37:18
text: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not show us what thou meanest by these?

title: Ezekiel 37:19
text: say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I will put them with it, [even] with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in my hand.

title: Ezekiel 37:20
text: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thy hand before their eyes.

title: Ezekiel 37:21
text: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the nations, whither they are gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

title: Ezekiel 37:22
text: and I will make them one nation in the land, upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all; and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all;

title: Ezekiel 37:23
text: neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwelling-places, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God.

title: Ezekiel 37:24
text: And my servant David shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in mine ordinances, and observe my statutes, and do them.

title: Ezekiel 37:25
text: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children's children, for ever: and David my servant shall be their prince for ever.

title: Ezekiel 37:26
text: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them; and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.

title: Ezekiel 37:27
text: My tabernacle also shall be with them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

title: Ezekiel 37:28
text: And the nations shall know that I am Jehovah that sanctifieth Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.

title: Ezekiel 38:1
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 38:2
text: Son of man, set thy face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

title: Ezekiel 38:3
text: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal:

title: Ezekiel 38:4
text: and I will turn thee about, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed in full armor, a great company with buckler and shield, all of them handling swords;

title: Ezekiel 38:5
text: Persia, Cush, and Put with them, all of them with shield and helmet;

title: Ezekiel 38:6
text: Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes; even many peoples with thee.

title: Ezekiel 38:7
text: Be thou prepared, yea, prepare thyself, thou, and all thy companies that are assembled unto thee, and be thou a guard unto them.

title: Ezekiel 38:8
text: After many days thou shalt be visited: in the latter years thou shalt come into the land that is brought back from the sword, that is gathered out of many peoples, upon the mountains of Israel, which have been a continual waste; but it is brought forth out of the peoples, and they shall dwell securely, all of them.

title: Ezekiel 38:9
text: And thou shalt ascend, thou shalt come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy hordes, and many peoples with thee.

title: Ezekiel 38:10
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: It shall come to pass in that day, that things shall come into thy mind, and thou shalt devise an evil device:

title: Ezekiel 38:11
text: and thou shalt say, I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will go to them that are at rest, that dwell securely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates;

title: Ezekiel 38:12
text: to take the spoil and to take the prey; to turn thy hand against the waste places that are [now] inhabited, and against the people that are gathered out of the nations, that have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the middle of the earth.

title: Ezekiel 38:13
text: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the young lions thereof, shall say unto thee, Art thou come to take the spoil? hast thou assembled thy company to take the prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take great spoil?

title: Ezekiel 38:14
text: Therefore, son of man, prophesy, and say unto Gog, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In that day when my people Israel dwelleth securely, shalt thou not know it?

title: Ezekiel 38:15
text: And thou shalt come from thy place out of the uttermost parts of the north, thou, and many peoples with thee, all of them riding upon horses, a great company and a mighty army;

title: Ezekiel 38:16
text: and thou shalt come up against my people Israel, as a cloud to cover the land: it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring thee against my land, that the nations may know me, when I shall be sanctified in thee, O Gog, before their eyes.

title: Ezekiel 38:17
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Art thou he of whom I spake in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, that prophesied in those days for [many] years that I would bring thee against them?

title: Ezekiel 38:18
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah, that my wrath shall come up into my nostrils.

title: Ezekiel 38:19
text: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel;

title: Ezekiel 38:20
text: so that the fishes of the sea, and the birds of the heavens, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things that creep upon the earth, and all the men that are upon the face of the earth, shall shake at my presence, and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.

title: Ezekiel 38:21
text: And I will call for a sword against him unto all my mountains, saith the Lord Jehovah: every man's sword shall be against his brother.

title: Ezekiel 38:22
text: And with pestilence and with blood will I enter into judgment with him; and I will rain upon him, and upon his hordes, and upon the many peoples that are with him, an overflowing shower, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.

title: Ezekiel 38:23
text: And I will magnify myself, and sanctify myself, and I will make myself known in the eyes of many nations; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 39:1
text: And thou, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal:

title: Ezekiel 39:2
text: and I will turn thee about, and will lead thee on, and will cause thee to come up from the uttermost parts of the north; and I will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel;

title: Ezekiel 39:3
text: and I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand, and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand.

title: Ezekiel 39:4
text: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou, and all thy hordes, and the peoples that are with thee: I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort, and to the beasts of the field to be devoured.

title: Ezekiel 39:5
text: Thou shalt fall upon the open field; for I have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 39:6
text: And I will send a fire on Magog, and on them that dwell securely in the isles; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 39:7
text: And my holy name will I make known in the midst of my people Israel; neither will I suffer my holy name to be profaned any more: and the nations shall know that I am Jehovah, the Holy One in Israel.

title: Ezekiel 39:8
text: Behold, it cometh, and it shall be done, saith the Lord Jehovah; this is the day whereof I have spoken.

title: Ezekiel 39:9
text: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth, and shall make fires of the weapons and burn them, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the handstaves, and the spears, and they shall make fires of them seven years;

title: Ezekiel 39:10
text: so that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests; for they shall make fires of the weapons; and they shall plunder those that plundered them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 39:11
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will give unto Gog a place for burial in Israel, the valley of them that pass through on the east of the sea; and it shall stop them that pass through: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude; and they shall call it The valley of Hamon-gog.

title: Ezekiel 39:12
text: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying them, that they may cleanse the land.

title: Ezekiel 39:13
text: Yea, all the people of the land shall bury them; and it shall be to them a renown in the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 39:14
text: And they shall set apart men of continual employment, that shall pass through the land, and, with them that pass through, those that bury them that remain upon the face of the land, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall they search.

title: Ezekiel 39:15
text: And they that pass through the land shall pass through; and when any seeth a man's bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon-gog.

title: Ezekiel 39:16
text: And Hamonah shall also be the name of a city. Thus shall they cleanse the land.

title: Ezekiel 39:17
text: And thou, son of man, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Speak unto the birds of every sort, and to every beast of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, that ye may eat flesh and drink blood.

title: Ezekiel 39:18
text: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bullocks, all of them fatlings of Bashan.

title: Ezekiel 39:19
text: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full, and drink blood till ye be drunken, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.

title: Ezekiel 39:20
text: And ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 39:21
text: And I will set my glory among the nations; and all the nations shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid upon them.

title: Ezekiel 39:22
text: So the house of Israel shall know that I am Jehovah their God, from that day and forward.

title: Ezekiel 39:23
text: And the nations shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity; because they trespassed against me, and I hid my face from them: so I gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they fell all of them by the sword.

title: Ezekiel 39:24
text: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions did I unto them; and I hid my face from them.

title: Ezekiel 39:25
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Now will I bring back the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel; and I will be jealous for my holy name.

title: Ezekiel 39:26
text: And they shall bear their shame, and all their trespasses whereby they have trespassed against me, when they shall dwell securely in their land, and none shall make them afraid;

title: Ezekiel 39:27
text: when I have brought them back from the peoples, and gathered them out of their enemies' lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations.

title: Ezekiel 39:28
text: And they shall know that I am Jehovah their God, in that I caused them to go into captivity among the nations, and have gathered them unto their own land; and I will leave none of them any more there;

title: Ezekiel 39:29
text: neither will I hide my face any more from them; for I have poured out my Spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 40:1
text: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth [day] of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in the selfsame day, the hand of Jehovah was upon me, and he brought me thither.

title: Ezekiel 40:2
text: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me down upon a very high mountain, whereon was as it were the frame of a city on the south.

title: Ezekiel 40:3
text: And he brought me thither; and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.

title: Ezekiel 40:4
text: And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thy heart upon all that I shall show thee; for, to the intent that I may show them unto thee, art thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 40:5
text: And, behold, a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man's hand a measuring reed six cubits long, of a cubit and a handbreadth each: so he measured the thickness of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

title: Ezekiel 40:6
text: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east, and went up the steps thereof: and he measured the threshold of the gate, one reed broad; and the other threshold, one reed broad.

title: Ezekiel 40:7
text: And every lodge was one reed long, and one reed broad; and [the space] between the lodges was five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate toward the house was one reed.

title: Ezekiel 40:8
text: He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house, one reed.

title: Ezekiel 40:9
text: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was toward the house.

title: Ezekiel 40:10
text: And the lodges of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side; they three were of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.

title: Ezekiel 40:11
text: And he measured the breadth of the opening of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits;

title: Ezekiel 40:12
text: and a border before the lodges, one cubit [on this side], and a border, one cubit on that side; and the lodges, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.

title: Ezekiel 40:13
text: And he measured the gate from the roof of the one lodge to the roof of the other, a breadth of five and twenty cubits; door against door.

title: Ezekiel 40:14
text: He made also posts, threescore cubits; and the court [reached] unto the posts, round about the gate.

title: Ezekiel 40:15
text: And [from] the forefront of the gate at the entrance unto the forefront of the inner porch of the gate were fifty cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:16
text: And there were closed windows to the lodges, and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the arches; and windows were round about inward; and upon [each] post were palm-trees.

title: Ezekiel 40:17
text: Then brought he me into the outer court; and, lo, there were chambers and a pavement, made for the court round about: thirty chambers were upon the pavement.

title: Ezekiel 40:18
text: And the pavement was by the side of the gates, answerable unto the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.

title: Ezekiel 40:19
text: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without, a hundred cubits, [both] on the east and on the north.

title: Ezekiel 40:20
text: And the gate of the outer court whose prospect is toward the north, he measured the length thereof and the breadth thereof.

title: Ezekiel 40:21
text: And the lodges thereof were three on this side and three on that side; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate: the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:22
text: And the windows thereof, and the arches thereof, and the palm-trees thereof, were after the measure of the gate whose prospect is toward the east; and they went up unto it by seven steps; and the arches thereof were before them.

title: Ezekiel 40:23
text: And there was a gate to the inner court over against the [other] gate, [both] on the north and on the east; and he measured from gate to gate a hundred cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:24
text: And he led me toward the south; and, behold, a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.

title: Ezekiel 40:25
text: And there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:26
text: And there were seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof were before them; and it had palm-trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.

title: Ezekiel 40:27
text: And there was a gate to the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south a hundred cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:28
text: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;

title: Ezekiel 40:29
text: and the lodges thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about; it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

title: Ezekiel 40:30
text: And there were arches round about, five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.

title: Ezekiel 40:31
text: And the arches thereof were toward the outer court; and palm-trees were upon the posts thereof: and the ascent to it had eight steps.

title: Ezekiel 40:32
text: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures;

title: Ezekiel 40:33
text: and the lodges thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and there were windows therein and in the arches thereof round about; it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

title: Ezekiel 40:34
text: And the arches thereof were toward the outer court; and palm-trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the ascent to it had eight steps.

title: Ezekiel 40:35
text: And he brought me to the north gate: and he measured [it] according to these measures;

title: Ezekiel 40:36
text: the lodges thereof, the posts thereof, and the arches thereof: and there were windows therein round about; the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:37
text: And the posts thereof were toward the outer court; and palm-trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the ascent to it had eight steps.

title: Ezekiel 40:38
text: And a chamber with the door thereof was by the posts at the gates; there they washed the burnt-offering.

title: Ezekiel 40:39
text: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt-offering and the sin-offering and the trespass-offering.

title: Ezekiel 40:40
text: And on the [one] side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the gate toward the north, were two tables; and on the other side, which belonged to the porch of the gate, were two tables. [

title: Ezekiel 40:41
text: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they slew [the sacrifices] .

title: Ezekiel 40:42
text: And there were four tables for the burnt-offering, of hewn stone, a cubit and a half long, and a cubit and a half broad, and one cubit high; whereupon they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt-offering and the sacrifice.

title: Ezekiel 40:43
text: And the hooks, a handbreadth long, were fastened within round about: and upon the tables was the flesh of the oblation.

title: Ezekiel 40:44
text: And without the inner gate were chambers for the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate; and their prospect was toward the south; one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north.

title: Ezekiel 40:45
text: And he said unto me, This chamber, whose prospect is toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house;

title: Ezekiel 40:46
text: and the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar: these are the sons of Zadok, who from among the sons of Levi come near to Jehovah to minister unto him.

title: Ezekiel 40:47
text: And he measured the court, a hundred cubits long, and a hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar was before the house.

title: Ezekiel 40:48
text: Then he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.

title: Ezekiel 40:49
text: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; even by the steps whereby they went up to it: and there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.

title: Ezekiel 41:1
text: And he brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side, which was the breadth of the tabernacle.

title: Ezekiel 41:2
text: And the breadth of the entrance was ten cubits; and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side: and he measured the length thereof, forty cubits, and the breadth, twenty cubits.

title: Ezekiel 41:3
text: Then went he inward, and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the breadth of the entrance, seven cubits.

title: Ezekiel 41:4
text: And he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits, and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This is the most holy place.

title: Ezekiel 41:5
text: Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of every side-chamber, four cubits, round about the house on every side.

title: Ezekiel 41:6
text: And the side-chambers were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in order; and they entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side-chambers round about, that they might have hold [therein], and not have hold in the wall of the house.

title: Ezekiel 41:7
text: And the side-chambers were broader as they encompassed [the house] higher and higher; for the encompassing of the house went higher and higher round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house [continued] upward; and so one went up [from] the lowest [chamber] to the highest by the middle [chamber] .

title: Ezekiel 41:8
text: I saw also that the house had a raised basement round about: the foundations of the side-chambers were a full reed of six great cubits.

title: Ezekiel 41:9
text: The thickness of the wall, which was for the side-chambers, on the outside, was five cubits: and that which was left was the place of the side-chambers that belonged to the house.

title: Ezekiel 41:10
text: And between the chambers was a breadth of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.

title: Ezekiel 41:11
text: And the doors of the side-chambers were toward [the place] that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south: and the breadth of the place that was left was five cubits round about.

title: Ezekiel 41:12
text: And the building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick round about, and the length thereof ninety cubits.

title: Ezekiel 41:13
text: So he measured the house, a hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with the walls thereof, a hundred cubits long;

title: Ezekiel 41:14
text: also the breadth of the face of the house, and of the separate place toward the east, a hundred cubits.

title: Ezekiel 41:15
text: And he measured the length of the building before the separate place which was at the back thereof, and the galleries thereof on the one side and on the other side, a hundred cubits; and the inner temple, and the porches of the court;

title: Ezekiel 41:16
text: the thresholds, and the closed windows, and the galleries round about on their three stories, over against the threshold, ceiled with wood round about, and [from] the ground up to the windows, (now the windows were covered),

title: Ezekiel 41:17
text: to [the space] above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.

title: Ezekiel 41:18
text: And it was made with cherubim and palm-trees; and a palm-tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces;

title: Ezekiel 41:19
text: so that there was the face of a man toward the palm-tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm-tree on the other side. [thus was it] made through all the house round about:

title: Ezekiel 41:20
text: from the ground unto above the door were cherubim and palm-trees made; thus was the wall of the temple.

title: Ezekiel 41:21
text: As for the temple, the door-posts were squared; and as for the face of the sanctuary, the appearance [thereof] was as the appearance [of the temple] .

title: Ezekiel 41:22
text: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and the length thereof two cubits; and the corners thereof, and the length thereof, and the walls thereof, were of wood: and he said unto me, This is the table that is before Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 41:23
text: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

title: Ezekiel 41:24
text: And the doors had two leaves [apiece], two turning leaves: two [leaves] for the one door, and two leaves for the other.

title: Ezekiel 41:25
text: And there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubim and palm-trees, like as were made upon the walls; and there was a threshold of wood upon the face of the porch without.

title: Ezekiel 41:26
text: And there were closed windows and palm-trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch: thus were the side-chambers of the house, and the thresholds.

title: Ezekiel 42:1
text: Then he brought me forth into the outer court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that was over against the separate place, and which was over against the building toward the north.

title: Ezekiel 42:2
text: Before the length of a hundred cubits was the north door, and the breadth was fifty cubits.

title: Ezekiel 42:3
text: Over against the twenty [cubits] which belonged to the inner court, and over against the pavement which belonged to the outer court, was gallery against gallery in the third story.

title: Ezekiel 42:4
text: And before the chambers was a walk of ten cubits' breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors were toward the north.

title: Ezekiel 42:5
text: Now the upper chambers were shorter; for the galleries took away from these, more than from the lower and the middlemost, in the building.

title: Ezekiel 42:6
text: For they were in three stories, and they had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore [the uppermost] was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.

title: Ezekiel 42:7
text: And the wall that was without by the side of the chambers, toward the outer court before the chambers, the length thereof was fifty cubits.

title: Ezekiel 42:8
text: For the length of the chambers that were in the outer court was fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple were a hundred cubits.

title: Ezekiel 42:9
text: And from under these chambers was the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the outer court.

title: Ezekiel 42:10
text: In the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, before the separate place, and before the building, there were chambers.

title: Ezekiel 42:11
text: And the way before them was like the appearance of [the way of] the chambers which were toward the north; according to their length so was their breadth: and all their egresses were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.

title: Ezekiel 42:12
text: And according to the doors of the chambers that were toward the south was a door at the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.

title: Ezekiel 42:13
text: Then said he unto me, The north chambers and the south chambers, which are before the separate place, they are the holy chambers, where the priests that are near unto Jehovah shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meal-offering, and the sin-offering, and the trespass-offering; for the place is holy.

title: Ezekiel 42:14
text: When the priests enter in, then shall they not go out of the holy place into the outer court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they are holy: and they shall put on other garments, and shall approach to that which pertaineth to the people.

title: Ezekiel 42:15
text: Now when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east, and measured it round about.

title: Ezekiel 42:16
text: He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.

title: Ezekiel 42:17
text: He measured on the north side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed round about.

title: Ezekiel 42:18
text: He measured on the south side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

title: Ezekiel 42:19
text: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

title: Ezekiel 42:20
text: He measured it on the four sides: it had a wall round about, the length five hundred, and the breadth five hundred, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common. [

title: Ezekiel 43:1
text: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looketh toward the east.

title: Ezekiel 43:2
text: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth shined with his glory.

title: Ezekiel 43:3
text: And it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city; and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.

title: Ezekiel 43:4
text: And the glory of Jehovah came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east.

title: Ezekiel 43:5
text: And the Spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of Jehovah filled the house.

title: Ezekiel 43:6
text: And I heard one speaking unto me out of the house; and a man stood by me.

title: Ezekiel 43:7
text: And he said unto me, Son of man, [this is] the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever. And the house of Israel shall no more defile my holy name, neither they, nor their kings, by their whoredom, and by the dead bodies of their kings [in] their high places;

title: Ezekiel 43:8
text: in their setting of their threshold by my threshold, and their door-post beside my door-post, and there was [but] the wall between me and them; and they have defiled my holy name by their abominations which they have committed: wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger.

title: Ezekiel 43:9
text: Now let them put away their whoredom, and the dead bodies of their kings, far from me; and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.

title: Ezekiel 43:10
text: Thou, son of man, show the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure the pattern.

title: Ezekiel 43:11
text: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, make known unto them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the egresses thereof, and the entrances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof; and write it in their sight; that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.

title: Ezekiel 43:12
text: This is the law of the house: upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.

title: Ezekiel 43:13
text: And these are the measures of the altar by cubits (the cubit is a cubit and a handbreadth): the bottom shall be a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about a span; and this shall be the base of the altar.

title: Ezekiel 43:14
text: And from the bottom upon the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser ledge to the greater ledge shall be four cubits, and the breadth a cubit.

title: Ezekiel 43:15
text: And the upper altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar hearth and upward there shall be four horns.

title: Ezekiel 43:16
text: And the altar hearth shall be twelve [cubits] long by twelve broad, square in the four sides thereof.

title: Ezekiel 43:17
text: And the ledge shall be fourteen [cubits] long by fourteen broad in the four sides thereof; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and the bottom thereof shall be a cubit round about; and the steps thereof shall look toward the east.

title: Ezekiel 43:18
text: And he said unto me, Son of man, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt-offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.

title: Ezekiel 43:19
text: Thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that are of the seed of Zadok, who are near unto me, to minister unto me, saith the Lord Jehovah, a young bullock for a sin-offering.

title: Ezekiel 43:20
text: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof, and put it on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the ledge, and upon the border round about: thus shalt thou cleanse it and make atonement for it.

title: Ezekiel 43:21
text: Thou shalt also take the bullock of the sin-offering, and it shall be burnt in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.

title: Ezekiel 43:22
text: And on the second day thou shalt offer a he-goat without blemish for a sin-offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse it with the bullock.

title: Ezekiel 43:23
text: When thou hast made an end of cleansing it, thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.

title: Ezekiel 43:24
text: And thou shalt bring them near before Jehovah, and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt-offering unto Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 43:25
text: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin-offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.

title: Ezekiel 43:26
text: Seven days shall they make atonement for the altar and purify it; so shall they consecrate it.

title: Ezekiel 43:27
text: And when they have accomplished the days, it shall be that upon the eighth day, and forward, the priests shall make your burnt-offerings upon the altar, and your peace-offerings; and I will accept you, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 44:1
text: Then he brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which looketh toward the east; and it was shut.

title: Ezekiel 44:2
text: And Jehovah said unto me, This gate shall be shut; it shall not be opened, neither shall any man enter in by it; for Jehovah, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it; therefore it shall be shut.

title: Ezekiel 44:3
text: As for the prince, he shall sit therein as prince to eat bread before Jehovah; he shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.

title: Ezekiel 44:4
text: Then he brought me by the way of the north gate before the house; and I looked, and, behold, the glory of Jehovah filled the house of Jehovah: and I fell upon my face.

title: Ezekiel 44:5
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of Jehovah, and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entrance of the house, with every egress of the sanctuary.

title: Ezekiel 44:6
text: And thou shalt say to the rebellious, even to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,

title: Ezekiel 44:7
text: in that ye have brought in foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to profane it, even my house, when ye offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant, [to add] unto all your abominations.

title: Ezekiel 44:8
text: And ye have not kept the charge of my holy things; but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.

title: Ezekiel 44:9
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any foreigners that are among the children of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 44:10
text: But the Levites that went far from me, when Israel went astray, that went astray from me after their idols, they shall bear their iniquity.

title: Ezekiel 44:11
text: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house, and ministering in the house: they shall slay the burnt-offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.

title: Ezekiel 44:12
text: Because they ministered unto them before their idols, and became a stumblingblock of iniquity unto the house of Israel; therefore have I lifted up my hand against them, saith the Lord Jehovah, and they shall bear their iniquity.

title: Ezekiel 44:13
text: And they shall not come near unto me, to execute the office of priest unto me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, unto the things that are most holy; but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.

title: Ezekiel 44:14
text: Yet will I make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.

title: Ezekiel 44:15
text: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister unto me; and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood, saith the Lord Jehovah:

title: Ezekiel 44:16
text: they shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister unto me, and they shall keep my charge.

title: Ezekiel 44:17
text: And it shall be that, when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, while they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.

title: Ezekiel 44:18
text: They shall have linen tires upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird themselves with [anything that causeth] sweat.

title: Ezekiel 44:19
text: And when they go forth into the outer court, even into the outer court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they minister, and lay them in the holy chambers; and they shall put on other garments, that they sanctify not the people with their garments.

title: Ezekiel 44:20
text: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only cut off the hair of their heads.

title: Ezekiel 44:21
text: Neither shall any of the priests drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.

title: Ezekiel 44:22
text: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away; but they shall take virgins of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that is the widow of a priest.

title: Ezekiel 44:23
text: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

title: Ezekiel 44:24
text: And in a controversy they shall stand to judge; according to mine ordinances shall they judge it: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all my appointed feasts; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.

title: Ezekiel 44:25
text: And they shall go in to no dead person to defile themselves; but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that hath had no husband, they may defile themselves.

title: Ezekiel 44:26
text: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.

title: Ezekiel 44:27
text: And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary, into the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin-offering, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 44:28
text: And they shall have an inheritance: I am their inheritance; and ye shall give them no possession in Israel; I am their possession.

title: Ezekiel 44:29
text: They shall eat the meal-offering, and the sin-offering, and the trespass-offering; and every devoted thing in Israel shall be theirs.

title: Ezekiel 44:30
text: And the first of all the first-fruits of every thing, and every oblation of everything, of all your oblations, shall be for the priest: ye shall also give unto the priests the first of your [ dough, to cause a blessing to rest on thy house.

title: Ezekiel 44:31
text: The priests shall not eat of anything that dieth of itself, or is torn, whether it be bird or beast.

title: Ezekiel 45:1
text: Moreover, when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, ye shall offer an oblation unto Jehovah, a holy portion of the land; the length shall be the length of five and twenty thousand [reeds], and the breadth shall be ten thousand: it shall be holy in all the border thereof round about.

title: Ezekiel 45:2
text: Of this there shall be for the holy place five hundred [in length] by five hundred [in breadth], square round about; and fifty cubits for the suburbs thereof round about.

title: Ezekiel 45:3
text: And of this measure shalt thou measure a length of five and twenty thousand, and a breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary, which is most holy.

title: Ezekiel 45:4
text: It is a holy portion of the land; it shall be for the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, that come near to minister unto Jehovah; and it shall be a place for their houses, and a holy place for the sanctuary.

title: Ezekiel 45:5
text: And five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth, shall be unto the Levites, the ministers of the house, for a possession unto themselves, [for] twenty chambers.

title: Ezekiel 45:6
text: And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, side by side with the oblation of the holy portion: it shall be for the whole house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 45:7
text: And [whatsoever is] for the prince [shall be] on the one side and on the other side of the holy oblation and of the possession of the city, in front of the holy oblation and in front of the possession of the city, on the west side westward, and on the east side eastward; and in length answerable unto one of the portions, from the west border unto the east border.

title: Ezekiel 45:8
text: In the land it shall be to him for a possession in Israel: and my princes shall no more oppress my people; but they shall give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.

title: Ezekiel 45:9
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Let it suffice you, O princes of Israel: remove violence and spoil, and execute justice and righteousness; take away your exactions from my people, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 45:10
text: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.

title: Ezekiel 45:11
text: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of a homer, and the ephah the tenth part of a homer: the measure thereof shall be after the homer.

title: Ezekiel 45:12
text: And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs; twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.

title: Ezekiel 45:13
text: This is the oblation that ye shall offer: the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of wheat; and ye shall give the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of barley;

title: Ezekiel 45:14
text: and the set portion of oil, of the bath of oil, the tenth part of a bath out of the cor, [which is] ten baths, even a homer; (for ten baths are a homer;)

title: Ezekiel 45:15
text: and one lamb of the flock, out of two hundred, from the well-watered pastures of Israel;--for a meal-offering, and for a burnt-offering, and for peace-offerings, to make atonement for them, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 45:16
text: All the people of the land shall give unto this oblation for the prince in Israel.

title: Ezekiel 45:17
text: And it shall be the prince's part to give the burnt-offerings, and the meal-offerings, and the drink-offerings, in the feasts, and on the new moons, and on the sabbaths, in all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel: he shall prepare the sin-offering, and the meal-offering, and the burnt-offering, and the peace-offerings, to make atonement for the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 45:18
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In the first [month], in the first [day] of the month, thou shalt take a young bullock without blemish; and thou shalt cleanse the sanctuary.

title: Ezekiel 45:19
text: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin-offering, and put it upon the door-posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.

title: Ezekiel 45:20
text: And so thou shalt do on the seventh [day] of the month for every one that erreth, and for him that is simple: so shall ye make atonement for the house.

title: Ezekiel 45:21
text: In the first [month], in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

title: Ezekiel 45:22
text: And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock for a sin-offering.

title: Ezekiel 45:23
text: And the seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt-offering to Jehovah, seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a he-goat daily for a sin-offering.

title: Ezekiel 45:24
text: And he shall prepare a meal-offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

title: Ezekiel 45:25
text: In the seventh [month], in the fifteenth day of the month, in the feast, shall he do the like the seven days; according to the sin-offering, according to the burnt-offering, and according to the meal-offering, and according to the oil.

title: Ezekiel 46:1
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath day it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.

title: Ezekiel 46:2
text: And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate; and the priests shall prepare his burnt-offering and his peace-offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

title: Ezekiel 46:3
text: And the people of the land shall worship at the door of that gate before Jehovah on the sabbaths and on the new moons.

title: Ezekiel 46:4
text: And the burnt-offering that the prince shall offer unto Jehovah shall be on the sabbath day six lambs without blemish and a ram without blemish;

title: Ezekiel 46:5
text: and the meal-offering shall be an ephah for the ram, and the meal-offering for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

title: Ezekiel 46:6
text: And on the day of the new moon it shall be a young bullock without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram; they shall be without blemish:

title: Ezekiel 46:7
text: and he shall prepare a meal-offering, an ephah for the bullock, and an ephah for the ram, and for the lambs according as he is able, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

title: Ezekiel 46:8
text: And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of the gate, and he shall go forth by the way thereof.

title: Ezekiel 46:9
text: But when the people of the land shall come before Jehovah in the appointed feasts, he that entereth by the way of the north gate to worship shall go forth by the way of the south gate; and he that entereth by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate: he shall not return by the way of the gate whereby he came in, but shall go forth straight before him.

title: Ezekiel 46:10
text: And the prince, when they go in, shall go in in the midst of them; and when they go forth, they shall go forth [together] .

title: Ezekiel 46:11
text: And in the feasts and in the solemnities the meal-offering shall be an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

title: Ezekiel 46:12
text: And when the prince shall prepare a freewill-offering, a burnt-offering or peace-offerings as a freewill-offering unto Jehovah, one shall open for him the gate that looketh toward the east; and he shall prepare his burnt-offering and his peace-offerings, as he doth on the sabbath day: then he shall go forth; and after his going forth one shall shut the gate.

title: Ezekiel 46:13
text: And thou shalt prepare a lamb a year old without blemish for a burnt-offering unto Jehovah daily: morning by morning shalt thou prepare it.

title: Ezekiel 46:14
text: And thou shalt prepare a meal-offering with it morning by morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of a hin of oil, to moisten the fine flour; a meal-offering unto Jehovah continually by a perpetual ordinance.

title: Ezekiel 46:15
text: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meal-offering, and the oil, morning by morning, for a continual burnt-offering.

title: Ezekiel 46:16
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: If the prince give a gift unto any of his sons, it is his inheritance, it shall belong to his sons; it is their possession by inheritance.

title: Ezekiel 46:17
text: But if he give of his inheritance a gift to one of his servants, it shall be his to the year of liberty; then it shall return to the prince; but as for his inheritance, it shall be for his sons.

title: Ezekiel 46:18
text: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people's inheritance, to thrust them out of their possession; he shall give inheritance to his sons out of his own possession, that my people be not scattered every man from his possession.

title: Ezekiel 46:19
text: Then he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers for the priests, which looked toward the north: and, behold, there was a place on the hinder part westward.

title: Ezekiel 46:20
text: And he said unto me, This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass-offering and the sin-offering, [and] where they shall bake the meal-offering; that they bring them not forth into the outer court, to sanctify the people.

title: Ezekiel 46:21
text: Then he brought me forth into the outer court, and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and, behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.

title: Ezekiel 46:22
text: In the four corners of the court there were courts inclosed, forty [cubits] long and thirty broad: these four in the corners were of one measure.

title: Ezekiel 46:23
text: And there was a wall round about in them, round about the four, and boiling-places were made under the walls round about.

title: Ezekiel 46:24
text: Then said he unto me, These are the boiling-houses, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.

title: Ezekiel 47:1
text: And he brought me back unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward; (for the forefront of the house was toward the east;) and the waters came down from under, from the right side of the house, on the south of the altar.

title: Ezekiel 47:2
text: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me round by the way without unto the outer gate, by the way of [the gate] that looketh toward the east; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.

title: Ezekiel 47:3
text: When the man went forth eastward with the line in his hand, he measured a thousand cubits, and he caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the ankles.

title: Ezekiel 47:4
text: Again he measured a thousand, and caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and caused me to pass through [the waters], waters that were to the loins.

title: Ezekiel 47:5
text: Afterward he measured a thousand; [and it was] a river that I could not pass through; for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed through.

title: Ezekiel 47:6
text: And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen [this] ? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the bank of the river.

title: Ezekiel 47:7
text: Now when I had returned, behold, upon the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.

title: Ezekiel 47:8
text: Then said he unto me, These waters issue forth toward the eastern region, and shall go down into the Arabah; and they shall go toward the sea; into the sea [shall the waters go] which were made to issue forth; and the waters shall be healed.

title: Ezekiel 47:9
text: And it shall come to pass, that every living creature which swarmeth, in every place whither the rivers come, shall live; and there shall be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters are come thither, and [the waters of the sea] shall be healed, and everything shall live whithersoever the river cometh.

title: Ezekiel 47:10
text: And it shall come to pass, that fishers shall stand by it: from En-gedi even unto En-eglaim shall be a place for the spreading of nets; their fish shall be after their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.

title: Ezekiel 47:11
text: But the miry places thereof, and the marshes thereof, shall not be healed; they shall be given up to salt.

title: Ezekiel 47:12
text: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow every tree for food, whose leaf shall not whither, neither shall the fruit thereof fail: it shall bring forth new fruit every month, because the waters thereof issue out of the sanctuary; and the fruit thereof shall be for food, and the leaf thereof for healing.

title: Ezekiel 47:13
text: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: This shall be the border, whereby ye shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph [shall have two] portions.

title: Ezekiel 47:14
text: And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another; for I sware to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.

title: Ezekiel 47:15
text: And this shall be the border of the land: On the north side, from the great sea, by the way of Hethlon, unto the entrance of Zedad;

title: Ezekiel 47:16
text: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazer-hatticon, which is by the border of Hauran.

title: Ezekiel 47:17
text: And the border from the sea, shall be Hazar-enon at the border of Damascus; and on the north northward is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.

title: Ezekiel 47:18
text: And the east side, between Hauran and Damascus and Gilead, and the land of Israel, shall be the Jordan; from the [north] border unto the east sea shall ye measure. This is the east side.

title: Ezekiel 47:19
text: And the south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth-kadesh, to the brook [of Egypt], unto the great sea. This is the south side southward.

title: Ezekiel 47:20
text: And the west side shall be the great sea, from the [south] border as far as over against the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.

title: Ezekiel 47:21
text: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 47:22
text: And it shall come to pass, that ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you and to the strangers that sojourn among you, who shall beget children among you; and they shall be unto you as the home-born among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 47:23
text: And it shall come to pass, that in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give him his inheritance, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 48:1
text: Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar-enan at the border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath, (and they shall have their sides east [and] west,) Dan, one [portion] .

title: Ezekiel 48:2
text: And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, Asher, one [portion] .

title: Ezekiel 48:3
text: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, Naphtali, one [portion] .

title: Ezekiel 48:4
text: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side, Manasseh, one [portion] .

title: Ezekiel 48:5
text: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side, Ephraim, one [portion] .

title: Ezekiel 48:6
text: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side, Reuben, one [portion] .

title: Ezekiel 48:7
text: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, Judah, one [portion] .

title: Ezekiel 48:8
text: And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the oblation which ye shall offer, five and twenty thousand [reeds] in breadth, and in length as one of the portions, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.

title: Ezekiel 48:9
text: The oblation that ye shall offer unto Jehovah shall be five and twenty thousand [reeds] in length, and ten thousand in breadth.

title: Ezekiel 48:10
text: And for these, even for the priests, shall be the holy oblation: toward the north five and twenty thousand [in length], and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of Jehovah shall be in the midst thereof.

title: Ezekiel 48:11
text: [It shall be] for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok, that have kept my charge, that went not astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray. [

title: Ezekiel 48:12
text: And it shall be unto them an oblation from the oblation of the land, a thing most holy, by the border of the Levites.

title: Ezekiel 48:13
text: And answerable unto the border of the priests, the Levites shall have five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length shall be five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.

title: Ezekiel 48:14
text: And they shall sell none of it, nor exchange it, nor shall the first-fruits of the land be alienated; for it is holy unto Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 48:15
text: And the five thousand that are left in the breadth, in front of the five and twenty thousand, shall be for common use, for the city, for dwelling and for suburbs; and the city shall be in the midst thereof.

title: Ezekiel 48:16
text: And these shall be the measures thereof: the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.

title: Ezekiel 48:17
text: And the city shall have suburbs: toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.

title: Ezekiel 48:18
text: And the residue in the length, answerable unto the holy oblation, shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward; and it shall be answerable unto the holy oblation; and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that labor in the city.

title: Ezekiel 48:19
text: And they that labor in the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall till it.

title: Ezekiel 48:20
text: All the oblation shall be five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: ye shall offer the holy oblation four-square, with the possession of the city.

title: Ezekiel 48:21
text: And the residue shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation and of the possession of the city; in front of the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward in front of the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, answerable unto the portions, it shall be for the prince: and the holy oblation and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the midst thereof.

title: Ezekiel 48:22
text: Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the midst of that which is the prince's, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, it shall be for the prince.

title: Ezekiel 48:23
text: And as for the rest of the tribes: from the east side unto the west side, Benjamin, one [portion] .

title: Ezekiel 48:24
text: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side unto the west side, Simeon, one [portion] .

title: Ezekiel 48:25
text: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side unto the west side, Issachar, one [portion] .

title: Ezekiel 48:26
text: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side unto the west side, Zebulun, one [portion] .

title: Ezekiel 48:27
text: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto the west side, Gad, one [portion] .

title: Ezekiel 48:28
text: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar unto the waters of Meribath-kadesh, to the brook [of Egypt], unto the great sea.

title: Ezekiel 48:29
text: This is the land which ye shall divide by lot unto the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their several portions, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 48:30
text: And these are the egresses of the city: On the north side four thousand and five hundred [reeds] by measure;

title: Ezekiel 48:31
text: and the gates of the city shall be after the names of the tribes of Israel, three gates northward: the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one.

title: Ezekiel 48:32
text: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred [reeds], and three gates: even the gate of Joseph, one; the gate of Benjamin, one; the gate of Dan, one.

title: Ezekiel 48:33
text: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred [reeds] by measure, and three gates: the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; the gate of Zebulun, one.

title: Ezekiel 48:34
text: At the west side four thousand and five hundred [reeds], with their three gates: the gate of Gad, one; the gate of Asher, one; the gate of Naphtali, one.

title: Ezekiel 48:35
text: It shall be eighteen thousand [reeds] round about: and the name of the city from that day shall be, Jehovah is there.

title: Daniel 1:1
text: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon unto Jerusalem, and besieged it.

title: Daniel 1:2
text: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of God; and he carried them into the land of Shinar to the house of his god: and he brought the vessels into the treasure-house of his god.

title: Daniel 1:3
text: And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring in [certain] of the children of Israel, even of the seed royal and of the nobles;

title: Daniel 1:4
text: youths in whom was no blemish, but well-favored, and skilful in all wisdom, and endued with knowledge, and understanding science, and such as had ability to stand in the king's palace; and that he should teach them the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans.

title: Daniel 1:5
text: And the king appointed for them a daily portion of the king's dainties, and of the wine which he drank, and that they should be nourished three years; that at the end thereof they should stand before the king.

title: Daniel 1:6
text: Now among these were, of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

title: Daniel 1:7
text: And the prince of the eunuchs gave names unto them: unto Daniel he gave [the name of] Belteshazzar; and to Hananiah, [of] Shadrach; and to Mishael, [of] Meshach; and to Azariah, [of] Abed-nego.

title: Daniel 1:8
text: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king's dainties, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

title: Daniel 1:9
text: Now God made Daniel to find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.

title: Daniel 1:10
text: And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who hath appointed your food and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse looking than the youths that are of your own age? so would ye endanger my head with the king.

title: Daniel 1:11
text: Then said Daniel to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:

title: Daniel 1:12
text: Prove thy servants, I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us pulse to eat, and water to drink.

title: Daniel 1:13
text: Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee, and the countenance of the youths that eat of the king's dainties; and as thou seest, deal with thy servants.

title: Daniel 1:14
text: So he hearkened unto them in this matter, and proved them ten days.

title: Daniel 1:15
text: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer, and they were fatter in flesh, than all the youths that did eat of the king's dainties.

title: Daniel 1:16
text: So the steward took away their dainties, and the wine that they should drink, and gave them pulse.

title: Daniel 1:17
text: Now as for these four youths, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom: and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.

title: Daniel 1:18
text: And at the end of the days which the king had appointed for bringing them in, the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.

title: Daniel 1:19
text: And the king communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah: therefore stood they before the king.

title: Daniel 1:20
text: And in every matter of wisdom and understanding, concerning which the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters that were in all his realm.

title: Daniel 1:21
text: And Daniel continued even unto the first year of king Cyrus.

title: Daniel 2:1
text: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams; and his spirit was troubled, and his sleep went from him.

title: Daniel 2:2
text: Then the king commanded to call the magicians, and the enchanters, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, to tell the king his dreams. So they came in and stood before the king.

title: Daniel 2:3
text: And the king said unto them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit is troubled to know the dream.

title: Daniel 2:4
text: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in the Syrian language, O king, live for ever: tell thy servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.

title: Daniel 2:5
text: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The thing is gone from me: if ye make not known unto me the dream and the interpretation thereof, ye shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made a dunghill.

title: Daniel 2:6
text: But if ye show the dream and the interpretation thereof, ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honor: therefore show me the dream and the interpretation thereof.

title: Daniel 2:7
text: They answered the second time and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.

title: Daniel 2:8
text: The king answered and said, I know of a certainty that ye would gain time, because ye see the thing is gone from me.

title: Daniel 2:9
text: But if ye make not known unto me the dream, there is but one law for you; for ye have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, till the time be changed: therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that ye can show me the interpretation thereof.

title: Daniel 2:10
text: The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, There is not a man upon the earth that can show the king's matter, forasmuch as no king, lord, or ruler, hath asked such a thing of any magician, or enchanter, or Chaldean.

title: Daniel 2:11
text: And it is a rare thing that the king requireth, and there is no other that can show it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.

title: Daniel 2:12
text: For this cause the king was angry and very furious, and commanded to destroy all the wise men of Babylon.

title: Daniel 2:13
text: So the decree went forth, and the wise men were to be slain; and they sought Daniel and his companions to be slain.

title: Daniel 2:14
text: Then Daniel returned answer with counsel and prudence to Arioch the captain of the king's guard, who was gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon;

title: Daniel 2:15
text: he answered and said to Arioch the king's captain, Wherefore is the decree so urgent from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.

title: Daniel 2:16
text: And Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would appoint him a time, and he would show the king the interpretation.

title: Daniel 2:17
text: Then Daniel went to his house, and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:

title: Daniel 2:18
text: that they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his companions should nor perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.

title: Daniel 2:19
text: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a vision of the night. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.

title: Daniel 2:20
text: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever; for wisdom and might are his.

title: Daniel 2:21
text: And he changeth the times and the seasons; he removeth kings, and setteth up kings; he giveth wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that have understanding;

title: Daniel 2:22
text: he revealeth the deep and secret things; he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.

title: Daniel 2:23
text: I thank thee, and praise thee, O thou God of my fathers, who hast given me wisdom and might, and hast now made known unto me what we desired of thee; for thou hast made known unto us the king's matter.

title: Daniel 2:24
text: Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch, whom the king had appointed to destroy the wise men of Babylon; he went and said thus unto him: Destroy not the wise men of Babylon; bring me in before the king, and I will show unto the king the interpretation.

title: Daniel 2:25
text: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said thus unto him, I have found a man of the children of the captivity of Judah, that will make known unto the king the interpretation.

title: Daniel 2:26
text: The king answered and said to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, Art thou able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen, and the interpretation thereof?

title: Daniel 2:27
text: Daniel answered before the king, and said, The secret which the king hath demanded can neither wise men, enchanters, magicians, nor soothsayers, show unto the king;

title: Daniel 2:28
text: but there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets, and he hath made known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Thy dream, and the visions of thy head upon thy bed, are these:

title: Daniel 2:29
