text: Then came the disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, when they heard this saying?

title: Matthew 15:13
text: But he answered and said, Every plant which my heavenly Father planted not, shall be rooted up.

title: Matthew 15:14
text: Let them alone: they are blind guides. And if the blind guide the blind, both shall fall into a pit.

title: Matthew 15:15
text: And Peter answered and said unto him, Declare unto us the parable.

title: Matthew 15:16
text: And he said, Are ye also even yet without understanding?

title: Matthew 15:17
text: Perceive ye not, that whatsoever goeth into the mouth passeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?

title: Matthew 15:18
text: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come forth out of the heart; and they defile the man.

title: Matthew 15:19
text: For out of the heart come forth evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, railings:

title: Matthew 15:20
text: these are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not the man.

title: Matthew 15:21
text: And Jesus went out thence, and withdrew into the parts of Tyre and Sidon.

title: Matthew 15:22
text: And behold, a Canaanitish woman came out from those borders, and cried, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a demon.

title: Matthew 15:23
text: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.

title: Matthew 15:24
text: But he answered and said, I was not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

title: Matthew 15:25
text: But she came and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.

title: Matthew 15:26
text: And he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread and cast it to the dogs.

title: Matthew 15:27
text: But she said, Yea, Lord: for even the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.

title: Matthew 15:28
text: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it done unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was healed from that hour.

title: Matthew 15:29
text: And Jesus departed thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and he went up into the mountain, and sat there.

title: Matthew 15:30
text: And there came unto him great multitudes, having with them the lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and they cast them down at this feet; and he healed them:

title: Matthew 15:31
text: insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb speaking, the maimed whole, and lame walking, and the blind seeing: and they glorified the God of Israel.

title: Matthew 15:32
text: And Jesus called unto him his disciples, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days and have nothing to eat: and I would not send them away fasting, lest haply they faint on the way.

title: Matthew 15:33
text: And the disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so many loaves in a desert place as to fill so great a multitude?

title: Matthew 15:34
text: And Jesus said unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few small fishes.

title: Matthew 15:35
text: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

title: Matthew 15:36
text: and he took the seven loaves and the fishes; and he gave thanks and brake, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

title: Matthew 15:37
text: And they all ate, and were filled: and they took up that which remained over of the broken pieces, seven baskets full.

title: Matthew 15:38
text: And they that did eat were four thousand men, besides women and children.

title: Matthew 15:39
text: And he sent away the multitudes, and entered into the boat, and came into the borders of Magadan.

title: Matthew 16:1
text: And the Pharisees and Sadducees came, and trying him asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

title: Matthew 16:2
text: But he answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, [It will be] fair weather: for the heaven is red.

title: Matthew 16:3
text: And in the morning, [It will be] foul weather to-day: for the heaven is red and lowering. Ye know how to discern the face of the heaven; but ye cannot [discern] the signs of the times.

title: Matthew 16:4
text: An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of Jonah. And he left them, and departed.

title: Matthew 16:5
text: And the disciples came to the other side and forgot to take bread.

title: Matthew 16:6
text: And Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

title: Matthew 16:7
text: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, We took no bread.

title: Matthew 16:8
text: And Jesus perceiving it said, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have no bread?

title: Matthew 16:9
text: Do ye not yet perceive, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

title: Matthew 16:10
text: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

title: Matthew 16:11
text: How is it that ye do not perceive that I spake not to you concerning bread? But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

title: Matthew 16:12
text: Then understood they that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

title: Matthew 16:13
text: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Who do men say that the Son of man is?

title: Matthew 16:14
text: And they said, Some [say] John the Baptist; some, Elijah; and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.

title: Matthew 16:15
text: He saith unto them, But who say ye that I am?

title: Matthew 16:16
text: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

title: Matthew 16:17
text: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar-jonah: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father who is in heaven.

title: Matthew 16:18
text: And I also say unto thee, that thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of Hades shall not prevail against it.

title: Matthew 16:19
text: I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven; and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

title: Matthew 16:20
text: Then charged he the disciples that they should tell no man that he was the Christ.

title: Matthew 16:21
text: From that time began Jesus to show unto his disciples, that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

title: Matthew 16:22
text: And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall never be unto thee.

title: Matthew 16:23
text: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art a stumbling-block unto me: for thou mindest not the things of God, but the things of men.

title: Matthew 16:24
text: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man would come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

title: Matthew 16:25
text: For whosoever would save his life shall lose it: and whosoever shall lose his life for my sake shall find it.

title: Matthew 16:26
text: For what shall a man be profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and forfeit his life? or what shall a man give in exchange for his life?

title: Matthew 16:27
text: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then shall he render unto every man according to his deeds.

title: Matthew 16:28
text: Verily I say unto you, there are some of them that stand here, who shall in no wise taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.

title: Matthew 17:1
text: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into a high mountain apart:

title: Matthew 17:2
text: and he was transfigured before them; and his face did shine as the sun, and his garments became white as the light.

title: Matthew 17:3
text: And behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elijah talking with him.

title: Matthew 17:4
text: And Peter answered, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, I will make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

title: Matthew 17:5
text: While he was yet speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold, a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.

title: Matthew 17:6
text: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.

title: Matthew 17:7
text: And Jesus came and touched them and said, Arise, and be not afraid.

title: Matthew 17:8
text: And lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, save Jesus only.

title: Matthew 17:9
text: And as they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen from the dead.

title: Matthew 17:10
text: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elijah must first come?

title: Matthew 17:11
text: And he answered and said, Elijah indeed cometh, and shall restore all things:

title: Matthew 17:12
text: but I say into you, that Elijah is come already, and they knew him not, but did unto him whatsoever they would. Even so shall the Son of man also suffer of them.

title: Matthew 17:13
text: Then understood the disciples that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.

title: Matthew 17:14
text: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a man, kneeling to him, saying,

title: Matthew 17:15
text: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is epileptic, and suffereth grievously; for oft-times he falleth into the fire, and oft-times into the water.

title: Matthew 17:16
text: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.

title: Matthew 17:17
text: And Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I bear with you? bring him hither to me.

title: Matthew 17:18
text: And Jesus rebuked him; and the demon went out of him: and the boy was cured from that hour.

title: Matthew 17:19
text: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast it out?

title: Matthew 17:20
text: And he saith unto them, Because of your little faith: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

title: Matthew 17:22
text: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be delivered up into the hands of men;

title: Matthew 17:23
text: and they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised up. And they were exceeding sorry.

title: Matthew 17:24
text: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received the half-shekel came to Peter, and said, Doth not your teacher pay the half-shekel?

title: Matthew 17:25
text: He saith, Yea. And when he came into the house, Jesus spake first to him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? the kings of the earth, from whom do they receive toll or tribute? from their sons, or from strangers?

title: Matthew 17:26
text: And when he said, From strangers, Jesus said unto him, Therefore the sons are free.

title: Matthew 17:27
text: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go thou to the sea, and cast a hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a shekel: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.

title: Matthew 18:1
text: In that hour came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who then is greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

title: Matthew 18:2
text: And he called to him a little child, and set him in the midst of them,

title: Matthew 18:3
text: and said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye turn, and become as little children, ye shall in no wise enter into the kingdom of heaven.

title: Matthew 18:4
text: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

title: Matthew 18:5
text: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me:

title: Matthew 18:6
text: But whoso shall cause one of these little ones that believe on me to stumble, it is profitable for him that a great millstone should be hanged about his neck, and [that] he should be sunk in the depth of the sea.

title: Matthew 18:7
text: Woe unto the world because of occasions of stumbling! for it must needs be that the occasions come; but woe to that man through whom the occasion cometh!

title: Matthew 18:8
text: And if thy hand or thy foot causeth thee to stumble, cut it off, and cast it from thee: it is good for thee to enter into life maimed or halt, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.

title: Matthew 18:9
text: And if thine eye causeth thee to stumble, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is good for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the hell of fire. [

title: Matthew 18:10
text: See that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, that in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father who is in heaven.

title: Matthew 18:11
text: (Ommitted)

title: Matthew 18:12
text: How think ye? if any man have a hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and go unto the mountains, and seek that which goeth astray?

title: Matthew 18:13
text: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth over it more than over the ninety and nine which have not gone astray.

title: Matthew 18:14
text: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.

title: Matthew 18:15
text: And if thy brother sin against thee, go, show him his fault between thee and him alone: if he hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.

title: Matthew 18:16
text: But if he hear [thee] not, take with thee one or two more, that at the mouth of two witnesses or three every word may be established.

title: Matthew 18:17
text: And if he refuse to hear them, tell it unto the church: and if he refuse to hear the church also, let him be unto thee as the Gentile and the publican.

title: Matthew 18:18
text: Verily I say unto you, what things soever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven; and what things soever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

title: Matthew 18:19
text: Again I say unto you, that if two of you shall agree on earth as touching anything that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father who is in heaven.

title: Matthew 18:20
text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

title: Matthew 18:21
text: Then came Peter and said to him, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? until seven times?

title: Matthew 18:22
text: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times; but, Until seventy times seven.

title: Matthew 18:23
text: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, who would make a reckoning with his servants.

title: Matthew 18:24
text: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, that owed him ten thousand talents.

title: Matthew 18:25
text: But forasmuch as he had not [wherewith] to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

title: Matthew 18:26
text: The servant therefore fell down and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

title: Matthew 18:27
text: And the lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him, and forgave him the debt.

title: Matthew 18:28
text: But that servant went out, and found one of his fellow-servants, who owed him a hundred shillings: and he laid hold on him, and took [him] by the throat, saying, Pay what thou owest.

title: Matthew 18:29
text: So his fellow-servant fell down and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee.

title: Matthew 18:30
text: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay that which was due.

title: Matthew 18:31
text: So when his fellow-servants saw what was done, they were exceeding sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.

title: Matthew 18:32
text: Then his lord called him unto him, and saith to him, Thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou besoughtest me:

title: Matthew 18:33
text: shouldest not thou also have had mercy on thy fellow-servant, even as I had mercy on thee?

title: Matthew 18:34
text: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due.

title: Matthew 18:35
text: So shall also my heavenly Father do unto you, if ye forgive not every one his brother from your hearts.

title: Matthew 19:1
text: And it came to pass when Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee, and came into the borders of Judaea beyond the Jordan;

title: Matthew 19:2
text: and great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.

title: Matthew 19:3
text: And there came unto him Pharisees, trying him, and saying, Is it lawful [for a man] to put away his wife for every cause?

title: Matthew 19:4
text: And he answered and said, Have ye not read, that he who made [them] from the beginning made them male and female,

title: Matthew 19:5
text: and said, For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh?

title: Matthew 19:6
text: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

title: Matthew 19:7
text: They say unto him, Why then did Moses command to give a bill of divorcement, and to put [her] away?

title: Matthew 19:8
text: He saith unto them, Moses for your hardness of heart suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it hath not been so.

title: Matthew 19:9
text: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and he that marrieth her when she is put away committeth adultery.

title: Matthew 19:10
text: The disciples say unto him, If the case of the man is so with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.

title: Matthew 19:11
text: But he said unto them, Not all men can receive this saying, but they to whom it is given.

title: Matthew 19:12
text: For there are eunuchs, that were so born from their mother's womb: and there are eunuchs, that were made eunuchs by men: and there are eunuchs, that made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.

title: Matthew 19:13
text: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should lay his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.

title: Matthew 19:14
text: But Jesus said, Suffer the little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for to such belongeth the kingdom of heaven.

title: Matthew 19:15
text: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.

title: Matthew 19:16
text: And behold, one came to him and said, Teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?

title: Matthew 19:17
text: And he said unto him, Why askest thou me concerning that which is good? One there is who is good: but if thou wouldest enter into life, keep the commandments.

title: Matthew 19:18
text: He saith unto him, Which? And Jesus said, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,

title: Matthew 19:19
text: Honor thy father and mother; and, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.

title: Matthew 19:20
text: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I observed: what lack I yet?

title: Matthew 19:21
text: Jesus said unto him, If thou wouldest be perfect, go, sell that which thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.

title: Matthew 19:22
text: But when the young man heard the saying, he went away sorrowful; for he was one that had great possessions.

title: Matthew 19:23
text: And Jesus said unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, It is hard for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of heaven.

title: Matthew 19:24
text: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

title: Matthew 19:25
text: And when the disciples heard it, they were astonished exceedingly, saying, Who then can be saved?

title: Matthew 19:26
text: And Jesus looking upon [them] said to them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

title: Matthew 19:27
text: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee; what then shall we have?

title: Matthew 19:28
text: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, that ye who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit on the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

title: Matthew 19:29
text: And every one that hath left houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive a hundredfold, and shall inherit eternal life.

title: Matthew 19:30
text: But many shall be last [that are] first; and first [that are] last.

title: Matthew 20:1
text: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that was a householder, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers into his vineyard.

title: Matthew 20:2
text: And when he had agreed with the laborers for a shilling a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

title: Matthew 20:3
text: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing in the marketplace idle;

title: Matthew 20:4
text: and to them he said, Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.

title: Matthew 20:5
text: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.

title: Matthew 20:6
text: And about the eleventh [hour] he went out, and found others standing; and he saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?

title: Matthew 20:7
text: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard.

title: Matthew 20:8
text: And when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the laborers, and pay them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.

title: Matthew 20:9
text: And when they came that [were hired] about the eleventh hour, they received every man a shilling.

title: Matthew 20:10
text: And when the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise received every man a shilling.

title: Matthew 20:11
text: And when they received it, they murmured against the householder,

title: Matthew 20:12
text: saying, These last have spent [but] one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat.

title: Matthew 20:13
text: But he answered and said to one of them, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a shilling?

title: Matthew 20:14
text: Take up that which is thine, and go thy way; it is my will to give unto this last, even as unto thee.

title: Matthew 20:15
text: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? or is thine eye evil, because I am good?

title: Matthew 20:16
text: So the last shall be first, and the first last.

title: Matthew 20:17
text: And as Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples apart, and on the way he said unto them,

title: Matthew 20:18
text: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests and scribes; and they shall condemn him to death,

title: Matthew 20:19
text: and shall deliver him unto the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify: and the third day he shall be raised up.

title: Matthew 20:20
text: Then came to him the mother of the sons of Zebedee with her sons, worshipping [him], and asking a certain thing of him.

title: Matthew 20:21
text: And he said unto her, What wouldest thou? She saith unto him, Command that these my two sons may sit, one on thy right hand, and one on thy left hand, in thy kingdom.

title: Matthew 20:22
text: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink the cup that I am about to drink? They say unto him, We are able.

title: Matthew 20:23
text: He saith unto them, My cup indeed ye shall drink: but to sit on my right hand, and on [my] left hand, is not mine to give; but [it is for them] for whom it hath been prepared of my Father.

title: Matthew 20:24
text: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation concerning the two brethren.

title: Matthew 20:25
text: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

title: Matthew 20:26
text: Not so shall it be among you: but whosoever would become great among you shall be your minister;

title: Matthew 20:27
text: and whosoever would be first among you shall be your servant:

title: Matthew 20:28
text: even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

title: Matthew 20:29
text: And as they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

title: Matthew 20:30
text: And behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, saying, Lord, have mercy on us, thou son of David.

title: Matthew 20:31
text: And the multitude rebuked them, that they should hold their peace: but they cried out the more, saying, Lord, have mercy on us, thou son of David.

title: Matthew 20:32
text: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I should do unto you?

title: Matthew 20:33
text: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

title: Matthew 20:34
text: And Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and straightway they received their sight, and followed him.

title: Matthew 21:1
text: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and came unto Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,

title: Matthew 21:2
text: saying unto them, Go into the village that is over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose [them], and bring [them] unto me.

title: Matthew 21:3
text: And if any one say aught unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.

title: Matthew 21:4
text: Now this is come to pass, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,

title: Matthew 21:5
text: Tell ye the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, Meek, and riding upon an ass, And upon a colt the foal of an ass.

title: Matthew 21:6
text: And the disciples went, and did even as Jesus appointed them,

title: Matthew 21:7
text: and brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their garments; and he sat thereon.

title: Matthew 21:8
text: And the most part of the multitude spread their garments in the way; and others cut branches from the trees, and spread them in the way.

title: Matthew 21:9
text: And the multitudes that went before him, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the son of David: Blessed [is] he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

title: Matthew 21:10
text: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred, saying, Who is this?

title: Matthew 21:11
text: And the multitudes said, This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.

title: Matthew 21:12
text: And Jesus entered into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the money-changers, and the seats of them that sold the doves; [

title: Matthew 21:13
text: and he saith unto them, It is written, My house shall be called a house of prayer: but ye make it a den of robbers.

title: Matthew 21:14
text: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.

title: Matthew 21:15
text: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children that were crying in the temple and saying, Hosanna to the son of David; they were moved with indignation,

title: Matthew 21:16
text: and said unto him, Hearest thou what these are saying? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea: did ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou has perfected praise?

title: Matthew 21:17
text: And he left them, and went forth out of the city to Bethany, and lodged there.

title: Matthew 21:18
text: Now in the morning as he returned to the city, he hungered.

title: Matthew 21:19
text: And seeing a fig tree by the way side, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only; and he saith unto it, Let there be no fruit from thee henceforward for ever. And immediately the fig tree withered away.

title: Matthew 21:20
text: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How did the fig tree immediately wither away?

title: Matthew 21:21
text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do what is done to the fig tree, but even if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou taken up and cast into the sea, it shall be done.

title: Matthew 21:22
text: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.

title: Matthew 21:23
text: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?

title: Matthew 21:24
text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one question, which if ye tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

title: Matthew 21:25
text: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven or from men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why then did ye not believe him?

title: Matthew 21:26
text: But if we shall say, From men; we fear the multitude; for all hold John as a prophet.

title: Matthew 21:27
text: And they answered Jesus, and said, We know not. He also said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

title: Matthew 21:28
text: But what think ye? A man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to-day in the vineyard.

title: Matthew 21:29
text: And he answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented himself, and went.

title: Matthew 21:30
text: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I [go], sir: and went not.

title: Matthew 21:31
text: Which of the two did the will of his father? They say, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, that the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.

title: Matthew 21:32
text: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not; but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye saw it, did not even repent yourselves afterward, that ye might believe him.

title: Matthew 21:33
text: Hear another parable: There was a man that was a householder, who planted a vineyard, and set a hedge about it, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into another country.

title: Matthew 21:34
text: And when the season of the fruits drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, to receive his fruits.

title: Matthew 21:35
text: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.

title: Matthew 21:36
text: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them in like manner.

title: Matthew 21:37
text: But afterward he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.

title: Matthew 21:38
text: But the husbandmen, when they saw the son, said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and take his inheritance.

title: Matthew 21:39
text: And they took him, and cast him forth out of the vineyard, and killed him.

title: Matthew 21:40
text: When therefore the lord of the vineyard shall come, what will he do unto those husbandmen?

title: Matthew 21:41
text: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will let out the vineyard unto other husbandmen, who shall render him the fruits in their seasons.

title: Matthew 21:42
text: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, The same was made the head of the corner; This was from the Lord, And it is marvelous in our eyes?

title: Matthew 21:43
text: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken away from you, and shall be given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.

title: Matthew 21:44
text: And he that falleth on this stone shall be broken to pieces: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will scatter him as dust.

title: Matthew 21:45
text: And when the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.

title: Matthew 21:46
text: And when they sought to lay hold on him, they feared the multitudes, because they took him for a prophet.

title: Matthew 22:1
text: And Jesus answered and spake again in parables unto them, saying,

title: Matthew 22:2
text: The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a certain king, who made a marriage feast for his son,

title: Matthew 22:3
text: and sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the marriage feast: and they would not come.

title: Matthew 22:4
text: Again he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them that are bidden, Behold, I have made ready my dinner; my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come to the marriage feast.

title: Matthew 22:5
text: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;

title: Matthew 22:6
text: and the rest laid hold on his servants, and treated them shamefully, and killed them.

title: Matthew 22:7
text: But the king was wroth; and he sent his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

title: Matthew 22:8
text: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they that were bidden were not worthy.

title: Matthew 22:9
text: Go ye therefore unto the partings of the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage feast.

title: Matthew 22:10
text: And those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was filled with guests.

title: Matthew 22:11
text: But when the king came in to behold the guests, he saw there a man who had not on a wedding-garment:

title: Matthew 22:12
text: and he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding-garment? And he was speechless.

title: Matthew 22:13
text: Then the king said to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and cast him out into the outer darkness; there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.

title: Matthew 22:14
text: For many are called, but few chosen.

title: Matthew 22:15
text: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might ensnare him in [his] talk.

title: Matthew 22:16
text: And they send to him their disciples, with the Herodians, saying, Teacher, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, and carest not for any one: for thou regardest not the person of men.

title: Matthew 22:17
text: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?

title: Matthew 22:18
text: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why make ye trial of me, ye hypocrites?

title: Matthew 22:19
text: Show me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a denarius.

title: Matthew 22:20
text: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?

title: Matthew 22:21
text: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things that are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.

title: Matthew 22:22
text: And when they heard it, they marvelled, and left him, and went away.

title: Matthew 22:23
text: On that day there came to him Sadducees, they that say that there is no resurrection: and they asked him,

title: Matthew 22:24
text: saying, Teacher, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

title: Matthew 22:25
text: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first married and deceased, and having no seed left his wife unto his brother;

title: Matthew 22:26
text: in like manner the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.

title: Matthew 22:27
text: And after them all, the woman died.

title: Matthew 22:28
text: In the resurrection therefore whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.

title: Matthew 22:29
text: But Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.

title: Matthew 22:30
text: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as angels in heaven.

title: Matthew 22:31
text: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,

title: Matthew 22:32
text: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not [the God] of the dead, but of the living.

title: Matthew 22:33
text: And when the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

title: Matthew 22:34
text: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, gathered themselves together.

title: Matthew 22:35
text: And one of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, trying him:

title: Matthew 22:36
text: Teacher, which is the great commandment in the law?

title: Matthew 22:37
text: And he said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.

title: Matthew 22:38
text: This is the great and first commandment.

title: Matthew 22:39
text: And a second like [unto it] is this, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.

title: Matthew 22:40
text: On these two commandments the whole law hangeth, and the prophets.

title: Matthew 22:41
text: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

title: Matthew 22:42
text: saying, What think ye of the Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, [The son] of David.

title: Matthew 22:43
text: He saith unto them, How then doth David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

title: Matthew 22:44
text: The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, Till I put thine enemies underneath thy feet?

title: Matthew 22:45
text: If David then calleth him Lord, how is he his son?

title: Matthew 22:46
text: And no one was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.

title: Matthew 23:1
text: Then spake Jesus to the multitudes and to his disciples,

title: Matthew 23:2
text: saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses seat:

title: Matthew 23:3
text: all things therefore whatsoever they bid you, [these] do and observe: but do not ye after their works; for they say, and do not.

title: Matthew 23:4
text: Yea, they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with their finger.

title: Matthew 23:5
text: But all their works they do to be seen of men: for they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders [of their garments] ,

title: Matthew 23:6
text: and love the chief place at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,

title: Matthew 23:7
text: and the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called of men, Rabbi.

title: Matthew 23:8
text: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your teacher, and all ye are brethren.

title: Matthew 23:9
text: And call no man your father on the earth: for one is your Father, [even] he who is in heaven.

title: Matthew 23:10
text: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your master, [even] the Christ.

title: Matthew 23:11
text: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.

title: Matthew 23:12
text: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be humbled; and whosoever shall humble himself shall be exalted.

title: Matthew 23:13
text: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye shut the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye enter not in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering in to enter. [

title: Matthew 23:14
text: (Ommitted)

title: Matthew 23:15
text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he is become so, ye make him twofold more a son of hell than yourselves.

title: Matthew 23:16
text: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, that say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor.

title: Matthew 23:17
text: Ye fools and blind: for which is greater, the gold, or the temple that hath sanctified the gold?

title: Matthew 23:18
text: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gift that is upon it, he is a debtor.

title: Matthew 23:19
text: Ye blind: for which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?

title: Matthew 23:20
text: He therefore that sweareth by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.

title: Matthew 23:21
text: And he that sweareth by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.

title: Matthew 23:22
text: And he that sweareth by the heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.

title: Matthew 23:23
text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye tithe mint and anise and cummin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law, justice, and mercy, and faith: but these ye ought to have done, and not to have left the other undone.

title: Matthew 23:24
text: Ye blind guides, that strain out the gnat, and swallow the camel!

title: Matthew 23:25
text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full from extortion and excess.

title: Matthew 23:26
text: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first the inside of the cup and of the platter, that the outside thereof may become clean also.

title: Matthew 23:27
text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.

title: Matthew 23:28
text: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but inwardly ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

title: Matthew 23:29
text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and garnish the tombs of the righteous,

title: Matthew 23:30
text: and say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we should not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.

title: Matthew 23:31
text: Wherefore ye witness to yourselves, that ye are sons of them that slew the prophets.

title: Matthew 23:32
text: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.

title: Matthew 23:33
text: Ye serpents, ye offspring of vipers, how shall ye escape the judgment of hell?

title: Matthew 23:34
text: Therefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: some of them shall ye kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute from city to city:

title: Matthew 23:35
text: that upon you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of Abel the righteous unto the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom ye slew between the sanctuary and the altar.

title: Matthew 23:36
text: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.

title: Matthew 23:37
text: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that killeth the prophets, and stoneth them that are sent unto her! how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!

title: Matthew 23:38
text: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.

title: Matthew 23:39
text: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed [is] he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

title: Matthew 24:1
text: And Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way; and his disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

title: Matthew 24:2
text: But he answered and said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

title: Matthew 24:3
text: And as he sat on the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what [shall be] the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?

title: Matthew 24:4
text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man lead you astray.

title: Matthew 24:5
text: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am the Christ; and shall lead many astray.

title: Matthew 24:6
text: And ye shall hear of wars and rumors of wars; see that ye be not troubled: for [these things] must needs come to pass; but the end is not yet.

title: Matthew 24:7
text: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there shall be famines and earthquakes in divers places.

title: Matthew 24:8
text: But all these things are the beginning of travail.

title: Matthew 24:9
text: Then shall they deliver you up unto tribulation, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all the nations for my name's sake.

title: Matthew 24:10
text: And then shall many stumble, and shall deliver up one another, and shall hate one another.

title: Matthew 24:11
text: And many false prophets shall arise, and shall lead many astray.

title: Matthew 24:12
text: And because iniquity shall be multiplied, the love of the many shall wax cold.

title: Matthew 24:13
text: But he that endureth to the end, the same shall be saved.

title: Matthew 24:14
text: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in the whole world for a testimony unto all the nations; and then shall the end come.

title: Matthew 24:15
text: When therefore ye see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let him that readeth understand),

title: Matthew 24:16
text: then let them that are in Judaea flee unto the mountains:

title: Matthew 24:17
text: let him that is on the housetop not go down to take out things that are in his house:

title: Matthew 24:18
text: and let him that is in the field not return back to take his cloak.

title: Matthew 24:19
text: But woe unto them that are with child and to them that give suck in those days!

title: Matthew 24:20
text: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on a sabbath:

title: Matthew 24:21
text: for then shall be great tribulation, such as hath not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever shall be.

title: Matthew 24:22
text: And except those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.

title: Matthew 24:23
text: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is the Christ, or, Here; believe [it] not.

title: Matthew 24:24
text: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall show great signs and wonders; so as to lead astray, if possible, even the elect.

title: Matthew 24:25
text: Behold, I have told you beforehand.

title: Matthew 24:26
text: If therefore they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the wilderness; go not forth: Behold, he is in the inner chambers; believe [it] not.

title: Matthew 24:27
text: For as the lightning cometh forth from the east, and is seen even unto the west; so shall be the coming of the Son of man.

title: Matthew 24:28
text: Wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.

title: Matthew 24:29
text: But immediately after the tribulation of those days the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:

title: Matthew 24:30
text: and then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

title: Matthew 24:31
text: And he shall send forth his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other. [

title: Matthew 24:32
text: Now from the fig tree learn her parable: when her branch is now become tender, and putteth forth its leaves, ye know that the summer is nigh;

title: Matthew 24:33
text: even so ye also, when ye see all these things, know ye that he is nigh, [even] at the doors.

title: Matthew 24:34
text: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all these things be accomplished.

title: Matthew 24:35
text: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.

title: Matthew 24:36
text: But of that day and hour knoweth no one, not even the angels of heaven, neither the Son, but the Father only.

title: Matthew 24:37
text: And as [were] the days of Noah, so shall be the coming of the Son of man.

title: Matthew 24:38
text: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ark,

title: Matthew 24:39
text: and they knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall be the coming of the Son of man.

title: Matthew 24:40
text: Then shall two men be in the field; one is taken, and one is left:

title: Matthew 24:41
text: two women [shall be] grinding at the mill; one is taken, and one is left.

title: Matthew 24:42
text: Watch therefore: for ye know not on what day your Lord cometh.

title: Matthew 24:43
text: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken through.

title: Matthew 24:44
text: Therefore be ye also ready; for in an hour that ye think not the Son of man cometh.

title: Matthew 24:45
text: Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath set over his household, to give them their food in due season?

title: Matthew 24:46
text: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

title: Matthew 24:47
text: Verily I say unto you, that he will set him over all that he hath.

title: Matthew 24:48
text: But if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord tarrieth;

title: Matthew 24:49
text: and shall begin to beat his fellow-servants, and shall eat and drink with the drunken;

title: Matthew 24:50
text: the lord of that servant shall come in a day when he expecteth not, and in an hour when he knoweth not,

title: Matthew 24:51
text: and shall cut him asunder, and appoint his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.

title: Matthew 25:1
text: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, who took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.

title: Matthew 25:2
text: And five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

title: Matthew 25:3
text: For the foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them:

title: Matthew 25:4
text: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

title: Matthew 25:5
text: Now while the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.

title: Matthew 25:6
text: But at midnight there is a cry, Behold, the bridegroom! Come ye forth to meet him.

title: Matthew 25:7
text: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

title: Matthew 25:8
text: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are going out.

title: Matthew 25:9
text: But the wise answered, saying, Peradventure there will not be enough for us and you: go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

title: Matthew 25:10
text: And while they went away to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage feast: and the door was shut.

title: Matthew 25:11
text: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.

title: Matthew 25:12
text: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.

title: Matthew 25:13
text: Watch therefore, for ye know not the day nor the hour.

title: Matthew 25:14
text: For [it is] as [when] a man, going into another country, called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.

title: Matthew 25:15
text: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one; to each according to his several ability; and he went on his journey.

title: Matthew 25:16
text: Straightway he that received the five talents went and traded with them, and made other five talents.

title: Matthew 25:17
text: In like manner he also that [received] the two gained other two.

title: Matthew 25:18
text: But he that received the one went away and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.

title: Matthew 25:19
text: Now after a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and maketh a reckoning with them.

title: Matthew 25:20
text: And he that received the five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: lo, I have gained other five talents.

title: Matthew 25:21
text: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will set thee over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

title: Matthew 25:22
text: And he also that [received] the two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: lo, I have gained other two talents.

title: Matthew 25:23
text: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will set thee over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

title: Matthew 25:24
text: And he also that had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art a hard man, reaping where thou didst not sow, and gathering where thou didst not scatter;

title: Matthew 25:25
text: and I was afraid, and went away and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, thou hast thine own.

title: Matthew 25:26
text: But his lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I did not scatter;

title: Matthew 25:27
text: thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back mine own with interest.

title: Matthew 25:28
text: Take ye away therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him that hath the ten talents.

title: Matthew 25:29
text: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not, even that which he hath shall be taken away.

title: Matthew 25:30
text: And cast ye out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.

title: Matthew 25:31
text: But when the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the angels with him, then shall he sit on the throne of his glory:

title: Matthew 25:32
text: and before him shall be gathered all the nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as the shepherd separateth the sheep from the goats;

title: Matthew 25:33
text: and he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

title: Matthew 25:34
text: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:

title: Matthew 25:35
text: for I was hungry, and ye gave me to eat; I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink; I was a stranger, and ye took me in;

title: Matthew 25:36
text: naked, and ye clothed me; I was sick, and ye visited me; I was in prison, and ye came unto me.

title: Matthew 25:37
text: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee hungry, and fed thee? or athirst, and gave thee drink?

title: Matthew 25:38
text: And when saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?

title: Matthew 25:39
text: And when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?

title: Matthew 25:40
text: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it unto one of these my brethren, [even] these least, ye did it unto me.

title: Matthew 25:41
text: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels:

title: Matthew 25:42
text: for I was hungry, and ye did not give me to eat; I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink;

title: Matthew 25:43
text: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in; naked, and ye clothed me not; sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.

title: Matthew 25:44
text: Then shall they also answer, saying, Lord, when saw we thee hungry, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?

title: Matthew 25:45
text: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not unto one of these least, ye did it not unto me.

title: Matthew 25:46
text: And these shall go away into eternal punishment: but the righteous into eternal life.

title: Matthew 26:1
text: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these words, he said unto his disciples,

title: Matthew 26:2
text: Ye know that after two days the passover cometh, and the Son of man is delivered up to be crucified.

title: Matthew 26:3
text: Then were gathered together the chief priests, and the elders of the people, unto the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas;

title: Matthew 26:4
text: and they took counsel together that they might take Jesus by subtlety, and kill him.

title: Matthew 26:5
text: But they said, Not during the feast, lest a tumult arise among people.

title: Matthew 26:6
text: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

title: Matthew 26:7
text: there came unto him a woman having an alabaster cruse of exceeding precious ointment, and she poured it upon his head, as he sat at meat.

title: Matthew 26:8
text: But when the disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?

title: Matthew 26:9
text: For this [ointment] might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.

title: Matthew 26:10
text: But Jesus perceiving it said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.

title: Matthew 26:11
text: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.

title: Matthew 26:12
text: For in that she poured this ointment upon my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

title: Matthew 26:13
text: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, that also which this woman hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.

title: Matthew 26:14
text: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,

title: Matthew 26:15
text: and said, What are ye willing to give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they weighed unto him thirty pieces of silver.

title: Matthew 26:16
text: And from that time he sought opportunity to deliver him [unto them] .

title: Matthew 26:17
text: Now on the first [day] of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying, Where wilt thou that we make ready for thee to eat the passover?

title: Matthew 26:18
text: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Teacher saith, My time is at hand; I keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.

title: Matthew 26:19
text: And the disciples did as Jesus appointed them; and they made ready the passover.

title: Matthew 26:20
text: Now when even was come, he was sitting at meat with the twelve disciples;

title: Matthew 26:21
text: and as they were eating, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

title: Matthew 26:22
text: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began to say unto him every one, Is it I, Lord?

title: Matthew 26:23
text: And he answered and said, He that dipped his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.

title: Matthew 26:24
text: The Son of man goeth, even as it is written of him: but woe unto that man through whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had not been born. [

title: Matthew 26:25
text: And Judas, who betrayed him, answered and said, Is it I, Rabbi? He saith unto him, Thou hast said.

title: Matthew 26:26
text: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it; and he gave to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.

title: Matthew 26:27
text: And he took a cup, and gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;

title: Matthew 26:28
text: for this is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many unto remission of sins.

title: Matthew 26:29
text: But I say unto you, I shall not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.

title: Matthew 26:30
text: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out unto the mount of Olives.

title: Matthew 26:31
text: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended in me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.

title: Matthew 26:32
text: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.

title: Matthew 26:33
text: But Peter answered and said unto him, If all shall be offended in thee, I will never be offended.

title: Matthew 26:34
text: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, that this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

title: Matthew 26:35
text: Peter saith unto him, Even if I must die with thee, [yet] will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.

title: Matthew 26:36
text: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto his disciples, Sit ye here, while I go yonder and pray.

title: Matthew 26:37
text: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and sore troubled.

title: Matthew 26:38
text: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: abide ye here, and watch with me.

title: Matthew 26:39
text: And he went forward a little, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, My Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass away from me: nevertheless, not as I will, but as thou wilt.

title: Matthew 26:40
text: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?

title: Matthew 26:41
text: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

title: Matthew 26:42
text: Again a second time he went away, and prayed, saying, My Father, if this cannot pass away, except I drink it, thy will be done.

title: Matthew 26:43
text: And he came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

title: Matthew 26:44
text: And he left them again, and went away, and prayed a third time, saying again the same words.

title: Matthew 26:45
text: Then cometh he to the disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

title: Matthew 26:46
text: Arise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that betrayeth me.

title: Matthew 26:47
text: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priest and elders of the people.

title: Matthew 26:48
text: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that is he: take him.

title: Matthew 26:49
text: And straightway he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, Rabbi; and kissed him.

title: Matthew 26:50
text: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, [do] that for which thou art come. Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

title: Matthew 26:51
text: And behold, one of them that were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and smote the servant of the high priest, and struck off his ear.

title: Matthew 26:52
text: Then saith Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into its place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.

title: Matthew 26:53
text: Or thinkest thou that I cannot beseech my Father, and he shall even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?

title: Matthew 26:54
text: How then should the scriptures be fulfilled that thus it must be?

title: Matthew 26:55
text: In that hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a robber with swords and staves to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and ye took me not.

title: Matthew 26:56
text: But all this is come to pass, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples left him, and fled.

title: Matthew 26:57
text: And they that had taken Jesus led him away to [the house of] Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.

title: Matthew 26:58
text: But Peter followed him afar off, unto the court of the high priest, and entered in, and sat with the officers, to see the end.

title: Matthew 26:59
text: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought false witness against Jesus, that they might put him to death;

title: Matthew 26:60
text: and they found it not, though many false witnesses came. But afterward came two,

title: Matthew 26:61
text: and said, This man said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.

title: Matthew 26:62
text: And the high priest stood up, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?

title: Matthew 26:63
text: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou art the Christ, the Son of God.

title: Matthew 26:64
text: Jesus said unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Henceforth ye shall see the Son of man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of heaven.

title: Matthew 26:65
text: Then the high priest rent his garments, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy: what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard the blasphemy:

title: Matthew 26:66
text: what think ye? They answered and said, He is worthy of death.

title: Matthew 26:67
text: Then did they spit in his face and buffet him: and some smote him with the palms of their hands,

title: Matthew 26:68
text: saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ: who is he that struck thee?

title: Matthew 26:69
text: Now Peter was sitting without in the court: and a maid came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus the Galilaean.

title: Matthew 26:70
text: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.

title: Matthew 26:71
text: And when he was gone out into the porch, another [maid] saw him, and saith unto them that were there, This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.

title: Matthew 26:72
text: And again he denied with an oath, I know not the man.

title: Matthew 26:73
text: And after a little while they that stood by came and said to Peter, Of a truth thou also art [one] of them; for thy speech maketh thee known.

title: Matthew 26:74
text: Then began he to curse and to swear, I know not the man. And straightway the cock crew.

title: Matthew 26:75
text: And Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.

title: Matthew 27:1
text: Now when morning was come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:

title: Matthew 27:2
text: and they bound him, and led him away, and delivered him up to Pilate the governor.

title: Matthew 27:3
text: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

title: Matthew 27:4
text: saying, I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood. But they said, What is that to us? see thou [to it] .

title: Matthew 27:5
text: And he cast down the pieces of silver into the sanctuary, and departed; and he went away and hanged himself.

title: Matthew 27:6
text: And the chief priests took the pieces of silver, and said, It is not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.

title: Matthew 27:7
text: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.

title: Matthew 27:8
text: Wherefore that field was called, the field of blood, unto this day.

title: Matthew 27:9
text: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was priced, whom [certain] of the children of Israel did price;

title: Matthew 27:10
text: and they gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.

title: Matthew 27:11
text: Now Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.

title: Matthew 27:12
text: And when he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

title: Matthew 27:13
text: Then saith Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?

title: Matthew 27:14
text: And he gave him no answer, not even to one word: insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.

title: Matthew 27:15
text: Now at the feast the governor was wont to release unto the multitude one prisoner, whom they would.

title: Matthew 27:16
text: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.

title: Matthew 27:17
text: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?

title: Matthew 27:18
text: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him up.

title: Matthew 27:19
text: And while he was sitting on the judgment-seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that righteous man; for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.

title: Matthew 27:20
text: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes that they should ask for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.

title: Matthew 27:21
text: But the governor answered and said unto them, Which of the two will ye that I release unto you? And they said, Barabbas.

title: Matthew 27:22
text: Pilate saith unto them, What then shall I do unto Jesus who is called Christ? They all say, Let him be crucified.

title: Matthew 27:23
text: And he said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out exceedingly, saying, Let him be crucified.

title: Matthew 27:24
text: So when Pilate saw that he prevailed nothing, but rather that a tumult was arising, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this righteous man; see ye [to it] .

title: Matthew 27:25
text: And all the people answered and said, His blood [be] on us, and on our children.

title: Matthew 27:26
text: Then released he unto them Barabbas; but Jesus he scourged and delivered to be crucified.

title: Matthew 27:27
text: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered unto him the whole band.

title: Matthew 27:28
text: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.

title: Matthew 27:29
text: And they platted a crown of thorns and put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!

title: Matthew 27:30
text: And they spat upon him, and took the reed and smote him on the head.

title: Matthew 27:31
text: And when they had mocked him, they took off from him the robe, and put on him his garments, and led him away to crucify him.

title: Matthew 27:32
text: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to go [with them], that he might bear his cross.

title: Matthew 27:33
text: And they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, The place of a skull,

title: Matthew 27:34
text: they gave him wine to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted it, he would not drink.

title: Matthew 27:35
text: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots;

title: Matthew 27:36
text: and they sat and watched him there.

title: Matthew 27:37
text: And they set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

title: Matthew 27:38
text: Then are there crucified with him two robbers, one on the right hand and one on the left.

title: Matthew 27:39
text: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads,

title: Matthew 27:40
text: and saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself: if thou art the Son of God, come down from the cross.

title: Matthew 27:41
text: In like manner also the chief priests mocking [him], with the scribes and elders, said,

title: Matthew 27:42
text: He saved others; himself he cannot save. He is the King of Israel; let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe on him.

title: Matthew 27:43
text: He trusteth on God; let him deliver him now, if he desireth him: for he said, I am the Son of God.

title: Matthew 27:44
text: And the robbers also that were crucified with him cast upon him the same reproach.

title: Matthew 27:45
text: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

title: Matthew 27:46
text: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

title: Matthew 27:47
text: And some of them stood there, when they heard it, said, This man calleth Elijah.

title: Matthew 27:48
text: And straightway one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.

title: Matthew 27:49
text: And the rest said, Let be; let us see whether Elijah cometh to save him.

title: Matthew 27:50
text: And Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

title: Matthew 27:51
text: And behold, the veil of the temple was rent in two from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake; and the rocks were rent;

title: Matthew 27:52
text: and the tombs were opened; and many bodies of the saints that had fallen asleep were raised;

title: Matthew 27:53
text: and coming forth out of the tombs after his resurrection they entered into the holy city and appeared unto many.

title: Matthew 27:54
text: Now the centurion, and they that were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake, and the things that were done, feared exceedingly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.

title: Matthew 27:55
text: And many women were there beholding from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:

title: Matthew 27:56
text: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

title: Matthew 27:57
text: And when even was come, there came a rich man from Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:

title: Matthew 27:58
text: this man went to Pilate, and asked for the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded it to be given up.

title: Matthew 27:59
text: And Joseph took the body, and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

title: Matthew 27:60
text: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb, and departed.

title: Matthew 27:61
text: And Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.

title: Matthew 27:62
text: Now on the morrow, which is [the day] after the Preparation, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together unto Pilate,

title: Matthew 27:63
text: saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said while he was yet alive, After three days I rise again.

title: Matthew 27:64
text: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest haply his disciples come and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: and the last error will be worse than the first.

title: Matthew 27:65
text: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a guard: go, make it [as] sure as ye can.

title: Matthew 27:66
text: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, the guard being with them.

title: Matthew 28:1
text: Now late on the sabbath day, as it began to dawn toward the first [day] of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.

title: Matthew 28:2
text: And behold, there was a great earthquake; for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled away the stone, and sat upon it.

title: Matthew 28:3
text: His appearance was as lightning, and his raiment white as snow:

title: Matthew 28:4
text: and for fear of him the watchers did quake, and became as dead men.

title: Matthew 28:5
text: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye; for I know that ye seek Jesus, who hath been crucified.

title: Matthew 28:6
text: He is not here; for he is risen, even as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

title: Matthew 28:7
text: And go quickly, and tell his disciples, He is risen from the dead; and lo, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.

title: Matthew 28:8
text: And they departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

title: Matthew 28:9
text: And behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and took hold of his feet, and worshipped him.

title: Matthew 28:10
text: Then saith Jesus unto them, Fear not: go tell my brethren that they depart into Galilee, and there shall they see me.

title: Matthew 28:11
text: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guard came into the city, and told unto the chief priests all the things that were come to pass.

title: Matthew 28:12
text: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave much money unto the soldiers,

title: Matthew 28:13
text: saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.

title: Matthew 28:14
text: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and rid you of care.

title: Matthew 28:15
text: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying was spread abroad among the Jews, [and continueth] until this day.

title: Matthew 28:16
