text: Let these words sink into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered up into the hands of men.

title: Luke 9:45
text: But they understood not this saying, and it was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it; and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.

title: Luke 9:46
text: And there arose a reasoning among them, which of them was the greatest.

title: Luke 9:47
text: But when Jesus saw the reasoning of their heart, he took a little child, and set him by his side,

title: Luke 9:48
text: and said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this little child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same is great.

title: Luke 9:49
text: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out demons in thy name; and we forbade him, because he followeth not with us.

title: Luke 9:50
text: But Jesus said unto him, Forbid [him] not: for he that is not against you is for you.

title: Luke 9:51
text: And it came to pass, when the days were well-nigh come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,

title: Luke 9:52
text: and sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.

title: Luke 9:53
text: And they did not receive him, because his face was [as though he were] going to Jerusalem.

title: Luke 9:54
text: And when his disciples James and John saw [this], they said, Lord, wilt thou that we bid fire to come down from heaven, and consume them ?

title: Luke 9:55
text: But he turned, and rebuked them.

title: Luke 9:56
text: And they went to another village.

title: Luke 9:57
text: And as they went on the way, a certain man said unto him, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

title: Luke 9:58
text: And Jesus said unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the heaven [have] nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

title: Luke 9:59
text: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

title: Luke 9:60
text: But he said unto him, Leave the dead to bury their own dead; but go thou and publish abroad the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 9:61
text: And another also said, I will follow thee, Lord; but first suffer me to bid farewell to them that are at my house.

title: Luke 9:62
text: But Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 10:1
text: Now after these things the Lord appointed seventy others, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself was about to come.

title: Luke 10:2
text: And he said unto them, The harvest indeed is plenteous, but the laborers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he send forth laborers into his harvest.

title: Luke 10:3
text: Go your ways; behold, I send you forth as lambs in the midst of wolves.

title: Luke 10:4
text: Carry no purse, no wallet, no shoes; and salute no man on the way.

title: Luke 10:5
text: And into whatsoever house ye shall enter, first say, Peace [be] to this house.

title: Luke 10:6
text: And if a son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon him: but if not, it shall turn to you again.

title: Luke 10:7
text: And in that same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the laborer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.

title: Luke 10:8
text: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:

title: Luke 10:9
text: and heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

title: Luke 10:10
text: But into whatsoever city ye shall enter, and they receive you not, go out into the streets thereof and say,

title: Luke 10:11
text: Even the dust from your city, that cleaveth to our feet, we wipe off against you: nevertheless know this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh.

title: Luke 10:12
text: I say unto you, it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.

title: Luke 10:13
text: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

title: Luke 10:14
text: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment, than for you.

title: Luke 10:15
text: And thou, Capernaum, shalt thou be exalted unto heaven? thou shalt be brought down unto Hades.

title: Luke 10:16
text: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that rejecteth you rejecteth me; and he that rejecteth me rejecteth him that sent me.

title: Luke 10:17
text: And the seventy returned with joy, saying, Lord, even the demons are subject unto us in thy name.

title: Luke 10:18
text: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan fallen as lightning from heaven.

title: Luke 10:19
text: Behold, I have given you authority to tread upon serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall in any wise hurt you.

title: Luke 10:20
text: Nevertheless in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.

title: Luke 10:21
text: In that same hour he rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou didst hide these things from the wise and understanding, and didst reveal them unto babes: yea, Father; for so it was well-pleasing in thy sight.

title: Luke 10:22
text: All things have been delivered unto me of my Father: and no one knoweth who the Son is, save the Father; and who the Father is, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son willeth to reveal [him] .

title: Luke 10:23
text: And turning to the disciples, he said privately, Blessed [are] the eyes which see the things that ye see:

title: Luke 10:24
text: for I say unto you, that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which ye see, and saw them not; and to hear the things which ye hear, and heard them not.

title: Luke 10:25
text: And behold, a certain lawyer stood up and made trial of him, saying, Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

title: Luke 10:26
text: And he said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?

title: Luke 10:27
text: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbor as thyself.

title: Luke 10:28
text: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.

title: Luke 10:29
text: But he, desiring to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbor?

title: Luke 10:30
text: Jesus made answer and said, A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho; and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

title: Luke 10:31
text: And by chance a certain priest was going down that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

title: Luke 10:32
text: And in like manner a Levite also, when he came to the place, and saw him, passed by on the other side.

title: Luke 10:33
text: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

title: Luke 10:34
text: and came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on [them] oil and wine; and he set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

title: Luke 10:35
text: And on the morrow he took out two shillings, and gave them to the host, and said, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, I, when I come back again, will repay thee.

title: Luke 10:36
text: Which of these three, thinkest thou, proved neighbor unto him that fell among the robbers?

title: Luke 10:37
text: And he said, He that showed mercy on him. And Jesus said unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.

title: Luke 10:38
text: Now as they went on their way, he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

title: Luke 10:39
text: And she had a sister called Mary, who also sat at the Lord's feet, and heard his word.

title: Luke 10:40
text: But Martha was cumbered about much serving; and she came up to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister did leave me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.

title: Luke 10:41
text: But the Lord answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art anxious and troubled about many things:

title: Luke 10:42
text: but one thing is needful: for Mary hath chosen the good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

title: Luke 11:1
text: And it came to pass, as he was praying in a certain place, that when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, even as John also taught his disciples.

title: Luke 11:2
text: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Father, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come.

title: Luke 11:3
text: Give us day by day our daily bread.

title: Luke 11:4
text: And forgive us our sins; for we ourselves also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And bring us not into temptation.

title: Luke 11:5
text: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say to him, Friend, lend me three loaves;

title: Luke 11:6
text: for a friend of mine is come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him;

title: Luke 11:7
text: and he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee?

title: Luke 11:8
text: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will arise and give him as many as he needeth.

title: Luke 11:9
text: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

title: Luke 11:10
text: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

title: Luke 11:11
text: And of which of you that is a father shall his son ask a loaf, and he give him a stone? or a fish, and he for a fish give him a serpent?

title: Luke 11:12
text: Or [if] he shall ask an egg, will he give him a scorpion?

title: Luke 11:13
text: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall [your] heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?

title: Luke 11:14
text: And he was casting out a demon [that was] dumb. And it came to pass, when the demon was gone out, the dumb man spake; and the multitudes marvelled.

title: Luke 11:15
text: But some of them said, By Beelzebub the prince of the demons casteth he out demons.

title: Luke 11:16
text: And others, trying [him], sought of him a sign from heaven.

title: Luke 11:17
text: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house [divided] against a house falleth.

title: Luke 11:18
text: And if Satan also is divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out demons by Beelzebub.

title: Luke 11:19
text: And if I by Beelzebub cast out demons, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.

title: Luke 11:20
text: But if I by the finger of God cast out demons, then is the kingdom of God come upon you.

title: Luke 11:21
text: When the strong [man] fully armed guardeth his own court, his goods are in peace:

title: Luke 11:22
text: but when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him his whole armor wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.

title: Luke 11:23
text: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.

title: Luke 11:24
text: The unclean spirit when he is gone out of the man, passeth through waterless places, seeking rest, and finding none, he saith, I will turn back unto my house whence I came out.

title: Luke 11:25
text: And when he is come, he findeth it swept and garnished.

title: Luke 11:26
text: Then goeth he, and taketh [to him] seven other spirits more evil than himself; and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man becometh worse than the first.

title: Luke 11:27
text: And it came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the breasts which thou didst suck.

title: Luke 11:28
text: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.

title: Luke 11:29
text: And when the multitudes were gathering together unto him, he began to say, This generation is an evil generation: it seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it but the sign of Jonah.

title: Luke 11:30
text: For even as Jonah became a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.

title: Luke 11:31
text: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and shall condemn them: for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

title: Luke 11:32
text: The men of Nineveh shall stand up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, a greater than Jonah is here.

title: Luke 11:33
text: No man, when he hath lighted a lamp, putteth it in a cellar, neither under the bushel, but on the stand, that they which enter in may see the light.

title: Luke 11:34
text: The lamp of thy body is thine eye: when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when it is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.

title: Luke 11:35
text: Look therefore whether the light that is in thee be not darkness.

title: Luke 11:36
text: If therefore thy whole body be full of light, having no part dark, it shall be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining doth give thee light.

title: Luke 11:37
text: Now as he spake, a Pharisee asketh him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.

title: Luke 11:38
text: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first bathed himself before dinner.

title: Luke 11:39
text: And the Lord said unto him, Now ye the Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter; but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.

title: Luke 11:40
text: Ye foolish ones, did not he that made the outside make the inside also?

title: Luke 11:41
text: But give for alms those things which are within; and behold, all things are clean unto you.

title: Luke 11:42
text: But woe unto you Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and every herb, and pass over justice and the love of God: but these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

title: Luke 11:43
text: Woe unto you Pharisees! for ye love the chief seats in the synagogues, and the salutations in the marketplaces.

title: Luke 11:44
text: Woe unto you! for ye are as the tombs which appear not, and the men that walk over [them] know it not.

title: Luke 11:45
text: And one of the lawyers answering saith unto him, Teacher, in saying this thou reproachest us also.

title: Luke 11:46
text: And he said, Woe unto you lawyers also! for ye load men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.

title: Luke 11:47
text: Woe unto you! for ye build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

title: Luke 11:48
text: So ye are witnesses and consent unto the works of your fathers: for they killed them, and ye build [their tombs] .

title: Luke 11:49
text: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send unto them prophets and apostles; and [some] of them they shall kill and persecute;

title: Luke 11:50
text: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

title: Luke 11:51
text: from the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary: yea, I say unto you, it shall be required of this generation.

title: Luke 11:52
text: Woe unto you lawyers! for ye took away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.

title: Luke 11:53
text: And when he was come out from thence, the scribes and the Pharisees began to press upon [him] vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things;

title: Luke 11:54
text: laying wait for him, to catch something out of his mouth.

title: Luke 12:1
text: In the mean time, when the many thousands of the multitude were gathered together, insomuch that they trod one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

title: Luke 12:2
text: But there is nothing covered up, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.

title: Luke 12:3
text: Wherefore whatsoever ye have said in the darkness shall be heard in the light; and what ye have spoken in the ear in the inner chambers shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.

title: Luke 12:4
text: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

title: Luke 12:5
text: But I will warn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, who after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.

title: Luke 12:6
text: Are not five sparrows sold for two pence? and not one of them is forgotten in the sight of God.

title: Luke 12:7
text: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not: ye are of more value than many sparrows.

title: Luke 12:8
text: And I say unto you, Every one who shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:

title: Luke 12:9
text: but he that denieth me in the presence of men shall be denied in the presence of the angels of God.

title: Luke 12:10
text: And every one who shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Spirit it shall not be forgiven.

title: Luke 12:11
text: And when they bring you before the synagogues, and the rulers, and the authorities, be not anxious how or what ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:

title: Luke 12:12
text: for the Holy Spirit shall teach you in that very hour what ye ought to say.

title: Luke 12:13
text: And one out of the multitude said unto him, Teacher, bid my brother divide the inheritance with me.

title: Luke 12:14
text: But he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?

title: Luke 12:15
text: And he said unto them, Take heed, and keep yourselves from all covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.

title: Luke 12:16
text: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:

title: Luke 12:17
text: and he reasoned within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have not where to bestow my fruits?

title: Luke 12:18
text: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my grain and my goods.

title: Luke 12:19
text: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, be merry.

title: Luke 12:20
text: But God said unto him, Thou foolish one, this night is thy soul required of thee; and the things which thou hast prepared, whose shall they be?

title: Luke 12:21
text: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.

title: Luke 12:22
text: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Be not anxious for [your] life, what ye shall eat; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on.

title: Luke 12:23
text: For the life is more than the food, and the body than the raiment.

title: Luke 12:24
text: Consider the ravens, that they sow not, neither reap; which have no store-chamber nor barn; and God feedeth them: of how much more value are ye than the birds!

title: Luke 12:25
text: And which of you by being anxious can add a cubit unto the measure of his life?

title: Luke 12:26
text: If then ye are not able to do even that which is least, why are ye anxious concerning the rest?

title: Luke 12:27
text: Consider the lilies, how they grow: they toil not, neither do they spin; yet I say unto you, Even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

title: Luke 12:28
text: But if God doth so clothe the grass in the field, which to-day is, and to-morrow is cast into the oven; how much more [shall he clothe] you, O ye of little faith?

title: Luke 12:29
text: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, and what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.

title: Luke 12:30
text: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: but your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.

title: Luke 12:31
text: Yet seek ye his kingdom, and these things shall be added unto you.

title: Luke 12:32
text: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

title: Luke 12:33
text: Sell that which ye have, and give alms; make for yourselves purses which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief draweth near, neither moth destroyeth.

title: Luke 12:34
text: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

title: Luke 12:35
text: Let your loins be girded about, and your lamps burning;

title: Luke 12:36
text: and be ye yourselves like unto men looking for their lord, when he shall return from the marriage feast; that, when he cometh and knocketh, they may straightway open unto him.

title: Luke 12:37
text: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them sit down to meat, and shall come and serve them. [

title: Luke 12:38
text: And if he shall come in the second watch, and if in the third, and find [them] so, blessed are those [servants] .

title: Luke 12:39
text: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched, and not have left his house to be broken through. [

title: Luke 12:40
text: Be ye also ready: for in an hour that ye think not the Son of man cometh.

title: Luke 12:41
text: And Peter said, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even unto all?

title: Luke 12:42
text: And the Lord said, Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall set over his household, to give them their portion of food in due season?

title: Luke 12:43
text: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

title: Luke 12:44
text: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will set him over all that he hath.

title: Luke 12:45
text: But if that servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;

title: Luke 12:46
text: the lord of that servant shall come in a day when he expecteth not, and in an hour when he knoweth not, and shall cut him asunder, and appoint his portion with the unfaithful.

title: Luke 12:47
text: And that servant, who knew his lord's will, and made not ready, nor did according to his will, shall be beaten with many [stripes] ;

title: Luke 12:48
text: but he that knew not, and did things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few [stripes] . And to whomsoever much is given, of him shall much be required: and to whom they commit much, of him will they ask the more.

title: Luke 12:49
text: I came to cast fire upon the earth; and what do I desire, if it is already kindled?

title: Luke 12:50
text: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!

title: Luke 12:51
text: Think ye that I am come to give peace in the earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:

title: Luke 12:52
text: for there shall be from henceforth five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

title: Luke 12:53
text: They shall be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother in law against her daughter in law, and daughter in law against her mother in law.

title: Luke 12:54
text: And he said to the multitudes also, When ye see a cloud rising in the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it cometh to pass.

title: Luke 12:55
text: And when [ye see] a south wind blowing, ye say, There will be a scorching heat; and it cometh to pass.

title: Luke 12:56
text: Ye hypocrites, ye know how to interpret the face of the earth and the heaven; but how is it that ye know not how to interpret this time?

title: Luke 12:57
text: And why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?

title: Luke 12:58
text: For as thou art going with thine adversary before the magistrate, on the way give diligence to be quit of him; lest haply he drag thee unto the judge, and the judge shall deliver thee to the officer, and the officer shall cast thee into prison.

title: Luke 12:59
text: I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou have paid the very last mite.

title: Luke 13:1
text: Now there were some present at that very season who told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.

title: Luke 13:2
text: And he answered and said unto them, Think ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they have suffered these things?

title: Luke 13:3
text: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all in like manner perish.

title: Luke 13:4
text: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and killed them, think ye that they were offenders above all the men that dwell in Jerusalem?

title: Luke 13:5
text: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

title: Luke 13:6
text: And he spake this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came seeking fruit thereon, and found none.

title: Luke 13:7
text: And he said unto the vinedresser, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why doth it also cumber the ground?

title: Luke 13:8
text: And he answering saith unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:

title: Luke 13:9
text: and if it bear fruit thenceforth, [well] ; but if not, thou shalt cut it down.

title: Luke 13:10
text: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath day.

title: Luke 13:11
text: And behold, a woman that had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years; and she was bowed together, and could in no wise lift herself up.

title: Luke 13:12
text: And when Jesus saw her, he called her, and said to her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.

title: Luke 13:13
text: And he laid his hands upon her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.

title: Luke 13:14
text: And the ruler of the synagogue, being moved with indignation because Jesus had healed on the sabbath, answered and said to the multitude, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the day of the sabbath.

title: Luke 13:15
text: But the Lord answered him, and said, Ye hypocrites, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?

title: Luke 13:16
text: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan had bound, lo, [these] eighteen years, to have been loosed from this bond on the day of the sabbath?

title: Luke 13:17
text: And as he said these things, all his adversaries were put to shame: and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

title: Luke 13:18
text: He said therefore, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I liken it?

title: Luke 13:19
text: It is like unto a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his own garden; and it grew, and became a tree; and the birds of the heaven lodged in the branches thereof.

title: Luke 13:20
text: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?

title: Luke 13:21
text: It is like unto leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till it was all leavened.

title: Luke 13:22
text: And he went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and journeying on unto Jerusalem.

title: Luke 13:23
text: And one said unto him, Lord, are they few that are saved? And he said unto them,

title: Luke 13:24
text: Strive to enter in by the narrow door: for many, I say unto you, shall seek to enter in, and shall not be able.

title: Luke 13:25
text: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, open to us; and he shall answer and say to you, I know you not whence ye are;

title: Luke 13:26
text: then shall ye begin to say, We did eat and drink in thy presence, and thou didst teach in our streets;

title: Luke 13:27
text: and he shall say, I tell you, I know not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.

title: Luke 13:28
text: There shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and yourselves cast forth without.

title: Luke 13:29
text: And they shall come from the east and west, and from the north and south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 13:30
text: And behold, there are last who shall be first, and there are first who shall be last.

title: Luke 13:31
text: In that very hour there came certain Pharisees, saying to him, Get thee out, and go hence: for Herod would fain kill thee.

title: Luke 13:32
text: And he said unto them, Go and say to that fox, Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures to-day and to-morrow, and the third [day] I am perfected.

title: Luke 13:33
text: Nevertheless I must go on my way to-day and to-morrow and the [day] following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.

title: Luke 13:34
text: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that killeth the prophets, and stoneth them that are sent unto her! how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen [gathereth] her own brood under her wings, and ye would not!

title: Luke 13:35
text: Behold, your house is left unto you [desolate] : and I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

title: Luke 14:1
text: And it came to pass, when he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a sabbath to eat bread, that they were watching him.

title: Luke 14:2
text: And behold, there was before him a certain man that had the dropsy.

title: Luke 14:3
text: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath, or not?

title: Luke 14:4
text: But they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go.

title: Luke 14:5
text: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a well, and will not straightway draw him up on a sabbath day?

title: Luke 14:6
text: And they could not answer again unto these things.

title: Luke 14:7
text: And he spake a parable unto those that were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief seats; saying unto them,

title: Luke 14:8
text: When thou art bidden of any man to a marriage feast, sit not down in the chief seat; lest haply a more honorable man than thou be bidden of him,

title: Luke 14:9
text: and he that bade thee and him shall come and say to thee, Give this man place; and then thou shalt begin with shame to take the lowest place.

title: Luke 14:10
text: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest place; that when he that hath bidden thee cometh, he may say to thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have glory in the presence of all that sit at meat with thee.

title: Luke 14:11
text: For every one that exalteth himself shall be humbled; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

title: Luke 14:12
text: And he said to him also that had bidden him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, nor thy kinsmen, nor rich neighbors; lest haply they also bid thee again, and a recompense be made thee.

title: Luke 14:13
text: But when thou makest a feast, bid the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:

title: Luke 14:14
text: and thou shalt be blessed; because they have not [wherewith] to recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed in the resurrection of the just.

title: Luke 14:15
text: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 14:16
text: But he said unto him, A certain man made a great supper; and he bade many:

title: Luke 14:17
text: and he sent forth his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for [all] things are now ready.

title: Luke 14:18
text: And they all with one [consent] began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a field, and I must needs go out and see it; I pray thee have me excused.

title: Luke 14:19
text: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them; I pray thee have me excused.

title: Luke 14:20
text: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.

title: Luke 14:21
text: And the servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor and maimed and blind and lame.

title: Luke 14:22
text: And the servant said, Lord, what thou didst command is done, and yet there is room.

title: Luke 14:23
text: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and constrain [them] to come in, that my house may be filled.

title: Luke 14:24
text: For I say unto you, that none of those men that were bidden shall taste of my supper.

title: Luke 14:25
text: Now there went with him great multitudes: and he turned, and said unto them,

title: Luke 14:26
text: If any man cometh unto me, and hateth not his own father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.

title: Luke 14:27
text: Whosoever doth not bear his own cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.

title: Luke 14:28
text: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doth not first sit down and count the cost, whether he have [wherewith] to complete it?

title: Luke 14:29
text: Lest haply, when he hath laid a foundation, and is not able to finish, all that behold begin to mock him,

title: Luke 14:30
text: saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.

title: Luke 14:31
text: Or what king, as he goeth to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and take counsel whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?

title: Luke 14:32
text: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and asketh conditions of peace.

title: Luke 14:33
text: So therefore whosoever he be of you that renounceth not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.

title: Luke 14:34
text: Salt therefore is good: but if even the salt have lost its savor, wherewith shall it be seasoned?

title: Luke 14:35
text: It is fit neither for the land nor for the dunghill: [men] cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

title: Luke 15:1
text: Now all the publicans and sinners were drawing near unto him to hear him.

title: Luke 15:2
text: And both the Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.

title: Luke 15:3
text: And he spake unto them this parable, saying,

title: Luke 15:4
text: What man of you, having a hundred sheep, and having lost one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?

title: Luke 15:5
text: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

title: Luke 15:6
text: And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and his neighbors, saying unto them, Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost.

title: Luke 15:7
text: I say unto you, that even so there shall be joy in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, [more] than over ninety and nine righteous persons, who need no repentance.

title: Luke 15:8
text: Or what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a lamp, and sweep the house, and seek diligently until she find it?

title: Luke 15:9
text: And when she hath found it, she calleth together her friends and neighbors, saying, Rejoice with me, for I have found the piece which I had lost.

title: Luke 15:10
text: Even so, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.

title: Luke 15:11
text: And he said, A certain man had two sons:

title: Luke 15:12
text: and the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of [thy] substance that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.

title: Luke 15:13
text: And not many days after, the younger son gathered all together and took his journey into a far country; and there he wasted his substance with riotous living.

title: Luke 15:14
text: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that country; and he began to be in want.

title: Luke 15:15
text: And he went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.

title: Luke 15:16
text: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.

title: Luke 15:17
text: But when he came to himself he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish here with hunger!

title: Luke 15:18
text: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight:

title: Luke 15:19
text: I am no more worthy to be called your son: make me as one of thy hired servants.

title: Luke 15:20
text: And he arose, and came to his father. But while he was yet afar off, his father saw him, and was moved with compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

title: Luke 15:21
text: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight: I am no more worthy to be called thy son .

title: Luke 15:22
text: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth quickly the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:

title: Luke 15:23
text: and bring the fatted calf, [and] kill it, and let us eat, and make merry:

title: Luke 15:24
text: for this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.

title: Luke 15:25
text: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard music and dancing.

title: Luke 15:26
text: And he called to him one of the servants, and inquired what these things might be.

title: Luke 15:27
text: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.

title: Luke 15:28
text: But he was angry, and would not go in: and his father came out, and entreated him.

title: Luke 15:29
text: But he answered and said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, and I never transgressed a commandment of thine; and [yet] thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:

title: Luke 15:30
text: but when this thy son came, who hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou killedst for him the fatted calf.

title: Luke 15:31
text: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that is mine is thine.

title: Luke 15:32
text: But it was meet to make merry and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive [again] ; and [was] lost, and is found.

title: Luke 16:1
text: And he said also unto the disciples, There was a certain rich man, who had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he was wasting his goods.

title: Luke 16:2
text: And he called him, and said unto him, What is this that I hear of thee? render the account of thy stewardship; for thou canst be no longer steward.

title: Luke 16:3
text: And the steward said within himself, What shall I do, seeing that my lord taketh away the stewardship from me? I have not strength to dig; to beg I am ashamed.

title: Luke 16:4
text: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.

title: Luke 16:5
text: And calling to him each one of his lord's debtors, he said to the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?

title: Luke 16:6
text: And he said, A hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bond, and sit down quickly and write fifty.

title: Luke 16:7
text: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, A hundred measures of wheat. He saith unto him, Take thy bond, and write fourscore.

title: Luke 16:8
text: And his lord commended the unrighteous steward because he had done wisely: for the sons of this world are for their own generation wiser than the sons of the light.

title: Luke 16:9
text: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends by means of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when it shall fail, they may receive you into the eternal tabernacles.

title: Luke 16:10
text: He that is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much: and he that is unrighteous in a very little is unrighteous also in much.

title: Luke 16:11
text: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true [riches] ?

title: Luke 16:12
text: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another's, who will give you that which is your own?

title: Luke 16:13
text: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

title: Luke 16:14
text: And the Pharisees, who were lovers of money, heard all these things; and they scoffed at him.

title: Luke 16:15
text: And he said unto them, Ye are they that justify yourselves in the sight of men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.

title: Luke 16:16
text: The law and the prophets [were] until John: from that time the gospel of the kingdom of God is preached, and every man entereth violently into it.

title: Luke 16:17
text: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away, than for one tittle of the law to fall.

title: Luke 16:18
text: Every one that putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and he that marrieth one that is put away from a husband committeth adultery.

title: Luke 16:19
text: Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, faring sumptuously every day:

title: Luke 16:20
text: and a certain beggar named Lazarus was laid at his gate, full of sores,

title: Luke 16:21
text: and desiring to be fed with the [crumbs] that fell from the rich man's table; yea, even the dogs came and licked his sores.

title: Luke 16:22
text: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and that he was carried away by the angels into Abraham's bosom: and the rich man also died, and was buried.

title: Luke 16:23
text: And in Hades he lifted up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.

title: Luke 16:24
text: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am in anguish in this flame.

title: Luke 16:25
text: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and Lazarus in like manner evil things: but now here he is comforted, and thou art in anguish.

title: Luke 16:26
text: And besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that they that would pass from hence to you may not be able, and that none may cross over from thence to us.

title: Luke 16:27
text: And he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house;

title: Luke 16:28
text: for I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.

title: Luke 16:29
text: But Abraham saith, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.

title: Luke 16:30
text: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one go to them from the dead, they will repent.

title: Luke 16:31
text: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, if one rise from the dead.

title: Luke 17:1
text: And he said unto his disciples, It is impossible but that occasions of stumbling should come; but woe unto him, through whom they come!

title: Luke 17:2
text: It were well for him if a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

title: Luke 17:3
text: Take heed to yourselves: if thy brother sin, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.

title: Luke 17:4
text: And if he sin against thee seven times in the day, and seven times turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.

title: Luke 17:5
text: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.

title: Luke 17:6
text: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye would say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou rooted up, and be thou planted in the sea; and it would obey you.

title: Luke 17:7
text: But who is there of you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say unto him, when he is come in from the field, Come straightway and sit down to meat;

title: Luke 17:8
text: and will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?

title: Luke 17:9
text: Doth he thank the servant because he did the things that were commanded?

title: Luke 17:10
text: Even so ye also, when ye shall have done all the things that are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants; we have done that which it was our duty to do.

title: Luke 17:11
text: And it came to pass, as they were on the way to Jerusalem, that he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.

title: Luke 17:12
text: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, who stood afar off:

title: Luke 17:13
text: and they lifted up their voices, saying, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.

title: Luke 17:14
text: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go and show yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, as they went, they were cleansed.

title: Luke 17:15
text: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, with a loud voice glorifying God;

title: Luke 17:16
text: and he fell upon his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.

title: Luke 17:17
text: And Jesus answering said, Were not the ten cleansed? but where are the nine?

title: Luke 17:18
text: Were there none found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger?

title: Luke 17:19
text: And he said unto him, Arise, and go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.

title: Luke 17:20
text: And being asked by the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God cometh, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:

title: Luke 17:21
text: neither shall they say, Lo, here! or, There! for lo, the kingdom of God is within you.

title: Luke 17:22
text: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.

title: Luke 17:23
text: And they shall say to you, Lo, there! Lo, here! go not away, nor follow after [them] :

title: Luke 17:24
text: for as the lightning, when it lighteneth out of the one part under the heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall the Son of man be in his day.

title: Luke 17:25
text: But first must he suffer many things and be rejected of this generation.

title: Luke 17:26
text: And as it came to pass in the days of Noah, even so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.

title: Luke 17:27
text: They ate, they drank, they married, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.

title: Luke 17:28
text: Likewise even as it came to pass in the days of Lot; they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;

title: Luke 17:29
text: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all:

title: Luke 17:30
text: after the same manner shall it be in the day that the Son of man is revealed.

title: Luke 17:31
text: In that day, he that shall be on the housetop, and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away: and let him that is in the field likewise not return back.

title: Luke 17:32
text: Remember Lot's wife.

title: Luke 17:33
text: Whosoever shall seek to gain his life shall lose it: but whosoever shall lose [his life] shall preserve it.

title: Luke 17:34
text: I say unto you, In that night there shall be two men on one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

title: Luke 17:35
text: There shall be two women grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

title: Luke 17:36
text: (Ommitted)

title: Luke 17:37
text: And they answering say unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Where the body [is], thither will the eagles also be gathered together.

title: Luke 18:1
text: And he spake a parable unto them to the end that they ought always to pray, and not to faint;

title: Luke 18:2
text: saying, There was in a city a judge, who feared not God, and regarded not man:

title: Luke 18:3
text: and there was a widow in that city; and she came oft unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.

title: Luke 18:4
text: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;

title: Luke 18:5
text: yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest she wear me out by her continual coming.

title: Luke 18:6
text: And the Lord said, Hear what the unrighteous judge saith.

title: Luke 18:7
text: And shall not God avenge his elect, that cry to him day and night, and [yet] he is longsuffering over them?

title: Luke 18:8
text: I say unto you, that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless, when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?

title: Luke 18:9
text: And he spake also this parable unto certain who trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and set all others at nought:

title: Luke 18:10
text: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.

title: Luke 18:11
text: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as the rest of men, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.

title: Luke 18:12
text: I fast twice in the week; I give tithes of all that I get.

title: Luke 18:13
text: But the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote his breast, saying, God, be thou merciful to me a sinner.

title: Luke 18:14
text: I say unto you, This man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be humbled; but he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

title: Luke 18:15
text: And they were bringing unto him also their babes, that he should touch them: but when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

title: Luke 18:16
text: But Jesus called them unto him, saying, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for to such belongeth the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 18:17
text: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall in no wise enter therein.

title: Luke 18:18
text: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

title: Luke 18:19
text: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, [even] God.

title: Luke 18:20
text: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honor thy father and mother.

title: Luke 18:21
text: And he said, All these things have I observed from my youth up.

title: Luke 18:22
text: And when Jesus heard it, he said unto him, One thing thou lackest yet: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.

title: Luke 18:23
text: But when he heard these things, he became exceeding sorrowful; for he was very rich.

title: Luke 18:24
text: And Jesus seeing him said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

title: Luke 18:25
text: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 18:26
text: And they that heard it said, Then who can be saved?

title: Luke 18:27
text: But he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

title: Luke 18:28
text: And Peter said, Lo, we have left our own, and followed thee.

title: Luke 18:29
text: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or wife, or brethren, or parents, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,

title: Luke 18:30
text: who shall not receive manifold more in this time, and in the world to come eternal life.

title: Luke 18:31
text: And he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets shall be accomplished unto the Son of man.

title: Luke 18:32
text: For he shall be delivered up unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and shamefully treated, and spit upon:

title: Luke 18:33
text: and they shall scourge and kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.

title: Luke 18:34
text: And they understood none of these things; and this saying was hid from them, and they perceived not the things that were said.

title: Luke 18:35
text: And it came to pass, as he drew nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:

title: Luke 18:36
text: and hearing a multitude going by, he inquired what this meant.

title: Luke 18:37
text: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.

title: Luke 18:38
text: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.

title: Luke 18:39
text: And they that went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried out the more a great deal, Thou son of David, have mercy on me.

title: Luke 18:40
text: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,

title: Luke 18:41
text: What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

title: Luke 18:42
text: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight; thy faith hath made thee whole.

title: Luke 18:43
text: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.

title: Luke 19:1
text: And he entered and was passing through Jericho.

title: Luke 19:2
text: And behold, a man called by name Zacchaeus; and he was a chief publican, and he was rich.

title: Luke 19:3
text: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the crowd, because he was little of stature.

title: Luke 19:4
text: And he ran on before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.

title: Luke 19:5
text: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to-day I must abide at thy house.

title: Luke 19:6
text: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.

title: Luke 19:7
text: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, He is gone in to lodge with a man that is a sinner.

title: Luke 19:8
text: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord, Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have wrongfully exacted aught of any man, I restore fourfold.

title: Luke 19:9
text: And Jesus said unto him, To-day is salvation come to this house, forasmuch as he also is a son of Abraham.

title: Luke 19:10
text: For the Son of man came to seek and to save that which was lost.

title: Luke 19:11
text: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and [because] they supposed that the kingdom of God was immediately to appear.

title: Luke 19:12
text: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country, to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

title: Luke 19:13
text: And he called ten servants of his, and gave them ten pounds, and said unto them, Trade ye [herewith] till I come.

title: Luke 19:14
text: But his citizens hated him, and sent an ambassage after him, saying, We will not that this man reign over us.

title: Luke 19:15
text: And it came to pass, when he was come back again, having received the kingdom, that he commanded these servants, unto whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by trading.

title: Luke 19:16
text: And the first came before him, saying, Lord, thy pound hath made ten pounds more.

title: Luke 19:17
text: And he said unto him, Well done, thou good servant: because thou wast found faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.

title: Luke 19:18
text: And the second came, saying, Thy pound, Lord, hath made five pounds.

title: Luke 19:19
text: And he said unto him also, Be thou also over five cities.

title: Luke 19:20
text: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, [here is] thy pound, which I kept laid up in a napkin:

title: Luke 19:21
text: for I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that which thou layedst not down, and reapest that which thou didst not sow.

title: Luke 19:22
text: He saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I am an austere man, taking up that which I laid not down, and reaping that which I did not sow;

title: Luke 19:23
text: then wherefore gavest thou not my money into the bank, and I at my coming should have required it with interest?

title: Luke 19:24
text: And he said unto them that stood by, Take away from him the pound, and give it unto him that hath the ten pounds.

title: Luke 19:25
text: And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.

title: Luke 19:26
text: I say unto you, that unto every one that hath shall be given; but from him that hath not, even that which he hath shall be taken away from him.

title: Luke 19:27
text: But these mine enemies, that would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.

title: Luke 19:28
text: And when he had thus spoken, he went on before, going up to Jerusalem.

title: Luke 19:29
text: And it came to pass, when he drew nigh unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount that is called Olivet, he sent two of the disciples,

title: Luke 19:30
text: saying, Go your way into the village over against [you] ; in which as ye enter ye shall find a colt tied, whereon no man ever yet sat: loose him, and bring him.

title: Luke 19:31
text: And if any one ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say, The Lord hath need of him.

title: Luke 19:32
text: And they that were sent went away, and found even as he had said unto them.

title: Luke 19:33
text: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?

title: Luke 19:34
text: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.

title: Luke 19:35
text: And they brought him to Jesus: and they threw their garments upon the colt, and set Jesus thereon.

title: Luke 19:36
text: And as he went, they spread their garments in the way.

title: Luke 19:37
text: And as he was now drawing nigh, [even] at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen;

title: Luke 19:38
text: saying, Blessed [is] the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

title: Luke 19:39
text: And some of the Pharisees from the multitude said unto him, Teacher, rebuke thy disciples.

title: Luke 19:40
text: And he answered and said, I tell you that, if these shall hold their peace, the stones will cry out.

title: Luke 19:41
text: And when he drew nigh, he saw the city and wept over it,

title: Luke 19:42
text: saying, If thou hadst known in this day, even thou, the things which belong unto peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.

title: Luke 19:43
text: For the days shall come upon thee, when thine enemies shall cast up a bank about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,

title: Luke 19:44
text: and shall dash thee to the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.

title: Luke 19:45
text: And he entered into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold,

title: Luke 19:46
text: saying unto them, It is written, And my house shall be a house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of robbers.

title: Luke 19:47
text: And he was teaching daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the principal men of the people sought to destroy him:

title: Luke 19:48
text: and they could not find what they might do; for the people all hung upon him, listening.

title: Luke 20:1
text: And it came to pass, on one of the days, as he was teaching the people in the temple, and preaching the gospel, there came upon him the chief priests and the scribes with the elders;

title: Luke 20:2
text: and they spake, saying unto him, Tell us: By what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?

title: Luke 20:3
text: And he answered and said unto them, I also will ask you a question; and tell me:

title: Luke 20:4
text: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?

title: Luke 20:5
text: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why did ye not believe him?

title: Luke 20:6
text: But if we shall say, From men; all the people will stone us: for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.

title: Luke 20:7
text: And they answered, that they knew not whence [it was] .

title: Luke 20:8
text: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

title: Luke 20:9
text: And he began to speak unto the people this parable: A man planted a vineyard, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into another country for a long time.

title: Luke 20:10
text: And at the season he sent unto the husbandmen a servant, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.

title: Luke 20:11
text: And he sent yet another servant: and him also they beat, and handled him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

title: Luke 20:12
text: And he sent yet a third: and him also they wounded, and cast him forth.

title: Luke 20:13
text: And the lord of the vineyard said, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son; it may be they will reverence him.

title: Luke 20:14
text: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned one with another, saying, This is the heir; let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.

title: Luke 20:15
text: And they cast him forth out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do unto them?

title: Luke 20:16
text: He will come and destroy these husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.

title: Luke 20:17
text: But he looked upon them, and said, What then is this that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, The same was made the head of the corner?

title: Luke 20:18
text: Every one that falleth on that stone shall be broken to pieces; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will scatter him as dust.

title: Luke 20:19
text: And the scribes and the chief priests sought to lay hands on him in that very hour; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he spake this parable against them.

title: Luke 20:20
text: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, who feigned themselves to be righteous, that they might take hold of his speech, so as to deliver him up to the rule and to the authority of the governor.

title: Luke 20:21
text: And they asked him, saying, Teacher, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, and acceptest not the person [of any], but of a truth teachest the way of God:

title: Luke 20:22
text: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?

title: Luke 20:23
text: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them,

title: Luke 20:24
text: Show me a denarius. Whose image and superscription hath it? And they said, Caesar's.

title: Luke 20:25
text: And he said unto them, Then render unto Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and unto God the things that are God's.

title: Luke 20:26
text: And they were not able to take hold of the saying before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.

title: Luke 20:27
text: And there came to him certain of the Sadducees, they that say that there is no resurrection;

title: Luke 20:28
text: and they asked him, saying, Teacher, Moses wrote unto us, that if a man's brother die, having a wife, and he be childless, his brother should take the wife, and raise up seed unto his brother. [

title: Luke 20:29
text: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died childless;

title: Luke 20:30
text: and the second:

title: Luke 20:31
text: and the third took her; and likewise the seven also left no children, and died.

title: Luke 20:32
text: Afterward the woman also died.

title: Luke 20:33
text: In the resurrection therefore whose wife of them shall she be? for the seven had her to wife.

title: Luke 20:34
text: And Jesus said unto them, The sons of this world marry, and are given in marriage:

title: Luke 20:35
text: but they that are accounted worthy to attain to that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:

title: Luke 20:36
text: for neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are sons of God, being sons of the resurrection.

title: Luke 20:37
text: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed, in [the place concerning] the Bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

title: Luke 20:38
text: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.

title: Luke 20:39
text: And certain of the scribes answering said, Teacher, thou hast well said.

title: Luke 20:40
text: For they durst not any more ask him any question.

title: Luke 20:41
text: And he said unto them, How say they that the Christ is David's son?

title: Luke 20:42
text: For David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

title: Luke 20:43
text: Till I make thine enemies the footstool of thy feet.

title: Luke 20:44
text: David therefore calleth him Lord, and how is he his son?

title: Luke 20:45
text: And in the hearing of all the people he said unto his disciples,

title: Luke 20:46
text: Beware of the scribes, who desire to walk in long robes, and love salutations in the marketplaces, and chief seats in the synagogues, and chief places at feasts;

title: Luke 20:47
text: who devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater condemnation.

title: Luke 21:1
text: And he looked up, and saw the rich men that were casting their gifts into the treasury.

title: Luke 21:2
text: And he saw a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.

title: Luke 21:3
text: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, This poor widow cast in more than they all:

title: Luke 21:4
text: for all these did of their superfluity cast in unto the gifts; but she of her want did cast in all the living that she had.

title: Luke 21:5
text: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and offerings, he said,

title: Luke 21:6
text: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in which there shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

title: Luke 21:7
text: And they asked him, saying, Teacher, when therefore shall these things be? and what [shall be] the sign when these things are about to come to pass?

title: Luke 21:8
text: And he said, Take heed that ye be not led astray: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am [he] ; and, The time is at hand: go ye not after them.

title: Luke 21:9
text: And when ye shall hear of wars and tumults, be not terrified: for these things must needs come to pass first; but the end is not immediately.

title: Luke 21:10
text: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom;

title: Luke 21:11
text: and there shall be great earthquakes, and in divers places famines and pestilences; and there shall be terrors and great signs from heaven.

title: Luke 21:12
text: But before all these things, they shall lay their hands on you, and shall persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name's sake.

title: Luke 21:13
text: It shall turn out unto you for a testimony.

title: Luke 21:14
text: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate beforehand how to answer:

title: Luke 21:15
text: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to withstand or to gainsay.

title: Luke 21:16
text: But ye shall be delivered up even by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolk, and friends; and [some] of you shall they cause to be put to death.

title: Luke 21:17
text: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.

title: Luke 21:18
text: And not a hair of your head shall perish.

title: Luke 21:19
text: In your patience ye shall win your souls.

title: Luke 21:20
text: But when ye see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that her desolation is at hand.

title: Luke 21:21
text: Then let them that are in Judaea flee unto the mountains; and let them that are in the midst of her depart out; and let not them that are in the country enter therein.

title: Luke 21:22
text: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

title: Luke 21:23
text: Woe unto them that are with child and to them that give suck in those days! for there shall be great distress upon the land, and wrath unto this people.

title: Luke 21:24
text: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led captive into all the nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

title: Luke 21:25
text: And there shall be signs in sun and moon and stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the billows;

title: Luke 21:26
text: men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens shall be shaken.

title: Luke 21:27
text: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

title: Luke 21:28
text: But when these things begin to come to pass, look up, and lift up your heads; because your redemption draweth nigh.

title: Luke 21:29
text: And he spake to them a parable: Behold the fig tree, and all the trees:

title: Luke 21:30
text: when they now shoot forth, ye see it and know of your own selves that the summer is now nigh.

title: Luke 21:31
text: Even so ye also, when ye see these things coming to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh.

title: Luke 21:32
text: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all things be accomplished.

title: Luke 21:33
text: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

title: Luke 21:34
text: But take heed to yourselves, lest haply your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day come on you suddenly as a snare:

title: Luke 21:35
text: for [so] shall it come upon all them that dwell on the face of all the earth.

title: Luke 21:36
text: But watch ye at every season, making supplication, that ye may prevail to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.

title: Luke 21:37
text: And every day he was teaching in the temple; and every night he went out, and lodged in the mount that is called Olivet.

title: Luke 21:38
text: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, to hear him.

title: Luke 22:1
text: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.

title: Luke 22:2
text: And the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death; for they feared the people.

title: Luke 22:3
text: And Satan entered into Judas who was called Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.

title: Luke 22:4
text: And he went away, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might deliver him unto them.

title: Luke 22:5
text: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.

title: Luke 22:6
text: And he consented, and sought opportunity to deliver him unto them in the absence of the multitude.

title: Luke 22:7
text: And the day of unleavened bread came, on which the passover must be sacrificed.

title: Luke 22:8
text: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and make ready for us the passover, that we may eat.

title: Luke 22:9
text: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we make ready?

title: Luke 22:10
text: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house whereinto he goeth.

title: Luke 22:11
text: And ye shall say unto the master of the house, The Teacher saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

title: Luke 22:12
text: And he will show you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.

title: Luke 22:13
text: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

title: Luke 22:14
text: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the apostles with him.

title: Luke 22:15
text: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:

title: Luke 22:16
text: for I say unto you, I shall not eat it, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 22:17
text: And he received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:

title: Luke 22:18
text: for I say unto you, I shall not drink from henceforth of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.

title: Luke 22:19
text: And he took bread, and when he had given thanks, he brake it, and gave to them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.

title: Luke 22:20
text: And the cup in like manner after supper, saying, This cup is the new covenant in my blood, [even] that which is poured out for you.

title: Luke 22:21
text: But behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.

title: Luke 22:22
text: For the Son of man indeed goeth, as it hath been determined: but woe unto that man through whom he is betrayed!

title: Luke 22:23
text: And they began to question among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.

title: Luke 22:24
text: And there arose also a contention among them, which of them was accounted to be greatest.

title: Luke 22:25
text: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles have lordship over them; and they that have authority over them are called Benefactors.

title: Luke 22:26
text: But ye [shall] not [be] so: but he that is the greater among you, let him become as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.

title: Luke 22:27
text: For which is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am in the midst of you as he that serveth.

title: Luke 22:28
text: But ye are they that have continued with me in my temptations;

title: Luke 22:29
text: and I appoint unto you a kingdom, even as my Father appointed unto me,

title: Luke 22:30
text: that ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom; and ye shall sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

title: Luke 22:31
text: Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have you, that he might sift you as wheat:

title: Luke 22:32
text: but I made supplication for thee, that thy faith fail not; and do thou, when once thou hast turned again, establish thy brethren.

title: Luke 22:33
text: And he said unto him, Lord, with thee I am ready to go both to prison and to death.

title: Luke 22:34
text: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, until thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.

title: Luke 22:35
text: And he said unto them, When I sent you forth without purse, and wallet, and shoes, lacked ye anything? And they said, Nothing.

title: Luke 22:36
text: And he said unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise a wallet; and he that hath none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.

title: Luke 22:37
text: For I say unto you, that this which is written must be fulfilled in me, And he was reckoned with transgressors: for that which concerneth me hath fulfilment.

title: Luke 22:38
text: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.

title: Luke 22:39
text: And he came out, and went, as his custom was, unto the mount of Olives; and the disciples also followed him.

title: Luke 22:40
text: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.

title: Luke 22:41
text: And he was parted from them about a stone's cast; and he kneeled down and prayed,

title: Luke 22:42
text: saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.

title: Luke 22:43
text: And there appeared unto him an angel from heaven, strengthening him.

title: Luke 22:44
text: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly; and his sweat became as it were great drops of blood falling down upon the ground.

title: Luke 22:45
text: And when he rose up from his prayer, he came unto the disciples, and found them sleeping for sorrow,

title: Luke 22:46
text: and said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, that ye enter not into temptation.

title: Luke 22:47
text: While he yet spake, behold, a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them; and he drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.

title: Luke 22:48
text: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?

title: Luke 22:49
