text: These things spake he: and after this he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus is fallen asleep; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.

title: John 11:12
text: The disciples therefore said unto him, Lord, if he is fallen asleep, he will recover.

title: John 11:13
text: Now Jesus had spoken of his death: but they thought that he spake of taking rest in sleep.

title: John 11:14
text: Then Jesus therefore said unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.

title: John 11:15
text: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.

title: John 11:16
text: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said unto his fellow-disciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.

title: John 11:17
text: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.

title: John 11:18
text: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off;

title: John 11:19
text: and many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.

title: John 11:20
text: Martha therefore, when she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary still sat in the house.

title: John 11:21
text: Martha therefore said unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

title: John 11:22
text: And even now I know that, whatsoever thou shalt ask of God, God will give thee.

title: John 11:23
text: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.

title: John 11:24
text: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.

title: John 11:25
text: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth on me, though he die, yet shall he live;

title: John 11:26
text: and whosoever liveth and believeth on me shall never die. Believest thou this?

title: John 11:27
text: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I have believed that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, [even] he that cometh into the world.

title: John 11:28
text: And when she had said this, she went away, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Teacher is here, and calleth thee.

title: John 11:29
text: And she, when she heard it, arose quickly, and went unto him.

title: John 11:30
text: (Now Jesus was not yet come into the village, but was still in the place where Martha met him.)

title: John 11:31
text: The Jews then who were with her in the house, and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, supposing that she was going unto the tomb to weep there.

title: John 11:32
text: Mary therefore, when she came where Jesus was, and saw him, fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

title: John 11:33
text: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews [also] weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,

title: John 11:34
text: and said, Where have ye laid him? They say unto him, Lord, come and see.

title: John 11:35
text: Jesus wept.

title: John 11:36
text: The Jews therefore said, Behold how he loved him!

title: John 11:37
text: But some of them said, Could not this man, who opened the eyes of him that was blind, have caused that this man also should not die?

title: John 11:38
text: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

title: John 11:39
text: Jesus saith, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time the body decayeth; for he hath been [dead] four days.

title: John 11:40
text: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou believedst, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

title: John 11:41
text: So they took away the stone. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou heardest me.

title: John 11:42
text: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the multitude that standeth around I said it, that they may believe that thou didst send me.

title: John 11:43
text: And when he had thus spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.

title: John 11:44
text: He that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with grave-clothes; and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.

title: John 11:45
text: Many therefore of the Jews, who came to Mary and beheld that which he did, believed on him.

title: John 11:46
text: But some of them went away to the Pharisees, and told them the things which Jesus had done.

title: John 11:47
text: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many signs.

title: John 11:48
text: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.

title: John 11:49
text: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,

title: John 11:50
text: nor do ye take account that it is expedient for you that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.

title: John 11:51
text: Now this he said not of himself: but, being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for the nation;

title: John 11:52
text: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God that are scattered abroad.

title: John 11:53
text: So from that day forth they took counsel that they might put him to death.

title: John 11:54
text: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed thence into the country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim; and there he tarried with the disciples.

title: John 11:55
text: Now the passover of the Jews was at hand: and many went up to Jerusalem out of the country before the passover, to purify themselves.

title: John 11:56
text: They sought therefore for Jesus, and spake one with another, as they stood in the temple, What think ye? That he will not come to the feast?

title: John 11:57
text: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had given commandment, that, if any man knew where he was, he should show it, that they might take him.

title: John 12:1
text: Jesus therefore six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, whom Jesus raised from the dead.

title: John 12:2
text: So they made him a supper there: and Martha served; but Lazarus was one of them that sat at meat with him.

title: John 12:3
text: Mary therefore took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odor of the ointment.

title: John 12:4
text: But Judas Iscariot, one of his disciples, that should betray him, saith,

title: John 12:5
text: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred shillings, and given to the poor?

title: John 12:6
text: Now this he said, not because he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and having the bag took away what was put therein.

title: John 12:7
text: Jesus therefore said, Suffer her to keep it against the day of my burying.

title: John 12:8
text: For the poor ye have always with you; but me ye have not always.

title: John 12:9
text: The common people therefore of the Jews learned that he was there: and they came, not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

title: John 12:10
text: But the chief priests took counsel that they might put Lazarus also to death;

title: John 12:11
text: because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.

title: John 12:12
text: On the morrow a great multitude that had come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

title: John 12:13
text: took the branches of the palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried out, Hosanna: Blessed [is] he that cometh in the name of the Lord, even the King of Israel.

title: John 12:14
text: And Jesus, having found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,

title: John 12:15
text: Fear not, daughter of Zion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.

title: John 12:16
text: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.

title: John 12:17
text: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb, and raised him from the dead, bare witness.

title: John 12:18
text: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, for that they heard that he had done this sign.

title: John 12:19
text: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Behold how ye prevail nothing: lo, the world is gone after him.

title: John 12:20
text: Now there were certain Greeks among those that went up to worship at the feast:

title: John 12:21
text: these therefore came to Philip, who was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.

title: John 12:22
text: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: Andrew cometh, and Philip, and they tell Jesus.

title: John 12:23
text: And Jesus answereth them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.

title: John 12:24
text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a grain of wheat fall into the earth and die, it abideth by itself alone; but if it die, it beareth much fruit.

title: John 12:25
text: He that loveth his life loseth it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

title: John 12:26
text: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will the Father honor.

title: John 12:27
text: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour. But for this cause came I unto this hour.

title: John 12:28
text: Father, glorify thy name. There came therefore a voice out of heaven, [saying], I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.

title: John 12:29
text: The multitude therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it had thundered: others said, An angel hath spoken to him.

title: John 12:30
text: Jesus answered and said, This voice hath not come for my sake, but for your sakes.

title: John 12:31
text: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

title: John 12:32
text: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto myself.

title: John 12:33
text: But this he said, signifying by what manner of death he should die.

title: John 12:34
text: The multitude therefore answered him, We have heard out of the law that the Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?

title: John 12:35
text: Jesus therefore said unto them, Yet a little while is the light among you. Walk while ye have the light, that darkness overtake you not: and he that walketh in the darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.

title: John 12:36
text: While ye have the light, believe on the light, that ye may become sons of light. These things spake Jesus, and he departed and hid himself from them.

title: John 12:37
text: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they believed not on him:

title: John 12:38
text: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? And to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?

title: John 12:39
text: For this cause they could not believe, for that Isaiah said again,

title: John 12:40
text: He hath blinded their eyes, and he hardened their heart; Lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, And should turn, And I should heal them.

title: John 12:41
text: These things said Isaiah, because he saw his glory; and he spake of him.

title: John 12:42
text: Nevertheless even of the rulers many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess [it], lest they should be put out of the synagogue:

title: John 12:43
text: for they loved the glory [that is] of men more than the glory [that is] of God.

title: John 12:44
text: And Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.

title: John 12:45
text: And he that beholdeth me beholdeth him that sent me.

title: John 12:46
text: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me may not abide in the darkness.

title: John 12:47
text: And if any man hear my sayings, and keep them not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

title: John 12:48
text: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my sayings, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I spake, the same shall judge him in the last day.

title: John 12:49
text: For I spake not from myself; but the Father that sent me, he hath given me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

title: John 12:50
text: And I know that his commandment is life eternal: the things therefore which I speak, even as the Father hath said unto me, so I speak.

title: John 13:1
text: Now before the feast of the passover, Jesus knowing that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto his Father, having loved his own that were in the world, he loved them unto the end.

title: John 13:2
text: And during supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's [son], to betray him,

title: John 13:3
text: [ Jesus], knowing that the Father had given all the things into his hands, and that he came forth from God, and goeth unto God,

title: John 13:4
text: riseth from supper, and layeth aside his garments; and he took a towel, and girded himself.

title: John 13:5
text: Then he poureth water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.

title: John 13:6
text: So he cometh to Simon Peter. He saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?

title: John 13:7
text: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt understand hereafter.

title: John 13:8
text: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

title: John 13:9
text: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.

title: John 13:10
text: Jesus saith to him, He that is bathed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

title: John 13:11
text: For he knew him that should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

title: John 13:12
text: So when he had washed their feet, and taken his garments, and sat down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?

title: John 13:13
text: Ye call me, Teacher, and, Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

title: John 13:14
text: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, ye also ought to wash one another's feet.

title: John 13:15
text: For I have given you an example, that ye also should do as I have done to you.

title: John 13:16
text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, A servant is not greater than his lord; neither one that is sent greater than he that sent him.

title: John 13:17
text: If ye know these things, blessed are ye if ye do them.

title: John 13:18
text: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled: He that eateth my bread lifted up his heel against me.

title: John 13:19
text: From henceforth I tell you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am [he] .

title: John 13:20
text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, he that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

title: John 13:21
text: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in the spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

title: John 13:22
text: The disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.

title: John 13:23
text: There was at the table reclining in Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

title: John 13:24
text: Simon Peter therefore beckoneth to him, and saith unto him, Tell [us] who it is of whom he speaketh.

title: John 13:25
text: He leaning back, as he was, on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?

title: John 13:26
text: Jesus therefore answereth, He it is, for whom I shall dip the sop, and give it him. So when he had dipped the sop, he taketh and giveth it to Judas, [the son] of Simon Iscariot.

title: John 13:27
text: And after the sop, then entered Satan into him. Jesus therefore saith unto him, What thou doest, do quickly.

title: John 13:28
text: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.

title: John 13:29
text: For some thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus said unto him, Buy what things we have need of for the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

title: John 13:30
text: He then having received the sop went out straightway: and it was night.

title: John 13:31
text: When therefore he was gone out, Jesus saith, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him;

title: John 13:32
text: and God shall glorify him in himself, and straightway shall he glorify him.

title: John 13:33
text: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say unto you.

title: John 13:34
text: A new commandment I give unto you, that ye love one another; even as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

title: John 13:35
text: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

title: John 13:36
text: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered, Whither I go, thou canst not follow now; but thou shalt follow afterwards.

title: John 13:37
text: Peter saith unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee even now? I will lay down my life for thee.

title: John 13:38
text: Jesus answereth, Wilt thou lay down thy life for me? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.

title: John 14:1
text: Let not your heart be troubled: believe in God, believe also in me.

title: John 14:2
text: In my Father's house are many mansions; if it were not so, I would have told you; for I go to prepare a place for you.

title: John 14:3
text: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I come again, and will receive you unto myself; that where I am, [there] ye may be also.

title: John 14:4
text: And whither I go, ye know the way.

title: John 14:5
text: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; how know we the way?

title: John 14:6
text: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, and the truth, and the life: no one cometh unto the Father, but by me.

title: John 14:7
text: If ye had known me, ye would have known my Father also: from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

title: John 14:8
text: Philip saith unto him, Lord, show us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

title: John 14:9
text: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and dost thou not know me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; how sayest thou, Show us the Father?

title: John 14:10
text: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I say unto you I speak not from myself: but the Father abiding in me doeth his works.

title: John 14:11
text: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.

title: John 14:12
text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, he that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater [works] than these shall he do; because I go unto the Father.

title: John 14:13
text: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

title: John 14:14
text: If ye shall ask anything in my name, that will I do.

title: John 14:15
text: If ye love me, ye will keep my commandments.

title: John 14:16
text: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may be with you for ever,

title: John 14:17
text: [ even] the Spirit of truth: whom the world cannot receive; for it beholdeth him not, neither knoweth him: ye know him; for he abideth with you, and shall be in you.

title: John 14:18
text: I will not leave you desolate: I come unto you.

title: John 14:19
text: Yet a little while, and the world beholdeth me no more; but ye behold me: because I live, ye shall live also.

title: John 14:20
text: In that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

title: John 14:21
text: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself unto him.

title: John 14:22
text: Judas (not Iscariot) saith unto him, Lord, what is come to pass that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

title: John 14:23
text: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my word: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

title: John 14:24
text: He that loveth me not keepeth not my words: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's who sent me.

title: John 14:25
text: These things have I spoken unto you, while [yet] abiding with you.

title: John 14:26
text: But the Comforter, [even] the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all that I said unto you.

title: John 14:27
text: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

title: John 14:28
text: Ye heard how I said to you, I go away, and I come unto you. If ye loved me, ye would have rejoiced, because I go unto the Father: for the Father is greater than I.

title: John 14:29
text: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe.

title: John 14:30
text: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world cometh: and he hath nothing in me;

title: John 14:31
text: but that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.

title: John 15:1
text: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

title: John 15:2
text: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit, he taketh it away: and every [branch] that beareth fruit, he cleanseth it, that it may bear more fruit.

title: John 15:3
text: Already ye are clean because of the word which I have spoken unto you.

title: John 15:4
text: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; so neither can ye, except ye abide in me.

title: John 15:5
text: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same beareth much fruit: for apart from me ye can do nothing.

title: John 15:6
text: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and they gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

title: John 15:7
text: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ask whatsoever ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

title: John 15:8
text: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; and [so] shall ye be my disciples.

title: John 15:9
text: Even as the Father hath loved me, I also have loved you: abide ye in my love.

title: John 15:10
text: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.

title: John 15:11
text: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy may be in you, and [that] your joy may be made full.

title: John 15:12
text: This is my commandment, that ye love one another, even as I have loved you.

title: John 15:13
text: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

title: John 15:14
text: Ye are my friends, if ye do the things which I command you.

title: John 15:15
text: No longer do I call you servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I heard from my Father, I have made known unto you.

title: John 15:16
text: Ye did not choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that ye should go and bear fruit, and [that] your fruit should abide: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

title: John 15:17
text: These things I command you, that ye may love one another.

title: John 15:18
text: If the world hateth you, ye know that it hath hated me before [it hated] you.

title: John 15:19
text: If ye were of the world, the world would love its own: but because ye are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

title: John 15:20
text: Remember the word that I said unto you, A servant is not greater than his lord. If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they kept my word, they will keep yours also.

title: John 15:21
text: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.

title: John 15:22
text: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no excuse for their sin.

title: John 15:23
text: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

title: John 15:24
text: If I had not done among them the works which none other did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

title: John 15:25
text: But [this cometh to pass], that the word may be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

title: John 15:26
text: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, [even] the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall bear witness of me:

title: John 15:27
text: and ye also bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.

title: John 16:1
text: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be caused to stumble.

title: John 16:2
text: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the hour cometh, that whosoever killeth you shall think that he offereth service unto God.

title: John 16:3
text: And these things will they do, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

title: John 16:4
text: But these things have I spoken unto you, that when their hour is come, ye may remember them, how that I told you. And these things I said not unto you from the beginning, because I was with you.

title: John 16:5
text: But now I go unto him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?

title: John 16:6
text: But because I have spoken these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.

title: John 16:7
text: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is expedient for you that I go away; for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I go, I will send him unto you.

title: John 16:8
text: And he, when he is come, will convict the world in respect of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

title: John 16:9
text: of sin, because they believe not on me;

title: John 16:10
text: of righteousness, because I go to the Father, and ye behold me no more;

title: John 16:11
text: of judgment, because the prince of this world hath been judged.

title: John 16:12
text: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.

title: John 16:13
text: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he shall guide you into all the truth: for he shall not speak from himself; but what things soever he shall hear, [these] shall he speak: and he shall declare unto you the things that are to come.

title: John 16:14
text: He shall glorify me: for he shall take of mine, and shall declare [it] unto you.

title: John 16:15
text: All things whatsoever the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he taketh of mine, and shall declare [it] unto you.

title: John 16:16
text: A little while, and ye behold me no more; and again a little while, and ye shall see me.

title: John 16:17
text: [ Some] of his disciples therefore said one to another, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye behold me not; and again a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

title: John 16:18
text: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? We know not what he saith.

title: John 16:19
text: Jesus perceived that they were desirous to ask him, and he said unto them, Do ye inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, A little while, and ye behold me not, and again a little while, and ye shall see me?

title: John 16:20
text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, that ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

title: John 16:21
text: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but when she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for the joy that a man is born into the world.

title: John 16:22
text: And ye therefore now have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no one taketh away from you.

title: John 16:23
text: And in that day ye shall ask me no question. Verily, verily, I say unto you, if ye shall ask anything of the Father, he will give it you in my name.

title: John 16:24
text: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be made full.

title: John 16:25
text: These things have I spoken unto you in dark sayings: the hour cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in dark sayings, but shall tell you plainly of the Father.

title: John 16:26
text: In that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you;

title: John 16:27
text: for the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came forth from the Father.

title: John 16:28
text: I came out from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go unto the Father.

title: John 16:29
text: His disciples say, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no dark saying.

title: John 16:30
text: Now know we that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.

title: John 16:31
text: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?

title: John 16:32
text: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and [yet] I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

title: John 16:33
text: These things have I spoken unto you, that in me ye may have peace. In the world ye have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

title: John 17:1
text: These things spake Jesus; and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that the son may glorify thee:

title: John 17:2
text: even as thou gavest him authority over all flesh, that to all whom thou hast given him, he should give eternal life.

title: John 17:3
text: And this is life eternal, that they should know thee the only true God, and him whom thou didst send, [even] Jesus Christ.

title: John 17:4
text: I glorified thee on the earth, having accomplished the work which thou hast given me to do.

title: John 17:5
text: And now, Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

title: John 17:6
text: I manifested thy name unto the men whom thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them to me; and they have kept thy word.

title: John 17:7
text: Now they know that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are from thee:

title: John 17:8
text: for the words which thou gavest me I have given unto them; and they received [them], and knew of a truth that I came forth from thee, and they believed that thou didst send me.

title: John 17:9
text: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for those whom thou hast given me; for they are thine:

title: John 17:10
text: and all things that are mine are thine, and thine are mine: and I am glorified in them.

title: John 17:11
text: And I am no more in the world, and these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep them in thy name which thou hast given me, that they may be one, even as we [are] .

title: John 17:12
text: While I was with them, I kept them in thy name which thou hast given me: and I guarded them, and not one of them perished, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

title: John 17:13
text: But now I come to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

title: John 17:14
text: I have given them thy word; and the world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

title: John 17:15
text: I pray not that thou shouldest take them from the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil [one] .

title: John 17:16
text: They are not of the world even as I am not of the world.

title: John 17:17
text: Sanctify them in the truth: thy word is truth.

title: John 17:18
text: As thou didst send me into the world, even so sent I them into the world.

title: John 17:19
text: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

title: John 17:20
text: Neither for these only do I pray, but for them also that believe on me through their word;

title: John 17:21
text: that they may all be one; even as thou, Father, [art] in me, and I in thee, that they also may be in us: that the world may believe that thou didst send me.

title: John 17:22
text: And the glory which thou hast given me I have given unto them; that they may be one, even as we [are] one;

title: John 17:23
text: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that thou didst send me, and lovedst them, even as thou lovedst me.

title: John 17:24
text: Father, I desire that they also whom thou hast given me be with me where I am, that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world. [

title: John 17:25
text: O righteous Father, the world knew thee not, but I knew thee; and these knew that thou didst send me;

title: John 17:26
text: and I made known unto them thy name, and will make it known; that the love wherewith thou lovedst me may be in them, and I in them.

title: John 18:1
text: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where was a garden, into which he entered, himself and his disciples.

title: John 18:2
text: Now Judas also, who betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus oft-times resorted thither with his disciples.

title: John 18:3
text: Judas then, having received the band [of soldiers], and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.

title: John 18:4
text: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were coming upon him, went forth, and saith unto them, Whom seek ye?

title: John 18:5
text: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am [he] . And Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

title: John 18:6
text: When therefore he said unto them, I am [he], they went backward, and fell to the ground.

title: John 18:7
text: Again therefore he asked them, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.

title: John 18:8
text: Jesus answered, I told you that I am [he] ; if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:

title: John 18:9
text: that the word might be fulfilled which he spake, Of those whom thou hast given me I lost not one.

title: John 18:10
text: Simon Peter therefore having a sword drew it, and struck the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. Now the servant's name was Malchus.

title: John 18:11
text: Jesus therefore said unto Peter, Put up the sword into the sheath: the cup which the Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?

title: John 18:12
text: So the band and the chief captain, and the officers of the Jews, seized Jesus and bound him,

title: John 18:13
text: and led him to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

title: John 18:14
text: Now Caiaphas was he that gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.

title: John 18:15
text: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and [so did] another disciple. Now that disciple was known unto the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;

title: John 18:16
text: but Peter was standing at the door without. So the other disciple, who was known unto the high priest, went out and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.

title: John 18:17
text: The maid therefore that kept the door saith unto Peter, Art thou also [one] of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.

title: John 18:18
text: Now the servants and the officers were standing [there], having made a fire of coals; for it was cold; and they were warming themselves: and Peter also was with them, standing and warming himself.

title: John 18:19
text: The high priest therefore asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his teaching.

title: John 18:20
text: Jesus answered him, I have spoken openly to the world; I ever taught in synagogues, and in the temple, where all the Jews come together; and in secret spake I nothing.

title: John 18:21
text: Why askest thou me? Ask them that have heard [me], what I spake unto them: behold, these know the things which I said.

title: John 18:22
text: And when he had said this, one of the officers standing by struck Jesus with his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?

title: John 18:23
text: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?

title: John 18:24
text: Annas therefore sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.

title: John 18:25
text: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore unto him, Art thou also [one] of his disciples? He denied, and said, I am not.

title: John 18:26
text: One of the servants of the high priest, being a kinsman of him whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?

title: John 18:27
text: Peter therefore denied again: and straightway the cock crew.

title: John 18:28
text: They lead Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium: and it was early; and they themselves entered not into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the passover.

title: John 18:29
text: Pilate therefore went out unto them, and saith, What accusation bring ye against this man?

title: John 18:30
text: They answered and said unto him, If this man were not an evildoer, we should not have delivered him up unto thee.

title: John 18:31
text: Pilate therefore said unto them, Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law. The Jews said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:

title: John 18:32
text: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying by what manner of death he should die.

title: John 18:33
text: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?

title: John 18:34
text: Jesus answered, Sayest thou this of thyself, or did others tell it thee concerning me?

title: John 18:35
text: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?

title: John 18:36
text: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

title: John 18:37
text: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end have I been born, and to this end am I come into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

title: John 18:38
text: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find no crime in him.

title: John 18:39
text: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

title: John 18:40
text: They cried out therefore again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.)

title: John 19:1
text: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.

title: John 19:2
text: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and arrayed him in a purple garment;

title: John 19:3
text: and they came unto him, and said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they struck him with their hands.

title: John 19:4
text: And Pilate went out again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him out to you, that ye may know that I find no crime in him.

title: John 19:5
text: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. And [Pilate] saith unto them, Behold, the man!

title: John 19:6
text: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify [him], crucify [him] ! Pilate saith unto them, Take him yourselves, and crucify him: for I find no crime in him.

title: John 19:7
text: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by that law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

title: John 19:8
text: When Pilate therefore heard this saying, he was the more afraid;

title: John 19:9
text: and he entered into the Praetorium again, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.

title: John 19:10
text: Pilate therefore saith unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? Knowest thou not that I have power to release thee, and have power to crucify thee?

title: John 19:11
text: Jesus answered him, Thou wouldest have no power against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath greater sin.

title: John 19:12
text: Upon this Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou release this man, thou art not Caesar's friend: every one that maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.

title: John 19:13
text: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out, and sat down on the judgment-seat at a place called The Pavement, but in Hebrew, Gabbatha.

title: John 19:14
text: Now it was the Preparation of the passover: it was about the sixth hour. And he saith unto the Jews, Behold, your King!

title: John 19:15
text: They therefore cried out, Away with [him], away with [him], crucify him! Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.

title: John 19:16
text: Then therefore he delivered him unto them to be crucified.

title: John 19:17
text: They took Jesus therefore: and he went out, bearing the cross for himself, unto the place called The place of a skull, which is called in Hebrew, Golgotha:

title: John 19:18
text: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.

title: John 19:19
text: And Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. And there was written, JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

title: John 19:20
text: This title therefore read many of the Jews, for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city; and it was written in Hebrew, [and] in Latin, [and] in Greek.

title: John 19:21
text: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.

title: John 19:22
text: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.

title: John 19:23
text: The soldiers therefore, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

title: John 19:24
text: They said therefore one to another, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my garments among them, And upon my vesture did they cast lots.

title: John 19:25
text: These things therefore the soldiers did. But there were standing by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the [wife] of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

title: John 19:26
text: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!

title: John 19:27
text: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold, thy mother! And from that hour the disciple took her unto his own [home] .

title: John 19:28
text: After this Jesus, knowing that all things are now finished, that the scripture might be accomplished, saith, I thirst.

title: John 19:29
text: There was set there a vessel full of vinegar: so they put a sponge full of the vinegar upon hyssop, and brought it to his mouth.

title: John 19:30
text: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up his spirit.

title: John 19:31
text: The Jews therefore, because it was the Preparation, that the bodies should not remain on the cross upon the sabbath (for the day of that sabbath was a high [day] ), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken, and [that] they might be taken away.

title: John 19:32
text: The soldiers therefore came, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other that was crucified with him:

title: John 19:33
text: but when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:

title: John 19:34
text: howbeit one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and straightway there came out blood and water.

title: John 19:35
text: And he that hath seen hath borne witness, and his witness is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye also may believe.

title: John 19:36
text: For these things came to pass, that the scripture might be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.

title: John 19:37
text: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.

title: John 19:38
text: And after these things Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave [him] leave. He came therefore, and took away his body.

title: John 19:39
text: And there came also Nicodemus, he who at the first came to him by night, bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred pounds.

title: John 19:40
text: So they took the body of Jesus, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.

title: John 19:41
text: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new tomb wherein was never man yet laid.

title: John 19:42
text: There then because of the Jews' Preparation (for the tomb was nigh at hand) they laid Jesus.

title: John 20:1
text: Now on the first [day] of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, while it was yet dark, unto the tomb, and seeth the stone taken away from the tomb.

title: John 20:2
text: She runneth therefore, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we know not where they have laid him.

title: John 20:3
text: Peter therefore went forth, and the other disciple, and they went toward the tomb.

title: John 20:4
text: And they ran both together: and the other disciple outran Peter, and came first to the tomb;

title: John 20:5
text: and stooping and looking in, he seeth the linen cloths lying; yet entered he not in.

title: John 20:6
text: Simon Peter therefore also cometh, following him, and entered into the tomb; and he beholdeth the linen cloths lying,

title: John 20:7
text: and the napkin, that was upon his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

title: John 20:8
text: Then entered in therefore the other disciple also, who came first to the tomb, and he saw, and believed.

title: John 20:9
text: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

title: John 20:10
text: So the disciples went away again unto their own home.

title: John 20:11
text: But Mary was standing without at the tomb weeping: so, as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb;

title: John 20:12
text: and she beholdeth two angels in white sitting, one at the head, and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

title: John 20:13
text: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.

title: John 20:14
text: When she had thus said, she turned herself back, and beholdeth Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.

title: John 20:15
text: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou hast borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.

title: John 20:16
text: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turneth herself, and saith unto him in Hebrew, Rabboni; which is to say, Teacher.

title: John 20:17
text: Jesus saith to her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended unto the Father: but go unto my brethren, and say to them, I ascend unto my Father and your Father, and my God and your God.

title: John 20:18
text: Mary Magdalene cometh and telleth the disciples, I have seen the Lord; and [that] he had said these things unto her.

title: John 20:19
text: When therefore it was evening, on that day, the first [day] of the week, and when the doors were shut where the disciples were, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace [be] unto you.

title: John 20:20
text: And when he had said this, he showed unto them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad, when they saw the Lord.

title: John 20:21
text: Jesus therefore said to them again, Peace [be] unto you: as the Father hath sent me, even so send I you.

title: John 20:22
text: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Spirit:

title: John 20:23
text: whose soever sins ye forgive, they are forgiven unto them; whose soever [sins] ye retain, they are retained.

title: John 20:24
text: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

title: John 20:25
text: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.

title: John 20:26
text: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them. Jesus cometh, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace [be] unto you.

title: John 20:27
text: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and see my hands; and reach [hither] thy hand, and put it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.

title: John 20:28
text: Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.

title: John 20:29
text: Jesus saith unto him, Because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed [are] they that have not seen, and [yet] have believed.

title: John 20:30
text: Many other signs therefore did Jesus in the presence of the disciples, which are not written in this book:

title: John 20:31
text: but these are written, that ye may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye may have life in his name.

title: John 21:1
text: After these things Jesus manifested himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and he manifested [himself] on this wise.

title: John 21:2
text: There was together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the [sons] of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.

title: John 21:3
text: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also come with thee. They went forth, and entered into the boat; and that night they took nothing.

title: John 21:4
text: But when day was now breaking, Jesus stood on the beach: yet the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.

title: John 21:5
text: Jesus therefore saith unto them, Children, have ye aught to eat? They answered him, No.

title: John 21:6
text: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.

title: John 21:7
text: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his coat about him (for he was naked), and cast himself into the sea.

title: John 21:8
text: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits off), dragging the net [full] of fishes.

title: John 21:9
text: So when they got out upon the land, they see a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.

title: John 21:10
text: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now taken.

title: John 21:11
text: Simon Peter therefore went up, and drew the net to land, full of great fishes, a hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, the net was not rent.

title: John 21:12
text: Jesus saith unto them, Come [and] break your fast. And none of the disciples durst inquire of him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.

title: John 21:13
text: Jesus cometh, and taketh the bread, and giveth them, and the fish likewise.

title: John 21:14
text: This is now the third time that Jesus was manifested to the disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.

title: John 21:15
text: So when they had broken their fast, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, [son] of John, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.

title: John 21:16
text: He saith to him again a second time, Simon, [son] of John, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Tend my sheep.

title: John 21:17
text: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, [son] of John, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

title: John 21:18
text: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.

title: John 21:19
text: Now this he spake, signifying by what manner of death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.

title: John 21:20
text: Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; who also leaned back on his breast at the supper, and said, Lord, who is he that betrayeth thee?

title: John 21:21
text: Peter therefore seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?

title: John 21:22
text: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what [is that] to thee? Follow thou me.

title: John 21:23
text: This saying therefore went forth among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, that he should not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what [is that] to thee?

title: John 21:24
text: This is the disciple that beareth witness of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his witness is true.

title: John 21:25
text: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself would not contain the books that should be written.

title: Acts 1:1
text: The former treatise I made, O Theophilus, concerning all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,

title: Acts 1:2
text: until the day in which he was received up, after that he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit unto the apostles whom he had chosen:

title: Acts 1:3
text: To whom he also showed himself alive after his passion by many proofs, appearing unto them by the space of forty days, and speaking the things concerning the kingdom of God:

title: Acts 1:4
text: and, being assembled together with them, he charged them not to depart from Jerusalem, but to wait for the promise of the Father, which, [said he], ye heard from me:

title: Acts 1:5
text: For John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days hence.

title: Acts 1:6
text: They therefore, when they were come together, asked him, saying, Lord, dost thou at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?

title: Acts 1:7
text: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know times or seasons, which the Father hath set within His own authority.

title: Acts 1:8
text: But ye shall receive power, when the Holy Spirit is come upon you: and ye shall be my witnesses both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea and Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

title: Acts 1:9
text: And when he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.

title: Acts 1:10
text: And while they were looking stedfastly into heaven as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;

title: Acts 1:11
text: who also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye looking into heaven? this Jesus, who was received up from you into heaven shall so come in like manner as ye beheld him going into heaven.

title: Acts 1:12
text: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is nigh unto Jerusalem, a Sabbath day's journey off.

title: Acts 1:13
text: And when they were come in, they went up into the upper chamber, where they were abiding; both Peter and John and James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James [the son] of Alphaeus, and Simon the Zealot, and Judas [the son] of James.

title: Acts 1:14
text: These all with one accord continued stedfastly in prayer, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.

title: Acts 1:15
text: And in these days Peter stood up in the midst of the brethren, and said (and there was a multitude of persons [gathered] together, about a hundred and twenty),

title: Acts 1:16
text: Brethren, it was needful that the Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spake before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to them that took Jesus.

title: Acts 1:17
text: For he was numbered among us, and received his portion in this ministry.

title: Acts 1:18
text: (Now this man obtained a field with the reward of his iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.

title: Acts 1:19
text: And it became known to all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch that in their language that field was called Akeldama, that is, The field of blood.)

title: Acts 1:20
text: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be made desolate, And let no man dwell therein: and, His office let another take. [

title: Acts 1:21
text: Of the men therefore that have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and went out among us,

title: Acts 1:22
text: beginning from the baptism of John, unto the day that he was received up from us, of these must one become a witness with us of his resurrection.

title: Acts 1:23
text: And they put forward two, Joseph called Barsabbas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.

title: Acts 1:24
text: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, who knowest the hearts of all men, show of these two the one whom thou hast chosen,

title: Acts 1:25
text: to take the place in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.

title: Acts 1:26
text: And they gave lots for them; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.

title: Acts 2:1
text: And when the day of Pentecost was now come, they were all together in one place.

title: Acts 2:2
text: And suddenly there came from heaven a sound as of the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

title: Acts 2:3
text: And there appeared unto them tongues parting asunder, like as of fire; and it sat upon each one of them.

title: Acts 2:4
text: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

title: Acts 2:5
text: Now there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under heaven.

title: Acts 2:6
text: And when this sound was heard, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speaking in his own language.

title: Acts 2:7
text: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying, Behold, are not all these that speak Galilaeans?

title: Acts 2:8
text: And how hear we, every man in our own language wherein we were born?

title: Acts 2:9
text: Parthians and Medes and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, in Judaea and Cappadocia, in Pontus and Asia,

title: Acts 2:10
text: in Phrygia and Pamphylia, in Egypt and the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and sojourners from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,

title: Acts 2:11
text: Cretans and Arabians, we hear them speaking in our tongues the mighty works of God.

title: Acts 2:12
text: And they were all amazed, and were perplexed, saying one to another, What meaneth this?

title: Acts 2:13
text: But others mocking said, They are filled with new wine.

title: Acts 2:14
text: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and spake forth unto them, [saying], Ye men of Judaea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and give ear unto my words.

title: Acts 2:15
text: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose; seeing it is [but] the third hour of the day.

title: Acts 2:16
text: but this is that which hath been spoken through the prophet Joel:

title: Acts 2:17
text: And it shall be in the last days, saith God, I will pour forth of my Spirit upon all flesh: And your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, And your young men shall see visions, And your old men shall dream dreams:

title: Acts 2:18
text: Yea and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days Will I pour forth of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy.

title: Acts 2:19
text: And I will show wonders in the heaven above, And signs on the earth beneath; Blood, and fire, and vapor of smoke:

title: Acts 2:20
text: The sun shall be turned into darkness, And the moon into blood, Before the day of the Lord come, That great and notable [day] .

title: Acts 2:21
text: And it shall be, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.

title: Acts 2:22
text: Ye men of Israel, hear these words: Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God unto you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him in the midst of you, even as ye yourselves know; [

title: Acts 2:23
text: him, being delivered up by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye by the hand of lawless men did crucify and slay:

title: Acts 2:24
text: whom God raised up, having loosed the pangs of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.

title: Acts 2:25
text: For David saith concerning him, I beheld the Lord always before my face; For he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:

title: Acts 2:26
text: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced; Moreover my flesh also shall dwell in hope:

title: Acts 2:27
text: Because thou wilt not leave my soul unto Hades, Neither wilt thou give thy Holy One to see corruption.

title: Acts 2:28
text: Thou madest known unto me the ways of life; Thou shalt make me full of gladness with thy countenance.

title: Acts 2:29
text: Brethren, I may say unto you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us unto this day.

title: Acts 2:30
text: Being therefore a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins he would set [one] upon his throne;

title: Acts 2:31
text: he foreseeing [this] spake of the resurrection of the Christ, that neither was he left unto Hades, nor did his flesh see corruption.

title: Acts 2:32
text: This Jesus did God raise up, whereof we all are witnesses.

title: Acts 2:33
text: Being therefore by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he hath poured forth this, which ye see and hear.

title: Acts 2:34
text: For David ascended not into the heavens: but he saith himself, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

title: Acts 2:35
text: Till I make thine enemies the footstool of thy feet.

title: Acts 2:36
text: Let all the house of Israel therefore know assuredly, that God hath made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom ye crucified.

title: Acts 2:37
text: Now when they heard [this], they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and the rest of the apostles, Brethren, what shall we do?

title: Acts 2:38
text: And Peter [said] unto them, Repent ye, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ unto the remission of your sins; and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

title: Acts 2:39
text: For to you is the promise, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, [even] as many as the Lord our God shall call unto him.

title: Acts 2:40
text: And with many other words he testified, and exhorted them, saying, Save yourselves from this crooked generation.

title: Acts 2:41
text: They then that received his word were baptized: and there were added [unto them] in that day about three thousand souls.

title: Acts 2:42
text: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread and the prayers.

title: Acts 2:43
text: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.

title: Acts 2:44
text: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;

title: Acts 2:45
text: and they sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all, according as any man had need.

title: Acts 2:46
text: And day by day, continuing stedfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,

title: Acts 2:47
text: praising God, and having favor with all the people. And the Lord added to them day by day those that were saved.

title: Acts 3:1
text: Now Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, [being] the ninth [hour] .

title: Acts 3:2
text: And a certain man that was lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;

title: Acts 3:3
text: who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, asked to receive an alms.

title: Acts 3:4
text: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him, with John, said, Look on us.

title: Acts 3:5
text: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something from them.

title: Acts 3:6
text: But Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but what I have, that give I thee. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, walk.

title: Acts 3:7
text: And he took him by the right hand, and raised him up: and immediately his feet and his ankle-bones received strength.

title: Acts 3:8
text: And leaping up, he stood, and began to walk; and he entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

title: Acts 3:9
text: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:

title: Acts 3:10
text: and they took knowledge of him, that it was he that sat for alms at the Beautiful Gate of the temple; and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.

title: Acts 3:11
text: And as he held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.

title: Acts 3:12
text: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this man? or why fasten ye your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him to walk?

title: Acts 3:13
text: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Servant Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied before the face of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.

title: Acts 3:14
text: But ye denied the Holy and Righteous One, and asked for a murderer to be granted unto you,

title: Acts 3:15
text: and killed the Prince of life; whom God raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.

title: Acts 3:16
text: And by faith in his name hath his name made this man strong, whom ye behold and know: yea, the faith which is through him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

title: Acts 3:17
text: And now, brethren, I know that in ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.

title: Acts 3:18
text: But the things which God foreshowed by the mouth of all the prophets, that his Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.

title: Acts 3:19
text: Repent ye therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, that so there may come seasons of refreshing from the presence of the Lord;

title: Acts 3:20
text: and that he may send the Christ who hath been appointed for you, [even] Jesus:

title: Acts 3:21
text: whom the heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, whereof God spake by the mouth of His holy prophets that have been from of old.

title: Acts 3:22
text: Moses indeed said, A prophet shall the Lord God raise up unto you from among your brethren, like unto me. To him shall ye hearken in all things whatsoever he shall speak unto you.

title: Acts 3:23
text: And it shall be, that every soul that shall not hearken to that prophet, shall be utterly destroyed from among the people.

title: Acts 3:24
text: Yea and all the prophets from Samuel and them that followed after, as many as have spoken, they also told of these days.

title: Acts 3:25
text: Ye are the sons of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with your fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

title: Acts 3:26
text: Unto you first God, having raised up his Servant, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your iniquities.

title: Acts 4:1
text: And as they spake unto the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came upon them,

title: Acts 4:2
text: being sore troubled because they taught the people, and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

title: Acts 4:3
text: And they laid hands on them, and put them in ward unto the morrow: for it was now eventide.

title: Acts 4:4
text: But many of them that heard the word believed; and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.

title: Acts 4:5
text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers and elders and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem;

title: Acts 4:6
text: and Annas the high priest [was there], and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest.

title: Acts 4:7
text: And when they had set them in the midst, they inquired, By what power, or in what name, have ye done this?

title: Acts 4:8
text: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders,

title: Acts 4:9
text: if we this day are examined concerning a good deed done to an impotent man, by what means this man is made whole;

title: Acts 4:10
text: be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, [even] in him doth this man stand here before you whole.

title: Acts 4:11
text: He is the stone which was set at nought of you the builders, which was made the head of the corner.

title: Acts 4:12
text: And in none other is there salvation: for neither is there any other name under heaven, that is given among men, wherein we must be saved.

title: Acts 4:13
text: Now when they beheld the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.

title: Acts 4:14
text: And seeing the man that was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

title: Acts 4:15
text: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

title: Acts 4:16
text: saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been wrought through them, is manifest to all that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.

title: Acts 4:17
text: But that it spread no further among the people, let us threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.

title: Acts 4:18
text: And they called them, and charged them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

title: Acts 4:19
text: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it is right in the sight of God to hearken unto you rather than unto God, judge ye:

title: Acts 4:20
text: for we cannot but speak the things which we saw and heard.

title: Acts 4:21
text: And they, when they had further threatened them, let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people; for all men glorified God for that which was done.

title: Acts 4:22
text: For the man was more than forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was wrought.

title: Acts 4:23
text: And being let go, they came to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said unto them.

title: Acts 4:24
text: And they, when they heard it, lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, O Lord, thou that didst make the heaven and the earth and the sea, and all that in them is:

title: Acts 4:25
text: who by the Holy Spirit, [by] the mouth of our father David thy servant, didst say, Why did the Gentiles rage, And the peoples imagine vain things?

title: Acts 4:26
text: The kings of the earth set themselves in array, And the rulers were gathered together, Against the Lord, and against his Anointed:

title: Acts 4:27
text: for of a truth in this city against thy holy Servant Jesus, whom thou didst anoint, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the peoples of Israel, were gathered together,

title: Acts 4:28
text: to do whatsoever thy hand and thy council foreordained to come to pass.

title: Acts 4:29
text: And now, Lord, look upon their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants to speak thy word with all boldness,

title: Acts 4:30
text: while thy stretchest forth thy hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of thy holy Servant Jesus.

title: Acts 4:31
text: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken wherein they were gathered together; and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spake the word of God with boldness.

title: Acts 4:32
text: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and soul: and not one [of them] said that aught of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.

title: Acts 4:33
text: And with great power gave the apostles their witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.

title: Acts 4:34
text: For neither was there among them any that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,

title: Acts 4:35
text: and laid them at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made unto each, according as any one had need.

title: Acts 4:36
text: And Joseph, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of exhortation), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,

title: Acts 4:37
text: having a field, sold it, and brought the money and laid it at the apostles' feet.

title: Acts 5:1
text: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

title: Acts 5:2
text: and kept back [part] of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

title: Acts 5:3
text: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thy heart to lie to the Holy Spirit, and to keep back [part] of the price of the land?

title: Acts 5:4
text: While it remained, did it not remain thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thy power? How is it that thou hast conceived this thing in thy heart? thou has not lied unto men, but unto God.

title: Acts 5:5
text: And Ananias hearing these words fell down and gave up the ghost: and great fear came upon all that heard it.

title: Acts 5:6
text: And the young men arose and wrapped him round, and they carried him out and buried him.

title: Acts 5:7
text: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.

title: Acts 5:8
text: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much. And she said, Yea, for so much.

title: Acts 5:9
text: But Peter [said] unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to try the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them that have buried thy husband are at the door, and they shall carry thee out.

title: Acts 5:10
text: And she fell down immediately at his feet, and gave up the ghost: and the young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.

title: Acts 5:11
text: And great fear came upon the whole church, and upon all that heard these things.

title: Acts 5:12
text: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.

title: Acts 5:13
text: But of the rest durst no man join himself to them: howbeit the people magnified them;

title: Acts 5:14
text: and believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women;

title: Acts 5:15
text: insomuch that they even carried out the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that, as Peter came by, at the least his shadow might overshadow some one of them.

title: Acts 5:16
text: And there also came together the multitudes from the cities round about Jerusalem, bring sick folk, and them that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.

title: Acts 5:17
text: But the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy,

title: Acts 5:18
text: and laid hands on the apostles, and put them in public ward.

title: Acts 5:19
text: But an angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them out, and said,

title: Acts 5:20
text: Go ye, and stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this Life.

title: Acts 5:21
