text: But now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

title: 1 Corinthians 14:7
text: Even things without life, giving a voice, whether pipe or harp, if they give not a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?

title: 1 Corinthians 14:8
text: For if the trumpet give an uncertain voice, who shall prepare himself for war?

title: 1 Corinthians 14:9
text: So also ye, unless ye utter by the tongue speech easy to understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye will be speaking into the air.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:10
text: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and no [kind] is without signification.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:11
text: If then I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be to him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh will be a barbarian unto me.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:12
text: So also ye, since ye are zealous of spiritual [gifts], seek that ye may abound unto the edifying of the church.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:13
text: Wherefore let him that speaketh in a tongue pray that he may interpret.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:14
text: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:15
text: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:16
text: Else if thou bless with the spirit, how shall he that filleth the place of the unlearned say the Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he knoweth not what thou sayest?

title: 1 Corinthians 14:17
text: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:18
text: I thank God, I speak with tongues more than you all:

title: 1 Corinthians 14:19
text: howbeit in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in a tongue.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:20
text: Brethren, be not children in mind: yet in malice be ye babes, but in mind be men.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:21
text: In the law it is written, By men of strange tongues and by the lips of strangers will I speak unto this people; and not even thus will they hear me, saith the Lord.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:22
text: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to the unbelieving: but prophesying [is for a sign], not to the unbelieving, but to them that believe.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:23
text: If therefore the whole church be assembled together and all speak with tongues, and there come in men unlearned or unbelieving, will they not say that ye are mad?

title: 1 Corinthians 14:24
text: But if all prophesy, and there come in one unbelieving or unlearned, he is reproved by all, he is judged by all;

title: 1 Corinthians 14:25
text: the secrets of his heart are made manifest; and so he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:26
text: What is it then, brethren? When ye come together, each one hath a psalm, hath a teaching, hath a revelation, hath a tongue, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:27
text: If any man speaketh in a tongue, [let it be] by two, or at the most three, and [that] in turn; and let one interpret:

title: 1 Corinthians 14:28
text: but if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:29
text: And let the prophets speak [by] two or three, and let the others discern.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:30
text: But if a revelation be made to another sitting by, let the first keep silence.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:31
text: For ye all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be exhorted;

title: 1 Corinthians 14:32
text: and the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets;

title: 1 Corinthians 14:33
text: for God is not [a God] of confusion, but of peace. As in all the churches of the saints,

title: 1 Corinthians 14:34
text: let the women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but let them be in subjection, as also saith the law.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:35
text: And if they would learn anything, let them ask their own husbands at home: for it is shameful for a woman to speak in the church.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:36
text: What? was it from you that the word of God went forth? or came it unto you alone?

title: 1 Corinthians 14:37
text: If any man thinketh himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him take knowledge of the things which I write unto you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:38
text: But if any man is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:39
text: Wherefore, my brethren, desire earnestly to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.

title: 1 Corinthians 14:40
text: But let all things be done decently and in order.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:1
text: Now I make known unto you brethren, the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye received, wherein also ye stand,

title: 1 Corinthians 15:2
text: by which also ye are saved, if ye hold fast the word which I preached unto you, except ye believed in vain.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:3
text: For I delivered unto you first of all that which also I received: that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;

title: 1 Corinthians 15:4
text: and that he was buried; and that he hath been raised on the third day according to the scriptures;

title: 1 Corinthians 15:5
text: and that he appeared to Cephas; then to the twelve;

title: 1 Corinthians 15:6
text: then he appeared to above five hundred brethren at once, of whom the greater part remain until now, but some are fallen asleep;

title: 1 Corinthians 15:7
text: then he appeared to James; then to all the apostles;

title: 1 Corinthians 15:8
text: and last of all, as to the [child] untimely born, he appeared to me also.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:9
text: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:10
text: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not found vain; but I labored more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:11
text: Whether then [it be] I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:12
text: Now if Christ is preached that he hath been raised from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?

title: 1 Corinthians 15:13
text: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither hath Christ been raised:

title: 1 Corinthians 15:14
text: and if Christ hath not been raised, then is our preaching vain, your faith also is vain.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:15
text: Yea, we are found false witnesses of God; because we witnessed of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead are not raised.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:16
text: For if the dead are not raised, neither hath Christ been raised:

title: 1 Corinthians 15:17
text: and if Christ hath not been raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:18
text: Then they also that are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:19
text: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:20
text: But now hath Christ been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of them that are asleep.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:21
text: For since by man [came] death, by man [came] also the resurrection of the dead.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:22
text: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ shall all be made alive.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:23
text: But each in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; then they that are Christ's, at his coming.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:24
text: Then [cometh] the end, when he shall deliver up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have abolished all rule and all authority and power.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:25
text: For he must reign, till he hath put all his enemies under his feet.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:26
text: The last enemy that shall be abolished is death.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:27
text: For, He put all things in subjection under his feet. But when he saith, All things are put in subjection, it is evident that he is excepted who did subject all things unto him.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:28
text: And when all things have been subjected unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subjected to him that did subject all things unto him, that God may be all in all.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:29
text: Else what shall they do that are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why then are they baptized for them?

title: 1 Corinthians 15:30
text: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

title: 1 Corinthians 15:31
text: I protest by that glorifying in you, brethren, which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:32
text: If after the manner of men I fought with beasts at Ephesus, what doth it profit me? If the dead are not raised, let us eat and drink, for to-morrow we die.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:33
text: Be not deceived: Evil companionships corrupt good morals.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:34
text: Awake to soberness righteously, and sin not; for some have no knowledge of God: I speak [this] to move you to shame.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:35
text: But some one will say, How are the dead raised? and with what manner of body do they come?

title: 1 Corinthians 15:36
text: Thou foolish one, that which thou thyself sowest is not quickened except it die:

title: 1 Corinthians 15:37
text: and that which thou sowest, thou sowest not the body that shall be, but a bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other kind;

title: 1 Corinthians 15:38
text: but God giveth it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:39
text: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one [flesh] of men, and another flesh of beasts, and another flesh of birds, and another of fishes.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:40
text: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the [glory] of the terrestrial is another.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:41
text: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differeth from another star in glory.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:42
text: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:

title: 1 Corinthians 15:43
text: it is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:

title: 1 Corinthians 15:44
text: it is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual [body] .

title: 1 Corinthians 15:45
text: So also it is written, The first man Adam became a living soul. The last Adam [became] a life-giving spirit.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:46
text: Howbeit that is not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; then that which is spiritual.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:47
text: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is of heaven.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:48
text: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:49
text: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:50
text: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:51
text: Behold, I tell you a mystery: We all shall not sleep, but we shall all be changed,

title: 1 Corinthians 15:52
text: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:53
text: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:54
text: But when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall come to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:55
text: O death, where is thy victory? O death, where is thy sting?

title: 1 Corinthians 15:56
text: The sting of death is sin; and the power of sin is the law:

title: 1 Corinthians 15:57
text: but thanks be to God, who giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: 1 Corinthians 15:58
text: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labor is not vain in the Lord.

title: 1 Corinthians 16:1
text: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I gave order to the churches of Galatia, so also do ye.

title: 1 Corinthians 16:2
text: Upon the first day of the week let each one of you lay by him in store, as he may prosper, that no collections be made when I come.

title: 1 Corinthians 16:3
text: And when I arrive, whomsoever ye shall approve, them will I send with letters to carry your bounty unto Jerusalem:

title: 1 Corinthians 16:4
text: and if it be meet for me to go also, they shall go with me.

title: 1 Corinthians 16:5
text: But I will come unto you, when I shall have passed through Macedonia; for I pass through Macedonia;

title: 1 Corinthians 16:6
text: but with you it may be that I shall abide, or even winter, that ye may set me forward on my journey whithersoever I go.

title: 1 Corinthians 16:7
text: For I do not wish to see you now by the way; for I hope to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.

title: 1 Corinthians 16:8
text: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost;

title: 1 Corinthians 16:9
text: for a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.

title: 1 Corinthians 16:10
text: Now if Timothy come, see that he be with you without fear; for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do:

title: 1 Corinthians 16:11
text: let no man therefore despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come unto me: for I expect him with the brethren.

title: 1 Corinthians 16:12
text: But as touching Apollos the brother, I besought him much to come unto you with the brethren: and it was not all [his] will to come now; but he will come when he shall have opportunity. [

title: 1 Corinthians 16:13
text: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.

title: 1 Corinthians 16:14
text: Let all that ye do be done in love.

title: 1 Corinthians 16:15
text: Now I beseech you, brethren (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to minister unto the saints),

title: 1 Corinthians 16:16
text: that ye also be in subjection unto such, and to every one that helpeth in the work and laboreth.

title: 1 Corinthians 16:17
text: And I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they supplied.

title: 1 Corinthians 16:18
text: For they refreshed my spirit and yours: acknowledge ye therefore them that are such.

title: 1 Corinthians 16:19
text: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Prisca salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.

title: 1 Corinthians 16:20
text: All the brethren salute you. Salute one another with a holy kiss.

title: 1 Corinthians 16:21
text: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.

title: 1 Corinthians 16:22
text: If any man loveth not the Lord, let him be anathema. Maranatha.

title: 1 Corinthians 16:23
text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

title: 1 Corinthians 16:24
text: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.

title: 2 Corinthians 1:1
text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints that are in the whole of Achaia:

title: 2 Corinthians 1:2
text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: 2 Corinthians 1:3
text: Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort;

title: 2 Corinthians 1:4
text: who comforteth us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort them that are in any affliction, through the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.

title: 2 Corinthians 1:5
text: For as the sufferings of Christ abound unto us, even so our comfort also aboundeth through Christ.

title: 2 Corinthians 1:6
text: But whether we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; or whether we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which worketh in the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer:

title: 2 Corinthians 1:7
text: and our hope for you is stedfast; knowing that, as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so also are ye of the comfort.

title: 2 Corinthians 1:8
text: For we would not have you ignorant, brethren, concerning our affliction which befell [us] in Asia, that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, insomuch that we despaired even of life:

title: 2 Corinthians 1:9
text: yea, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raiseth the dead:

title: 2 Corinthians 1:10
text: who delivered us out of so great a death, and will deliver: on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us;

title: 2 Corinthians 1:11
text: ye also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift bestowed upon us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on our behalf.

title: 2 Corinthians 1:12
text: For our glorifying is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.

title: 2 Corinthians 1:13
text: For we write no other things unto you, than what ye read or even acknowledge, and I hope ye will acknowledge unto the end:

title: 2 Corinthians 1:14
text: as also ye did acknowledge us in part, that we are your glorying, even as ye also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

title: 2 Corinthians 1:15
text: And in this confidence I was minded to come first unto you, that ye might have a second benefit;

title: 2 Corinthians 1:16
text: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come unto you, and of you to be set forward on my journey unto Judaea.

title: 2 Corinthians 1:17
text: When I therefore was thus minded, did I show fickleness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be the yea yea and the nay nay?

title: 2 Corinthians 1:18
text: But as God is faithful, our word toward you is not yea and nay.

title: 2 Corinthians 1:19
text: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, [even] by me and Silvanus and Timothy, was not yea and nay, but in him is yea.

title: 2 Corinthians 1:20
text: For how many soever be the promises of God, in him is the yea: wherefore also through him is the Amen, unto the glory of God through us.

title: 2 Corinthians 1:21
text: Now he that establisheth us with you in Christ, and anointed us, is God;

title: 2 Corinthians 1:22
text: who also sealed us, and gave [us] the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.

title: 2 Corinthians 1:23
text: But I call God for a witness upon my soul, that to spare you I forbare to come unto Corinth.

title: 2 Corinthians 1:24
text: Not that we have lordship over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for in faith ye stand fast.

title: 2 Corinthians 2:1
text: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come again to you with sorrow.

title: 2 Corinthians 2:2
text: For if I make you sorry, who then is he that maketh me glad but he that is made sorry by me?

title: 2 Corinthians 2:3
text: And I wrote this very thing, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is [the joy] of you all.

title: 2 Corinthians 2:4
text: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be made sorry, but that ye might know the love that I have more abundantly unto you.

title: 2 Corinthians 2:5
text: But if any hath caused sorrow, he hath caused sorrow, not to me, but in part (that I press not too heavily) to you all.

title: 2 Corinthians 2:6
text: Sufficient to such a one is this punishment which was [inflicted] by the many;

title: 2 Corinthians 2:7
text: so that contrariwise ye should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his overmuch sorrow.

title: 2 Corinthians 2:8
text: Wherefore I beseech you to confirm [your] love toward him.

title: 2 Corinthians 2:9
text: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye are obedient in all things.

title: 2 Corinthians 2:10
text: But to whom ye forgive anything, I [forgive] also: for what I also have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, for your sakes [have I forgiven it] in the presence of Christ;

title: 2 Corinthians 2:11
text: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan: for we are not ignorant of his devices.

title: 2 Corinthians 2:12
text: Now when I came to Troas for the gospel of Christ, and when a door was opened unto me in the Lord,

title: 2 Corinthians 2:13
text: I had no relief for my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went forth into Macedonia.

title: 2 Corinthians 2:14
text: But thanks be unto God, who always leadeth us in triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest through us the savor of his knowledge in every place.

title: 2 Corinthians 2:15
text: For we are a sweet savor of Christ unto God, in them that are saved, and in them that perish;

title: 2 Corinthians 2:16
text: to the one a savor from death unto death; to the other a savor from life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?

title: 2 Corinthians 2:17
text: For we are not as the many, corrupting the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, speak we in Christ.

title: 2 Corinthians 3:1
text: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? or need we, as do some, epistles of commendation to you or from you?

title: 2 Corinthians 3:2
text: Ye are our epistle, written in our hearts, known and read of all men;

title: 2 Corinthians 3:3
text: being made manifest that ye are an epistle of Christ, ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in tables [that are] hearts of flesh.

title: 2 Corinthians 3:4
text: And such confidence have we through Christ to God-ward:

title: 2 Corinthians 3:5
text: not that we are sufficient of ourselves, to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God;

title: 2 Corinthians 3:6
text: who also made us sufficient as ministers of a new covenant; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.

title: 2 Corinthians 3:7
text: But if the ministration of death, written, [and] engraven on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look stedfastly upon the face of Moses for the glory of his face; which [glory] was passing away:

title: 2 Corinthians 3:8
text: how shall not rather the ministration of the spirit be with glory?

title: 2 Corinthians 3:9
text: For if the ministration of condemnation hath glory, much rather doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.

title: 2 Corinthians 3:10
text: For verily that which hath been made glorious hath not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasseth.

title: 2 Corinthians 3:11
text: For if that which passeth away [was] with glory, much more that which remaineth [is] in glory.

title: 2 Corinthians 3:12
text: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

title: 2 Corinthians 3:13
text: and [are] not as Moses, [who] put a veil upon his face, that the children of Israel should not look stedfastly on the end of that which was passing away: [

title: 2 Corinthians 3:14
text: but their minds were hardened: for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remaineth, it not being revealed [to them] that it is done away in Christ.

title: 2 Corinthians 3:15
text: But unto this day, whensoever Moses is read, a veil lieth upon their heart.

title: 2 Corinthians 3:16
text: But whensoever it shall turn to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

title: 2 Corinthians 3:17
text: Now the Lord is the Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, [there] is liberty.

title: 2 Corinthians 3:18
text: But we all, with unveiled face beholding as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord the Spirit.

title: 2 Corinthians 4:1
text: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we faint not:

title: 2 Corinthians 4:2
text: but we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.

title: 2 Corinthians 4:3
text: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled in them that perish:

title: 2 Corinthians 4:4
text: in whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn [upon them] .

title: 2 Corinthians 4:5
text: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus' sake.

title: 2 Corinthians 4:6
text: Seeing it is God, that said, Light shall shine out of darkness, who shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

title: 2 Corinthians 4:7
text: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God, and not from ourselves;

title: 2 Corinthians 4:8
text: [ we are] pressed on every side, yet not straitened; perplexed, yet not unto despair;

title: 2 Corinthians 4:9
text: pursued, yet not forsaken; smitten down, yet not destroyed;

title: 2 Corinthians 4:10
text: always bearing about in the body the dying of Jesus, that the life also of Jesus may be manifested in our body.

title: 2 Corinthians 4:11
text: For we who live are always delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus may be manifested in our mortal flesh.

title: 2 Corinthians 4:12
text: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.

title: 2 Corinthians 4:13
text: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, I believed, and therefore did I speak; we also believe, and therefore also we speak;

title: 2 Corinthians 4:14
text: knowing that he that raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also with Jesus, and shall present us with you.

title: 2 Corinthians 4:15
text: For all things [are] for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound unto the glory of God.

title: 2 Corinthians 4:16
text: Wherefore we faint not; but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.

title: 2 Corinthians 4:17
text: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, worketh for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory;

title: 2 Corinthians 4:18
text: while we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

title: 2 Corinthians 5:1
text: For we know that if the earthly house of our tabernacle be dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

title: 2 Corinthians 5:2
text: For verily in this we groan, longing to be clothed upon with our habitation which is from heaven:

title: 2 Corinthians 5:3
text: if so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.

title: 2 Corinthians 5:4
text: For indeed we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened; not for that we would be unclothed, but that we would be clothed upon, that what is mortal may be swallowed up of life.

title: 2 Corinthians 5:5
text: Now he that wrought us for this very thing is God, who gave unto us the earnest of the Spirit.

title: 2 Corinthians 5:6
text: Being therefore always of good courage, and knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord

title: 2 Corinthians 5:7
text: (for we walk by faith, not by sight);

title: 2 Corinthians 5:8
text: we are of good courage, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be at home with the Lord.

title: 2 Corinthians 5:9
text: Wherefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well-pleasing unto him.

title: 2 Corinthians 5:10
text: For we must all be made manifest before the judgment-seat of Christ; that each one may receive the things [done] in the body, according to what he hath done, whether [it be] good or bad.

title: 2 Corinthians 5:11
text: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are made manifest unto God; and I hope that we are made manifest also in your consciences.

title: 2 Corinthians 5:12
text: We are not again commending ourselves unto you, but [speak] as giving you occasion of glorying on our behalf, that ye may have wherewith to answer them that glory in appearance, and not in heart.

title: 2 Corinthians 5:13
text: For whether we are beside ourselves, it is unto God; or whether we are of sober mind, it is unto you.

title: 2 Corinthians 5:14
text: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that one died for all, therefore all died;

title: 2 Corinthians 5:15
text: and he died for all, that they that live should no longer live unto themselves, but unto him who for their sakes died and rose again.

title: 2 Corinthians 5:16
text: Wherefore we henceforth know no man after the flesh: even though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now we know [him so] no more.

title: 2 Corinthians 5:17
text: Wherefore if any man is in Christ, [he is] a new creature: the old things are passed away; behold, they are become new.

title: 2 Corinthians 5:18
text: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ, and gave unto us the ministry of reconciliation;

title: 2 Corinthians 5:19
text: to wit, that God was in Christ reconciling the world unto himself, not reckoning unto them their trespasses, and having committed unto us the word of reconciliation.

title: 2 Corinthians 5:20
text: We are ambassadors therefore on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beseech [you] on behalf of Christ, be ye reconciled to God.

title: 2 Corinthians 5:21
text: Him who knew no sin he made [to be] sin on our behalf; that we might become the righteousness of God in him.

title: 2 Corinthians 6:1
text: And working together [with him] we entreat also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain

title: 2 Corinthians 6:2
text: (for he saith, At an acceptable time I hearkened unto thee, And in a day of salvation did I succor thee: behold, now is the acceptable time; behold, now is the day of salvation):

title: 2 Corinthians 6:3
text: giving no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our ministration be not blamed;

title: 2 Corinthians 6:4
text: but in everything commending ourselves, as ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,

title: 2 Corinthians 6:5
text: in stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labors, in watchings, in fastings;

title: 2 Corinthians 6:6
text: in pureness, in knowledge, in long suffering, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in love unfeigned,

title: 2 Corinthians 6:7
text: in the word of truth, in the power of God; by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

title: 2 Corinthians 6:8
text: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report; as deceivers, and [yet] true;

title: 2 Corinthians 6:9
text: as unknown, and [yet] well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;

title: 2 Corinthians 6:10
text: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and [yet] possessing all things.

title: 2 Corinthians 6:11
text: Our mouth is open unto you, O Corinthians, our heart is enlarged.

title: 2 Corinthians 6:12
text: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own affections.

title: 2 Corinthians 6:13
text: Now for a recompense in like kind (I speak as unto [my] children), be ye also enlarged.

title: 2 Corinthians 6:14
text: Be not unequally yoked with unbelievers: for what fellowship have righteousness and iniquity? or what communion hath light with darkness?

title: 2 Corinthians 6:15
text: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what portion hath a believer with an unbeliever?

title: 2 Corinthians 6:16
text: And what agreement hath a temple of God with idols? for we are a temple of the living God; even as God said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

title: 2 Corinthians 6:17
text: Wherefore Come ye out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, And touch no unclean thing; And I will receive you,

title: 2 Corinthians 6:18
text: And will be to you a Father, And ye shall be to me sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.

title: 2 Corinthians 7:1
text: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

title: 2 Corinthians 7:2
text: Open your hearts to us: we wronged no man, we corrupted no man, we took advantage of no man.

title: 2 Corinthians 7:3
text: I say it not to condemn [you] : for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die together and live together.

title: 2 Corinthians 7:4
text: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying on your behalf: I am filled with comfort, I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

title: 2 Corinthians 7:5
text: For even when we were come into Macedonia our flesh had no relief, but [we were] afflicted on every side; without [were] fightings, within [were] fears.

title: 2 Corinthians 7:6
text: Nevertheless he that comforteth the lowly, [even] God, comforted us by the coming of Titus;

title: 2 Corinthians 7:7
text: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort wherewith he was comforted in you, while he told us your longing, your mourning, your zeal for me; so that I rejoiced yet more.

title: 2 Corinthians 7:8
text: For though I made you sorry with my epistle, I do not regret it: though I did regret [it] (for I see that that epistle made you sorry, though but for a season),

title: 2 Corinthians 7:9
text: I now rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye were made sorry unto repentance; for ye were made sorry after a godly sort, that ye might suffer loss by us in nothing.

title: 2 Corinthians 7:10
text: For godly sorrow worketh repentance unto salvation, [a repentance] which bringeth no regret: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.

title: 2 Corinthians 7:11
text: For behold, this selfsame thing, that ye were made sorry after a godly sort, what earnest care it wrought in you, yea what clearing of yourselves, yea what indignation, yea what fear, yea what longing, yea what zeal, yea what avenging! In everything ye approved yourselves to be pure in the matter.

title: 2 Corinthians 7:12
text: So although I wrote unto you, I [wrote] not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be made manifest unto you in the sight of God.

title: 2 Corinthians 7:13
text: Therefore we have been comforted: And in our comfort we joyed the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit hath been refreshed by you all.

title: 2 Corinthians 7:14
text: For if in anything I have gloried to him on your behalf, I was not put to shame; but as we spake all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

title: 2 Corinthians 7:15
text: And his affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.

title: 2 Corinthians 7:16
text: I rejoice that in everything I am of good courage concerning you.

title: 2 Corinthians 8:1
text: Moreover, brethren, we make known to you the grace of God which hath been given in the churches of Macedonia;

title: 2 Corinthians 8:2
text: how that in much proof of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.

title: 2 Corinthians 8:3
text: For according to their power, I bear witness, yea and beyond their power, [they gave] of their own accord,

title: 2 Corinthians 8:4
text: beseeching us with much entreaty in regard of this grace and the fellowship in the ministering to the saints:

title: 2 Corinthians 8:5
text: and [this], not as we had hoped, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

title: 2 Corinthians 8:6
text: Insomuch that we exhorted Titus, that as he made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace also.

title: 2 Corinthians 8:7
text: But as ye abound in everything, [in] faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and [in] all earnestness, and [in] your love to us, [see] that ye abound in this grace also. [

title: 2 Corinthians 8:8
text: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

title: 2 Corinthians 8:9
text: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might become rich.

title: 2 Corinthians 8:10
text: And herein I give [my] judgment: for this is expedient for you, who were the first to make a beginning a year ago, not only to do, but also to will.

title: 2 Corinthians 8:11
text: But now complete the doing also; that as [there was] the readiness to will, so [there may be] the completion also out of your ability.

title: 2 Corinthians 8:12
text: For if the readiness is there, [it is] acceptable according as [a man] hath, not according as [he] hath not.

title: 2 Corinthians 8:13
text: For [I say] not [this] that others may be eased [and] ye distressed;

title: 2 Corinthians 8:14
text: but by equality: your abundance [being a supply] at this present time for their want, that their abundance also may become [a supply] for your want; that there may be equality:

title: 2 Corinthians 8:15
text: as it is written, He that [gathered] much had nothing over; and he that [gathered] little had no lack.

title: 2 Corinthians 8:16
text: But thanks be to God, who putteth the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

title: 2 Corinthians 8:17
text: For he accepted indeed our exhortation; but being himself very earnest, he went forth unto you of his own accord.

title: 2 Corinthians 8:18
text: And we have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the gospel [is spread] through all the churches;

title: 2 Corinthians 8:19
text: and not only so, but who was also appointed by the churches to travel with us in [the matter of] this grace, which is ministered by us to the glory of the Lord, and [to show] our readiness:

title: 2 Corinthians 8:20
text: Avoiding this, that any man should blame us in [the matter of] this bounty which is ministered by us:

title: 2 Corinthians 8:21
text: for we take thought for things honorable, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

title: 2 Corinthians 8:22
text: and we have sent with them our brother, whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which [he hath] in you.

title: 2 Corinthians 8:23
text: Whether [any inquire] about Titus, [he is] my partner and [my] fellow-worker to you-ward, or our brethren, [they are] the messengers of the churches, [they are] the glory of Christ.

title: 2 Corinthians 8:24
text: Show ye therefore unto them in the face of the churches the proof of your love, and of our glorying on your behalf.

title: 2 Corinthians 9:1
text: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:

title: 2 Corinthians 9:2
text: for I know your readiness, of which I glory on your behalf to them of Macedonia, that Achaia hath been prepared for a year past; and your zeal hath stirred up very many of them.

title: 2 Corinthians 9:3
text: But I have sent the brethren, that our glorying on your behalf may not be made void in this respect; that, even as I said, ye may be prepared:

title: 2 Corinthians 9:4
text: lest by any means, if there come with me any of Macedonia and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be put to shame in this confidence.

title: 2 Corinthians 9:5
text: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your aforepromised bounty, that the same might be ready as a matter of bounty, and not of extortion.

title: 2 Corinthians 9:6
text: But this [I say], He that soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he that soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.

title: 2 Corinthians 9:7
text: [ Let] each man [do] according as he hath purposed in his heart: not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

title: 2 Corinthians 9:8
text: And God is able to make all grace abound unto you; that ye, having always all sufficiency in everything, may abound unto every good work:

title: 2 Corinthians 9:9
text: as it is written, He hath scattered abroad, he hath given to the poor; His righteousness abideth for ever.

title: 2 Corinthians 9:10
text: And he that supplieth seed to the sower and bread for food, shall supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness:

title: 2 Corinthians 9:11
text: ye being enriched in everything unto all liberality, which worketh through us thanksgiving to God.

title: 2 Corinthians 9:12
text: For the ministration of this service not only filleth up the measure of the wants of the saints, but aboundeth also through many thanksgivings unto God;

title: 2 Corinthians 9:13
text: seeing that through the proving [of you] by this ministration they glorify God for the obedience of your confession unto the gospel of Christ, and for the liberality of [your] contribution unto them and unto all;

title: 2 Corinthians 9:14
text: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, long after you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.

title: 2 Corinthians 9:15
text: Thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift.

title: 2 Corinthians 10:1
text: Now I Paul myself entreat you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am of good courage toward you:

title: 2 Corinthians 10:2
text: yea, I beseech you, that I may not when present show courage with the confidence wherewith I count to be bold against some, who count of us as if we walked according to the flesh.

title: 2 Corinthians 10:3
text: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war according to the flesh

title: 2 Corinthians 10:4
text: (for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the casting down of strongholds),

title: 2 Corinthians 10:5
text: casting down imaginations, and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God, and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ;

title: 2 Corinthians 10:6
text: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience, when your obedience shall be made full.

title: 2 Corinthians 10:7
text: Ye look at the things that are before your face. If any man trusteth in himself that he is Christ's, let him consider this again with himself, that, even as he is Christ's, so also are we.

title: 2 Corinthians 10:8
text: For though I should glory somewhat abundantly concerning our authority (which the Lord gave for building you up, and not for casting you down), I shall not be put to shame:

title: 2 Corinthians 10:9
text: that I may not seem as if I would terrify you by my letters.

title: 2 Corinthians 10:10
text: For, His letters, they say, are weighty and strong; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech of no account.

title: 2 Corinthians 10:11
text: Let such a one reckon this, that, what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such [are we] also in deed when we are present.

title: 2 Corinthians 10:12
text: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with certain of them that commend themselves: but they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.

title: 2 Corinthians 10:13
text: But we will not glory beyond [our] measure, but according to the measure of the province which God apportioned to us as a measure, to reach even unto you.

title: 2 Corinthians 10:14
text: For we stretch not ourselves overmuch, as though we reached not unto you: for we came even as far as unto you in the gospel of Christ:

title: 2 Corinthians 10:15
text: not glorying beyond [our] measure, [that is], in other men's labors; but having hope that, as your faith groweth, we shall be magnified in you according to our province unto [further] abundance,

title: 2 Corinthians 10:16
text: so as to preach the gospel even unto the parts beyond you, [and] not to glory in another's province in regard of things ready to our hand.

title: 2 Corinthians 10:17
text: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.

title: 2 Corinthians 10:18
text: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:1
text: Would that ye could bear with me in a little foolishness: but indeed ye do bear with me.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:2
text: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy: for I espoused you to one husband, that I might present you [as] a pure virgin to Christ.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:3
text: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve in his craftiness, your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity and the purity that is toward Christ.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:4
text: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we did not preach, or [if] ye receive a different spirit, which ye did not receive, or a different gospel, which ye did not accept, ye do well to bear with [him] .

title: 2 Corinthians 11:5
text: For I reckon that I am not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:6
text: But though [I be] rude in speech, yet [am I] not in knowledge; nay, in every way have we made [this] manifest unto you in all things.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:7
text: Or did I commit a sin in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I preached to you the gospel of God for nought?

title: 2 Corinthians 11:8
text: I robbed other churches, taking wages [of them] that I might minister unto you;

title: 2 Corinthians 11:9
text: and when I was present with you and was in want, I was not a burden on any man; for the brethren, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my want; and in everything I kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and [so] will I keep [myself] .

title: 2 Corinthians 11:10
text: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this glorying in the regions of Achaia.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:11
text: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:12
text: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them that desire an occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:13
text: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, fashioning themselves into apostles of Christ.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:14
text: And no marvel; for even Satan fashioneth himself into an angel of light.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:15
text: It is no great thing therefore if his ministers also fashion themselves as ministers of righteousness, whose end shall be according to their works.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:16
text: I say again, let no man think me foolish; but if [ye do], yet as foolish receive me, that I also may glory a little.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:17
text: That which I speak, I speak not after the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of glorying.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:18
text: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:19
text: For ye bear with the foolish gladly, being wise [yourselves] .

title: 2 Corinthians 11:20
text: For ye bear with a man, if he bringeth you into bondage, if he devoureth you, if he taketh you [captive], if he exalteth himself, if he smiteth you on the face.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:21
text: I speak by way of disparagement, as though we had been weak. Yet whereinsoever any is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:22
text: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:23
text: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself) I more; in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, in deaths oft.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:24
text: Of the Jews five times received I forty [stripes] save one.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:25
text: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day have I been in the deep;

title: 2 Corinthians 11:26
text: [ in] journeyings often, [in] perils of rivers, [in] perils of robbers, [in] perils from [my] countrymen, [in] perils from the Gentiles, [in] perils in the city, [in] perils in the wilderness, [in] perils in the sea, [in] perils among false brethren;

title: 2 Corinthians 11:27
text: [ in] labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:28
text: Besides those things that are without, there is that which presseth upon me daily, anxiety for all the churches.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:29
text: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is caused to stumble, and I burn not?

title: 2 Corinthians 11:30
text: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things that concern my weakness.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:31
text: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, he who is blessed for evermore knoweth that I lie not.

title: 2 Corinthians 11:32
text: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king guarded the city of the Damascenes in order to take me:

title: 2 Corinthians 11:33
text: and through a window was I let down in a basket by the wall, and escaped his hands.

title: 2 Corinthians 12:1
text: I must needs glory, though it is not expedient; but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

title: 2 Corinthians 12:2
text: I know a man in Christ, fourteen years ago (whether in the body, I know not; or whether out of the body, I know not; God knoweth), such a one caught up even to the third heaven.

title: 2 Corinthians 12:3
text: And I know such a man (whether in the body, or apart from the body, I know not; God knoweth),

title: 2 Corinthians 12:4
text: how that he was caught up into Paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

title: 2 Corinthians 12:5
text: On behalf of such a one will I glory: but on mine own behalf I will not glory, save in [my] weaknesses.

title: 2 Corinthians 12:6
text: For if I should desire to glory, I shall not be foolish; for I shall speak the truth: but I forbear, lest any man should account of me above that which he seeth me [to be], or heareth from me.

title: 2 Corinthians 12:7
text: And by reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted overmuch, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to buffet me, that I should not be exalted overmuch.

title: 2 Corinthians 12:8
text: Concerning this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.

title: 2 Corinthians 12:9
text: And he hath said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for [my] power is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

title: 2 Corinthians 12:10
text: Wherefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses, for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

title: 2 Corinthians 12:11
text: I am become foolish: ye compelled me; for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing was I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I am nothing.

title: 2 Corinthians 12:12
text: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, by signs and wonders and mighty works.

title: 2 Corinthians 12:13
text: For what is there wherein ye were made inferior to the rest of the churches, except [it be] that I myself was not a burden to you? forgive me this wrong.

title: 2 Corinthians 12:14
text: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be a burden to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

title: 2 Corinthians 12:15
text: And I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

title: 2 Corinthians 12:16
text: But be it so, I did not myself burden you; but, being crafty, I caught you with guile.

title: 2 Corinthians 12:17
text: Did I take advantage of you by any one of them whom I have sent unto you?

title: 2 Corinthians 12:18
text: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? walked we not in the same spirit? [walked we] not in the same steps?

title: 2 Corinthians 12:19
text: Ye think all this time that we are excusing ourselves unto you. In the sight of God speak we in Christ. But all things, beloved, [are] for your edifying.

title: 2 Corinthians 12:20
text: For I fear, lest by any means, when I come, I should find you not such as I would, and should myself be found of you such as ye would not; lest by any means [there should be] strife, jealousy, wraths, factions, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults;

title: 2 Corinthians 12:21
text: lest again when I come my God should humble me before you, and I should mourn for many of them that have sinned heretofore, and repented not of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they committed.

title: 2 Corinthians 13:1
text: This is the third time I am coming to you. At the mouth of two witnesses or three shall every word be established.

title: 2 Corinthians 13:2
text: I have said beforehand, and I do say beforehand, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, to them that have sinned heretofore, and to all the rest, that, if I come again, I will not spare;

title: 2 Corinthians 13:3
text: seeing that ye seek a proof of Christ that speaketh in me; who to you-ward is not weak, but is powerful in you:

title: 2 Corinthians 13:4
text: for he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him through the power of God toward you.

title: 2 Corinthians 13:5
text: Try your own selves, whether ye are in the faith; prove your own selves. Or know ye not as to your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you? unless indeed ye be reprobate.

title: 2 Corinthians 13:6
text: But I hope that ye shall know that we are not reprobate.

title: 2 Corinthians 13:7
text: Now we pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that ye may do that which is honorable, though we be as reprobate.

title: 2 Corinthians 13:8
text: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

title: 2 Corinthians 13:9
text: For we rejoice, when we are weak, and ye are strong: this we also pray for, even your perfecting.

title: 2 Corinthians 13:10
text: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not when present deal sharply, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up, and not for casting down.

title: 2 Corinthians 13:11
text: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfected; be comforted; be of the same mind; live in peace: and the God of love and peace shall be with you.

title: 2 Corinthians 13:12
text: Salute one another with a holy kiss.

title: 2 Corinthians 13:13
text: All the saints salute you.

title: 2 Corinthians 13:14
text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Spirit, be with you all.

title: Galatians 1:1
text: Paul, an apostle (not from men, neither through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead),

title: Galatians 1:2
text: and all the brethren that are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:

title: Galatians 1:3
text: Grace to you and peace from God the Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,

title: Galatians 1:4
text: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil world, according to the will of our God and Father:

title: Galatians 1:5
text: to whom [be] the glory for ever and ever. Amen.

title: Galatians 1:6
text: I marvel that ye are so quickly removing from him that called you in the grace of Christ unto a different gospel;

title: Galatians 1:7
text: which is not another [gospel] only there are some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.

title: Galatians 1:8
text: But though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach unto you any gospel other than that which we preached unto you, let him be anathema.

title: Galatians 1:9
text: As we have said before, so say I now again, if any man preacheth unto you any gospel other than that which ye received, let him be anathema.

title: Galatians 1:10
text: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? or am I striving to please men? if I were still pleasing men, I should not be a servant of Christ.

title: Galatians 1:11
text: For I make known to you, brethren, as touching the gospel which was preached by me, that it is not after man.

title: Galatians 1:12
text: For neither did I receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but [it came to me] through revelation of Jesus Christ.

title: Galatians 1:13
text: For ye have heard of my manner of life in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and made havoc of it:

title: Galatians 1:14
text: and I advanced in the Jews' religion beyond many of mine own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

title: Galatians 1:15
text: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me, [even] from my mother's womb, and called me through his grace,

title: Galatians 1:16
text: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles; straightway I conferred not with flesh and blood:

title: Galatians 1:17
text: neither went I up to Jerusalem to them that were apostles before me: but I went away into Arabia; and again I returned unto Damascus.

title: Galatians 1:18
text: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Cephas, and tarried with him fifteen days.

title: Galatians 1:19
text: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.

title: Galatians 1:20
text: Now touching the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.

title: Galatians 1:21
text: Then I came unto the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

title: Galatians 1:22
text: And I was still unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:

title: Galatians 1:23
text: but they only heard say, He that once persecuted us now preacheth the faith of which he once made havoc;

title: Galatians 1:24
text: and they glorified God in me.

title: Galatians 2:1
text: Then after the space of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

title: Galatians 2:2
text: And I went up by revelation; and I laid before them the gospel which I preach among the Gentiles but privately before them who were of repute, lest by any means I should be running, or had run, in vain.

title: Galatians 2:3
text: But not even Titus who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:

title: Galatians 2:4
text: and that because of the false brethren privily brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:

title: Galatians 2:5
text: to whom we gave place in the way of subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.

title: Galatians 2:6
text: But from those who were reputed to be somewhat (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth not man's person)--they, I say, who were of repute imparted nothing to me:

title: Galatians 2:7
text: but contrariwise, when they saw that I had been intrusted with the gospel of the uncircumcision, even as Peter with [the gospel] of the circumcision

title: Galatians 2:8
text: (for he that wrought for Peter unto the apostleship of the circumcision wrought for me also unto the Gentiles);

title: Galatians 2:9
text: and when they perceived the grace that was given unto me, James and Cephas and John, they who were reputed to be pillars, gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship, that we should go unto the Gentiles, and they unto the circumcision;

title: Galatians 2:10
text: only [they would] that we should remember the poor; which very thing I was also zealous to do.

title: Galatians 2:11
text: But when Cephas came to Antioch, I resisted him to the face, because he stood condemned.

title: Galatians 2:12
text: For before that certain came from James, he ate with the Gentiles; but when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing them that were of the circumcision.

title: Galatians 2:13
text: And the rest of the Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that even Barnabas was carried away with their dissimulation.

title: Galatians 2:14
text: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Cephas before [them] all, If thou, being a Jew, livest as do the Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, how compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?

title: Galatians 2:15
text: We being Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,

title: Galatians 2:16
text: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed on Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ, and not by the works of the law: because by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.

title: Galatians 2:17
text: But if, while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a minister of sin? God forbid.

title: Galatians 2:18
text: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a transgressor.

title: Galatians 2:19
text: For I through the law died unto the law, that I might live unto God.

title: Galatians 2:20
text: I have been crucified with Christ; and it is no longer I that live, but Christ living in me: and that [life] which I now live in the flesh I live in faith, [the faith] which is in the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself up for me.

title: Galatians 2:21
text: I do not make void the grace of God: for if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nought.

title: Galatians 3:1
text: O foolish Galatians, who did bewitch you, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly set forth crucified?

title: Galatians 3:2
text: This only would I learn from you. Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

title: Galatians 3:3
text: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now perfected in the flesh?

title: Galatians 3:4
text: Did ye suffer so many things in vain? if it be indeed in vain.

title: Galatians 3:5
text: He therefore that supplieth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, [doeth he it] by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

title: Galatians 3:6
text: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned unto him for righteousness.

title: Galatians 3:7
text: Know therefore that they that are of faith, the same are sons of Abraham.

title: Galatians 3:8
text: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the gospel beforehand unto Abraham, [saying], In thee shall all the nations be blessed.

title: Galatians 3:9
text: So then they that are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

title: Galatians 3:10
text: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one who continueth not in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.

title: Galatians 3:11
text: Now that no man is justified by the law before God, is evident: for, The righteous shall live by faith;

title: Galatians 3:12
text: and the law is not of faith; but, He that doeth them shall live in them.

title: Galatians 3:13
text: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us; for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:

title: Galatians 3:14
text: that upon the Gentiles might come the blessing of Abraham in Christ Jesus; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

title: Galatians 3:15
text: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men: Though it be but a man's covenant, yet when it hath been confirmed, no one maketh it void, or addeth thereto.

title: Galatians 3:16
text: Now to Abraham were the promises spoken, and to his seed. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.

title: Galatians 3:17
text: Now this I say: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God, the law, which came four hundred and thirty years after, doth not disannul, so as to make the promise of none effect.

title: Galatians 3:18
text: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise: but God hath granted it to Abraham by promise.

title: Galatians 3:19
text: What then is the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise hath been made; [and it was] ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

title: Galatians 3:20
text: Now a mediator is not [a mediator] of one; but God is one.

title: Galatians 3:21
text: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could make alive, verily righteousness would have been of the law.

title: Galatians 3:22
text: But the scriptures shut up all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.

title: Galatians 3:23
text: But before faith came, we were kept in ward under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

title: Galatians 3:24
text: So that the law is become our tutor [to bring us] unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

title: Galatians 3:25
text: But now that faith is come, we are no longer under a tutor.

title: Galatians 3:26
text: For ye are all sons of God, through faith, in Christ Jesus.

title: Galatians 3:27
text: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ did put on Christ.

title: Galatians 3:28
text: There can be neither Jew nor Greek, there can be neither bond nor free, there can be no male and female; for ye all are one [man] in Christ Jesus.

title: Galatians 3:29
text: And if ye are Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, heirs according to promise.

title: Galatians 4:1
text: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he differeth nothing from a bondservant though he is lord of all;

title: Galatians 4:2
text: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed of the father.

title: Galatians 4:3
text: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the rudiments of the world:

title: Galatians 4:4
text: but when the fulness of the time came, God sent forth his Son, born of a woman, born under the law,

title: Galatians 4:5
text: that he might redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.

title: Galatians 4:6
text: And because ye are sons, God sent forth the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

title: Galatians 4:7
text: So that thou art no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir through God.

title: Galatians 4:8
text: Howbeit at that time, not knowing God, ye were in bondage to them that by nature are no gods:

title: Galatians 4:9
text: but now that ye have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, how turn ye back again to the weak and beggarly rudiments, whereunto ye desire to be in bondage over again?

title: Galatians 4:10
text: Ye observe days, and months, and seasons, and years.

title: Galatians 4:11
text: I am afraid of you, lest by any means I have bestowed labor upon you in vain.

title: Galatians 4:12
text: I beseech you, brethren, become as I [am], for I also [am become] as ye [are] . Ye did me no wrong:

title: Galatians 4:13
text: but ye know that because of an infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you the first time:

title: Galatians 4:14
text: and that which was a temptation to you in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but ye received me as an angel of God, [even] as Christ Jesus.

title: Galatians 4:15
text: Where then is that gratulation of yourselves? for I bear you witness, that, if possible, ye would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

title: Galatians 4:16
text: So then am I become your enemy, by telling you the truth?

title: Galatians 4:17
text: They zealously seek you in no good way; nay, they desire to shut you out, that ye may seek them.

title: Galatians 4:18
text: But it is good to be zealously sought in a good matter at all times, and not only when I am present with you.

title: Galatians 4:19
text: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ be formed in you--

title: Galatians 4:20
text: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone; for I am perplexed about you.

title: Galatians 4:21
text: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?

title: Galatians 4:22
text: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, one by the handmaid, and one by the freewoman.

title: Galatians 4:23
text: Howbeit the [son] by the handmaid is born after the flesh; but the [son] by the freewoman [is born] through promise.

title: Galatians 4:24
text: Which things contain an allegory: for these [women] are two covenants; one from mount Sinai, bearing children unto bondage, which is Hagar.

title: Galatians 4:25
text: Now this Hagar is mount Sinai in Arabia and answereth to the Jerusalem that now is: for she is in bondage with her children.

title: Galatians 4:26
text: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is our mother.

title: Galatians 4:27
text: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; Break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: For more are the children of the desolate than of her that hath the husband.

title: Galatians 4:28
text: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

title: Galatians 4:29
text: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him [that was born] after the Spirit, so also it is now.

title: Galatians 4:30
text: Howbeit what saith the scripture? Cast out the handmaid and her son: for the son of the handmaid shall not inherit with the son of the freewoman.

title: Galatians 4:31
text: Wherefore, brethren, we are not children of a handmaid, but of the freewoman.

title: Galatians 5:1
text: For freedom did Christ set us free: stand fast therefore, and be not entangled again in a yoke of bondage.

title: Galatians 5:2
text: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that, if ye receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

title: Galatians 5:3
text: Yea, I testify again to every man that receiveth circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

title: Galatians 5:4
text: Ye are severed from Christ, ye who would be justified by the law; ye are fallen away from grace.

title: Galatians 5:5
text: For we through the Spirit by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

title: Galatians 5:6
text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision; but faith working through love.

title: Galatians 5:7
text: Ye were running well; who hindered you that ye should not obey the truth?

title: Galatians 5:8
text: This persuasion [came] not of him that calleth you.

title: Galatians 5:9
text: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

title: Galatians 5:10
text: I have confidence to you-ward in the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

title: Galatians 5:11
text: But I, brethren, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? then hath the stumbling-block of the cross been done away.

title: Galatians 5:12
text: I would that they that unsettle you would even go beyond circumcision.

title: Galatians 5:13
text: For ye, brethren, were called for freedom; only [use] not your freedom for an occasion to the flesh, but through love be servants one to another.

title: Galatians 5:14
text: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, [even] in this: Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.

title: Galatians 5:15
text: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

title: Galatians 5:16
text: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

title: Galatians 5:17
text: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; for these are contrary the one to the other; that ye may not do the things that ye would.

title: Galatians 5:18
text: But if ye are led by the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

title: Galatians 5:19
text: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are [these] : fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

title: Galatians 5:20
text: idolatry, sorcery, enmities, strife, jealousies, wraths, factions, divisions, parties,

title: Galatians 5:21
text: envyings, drunkenness, revellings, and such like; of which I forewarn you, even as I did forewarn you, that they who practise such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

title: Galatians 5:22
text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,

title: Galatians 5:23
text: meekness, self-control; against such there is no law.

title: Galatians 5:24
text: And they that are of Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with the passions and the lusts thereof.

title: Galatians 5:25
text: If we live by the Spirit, by the Spirit let us also walk.

title: Galatians 5:26
text: Let us not become vainglorious, provoking one another, envying one another.

title: Galatians 6:1
text: Brethren, even if a man be overtaken in any trespass, ye who are spiritual, restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

title: Galatians 6:2
text: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

title: Galatians 6:3
text: For if a man thinketh himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

title: Galatians 6:4
text: But let each man prove his own work, and then shall he have his glorying in regard of himself alone, and not of his neighbor.

title: Galatians 6:5
text: For each man shall bear his own burden.

title: Galatians 6:6
text: But let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.

title: Galatians 6:7
text: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

title: Galatians 6:8
text: For he that soweth unto his own flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth unto the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap eternal life.

title: Galatians 6:9
text: And let us not be weary in well-doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

title: Galatians 6:10
text: So then, as we have opportunity, let us work that which is good toward all men, and especially toward them that are of the household of the faith.

title: Galatians 6:11
text: See with how large letters I write unto you with mine own hand.

title: Galatians 6:12
text: As many as desire to make a fair show in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

title: Galatians 6:13
text: For not even they who receive circumcision do themselves keep the law; but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

title: Galatians 6:14
text: But far be it from me to glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world hath been crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

title: Galatians 6:15
text: For neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

title: Galatians 6:16
text: And as many as shall walk by this rule, peace [be] upon them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

title: Galatians 6:17
text: Henceforth, let no man trouble me; for I bear branded on my body the marks of Jesus.

title: Galatians 6:18
text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brethren. Amen.

title: Ephesians 1:1
text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints that are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

title: Ephesians 1:2
text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Ephesians 1:3
text: Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly [places] in Christ:

title: Ephesians 1:4
text: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blemish before him in love:

title: Ephesians 1:5
text: having foreordained us unto adoption as sons through Jesus Christ unto himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

title: Ephesians 1:6
text: to the praise of the glory of his grace, which he freely bestowed on us in the Beloved:

title: Ephesians 1:7
text: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,

title: Ephesians 1:8
text: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

title: Ephesians 1:9
text: making known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

title: Ephesians 1:10
text: unto a dispensation of the fulness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens, and the things upon the earth; in him, [I say],

title: Ephesians 1:11
text: in whom also we were made a heritage, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his will;

title: Ephesians 1:12
text: to the end that we should be unto the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ:

title: Ephesians 1:13
